A-PLS: Pulse Rifle.name: A-PLS: Pulse Rifle
A-PLS: Pulse Rifle.desc: The A-PLS: Pulse Rifle is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When used, it fires a purple hitscan beam that dissipates into 4 pulse orbs on enemy hits that deal 50% of the weapon's damage and pierce up to 3 times before dissipating.
A-PLS: Pulse Rifle.tip: Fires an enhanced pulse beam that dissipates into 4 high-frequency pulse orbs on hit · Pulse orbs aggressively track nearby targets and track faster the more they hit · Pulse orb pierce will not decrease when killing enemies or dealing low damage · 'My own personal weapon, used to stamp out failed creations. · I have backed up the schematics in the event of the original's destruction.'

Ascendant Spirit Essence.name: Ascendant Spirit Essence
Ascendant Spirit Essence.desc: Ascendant Spirit Essence is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is a combination of Necroplasm, Nightmare Fuel, Endothermic Energy, and Darksun Fragments. It is used to craft several powerful post-Devourer of Gods items.
Ascendant Spirit Essence.tip: A catalyst of the highest caliber formed by fusing powerful souls

Cosmilite Bar.name: Cosmilite Bar
Cosmilite Bar.desc: Cosmilite Bars are post-Moon Lord bars that are used to craft many pieces of late-game equipment as well as Cosmilite-related items. They are dropped by The Devourer of Gods.
Cosmilite Bar.tip: A chunk of durable and highly resilient cosmic steel

Dubious Plating.name: Dubious Plating
Dubious Plating.desc: Dubious Platings are crafting materials that are found in the Arsenal Labs in the Cavern layer and dropped by Burrowers. They are used in the crafting of various weapons, furniture, and other items alongside Mysterious Circuitry.

Mysterious Circuitry.name: Mysterious Circuitry
Mysterious Circuitry.desc: Mysterious Circuitry are crafting materials that are found in Arsenal Labs in the Cavern layer and dropped by Burrowers. They are used in the crafting of various weapons, furniture, and other items alongside Dubious Plating.

Abombination.name: Abombination
Abombination.desc: The Abombination is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Plaguebringer Goliath. It can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle, and can only be crafted after decrypting the Encrypted Schematic (Jungle) at The Codebreaker.
Abombination.tip: Summons the Plaguebringer Goliath when used in the Jungle · Enrages outside the Jungle · Not consumable · 'Radio capable of emitting a frequency recognized by the Plague nanovirus.'

Plague Cell Canister.name: Plague Cell Canister
Plague Cell Canister.desc: Plague Cell Canisters are a Hardmode crafting material dropped by various plague-related enemies in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated.

Abyss Bathtub.name: Abyss Bathtub
Abyss Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Smooth Abyss Gravel.name: Smooth Abyss Gravel
Smooth Abyss Gravel.desc: Smooth Abyss Gravel is a craftable block crafted from Abyss Gravel at a Work Bench. It is used in the crafting of Abyss furniture.

Abyss Bed.name: Abyss Bed
Abyss Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silk.name: Silk
Silk.desc: Silk is an item used to craft the Bed, as well as several placeable decorative items and vanity clothing items.

Abyss Blade.name: Abyss Blade
Abyss Blade.desc: The Abyss Blade is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that is the direct upgrade to the Depth Crusher. When used, it throws a gravity-affected spinning abyssal sword that pierces infinitely.
Abyss Blade.tip: Tosses a spinning abyssal sword that slices through enemies and releases water energy upon hitting a tile · The sword will fly towards enemies after a ricochet, dealing 2x damage

Depth Cells.name: Depth Cells
Depth Cells.desc: Depth Cells are a Hardmode crafting material dropped by enemies in the Abyss after Leviathan and Anahita have been defeated. It is used in crafting many aquatic themed items, typically in conjunction with Lumenyl.

Depth Crusher.name: Depth Crusher
Depth Crusher.desc: The Depth Crusher is a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that is dropped by Viperfish. It also has a chance to be inside the Abyss Shrine's Void Chest.
Depth Crusher.tip: Tosses a heavy abyssal crusher that releases water energy upon hitting a tile · The crusher will ricochet off of tiles and enemies

Voidstone.name: Voidstone
Voidstone.desc: Voidstone is a block that generates in the 4th layer of the Abyss. It requires at least an Adamantite, Titanium, or Shardlight Pickaxe to mine. It is also dropped by enemies that spawn in the lower layers of the Abyss.

Abyss Bookcase.name: Abyss Bookcase
Abyss Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Book.name: Book
Book.desc: The Book is a crafting material used only to craft Bookcases, Pianos, and Librarian Blocks. It can also be placed as decoration on Flat-surface items. Books are found placed on the Dungeon's many shelves, where they can be freed with a pickaxe or drill.
Book.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'It contains strange symbols'

Abyss Candelabra.name: Abyss Candelabra
Abyss Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Abyss Candle.name: Abyss Candle
Abyss Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Abyss Chair.name: Abyss Chair
Abyss Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Abyss Chandelier.name: Abyss Chandelier
Abyss Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Chain.name: Chain
Chain.desc: Chains are used both for climbing and as components for various crafting recipes. They are used in crafting items such as the Grappling Hook, Sawmill, all types of watches, and chandeliers.

Abyss Chest.name: Abyss Chest
Abyss Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Any Iron Bar.name: Any Iron Bar
Any Iron Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as "Any <groupname>". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be crafted with regular Wood, Ebonwood, Shadewood, etc.

Abyss Clock.name: Abyss Clock
Abyss Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Glass.name: Glass
Glass.desc: Glass is crafted from different types of sand at a Furnace. Glass can be placed as a block and is an ingredient in producing various items.

Abyss Door.name: Abyss Door
Abyss Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyss Dresser.name: Abyss Dresser
Abyss Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyss Gravel.name: Abyss Gravel
Abyss Gravel.desc: Abyss Gravel is a block that generates naturally in the second layer of the Abyss. It can be mined with a Nightmare Pickaxe or a Deathbringer Pickaxe. It emits water particles when mined.

Abyss Gravel Wall.name: Abyss Gravel Wall
Abyss Gravel Wall.desc: Abyss Gravel Walls are background walls that are naturally generated in the Abyss. Naturally-generated walls cannot be destroyed or collected and spawn water in front of them whenever a nearby tile updates.

Abyss Lamp.name: Abyss Lamp
Abyss Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyss Lantern.name: Abyss Lantern
Abyss Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyss Sink.name: Abyss Sink
Abyss Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Water Bucket.name: Water Bucket
Water Bucket.desc: Buckets are tools used to carry water, lava, or honey, allowing them to be removed or placed.
Water Bucket.tip: Contains a small amount of water · Can be poured out

Abyss Sofa.name: Abyss Sofa
Abyss Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Abyss Synth.name: Abyss Synth
Abyss Synth.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Bone.name: Bone
Bone.desc: Bones are crafting materials and consumable ranged weapons. They are dropped by Angry Bones, Dark Casters, Cursed Skulls, and Librarian Skeletons which spawn in the Dungeon.

Abyss Table.name: Abyss Table
Abyss Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyss Work Bench.name: Abyss Work Bench
Abyss Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Abyssal Diving Gear.name: Abyssal Diving Gear
Abyssal Diving Gear.desc: The Abyssal Diving Gear is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Arctic Diving Gear and Depths Charm. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Abyssal Diving Gear.tip: Reduces the damage caused by the pressure of the abyss while out of breath · Grants the ability to swim and greatly extends underwater breathing · Provides light underwater and extra mobility on ice · Provides a moderate amount of light and reduces breath loss in the abyss

Arctic Diving Gear.name: Arctic Diving Gear
Arctic Diving Gear.desc: The Arctic Diving Gear is an accessory which is crafted by combining the Jellyfish Diving Gear and Ice Skates at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the functionalities of its ingredients:
Arctic Diving Gear.tip: Grants the ability to swim and greatly extends underwater breathing · Provides extra mobility on ice · Generates a very subtle glow which becomes more vibrant underwater

Depths Charm.name: Depths Charm
Depths Charm.desc: The Depths Charm is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. While equipped, it reduces the damage the player takes when out of breath in the Abyss by 40 damage per second.
Depths Charm.tip: Reduces the damage caused by drowning in the abyss · Removes the increased breath loss of Crush Depth

Lumenyl.name: Lumenyl
Lumenyl.desc: Lumenyl is a Hardmode crafting material that grows on blocks and is dropped by enemies in the Abyss after Leviathan and Anahita have been defeated. It is used in crafting the Stratus set and some aquatic items.

Abyssal Diving Suit.name: Abyssal Diving Suit
Abyssal Diving Suit.desc: The Abyssal Diving Suit is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it provides several benefits for swimming.
Abyssal Diving Suit.tip: Transforms the holder into an armored diver: · Increases max movement speed and acceleration while underwater, but reduces it outside of water · Grants the ability to swim, extends underwater breathing, emits light underwater, and improves mobility on ice · Provides a moderate amount of light, reduces breath loss, and reduces damage caused by drowning in the abyss · Abyss creatures are less likely to see you, mitigates the abyss' defense reduction, and lets you sink faster in liquids · Grants immunity to the sulphurous waters and Crush Depth's increased breath loss · Grants resistance to the increased breath loss caused by Hadopelagic Pressure

Anechoic Plating.name: Anechoic Plating
Anechoic Plating.desc: Anechoic Plating is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. When equipped, it makes Abyss enemies less likely to detect the player and reduces the defense reduction caused from the Abyss by 2/3.
Anechoic Plating.tip: Abyss creatures are less likely to see you · Mitigates the defense reduction from the abyss' pressure

Luminite Bar.name: Luminite Bar
Luminite Bar.desc: The Luminite Bar is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord bar.

Mollusk Husk.name: Mollusk Husk
Mollusk Husk.desc: Mollusk Husks are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Clams and the Giant Clam mini boss. They are used to craft several defensive and water-themed items.
usedIn: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

Abyssal Mirror.name: Abyssal Mirror
Abyssal Mirror.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Abyssal Mirror.tip: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'

Ink Bomb.name: Ink Bomb
Ink Bomb.desc: The Ink Bomb is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by Cuttlefish and Colossal Squids. It also has a chance to be inside the Abyss Shrine's Void Chest. It grants the following effects when equipped:
Ink Bomb.tip: Stealth generates 7% faster · Throws several ink bombs when hit that explode into ink and confuse enemies · Gain a lot of stealth when struck · This effect has a 20 second cooldown before it can occur again

Mirage Mirror.name: Mirage Mirror
Mirage Mirror.desc: The Mirage Mirror is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.
Mirage Mirror.tip: Reduces enemy aggression outside of the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · 'Bend light around you'

Abyssal Warhammer.name: Abyssal Warhammer
Abyssal Warhammer.desc: The Abyssal Warhammer is a craftable Hardmode hammer.

Cryonic Bar.name: Cryonic Bar
Cryonic Bar.desc: Cryonic Bars are Hardmode bars that are made with 4 Cryonic Ore at a Hardmode Forge and are additionally dropped from the Fleshy and Necromantic Geode. They are mainly used in the crafting of crystal-themed items, as well as being used to craft Life Alloys.

Ace's Apron of Affection.name: Ace's Apron of Affection
Ace's Apron of Affection.desc: Ace's Apron of Affection is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity item that can only be worn in the social shirt slot.

Life Crystal.name: Life Crystal
Life Crystal.desc: The Life Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's health capacity by 20, adding a red heart to the player's health bar, while also restoring 20health.

Love Potion.name: Love Potion
Love Potion.desc: The Love Potion is a Hardmode thrown potion that functions similarly to Thrown Water.
Love Potion.tip: Throw this to make someone fall in love

Robe.name: Robe
Robe.desc: Robes are equipable items, most of which provide magic damage bonuses and are a part of the Wizard set. All gem robes are adapted from the Robe, a vanity item equipped in the shirt slot. They resemble the robes worn by Dark Casters and Tim.

Ace's High.name: Ace's High
Ace's High.desc: The Ace's High is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used, it fires a line of four playing cards in the order of a heart, club, diamond, and spade, with a mild delay between each set. Each of the cards has varying effects.
Ace's High.tip: Fires a string of cards with varying effects based on card type · Hearts grant lifesteal · Spades pierce enemies · Diamonds violently explode · Clubs split into three

Auric Bar.name: Auric Bar
Auric Bar.desc: Auric Bars are post-Moon Lord bars that are made with Auric Ore and a Yharon Soul Fragment. They are used in creating some of the most powerful items the Calamity Mod has to offer, as well as Shadowspec Bars, which are used in the crafting of developer-tier items.
Auric Bar.tip: Boundless power emanates from the metal

Claret Cannon.name: Claret Cannon
Claret Cannon.desc: The Claret Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.
Claret Cannon.tip: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness, your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

Fantasy Talisman.name: Fantasy Talisman
Fantasy Talisman.desc: The Fantasy Talisman is a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, it throws a talisman card that sticks onto enemies, periodically releasing homing souls that deal 50% of the weapon's base damage. Up to 3 talismans can stick to an enemy at a time.
Fantasy Talisman.tip: Fires high velocity talismans that ignore gravity · Talismans attach to enemies, releasing vengeful souls that chase them down · Stealth strikes release more souls and erupt into lost souls on death · 'Good thing I didn't bet against you!'

Revolver.name: Revolver
Revolver.desc: The Revolver is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for after a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart has been smashed.
Revolver.tip: Well-timed shots reduce cooldown and increase critical strike chance

Acid Gun.name: Acid Gun
Acid Gun.desc: The Acid Gun is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires a volley of three acid streams that dissipate on collision with tiles or after piercing once. The acid streams inflict the Irradiated debuff.
Acid Gun.tip: Releases three streams of irradiated acid

Acidwood.name: Acidwood
Acidwood.desc: Acidwood is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by cutting down Acidwood Trees in the Sulphurous Sea biome. It is used to craft several weapons themed around the Acid Rain, as well as the Sulphurous armor.

Sulphuric Scale.name: Sulphuric Scale
Sulphuric Scale.desc: Sulphuric Scales are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by various enemies in the Acid Rain event after the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated. They are used to craft several weapons themed around the Acid Rain, as well as the Sulphurous armor.

Acid Rain Dye.name: Acid Rain Dye
Acid Rain Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Bottled Water.name: Bottled Water
Bottled Water.desc: Bottled Water is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion. It can be crafted at a sink or a body of water. Bottled Water mainly serves as the basis of almost every craftable potion in the game, and is also required for crafting flasks.

Acidwood Platform.name: Acidwood Platform
Acidwood Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Acidwood Wall.name: Acidwood Wall
Acidwood Wall.desc: Acidwood Wall is a background wall crafted with Acidwood.

Acidwood Bathtub.name: Acidwood Bathtub
Acidwood Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Bed.name: Acidwood Bed
Acidwood Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Bench.name: Acidwood Bench
Acidwood Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Acidwood Bookcase.name: Acidwood Bookcase
Acidwood Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Bow.name: Acidwood Bow
Acidwood Bow.desc: The Acidwood Bow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow.

Acidwood Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Acidwood Dresser.name: Acidwood Dresser
Acidwood Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Hammer.name: Acidwood Hammer
Acidwood Hammer.desc: The Acidwood Hammer is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hammer.

Acidwood Lamp.name: Acidwood Lamp
Acidwood Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Lantern.name: Acidwood Lantern
Acidwood Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Piano.name: Acidwood Piano
Acidwood Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Sink.name: Acidwood Sink
Acidwood Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Sword.name: Acidwood Sword
Acidwood Sword.desc: The Acidwood Sword is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Acidwood Table.name: Acidwood Table
Acidwood Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acidwood Work Bench.name: Acidwood Work Bench
Acidwood Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Acrobatic Bobber.name: Acrobatic Bobber
Acrobatic Bobber.desc: The Acrobatic Bobber is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory.
Acrobatic Bobber.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Provides a fishing minigame · Moving while fishing instead moves your bobbers · Rings appear over time above the water's surface · Touching a ring hooks an item onto the bobber · Bobbers will automatically reel in hooked items upon landing back in the water

Aerialite Bar.name: Aerialite Bar
Aerialite Bar.desc: Aerialite Bars are Pre-Hardmode bars made with 3 Aerialite Ore at a Furnace. They are used to craft various sky-themed items.

Fishing Bobber.name: Fishing Bobber
Fishing Bobber.desc: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Activated Auric Panel.name: Activated Auric Panel
Activated Auric Panel.desc: Activated Auric Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block.

Any Stone Block.name: Any Stone Block
Any Stone Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Auric Ore.name: Auric Ore
Auric Ore.desc: "Ancient draconic power manifests in the caverns, lacing itself through the rock."
Auric Ore.tip: Infused with long lost draconic energies
stats: 300 (If player) / 5% of maximum health (If NPC or Super Dummy)

Adamantite Particle Accelerator.name: Adamantite Particle Accelerator
Adamantite Particle Accelerator.desc: The Adamantite Particle Accelerator is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it fires a thick pink laser beam shortly followed by a thick blue laser beam.
Adamantite Particle Accelerator.tip: Charges and fires 2 beams of opposite polarities. Hitting with the opposite polarity increases the damage

Adamantite Bar.name: Adamantite Bar
Adamantite Bar.desc: The Adamantite Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Soul of Light.name: Soul of Light
Soul of Light.desc: Soul of Light is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Hallow (in the Cavern layer) with a 1/5 chance. This also includes enemies not native to the biome, such as Granite Elementals. See Notes for details.
usedIn: Soul of Light in a Bottle

Soul of Night.name: Soul of Night
Soul of Night.desc: Soul of Night is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Corruption or Underground Crimson (in the Cavern layer), with a 1/5 chance.
usedIn: Soul of Night in a Bottle

Adamantite Throwing Axe.name: Adamantite Throwing Axe
Adamantite Throwing Axe.desc: The Adamantite Throwing Axe is a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, it throws an adamantite axe that pierces twice and travels a short distance before being affected by gravity and losing 25% of the weapon's damage per hit.
Adamantite Throwing Axe.tip: Stealth strikes ignore gravity and rain down lightning on enemy hits

Advanced Display.name: Advanced Display
Advanced Display.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Life Alloy.name: Life Alloy
Life Alloy.desc: Life Alloys are Hardmode crafting materials crafted with Cryonic, Perennial, and Scoria Bars, additionally being dropped from Fleshy and Necromantic Geodes. They are primarily used in the crafting of many powerful upgrades.
usedIn: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

Aerial Hamaxe.name: Aerial Hamaxe
Aerial Hamaxe.desc: The Aerial Hamaxe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hamaxe.

Aerialite Ore.name: Aerialite Ore
Aerialite Ore.desc: "The sky is glittering with cyan light."

Aerialite Brick.name: Aerialite Brick
Aerialite Brick.desc: Aerialite Brick is a craftable brick crafted with Aerialite Ore and Stone Blocks.

Aerialite Brick Wall.name: Aerialite Brick Wall
Aerialite Brick Wall.desc: Aerialite Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Aerialite Brick.

Aerialite Dye.name: Aerialite Dye
Aerialite Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Cobalt Ore.name: Cobalt Ore
Cobalt Ore.desc: Cobalt Ore belongs to the first tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the first altar broken, either it or Palladium Ore can spawn in the underground and cavern layers. Mining Cobalt Ore requires a Molten Pickaxe or better.

Aerospec Breastplate.name: Aerospec Breastplate
Aerospec Breastplate.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
Aerospec Breastplate.tip: 3% increased damage and critical strike chance

Feather.name: Feather
Feather.desc: The Feather is a common crafting material dropped frequently by Harpies. It is used in crafting the Featherfall and Gravitation Potions and once again becomes important in Hardmode for crafting the first tier of wings – Angel and Demon Wings.

Aerospec Hat.name: Aerospec Hat
Aerospec Hat.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
Aerospec Hat.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 10% increased magic damage

Aerospec Headgear.name: Aerospec Headgear
Aerospec Headgear.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
Aerospec Headgear.tip: 10% increased rogue damage and 5% increased movement speed

Aerospec Helm.name: Aerospec Helm
Aerospec Helm.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

Aerospec Helmet.name: Aerospec Helmet
Aerospec Helmet.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
Aerospec Helmet.tip: 10% increased summon damage and 5% increased movement speed

Aerospec Hood.name: Aerospec Hood
Aerospec Hood.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

Aerospec Leggings.name: Aerospec Leggings
Aerospec Leggings.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

Aestheticus.name: Aestheticus
Aestheticus.desc: The Aestheticus is a craftable Pre-Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it swings in a similar manner to broadswords. It fires a homing crystal that splits into 4 more homing crystals which explode on collision. Both the main and split crystals inflict the Vaporfied debuff.
Aestheticus.tip: Fires crystals that explode and inflict Vaporfied · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

Fallen Star.name: Fallen Star
Fallen Star.desc: The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM). They can be used to craft Mana Crystals, which permanently increase a player's mana capacity by 20 points each.

Sea Prism.name: Sea Prism
Sea Prism.desc: Sea Prisms are a Pre-Hardmode ore found naturally generated within the Sunken Sea and can be crafted using Prism Shards. They require at least a Gold or Platinum Pickaxe to mine.

Aether Torch.name: Aether Torch
Aether Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Kelp Torch.name: Kelp Torch
Kelp Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that emit light when placed. The Calamity Mod currently adds eleven types of torches to the game which correspond to the existing biomes.

Marnite Light.desc: Torches are furniture items that emit light when placed. The Calamity Mod currently adds eleven types of torches to the game which correspond to the existing biomes.

Aether's Whisper.name: Aether's Whisper
Aether's Whisper.desc: The Aether's Whisper is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Plasma Rod. When used, it fires a laser beam that cannot pass through blocks and splits into 8 beams upon contact with tiles. The secondary beams can pass through blocks.
Aether's Whisper.tip: Fires void beams that gain damage as they travel and split on tile hits

Plasma Rod.name: Plasma Rod
Plasma Rod.desc: The Plasma Rod is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by Goblin Sorcerer and Tim. When used, it fires a shadow beam that does not pierce and inflicts the Shadowflame debuff on contact. If the beam hits a tile, it will split into eight smaller beams with higher damage.
Plasma Rod.tip: Casts a low-damage plasma bolt · Shooting a tile will cause several bolts with increased damage to fire · Shooting an enemy will inflict Shadowflame

Twisting Nether.name: Twisting Nether
Twisting Nether.desc: Twisting Nether is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is dropped by Signus. It is used in the crafting of various weapons, the Statis' Void Sash and other items.

Aetherflux Cannon.name: Aetherflux Cannon
Aetherflux Cannon.desc: The Aetherflux Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Nano Purge. When used, it spins up for about 0.5 seconds before rapidly firing pairs of fast yellow lasers which travel in a double helix pattern.
Aetherflux Cannon.tip: Fires a focused photon helix that phases through everything

Divine Geode.name: Divine Geode
Divine Geode.desc: Divine Geodes are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped exclusively by Providence, the Profaned Goddess.
Divine Geode.tip: A chunk of crystallized holy energy

Nano Purge.name: Nano Purge
Nano Purge.desc: The Nano Purge is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Laser Machinegun. When used, it spins up for about two seconds before spinning faster and firing volleys of two inaccurate nano beams that do not pierce.
Nano Purge.tip: Fires a barrage of nano lasers · Bounces towards the nearest enemy after hitting a wall

Uelibloom Bar.name: Uelibloom Bar
Uelibloom Bar.desc: Uelibloom Bars are craftable post-Moon Lord bars. They are used to craft Uelibloom-themed items along with various other items.

Aged Biolight.name: Aged Biolight
Aged Biolight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Caged Biolight.name: Caged Biolight
Caged Biolight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Caged Lablight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Aged Laboratory Console.name: Aged Laboratory Console
Aged Laboratory Console.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Draedon Power Cell.name: Draedon Power Cell
Draedon Power Cell.desc: Draedon Power Cells are consumable items that are generated by the Power Cell Factory. They can also be obtained from Repair Units. When used and correctly input at the Charging Station, it is able to add 1 unit of charge to chargeable weapons per power cell.
Draedon Power Cell.tip: Used to charge Draedon's weaponry at a Charging Station · Also can be processed by the Extractinator for spare parts

Rusted Plating.name: Rusted Plating
Rusted Plating.desc: Rusted Plating is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. It is used in the crafting of Aged Laboratory furniture.

Aged Laboratory Containment Box.name: Aged Laboratory Containment Box
Aged Laboratory Containment Box.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Laboratory Display.name: Aged Laboratory Display
Aged Laboratory Display.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Laboratory Door.name: Aged Laboratory Door
Aged Laboratory Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Aged Laboratory Electric Panel.name: Aged Laboratory Electric Panel
Aged Laboratory Electric Panel.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Laboratory Screen.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Laboratory Server.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Laboratory Terminal.name: Aged Laboratory Terminal
Aged Laboratory Terminal.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Reinforced Crate.name: Aged Reinforced Crate
Aged Reinforced Crate.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Aged Security Chest.name: Aged Security Chest
Aged Security Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Aglet.name: Aglet
Aglet.desc: The Aglet is a pre-Hardmode movement accessory that increases the player's movement speed by 5%. The Aglet has a 1/11 chance of being found inside surface Chests, or a 1/120 chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.

Any Copper Bar.name: Any Copper Bar
Any Copper Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Air Spinner.name: Air Spinner
Air Spinner.desc: The Air Spinner is a craftable Pre-Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it fires small golden feathers towards enemies within 20 tiles. The golden feathers fall slowly, do not pierce or pass through tiles, and deal 25% of the weapon's damage.
Air Spinner.tip: Reach: 20.625 tiles · Speed: 32 · Duration: 30 seconds · Fires feathers when enemies are near

Alchemical Decanter.name: Alchemical Decanter
Alchemical Decanter.desc: The Alchemical Decanter is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Alchemical Decanter.tip: All attacks inflict the Plague and reduces damage taken from the Plague by 50% · Projectiles spawn plague seekers on enemy hits · Releases plague bees and douses you in Honey (buff) when damaged

Bee Wax.name: Bee Wax
Bee Wax.desc: Bee Wax is a crafting material dropped by the Queen Bee. It cannot be crafted or placed. It takes 44 to craft a set of Bee armor and the Hornet Staff, which amounts to killing Queen Bee 2–3 times.

Honey Comb.name: Honey Comb
Honey Comb.desc: The Honey Comb is a pre-Hardmode accessory which has a 1/3 chance to be dropped by the Queen Bee. When equipped, it spawns 1–4 Bee projectiles which attack nearby enemies each time the player takes damage, and grants the Honey buff for 5 seconds after being damaged.
Honey Comb.tip: Releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged

Prism Shard.name: Prism Shard
Prism Shard.desc: Prism Shards are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are naturally generated in the Sunken Sea biome. They require at least a Gold or Platinum Pickaxe to mine.

Alluvion.name: Alluvion
Alluvion.desc: The Alluvion is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that is a direct upgrade to the Monsoon. When used, it rapidly auto-fires double volleys of 6 arrows.
Alluvion.tip: Unleashes a torrent of six arrows at once · Converts wooden arrows into a combination of sharks, torrential and typhoon arrows

Endothermic Energy.name: Endothermic Energy
Endothermic Energy.tip: Its deathly chill sucks the life from its surroundings

Monsoon.name: Monsoon
Monsoon.desc: The Monsoon is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that auto-fires five arrows at once. When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow.
Monsoon.tip: Fires a spread of 5 arrows · Wooden arrows are converted into typhoon arrows and sharks

Alpha Draconis.name: Alpha Draconis
Alpha Draconis.desc: Alpha Draconis is a post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Wyvern's Call and the final upgrade to the Sky Glaze. When used, it rains stars from the sky which home in on enemies. These projectiles have a chance to turn into Starburst on hit.
Alpha Draconis.tip: Calls down a meteor shower towards the cursor · Successful hits sometimes create Starbursts that can be picked up · Right Click with enough Starbursts to summon Draco to protect you · Draco burns Starbursts over time, and can be disspelled with Right Click · Draco inflicts Voidfrost · 'An imitation of insanity'

Exodium Cluster.name: Exodium Cluster
Exodium Cluster.desc: Exodium Cluster is a post-Moon Lord ore that generates alongside Luminite in Planetoids after Moon Lord has been defeated. It requires at least one of the Luminite Pickaxes to mine.
Exodium Cluster.tip: A cold cluster from the great unknown

Ruinous Soul.name: Ruinous Soul
Ruinous Soul.desc: Ruinous Souls are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by Polterghast. They are used to craft two armor sets, numerous weapons, the Phantom Heart, and Stratus Bricks.
Ruinous Soul.tip: A shard of the distant past

Wyvern's Call.name: Wyvern's Call
Wyvern's Call.desc: The Wyvern's Call is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Sky Glaze. When used, it rains downs three random projectiles, which can be the same type or different. All projectiles do not pierce or pass through tiles.
Wyvern's Call.tip: Fires wyverns and colored feathers from the sky that stick to enemies and tiles and explode · 'I call upon the mythical Wyvern to shower the lands with its grace'

Altar of the Accursed.name: Altar of the Accursed
Altar of the Accursed.desc: The Altar of the Accursed is a craftable post-Moon Lord furniture item. When right-clicked, it is used to summon Supreme Witch, Calamitas while Ashes of Calamity or a Ceremonial Urn is in the player's inventory.
Altar of the Accursed.tip: Offer Ashes of Calamity at this altar to summon the Witch · Doing so will create a square arena of blocks, with the altar at its center · The Witch enrages while you are outside of the arena · Hovering over the altar while using ruler measurements will display a temporary arena box · Used for special crafting

Brimstone Slag.name: Brimstone Slag
Brimstone Slag.desc: Brimstone Slag is a block that comprises most of the Brimstone Crag biome, and typically surrounds Infernal Suevite. It spawns naturally upon world generation and is also dropped from Despair Stones. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.

Core of Calamity.name: Core of Calamity
Core of Calamity.desc: Cores of Calamity are craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted from Ashes of Calamity, Ectoplasm and three different types of essence at a Hardmode Anvil.

Amalgamated Brain.name: Amalgamated Brain
Amalgamated Brain.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Amalgamated Brain.tip: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

Brain of Confusion.name: Brain of Confusion
Brain of Confusion.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Brain of Confusion.tip: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

Rotten Brain.name: Rotten Brain
Rotten Brain.desc: The Rotten Brain is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Hive Mind. When the player takes damage, a dank creeper is spawned which flies above the player and bursts into 2 shaderain clouds with a base damage of 8.
Rotten Brain.tip: Taking damage spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds

Ambrosial Ampoule.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
Ambrosial Ampoule.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ambrosial Ampoule.tip: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 75% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

Living Dew.name: Living Dew
Living Dew.desc: The Living Dew is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Honey Dew. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.75x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.
Living Dew.tip: Natural life regen is 75% more potent and returns 100% faster

Radiant Ooze.name: Radiant Ooze
Radiant Ooze.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + to +; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.
Radiant Ooze.tip: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)

Solar Fragment.name: Solar Fragment
Solar Fragment.desc: The Solar Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100.
Solar Fragment.tip: 'The fury of the universe lies within this fragment'

Ammo Reservation Potion.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
Ammo Reservation Potion.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%.

Blood Orb.name: Blood Orb
Blood Orb.desc: Blood Orbs are a crafting material dropped by several Blood Moon enemies after the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated. Additionally, the unique Blood Moon fishing enemies have a guaranteed independent drop of Blood Orbs in varying quantities.

Amphibian's Guitar.name: Amphibian's Guitar
Amphibian's Guitar.desc: The Amphibian's Guitar is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a guitar that spins around the player and fires notes at nearby enemies. Every three shots, the guitar instead fires a spread of three notes which are each able to pierce twice.
Amphibian's Guitar.tip: Summons up to 8 guitars that spin around you and shoot notes at the target, occasionally firing spread shots. · If all 8 guitars are present, some notes become empowered, dealing extra damage · 'I'll show you suffering!'

Frog.name: Frog
Frog.desc: The Frog is a harmless critter that spawns in the Jungle at any time. When in water, Frogs will swim along the water's surface. Frogs will occasionally croak when nearby.

Living Shard.name: Living Shard
Living Shard.desc: Living Shards are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Plantera. They are used to craft "Terra"-themed equipment, some permanent power-ups as well as the Reaver armor set, Living Dew and Stygian Shield.

The Axe.name: The Axe
The Axe.desc: The Axe is a Hardmode hamaxe that has a 1/50 / 1/20 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When swung, it produces an electric guitar sound that changes in tone depending on the distance from the cursor to the player.

Anarchy Blade.name: Anarchy Blade
Anarchy Blade.desc: The Anarchy Blade is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. Hitting an enemy generates a brimstone explosion that deals 100% base damage and inflicts the Brimstone Flames debuff. 10% of the player's missing health is added to the base damage of the sword.
Anarchy Blade.tip: The lower your life the more damage this blade does · Your hits will generate a large explosion · While below 50% life your hits have a chance to instantly kill regular enemies

Breaker Blade.name: Breaker Blade
Breaker Blade.desc: The Breaker Blade is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It has a larger size than most other swords. It deals 250% damage ( base damage) to enemies at 90% health or higher.
Breaker Blade.tip: Deals more damage to unhurt enemies

Unholy Core.name: Unholy Core
Unholy Core.desc: The Unholy Core is a craftable Hardmode crafting material crafted from Infernal Suevite and Hellstone at a Hellforge. It is used in the crafting of various Brimstone-themed equipment and some Ashen-themed items.

Ancient Altar.name: Ancient Altar
Ancient Altar.desc: The Ancient Altar is a Hardmode furniture item.

Scorched Bone.name: Scorched Bone
Scorched Bone.desc: Scorched Bone is a block obtained by cutting down Spine Trees in the Brimstone Crag biome. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.

Ancient Basin.name: Ancient Basin
Ancient Basin.desc: Basins are furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. Unlike the other furniture sets, only six types of basins exist in the Calamity Mod.

Ancient Bathtub.name: Ancient Bathtub
Ancient Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Bed.name: Ancient Bed
Ancient Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Bookcase.name: Ancient Bookcase
Ancient Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Chair.name: Ancient Chair
Ancient Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Ancient Chandelier.name: Ancient Chandelier
Ancient Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Door.name: Ancient Door
Ancient Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Dresser.name: Ancient Dresser
Ancient Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Fossil.name: Ancient Fossil
Ancient Fossil.desc: The Ancient Fossil is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it increases mining speed by 10% and grants immunity to damage from falling blocks.
Ancient Fossil.tip: Increases mining speed by 10% · Provides immunity to damage from falling blocks

Any Silt Block.name: Any Silt Block
Any Silt Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Ancient Lamp.name: Ancient Lamp
Ancient Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Lantern.name: Ancient Lantern
Ancient Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Monolith.name: Ancient Monolith
Ancient Monolith.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Navystone Bathtub.name: Ancient Navystone Bathtub
Ancient Navystone Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Smooth Navystone.name: Ancient Smooth Navystone

Lava Bucket.name: Lava Bucket
Lava Bucket.desc: Buckets are tools used to carry water, lava, or honey, allowing them to be removed or placed.
Lava Bucket.tip: Contains a small amount of lava · Can be poured out

Smooth Navystone.name: Smooth Navystone
Smooth Navystone.desc: Smooth Navystone is a Pre-Hardmode block that is crafted from Navystone at a Work Bench.

Ancient Smooth Navystone Wall.name: Ancient Smooth Navystone Wall
Ancient Smooth Navystone Wall.desc: Ancient Smooth Navystone Wall is a background wall crafted with Ancient Smooth Navystone.

Ancient Sofa.name: Ancient Sofa

Ancient Table.name: Ancient Table
Ancient Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ancient Work Bench.name: Ancient Work Bench
Ancient Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Anechoic Coating.name: Anechoic Coating
Anechoic Coating.desc: The Anechoic Coating is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion that is also dropped by Cuttlefish, Sulflounders, Frogfish, and Reaper Sharks. Upon consumption, it grants the Anechoic Coating buff, which reduces the Abyss enemies' detection radius.
Anechoic Coating.tip: Reduces creatures' ability to detect you in the abyss

Iron Boots.name: Iron Boots
Iron Boots.desc: The Iron Boots are a Pre-Hardmode accessory that are obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss.
Iron Boots.tip: Hold Down to increase your maximum fall speed, even in water · Upon hitting the ground, a shockwave is created at your feet · The shockwave scales in both damage and size the longer you fall for · Negates fall damage

Angel Treads.name: Angel Treads
Angel Treads.desc: The Angel Treads are a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Angel Treads.tip: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

Essence of Sunlight.name: Essence of Sunlight
Essence of Sunlight.desc: Essences of Sunlight are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain enemies related to the sky, storms, or the sun.
Essence of Sunlight.tip: The essence of sky, light, and storm creatures

Harpy Ring.name: Harpy Ring
Harpy Ring.desc: The Harpy Ring is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It increases 20% movement speed and flight time while equipped.
Harpy Ring.tip: 20% increased movement speed and flight time

Soul of Fright.name: Soul of Fright
Soul of Fright.desc: The Soul of Fright is one of the six souls. It is a crafting material dropped by Skeletron Prime.
usedIn: Soul of Fright in a Bottle

Soul of Might.name: Soul of Might
Soul of Might.desc: The Soul of Might is one of the six souls. It is a crafting material dropped by The Destroyer.
usedIn: Soul of Might in a Bottle

Soul of Sight.name: Soul of Sight
Soul of Sight.desc: The Soul of Sight is one of the six souls that can be obtained in Hardmode. It is a crafting material dropped by The Twins.
usedIn: Soul of Sight in a Bottle

Terraspark Boots.name: Terraspark Boots
Terraspark Boots.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Frostspark Boots and Lava Waders, and combines their functionality. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Terraspark Boots.tip: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

Angel Wings.name: Angel Wings
Angel Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Soul of Flight.name: Soul of Flight
Soul of Flight.desc: The Soul of Flight is a Hardmode crafting material used to craft several different types of wings and the Soul of Flight in a Bottle.
usedIn: Soul of Flight in a Bottle

Angelic Alliance.name: Angelic Alliance
Angelic Alliance.desc: The Angelic Alliance is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Angelic Alliance.tip: Call upon the force of heaven to empower your attacks and minions · Courage, Enlightenment, Bliss. United in Judgement · +2 max minions, 15% increased summon damage, and 8% increased damage to all other classes · +2 HP/s life regen while flight time is partially or fully expended · Press Angelic Alliance Blessing to grace yourself with the Divine Bless buff for 15 seconds · While active, an archangel is summoned for every minion you have · Archangels vaporize foes with heavenly light and each restore 2 HP upon spawning · Minion attacks inflict Banishing Fire, and you gain a flat 4 HP/s regen · This effect has a cooldown of 1 minute

Any Hallowed Greaves.name: Any Hallowed Greaves
Any Hallowed Greaves.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Any Hallowed Helmet.name: Any Hallowed Helmet
Any Hallowed Helmet.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Any Hallowed Plate Mail.name: Any Hallowed Plate Mail
Any Hallowed Plate Mail.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Cross Necklace.name: Cross Necklace
Cross Necklace.desc: The Cross Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that increases the duration of the invincibility a player is afforded after taking damage. The Cross Necklace has a 1/6 / 1/7 chance to be dropped by Mimics.
Cross Necklace.tip: Increases length of invincibility after taking damage

Paladin's Shield.name: Paladin's Shield
Paladin's Shield.desc: The Paladin's Shield is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shield that has a 1/10 / 19/100 chance of being dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Paladin's Shield.tip: Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life · Grants immunity to knockback

Shadowspec Bar.name: Shadowspec Bar
Shadowspec Bar.desc: Shadowspec Bars are post-Moon Lord bars used to craft various developer items. They can be considered a direct upgrade to Auric Bars, crafted using Ashes of Annihilation and Exo Prisms.
Shadowspec Bar.tip: A vile, black metal, so horrendous and powerful as to defy explanation
usedIn: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

True Excalibur.name: True Excalibur
True Excalibur.desc: The True Excalibur is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Excalibur. When swung, a large yellow aura with a pink edge follows the swing, reaching about twice the distance of the sword itself. The aura can hit up to six enemies.

Angelic Shotgun.name: Angelic Shotgun
Angelic Shotgun.desc: The Angelic Shotgun is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. Each time the weapon is fired, it shoots 5-6 bullets and summons a radiant beam from the sky towards the cursor. The beam deals 200% of the weapon's damage, pierces infinitely and passes through tiles.
Angelic Shotgun.tip: Each shot casts a radiant beam of Holy Flames from the sky · Musket balls convert into hallow-point rounds which also empower the beam · 'Fighting 'til the war's won'

Sunplate Block.name: Sunplate Block
Sunplate Block.desc: Sunplate Block is a block that is found on Floating Islands (or can be crafted with Fallen Stars and Stone Blocks in the with a Sky Mill). When a square of four or more Sunplate Blocks are put next to each other, they make a pattern that resembles a starry night sky.

Anklet of the Wind.name: Anklet of the Wind
Anklet of the Wind.desc: The Anklet of the Wind is an accessory that gives a 10% bonus to movement speed. The effect also stacks with the movement speed bonus of the Aglet.

Cloud.name: Cloud
Cloud.desc: Cloud is a type of block found beneath Floating Islands, along with Rain Cloud blocks; they can be found in stacks in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates and Azure Crates as well. Cloud blocks display as solid blocks, but light passes through them as if they were empty space.
Cloud.tip: Prevents fall damage (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions)

Jungle Spores.name: Jungle Spores
Jungle Spores.desc: Jungle Spores are crafting materials acquired by destroying green glowing orbs that grow randomly on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, in or below the Cavern layer. Each orb drops 2–3 Jungle Spores. Harvested Jungle Spores cannot be replanted.

Pink Gel.name: Pink Gel
Pink Gel.desc: Pink Gel is a rare crafting material dropped by Pinky in stacks of 25–50. It is primarily used to craft "bouncy" versions of certain consumable items, as well as Restoration Potions.

Anodized Wulfrum Bathtub.name: Anodized Wulfrum Bathtub
Anodized Wulfrum Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels.name: Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels
Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels.desc: Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block made from Stone Blocks, Wulfrum Metal Scraps, and Anodized Wulfrum Metal at a Heavy Work Bench. It is used to make the Anodized Wulfrum furniture set.

Anodized Wulfrum Metal.name: Anodized Wulfrum Metal
Anodized Wulfrum Metal.desc: Anodized Wulfrum Metal is a craftable Pre-Hardmode crafting material crafted from a Stormlion Mandible and a Wulfrum Metal Scrap at a Work Bench. It is used to make several cosmetic Wulfrum blocks.

Anodized Wulfrum Platform.name: Anodized Wulfrum Platform
Anodized Wulfrum Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Stormlion Mandible.name: Stormlion Mandible
Stormlion Mandible.desc: Stormlion Mandibles are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Stormlions in the Desert. They are used in the crafting of several items themed around the desert and storms, including the Desert Medallion which is used to summon the Desert Scourge.

Wulfrum Metal Scrap.name: Wulfrum Metal Scrap
Wulfrum Metal Scrap.desc: Wulfrum Metal Scraps are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Wulfrum enemies. They are used solely to craft the Wulfrum-tier items. They can also be used as ammunition for the Wulfrum Blunderbuss and Wulfrum Scaffold Kit.

Anodized Wulfrum Panels.name: Anodized Wulfrum Panels
Anodized Wulfrum Panels.desc: Anodized Wulfrum Panels are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block crafted from Stone Blocks and Anodized Wulfrum Metal at a Heavy Work Bench.
