Anodized Wulfrum Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Anodized Wulfrum Toilet.name: Anodized Wulfrum Toilet
Anodized Wulfrum Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Anodized Wulfrum Trim.name: Anodized Wulfrum Trim
Anodized Wulfrum Trim.desc: Anodized Wulfrum Trim is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block crafted from Stone Blocks and Anodized Wulfrum Metal at a Heavy Work Bench.

Anodized Wulfrum Trim Wall.name: Anodized Wulfrum Trim Wall
Anodized Wulfrum Trim Wall.desc: Anodized Wulfrum Trim Walls are a background wall wall crafted with Anodized Wulfrum Metal.

Anodized Wulfrum Work Bench.name: Anodized Wulfrum Work Bench
Anodized Wulfrum Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Anti-Cyst Ointment.name: Anti-Cyst Ointment
Anti-Cyst Ointment.desc: The Anti-Cyst Ointment is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable Perforator Cyst spawns. It is the Crimson equivalent of the Anti-Tumor Ointment.
Anti-Cyst Ointment.tip: Toggle this item to prevent hive cysts from spawning near you · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Crimtane Bar.name: Crimtane Bar
Crimtane Bar.desc: The Crimtane Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Anti-materiel Rifle.name: Anti-materiel Rifle
Anti-materiel Rifle.desc: The Anti-materiel Rifle is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a high-damage High Velocity Bullet.
Anti-materiel Rifle.tip: Converts musket balls into.50 caliber sniper rounds that rip apart enemy defense and cause enemies to become Marked for Death · Unleashes a second swarm of bullets on hit, with additional bullets on critical strikes

Nightmare Fuel.name: Nightmare Fuel
Nightmare Fuel.desc: Nightmare Fuel is a post-Moon Lord crafting material dropped by most Pumpkin Moon enemies after The Devourer of Gods has been defeated.

Shroomer.name: Shroomer
Shroomer.desc: The Shroomer is a craftable Hardmode gun that is an upgrade to the Sniper Rifle. It fires bullets at a high velocity along with a translucent mushroom that homes in on and pierces enemies and deals massive damage.
Shroomer.tip: Fires bullets and an extremely powerful homing mushroom

Anti-Tumor Ointment.name: Anti-Tumor Ointment
Anti-Tumor Ointment.desc: The Anti-Tumor Ointment is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable Hive Tumor spawns. It is the Corruption equivalent of the Anti-Cyst Ointment.
Anti-Tumor Ointment.tip: Toggle this item to prevent hive tumors from spawning near you · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Demonite Bar.name: Demonite Bar
Demonite Bar.desc: The Demonite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Apathanull.name: Apathanull
Apathanull.desc: The Apathanull is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, it releases cosmic tentacles which spawn near and target the cursor. The tentacles strike three times before disappearing.
Apathanull.tip: Casts a spread of dark cosmic tentacles to skewer your enemies · Tentacles will aim at your cursor and lash out three times before disappearing

Meld Blob.name: Meld Blob
Meld Blob.desc: Meld Blobs are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by enemies spawned during the Lunar Events and Astrum Deus.
Meld Blob.tip: 'Shrieks of distorted memories echo within this mass'

Spell Tome.name: Spell Tome
Spell Tome.desc: The Spell Tome is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Wizard for.

Apoctolith.name: Apoctolith
Apoctolith.desc: The Apoctolith is a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, it throws a gravity-affected abyssal brick that inflicts the Crush Depth debuff. Critical hits cause the target to lose 15 defense permanently, which cannot stack with itself.
Apoctolith.tip: Critical hits tear away enemy defense · Stealth strikes shatter and briefly stun enemies · 'Maybe catching bricks with your face isn't such a hot idea...'

Throwing Brick.name: Throwing Brick
Throwing Brick.desc: The Throwing Brick is a craftable consumable Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon. Additionally, the Starter Bag contains 150 of them. When used, it throws a gravity affected brick that travels a short distance before falling to the ground and breaking.
Throwing Brick.tip: Stealth strikes cause the brick to shatter · 'Prove its resistance by throwing it upwards and catching it with your face'

Apoctosis Array.name: Apoctosis Array
Apoctosis Array.desc: The Apoctosis Array is a craftable Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Ion Blaster. When used, it fires spreads of three blasts that have 40 armor penetration and explode on hit, dealing 30% base damage.
Apoctosis Array.tip: Rapidly fires an array of ion blasts with heavy armor penetration that accelerate and explode · Press Right Click to charge the blaster, restoring your mana until it reaches max · The more mana you restore, the stronger the arrow is when you release it · Charging for 90% of your max mana or more will reach max power · Holding this weapon disables the pickup of stars

Ion Blaster.name: Ion Blaster
Ion Blaster.desc: The Ion Blaster is a craftable Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires continuously accelerating ion blasts that increase in damage with the player's current mana.
Ion Blaster.tip: Rapidly fires ion blasts with heavy armor penetration that accelerate and explode · Press Right Click to charge the blaster, restoring your mana until it reaches max · The more mana you restore, the stronger the burst is when you release it · Charging for 90% of your max mana or more will reach max power · Holding this weapon disables the pickup of stars

Apollyon.name: Apollyon
Apollyon.desc: Apollyon is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff.
Apollyon.tip: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS

Abaddon.name: Abaddon
Abaddon.desc: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.
Abaddon.tip: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS

Eye of the Golem.name: Eye of the Golem
Eye of the Golem.desc: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem.

Apotheosis.name: Apotheosis
Apotheosis.desc: Apotheosis is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it summons a cosmic portal that releases a mini Devourer of Gods that swarms enemies and fires lasers at them, before disappearing 5 seconds later.
Apotheosis.tip: Unleashes interdimensional projection magic · Eat worms

Cosmic Discharge.name: Cosmic Discharge
Cosmic Discharge.desc: The Cosmic Discharge is a post-Moon Lord flail that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods.
Cosmic Discharge.tip: Striking an enemy with the whip causes glacial explosions that grant the player the Cosmic Freeze buff · Cosmic Freeze gives the player +2 HP/s life regen while standing still and freezes enemies near the player
stats: 1 second (Flail) / Infinite while near player and player has Cosmic Freeze buff

Maw of Infinity.name: Maw of Infinity
Maw of Infinity.desc: The Maw of Infinity is a post-Moon Lord special sword that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods.
Maw of Infinity.tip: Swings a blade forged from the Devourer's maw in a 3-swing combo · The first swing only hits close range · The second swing additionally launches Faith Incinerator · The third swing unleashes Divinity Devourer at your cursor, exploding for massive damage

Void Eater Marionette.name: Void Eater Marionette
Void Eater Marionette.desc: The Void Eater Marionette is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. Upon use, it summons a flying mechanical worm that charges, fires lasers, teleports onto enemies to inflict them with the God Slayer Inferno debuff and ignores immunity frames.
Void Eater Marionette.tip: Contains the power to control a mini Devourer · Repeated summons increase the length and power of the Devourer · The Devourer attacks with Divinity Devourer, Faith Incinerator, and Ultracosmic Maelstrom · Can play fetch with dropped items · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory when the Devourer has been spawned to prioritize fetching
stats: 6 seconds (Fireballs) 3 seconds (Head) 2 seconds (Body and Lasers) 1.5 seconds (Tail)

Aqua's Scepter.name: Aqua's Scepter
Aqua's Scepter.desc: The Aqua's Scepter is a craftable post-Moon Lord sentry. It summons a stationary storm cloud which passively rain down 20 raindrops per second. Raindrops cannot travel through solid tiles and can pierce one enemy, dealing 40% less damage on the second enemy hit.
Aqua's Scepter.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a giant storm cloud to rain down on your foes, and strike nearby enemies with overloading tesla energy · 'Captain! I think- we've got a risk of rain!'

Aqua Scepter.name: Aqua Scepter
Aqua Scepter.desc: The Aqua Scepter is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires arcing streams of water in quick succession, with each stream being able to hit up to 5 targets. The water streams bounce upwards upon colliding with lava.
Aqua Scepter.tip: Sprays out a shower of water

Armored Shell.name: Armored Shell
Armored Shell.desc: Armored Shells are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by the Storm Weaver. They are used in the crafting of various weapons, Prismatic armor set and other items.

Nimbus Rod.name: Nimbus Rod
Nimbus Rod.desc: The Nimbus Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that creates storm clouds that drop damaging "rain" projectiles directly below themselves. When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor.
Nimbus Rod.tip: Summons a cloud to rain down on your foes

Aquamarine Staff.name: Aquamarine Staff
Aquamarine Staff.desc: The Aquamarine Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it rapidly fires 2 aquamarine bolts that do not pierce or go through tiles.

Amethyst Staff.name: Amethyst Staff
Amethyst Staff.desc: The Amethyst Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a purple bolt which does not pierce and homes onto the closest enemy within a 31.25-tile radius.
Amethyst Staff.tip: Amethysts find their path · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Navystone.name: Navystone
Navystone.desc: Navystone is a block that generates in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Eutrophic Sand. It is also dropped by Clams and Giant Clams. It is used in the crafting of Eutrophic furniture as well as the Storm Surge and some Sunken Sea-themed equipment.

Pearl Shard.name: Pearl Shard
Pearl Shard.desc: Pearl Shards are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by the Desert Scourge. They are used to craft Sea Remains and other early-game items.

Aquashard Shotgun.name: Aquashard Shotgun
Aquashard Shotgun.desc: The Aquashard Shotgun is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used, it shoots a spread of 2 bullets.
Aquashard Shotgun.tip: Converts musket balls into aquashards that split upon hitting an enemy

Boomstick.name: Boomstick
Boomstick.desc: The Boomstick is a pre-Hardmode gun. It can be found in Ivy Chests (mode=p chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 chance). When used, it fires a spread of 3–4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Aquatic Scourge (Lore).name: Aquatic Scourge (Lore)
Aquatic Scourge (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Aquatic Scourge (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Aquatic Scourge Trophy.name: Aquatic Scourge Trophy
Aquatic Scourge Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Arbalest.name: Arbalest
Arbalest.desc: The Arbalest is a craftable Hardmode repeater. When used, it fires four volleys of unevenly spread arrows.
Arbalest.tip: Fires a volley of 6 high-speed arrows · Arrows start off small and grow in size with continuous fire · Arrow damage, spread and knockback scale with arrow size

Any Mythril Bar.name: Any Mythril Bar
Any Mythril Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Cog.name: Cog
Cog.desc: Cogs are Hardmode crafting materials and placeable blocks that are purchased from the Steampunker for each. They are used to make High Velocity Bullets, Liquid Sensors, and Steampunk furniture.

Arc Nova Diffuser.name: Arc Nova Diffuser
Arc Nova Diffuser.desc: The Arc Nova Diffuser is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. While holding, the player channels a glowing green orb at the tip of the gun and loads one unstable energy bolt every 0.22 seconds.
Arc Nova Diffuser.tip: Charges and fires a rapid burst of nova bolts · The first charging stage increases the fire rate of the burst · The second charging stage replaces the rapid burst with a devastating nova blast that always crits

Magna Cannon.name: Magna Cannon
Magna Cannon.desc: The Magna Cannon is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the gun and loads one crystal bolt every 0.15 seconds.
Magna Cannon.tip: Charges up a rapid fire burst of crystal bolts · Charging for longer increases the number of bolts fired · Fully charged shots fire an even longer and more rapid burst

Opal Striker.name: Opal Striker
Opal Striker.desc: The Opal Striker is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. While holding, the player channels a glowing orange orb at the tip of the gun which reaches its maximum power after 1.47 seconds.
Opal Striker.tip: Fires a chargeable heated energy bolt that pierces · Fully charged shots deal extra damage, move faster and inflict Hellfire

Arcane Crystal.name: Arcane Crystal
Arcane Crystal.desc: The Arcane Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's mana regeneration. It slightly reduces mana regeneration delay and increases mana regeneration rate. See technical info about mana regeneration for details.

Enchanted Starfish.name: Enchanted Starfish
Enchanted Starfish.desc: The Enchanted Starfish is a permanent power-up item that has a 10% chance to be obtained by fishing on the surface at night. Upon consumption, it increases the player's maximum mana by 20.
Enchanted Starfish.tip: Permanently increases maximum mana by 20 · Functions as an alternative to Mana Crystal

Arch Amaryllis.name: Arch Amaryllis
Arch Amaryllis.desc: The Arch Amaryllis is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Gleaming Magnolia. When used, it fires a magenta flower that quickly decelerates before eventually stopping.
Arch Amaryllis.tip: Casts a beaming flower that explodes into homing petals

Gleaming Magnolia.name: Gleaming Magnolia
Gleaming Magnolia.desc: The Gleaming Magnolia is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Mana Rose. When used, it fires a bright white-pink flower that decelerates before eventually stopping.
Gleaming Magnolia.tip: Casts a gleaming flower that explodes into petals

Nebula Fragment.name: Nebula Fragment
Nebula Fragment.desc: The Nebula Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100.
Nebula Fragment.tip: 'The power of a galaxy resides within this fragment'

Archaic Powder.name: Archaic Powder
Archaic Powder.desc: The Archaic Powder is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Archaic Powder.tip: Increases mining speed by 25% · Provides immunity to damage from falling blocks and dart traps · 65% resistance to all damage from traps · Does not stack with downgrades

Ancient Bone Dust.name: Ancient Bone Dust
Ancient Bone Dust.desc: The Ancient Bone Dust is a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by various Skeleton-type enemies. It is used to craft the Archaic Powder, the Slagsplitter Pauldron, Fledgling Wings, Moonshine, and Calcium Potions.

Ancient Chisel.name: Ancient Chisel
Ancient Chisel.desc: The Ancient Chisel is a construction accessory that increases mining speed by 25%, similarly to a Mining Potion. It can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Ancient Chisel.tip: Increases mining speed by 25% · 'Ancient problems require ancient solutions'

Archery Potion.name: Archery Potion
Archery Potion.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow-firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%.
Archery Potion.tip: 10% increased bow damage and 20% increased arrow speed

Argon Moss Brick.name: Argon Moss Brick
Argon Moss Brick.desc: Argon Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Argon Moss that glows in the dark when placed.

Argon Moss.name: Argon Moss
Argon Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Argon Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Astral Clay.name: Astral Clay
Astral Clay.desc: Astral Clay is a Hardmode block that replaces Clay Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. It is used in the crafting of various vanilla furniture items and the Wandering Jingasa.

Arid Artifact.name: Arid Artifact
Arid Artifact.desc: The Arid Artifact is a craftable Hardmode event-summoning item that starts the Sandstorm event shortly after being used. When used during a Sandstorm, it will stop the event instead. It can be used if the world is in Hardmode or after the Desert Scourge has been defeated.
Arid Artifact.tip: Summons a sandstorm · The sandstorm will happen shortly after the item is used · If used during a sandstorm, the sandstorm will stop some time afterward

Ancient Cloth.name: Ancient Cloth
Ancient Cloth.desc: Ancient Cloth is an uncommon Hardmode crafting material which has a 1/10 chance of dropping from all types of Ghouls.

Any Adamantite Bar.name: Any Adamantite Bar
Any Adamantite Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Any Sand Block.name: Any Sand Block
Any Sand Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Arid Soil.name: Arid Soil
Arid Soil.desc: Arid Soil is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Shellstone into Shimmer.

Shellstone.name: Shellstone
Shellstone.desc: The Shellstone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Runestone into Shimmer.

Arietes 41.name: Arietes 41
Arietes 41.desc: The Arietes 41 is a craftable Hardmode gun that is a direct upgrade to the Thermocline Blaster. When fired, it alternates between imbuing the bullet with electricity and lifesteal with every other shot.
Arietes 41.tip: Alternates between firing bullets imbued with lifesteal and Electrified · Electric imbued bullets create a small shockblast on impact, dealing additional damage to the enemy they hit

Shroomite Bar.name: Shroomite Bar
Shroomite Bar.desc: The Shroomite Bar is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bar.

Thermocline Blaster.name: Thermocline Blaster
Thermocline Blaster.desc: The Thermocline Blaster is a craftable Hardmode gun that is a direct upgrade to the Phoenix Blaster. When fired, it alternates between imbuing the bullet with Frostbite and Hellfire with every other shot.
Thermocline Blaster.tip: Alternates between firing bullets imbued with fire and ice · Any bullet type can be imbued when fired from this gun

Ark of the Ancients.name: Ark of the Ancients
Ark of the Ancients.desc: The Ark of the Ancients is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Fractured Ark.
Ark of the Ancients.tip: Right Click to extend the Ark out in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability · You can also parry projectiles to make them deal 30 less damage for a short period · Parrying will empower the next 10 swings of the sword, letting it throw stronger projectiles · A heavenly blade forged to vanquish all evil

Broken Hero Sword.name: Broken Hero Sword
Broken Hero Sword.desc: The Broken Hero Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material that has a 1/4 / 7/16 chance of being dropped by Mothrons.

Fractured Ark.name: Fractured Ark
Fractured Ark.desc: The Fractured Ark is a craftable Pre-Hardmode melee weapon. Holding Left Click performs a simple combo of a downwards slash followed by an upwards one.
Fractured Ark.tip: Right Click to extend the Ark out in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you a small window of invulnerability · Parrying empowers the next 10 swings of the sword, boosting damage and letting them throw projectiles · A worn down and rusty blade once wielded against the evil of this world, ready to be of use once more

Starfury.name: Starfury
Starfury.desc: The Starfury is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 chance of being obtained from Sky Crate and Azure Crate.
Starfury.tip: Causes stars to rain from the sky · 'Forged with the fury of heaven'

Ark of the Cosmos.name: Ark of the Cosmos
Ark of the Cosmos.desc: The Ark of the Cosmos is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is the final upgrade of the Fractured Ark and Broken Biome Blade.
Ark of the Cosmos.tip: Left Click to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade · The thrown blade will follow your cursor · Releasing while the blade is out will cause an exploding snap · Right Click to snip out the scissor blades in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability · You can parry projectiles to make them deal 120 less damage for a short period · Parrying will empower the next 16 swings of the sword · Double Right Click with charges available to cause a Big Rip in spacetime and consume all charges · The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder

Ark of the Elements.name: Ark of the Elements
Ark of the Elements.desc: The Ark of the Elements is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is the penultimate upgrade to the Fractured Ark.
Ark of the Elements.tip: Left Click to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade · Releasing while the blade is out will deal extra damage · Right Click to snip out the scissor blades in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability · You can parry projectiles to make them deal 60 less damage for a short period · Parrying will empower the next 10 swings of the sword, letting you use both blades at once · A heavenly pair of blades infused with the essence of Terraria, powerful enough to cut through the fabric of reality
stats: 1 second (Swing, Solar Needle, Glass Star) / 1.5 seconds (Parry attack)

Galaxia.name: Galaxia
Galaxia.desc: Galaxia is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is an upgraded version of the True Biome Blade. It possesses 4 separate attack modes under the form of constellation-themed upgrades of the True Biome Blade's attunements.
Galaxia.tip: FUNCTION_DESC · Freed from earthly shackles and coursing with cosmic power · Has access to all of the attunements at all times · Press Right Click to cycle the sword's attunement depending on the cursor's position · Active Attunement: [ATTUNEMENT]

Art Attack.name: Art Attack
Art Attack.desc: The Art Attack is a craftable Hardmode wand. Upon use, it fires a star with a rainbow trail that follows the mouse cursor. It initially deals no damage until a full shape with the trail is completed.
Art Attack.tip: Casts a star that follows the mouse that creates a rainbow trail as it moves · Once a full shape is created with the trail all enemies within it take damage proportional to how long it took to draw the shape · 'And the audience goes wild!'

Ashes of Calamity.name: Ashes of Calamity
Ashes of Calamity.desc: Ashes of Calamity are Hardmode crafting materials that drop solely from Calamitas Clone. They are used in the crafting of the Flask of Brimstone, Sigil of Calamitas, Brimflame armor, several weapons and pieces of the Sacrilegious furniture set.

Crystal Shard.name: Crystal Shard
Crystal Shard.desc: Crystal Shards are a common Hardmode crafting material found in the Underground Hallow. They can naturally grow on the left, right, and bottom sides of Pearlstone, Pink Ice, Pearlsand, Hardened Pearlsand, and Pearlsandstone Blocks.

Large Ruby.name: Large Ruby
Large Ruby.desc: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem, and are dropped when the player dies, even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode. With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head.
Large Ruby.tip: For Capture the Gem. It drops when you die

Rainbow Rod.name: Rainbow Rod
Rainbow Rod.desc: The Rainbow Rod is a Hardmode, post-The Twins wand. When used, it fires a rainbow missile that follows the cursor when Left Click key is held. If the Left Click key is released mid-drag, the missile will be fired in that direction.

Arterial Assault.name: Arterial Assault
Arterial Assault.desc: The Arterial Assault is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow made from Bloodstone Cores. When used, a burst of five blood arrows are fired that can home in on enemies and spawn a blood orb on hit.
Arterial Assault.tip: Fires a group of 5 homing blood arrows · These blood arrows burst into blood orbs upon striking an enemy · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness

Bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
Bloodstone.desc: "The calamitous beings have been inundated with bloodstone."

Ascendant Insignia.name: Ascendant Insignia
Ascendant Insignia.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ascendant Insignia.tip: Grants 4 additional seconds of flight time · Increases movement speed by 15%, jump speed by 20%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Accessory Ability fully restores flight time and prevents it from decreasing for 4 seconds · This ability has a 40 second cooldown

Effulgent Feather.name: Effulgent Feather
Effulgent Feather.desc: Effulgent Feathers are crafting materials that are dropped by Draconic Swarmers and Dragonfolly.
Effulgent Feather.tip: It vibrates with fluffy golden energy

Soaring Insignia.name: Soaring Insignia
Soaring Insignia.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:
Soaring Insignia.tip: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

Darksun Fragment.name: Darksun Fragment
Darksun Fragment.desc: Darksun Fragments are post-Moon Lord crafting materials dropped by enemies during a Solar Eclipse after The Devourer of Gods has been defeated.
Darksun Fragment.tip: An impacted crystal suffused with opposing celestial energies

Necroplasm.name: Necroplasm
Necroplasm.desc: Necroplasm is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is dropped by Overloaded Soldiers, Phantom Spirits and Polterghast.
Necroplasm.tip: It churns and seethes with ghastly malice

Asgard's Valor.name: Asgard's Valor
Asgard's Valor.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a craftable Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Asgard's Valor.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

Hallowed Bar.name: Hallowed Bar
Hallowed Bar.desc: The Hallowed Bar is a Hardmode bar. It is dropped by all three mechanical bosses: The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.

Ornate Shield.name: Ornate Shield
Ornate Shield.desc: The Ornate Shield is a craftable Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ornate Shield.tip: Allows the ability to dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

Asgardian Aegis.name: Asgardian Aegis
Asgardian Aegis.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a craftable post-Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Asgardian Aegis.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

Elysian Aegis.name: Elysian Aegis
Elysian Aegis.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post-Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Elysian Aegis.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'

Ashen Accent Slab.name: Ashen Accent Slab
Ashen Accent Slab.desc: Ashen Accent Slab is a craftable block crafted from 50 Smooth Brimstone Slag at an Ashen Altar and Ecto Mist. This block functions as a variant to Ashen Slab except it merges differently when placed with other nearby blocks.
Ashen Accent Slab.tip: An Ashen Slab variant that merges differently with nearby blocks · 'Favored by advanced builders'

Smooth Brimstone Slag.name: Smooth Brimstone Slag
Smooth Brimstone Slag.desc: Smooth Brimstone Slag is a craftable block crafted from Brimstone Slag at a Work Bench. It is used in the crafting of Ashen furniture.

Ashen Altar.name: Ashen Altar
Ashen Altar.desc: The Ashen Altar is a crafting station that is used to craft the Ancient and Ashen furniture sets themed around the Brimstone Crag. It is also able to create a Music Box.

Ashen Basin.name: Ashen Basin
Ashen Basin.desc: Basins are furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. Unlike the other furniture sets, only six types of basins exist in the Calamity Mod.

Ashen Bathtub.name: Ashen Bathtub
Ashen Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Bed.name: Ashen Bed
Ashen Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Bookcase.name: Ashen Bookcase
Ashen Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Candelabra.name: Ashen Candelabra
Ashen Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Candle.name: Ashen Candle
Ashen Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Ashen Chair.name: Ashen Chair
Ashen Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Ashen Chandelier.name: Ashen Chandelier
Ashen Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Chest.name: Ashen Chest
Ashen Chest.desc: Ashen Chests are chests that are found only in the Brimstone Crag. Each Ashen Chest will contain one special item along with other standard loot.

Ashen Door.name: Ashen Door
Ashen Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Dresser.name: Ashen Dresser
Ashen Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Lamp.name: Ashen Lamp
Ashen Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Lantern.name: Ashen Lantern
Ashen Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Monolith.name: Ashen Monolith
Ashen Monolith.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Pipe Organ.name: Ashen Pipe Organ
Ashen Pipe Organ.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Platform.name: Ashen Platform
Ashen Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Ashen Sink.name: Ashen Sink
Ashen Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Slab.name: Ashen Slab
Ashen Slab.desc: Ashen Slab is a craftable block crafted from Smooth Brimstone Slag.

Ashen Slab Wall.name: Ashen Slab Wall
Ashen Slab Wall.desc: Ashen Slab Wall is a background wall crafted with Ashen Slabs.

Ashen Sofa.name: Ashen Sofa
Ashen Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Ashen Table.name: Ashen Table
Ashen Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Ashen Work Bench.name: Ashen Work Bench
Ashen Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Astral Bar.name: Astral Bar
Astral Bar.desc: Astral Bars are Hardmode bars made with 2 Astral Ore and 3 Starblight Soot per bar. They are primarily used to create Astral-themed gear and are additionally used to craft upgrades to weapons, such as the Radiant Star.

Astral Ore.name: Astral Ore
Astral Ore.desc: "The seal of the stars has been broken!"

Starblight Soot.name: Starblight Soot
Starblight Soot.desc: Starblight Soot is a Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by enemies in the Astral Infection biome as well as Astrum Deus and the Astrum Aureus.

Astral Beacon.name: Astral Beacon
Astral Beacon.desc: The Astral Beacon is a Hardmode furniture item that can be crafted or found naturally on a pillar of Astral Monolith after the Astral Infection has generated. When right-clicked, it is used to summon Astrum Deus while a Titan Heart or Starcore is in the player's inventory.
Astral Beacon.tip: Summons Astrum Deus in exchange for specific offerings

Astral Stone.name: Astral Stone
Astral Stone.desc: Astral Stone is a Hardmode block which replaces Stone Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Aureus Cell.name: Aureus Cell
Aureus Cell.desc: The Aureus Cell is a Hardmode potion that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. Upon consumption, it grants the Mana Regeneration and Magic Power buffs for 8 minutes. It is used in the crafting of various Astral Infection-themed items and the Auralis.
Aureus Cell.tip: Grants the Magic Power and Mana Regeneration buffs

Astral Blaster.name: Astral Blaster
Astral Blaster.desc: The Astral Blaster is a craftable Hardmode gun. When Musket Balls are used for ammo, bullets fired become astral rounds that home in on enemies and inflict the Astral Infection debuff.
Astral Blaster.tip: Converts musket balls into homing astral rounds that spread the Astral Infection (debuff)

Astral Blue Dye.name: Astral Blue Dye
Astral Blue Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Astral Breastplate.name: Astral Breastplate
Astral Breastplate.desc: Astral armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Astral Bars and Meteorite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.
Astral Breastplate.tip: Increased maximum mana by 80 · 10% increased damage · 25% chance to save ammo

Astral Brick.name: Astral Brick
Astral Brick.desc: Astral Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Astral Ore and Astral Stone.

Astral Brick Wall.name: Astral Brick Wall
Astral Brick Wall.desc: Astral Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Astral Brick.

Astral Chunk.name: Astral Chunk
Astral Chunk.desc: The Astral Chunk is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Astrum Aureus. It can only be used in the Astral Infection, and can only be crafted after decrypting the Encrypted Schematic (Planetoid) at The Codebreaker.
Astral Chunk.tip: Summons Astrum Aureus when used in the Astral Infection · Not consumable · 'The Infection's fortress has found another target.'

Astral Dirt.name: Astral Dirt
Astral Dirt.desc: Astral Dirt is a Hardmode block which replaces Dirt Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. It will spontaneously create Astral Grass and Astral Grass Seeds can be planted on it.

Astral Dirt Wall.name: Astral Dirt Wall
Astral Dirt Wall.desc: Astral Dirt Walls are background walls that replace Dirt Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Flesh Dye.name: Astral Flesh Dye
Astral Flesh Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Astral Hamaxe.name: Astral Hamaxe
Astral Hamaxe.desc: The Astral Hamaxe is a craftable Hardmode hamaxe. Despite being available pre-Moon Lord, it has greater hammer power than the Lunar Hamaxes, but falls one block short of their range. It emits faint purple particles when swung.

Astral Helm.name: Astral Helm
Astral Helm.desc: Astral armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Astral Bars and Meteorite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.
Astral Helm.tip: 5% increased damage and 15% increased critical strike chance · Detects nearby creatures, enemy projectiles, danger sources, and treasure · Shift-Right Click in your inventory to toggle the Omniscience effect

Astral Ice.name: Astral Ice
Astral Ice.desc: Astral Ice is a Hardmode block which replaces Ice Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Ice Wall.name: Astral Ice Wall
Astral Ice Wall.desc: Astral Ice Walls are background walls that replace Ice Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Infection (Lore).name: Astral Infection (Lore)
Astral Infection (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Astral Infection (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Astrum Deus Trophy.name: Astrum Deus Trophy
Astrum Deus Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Astral Injection.name: Astral Injection
Astral Injection.desc: The Astral Injection is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Astral Injection buff, which provides +60 mana regen per second and being inflicted with the Mana Sickness debuff.
Astral Injection.tip: Restores 60 mana per second · Inflicts Mana Sickness when used

Super Mana Potion.name: Super Mana Potion
Super Mana Potion.desc: The Super Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.

Astral Leggings.name: Astral Leggings
Astral Leggings.desc: Astral armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Astral Bars and Meteorite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

Astral Monolith.name: Astral Monolith
Astral Monolith.desc: Astral Monolith is a Hardmode block which replaces Wood in the Astral Infection biome and can be obtained by cutting down Monoliths.

Monolith Platform.name: Monolith Platform
Monolith Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Astral Monolith Wall.name: Astral Monolith Wall
Astral Monolith Wall.desc: Astral Monolith Wall is a background wall crafted with Astral Monolith.

Astral Orange Dye.name: Astral Orange Dye
Astral Orange Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Astral Pickaxe.name: Astral Pickaxe
Astral Pickaxe.desc: The Astral Pickaxe is a craftable Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Lihzahrd Brick and Scoria Ore. It has a range bonus of 3 tiles and has a higher than average critical strike chance.

Astral Pike.name: Astral Pike
Astral Pike.desc: The Astral Pike is a craftable Hardmode spear. It emits dust when swung, which produces light. When hitting enemies, three astral stars move in a diagonal pattern towards the player, homing into nearby enemies, and dealing 33% of the spear's damage.
Astral Pike.tip: Summons astral star swarms on hit that spread the Astral Infection (debuff)

Astral Projector.name: Astral Projector
Astral Projector.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Astral Sand.name: Astral Sand
Astral Sand.desc: Astral Sand is a Hardmode block which replaces Sand Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. Like Sand Blocks and their counterparts, Astral Sand is affected by gravity and can deal damage to any player or enemy it falls on.

Hardened Astral Sand.name: Hardened Astral Sand
Hardened Astral Sand.desc: Hardened Astral Sand is a Hardmode block which replaces Hardened Sand Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Sandstone.name: Astral Sandstone
Astral Sandstone.desc: Astral Sandstone is a Hardmode block which replaces Sandstone Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Sandstone Wall.name: Astral Sandstone Wall
Astral Sandstone Wall.desc: Astral Sandstone Walls are background walls that replace Sandstone Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Snow.name: Astral Snow
Astral Snow.desc: Astral Snow is a Hardmode block which replaces Snow Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Snow Wall.name: Astral Snow Wall
Astral Snow Wall.desc: Astral Snow Walls are background wall that replace Snow Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Staff.name: Astral Staff
Astral Staff.desc: The Astral Staff is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it rains down an astral crystal from the sky that shatters after piercing an enemy once or hitting a tile. Upon shattering, it emits a petal-shaped explosion that damages enemies in an area of effect.
Astral Staff.tip: Summons a large crystal from the sky that has a large area of effect on impact and spreads the Astral Infection (debuff)

Astral Stone Wall.name: Astral Stone Wall
Astral Stone Wall.desc: Astral Stone Wall is a background wall that replace Stone Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Swirl Dye.name: Astral Swirl Dye
Astral Swirl Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Astreal Defeat.name: Astreal Defeat
Astreal Defeat.desc: The Astreal Defeat is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow.
Astreal Defeat.tip: All arrows are converted to Astreal Arrows that emit flames as they travel

Shadowflame Bow.name: Shadowflame Bow
Shadowflame Bow.desc: The Shadowflame Bow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/6 / 1/3 chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army. When used, it converts any type of arrow into Shadowflame Arrows.

Spirit Flame.name: Spirit Flame
Spirit Flame.desc: The Spirit Flame is a Hardmode magic weapon that causes a small purple flame to appear in a random location around the player and hovers in midair when used. When an enemy comes within 25 tiles and has a clear line of sight to the flame, it will home in on that enemy.

Astrum Aureus (Lore).name: Astrum Aureus (Lore)
Astrum Aureus (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.

Ataraxia.name: Ataraxia
Ataraxia.desc: Ataraxia is a post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswings. When swung, Ataraxia fires three rocket-like projectiles, two small and one large, towards the cursor. The larger projectile explodes on impact with a tile or enemy.

Augur of the Void.name: Augur of the Void
Augur of the Void.desc: The Augur of the Void is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome and the direct upgrade to the Shadowflame Hex Doll and Eldritch Tome.
Augur of the Void.tip: Casts a burst of elemental tentacles to spear your enemies

Eldritch Tome.name: Eldritch Tome
Eldritch Tome.desc: The Eldritch Tome is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it releases red tendrils which bend in random directions, similarly to the Shadowflame Hex Doll.
Eldritch Tome.tip: Casts eldritch tentacles to spear your enemies

Shadowflame Hex Doll.name: Shadowflame Hex Doll
Shadowflame Hex Doll.desc: The Shadowflame Hex Doll is a Hardmode magic weapon that fires a spread of three curving purple tentacle projectiles per use at a medium range, inflicting the Shadowflame debuff onto enemies for 4–8 seconds, and piercing 2 targets before dissipating on the 3rd hit.
Shadowflame Hex Doll.tip: Summons Shadowflame tentacles to strike your foes

Auralis.name: Auralis
Auralis.desc: The Auralis is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is the direct upgrade to the Sniper Rifle. When used, it fires a high-velocity blue-green dust round which pierces up to four targets and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff.
Auralis.tip: Fires a high speed glowing bullet that causes enemies to become Marked for Death · Press Right Click to zoom out · Standing still provides increasing damage bonuses up to 25% · Standing still for 5 or more seconds while using the scope ability will summon an aurora · The aurora reduces the damage of the next projectile hit by 100 · This effect lasts up to 20 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown

Sniper Rifle.name: Sniper Rifle
Sniper Rifle.desc: The Sniper Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that has a 1/12 / 23/144 chance of being dropped by Skeleton Snipers in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires bullets at an extremely high damage and velocity, with a slow fire rate.
Sniper Rifle.tip: Shoots a powerful, high velocity bullet · Right click to zoom out

Aureate Booster.name: Aureate Booster
Aureate Booster.desc: The Aureate Booster is a craftable Hardmode wing-type accessory. When equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide. Holding Up during ascent increases vertical flight speed and acceleration by 50% but drains flight time 50% faster.
Aureate Booster.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Good · Vertical acceleration: Good · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'Mach speed with style!'

Perennial Bar.name: Perennial Bar
Perennial Bar.desc: Perennial Bars are Hardmode bars made with 4 Perennial Ore at a Hardmode Forge and are additionally dropped from the Fleshy and Necromantic Geode. They are used to craft various items themed around savage plant-life and are also used to craft Life Alloy.

Auric Absorber.name: Auric Absorber
Auric Absorber.desc: Auric Absorber is a craftable post-Moon Lord block.

Yharon Soul Fragment.name: Yharon Soul Fragment
Yharon Soul Fragment.desc: Yharon Soul Fragments are a post-Moon Lord crafting material that are dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. They are used to make highly powerful endgame equipment, including Auric Bars.
Yharon Soul Fragment.tip: A shard of a draconic Auric Soul

Auric Console.name: Auric Console
Auric Console.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Land Mine.name: Land Mine
Land Mine.desc: The Land Mine is a unique Hardmode, post-Plantera placeable item. They remain dormant once placed, until an entity touches them or they are activated by Wire, at which point they explode, dealing 500 / 1000 / base damage to players and 250 base damage to non-player entities.
Land Mine.tip: Explodes when stepped on or signalled

Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.name: Auric Quantum Cooling Cell
Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Essence of Eleum.name: Essence of Eleum
Essence of Eleum.desc: Essences of Eleum are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain ice-related enemies.

Auric Reinforced Crate.name: Auric Reinforced Crate

Auric Repulser Panel.name: Auric Repulser Panel
Auric Repulser Panel.desc: Auric Repulser Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block. Similarly to Auric Ore, it can repel players that touch it. This repel has the same strength (40 velocity or 150 tiles/second), but it does no damage and always repels the player regardless of equipment.
Auric Repulser Panel.tip: Repels players that come in contact with it

Botanic Chair.name: Botanic Chair
Botanic Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Avenger Emblem.desc: The Avenger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that grants 12% increased damage to all weapons.

Rogue Emblem.name: Rogue Emblem
Rogue Emblem.desc: The Rogue Emblem is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When equipped, it increases rogue damage by 15%. It is the rogue-class equivalent of the vanilla class emblems. It is used in the crafting of the Avenger Emblem and Nanotech.

Awakening (Lore).name: Awakening (Lore)
Awakening (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Awakening (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Armor Statue.name: Armor Statue
Armor Statue.desc: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire—depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies, drop items, or teleport an NPC to the statue's location.

Axe of Purity.name: Axe of Purity
Axe of Purity.desc: The Axe of Purity is a craftable Hardmode axe that is the direct upgrade to the Feller of Evergreens. Holding Left Click uses it like a normal axe. Holding Right Click instead fires damaging Purification Powder that spreads The Purity and deals 85% base damage.
Axe of Purity.tip: Left Click to use as a tool · Right Click to cleanse evil

Feller of Evergreens.name: Feller of Evergreens
Feller of Evergreens.desc: The Feller of Evergreens is a craftable Pre-Hardmode axe that can also be obtained from Ivy Chests in the Vernal Pass.
Feller of Evergreens.tip: Occasionally drops extra fruits from shaking trees

Pixie Dust.name: Pixie Dust
Pixie Dust.desc: Pixie Dust is a common Hardmode crafting material that always drops from Pixies.

Purification Powder.name: Purification Powder
Purification Powder.desc: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their pure, Crimson, or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword, and produce a fair amount of light.

Azafure (Lore).name: Azafure (Lore)
Azafure (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Azafure (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Brimstone Elemental Trophy.name: Brimstone Elemental Trophy
Brimstone Elemental Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

B-GSS: Nidhogg.name: B-GSS: Nidhogg
B-GSS: Nidhogg.desc: The B-GSS: Nidhogg is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it rapidly fires instant-traveling gauss shots with very slight inaccuracy. Gauss shots create a small lingering magnetic implosion which pulls in non-boss enemies, though only one can exist at a time.
B-GSS: Nidhogg.tip: A magnet powered energy railgun that fires rapidly, creating lingering magnetic implosions that pull in weak enemies on hit · Only one implosion can exist at a time · Press Right Click to begin charging a devastating energy beam that always crits and will fire once ready · This charge attack can not be interrupted once started and has a long cooldown · 'Many soldiers underestimate the destructive capabilities of magnetism. · This railgun has reliably pulled in skeptics of its crushing efficiency.'

Infected Armor Plating.name: Infected Armor Plating
Infected Armor Plating.desc: Infected Armor Plating is a Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. Similarly to Plague Cell Canisters, they are used to craft Plague-themed items such as Plaguebringer armor.

B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt.name: B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt
B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt.desc: The B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt is a craftable Hardmode magic weapon. When used, it holds out a glove, which fires laser beams from each of its fingertips. The laser beams condense briefly before opening up into a wide spread.
B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt.tip: A precision welding glove with laser emitters in each fingertip · Right Click to focus all emitters into a short range palm blast that always critically strikes · Palm blasts restore a large amount of mana on hit and have a cooldown which is significantly shorter if they miss · 'Most battalions prefer to either spread attacks widely, or focus on a singular target. · This glove caters to both, though it will never bridge the gap between their strategies.'

Baby Cannonball Jellyfish Bowl.name: Baby Cannonball Jellyfish Bowl
Baby Cannonball Jellyfish Bowl.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Baby Cannonball Jellyfish.name: Baby Cannonball Jellyfish
Baby Cannonball Jellyfish.desc: The Baby Cannonball Jellyfish is a critter that spawns in the 1st layer of the Abyss. It remains still underwater and on land similarly to a Baby Ghost Bell and emits a small amount of turquoise light. When killed, it explodes in a small radius, capable of damaging the player.
Baby Cannonball Jellyfish.tip: Can be fired out of cannons

Baby Flak Crab Cage.name: Baby Flak Crab Cage
Baby Flak Crab Cage.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Baby Flak Crab.name: Baby Flak Crab
Baby Flak Crab.desc: The Baby Flak Crab is a critter that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea biome or dropped while shaking an Acidwood Tree. Similarly to its adult counterpart, it disguises itself as a geyser.

Terrarium.name: Terrarium
Terrarium.desc: The Terrarium is an item used to make Cages for critters caught with the Bug Net, Lavaproof Bug Net, or Golden Bug Net.

Baby Ghost Bell Jar.name: Baby Ghost Bell Jar
Baby Ghost Bell Jar.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Baby Ghost Bell.name: Baby Ghost Bell
Baby Ghost Bell.desc: The Baby Ghost Bell is a critter that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It is completely motionless both in water and on land. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net and can be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 20%.

Badge of Bravery.name: Badge of Bravery
Badge of Bravery.desc: The Badge of Bravery is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.
Badge of Bravery.tip: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10% · Increases melee armor penetration by 5

Warrior Emblem.name: Warrior Emblem
Warrior Emblem.desc: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Baguette.name: Baguette
Baguette.desc: The Baguette is a craftable food item. Upon consumption, it grants the Well Fed buff for 5 minutes. While under the effects of Red Wine, consuming the Baguette heals the player for 200 health and grants the Baguette debuff, which reduces life regen by.
Baguette.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · Goes well with Red Wine (debuff) · 'je suis Monte'

Hay.name: Hay
Hay.desc: Hay is a type of block that is harvested from wild grass plants and sea oats by using a Sickle. It can be used to make Target Dummies.

Bakidon.name: Bakidon
Bakidon.desc: The Bakidon is a Hardmode tool that freezes the passage of time for 10 minutes, with a cooldown of 10 minutes after it has expired. Time cannot be frozen during a Blood Moon, Frost Moon, Pumpkin Moon, or Solar Eclipse.
Bakidon.tip: A lost artifact said to pin the heavens in place · Left click to freeze the passage of day and night temporarily · This does not work during celestial anomalies · The time freeze recharges while not in use

Baleful Harvester.name: Baleful Harvester
Baleful Harvester.desc: The Baleful Harvester is a craftable Hardmode special sword. On use, it swings the blade around the player 3 times before a slight pause.
Baleful Harvester.tip: A flaming scythe which is rapidly swung around three times in succession · Enemy hits summon flaming skulls that split into homing fire orbs

Stardust Fragment.name: Stardust Fragment
Stardust Fragment.desc: The Stardust Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100.

The Horseman's Blade.name: The Horseman's Blade
The Horseman's Blade.desc: The Horseman's Blade is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that can be dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. When swung, an orange aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself.
The Horseman's Blade.tip: Summons Pumpkin heads to attack your enemies

Ball and Chain.name: Ball and Chain
Ball and Chain.desc: The Ball and Chain is a craftable Pre-Hardmode tool. If the item is Right-Clicked in the inventory, all dashes that are activated by double tapping Left Click and Right Click keys (such as the Shield of Cthulhu, Tabi, or Asgard's Valor) are disabled.
Ball and Chain.tip: Toggle this item to disable any dashes granted by equipment · Right Click to toggle · Dashes are currently [STATE] · 'So heavy...'

Ball O' Hurt.name: Ball O' Hurt
Ball O' Hurt.desc: The Ball O' Hurt is a pre-Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption.

The Rotted Fork.name: The Rotted Fork
The Rotted Fork.desc: The Rotted Fork is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 1/5 chance of being obtained from destroying Crimson Hearts found in The Crimson or a 1/5 chance from Crimson Crates and Hematic Crates. When thrust, it creates a small shockwave at its tip.

Ballistic Poison Bomb.name: Ballistic Poison Bomb
Ballistic Poison Bomb.desc: The Ballistic Poison Bomb is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws bombs that are affected by gravity. Upon contact with an enemy, it explodes and launches 3 spikes that fly in random directions, while also creating 3-5 poison clouds that pierce 4 times.
Ballistic Poison Bomb.tip: Throws a sticky bomb that explodes into spikes and venomous clouds · Stealth strikes erupt into more clouds with a longer lasting Acid Venom
stats: 4 seconds (Stealth strike cloud) / 3 seconds (Bomb) / 2 seconds (Spike, Cloud)

Seafoam Bomb.name: Seafoam Bomb
Seafoam Bomb.desc: The Seafoam Bomb is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable bomb. When used, it throws a small bomb that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. Upon collision with a tile or enemy, the bomb explodes into a bubble that ignores enemy immunity frames.
Seafoam Bomb.tip: Throws a bomb that explodes into a bubble which deals extra damage to enemies · Stealth strikes are faster and explode into 5 bubbles

Sulphurous Sand.name: Sulphurous Sand
Sulphurous Sand.desc: Sulphurous Sand is a Pre-Hardmode block that composes most of the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It is used to craft Seafood and the Ballistic Poison Bomb.

Baroclaw.name: Baroclaw
Baroclaw.desc: The Baroclaw is a craftable Hardmode accessory and a direct upgrade to the Craw Carapace. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Baroclaw.tip: 10% increased damage and 5% increased damage reduction · Attackers take high damage and are inflicted with Armor Crunch and Crush Depth

Craw Carapace.name: Craw Carapace
Craw Carapace.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%.
Craw Carapace.tip: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling

Barracuda Gun.name: Barracuda Gun
Barracuda Gun.desc: The Barracuda Gun is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is an upgraded version of the Piranha Gun. Holding left-click will fire four barracudas that latch on to enemies and deal continuous damage as long as left-click is held down.
Barracuda Gun.tip: Fires four barracudas that latch onto enemies and shred them

Piranha Gun.name: Piranha Gun
Piranha Gun.desc: The Piranha Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged weapon that costs no ammunition. It fires a spread of three returning Mechanical Piranha projectiles that inflict the Hemorrhage debuff for 4-6 seconds on hit.
Piranha Gun.tip: Latches on to enemies for continuous damage

Shark Fin.name: Shark Fin
Shark Fin.desc: The Shark Fin is a crafting material that has a 19/20 chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas found in the Ocean biome, and a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Sand Sharks during a Sandstorm.

Basalt.name: Basalt
Basalt.desc: Basalt is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Arid Soil into Shimmer.

Basalt Slab.name: Basalt Slab
Basalt Slab.desc: Basalt Slab is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block crafted from Basalt at a Work Bench.

Basher.name: Basher
Basher.desc: The Basher is a craftable Pre-Hardmode true melee special sword. When used, it swings back and forth in almost a complete circle toward the cursor and inflicts the Irradiated debuff, while also knocking the player back in the process.
Basher.tip: Swings a rotten club while knocking you back in the process

Bast Statue.name: Bast Statue
Bast Statue.desc: The Bast Statue is a furniture item that grants The Bast Defense buff to players in its vicinity, increasing their defense by 5. The buff effect can be toggled via wire.
Bast Statue.tip: Increases defense by 5 when placed nearby

Any Gold Bar.name: Any Gold Bar
Any Gold Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Ruby.name: Ruby
Ruby.desc: Ruby is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and it also has two exclusive recipes: the Gold Crown and the Platinum Crown. It can be obtained in the following ways:

Batholith Bangle.name: Batholith Bangle
Batholith Bangle.desc: The Batholith Bangle is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a granite flash upon enemy hits with magic weapons that deals 50 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 10 second cooldown.
Batholith Bangle.tip: Magic enemy hits create a powerful granite flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 10 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The solid granite radiates energy throughout your body'

Amber.name: Amber
Amber.desc: Amber is a gem found within the Underground Desert of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and it also has three exclusive recipes: the Crate Potion, the Harpy Charm, and the Slasher's Mysterious Skull.

Any Evil Flesh.name: Any Evil Flesh
Any Evil Flesh.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Black Glass Band.name: Black Glass Band
Black Glass Band.desc: The Black Glass Band is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike.
Black Glass Band.tip: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'

Granite Block.name: Granite Block
Granite Block.desc: Granite is a block found underground in Granite Caves. In addition to being found in placed form, it can also drop from Granite Elementals and Granite Golems.

Battle Potion.name: Battle Potion
Battle Potion.desc: The Battle Potion is a buff potion which grants the Battle buff when consumed. The buff increases the spawn rate and maximum number of enemies and critters that can be on-screen at once by 100%, effectively doubling these rates.

Beastial Pickaxe.name: Beastial Pickaxe
Beastial Pickaxe.desc: The Beastial Pickaxe is a craftable Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining up to Chlorophyte Ore. It emits green light particles when swung and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff.

Beenade.name: Beenade
Beenade.desc: The Beenade is a consumable ranged weapon that acts similarly to a regular Grenade when thrown but releases 15–24 friendly bee projectiles upon detonating after 3 seconds.
Beenade.tip: Explodes into a swarm of bees

Grenade.name: Grenade
Grenade.desc: The Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon which can be purchased from the Demolitionist for each, or found rarely in natural Chests and, once Hardmode is activated, in Pots (replacing Shurikens).
Grenade.tip: A small explosion that will not destroy tiles

Belladonna Spirit Staff.name: Belladonna Spirit Staff
Belladonna Spirit Staff.desc: The Belladonna Spirit Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that can also be obtained from Ivy Chests in the Vernal Pass. When used, it summons a flying forest spirit minion.
Belladonna Spirit Staff.tip: Summons a cute forest spirit that flings magical petals

Rich Mahogany.name: Rich Mahogany
Rich Mahogany.desc: Rich Mahogany is a type of wood harvested from Mahogany trees found naturally growing in the Jungle and Underground Jungle, or from Living Mahogany Trees, Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle, and Jungle Shrines.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.desc: The Stinger is a crafting material used in various Jungle-themed crafting recipes. It is obtained from Spiked Jungle Slimes, Hornets, and Moss Hornets found in the Underground Jungle biome.

Vine.name: Vine
Vine.desc: Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 / 100% drop chance.

Berserker Waraxe.name: Berserker Waraxe
Berserker Waraxe.desc: The Berserker Waraxe is a craftable Hardmode axe. When swung, it emits a small amount of light particles and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff.

Biofusillade.name: Biofusillade
Biofusillade.desc: The Biofusillade is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome. When used, it rapidly shoots gamma lasers that can pierce once.
Biofusillade.tip: Unleashes a concentrated beam of life energy

Biome Blade.name: Biome Blade
Biome Blade.desc: The Biome Blade is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings and is an upgraded version of the Broken Biome Blade. By default, it does not fire any projectile nor does it have any special effects.
Biome Blade.tip: Does nothing..yet · Repairing the blade seems to have improved its attuning capacities · Hold down Right Click while standing still on flat ground to attune the weapon to the powers of the surrounding biome · Pressing Right Click otherwise switches between the current attunement and an extra stored one · Main Attunement: [None] · Secondary Attunement: [None]

Broken Biome Blade.name: Broken Biome Blade
Broken Biome Blade.desc: The Broken Biome Blade is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. By default, it does not fire any projectile nor does it have any special effects.
Broken Biome Blade.tip: Does nothing.. yet · Hold down Right Click while standing still on flat ground to attune the weapon to the powers of the surrounding biome · Pressing Right Click otherwise switches between the current attunement and an extra stored one · Main Attunement: [None] · Secondary Attunement: [None]

Biome Sight Potion.name: Biome Sight Potion
Biome Sight Potion.desc: The Biome Sight Potion is a buff potion which grants the Biome Sight buff when consumed. The buff highlights all tiles that are infected with The Corruption, The Crimson, or The Hallow in purple, red, and pink respectively, while in the dark.
Biome Sight Potion.tip: Shows the location of infected blocks

Diamond.name: Diamond
Diamond.desc: Diamond is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Obsidian.name: Obsidian
Obsidian.desc: Obsidian is a pre-Hardmode ore that is created when water and lava collide. Mining Obsidian requires a Gold/Platinum Pickaxe or better. Explosives can also destroy Obsidian.

Black Pearl Pile.name: Black Pearl Pile
Black Pearl Pile.desc: Black Pearl Pile is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block.

Black Pearl.name: Black Pearl
Black Pearl.desc: Pearls are crafting materials obtained from opening Oysters, and are used to craft Luck Potions. Each of the three pearls have different rarities, with the rarer ones being crafted into stronger potions.

Bladedge Railbow.name: Bladedge Railbow
Bladedge Railbow.desc: The Bladedge Railbow is a craftable Hardmode repeater. It fires out 4 arrows at once, quickly followed by a pair of leaves. The leaves inflict no knockback and deal 70% of the weapon's base damage.
Bladedge Railbow.tip: Fires a spread of 4 arrows and 2 leaves at once

Blazing Star.name: Blazing Star
Blazing Star.desc: The Blazing Star is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a glaive that ricochets towards nearby enemies upon contact with tiles or enemies, and pierces five times. Upon striking tiles, the glaive can re-hit enemies that were hit before.
Blazing Star.tip: Tosses a red-hot ricocheting glaive · After bouncing off of tiles, the glaive can re-hit the same enemy · Stealth strikes shred the first enemy they hit and provide rings of high-knockback orbiting glaives

Essence of Havoc.name: Essence of Havoc
Essence of Havoc.desc: Essences of Havoc are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain enemies related to fire or evil, such as those present in the Brimstone Crag.

Glaive.name: Glaive
Glaive.desc: The Glaive is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is sold by the Bandit for 10 gold. When used, it throws a glaive that ricochets towards nearby enemies upon contact with tiles or enemies, and pierces three times. Each struck enemy will reduce the damage of the glaive by 10%.
Glaive.tip: Tosses a ricocheting glaive · Stealth strikes shred the first enemy they hit and provide a ring of high-knockback orbiting glaives

Hellstone Bar.name: Hellstone Bar
Hellstone Bar.desc: The Hellstone Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar. It is used to craft some of the most powerful equipment available pre-Hardmode, and remains useful, if not necessary, in dealing with the shift in difficulty upon entering Hardmode.

Bleach Ball.name: Bleach Ball
Bleach Ball.desc: The Bleach Ball is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable Aquatic Scourge spawns.
Bleach Ball.tip: Toggle this item to prevent Aquatic Scourge from spawning · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Blighted Gel.name: Blighted Gel
Blighted Gel.desc: Blighted Gel is a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by Blight Slimes. It is used to craft the Overloaded Sludge, Bleach Ball, Sludge Splotch, and Statigel-themed equipment.

Calming Potion.name: Calming Potion
Calming Potion.desc: The Calming Potion is a buff potion which grants the Calm buff when consumed. The buff reduces the enemy spawn rate by 39%, and the maximum number of enemies on-screen is reduced by 40%.

Blessed Phoenix Egg.name: Blessed Phoenix Egg
Blessed Phoenix Egg.desc: The Blessed Phoenix Egg is a craftable boss-summoning item that is used to summon Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. It can be used anywhere at any time.
Blessed Phoenix Egg.tip: Summons Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth · Enrages outside the fire walls · Not consumable · 'A symbol of the Dragon watching over and waiting for you.'

Blight Spewer.name: Blight Spewer
Blight Spewer.desc: The Blight Spewer is a craftable Hardmode flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 33% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a green nanomachine cloud that rapidly slows down after traveling a moderate distance, then lingers for 1.11 seconds before dissipating.
Blight Spewer.tip: Fires clouds of Plague nanomachines that stick to tiles · Nanomachines aggressively lock onto nearby enemies · 33% chance to save ammo

Spark Spreader.name: Spark Spreader
Spark Spreader.desc: The Spark Spreader is a craftable Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.
Spark Spreader.tip: Ignites your foe with flaming sparks · Uses gel for ammo

Blighted Cleaver.name: Blighted Cleaver
Blighted Cleaver.desc: The Blighted Cleaver is a craftable Hardmode broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Caustic Edge. When swung, it fires a large, spinning, blazing phantom blade that homes in on enemies and pierces 3 times. The sword and blades inflict the Acid Venom and Hellfire debuffs.
stats: 4 seconds (True melee hits) / 2 seconds (Blazing Phantom Blade)
4 seconds (True melee hits) / 2 seconds (Blazing Phantom Blade)

Caustic Edge.name: Caustic Edge
