Caustic Edge.desc: The Caustic Edge is a craftable Hardmode broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Tainted Blade. When swung, it fires a green-purple sword beam that can bounce or pierce twice, but loses 50% velocity on each bounce or enemy hit. The sword beam deals 75% of the weapon's damage.
Caustic Edge.tip: Fires a bouncing caustic beam · Inflicts Acid Venom and slows down on enemy hits

Chlorophyte Bar.name: Chlorophyte Bar
Chlorophyte Bar.desc: The Chlorophyte Bar is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses bar.

Vial of Venom.name: Vial of Venom
Vial of Venom.desc: The Vial of Venom is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Witch Doctor for each, after Plantera has been defeated.

Blizzard in a Bottle.name: Blizzard in a Bottle
Blizzard in a Bottle.desc: The Blizzard in a Bottle is a pre-Hardmode accessory which works similarly to the Cloud in a Bottle, allowing the player to double-jump. Instead of a cloud being produced when the player jumps, a trail of snow is produced at the player's feet.
Blizzard in a Bottle.tip: Allows the holder to double jump

Any Snow Block.name: Any Snow Block
Any Snow Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Bottle.name: Bottle
Bottle.desc: A Bottle is a crafting material required to craft most potions. Like the Pink Vase, Mug, and different Cups, placing it (on most "flat-surface items" or a platform) allows it to act as a Placed Bottle where the player can craft potions.
usedIn: Soul of Flight in a Bottle
Soul of Fright in a Bottle
Soul of Light in a Bottle
Soul of Might in a Bottle
Soul of Night in a Bottle
Soul of Sight in a Bottle

Blood Boiler.name: Blood Boiler
Blood Boiler.desc: The Blood Boiler is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses health for ammunition, with a 20% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires two long and continuous streams of bloodfire.
Blood Boiler.tip: Fires twin streams of bloodfire that returns to you · Returning bloodfire reduces Potion Sickness if it struck an enemy · Uses your health as ammo · 20% chance to save health

Blood Moon (Lore).name: Blood Moon (Lore)
Blood Moon (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Blood Moon (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Bloody Tear.name: Bloody Tear
Bloody Tear.desc: The Bloody Tear is an event-summoning item used to summon a Blood Moon. It can only be used at night, and attempting to use it during the day or while a Blood Moon is already active will not summon a Blood Moon, affect the ongoing Blood Moon, or consume the item.
Bloody Tear.tip: Summons the Blood Moon · 'What a horrible night to have a curse.'

Bloodfire Arrow.name: Bloodfire Arrow
Bloodfire Arrow.desc: Bloodfire Arrows are craftable post-Moon Lord arrows. They drain 1 HP from the player when fired, travel at a noticeably higher speed than most arrows, and are not affected by gravity.
Bloodfire Arrow.tip: High-velocity arrows with a blood soaked tip · Firing these arrows will drain your health and boost the arrow damage by 20% · Accelerates your natural life regen and heals you on hit

Bloodfire Bullet.name: Bloodfire Bullet
Bloodfire Bullet.desc: Bloodfire Bullets are craftable post-Moon Lord bullets. They can pass through tiles and accelerate the player's natural life regeneration rate by 3 on enemy hits.
Bloodfire Bullet.tip: Passes through tiles and accelerates your natural life regen on hit based on how powerful the hit was · Deals bonus damage based on your current natural life regen · This damage caps at 1.1x

Bloodflare Dye.name: Bloodflare Dye
Bloodflare Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Bloodsoaked Crasher.name: Bloodsoaked Crasher
Bloodsoaked Crasher.desc: The Bloodsoaked Crasher is a post-Moon Lord non-consumable rogue weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Crushsaw Crasher. When used, it throws a gravity-affected axe that can hit enemies 6 times and bounces twice before disappearing.
Bloodsoaked Crasher.tip: Throws a bloody axe that is affected by gravity and can bounce twice · The axe speeds up over time, but will slow down upon hitting an enemy · Spews blood orbs upon enemy hits · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness · Stealth strikes spawn homing blood bolts on hit

Crushsaw Crasher.name: Crushsaw Crasher
Crushsaw Crasher.desc: The Crushsaw Crasher is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped from Catastrophic Construct. When used, the player swings a claw and throws a homing, spinning axe that can pierce one enemy or bounce once before disappearing on its next impact.
Crushsaw Crasher.tip: Throws bouncing axes · Stealth strikes throw six at once

Bloodstone Core.name: Bloodstone Core
Bloodstone Core.desc: Bloodstone Cores were craftable post-Moon Lord crafting materials. They were used to craft weaponry and armor themed around Bloodstone.

Bloody Mary.name: Bloody Mary
Bloody Mary.desc: Bloody Mary is a craftable Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Bloody Mary debuff, which provides the following effects:
Bloody Mary.tip: Increases enemy spawn rates by 7x · Greatly reduces piercing weapon effectiveness · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Bloody Worm Food.name: Bloody Worm Food
Bloody Worm Food.desc: The Bloody Worm Food is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Perforators. It can only be used in The Crimson or Underground Crimson. Note that the boss can also be summoned by killing a Perforator Cyst, which spawns rarely in the Crimson.
Bloody Worm Food.tip: Summons the Perforator Hive when used in the Crimson · Despawns outside the Crimson · Not consumable · 'Do not play with your food, they won't play with theirs.'

Vertebra.name: Vertebra
Vertebra.desc: The Vertebra (Vertebrae ) is a crafting material that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by Crimeras, Blood Crawlers, Face Monsters, Floaty Grosses.

Bloody Worm Scarf.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
Bloody Worm Scarf.desc: The Bloody Worm Scarf is a craftable Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.
Bloody Worm Scarf.tip: 10% increased damage reduction and melee damage

Bloody Worm Tooth.name: Bloody Worm Tooth
Bloody Worm Tooth.desc: The Bloody Worm Tooth is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Perforators. When equipped, it grants 2 defense and increases melee damage by 10%.

Worm Scarf.name: Worm Scarf
Worm Scarf.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

Blossom Pickaxe.name: Blossom Pickaxe
Blossom Pickaxe.desc: The Blossom Pickaxe is a craftable post-Moon Lord pickaxe that is capable of mining Auric Ore. It has a bonus range of 5 tiles and emits green light particles when swung.

Blue Cosmic Flame Dye.name: Blue Cosmic Flame Dye
Blue Cosmic Flame Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Blue Distorted Monolith.name: Blue Distorted Monolith
Blue Distorted Monolith.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Blue Statigel Dye.name: Blue Statigel Dye
Blue Statigel Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Purified Gel.name: Purified Gel
Purified Gel.desc: Purified Gel is a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by The Slime God. It is used in the crafting of several late Pre-Hardmode equipment that belongs to the "Night's" theme as well as some potions and Statigel-themed items.

Blunder Booster.name: Blunder Booster
Blunder Booster.desc: The Blunder Booster is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Plagued Fuel Pack. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Blunder Booster.tip: 12% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue projectile velocity · Stealth generates 10% faster · Summons a red lightning aura around the player that electrifies nearby enemies with Vermillion Flux · The aura has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · Press Booster Dash to consume 25% of your maximum stealth to perform a swift upwards diagonal dash · This dash leaves a trail of red lightning bolts · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can be used again

Plagued Fuel Pack.name: Plagued Fuel Pack
Plagued Fuel Pack.desc: The Plagued Fuel Pack is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by Plaguebringers. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Plagued Fuel Pack.tip: 8% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue projectile velocity · Stealth generates 10% faster · Press Booster Dash to consume 25% of your maximum stealth to perform a swift upwards diagonal dash · The dash leaves a lingering trail of Plague clouds · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can be used again

Bonebreaker.name: Bonebreaker
Bonebreaker.desc: The Bonebreaker is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that is an upgrade to Bone Javelins. It fires javelins that stick to enemies for a long time, then bursting into damaging rocky shrapnels. Up to six javelin projectiles can be stuck on an enemy at once.
Bonebreaker.tip: Fires javelins that stick to enemies before bursting into shrapnel · Stuck javelins inflict several debuffs

Bone Javelin.name: Bone Javelin
Bone Javelin.desc: The Bone Javelin is a consumable ranged weapon crafted from Sturdy Fossils. Upon hitting an enemy, it will stick to the enemy and inflict the Penetrated debuff, dealing 3 damage per second for 15 seconds.

Corroded Fossil.name: Corroded Fossil
Corroded Fossil.desc: Corroded Fossils are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by various enemies in the Acid Rain event after the Aquatic Scourge has been defeated, as well as some post-Aquatic Scourge Sulphurous Sea enemies.

Boss Rush Monolith.name: Boss Rush Monolith
Boss Rush Monolith.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.desc: The Rock is an item that is obtained as a reward for defeating the Boss Rush. It can be placed as furniture or shimmered into the Boss Rush Monolith, as well as providing lore and being a trophy for completing the Boss Rush.
Rock.tip: When the battle was finally over, the dust having just began to settle · Where even the stone refused the course of time, there sat a monk · Who dared to question history and stare into fate · 'What is the true price of the past being ever eternal? · Why must our future forever haunt us?'

Botanic Bathtub.name: Botanic Bathtub
Botanic Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Uelibloom Brick.name: Uelibloom Brick
Uelibloom Brick.desc: Uelibloom Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Uelibloom Ore at an Ancient Manipulator. It is used in the crafting of Botanic furniture.

Botanic Bed.name: Botanic Bed
Botanic Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Bench.name: Botanic Bench
Botanic Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Botanic Bookcase.name: Botanic Bookcase
Botanic Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Candelabra.name: Botanic Candelabra
Botanic Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Candle.name: Botanic Candle
Botanic Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Botanic Chandelier.name: Botanic Chandelier
Botanic Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Chest.name: Botanic Chest
Botanic Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Botanic Clock.name: Botanic Clock
Botanic Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Door.name: Botanic Door
Botanic Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Dresser.name: Botanic Dresser
Botanic Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Lamp.name: Botanic Lamp
Botanic Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Lantern.name: Botanic Lantern
Botanic Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Piano.name: Botanic Piano
Botanic Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Piercer.name: Botanic Piercer
Botanic Piercer.desc: The Botanic Piercer is a craftable Hardmode spear. When swung, it will fire out a green spear beam that pierces once, and can pass through tiles.

Chlorophyte Partisan.name: Chlorophyte Partisan
Chlorophyte Partisan.desc: The Chlorophyte Partisan is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses spear. When thrust, it fires a Spore Cloud projectile that deals the weapon's damage and knockback, lasts for a short time, can pass through blocks, and pierces an infinite number of enemies.

Dark Lance.name: Dark Lance
Dark Lance.desc: The Dark Lance is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron spear that has a 1/5 chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Gungnir.name: Gungnir
Gungnir.desc: The Gungnir is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear. When thrust, it creates a small shockwave at its tip.

Botanic Planter.name: Botanic Planter
Botanic Planter.desc: The Botanic Planter is a post-Moon Lord furniture item.

Botanic Platform.name: Botanic Platform
Botanic Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Botanic Sink.name: Botanic Sink
Botanic Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Honey Bucket.name: Honey Bucket
Honey Bucket.desc: Buckets are tools used to carry water, lava, or honey, allowing them to be removed or placed.
Honey Bucket.tip: Contains a small amount of honey · Can be poured out

Botanic Table.name: Botanic Table
Botanic Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Botanic Work Bench.name: Botanic Work Bench
Botanic Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Bounding Potion.name: Bounding Potion
Bounding Potion.desc: The Bounding Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.
Bounding Potion.tip: 5% increased jump speed and 20% increased jump height

Moonglow.name: Moonglow
Moonglow.desc: Moonglow is a type of herb which appears as a bent stalk with a drooping blue-white flower.

Bowl.name: Bowl
Bowl.desc: Bowls are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on flat-surface items. Unlike plates, food cannot be placed in bowls. Only the regular Bowl can be used in crafting.

Bowl of Soup.name: Bowl of Soup
Bowl of Soup.desc: The Bowl of Soup is a food item crafted at the Cooking Pot. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff.
Bowl of Soup.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Simple, yet refreshing.'

Mushroom.name: Mushroom
Mushroom.desc: The Mushroom is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion that spawns randomly on grass or Hallowed grass on the surface layer. It can be harvested with any tool or weapon.

Sea Minnow.name: Sea Minnow
Sea Minnow.desc: The Sea Minnow is a critter that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It passively swims back and forth, gaining a temporary speed boost when hitting a tile and will attempt to swim away from the player.

Brimblade.name: Brimblade
Brimblade.desc: The Brimblade is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a brimstone blade that returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy.
Brimblade.tip: Throws a blade that splits on enemy hits · Stealth strikes split further and cause the player to launch a barrage of brimstone darts

Brimflame Boots.name: Brimflame Boots
Brimflame Boots.desc: Brimflame armor is a craftable Hardmode mage armor set crafted from Ashes of Calamity and Unholy Cores. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.
Brimflame Boots.tip: 5% increased magic damage · 5% increased movement speed

Brimflame Cowl.name: Brimflame Cowl
Brimflame Cowl.desc: Brimflame armor is a craftable Hardmode mage armor set crafted from Ashes of Calamity and Unholy Cores. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.
Brimflame Cowl.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 and reduces mana cost by 10% · 10% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · Immunity to On Fire!, Brimstone Flames and Frostburn

Brimflame Dye.name: Brimflame Dye
Brimflame Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Brimflame Robes.name: Brimflame Robes
Brimflame Robes.desc: Brimflame armor is a craftable Hardmode mage armor set crafted from Ashes of Calamity and Unholy Cores. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.
Brimflame Robes.tip: 7% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Brimlash.name: Brimlash
Brimlash.desc: The Brimlash is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires out a brimstone bolt that pierces infinitely and splits into 3 homing bolts upon hitting tiles or reaching the end of its range. Both the sword and the bolt inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.
Brimlash.tip: Fires a brimstone bolt that explodes into more bolts on hit

Brimrose.name: Brimrose
Brimrose.desc: The Brimrose is a craftable post-Moon Lord mount summoning item. When used, it summons a Brimrose mount which acts similarly to the UFO summoned by the Cosmic Car Key, but is much faster and easier to control.

Brimrose Staff.name: Brimrose Staff
Brimrose Staff.desc: The Brimrose Staff is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a single short laser beam that instantly splits into two beams, with the resulting beams also splitting into two more beams.
Brimrose Staff.tip: Fires a spread of splitting brimstone beams

Brimstone Elemental (Lore).name: Brimstone Elemental (Lore)
Brimstone Elemental (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Brimstone Elemental (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Brimstone Fury.name: Brimstone Fury
Brimstone Fury.desc: The Brimstone Fury is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it shoots 3 arrows in a slight spread. If Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, arrows are converted into three fast brimstone laser bolts with a slight spread. The bolts dissipate upon impact with tiles and can pierce twice.
Brimstone Fury.tip: Converts wooden arrows into a spread of 3 brimstone bolts

Brimstone Locus.name: Brimstone Locus
Brimstone Locus.desc: The Brimstone Locus is an item placed in a player's inventory when they open the enchanting interface after talking to the Brimstone Witch for the first time.
Brimstone Locus.tip: 'Not only can I enhance your equipment with potent magic, · I can also transcend some of your weaponry to entirely new forms. · Such items are revealed while this item is in your inventory.'

Ashes of Annihilation.name: Ashes of Annihilation
Ashes of Annihilation.desc: Ashes of Annihilation are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. They are used to craft Shadowspec Bars among other items, and the Ceremonial Urn, a non-consumable item used to summon Supreme Witch, Calamitas.
Ashes of Annihilation.tip: The smoldering essence of the Witch's wrath

Brimstone Slab.name: Brimstone Slab
Brimstone Slab.desc: Brimstone Slab is a block that naturally generates in ruined structures of the Brimstone Crag. It can also be crafted with Brimstone Slag at a Heavy Work Bench. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.

Brimstone Slab Wall.name: Brimstone Slab Wall
Brimstone Slab Wall.desc: Brimstone Slab Wall is a background wall crafted with Brimstone Slab.

Brimstone Slag Wall.name: Brimstone Slag Wall
Brimstone Slag Wall.desc: Brimstone Slag Wall is a background wall. It is crafted with Brimstone Slag.

Brimstone Sword.name: Brimstone Sword
Brimstone Sword.desc: The Brimstone Sword is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it summons a brimstone geyser on enemy hits that is affected by gravity and lingers for a short time before dissipating.
Brimstone Sword.tip: Summons geysers of Brimstone Flames on hit · Press Right Click to throw the sword like a javelin that explodes on hit

Any Wooden Sword.name: Any Wooden Sword
Any Wooden Sword.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Dirt Block.name: Dirt Block
Dirt Block.desc: The Dirt Block is one of the most common blocks in Terraria, occurring naturally almost everywhere throughout the world. All caves above the elevation of 0ft are made of Dirt. Below 0ft, in the underground layer, the caves are made of roughly 50% Dirt.

Broken Plagued 'Bed'.name: Broken Plagued 'Bed'
Broken Plagued 'Bed'.desc: Basins are furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. Unlike the other furniture sets, only six types of basins exist in the Calamity Mod.

Plagued Containment Brick.name: Plagued Containment Brick
Plagued Containment Brick.desc: Plagued Containment Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Plague Cell Canisters. It is used in the crafting of Plagued furniture.

Plagued 'Bed'.name: Plagued 'Bed'
Plagued 'Bed'.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Bubonic Round.name: Bubonic Round
Bubonic Round.desc: Bubonic Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They burst into a virulent plague upon contact which inflicts the Plague debuff and they ignore 10% of the enemy's defense.
Bubonic Round.tip: Spreads the Plague on hit and ignores 10% of enemy defense

Musket Ball.name: Musket Ball
Musket Ball.desc: The Musket Ball is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g.

Builder Potion.name: Builder Potion
Builder Potion.desc: The Builder Potion is a buff potion that grants the Builder buff when consumed. It grants the following effects:

Bullet-Filled Shotgun.name: Bullet-Filled Shotgun
Bullet-Filled Shotgun.desc: The Bullet-Filled Shotgun is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used, it fires 40 bullets per shot at an extremely large spread and varying velocity, consuming 5 bullets.
Bullet-Filled Shotgun.tip: Fires a massive spread of bouncing bullets · Bullets attempt to bounce towards enemies after bouncing twice · Consumes five bullets per-use · 'Aim? What's that?'

Burning Sea.name: Burning Sea
Burning Sea.desc: The Burning Sea is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, a brimstone fireball is conjured near the player which grows to a massive size over 4 seconds. This fireball can weakly follow the cursor.
Burning Sea.tip: Conjures a massive fireball that hovers near you and incinerates foes with Brimstone Flames · Holding the fireball for too long causes it to burn out · This sets you alight with Brimstone Flames and gives a long delay before another can be cast

Rancor.name: Rancor
Rancor.desc: The Rancor is a post-Moon Lord spell tome, and the exhumed form of the Burning Sea. When used, it creates a magic circle a set distance away from the player. After 3 seconds, the magic circle fires a large laser beam that pierces infinitely.
Rancor.tip: Casts a magic circle that charges energy and eventually releases a powerful laser burst of controlled maleficent magic · The laser causes arms and searing lava to appear on surfaces it touches

Buzzkill.name: Buzzkill
Buzzkill.desc: The Buzzkill is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When held, it charges up a handheld buzzsaw which deals 100% damage on contact.
Buzzkill.tip: Hold Left Click to rev up a buzzsaw that deals close-range damage · Release to fire the buzzsaw, which bounces off tiles and shreds foes · Revving up the saws increases their damage and allows them to pierce more enemies · 'Not to be confused with the Sawed-On Shotgun'

Illegal Gun Parts.name: Illegal Gun Parts
Illegal Gun Parts.desc: Illegal Gun Parts are a crafting material used to craft the Sandgun, the Megashark, and the Flamethrower. They are sold by the Arms Dealer for at night.

Plagueplate.name: Plagueplate
Plagueplate.desc: Plagueplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Jungle Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Faded Idolatry and Plague Turrets.

Onyxplate.name: Onyxplate
Onyxplate.desc: Onyxplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Cavern Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Phantomic Artifact and Onyx Turrets.

Cinderplate.name: Cinderplate
Cinderplate.desc: Cinderplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Space Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Normality Relocator and Laser Turrets.

Havocplate.name: Havocplate
Havocplate.desc: Havocplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Underworld Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Profaned Soul Artifact and Fire Turrets.

Navyplate.name: Navyplate
Navyplate.desc: Navyplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Sunken Sea Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Fragments of Another World and Water Turrets.

Elumplate.name: Elumplate
Elumplate.desc: Elumplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Ice Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Crushing Ego and Ice Turrets.

Calamitas (Lore).name: Calamitas (Lore)
Calamitas (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Calamitas (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Calamitas Trophy.name: Calamitas Trophy
Calamitas Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Calamitas Clone (Lore).name: Calamitas Clone (Lore)
Calamitas Clone (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Calamitas Clone (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Calamitas Clone Trophy.name: Calamitas Clone Trophy
Calamitas Clone Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Calamitous Dye.name: Calamitous Dye
Calamitous Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Calcium Potion.name: Calcium Potion
Calcium Potion.desc: The Calcium Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion that is also sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a full moon, waning gibbous, third quarter, or waning crescent.. Upon consumption, it grants the Calcium buff, which causes the player to take half as much knockback.

Caribbean Rum.name: Caribbean Rum
Caribbean Rum.desc: Caribbean Rum is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Caribbean Rum debuff, which increases movement speed by 25% but halves the gravity.
Caribbean Rum.tip: Increases move speed by 25% · Reduces your gravity by 50% · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Ice Feather.name: Ice Feather
Ice Feather.desc: The Ice Feather is a Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Frozen Wings. The Ice Feather has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by Ice Golems during a Blizzard in the Snow biome.

Cascade.name: Cascade
Cascade.desc: The Cascade is a pre-Hardmode-exclusive, post-Skeletron yoyo that has a 1/400 chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld. Once Hardmode begins, it will no longer drop, being replaced by the Hel-Fire.

Hel-Fire.name: Hel-Fire
Hel-Fire.desc: The Hel-Fire is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/400 chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld. It inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 3–8 seconds upon hit.

Any Hardmode Evil Component.name: Any Hardmode Evil Component
Any Hardmode Evil Component.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Spider Fang.name: Spider Fang
Spider Fang.desc: The Spider Fang is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Black Recluses in Spider Nests with a 1/2 / 9/10 chance. It can be used to craft several minion-related items and armor.

Tainted Blade.name: Tainted Blade
Tainted Blade.desc: The Tainted Blade is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. The sword inflicts the Poisoned debuff.

Caustic Staff.name: Caustic Staff
Caustic Staff.desc: The Caustic Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a black Caustic Dragon minion that flies behind the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing thorns that pass through tiles and pierce twice.
Caustic Staff.tip: Summons a mini dragon to fight for you · The dragon attacks faster and inflicts more debuffs the more are summoned · Hold Shift for moreAlways inflicts Hellfire and Acid Venom · Inflicts Cursed Inferno with 2 dragons summoned · Inflicts Ichor (debuff) with 3 dragons summoned · Inflicts Marked for Death with 4 dragons summoned

Any Evil Bar.name: Any Evil Bar
Any Evil Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Caustic Tear.name: Caustic Tear
Caustic Tear.desc: The Caustic Tear is a Pre-Hardmode event summoning item that is used to start the Acid Rain event.
Caustic Tear.tip: Causes an acidic downpour in the Sulphurous Sea

Sulphurous Shale.name: Sulphurous Shale
Sulphurous Shale.desc: Sulphurous Shale is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found at the bottom of the Sulphurous Sea biome and mostly in the Sulphuric Depths layer of the Abyss, which spawns upon world generation. It requires at least a Nightmare or Deathbringer Pickaxe to mine.

Ceaseless Dye.name: Ceaseless Dye
Ceaseless Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Dark Plasma.name: Dark Plasma
Dark Plasma.desc: Dark Plasma is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is dropped by the Ceaseless Void. It is used in the crafting of several magic and rogue weapons among other items.

Shadow Dye.name: Shadow Dye
Shadow Dye.desc: Shadow Dye is a type of dye bought from the Dye Trader during a full moon, or given as a possible reward for turning in a Strange Plant in Hardmode. When applied, it will darken the color of an item to almost pure black.

Void Dye.name: Void Dye
Void Dye.desc: Void Dye is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord dye crafted using Luminite Bars. The dye causes a pulsating effect, much like the pulsating effect that the Moon Lord creates moments before he spawns.

Ceaseless Hunger Potion.name: Ceaseless Hunger Potion
Ceaseless Hunger Potion.desc: The Ceaseless Hunger Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Ceaseless Hunger buff, which causes all items within the world to be sucked up by the player.
Ceaseless Hunger Potion.tip: Causes you to suck up all items in the world

Ceaseless Void (Lore).name: Ceaseless Void (Lore)
Ceaseless Void (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Ceaseless Void (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Ceaseless Void Trophy.name: Ceaseless Void Trophy
Ceaseless Void Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Celestial Remains.name: Celestial Remains
Celestial Remains.desc: Celestial Remains are Hardmode blocks which replaces Desert Fossils in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. Like their counterpart, they can be used in the Extractinator.

Celestial Remains Wall.name: Celestial Remains Wall
Celestial Remains Wall.desc: Celestial Remains Wall is a background wall that replaces Desert Fossil Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Celestus.name: Celestus
Celestus.desc: The Celestus is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang. When used, it rapidly throws a high velocity scythe that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance.
Celestus.tip: Throws a high-velocity scythe that splits into multiple phantom scythes on enemy hits · Stealth strikes reverse direction and home in on enemies after returning to the player · Struck enemies are decimated by Miracle Blight

Enchanted Axe.name: Enchanted Axe
Enchanted Axe.desc: The Enchanted Axe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is the direct upgrade to the Iron Francisca and Lead Tomahawk. When used, it throws an enchanted axe that travels a moderate distance before returning to the player.
Enchanted Axe.tip: Throws a high velocity axe that returns to you after travelling a short distance or hitting a wall · At the furthest point from the player, a magical axe that travels through walls will be cast towards the nearest enemy · Stealth strikes make the axe fly further, casting additional homing magical axes

Miracle Matter.name: Miracle Matter
Miracle Matter.desc: Miracle Matter is a craftable post-Moon Lord crafting material that can be crafted after the Exo Mechs have been defeated. It is used to craft weapons from the endgame "Exo Weapons" set. When dropped or in the inventory, the item will pulse and glow.
Miracle Matter.tip: Its amorphous form contains untold potential · One is required for every Exo Weapon

Molten Amputator.name: Molten Amputator
Molten Amputator.desc: The Molten Amputator is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it throws a rapidly spinning scythe which lingers at the position of the cursor when it was fired before returning.
Molten Amputator.tip: Throws a spinning scythe that lingers at your cursor · Right Click to recall all existing scythes · Recalling a scythe while it's on an enemy rends them for massive damage · Right Click with sufficient stealth to empower the next 30 scythes and greatly increase attack speed · You cannot recall scythes thrown while empowered

Rebounding Rainbow.name: Rebounding Rainbow
Rebounding Rainbow.desc: The Rebounding Rainbow is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang. When used, it rapidly throws a disk that has a chance of splitting into 8 more disks when near an enemy.
Rebounding Rainbow.tip: Throws a disk that has a chance to generate several disks if enemies are near it · Stealth strikes fly slower but travel farther, pierce through enemies, and spawn extra disks more frequently

Subduction Slicer.name: Subduction Slicer
Subduction Slicer.desc: The Subduction Slicer is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang that auto-fires. When used, it throws a scythe that pierces 4 times and creates a small explosion on enemy hits that deals 80% of the weapon's damage and inflicts the Hellfire debuff.
Subduction Slicer.tip: Throws a scythe that explodes on enemy hits · Stealth strikes also summon a pillar of fire on enemy hits

Ceremonial Urn.name: Ceremonial Urn
Ceremonial Urn.desc: The Ceremonial Urn is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It can only be used at an Altar of the Accursed.
Ceremonial Urn.tip: Use at the Altar of the Accursed to summon the Supreme Witch, Calamitas · Not consumable · 'The Witch will not allow it to happen once again.'

Chain Guillotines.name: Chain Guillotines
Chain Guillotines.desc: The Chain Guillotines are a Hardmode flail that have a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics. When used, they fire two blades attached to chains in rapid succession, with a maximum range of 32 tiles. They can pierce enemies that are very close by.

Fetid Baghnakhs.name: Fetid Baghnakhs
Fetid Baghnakhs.desc: The Fetid Baghnakhs are a Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics. They have a very short range, but an exceptionally high attack speed.

Chalice of the Blood God.name: Chalice of the Blood God
Chalice of the Blood God.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Chalice of the Blood God.tip: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding, Burning Blood, Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

Blood Pact.name: Blood Pact
Blood Pact.desc: The Blood Pact is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Ravager.
Blood Pact.tip: Increases max HP by 25% · Healing Potions are 33% more effective · Grants immunity to Bleeding, Burning Blood and Heavy Bleeding

Charm of Myths.name: Charm of Myths
Charm of Myths.desc: The Charm of Myths is a Hardmode accessory which combines the effects of the Band of Regeneration and the Philosopher's Stone. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%.
Charm of Myths.tip: Provides life regeneration and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%

Chaos Candle.name: Chaos Candle
Chaos Candle.desc: The Chaos Candle is a craftable Hardmode furniture item that will emit light and grant the Chaos Candle buff, which boosts all spawn rates by 100% and maximum spawn count by 100%.
Chaos Candle.tip: The mere presence of this candle enrages surrounding enemies drastically

Water Candle.name: Water Candle
Water Candle.desc: The Water Candle is a furniture item that emits a low amount of light, and can be placed only on flat-surface items. When placed or held, it gives nearby players the Water Candle debuff.
Water Candle.tip: Holding this may attract unwanted attention

Zerg Potion.name: Zerg Potion
Zerg Potion.desc: The Zerg Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Zerg buff, which increases spawn rates and maximum spawn count by 300%. It is also used in the crafting of the Chaos Candle.

Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier.name: Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier
Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier.desc: Charged Wulfrum Energy Barriers are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Glass and Energy Cores at a Heavy Work Bench.

Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall.name: Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall
Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall.desc: Charged Wulfrum Energy Barrier Walls are a background wall crafted with Charged Wulfrum Energy Barriers.

Energy Core.name: Energy Core
Energy Core.desc: Energy Cores are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Wulfrum enemies when they are supercharged. They are used to craft several Wulfrum related items.

Charged Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb.name: Charged Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb
Charged Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Charred Idol.name: Charred Idol
Charred Idol.desc: The Charred Idol is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Brimstone Elemental. It can only be used in the Brimstone Crag.
Charred Idol.tip: Summons the Brimstone Elemental when used in the Brimstone Crags · Enrages outside the Brimstone Crags · Not consumable · 'Anything under her gaze shall be scorched beyond recognition.'

Chik.name: Chik
Chik.desc: The Chik is a Hardmode yoyo. On every 3rd yoyo hit, the Chik deals 200% damage (( base damage) and also shoots a spread of 5 crystal shards in random directions that can pass through blocks and travel for a short distance before disappearing.

Wooden Yoyo.name: Wooden Yoyo
Wooden Yoyo.desc: The Wooden Yoyo is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Chlorophyte Ore.name: Chlorophyte Ore
Chlorophyte Ore.desc: Chlorophyte Ore is a Hardmode ore. After Hardmode starts, Mud Blocks located near Jungle grass blocks (naturally in the Underground Jungle) in or below the bottom half of the Underground layer will occasionally be replaced by Chlorophyte Ore.

Perennial Ore.name: Perennial Ore
Perennial Ore.desc: "Energized plant matter has formed in the underground."

Chromatic Eruption.name: Chromatic Eruption
Chromatic Eruption.desc: The Chromatic Eruption is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires long bursts of rainbow flames that pierce five times. It additionally fires pairs of homing elemental flares.
Chromatic Eruption.tip: Charges up to spew rainbow flames and pairs of homing chromatic flares · Uses gel for ammo · 50% chance to save ammo

Vortex Fragment.name: Vortex Fragment
Vortex Fragment.desc: The Vortex Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100.

Wildfire Bloom.name: Wildfire Bloom
Wildfire Bloom.desc: The Wildfire Bloom is a craftable Hardmode flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a long burst of green flames at a moderate range.
Wildfire Bloom.tip: Charges up to emit a stream of energized flames and pairs of homing wildfire flares · Uses gel for ammo · 50% chance to save ammo

Chronomancer's Scythe.name: Chronomancer's Scythe
Chronomancer's Scythe.desc: The Chronomancer's Scythe is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), the player will swing a scythe towards the cursor rapidly with a tiny range, similarly to the Terragrim.
Chronomancer's Scythe.tip: Rapidly fires icicles that cause Time Distortion on enemies · Press Right Click to swing the scythe around you, creating a clock pattern of homing icicles · Direct hits with the scythe have a chance to spawn clocks · Collecting the clocks increases movement speed and acceleration by 5% for each clock collected · This stacks up to 3 times and each level wears off after 5 seconds
stats: Depends on how many clocks are collected

Fast Clock.name: Fast Clock
Fast Clock.desc: The Fast Clock is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Slow debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Pixies, regular Mummies, and Wraiths.

Ice Sickle.name: Ice Sickle
Ice Sickle.desc: The Ice Sickle is a Hardmode broadsword that can be dropped with a 1/100 chance by Armored Vikings, Ice Elementals, Ice Tortoises, and Icy Mermen.

drops.chance: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.56%
(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.56%
(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1% / / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.56%

Cinder Arrow.name: Cinder Arrow
Cinder Arrow.desc: Cinder Arrows are craftable Hardmode arrows. They create a small explosion on hit, dealing 40% damage to all nearby enemies. They also additionally burst into three gravity-affected flaming pieces of shrapnel which do not pierce, deal 6% damage, and inflict Brimstone Flames.
Cinder Arrow.tip: Explosive arrows that burst into weak flaming Brimstone Shards

Hellfire Arrow.name: Hellfire Arrow
Hellfire Arrow.desc: The Hellfire Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow that explodes upon impact, damaging all enemies in a small area.

Cinder Blossom Staff.name: Cinder Blossom Staff
Cinder Blossom Staff.desc: The Cinder Blossom Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a spinning scorching flower minion above the player's head that fires a flaming cinder at nearby enemies which pierces twice and passes through tiles.
Cinder Blossom Staff.tip: Summons a scorching flower over your head · There can only be one flower at a time

Ash Wood.name: Ash Wood
Ash Wood.desc: Ash Wood is a type of wood harvested from Ash trees found naturally growing in Ash forests. Ash trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Ash grass at any height.

Fireblossom.name: Fireblossom
Fireblossom.desc: Fireblossom is a type of herb which appears as a small, magma-colored flower.

Cinderplate Wall.name: Cinderplate Wall
Cinderplate Wall.desc: Cinderplate Wall is a background wall crafted with Cinderplate.

Cinders of Lament.name: Cinders of Lament
Cinders of Lament.desc: The Cinders of Lament is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon, and the exhumed form of the Entropy's Vigil. When used, a full-sized apparition of Cataclysm or Catastrophe appears at the player's cursor. After 0.67 seconds, its damage increases by 45% and it charges at the player.
Cinders of Lament.tip: Summons either Cataclysm or Catastrophe at the mouse position · They will look at you for a moment before charging at you · They can do damage to both you and enemies

Entropy's Vigil.name: Entropy's Vigil
Entropy's Vigil.desc: The Entropy's Vigil is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Calamitas Clone.
Entropy's Vigil.tip: Summons a mini Calamitas Clone and her brothers to protect you

Cinnamon Roll.name: Cinnamon Roll
Cinnamon Roll.desc: Cinnamon Roll is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Cinnamon Roll debuff, which increases dash velocity by 100% but significantly reduces dash distance.
Cinnamon Roll.tip: Greatly increases dash speed · Greatly reduces dash distance · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Turtle Shell.name: Turtle Shell
Turtle Shell.desc: The Turtle Shell is a Hardmode crafting material. It has a 1/12 chance of being dropped by Giant Tortoises, which spawn in the Jungle and Underground Jungle.

Clay Block.name: Clay Block
Clay Block.desc: Clay is a block type mainly used as a crafting material. It is found primarily in Surface-level (above 0 elevation) areas, and is more rare at the upper parts of the Underground.

Clay Pot.name: Clay Pot
Clay Pot.desc: The Clay Pot is a furniture item in which a herb or flower seed can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of it, provided the pot is placed on the surface or in Space. The plant in a Clay Pot cannot be cut in the regular manner, e.g.

Cleansing Blaze.name: Cleansing Blaze
Cleansing Blaze.desc: The Cleansing Blaze is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires a large spread of purple flames that pierce infinitely, pass through tiles, and inflict the God Slayer Inferno debuff on hit.
Cleansing Blaze.tip: Unleashes a torrent of God Slayer Inferno which can pass through tiles · Uses gel for ammo

Cleansing Jelly.name: Cleansing Jelly
Cleansing Jelly.desc: The Cleansing Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Blue Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies. While equipped, drinking a healing potion spawns a blue cleansing aura. All debuffs are removed upon entering the aura, and this effect applies once per aura.
Cleansing Jelly.tip: Using a healing potion spawns a blue aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs one time

Life Jelly.name: Life Jelly
Life Jelly.desc: The Life Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Pink Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies.
Life Jelly.tip: Using a healing potion spawns a pink aura that lasts for 30 seconds · The aura grants +2 HP/s life regen

Clinger Staff.name: Clinger Staff
Clinger Staff.desc: The Clinger Staff is a Hardmode magic weapon that generates a 15-tile high wall of Cursed Flame, which deals damage and inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff to enemies that walk through it for a duration of 7 seconds.
Clinger Staff.tip: Summons a wall of cursed flames

Life Drain.name: Life Drain
Life Drain.desc: The Life Drain is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.
stats: Until all enemies are killed or usage of Life Drain ceases

Clockwork Bow.name: Clockwork Bow
Clockwork Bow.desc: The Clockwork Bow is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. When used, it slowly loads up to 6 precision bolts. Each bolt loaded reduces the time taken to load the next bolt by 5%. Whenever a bolt is loaded, the text Tick or Tock shows up above the player in alternating order.
Clockwork Bow.tip: Hold Left Click to load up to six precision bolts · The more precision bolts are loaded, the harder they hit

Cloud in a Bottle.name: Cloud in a Bottle
Cloud in a Bottle.desc: The Cloud in a Bottle is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. When equipped, it allows the player an extra jump.
Cloud in a Bottle.tip: Allows the holder to double jump

Cnidarian.name: Cnidarian
Cnidarian.desc: The Cnidarian is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, the user holds out a fishing rod and a jellyfish on a string attaches to the bottom of the user's cursor.
Cnidarian.tip: Fishes up an electric jellyfish · Periodically sends out sparks to electrocute nearby enemies. · 'From looking at their less sapient brethren, the Old Kingdom's inhabitants adapted tools and weapons designed for underwater efficiency. · The electric properties of ghost bells remain useful even after death, having been commonly used as conduits.'

Sea Remains.name: Sea Remains
Sea Remains.desc: Sea Remains are a Pre-Hardmode crafting material made with a Pearl Shard, Coral, a Starfish and a Seashell. They are used to craft various ocean-themed items.

Cobalt Kunai.name: Cobalt Kunai
Cobalt Kunai.desc: The Cobalt Kunai is a craftable Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a cobalt dagger that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Cobalt Kunai.tip: Stealth strikes fire four homing cobalt energy bolts

Cobalt Bar.name: Cobalt Bar
Cobalt Bar.desc: The Cobalt Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Cobalt Shield.name: Cobalt Shield
Cobalt Shield.desc: The Cobalt Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Box. While equipped, it grants 1 defense and immunity to knockback.

Any Cobalt Bar.name: Any Cobalt Bar
Any Cobalt Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Codebreaker Base.name: Codebreaker Base
Codebreaker Base.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Charging Station.name: Charging Station
Charging Station.desc: Charging Station is a furniture item used to charge certain weapons. It uses Draedon Power Cells as fuel to grant weapons charge. To charge an item, right-click the station, put the arsenal weapon at the top, and the power cell at the bottom. It can be found inside Arsenal Labs.
Charging Station.tip: Charges Draedon's Arsenal items using Draedon Power Cell · Place both an item and Power Cells into the Charging Station to charge the item

Coin of Deceit.name: Coin of Deceit
Coin of Deceit.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.
Coin of Deceit.tip: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance

Comet Quasher.name: Comet Quasher
Comet Quasher.desc: The Comet Quasher is a craftable Hardmode special sword that autoswings. On use, the sword is swung in a circular motion around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a barrage of 4 meteors on them that deals 150% base damage.
Comet Quasher.tip: Summons a swarm of meteors from the sky on enemy hits

Meteorite Bar.name: Meteorite Bar
Meteorite Bar.desc: The Meteorite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar. In addition to being crafted, Meteorite Bars can also be found as common items in Shadow Chests, or more rarely in Gold Chests in the Cavern layer that generate close to the Underworld.

Comet Shard.name: Comet Shard
Comet Shard.desc: The Comet Shard is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that can only be consumed once, and upon consumption, increases the player's maximum mana by 60. There are two other items that function identically to this: the Ethereal Core and the Phantom Heart.

Conference Call.name: Conference Call
Conference Call.desc: The Conference Call is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it shoots a tight spread of four bullets with tripled velocity. If an enemy is nearby, seven bullets are additionally fired from the sky targeting the enemy present.
Conference Call.tip: Fires a tight spread of bullets that call more bullets from the sky · @everyone

Tactical Shotgun.name: Tactical Shotgun
Tactical Shotgun.desc: The Tactical Shotgun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that has a 1/12 / 23/144 chance of being dropped by Tactical Skeletons in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires six bullets in a spread, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Consecrated Water.name: Consecrated Water
Consecrated Water.desc: The Consecrated Water is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws a gravity affected holy flask that breaks upon contact with enemies or tiles. Upon breaking, the flask releases a 20-block high flame pillar that damages enemies and dissipates after three seconds.
Consecrated Water.tip: Throws a holy flask of water that explodes into a sacred flame pillar · The pillar is destroyed if there's no tiles below it · Stealth strikes create three flame pillars instead of one on impact · The bottle is surprisingly dusty

Holy Water.name: Holy Water
Holy Water.desc: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown.
Holy Water.tip: Spreads the Hallow to some blocks

Contagion.name: Contagion
Contagion.desc: The Contagion is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer bow. It fires arrows that leave behind a trail of orbs, exploding after a short delay. Holding left-click will cause the bow to "spin-up", increasing the fire rate appreciably.
Contagion.tip: Fires contagion arrows that leave exploding orbs behind as they travel

Riftburst.name: Riftburst
Riftburst.desc: The Riftburst is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that is the direct upgrade to the Phantasm. When used, it shoots volleys of 5 arrows at an initially low rate of fire that increases as it is used continuously.
Riftburst.tip: Fires a spread of 5 arrows and emits phantom arrows on enemy hits · 66% chance to save ammo

Continental Greatbow.name: Continental Greatbow
Continental Greatbow.desc: The Continental Greatbow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows. All ammunition is fired in volleys of three, followed by two arrows picked randomly: Ichor Arrows or explosive Hellfire Arrows.
Continental Greatbow.tip: Wooden arrows are set alight with fire · Fires 3 arrows at once · Fires 2 additional hellfire or ichor arrows

Scoria Bar.name: Scoria Bar
Scoria Bar.desc: Scoria Bars are Hardmode bars that are made with 4 Scoria Ore at a Hardmode Forge and are additionally dropped from the Fleshy and Necromantic Geode. They are used to craft various volcanic-themed items, as well as being used to craft Life Alloys.

Cooked Fish.name: Cooked Fish
Cooked Fish.desc: The Cooked Fish is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Cooked Fish.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Where's the chips!?'

Coralskin Foolfish.name: Coralskin Foolfish
Coralskin Foolfish.desc: The Coralskin Foolfish is an unobtainable item.
Coralskin Foolfish.tip: Camouflage is one of nature's best defenses

Gleaming Cucumber.name: Gleaming Cucumber
Gleaming Cucumber.desc: The Gleaming Cucumber is an unobtainable item.
Gleaming Cucumber.tip: A slippery, slimy creature found on the Polyp Forest's floor

Molten Fishron.name: Molten Fishron
Molten Fishron.desc: The Molten Fishron is an unobtainable item.
Molten Fishron.tip: Instead of honking it makes crisp wheezing noises · Or maybe it actually is wheezing due to being taken out of lava

Prismatic Guppy.name: Prismatic Guppy
Prismatic Guppy.desc: The Prismatic Guppy is a fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea. It replaces Bass when fishing in the Sunken Sea and can be used to craft Cooked Fish.
Prismatic Guppy.tip: Throwing these in an aquarium would be insanity

Specular Sturgeon.name: Specular Sturgeon
Specular Sturgeon.desc: The Specular Sturgeon is an unobtainable item.
Specular Sturgeon.tip: A deep-dwelling fish that can live for many generations · Needless to say, it's old!

Squidoom.name: Squidoom
Squidoom.desc: The Squidoom is an unobtainable item.
Squidoom.tip: Those who gaze at it for too long are said to enter a hypnotic state

Twinkling Pollox.name: Twinkling Pollox
Twinkling Pollox.desc: The Twinkling Pollox is a fishing catch caught in the Astral Infection. It replaces Bass when fishing in the Astral Infection and can be used to craft Cooked Fish.

Cooked Shrimp.name: Cooked Shrimp
Cooked Shrimp.desc: The Cooked Shrimp is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Cooked Shrimp.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Barbecue it, boil it, broil it, bake it...'

Procyonid Prawn.name: Procyonid Prawn
Procyonid Prawn.desc: The Procyonid Prawn is a fishing catch caught in the Astral Infection. It replaces Shrimp when fishing in the Astral Infection and can be used to craft Cooked Shrimp.

Cool Whip.name: Cool Whip
Cool Whip.desc: The Cool Whip is a Hardmode whip. It has a 30% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Cool Whip.tip: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to summon a friendly snowflake · 'Let me have some of that cool whip'

Frost Core.name: Frost Core
Frost Core.desc: The Frost Core is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped from Ice Golems, which spawn during Blizzards in the Snow biome. To craft all items that require this material, 5 Frost Cores are required.

Coral Spout.name: Coral Spout
Coral Spout.desc: The Coral Spout is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. It fires out a spread of five pink coral spikes that travel a short distance before exploding, dealing damage to enemies. Additionally, Coral Spout can also be charged up to decrease the spread of the coral spikes.
Coral Spout.tip: Casts a shotgun-like blast of coral shards · Keep the attack button held down to narrow the spread · Coral shards ignore 5 points of enemy defense · Fully charging the attack releases a single, bigger chunk of coral that sticks to enemies · Grabbing the chunk of coral after it falls from the enemy replenishes 150 mana · The mana-charged coral also provides the Coral Symbiosis buff · 'Knowledge is important, and the Old Sea Kingdom's many scribes knew it had to be preserved at any cost. · Their libraries were much larger than most, because of the water-proof stone tablets occupying them.'

Coral.name: Coral
Coral.desc: Corals are crafting materials which can be found in the Ocean biomes at the ends of the world.
Coral.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
Ectoplasm.desc: Ectoplasm is a Hardmode post-Plantera crafting material dropped from Dungeon Spirits in the Dungeon. Dungeon Spirits drop 1–2 Ectoplasm upon death.

Corinth Prime.name: Corinth Prime
Corinth Prime.desc: The Corinth Prime is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it converts Musket Balls into explosive bullets identical to those of the Realm Ravager. All ammunition is fired in small spreads of 6.
Corinth Prime.tip: Shoots a tight burst of 6 high velocity bullets · Press Right Click to fire a grenade · The grenade emits a massive explosion if it doesn't touch anything for 2 seconds · Otherwise, the grenade emits an extremely weak explosion · Converts musket balls into high velocity explosive bullets

Realm Ravager.name: Realm Ravager
Realm Ravager.desc: The Realm Ravager is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by the Ravager. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, they are converted into explosive bullets. When used, it fires a shotgun blast of 4 bullets while 1 bullet is always aimed at the cursor.
Realm Ravager.tip: Shoots a burst of 4 bullets · Converts musket balls into explosive bullets

Vortex Beater.name: Vortex Beater
Vortex Beater.desc: The Vortex Beater is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist gun. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets with inaccurate spread.
Vortex Beater.tip: 66% chance to save ammo · 'The catastrophic mixture of pew pew and boom boom.'

Corroded Caustibow.name: Corroded Caustibow
Corroded Caustibow.desc: The Corroded Caustibow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, It fires slow gravity-affected toxic shells that emit a wet aura along its path which deals 15% of the weapon's damage.
Corroded Caustibow.tip: Converts wooden arrows into slow, powerful shells that trail an irradiated aura

Shellshooter.name: Shellshooter
Shellshooter.desc: The Shellshooter is a Pre-Hardmode bow that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into very slow shells that pierce four times.
Shellshooter.tip: Fires slow but powerful arrows · Converts wooden arrows into heavy piercing seashells

Toxibow.name: Toxibow
Toxibow.desc: The Toxibow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into toxic arrows that cause a tiny explosion upon contact with tiles or enemies, which deals an additional 50% of the weapon's damage and inflicts the Irradiated debuff.
Toxibow.tip: Converts wooden arrows into slow arrows that inflict Irradiated

Corruption Effigy.name: Corruption Effigy
Corruption Effigy.desc: The Corruption Effigy is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item that is found in the Lesion Chest within The Corruption shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold during a First Quarter after the item has been found.
Corruption Effigy.tip: Right Click when placed to gain 10% increased movement speed and critical strike chance · However, this comes at a cost of 10% damage reduction · This cannot be stacked with Crimson Effigy

Crimson Effigy.name: Crimson Effigy
Crimson Effigy.desc: The Crimson Effigy is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item that is found in the Flesh Chest within The Crimson shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold during a Third Quarter after the item has been found.
Crimson Effigy.tip: Right Click when placed to gain 10% damage and 5 defense · However, this comes at a cost of 10% maximum health · This cannot be stacked with Corruption Effigy

Corvid Harbinger Staff.name: Corvid Harbinger Staff
Corvid Harbinger Staff.desc: The Corvid Harbinger Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Raven Staff.
Corvid Harbinger Staff.tip: Summons a powerful raven which teleports and dashes · 'Nevermore'

Raven Staff.name: Raven Staff
Raven Staff.desc: The Raven Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Raven minion. It flies and charges through enemies. The Raven Staff is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.
Raven Staff.tip: Summons a raven to fight for you

Cosmic Anvil.name: Cosmic Anvil
Cosmic Anvil.desc: Cosmic Anvil is a post-Moon Lord crafting station that is an upgrade to the Hardmode Anvil. It is used to craft most post-The Devourer of Gods items.
Cosmic Anvil.tip: An otherworldly anvil capable of withstanding the pressures of stellar collapse · Also functions as every previous tier of anvil

Any Hardmode Anvil.name: Any Hardmode Anvil
Any Hardmode Anvil.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Cosmic Immaterializer.name: Cosmic Immaterializer
Cosmic Immaterializer.desc: The Cosmic Immaterializer is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons an entity of cosmic energy that fires homing energy bolts and exploding stars at enemies. It requires 10 minion slots to summon 1 energy, and only 1 energy can be active at once.
Cosmic Immaterializer.tip: Summons a cosmic energy spiral to fight for you · The spiral will fire swarms of homing energy bolts when enemies are detected by it · Struck enemies are cleansed by Miracle Blight · There can only be one energy spiral

Calamari's Lament.name: Calamari's Lament
Calamari's Lament.desc: Calamari's Lament is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Colossal Squids after Polterghast has been defeated. When used, it summons a baby squid that hovers near the player and fires homing ink projectiles from a large distance at enemies.
Calamari's Lament.tip: Summons a miniature squid that viciously inks enemies · At long distance, the squid will fire aggressively homing ink volleys · At close range, the squid will latch onto enemies and deal increased damage · 'In the Abyss, all kinds of resources are scarce. · Every species is solitary. There simply is not enough to share.'

Cosmilamp.name: Cosmilamp
Cosmilamp.desc: The Cosmilamp is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Signus. When used, it summons a Cosmilamp minion which hovers above the player and fires homing purple cosmic beams at nearby enemies. Cosmic beams pierce twice and travel through tiles.
Cosmilamp.tip: Summons a cosmic lantern above your head to fight for you

Ethereal Subjugator.name: Ethereal Subjugator
Ethereal Subjugator.desc: The Ethereal Subjugator is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.
Ethereal Subjugator.tip: Summons a phantom to protect you

Legion of Celestia.name: Legion of Celestia
Legion of Celestia.desc: The Legion of Celestia is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a Celestial Axe minion that floats around the player and attacks nearby enemies by aggressively dashing through them to deal damage and inflict the Elemental Mix debuff.
Legion of Celestia.tip: Summons a possessed, celestial axe to fight for you

Cosmic Rainbow.name: Cosmic Rainbow
Cosmic Rainbow.desc: The Cosmic Rainbow is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon. When fired, it spawns 3 rainbows in the direction of the cursor in a similar manner as an arrow flying out of a bow.
Cosmic Rainbow.tip: Launches a barrage of rainbows and homing sparkles

Rainbow Gun.name: Rainbow Gun
Rainbow Gun.desc: The Rainbow Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic gun that fires a curving rainbow that persists for 40 seconds or until another rainbow is fired. Enemies touching the rainbow take damage repeatedly, approximately five times per second.
Rainbow Gun.tip: Shoots a rainbow that does continuous damage

Cosmic Shiv.name: Cosmic Shiv
Cosmic Shiv.desc: The Cosmic Shiv is a craftable post-Moon Lord shortsword that is the direct upgrade to the Lightspeed. When used, it fires a cosmic star that homes on nearby enemies and does not pierce.
Cosmic Shiv.tip: Fires a cosmic star that homes in on enemies · Upon hitting an enemy, a barrage of blades will persistently strike · Landing more stars causes more blades to strike

Lightspeed.name: Lightspeed
Lightspeed.desc: The Lightspeed is a craftable post-Moon Lord shortsword that autoswings. When used, it rapidly thrusts in a flurry of stabs straight ahead, piercing infinitely.
Lightspeed.tip: Unleash a flurry of stabs which build Elemental Mastery on hit · Elemental Mastery is lost over time if it has not been gained for a few seconds · Press Right Click with maximum Elemental Mastery to dash toward your cursor · Hitting an enemy during the dash refunds some Elemental Mastery

Cosmic Viper Engine.name: Cosmic Viper Engine
Cosmic Viper Engine.desc: The Cosmic Viper Engine is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is an upgrade to the Tactical Plague Engine. It summons a Cosmic Gunship that fires and consumes bullets. It alternates between firing the chosen bullet and one of the following projectiles:
Cosmic Viper Engine.tip: Summons a cosmic gunship to shoot down your foes · Gunships will fire bullets from your inventory · Alternates firing rockets and bullets · 50% chance to save ammo · Rockets do not consume ammo
stats: 3 seconds (Concussion Missile) / 2 seconds (Homing, Splitting Rocket) / 1 second (Shrapnel)

Tactical Plague Engine.name: Tactical Plague Engine
Tactical Plague Engine.desc: The Tactical Plague Engine is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a Plague Jet minion that fires and consumes bullets.
Tactical Plague Engine.tip: Summons a Plague jet to pummel your enemies into submission · Jets will fire bullets from your inventory · Sometimes shoots a missile instead of a bullet · 50% chance to save ammo · Missiles do not consume ammo

Cosmic Worm.name: Cosmic Worm
Cosmic Worm.desc: The Cosmic Worm is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Devourer of Gods. It can be used anywhere at any time.
Cosmic Worm.tip: Summons the Devourer of Gods · Not consumable · 'The Nameless Serpent has set out for you.'

Cosmilite Basin.name: Cosmilite Basin
Cosmilite Basin.desc: Basins are furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. Unlike the other furniture sets, only six types of basins exist in the Calamity Mod.

Cosmilite Brick.name: Cosmilite Brick
Cosmilite Brick.desc: Cosmilite Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Cosmilite Bars. It is also dropped by The Devourer of Gods. It is used in the crafting of Cosmilite furniture set.

Cosmilite Bathtub.name: Cosmilite Bathtub
Cosmilite Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Bed.name: Cosmilite Bed
Cosmilite Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Bookcase.name: Cosmilite Bookcase
Cosmilite Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Platform.name: Cosmilite Platform
Cosmilite Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Cosmilite Brick Wall.name: Cosmilite Brick Wall
Cosmilite Brick Wall.desc: Cosmilite Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Cosmilite Brick, which is in turn crafted with Cosmilite Bars.

Cosmilite Candelabra.name: Cosmilite Candelabra
Cosmilite Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Candle.name: Cosmilite Candle
Cosmilite Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Cosmilite Chandelier.name: Cosmilite Chandelier
Cosmilite Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Chest.name: Cosmilite Chest
Cosmilite Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Cosmilite Clock.name: Cosmilite Clock
Cosmilite Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Door.name: Cosmilite Door
Cosmilite Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Dresser.name: Cosmilite Dresser
Cosmilite Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Dye.name: Cosmilite Dye
