Cosmilite Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Cosmilite Lamp.name: Cosmilite Lamp
Cosmilite Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Lantern.name: Cosmilite Lantern
Cosmilite Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Piano.name: Cosmilite Piano
Cosmilite Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Sconce.name: Cosmilite Sconce
Cosmilite Sconce.desc: Sconces are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed on background walls in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds one type of sconce.

Cosmilite Sink.name: Cosmilite Sink
Cosmilite Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Sofa.name: Cosmilite Sofa
Cosmilite Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Cosmilite Table.name: Cosmilite Table
Cosmilite Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmilite Work Bench.name: Cosmilite Work Bench
Cosmilite Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Cosmolight.name: Cosmolight
Cosmolight.desc: The Cosmolight is a craftable Hardmode tool that is a direct upgrade to the Bakidon. Holding Left Click makes time advance at 120x its usual rate, allowing a day to pass in only 12 seconds. Pressing Right Click freezes time in the world until toggled off.
Cosmolight.tip: A lost artifact freshly rekindled by exposure to raw cosmic energies · Hold Left Click to drastically accelerate the passage of day and night · Right Click to freeze the passage of day and night indefinitely · The time freeze lasts forever and works during celestial anomalies

Enchanted Sundial.name: Enchanted Sundial
Enchanted Sundial.desc: The Enchanted Sundial is a Hardmode furniture item. It can be triggered by the Right Click key or wires, doing so will advance time to sunrise (4:30 AM) the following day.
Enchanted Sundial.tip: Allows time to fast forward to dawn one day per week · Instantly reusable after certain celestial events

Crabulon (Lore).name: Crabulon (Lore)
Crabulon (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Crabulon (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Crabulon Trophy.name: Crabulon Trophy
Crabulon Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Crackshot Colt.name: Crackshot Colt
Crackshot Colt.desc: The Crackshot Colt is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it transforms any suitable bullets into Marksman Rounds. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), a Copper Coin is consumed and fired with an upwards curve.
Crackshot Colt.tip: Press Right Click to toss a Copper Coin in the air · Striking a coin with a bullet causes it to ricochet into the nearest enemy · Up to 4 coins can be tossed simultaneously, and shots will ricochet off multiple coins if possible · Coins guarantee a critical strike after a short delay

Copper Coin.name: Copper Coin
Copper Coin.desc: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria, primarily used for transactions with NPCs. They are obtained by killing enemies, selling items to or interacting with NPCs, or finding them in multiple forms of loot.

Crate Potion.name: Crate Potion
Crate Potion.desc: The Crate Potion is a buff potion which grants the Crate buff when consumed. The buff increases the chance of getting a crate from 1/10 to 1/4 when fishing.
Crate Potion.tip: Increases chance to get a crate

Giant Shell.name: Giant Shell
Giant Shell.desc: The Giant Shell is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Giant Shellies and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning gibbous or waxing gibbous for 12 gold. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Giant Shell.tip: 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense for 3 seconds

Crescent Moon.name: Crescent Moon
Crescent Moon.desc: The Crescent Moon is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail that autoswings. When used, it spins a flail around the player, throwing out the flail towards the cursor when the attack button is released and creating homing crescent moon projectiles as it travels.
Crescent Moon.tip: Throws a lunar flail that releases homing moons at the apex of its path · Holding Left Click spins the flail around you, generating Starbursts · With 20 Starbursts, hold Left Click again after throwing the flail to cause it to explode · Instead of releasing moons, this explosion summons Scorpius to do immense damage and inflict Voidfrost · 'Lunacy derived from genius'

Blue Moon.name: Blue Moon
Blue Moon.desc: The Blue Moon is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Crimson Heart (item).name: Crimson Heart (item)
Crimson Heart (item).desc: The Crimson Heart is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a fast-moving bleeding Crimson Heart that emits dim, red light. It follows the player around while affected by gravity, rolling or hopping along the ground.

Shadow Orb (item).name: Shadow Orb (item)
Shadow Orb (item).desc: The Shadow Orb is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a slow-moving Shadow Orb which follows the player around and emits dim, purple light.

Crimson Rod.name: Crimson Rod
Crimson Rod.desc: The Crimson Rod is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that launches a reddish rain cloud towards the cursor, where it rains damaging blood droplets downward onto enemies below.
Crimson Rod.tip: Summons a cloud to rain blood on your foes

Vilethorn.name: Vilethorn
Vilethorn.desc: The Vilethorn is a pre-Hardmode wand. It has a 1/5 chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 chance from Corrupt Crate and Defiled Crate, which are fished in the Corruption.

Cross Grave Marker.name: Cross Grave Marker
Cross Grave Marker.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Any Wood.name: Any Wood
Any Wood.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Crushing Ego.name: Crushing Ego
Crushing Ego.desc: The Crushing Ego is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, all damage dealt by the player is multiplied by 1.3. However, all damage inflicted onto the player is increased by 20%.
Crushing Ego.tip: Multiplies all damage by 1.3x, but at the cost of taking 20% increased damage · 'Don the mask of arrogance, and dance by your lonesome. Once the ball has gone quiet, you'll be the last man standing.'

Cryo Key.name: Cryo Key
Cryo Key.desc: The Cryo Key is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Cryogen. It can only be used in the Snow or Ice biome.
Cryo Key.tip: Summons Cryogen when used in the tundra · Not consumable · 'A key for a glacial prison.'

Any Ice Block.name: Any Ice Block
Any Ice Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Cryonic Ore.name: Cryonic Ore
Cryonic Ore.desc: "The ice caves are crackling with frigid energy."

Cryonic Brick.name: Cryonic Brick
Cryonic Brick.desc: Cryonic Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted with Cryonic Ore and Stone Blocks.

Cryonic Brick Wall.name: Cryonic Brick Wall
Cryonic Brick Wall.desc: Cryonic Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Cryonic Brick.

Cryonic Dye.name: Cryonic Dye
Cryonic Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Crystal Piercer.name: Crystal Piercer
Crystal Piercer.desc: The Crystal Piercer is a craftable Hardmode javelin. When used, it throws a crystal javelin that pierces infinitely and inflicts the Frostbite debuff. It travels a short distance before being affected by gravity.
Crystal Piercer.tip: Throws a crystal javelin that pierces infinitely · Stealth strikes travel through blocks, ignore gravity, and summon crystal shards as they fly

Crystalline.name: Crystalline
Crystalline.desc: The Crystalline is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gemstone dagger that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Crystalline.tip: Splits into several projectiles as it travels · Stealth strikes make the blade split more and create crystals when destroyed

Wulfrum Knife.name: Wulfrum Knife
Wulfrum Knife.desc: The Wulfrum Knife is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it throws a set of three knives in quick succession. The knives are affected by gravity and do not pierce.
Wulfrum Knife.tip: Fires wulfrum knives in bursts of 3 that stick in enemies · Stealth strikes make the knife fly further and hit several times at once · Right Click to magnetize all stuck knives back to you, restoring stealth · Returning knives also temporarily allows using stealth strikes without rogue armor

Crystyl Crusher.name: Crystyl Crusher
Crystyl Crusher.desc: The Crystyl Crusher is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer pickaxe. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it swings like a regular pickaxe and has a bonus +50 range.
Crystyl Crusher.tip: Hold Right Click to channel a beam that destroys just about anything · 'A primitive weapon from a bygone era...'

Any Lunar Pickaxe.name: Any Lunar Pickaxe
Any Lunar Pickaxe.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Cursed Arrow.name: Cursed Arrow
Cursed Arrow.desc: The Cursed Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds upon contact with enemies.

Cursed Flame.name: Cursed Flame
Cursed Flame.desc: Cursed Flame is a Hardmode crafting material, whose Crimson counterpart is Ichor. It is dropped by World Feeders, Vile Ghouls and Clingers, all of which can be found in The Corruption. It can also be found in Defiled Crates.
Cursed Flame.tip: 'Not even water can put the flame out'

Wooden Arrow.name: Wooden Arrow
Wooden Arrow.desc: The Wooden Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When fired with certain bows, Wooden Arrows will be converted into a special projectile (e.g.

Cursed Bullet.name: Cursed Bullet
Cursed Bullet.desc: The Cursed Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, causing damage over time that cannot be extinguished by water (unlike the On Fire! debuff).

Cyan Coral.name: Cyan Coral
Cyan Coral.desc: Cyan Coral is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates.

Yellow Coral.name: Yellow Coral
Yellow Coral.desc: Yellow Coral is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates.

Cyan Seeking Mechanism.name: Cyan Seeking Mechanism
Cyan Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

Lab Seeking Mechanism.name: Lab Seeking Mechanism
Lab Seeking Mechanism.desc: The Lab Seeking Mechanism is a craftable Pre-Hardmode crafting material. It is solely used to craft Seeking Mechanisms.
Lab Seeking Mechanism.tip: A receptacle for technology which pinpoints the power cores of Draedon's Labs

Cynosure (Lore).name: Cynosure (Lore)
Cynosure (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Cynosure (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Daawnlight Spirit Origin.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
Daawnlight Spirit Origin.desc: The Daawnlight Spirit Origin is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Daawnlight Spirit Origin.tip: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

Deadshot Brooch.name: Deadshot Brooch
Deadshot Brooch.desc: The Deadshot Brooch is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Deadshot Brooch.tip: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

Daedalus Breastplate.name: Daedalus Breastplate
Daedalus Breastplate.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.

Daedalus Dye.name: Daedalus Dye
Daedalus Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Daedalus Facemask.name: Daedalus Facemask
Daedalus Facemask.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Facemask.tip: 13% increased rogue damage and 5% increased rogue critical strike chance · 15% increased rogue velocity and 5% increased movement speed

Daedalus Golem Staff.name: Daedalus Golem Staff
Daedalus Golem Staff.desc: The Daedalus Golem Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a Daedalus Golem that follows the player.
Daedalus Golem Staff.tip: Summons a Daedalus Golem soldier that fires pellets and electricity · 'Shining god of greed'

Daedalus Headgear.name: Daedalus Headgear
Daedalus Headgear.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Headgear.tip: 13% increased ranged damage and 7% increased ranged critical strike chance · 20% chance to save ammo

Daedalus Helm.name: Daedalus Helm
Daedalus Helm.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Helm.tip: 10% increased melee damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased melee speed

Daedalus Hood.name: Daedalus Hood
Daedalus Hood.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Hood.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 and 10% reduced mana cost · 13% increased magic damage and 7% increased magic critical strike chance

Daedalus Leggings.name: Daedalus Leggings
Daedalus Leggings.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Leggings.tip: 8% increased critical strike chance · 10% increased movement speed

Daedalus Mask.name: Daedalus Mask
Daedalus Mask.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.
Daedalus Mask.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 10% increased summon damage

Dangersense Potion.name: Dangersense Potion
Dangersense Potion.desc: The Dangersense Potion is a buff potion which grants the Dangersense buff when consumed. The buff reveals hazardous traps, blocks, and objects that can potentially harm or impede the player by highlighting them in red, even in complete darkness.
Dangersense Potion.tip: Allows you to see nearby danger sources

Dao of Pow.name: Dao of Pow
Dao of Pow.desc: The Dao of Pow is a Hardmode flail. It has a 4/5 chance of inflicting the Confused debuff for 2–4 seconds upon striking an enemy.
Dao of Pow.tip: Has a chance to confuse · 'Find your inner pieces'

Dark Shard.name: Dark Shard
Dark Shard.desc: The Dark Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow and the Onyx Blaster. It has a 1/10 chance of being dropped by Dark Mummies and Shadow Mummy in Corrupt Deserts, and Blood Mummy in Crimson Deserts.
Dark Shard.tip: 'Sometimes carried by creatures in dark deserts'

Light Shard.name: Light Shard
Light Shard.desc: The Light Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow, Sky Fracture and Ruinous Staff. It has a 1/10 chance to drop from Light Mummies and Spectral Mummies which spawn in Hallowed deserts.
Light Shard.tip: 'Sometimes carried by creatures in light deserts'

Dark Matter Sheath.name: Dark Matter Sheath
Dark Matter Sheath.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Dark Matter Sheath.tip: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

Ruin Medallion.name: Ruin Medallion
Ruin Medallion.desc: The Ruin Medallion is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Coin of Deceit. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ruin Medallion.tip: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

Silencing Sheath.name: Silencing Sheath
Silencing Sheath.desc: The Silencing Sheath is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.
Silencing Sheath.tip: +10 maximum stealth, and stealth generates 4% faster

Dark Spark.name: Dark Spark
Dark Spark.desc: Dark Spark is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Last Prism. When used, it initially fires a single black beam of light that splits into six different beams as it charges.
Dark Spark.tip: 'And everything under the sun is in tune, · But the sun is eclipsed by the moon.'

Last Prism.name: Last Prism
Last Prism.desc: The Last Prism is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord magic weapon that fires several colored beams of light that converge into one focused beam as it charges, dealing massive damage. It has one of the highest base in the game at the cost of rapidly consuming mana.

Dark Sun Ring.name: Dark Sun Ring
Dark Sun Ring.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Dark Sun Ring.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

Darkecho Greatbow.name: Darkecho Greatbow
Darkecho Greatbow.desc: The Darkecho Greatbow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it fires two arrows along with a very fast Crystal Dart. The crystal darts ricochet towards the nearest enemy and bounce on tiles and between hit enemies up to three times.
Darkecho Greatbow.tip: Fires two arrows at once · Fires an additional crystal dart

Darklight Greatsword.name: Darklight Greatsword
Darklight Greatsword.desc: The Darklight Greatsword is a craftable Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a blue or purple blade that starts off slow before accelerating at full speed but will lose velocity as it goes through tiles and fade out before disappearing.
Darklight Greatsword.tip: Fires darklight blades that slice through enemies, creating additional slashes

Dart Pistol.name: Dart Pistol
Dart Pistol.desc: The Dart Pistol is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Crimson counterpart to the Corruption's Dart Rifle, with a higher rate of fire but lower damage. It has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

Dart Rifle.name: Dart Rifle
Dart Rifle.desc: The Dart Rifle is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Corruption counterpart to the Crimson's Dart Pistol, with higher damage but a lower rate of fire. It has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics.

Dead Sun's Wind.name: Dead Sun's Wind
Dead Sun's Wind.desc: Dead Sun's Wind is a craftable Hardmode flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires high-velocity blasts of cosmic plasma that cause explosions on enemy hits, each explosion dealing 150% of the weapon's damage and increasing in size with consecutive hits.
Dead Sun's Wind.tip: Fires a concentrated blast of superheated cosmic plasma that explodes and can ricochet off blocks · Shots aggressively home in on enemies after being ricocheted · Consecutive hits cause larger explosions · Uses gel for ammo

Ranger Emblem.name: Ranger Emblem
Ranger Emblem.desc: The Ranger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases ranged damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Death Valley Duster.name: Death Valley Duster
Death Valley Duster.desc: The Death Valley Duster is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, it casts a large blast of damaging dust particles that can travel through tiles and pierce up to five times before dissipating on the sixth.
Death Valley Duster.tip: Casts an enchanted blast of sand that passes through enemies and tiles · Casting this spell at max mana while without mana sickness will cause it to give you and any player it hits the Sand's Wind buff

Sturdy Fossil.name: Sturdy Fossil
Sturdy Fossil.desc: The Sturdy Fossil is a block and crafting material used to make bone- and fossil-themed gear. Sturdy Fossils are obtained by consuming Desert Fossils at an Extractinator, with a 10% chance of acquiring a Sturdy Fossil from each Desert Fossil.

Death Whistle.name: Death Whistle
Death Whistle.desc: The Death Whistle is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Ravager. It can only be used on the surface.
Death Whistle.tip: Summons the Ravager · Not consumable · 'One of the few sounds the flesh golem still recognizes.'

Lihzahrd Brick.name: Lihzahrd Brick
Lihzahrd Brick.desc: Lihzahrd Bricks are blocks that make up the structure of the Jungle Temple. They are the toughest block in the game, being impervious to and only breakable using the Picksaw or a better pickaxe or drill.

Solar Tablet Fragment.name: Solar Tablet Fragment
Solar Tablet Fragment.desc: The Solar Tablet Fragment is a post-Plantera Hardmode crafting material used to craft the Solar Tablet, which summons the Solar Eclipse event.

Death's Ascension.name: Death's Ascension
Death's Ascension.desc: The Death's Ascension is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon. Holding Left Click swings the scythe back and forth in front of the player. Holding Right Click instead swings the scythe in a similar manner to a broadsword, and a large spread of four homing scythes are fired.
Death's Ascension.tip: Performs powerful soul-infused swings that creates a rift orbited by scythes on enemy hits · Press Right Click to launch a barrage of homing scythes · The rift will fire scythes along with you · 'It feels just right in your grip... · But the hands that wield it are not yours'

Death Sickle.name: Death Sickle
Death Sickle.desc: The Death Sickle is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/40 / 79/1600 chance of being dropped by Reapers during the Solar Eclipse event. When swung, it fires a spinning purple sickle that can pass through blocks.

drops.chance: 2.5% (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 0.4% (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)4.94%

Decapodita Sprout.name: Decapodita Sprout
Decapodita Sprout.desc: The Decapodita Sprout is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Crabulon. It can only be used in the underground Glowing Mushroom biome.
Decapodita Sprout.tip: Summons Crabulon when used in the Underground Mushroom biome · Not consumable · 'Bristling with the spores of a unique, parasitic strain.'

Glowing Mushroom.name: Glowing Mushroom
Glowing Mushroom.desc: The Glowing Mushroom is a plant, crafting material, and block that can be found on Mushroom grass in the Glowing Mushroom biome. Glowing Mushroom plants emit blue light.

Decryption Computer.name: Decryption Computer
Decryption Computer.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Wire.name: Wire
Wire.desc: Wire is a unique item generally used to connect mechanisms to triggers, like a Pressure Plate, Timer, Switch, or Lever.
Wire.tip: Carries signals between mechanisms · Use a wrench to place

Deep Diver.name: Deep Diver
Deep Diver.desc: The Deep Diver is a craftable Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water.
Deep Diver.tip: Allows the ability to dash with a shorter cooldown · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · Provides greatly improved water mobility

Defiled Greatsword.name: Defiled Greatsword
Defiled Greatsword.desc: The Defiled Greatsword is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that is the direct upgrade to the Blighted Cleaver and the final upgrade to the Tainted Blade. When swung, it fires three large spinning blades which each have various effects.
Defiled Greatsword.tip: Fires blazing, hyper, and sunlight blades

Deific Amulet.name: Deific Amulet
Deific Amulet.desc: The Deific Amulet is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Deific Amulet.tip: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey (buff) after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace Panic Necklace's effect

Bee Cloak.name: Bee Cloak
Bee Cloak.desc: The Bee Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Star Cloak and the Honey Comb. When the player is injured, three stars will fall on the player's current location and bees are released.
Bee Cloak.tip: Causes stars to fall, releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged

Panic Necklace.name: Panic Necklace
Panic Necklace.desc: The Panic Necklace is an accessory, that, when equipped, grants the player the Panic! buff for 8 seconds when harmed by any source of damage besides fire blocks, increasing movement speed by 100%.
Panic Necklace.tip: Increases movement speed after taking damage

Star Veil.name: Star Veil
Star Veil.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.
Star Veil.tip: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

Sweetheart Necklace.name: Sweetheart Necklace
Sweetheart Necklace.desc: The Sweetheart Necklace is an accessory which releases a concentrated burst of bees and grants the player the Panic! and Honey buffs when damaged, increasing movement speed by 100% for 8 / 5 seconds and health regeneration for 5 seconds.
Sweetheart Necklace.tip: Releases bees, douses the user in honey and increases movement speed when damaged

Demon Conch.name: Demon Conch
Demon Conch.desc: The Demon Conch is a rare pre-Hardmode tool obtainable by fishing in lava. It teleports the player to the center of the Underworld 0.75 (45 ticks) after being used.
Demon Conch.tip: If you listen closely, you can hear screams · 'Watch your toes'

Demon Wings.name: Demon Wings
Demon Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Demonshade Breastplate.name: Demonshade Breastplate
Demonshade Breastplate.desc: Demonshade armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer armor set crafted from Shadowspec Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits afterimages and purple dust while moving.
Demonshade Breastplate.tip: Increases maximum mana by 200 · 15% increased damage and critical strike chance · 25% increased melee speed · 30% chance to save ammo · Standing still grants exponentially accelerating life regen

Demonshade Greaves.name: Demonshade Greaves
Demonshade Greaves.desc: Demonshade armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer armor set crafted from Shadowspec Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits afterimages and purple dust while moving.
Demonshade Greaves.tip: 30% increased movement speed and 50% increased acceleration · Shift-Right Click in your inventory to toggle the increased acceleration

Demonshade Helm.name: Demonshade Helm
Demonshade Helm.desc: Demonshade armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer armor set crafted from Shadowspec Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits afterimages and purple dust while moving.
Demonshade Helm.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased damage and 15% increased critical strike chance

Desecrated Water.name: Desecrated Water
Desecrated Water.desc: The Desecrated Water is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, a gravity affected flask is thrown that breaks upon contact with enemies and blocks. Upon breaking, the flask releases five bubbles that travel in multiple directions away from where the flask broke.
Desecrated Water.tip: Throws an unholy flask of water that explodes into an explosion of evil bubbles · Stealth strikes spawn additional bubbles that inflict Ichor (debuff) and Cursed Inferno

Any Evil Water.name: Any Evil Water
Any Evil Water.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Desert Medallion.name: Desert Medallion
Desert Medallion.desc: The Desert Medallion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Desert Scourge. It can only be used in the Desert or Underground Desert. It can also be found in Sandstone Chests at a 20% chance.
Desert Medallion.tip: Summons the Desert Scourge when used in the Desert · Enrages outside the Desert · Not consumable · 'The Scourge seeks for another meal.'

Antlion Mandible.name: Antlion Mandible
Antlion Mandible.desc: The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.

Desert Prowler Hat.name: Desert Prowler Hat
Desert Prowler Hat.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Stormlion Mandibles and Silk.

Desert Prowler Pants.name: Desert Prowler Pants
Desert Prowler Pants.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Stormlion Mandibles and Silk.
Desert Prowler Pants.tip: 4% increased rogue critical strike chance · Grants immunity to Mighty Wind

Desert Prowler Shirt.name: Desert Prowler Shirt
Desert Prowler Shirt.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Stormlion Mandibles and Silk.

Desert Scourge (Lore).name: Desert Scourge (Lore)
Desert Scourge (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Desert Scourge (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Desert Scourge Trophy.name: Desert Scourge Trophy
Desert Scourge Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Desert Torch.name: Desert Torch
Desert Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Devil's Devastation.name: Devil's Devastation
Devil's Devastation.desc: The Devil's Devastation is a craftable post-Moon Lord special sword that autoswings and is the final upgrade to the Exalted Oathblade. When used, it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 5 being able to be stuck into a single enemy.
Devil's Devastation.tip: Throw a demonic blade that impales, immolates, and slows enemies · Up to five blades can impale an enemy at a time, with further hits launching the previous impaled blades · Press Right Click to enter a stance where you can use Left Click to perform a colossal, devastating slash · While in the stance, you gain life and flight time regeneration and your dashes have a shorter cooldown · The devastating slash must recharge after being used · Striking an impaled enemy with the devastating slash launches all blades and readies another slash · The final enemy hit with a devastating slash has a death mark applied to them · When you exit the stance, the death mark explodes for massive damage · Hold Shift for moreThe perfect blade of the Underworld, wielding the power of Brimstone directly. · Humans understand this force as Havoc, the inevitable sundering of all order in fire. · Perhaps this is why the Brimstone Elemental had strength unrivaled by her sisters.

Exalted Oathblade.name: Exalted Oathblade
Exalted Oathblade.desc: The Exalted Oathblade is a craftable Hardmode special sword that autoswings and is the direct upgrade to the Forbidden Oathblade. When used, it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 4 being able to be stuck into a single enemy.
Exalted Oathblade.tip: Throw a twisted blade that impales, immolates, and slows enemies · Up to four blades can impale an enemy at a time, with further hits launching the previous impaled blades · Press Right Click to enter a stance where you can use Left Click to perform a devastating slash · While in the stance, you gain life and flight time regeneration and your dashes have a shorter cooldown · The devastating slash must recharge after being used · Striking an impaled enemy with the devastating slash launches all blades and readies another slash · Hold Shift for moreA sword fashioned from the legend of the Last Demon Lord. · Crowned through his overwhelming might, his sword bathed in the blood of Demons and the fires of hell. · Even long after his passing, none have dared to take the seat. · Demonkind has not known unity since.

Devil's Sunrise.name: Devil's Sunrise
Devil's Sunrise.desc: The Devil's Sunrise is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Terragrim. It spawns a large barrage of swipes towards the player's cursor when used.
Devil's Sunrise.tip: Unleashes a devilish flurry of swipes · Hellish energy charges in the blades over time, which is accelerated by striking foes · Press Right Click while swinging the blades with full energy to throw the spinning blades to your cursor · The spinning blades lodge into and repeatedly slice the first foe they meet, stealing their life · 'Balls? Smalls.'

Terragrim.name: Terragrim
Terragrim.desc: The Terragrim is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it rapidly releases slashes aimed towards the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate exceeding the weapon's stated use time.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Diamond of the Deep.name: Diamond of the Deep
Diamond of the Deep.desc: The Diamond of the Deep is a craftable Hardmode accessory. While equipped it spawns abyssal spirits every 2.5 seconds which follow the player, up to a maximum of 3. The spirits are always spawned in the order of gravel spirit, hadal spirit, void spirit.
Diamond of the Deep.tip: 60% increased Water debuff damage · Slowly accrue up to three different abyssal spirits · Dash to disperse the spirits and have them attack enemies · When dispersed below 50% life, the spirits support you instead · The spirits appear in order and have different effects based on color: · Explodes on impact and inflicts Crush Depth / Heals for 8 HP · Pierces enemies and inflicts Hellfire / Increases defense by 10 temporarily · Hits multiple times and inflicts Hadopelagic Pressure / Heals 5% of max HP · Spirits are transparent and silent when visibility is toggled off

Pyre Mantle.name: Pyre Mantle
Pyre Mantle.desc: Pyre Mantle is a block that generates in the third layer of the Abyss and is also dropped by Devil Fish. It requires at least an Adamantite, Titanium, or Shardlight Pickaxe to mine.

Sea Spirit Amulet.name: Sea Spirit Amulet
Sea Spirit Amulet.desc: The Sea Spirit Amulet is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be caught while fishing in the Sunken Sea after defeating Desert Scourge. While equipped, it spawns spirit orbs every 1.25 seconds which follow the player, up to a maximum of 8.
Sea Spirit Amulet.tip: Slowly accumulate up to eight spirit orbs that follow you · Spirits disperse when dashing · If below 50% life, they will heal you, otherwise they will attack nearby enemies · 35% increased Water debuff damage · Spirit orbs are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

DPS Meter.name: DPS Meter
DPS Meter.desc: The DPS Meter is an informational accessory that displays the of the weapon that last dealt damage to any entity, including enemies, critters, NPCs, Target Dummies, and other players.

Stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
Stopwatch.desc: The Stopwatch is an informational accessory that displays the player's current movement speed in, e.g. "GameUI.Speed".
Stopwatch.tip: Displays how fast the player is moving

Draconic Destruction.name: Draconic Destruction
Draconic Destruction.desc: The Draconic Destruction is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires a high-velocity sword beam that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and splits into 8 more sword beams in a circular formation on enemy hits.
Draconic Destruction.tip: Fires a draconic sword beam that explodes into additional beams · Additional beams fly up and down to shred enemies

Draconic Incense.name: Draconic Incense
Draconic Incense.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Draedon's Forge.name: Draedon's Forge
Draedon's Forge.desc: Draedon's Forge is a post-Moon Lord crafting station used to craft end-game items. It counts as a Work Bench, Hardmode Forge, a Cosmic Anvil, a Tinkerer's Workshop, a Table, a Chair, a Demon/Crimson Altar, and an Ancient Manipulator.
Draedon's Forge.tip: A plasma-lattice nanoforge powered by limitless Exo energies · Functions as every major crafting station simultaneously

Ancient Manipulator.name: Ancient Manipulator
Ancient Manipulator.desc: The Ancient Manipulator is a Hardmode crafting station that is always dropped by the Lunatic Cultist. It is mainly used to craft items from Luminite and Lunar Fragments.
Ancient Manipulator.tip: Used to craft items from Lunar Fragments and Luminite

Any Hardmode Forge.name: Any Hardmode Forge
Any Hardmode Forge.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Exo Prism.name: Exo Prism
Exo Prism.desc: Exo Prisms are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by the Exo Mechs. They are used in the crafting of Miracle Matter, Shadowspec Bars, Gem Tech armor and Draedon's Forge among other items.
Exo Prism.tip: Fractal energies shimmer across its surface

Tinkerer's Workshop.name: Tinkerer's Workshop
Tinkerer's Workshop.desc: The Tinkerer's Workshop is a flat-surface item and crafting station that is used primarily to combine multiple accessories into single items that usually provide the abilities of their components.
Tinkerer's Workshop.tip: Allows the combining of some accessories

Dragon Pow.name: Dragon Pow
Dragon Pow.desc: The Dragon Pow is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail. It fires out a dragon head that releases red, orange, and yellow homing sparks that inflict Dragonfire on hit, and each spark will deal 50% of the initial swing. When fired, the roar of Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth can be heard.
Dragon Pow.tip: Fires a dragon head that releases Dragonfire sparks · Summons a barrage of petals and waterfalls on enemy hits

Ball O' Fugu.name: Ball O' Fugu
Ball O' Fugu.desc: The Ball O' Fugu is a Pre-Hardmode flail obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. It throws out a pufferfish, which behaves similarly to other thrown flails at base.
Ball O' Fugu.tip: Throws a flailing abyssal pufferfish · Builds up poisonous spikes as it spins · Spikes blow out of the fish as it retracts

Flairon.name: Flairon
Flairon.desc: The Flairon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it swings like a thrown flail and releases non-piercing, homing bubbles.
Flairon.tip: Spews homing bubbles · Right click to toggle modes

Flower Pow.name: Flower Pow
Flower Pow.desc: The Flower Pow is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When thrown, it rapidly fires pink flower petals at nearby enemies, which deal of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and inflict 50% of its knockback (base knockback of ).
Flower Pow.tip: Shoots razor sharp flower petals at nearby enemies

Mourningstar.name: Mourningstar
Mourningstar.desc: The Mourningstar is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail and the direct upgrade to the Solar Eruption. When used, it fires two whipswords from the player's position. The whipswords pierce infinitely, can hit through blocks, and create explosions on hit.
Mourningstar.tip: Launches two solar whip swords that explode on hit

Tumbleweed.name: Tumbleweed
Tumbleweed.desc: The Tumbleweed is a craftable Hardmode flail. While spinning, the flail creates a large ring of dust which effectively expands the hitbox of the flail.
Tumbleweed.tip: Throws a tumbleweed flail · Spinning tumbleweeds brew a localized dust storm · Launched tumbleweeds detach from their chain upon striking an enemy and roll forwards

Dragon Soul Dye.name: Dragon Soul Dye
Dragon Soul Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Dragonblood Disgorger.name: Dragonblood Disgorger
Dragonblood Disgorger.desc: The Dragonblood Disgorger is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a large skeleton dragon minion accompanied by her two children.
Dragonblood Disgorger.tip: Summons a skeletal dragon and her two children · Baby spits burst into blood orbs upon hitting an enemy · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness · There can only be one family at a time

Dragonfolly (Lore).name: Dragonfolly (Lore)
Dragonfolly (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Dragonfolly (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Dragonfolly Trophy.name: Dragonfolly Trophy
Dragonfolly Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Drataliornus.name: Drataliornus
Drataliornus.desc: Drataliornus is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that is an upgrade to the Blossom Flux. Its primary fire (left-click) initially shoots fireballs at a very low rate but increases in speed until reaching its highest fire rate after six seconds.
Drataliornus.tip: Fires an escalating stream of Dragonfire arrows · Fireballs rain meteors, leave dragon dust trails, and launch additional bolts at max speed · Taking damage while firing the stream will interrupt it and reduce your wing flight time · Press Right Click to fire two devastating barrages of five empowered fireballs · 'Just don't get hit'

Blossom Flux.name: Blossom Flux
Blossom Flux.desc: The Blossom Flux is a Hardmode bow that is dropped by Plantera.
Blossom Flux.tip: Fires a stream of leaves · Press Right Click to fire a spore orb that explodes into a cloud of spore gas · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer'...I see... So frightened by the Godseeker were my children they chose to defile death for a warden in my image. · I am sorry. I could not gaze unto your hearts. The despair I inflicted upon you... I should have forseen the consequences of taking away your guardian. · But you shan't be neglected any longer. · Heed me, floral beast, on my authority. Ravage this place no longer, stand guard of the home and memories of the people who once lived here. · Channel all the might of this canopy and of the dead within you, so that no Godseeker, lowly or high, will ever trespass into this settlement. · Defend it till the last rays of the sun, so my hero shall yet have a home.'

Dreadmine Staff.name: Dreadmine Staff
Dreadmine Staff.desc: The Dreadmine Staff is a craftable Hardmode sentry. It summons a stationary mine base that summons mines on nearby tiles which home in on enemies. When an enemy comes in contact with a mine, it will blow up.
Dreadmine Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a turret that swarms your enemies with sea mines

Driftwood.name: Driftwood
Driftwood.desc: Driftwood is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates or by fishing in the Sunken Sea. It is used to craft Naiad's Warhorn, the Fishing Bobber, and its own furniture set.

Driftwood Platform.name: Driftwood Platform
Driftwood Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Driftwood Wall.name: Driftwood Wall
Driftwood Wall.desc: Driftwood Wall is a background wall crafted with Driftwood.

Driftwood Baroque Cello.name: Driftwood Baroque Cello
Driftwood Baroque Cello.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Bathtub.name: Driftwood Bathtub
Driftwood Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Bed.name: Driftwood Bed
Driftwood Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Bookcase.name: Driftwood Bookcase
Driftwood Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Bow.name: Driftwood Bow
Driftwood Bow.desc: The Driftwood Bow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow. While the player has the Wet debuff, is on the surface during the rain, wearing the Fish Bowl, or is in contact with water, the bow gains 20% attack speed, 20% velocity, and 1 flat knockback.
Driftwood Bow.tip: This bow is stronger when you are wet

Driftwood Candelabra.name: Driftwood Candelabra
Driftwood Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Candle.name: Driftwood Candle
Driftwood Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Driftwood Chair.name: Driftwood Chair
Driftwood Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Driftwood Chandelier.name: Driftwood Chandelier
Driftwood Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Chest.name: Driftwood Chest
Driftwood Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Driftwood Door.name: Driftwood Door
Driftwood Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Dresser.name: Driftwood Dresser
Driftwood Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Hammer.name: Driftwood Hammer
Driftwood Hammer.desc: The Driftwood Hammer is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hammer. While the player has the Wet debuff, is on the surface during the rain, wearing the Fish Bowl, or is in contact with water, it harvests 28.57% faster while swinging at the same rate.
Driftwood Hammer.tip: Improved efficiency while you are wet

Driftwood Lamp.name: Driftwood Lamp
Driftwood Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Lantern.name: Driftwood Lantern
Driftwood Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Sink.name: Driftwood Sink
Driftwood Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Sofa.name: Driftwood Sofa
Driftwood Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Driftwood Sundial.name: Driftwood Sundial
Driftwood Sundial.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Sword.name: Driftwood Sword
Driftwood Sword.desc: The Driftwood Sword is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. While the player has the Wet debuff, is on the surface during the rain, wearing the Fish Bowl, or is in contact with water, the sword gains 25% attack speed and knockback.
Driftwood Sword.tip: This sword is more powerful while you are wet

Driftwood Table.name: Driftwood Table
Driftwood Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Driftwood Toilet.name: Driftwood Toilet
Driftwood Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Driftwood Work Bench.name: Driftwood Work Bench
Driftwood Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Dryad's Tear.name: Dryad's Tear
Dryad's Tear.desc: Dryad's Tears are craftable Hardmode bullets. Each fired bullet carries an extra teardrop which detaches on hit and rises above the enemy before crashing down on them for extra damage. Teardrops always critically strike if the bullet critically strikes.
Dryad's Tear.tip: An extremely powerful magic bullet blessed with nature's essence that becomes unstable when multiple are nearby · Carries a teardrop along with it which on impact will detach and crash down upon the hit enemy and burst · All bullet and teardrop hits have 18 armor penetration · 'Focus. Breathe. Just one more shot, and the violence will fade away...'

Crystal Bullet.name: Crystal Bullet
Crystal Bullet.desc: The Crystal Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It shatters upon impact with enemies or solid blocks, splitting into two small shards. The shards have a short range, can pass through blocks, and deal 50% of the weapon's damage ( base damage).

Duke Fishron (Lore).name: Duke Fishron (Lore)
Duke Fishron (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Duke Fishron (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Duke Fishron Trophy.name: Duke Fishron Trophy
Duke Fishron Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Dunesand.name: Dunesand
Dunesand.desc: Dunesand is a decorative block that is only obtainable via shimmering Volcanic Sand.

Volcanic Sand.name: Volcanic Sand
Volcanic Sand.desc: Volcanic Sand is a decorative block that is only obtainable via shimmering Polyp Sand.

Duststorm in a Bottle.name: Duststorm in a Bottle
Duststorm in a Bottle.desc: The Duststorm in a Bottle is a craftable Hardmode bomb and a direct upgrade to the Lemon 'nade. When used, it throws a bottle that shatters into a dust cloud after a delay, or when hitting an enemy.
Duststorm in a Bottle.tip: Disables normal stealth generation · Throws a bottle filled with high-pressure dust that shatters on impact with a target or after a short delay · Hold Left Click to generate stealth, but cause the bottle to shatter sooner · Stealth strikes cause the bottle to leak dust clouds around it for a few seconds instead of shattering · Will shatter in your hand if charged for too long

Grand Scale.name: Grand Scale
Grand Scale.desc: The Grand Scale is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material that is dropped by the Great Sand Shark. It is used to craft powerful sand-related upgrades to previous equipment.
Grand Scale.tip: Large scale of an apex predator

Lemon 'nade.name: Lemon 'nade
Lemon 'nade.desc: The Lemon 'nade is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable bomb. While holding Left Click, the player shakes the Lemon 'nade 90 degrees counter-clockwise to the cursor.
Lemon 'nade.tip: Disables normal stealth generation · Hold Left Click to pull the pin and generate stealth, and release to throw · The longer it is held, the shorter the fuse once the 'nade is thrown · Will explode in your hand if the fuse is held too long · Stealth strikes explode into exploding lemon seeds · 'Burn their house down!'

Dynamic Pursuer.name: Dynamic Pursuer
Dynamic Pursuer.desc: The Dynamic Pursuer is a craftable post-Moon Lord non-consumable rogue boomerang which is an upgrade to the P-LSR: Aerial Tracker. When used, it throws a high-velocity boomerang which returns on hit or after 0.75 seconds.
Dynamic Pursuer.tip: Throws a calculation-processing disk that fires electricity at enemies · Stealth strikes allows the disk to ricochet to other targets, fire lasers, and unleash an explosion · If the disk cannot find a new target to ricochet to, it will pursue the original target instead

Dimension-Tearing Disk.name: Dimension-Tearing Disk
Dimension-Tearing Disk.desc: The Dimension-Tearing Disk is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. When used, it throws a disk that passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance.
Dimension-Tearing Disk.tip: Throws a disk that tears space in the direction of the nearest enemy · Stealth strikes stick to enemies and unleash God's Bane Doombeam Array

P-LSR: Aerial Tracker.name: P-LSR: Aerial Tracker
P-LSR: Aerial Tracker.desc: The P-LSR: Aerial Tracker is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang. When thrown, the disk detects the nearest enemy and fires lasers towards them, accelerating further the longer it is out.
P-LSR: Aerial Tracker.tip: Releases a flying disk that fires lasers at nearby enemies · Lasers do not directly damage enemies, but instead apply a stacking laser burn effect · Once hit by enough lasers or sufficient time has passed, laser burn will deal direct damage · The disk gains acceleration as it returns to the player · Stealth strikes toss two disks that can fire at multiple different targets from farther range

Early Bloom Rod.name: Early Bloom Rod
Early Bloom Rod.desc: The Early Bloom Rod is a craftable post-Moon Lord fishing pole. When swung, six fishing lines are deployed at once instead of one. In addition to this, fishing lines will not break in a similar manner to equipping the High Test Fishing Line.
Early Bloom Rod.tip: Fires six lines at once. Line never snaps · 'The early bird catches the fish'

Earth.name: Earth
Earth.desc: Earth is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer special sword. When used, the sword is rapidly swung in a circular motion around the player, leaving behind a rainbow trail, before swinging toward the cursor with a larger slash.
Earth.tip: A beautiful prismatic blade with unrivaled close combat proficiency · Heals you greatly on hit · Every other swing will summon three Gaia meteors to annihilate nearby enemies · 'All Its spawn shall know the beauty and wrath of their creator'

Grand Guardian.name: Grand Guardian
Grand Guardian.desc: The Grand Guardian is a craftable Hardmode special sword that is a direct upgrade to the Majestic Guard. When used, the sword is swung back and forth toward the cursor.
Grand Guardian.tip: An ornate winged blade that easily cuts through enemies · Creates cosmic explosions and heals you slightly on hit

Stellar Striker.name: Stellar Striker
Stellar Striker.desc: The Stellar Striker is a craftable post-Moon Lord special sword that is a direct upgrade to the Comet Quasher. On use, the sword is swung in a circular motion around the player.
Stellar Striker.tip: Summons a swarm of lunar flares from the sky on enemy hits

Eclipse Mirror.name: Eclipse Mirror
Eclipse Mirror.desc: The Eclipse Mirror is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abyssal Mirror and Dark Matter Sheath. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Eclipse Mirror.tip: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

Eclipse's Fall.name: Eclipse's Fall
Eclipse's Fall.desc: The Eclipse's Fall is a craftable post-Moon Lord javelin that is a direct upgrade to the Vega and the final upgrade to the Profaned Partisan. When used, it throws a javelin that shatters into light fragments on hit.
Eclipse's Fall.tip: Throws a javelin that shatters into fragments of primordial light upon enemy hits · If more than 20 fragments exist, the oldest fragments will seek out enemies to attack · Stealth strikes coalesce fragments into Spear of Obscuration, gaining power based on the number of fragments · Spear of Obscuration will pierce though any enemy hit by Eclipse's Fall · 'When the sun goes dark, all will know terror'

Vega.name: Vega
Vega.desc: The Vega is a craftable post-Moon Lord javelin. It throws a rapid stratus spear that breaks upon hitting a tile and explodes upon striking an enemy, releasing 4 stratus stars that inflict Nightwither.
Vega.tip: Throws a spear that shatters into star fragments on impact and generates Starbursts · Stealth strike conjure an image of Lyra to deal immense damage in an area · Right Click to consume 20 Starbursts and immediately perform a stealth strike, regardless of your current stealth · This strike calls all star fragments to attack the damaged foe and inflicts Voidfrost · Consuming Starbursts with Vega allows using stealth for 10 seconds, even without rogue armor · 'The final song of a misunderstood genius... or just a madman'

Effervescence.name: Effervescence
Effervescence.desc: Effervescence is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Bubble Gun. When used, it fires a spread of four purple bubbles that move in a straight line and pierce infinitely.
Effervescence.tip: Shoots a massive spread of bubbles

Aetherium Block.name: Aetherium Block
Aetherium Block.desc: Aetherium Blocks are blocks formed when Shimmer comes into contact with any other liquid besides itself. Similarly to Ice Blocks, Aetherium Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions.

Bubble Gun.name: Bubble Gun
Bubble Gun.desc: The Bubble Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it rapidly fires a large spread of short-range bubbles, with three bubbles per use.

Electrician's Glove.name: Electrician's Glove
Electrician's Glove.desc: The Electrician's Glove is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory and a direct upgrade to the Bloodstained Glove and Filthy Glove. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Electrician's Glove.tip: Stealth strikes summon sparks on enemy hits and heal you for 10 HP · Stealth strikes also have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage

Bloodstained Glove.name: Bloodstained Glove
Bloodstained Glove.desc: The Bloodstained Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Perforators. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal the player for 5 health.
Bloodstained Glove.tip: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal for 5 HP

Elemental Dye.name: Elemental Dye
Elemental Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Meld Dye.name: Meld Dye
Meld Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Nebula Dye.name: Nebula Dye
Nebula Dye.desc: Nebula Dye is a Hardmode, endgame dye crafted using Nebula Fragments dropped by the Nebula Pillar in the Lunar Events. The dye gives the player a pink/purple shiny look on armor, equipment or accessories and looks like stars are moving rapidly upward on anything with the dye.

Solar Dye.name: Solar Dye
Solar Dye.desc: Solar Dye is a Hardmode, endgame dye crafted from Solar Fragments dropped by the Solar Pillar from the Lunar Events.

Stardust Dye.name: Stardust Dye
Stardust Dye.desc: Stardust Dye is a Hardmode, endgame dye crafted using Stardust Fragments obtained from the Stardust Pillar from the Lunar Events. It gives a fade bluish-white color, and it gives a white sparkling effect on the dyed armor pieces and accessories.

Vortex Dye.name: Vortex Dye
Vortex Dye.desc: Vortex Dye is a Hardmode dye crafted from Vortex Fragments dropped by the Vortex Pillar in the Lunar Events and Bottled Water. The effect produced is reminiscent of a green warp drive effect on all clothing and accessories the dye is applied to.

Elemental Gauntlet.name: Elemental Gauntlet
Elemental Gauntlet.desc: The Elemental Gauntlet is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the final upgrade to the Titan Glove and Feral Claws. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Elemental Gauntlet.tip: Melee attacks and projectiles inflict Elemental Mix · 15% increased melee damage and melee speed · 5% increased melee critical strike chance · 20% increased true melee damage and increased melee knockback · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and increases their size · Does not stack with downgrades

Fire Gauntlet.name: Fire Gauntlet
Fire Gauntlet.desc: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Fire Gauntlet.tip: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

Elumplate Wall.name: Elumplate Wall
Elumplate Wall.desc: Elumplate Walls is a background wall crafted with Elumplate.

Elysian Arrow.name: Elysian Arrow
Elysian Arrow.desc: Elysian Arrows are craftable post-Moon Lord arrows. They summon two holy light slashes on collision with an enemy or a tile which target the nearest enemy, dealing 20% of the arrow's damage and having a default armor penetration of 15.
Elysian Arrow.tip: On impact, summons purifying light from above and below at the nearest enemy · Purifying light ignores 15 points of enemy Defense

Holy Arrow.name: Holy Arrow
Holy Arrow.desc: The Holy Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. Upon contact with enemies or blocks, two Hallow Star projectiles will fall from the sky to the impact location. The stars deal 1/3 of the combined damage of the arrow and weapon, and do not pierce.

Unholy Essence.name: Unholy Essence
Unholy Essence.desc: Unholy Essence is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that drops from Impious Immolators, Profaned Energies, Scorn Eaters, Profaned Guardians, and Providence, the Profaned Goddess.

Empress of Light (Lore).name: Empress of Light (Lore)
Empress of Light (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Empress of Light (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Empress of Light Trophy.name: Empress of Light Trophy
Empress of Light Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Empyrean Cloak.name: Empyrean Cloak
Empyrean Cloak.desc: Empyrean armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue armor set crafted from Meld Blobs and Luminite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages.
Empyrean Cloak.tip: 12% increased rogue damage and 8% increased critical strike chance

Empyrean Cuisses.name: Empyrean Cuisses
Empyrean Cuisses.desc: Empyrean armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue armor set crafted from Meld Blobs and Luminite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages.
Empyrean Cuisses.tip: 8% increased rogue damage and critical strike chance · 20% increased movement speed

Empyrean Knives.name: Empyrean Knives
Empyrean Knives.desc: The Empyrean Knives are a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Vampire Knives. When used, they throw a spread of 4 to 8 homing knives, each dealing damage and healing the player for 1% of the damage dealt.
Empyrean Knives.tip: Throws a flurry of homing knives that bounce off of tiles and heal the user

Monstrous Knives.name: Monstrous Knives
Monstrous Knives.desc: The Monstrous Knives are a craftable Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that act similarly to the Vampire Knives. When used, the player throws a spread of 3-4 gravity-affected knives that heal the player for 5% to 10% of the damage dealt.
Monstrous Knives.tip: Throws a spread of short-range knives that heal the user

Vampire Knives.name: Vampire Knives
Vampire Knives.desc: The Vampire Knives are a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When used, it rapidly fires a spread of 4–8 red knife projectiles.

Empyrean Mask.name: Empyrean Mask
Empyrean Mask.desc: Empyrean armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue armor set crafted from Meld Blobs and Luminite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages.
Empyrean Mask.tip: 12% increased rogue damage and 7% increased critical strike chance · 10% increased rogue velocity

Iron Francisca.name: Iron Francisca
Iron Francisca.desc: The Iron Francisca is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is the direct counterpart to the Lead Tomahawk. It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground.
Iron Francisca.tip: The franciscas do more damage for a short time when initially thrown · Stealth strikes pierce up to 6 times

Enchanted Boomerang.name: Enchanted Boomerang
Enchanted Boomerang.desc: The Enchanted Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. It is a direct upgrade to the Wooden Boomerang.

Wooden Boomerang.name: Wooden Boomerang
Wooden Boomerang.desc: The Wooden Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 1/11 chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer. It can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for during a full moon.

Enchanted Butterfly.name: Enchanted Butterfly
Enchanted Butterfly.desc: The Enchanted Butterfly is a craftable Hardmode light pet summoning item. When used, it summons a tiny dragonfly pet to follow the player around and provide a small amount of light. It will actively fly towards butterflies to consume them, though this does not have any effect.
Enchanted Butterfly.tip: Summons a mysterious dragonfly light pet · Provides a small amount of light in the abyss · 'Feed him butterflies to keep him strong!'

Gold Butterfly.name: Gold Butterfly
Gold Butterfly.desc: The Gold Butterfly is a harmless critter.

Hell Butterfly.name: Hell Butterfly
Hell Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Julia Butterfly.name: Julia Butterfly
Julia Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Monarch Butterfly.name: Monarch Butterfly
Monarch Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Purple Emperor Butterfly.name: Purple Emperor Butterfly
Purple Emperor Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Red Admiral Butterfly.name: Red Admiral Butterfly
Red Admiral Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Sulphur Butterfly.name: Sulphur Butterfly
Sulphur Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Tree Nymph Butterfly.name: Tree Nymph Butterfly
Tree Nymph Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Ulysses Butterfly.name: Ulysses Butterfly
Ulysses Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Zebra Swallowtail Butterfly.name: Zebra Swallowtail Butterfly
Zebra Swallowtail Butterfly.desc: Butterflies are small critters that can be found in Forests during daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree during the day.

Enchanted Pearl.name: Enchanted Pearl
Enchanted Pearl.desc: The Enchanted Pearl is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Enchanted Pearl.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Increases chance to catch crates and loot-containing fish by 15% · Crate catches are 25% more likely to be higher quality, accompanied by visual pearls

White Pearl.name: White Pearl
White Pearl.desc: Pearls are crafting materials obtained from opening Oysters, and are used to craft Luck Potions. Each of the three pearls have different rarities, with the rarer ones being crafted into stronger potions.

Enchanted Sword.name: Enchanted Sword
Enchanted Sword.desc: The Enchanted Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it occasionally fires an Enchanted Beam projectile that cannot pierce enemies or pass through blocks. Both the sword and its projectile produce lingering particles that emit large amounts of light.

Encrypted Schematic (Ice).name: Encrypted Schematic (Ice)
Encrypted Schematic (Ice).desc: Schematics are items found in all five Bio-center Labs. They are used to unlock various items crafted with Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry by decrypting them with Draedon Power Cells at The Codebreaker.

Encrypted Schematic (Jungle).name: Encrypted Schematic (Jungle)
Encrypted Schematic (Jungle).desc: Schematics are items found in all five Bio-center Labs. They are used to unlock various items crafted with Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry by decrypting them with Draedon Power Cells at The Codebreaker.

Encrypted Schematic (Planetoid).name: Encrypted Schematic (Planetoid)
Encrypted Schematic (Planetoid).desc: Schematics are items found in all five Bio-center Labs. They are used to unlock various items crafted with Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry by decrypting them with Draedon Power Cells at The Codebreaker.

Encrypted Schematic (Underworld).name: Encrypted Schematic (Underworld)
Encrypted Schematic (Underworld).desc: Schematics are items found in all five Bio-center Labs. They are used to unlock various items crafted with Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry by decrypting them with Draedon Power Cells at The Codebreaker.

Encumbering Stone.name: Encumbering Stone
Encumbering Stone.desc: The Encumbering Stone is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents item pickup while inside the player's inventory. While in the inventory, the Encumbering Stone will prevent the pickup of any items, even if the player already has a stackable item in their inventory.
Encumbering Stone.tip: Prevents item pickups while locked · Right click to unlock · 'You are over-encumbered'

Endo Hydra Staff.name: Endo Hydra Staff
Endo Hydra Staff.desc: The Endo Hydra Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a single-headed Endo Hydra at the back of the player, with each resummon consuming one additional minion slot for an extra head.
Endo Hydra Staff.tip: Summons a frigid endothermic entity with one head · If the entity already exists, using this item again will cause it to gain more heads

Staff of the Frost Hydra.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
Staff of the Frost Hydra.desc: The Staff of the Frost Hydra is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons the Frost Hydra sentry. It fires frost blasts towards enemies, which pierce twice and inflict the Frostbite debuff.
Staff of the Frost Hydra.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a powerful frost hydra to spit ice at your enemies
stats: 9Category:Pages with information based on outdated versions of Terraria's source code

Endogenesis.name: Endogenesis
Endogenesis.desc: The Endogenesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. It summons an ascended ice construct that has four different modes:
Endogenesis.tip: Summons an ascended ice construct to protect you · Changes attack modes by resummoning or reusing the staff · The first mode makes it shoot sweeping lasers aimed at the enemy · The second mode sacrifices its limbs to shoot out homing projectiles · The third mode allows it to aggressively tackle its enemies · The fourth mode makes the limbs function as endothermic flamethrowers · There can only be one construct at a time · 'Ice puns not included'

Blizzard Staff.name: Blizzard Staff
