Blizzard Staff.desc: The Blizzard Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

Cryogenic Staff.name: Cryogenic Staff
Cryogenic Staff.desc: The Cryogenic Staff is a Hardmode sentry that is sold by the Archmage for 35 gold after defeating all the Mechanical Bosses. When summoned, the ice sentry fires an ice ball that inflicts the Frostbite debuff, as well as their rate increasing the longer an enemy is targeted.
Cryogenic Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons an ice construct to unleash the cold upon your enemies · Fire rate and range increase the longer it targets an enemy

Endothermic Dye.name: Endothermic Dye
Endothermic Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Endurance Potion.name: Endurance Potion
Endurance Potion.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction.

Entropic Claymore.name: Entropic Claymore
Entropic Claymore.desc: The Entropic Claymore is a craftable Hardmode broadsword with a custom swing animation. When swung, it fires a spread of 5 tapeworm projectiles on swing.
Entropic Claymore.tip: Fires a spread of living plasma that swims through the air · Plasma will track your cursor or enemies near it, prioritizing which is closest · The plasma pierces, but will stop tracking after hitting the first enemy

Epidemic Shredder.name: Epidemic Shredder
Epidemic Shredder.desc: The Epidemic Shredder is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a plague disk that pierces five times and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. The disk can bounce on tiles indefinitely until it reaches the player or despawns.
Epidemic Shredder.tip: Throws an infected boomerang that releases Plague seekers when it hits tiles or enemies · Stealth strikes cause the boomerang to release Plague seekers constantly as it travels · Contrary to its name, it will probably cause an epidemic if used incorrectly

Nanites.name: Nanites
Nanites.desc: Nanites are a Hardmode crafting material used solely for crafting the Flask of Nanites and Nano Bullets, whose purpose is to inflict the Confused debuff with melee and ranged weapons, respectively. Nanites are purchased from the Cyborg for each.

Equanimity.name: Equanimity
Equanimity.desc: Equanimity is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a boomerang that has a custom throw animation and can ricochet between enemies. On enemy hits, the boomerang alternates between spawning piercing dark shards and homing light shards.
Equanimity.tip: Throws a boomerang that ricochets between enemies and makes them Confused · Enemy hits alternate summoning homing light shards or piercing dark shards · Stealth strikes cause an alternating explosion of light or dark on every ricochet, empowering the opposite color of shard

Fishbone Boomerang.name: Fishbone Boomerang
Fishbone Boomerang.desc: The Fishbone Boomerang is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boomerang. When used, it throws a boomerang which remains airborne up to four seconds.
Fishbone Boomerang.tip: Ricochets between up to three enemies · Stealth strikes release rotting bone shards with every ricochet · Though the evaporating Sea Kingdom fought a losing battle, its proud inhabitants did not go down easily. · As a last resort, they had to fashion weapons from the skeletons of dead animals.

Essence Flayer.name: Essence Flayer
Essence Flayer.desc: The Essence Flayer is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When swung, it fires a spinning purple scythe that functions similarly to the Death Sickle's sickles, traveling a moderate distance before stopping in place.
Essence Flayer.tip: Shoots an essence scythe that generates healing spirits on enemy kills

Eternity.name: Eternity
Eternity.desc: Eternity is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it will create a large circle, which inside will have five crystals, a beam, and a group of projectiles that create a flower shape while traveling, all of which will be centered around a nearby enemy.
Eternity.tip: Hexes a possible nearby enemy, trapping them in a brilliant display of destruction · 'There's pictures of ponies in the book'

Heresy.name: Heresy
Heresy.desc: Heresy is a post-Moon Lord spell tome that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It fires flame particles and souls upwards, which can travel through solid tiles but only home into enemies when solid tiles are not present.
Heresy.tip: Releases fire and souls upward from a held book · As the book is held the power of both increases

Unicorn Horn.name: Unicorn Horn
Unicorn Horn.desc: The Unicorn Horn is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped by Unicorns in The Hallow.

Ethereal Core.name: Ethereal Core
Ethereal Core.desc: The Ethereal Core is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that can only be consumed once, and upon consumption, increases the player's maximum mana by 60. There are 2 other items that function identically to this: the Comet Shard and the Phantom Heart.

Ethereal Talisman.name: Ethereal Talisman
Ethereal Talisman.desc: The Ethereal Talisman is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Sigil of Calamitas. It is also the final upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ethereal Talisman.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift-Right Click in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower Mana Flower's effect

Any Mana Flower.name: Any Mana Flower
Any Mana Flower.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Sigil of Calamitas.name: Sigil of Calamitas
Sigil of Calamitas.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Sigil of Calamitas.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

Eutrophic Crate.name: Eutrophic Crate
Eutrophic Crate.desc: The Eutrophic Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sunken Sea. The crate contains several Sunken Sea blocks. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Prism Crate.

Prism Crate.name: Prism Crate
Prism Crate.desc: The Prism Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sunken Sea. The crate contains several Sunken Sea blocks. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Eutrophic Crate.

Eutrophic Glass.name: Eutrophic Glass
Eutrophic Glass.desc: Eutrophic Glass is a craftable block that is crafted with Eutrophic Sand at a Furnace.

Eutrophic Sand.name: Eutrophic Sand
Eutrophic Sand.desc: Eutrophic Sand is a block that generates in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Navystone.

Eutrophic Glass Wall.name: Eutrophic Glass Wall
Eutrophic Glass Wall.desc: The Eutrophic Glass Wall is a background wall crafted with Eutrophic Glass.

Hardened Eutrophic Sand.name: Hardened Eutrophic Sand
Hardened Eutrophic Sand.desc: Hardened Eutrophic Sand is a craftable block crafted from Eutrophic Sand and Dirt Blocks.

Eutrophic Sand Wall.name: Eutrophic Sand Wall
Eutrophic Sand Wall.desc: Eutrophic Sand Wall is a background wall crafted with Eutrophic Sand. It will not contribute to the creation of an artificial Sunken Sea biome nor will it release water.

Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall.name: Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall
Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall.desc: Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Unsafe Navystone Wall. Eutrophic Sand Walls will release water whenever the nearby tiles update. It can be removed using any hammer.

Eutrophic Shelf.name: Eutrophic Shelf
Eutrophic Shelf.desc: The Eutrophic Shelf is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item. It can only be placed sideways on blocks.

Evasion Scarf.name: Evasion Scarf
Evasion Scarf.desc: The Evasion Scarf is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Counter Scarf. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the Left Click or Right Click keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.
Evasion Scarf.tip: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again · Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes

Counter Scarf.name: Counter Scarf
Counter Scarf.desc: The Counter Scarf is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Clothier for 20 gold. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the Left Click or Right Click keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.
Counter Scarf.tip: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again

Event Horizon.name: Event Horizon
Event Horizon.desc: The Event Horizon is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome and the upgrade to the Star Shower, Nuclear Fury, and Relic of Ruin. When used, it releases a ring of stars around the player that orbit their location at the time it was used and home in on nearby enemies.
Event Horizon.tip: Fires a ring of stars to home in on nearby enemies · Stars spawn black holes on enemy hits · 'Nothing, not even light, can return'

Nuclear Fury.name: Nuclear Fury
Nuclear Fury.desc: The Nuclear Fury is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Razorblade Typhoon. When used, it fires 8 cosmic typhoons evenly distributed in a circle around the player. The typhoons home in on nearby enemies, pass through tiles and pierce twice.
Nuclear Fury.tip: Casts a torrent of cosmic typhoons

Relic of Ruin.name: Relic of Ruin
Relic of Ruin.desc: The Relic of Ruin is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires out 12 spinning blades in a circle from the player, which home in on nearby enemies.
Relic of Ruin.tip: Casts a spread of sand blades

Star Shower.name: Star Shower
Star Shower.desc: The Star Shower is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons a spread of 5 astral stars from the sky that quickly travel to meet at the cursor's location, then continue to fall in that direction.
Star Shower.tip: Casts a spread of astral stars from the sky that converge at the cursor and spread the Astral Infection (debuff)

Everclear.name: Everclear
Everclear.desc: Everclear is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Everclear debuff, which provides the following effects:
Everclear.tip: 25% increased damage · Reduces life regen by 5 HP/s and defense by 30% · Counts as 2 alcohols for Alcohol Poisoning · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Black Lens.name: Black Lens
Black Lens.desc: The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 chance.

Everglade Spray.name: Everglade Spray
Everglade Spray.desc: The Everglade Spray is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. Like the Golden Shower, it fires a gravity-affected green stream that pierces up to five times before dissipating on the sixth. The stream inflicts the Cursed Inferno and Ichor debuffs.
Everglade Spray.tip: Fires a stream of burning green ichor

Golden Shower.name: Golden Shower
Golden Shower.desc: The Golden Shower is a Hardmode spell book that fires arcing golden ichor streams in quick succession. Each stream can hit up to 5 targets. The streams inflict the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), which adds 15 armor penetration.
Golden Shower.tip: Sprays a shower of ichor · Decreases target's defense

Evergreen Gin.name: Evergreen Gin
Evergreen Gin.desc: Evergreen Gin is a craftable Hardmode alcohol.
Evergreen Gin.tip: 50% increased Water and Sickness debuff damage · 50% decreased Electric and Heat debuff damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Forbidden Oathblade.name: Forbidden Oathblade
Forbidden Oathblade.desc: The Forbidden Oathblade is a craftable Hardmode special sword that autoswings and is the direct upgrade to the Bladecrest Oathsword and the Old Lord Claymore.
Forbidden Oathblade.tip: Throw a sharp blade that impales, burns, and slows enemies · Up to three blades can impale an enemy at a time, with further hits launching the previous impaled blades · Press Right Click to enter a stance where you can use Left Click to perform a powerful slash · The powerful slash must recharge after being used · Striking an impaled enemy with the powerful slash launches all blades and readies another slash · Hold Shift for moreA blade forged in the likeness of that granted to the Demon Lord. · The title was coveted by all demonkind. Only one may exist at a time. · Any claimant who seeks the throne has a simple goal: the head of the former Lord.

Executioner's Blade.name: Executioner's Blade
Executioner's Blade.desc: The Executioner's Blade is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue weapon. When used, it rapidly auto-fires a continuous stream of purple blades that home on nearby enemies and explode on impact.
Executioner's Blade.tip: Throws a stream of homing blades · Stealth strikes summon a guillotine of blades on hit

Exo Bathtub.name: Exo Bathtub
Exo Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Plating.name: Exo Plating
Exo Plating.desc: Exo Plating is a post-Moon Lord block that is crafted from Stone Blocks and Exo Prisms. It is used in the crafting of Exo furniture.

Exo Bed.name: Exo Bed
Exo Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Bookcase.name: Exo Bookcase
Exo Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Candelabra.name: Exo Candelabra
Exo Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Candle.name: Exo Candle
Exo Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Exo Chair.name: Exo Chair
Exo Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Exo Chandelier.name: Exo Chandelier
Exo Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Chest.name: Exo Chest
Exo Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Exo Clock.name: Exo Clock
Exo Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Console.name: Exo Console
Exo Console.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Exo Display.name: Exo Display
Exo Display.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Exo Door.name: Exo Door
Exo Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Dresser.name: Exo Dresser
Exo Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Dye.name: Exo Dye
Exo Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Exo Keyboard.name: Exo Keyboard
Exo Keyboard.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Lamp.name: Exo Lamp
Exo Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Lantern.name: Exo Lantern
Exo Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Obelisk.name: Exo Obelisk
Exo Obelisk.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Exo Platform.name: Exo Platform
Exo Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Exo Plating Wall.name: Exo Plating Wall
Exo Plating Wall.desc: Exo Plating Wall is a background wall crafted with Exo Plating.

Exo Prism Panel.name: Exo Prism Panel
Exo Prism Panel.desc: Exo Prism Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block that is crafted from Glass and Exo Prisms.

Exo Prism Platform.name: Exo Prism Platform
Exo Prism Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Exo Prism Panel Wall.name: Exo Prism Panel Wall
Exo Prism Panel Wall.desc: Exo Prism Panel Wall is a background wall crafted with Exo Prism Panel.

Exo Screen.name: Exo Screen
Exo Screen.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Exo Server.name: Exo Server
Exo Server.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Exo Sink.name: Exo Sink
Exo Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Sofa.name: Exo Sofa
Exo Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Exo Table.name: Exo Table
Exo Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo Terminal.name: Exo Terminal
Exo Terminal.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Exo Toilet.name: Exo Toilet
Exo Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Exo Work Bench.name: Exo Work Bench
Exo Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Exo-Auric Panel.name: Exo-Auric Panel
Exo-Auric Panel.desc: Exo-Auric Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Auric Panels and Exo Prisms.

Exoblade.name: Exoblade
Exoblade.desc: The Exoblade is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon.
Exoblade.tip: Press Left Click to release multiple energy beams that home in on enemies and slice them on hit · Press Right Click to dash in the direction of the cursor with the blade · Enemy hits from the blade during the dash result in massive damage and a rebound · Press Left Click immediately after a rebound to perform a powerful slash · Powerful slashes are larger, heal you, and create a large explosion · Struck enemies are torn apart by Miracle Blight

Flarefrost Blade.name: Flarefrost Blade
Flarefrost Blade.desc: The Flarefrost Blade is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires a swirling flarefrost orb which homes on nearby enemies and inflicts the Hellfire and Frostbite debuffs.

Terratomere.name: Terratomere
Terratomere.desc: The Terratomere is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswings. When used, it fires 4 homing energy bolts that cause an explosion which deals 50% of the weapon's damage and also fires a short-range slash projectile after every swing.
Terratomere.tip: Heals the player on true melee hits · Fires several piercing energy bolts that rapidly seek targets · On hit, explodes and repeatedly slashes the target · 'Linked to the essence of Terraria'

Uelibloom Ore.name: Uelibloom Ore
Uelibloom Ore.desc: "Fossilized tree bark is bursting through the jungle's mud."

Exodus Wings.name: Exodus Wings
Exodus Wings.desc: Exodus Wings are a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide. If they are equipped along with Empyrean armor, they grant permanent Empyrean Wrath buff.
Exodus Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · Grants permanent Empyrean Wrath while wearing the Empyrean armor · Pulsing with an alien heartbeat

Exorcism.name: Exorcism
Exorcism.desc: The Exorcism is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, a massive holy cross is thrown upwards, falling at the cursor and impaling enemies below with holy light. Once impaled or after hitting the ground, it creates a large holy explosion after a delay.
Exorcism.tip: Throws a gigantic hallowed cross to the heavens, which will fall at your cursor a moment later · Enemies hit as it falls are impaled and repeatedly seared with holy light · Upon expiration a cross shaped explosion is created · Stealth strikes twirl and throw the cross, ending in a stronger explosion at your cursor

Exotic Pheromones.name: Exotic Pheromones
Exotic Pheromones.desc: Exotic Pheromones are a craftable boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Dragonfolly. They can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.
Exotic Pheromones.tip: Summons Dragonfolly when used in the Jungle · Enrages outside the Jungle · Not consumable · 'Pheromones used for hunting Draconic Offshoots.'

Eye of Desolation.name: Eye of Desolation
Eye of Desolation.desc: The Eye of Desolation is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Calamitas Clone. It can be used anywhere.
Eye of Desolation.tip: Summons the Calamitas Clone · Creates a square arena in Revengeance Mode, with you at its bottom · Not consumable · 'She is here.'

Eye of Magnus.name: Eye of Magnus
Eye of Magnus.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a craftable Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye.
Eye of Magnus.tip: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that causes enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

Lunic Eye.name: Lunic Eye
Lunic Eye.desc: The Lunic Eye is a craftable Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff.
Lunic Eye.tip: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

Eye of Night.name: Eye of Night
Eye of Night.desc: The Eye of Night is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball that moves erratically above the player. When an enemy is nearby, the eye orbits around it and fires cells which stick to enemies and damage them twice.
Eye of Night.tip: Summons a diseased eyeball that fires cells which attach to enemies

Imp Staff.name: Imp Staff
Imp Staff.desc: The Imp Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Flying Imp minion. It hovers near enemies, shooting fireballs that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds and can pierce up to 4 enemies.
Imp Staff.tip: Summons an imp to fight for you

Staff of Necrosteocytes.name: Staff of Necrosteocytes
Staff of Necrosteocytes.desc: The Staff of Necrosteocytes is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Dark Casters. When used, it summons a small skeleton minion that runs along the ground to target nearby enemies.
Staff of Necrosteocytes.tip: Summons small skeletons to fight for you · The skeletons leave behind bone cells as they move

Vile Feeder.name: Vile Feeder
Vile Feeder.desc: The Vile Feeder is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a tiny Eater of Souls minion, which flies around and latches onto nearby enemies.
Vile Feeder.tip: Summons a baby eater of souls to protect you

Eye of the Accursed Banner.name: Eye of the Accursed Banner
Eye of the Accursed Banner.desc: Banners are functional furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks. The Calamity Mod features banners for many of the enemies and critters introduced in the mod's various biomes.
Eye of the Accursed Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: [enemy name]

Occult Brick.name: Occult Brick
Occult Brick.desc: Occult Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Ashes of Annihilation. It is used in the crafting of Sacrilegious furniture.

Face Melter.name: Face Melter
Face Melter.desc: The Face Melter is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon. When the primary-fire (left click) is used, streams of two red musical notes are rapidly fired from the player in the cursor's direction.
Face Melter.tip: Fires music notes · Press Right Click to summon an amplifier that shoots towards your mouse · 'WOOO!! FAAAAAAANTASYY WORLDDDDD!'

Stellar Tune.name: Stellar Tune
Stellar Tune.desc: The Stellar Tune is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that fires pairs of star-shaped projectiles that travel in a wave-like pattern toward the cursor and home in on enemies, travel through solid blocks, and explode in a small radius upon impact.
Stellar Tune.tip: 'These chords are out of this world'

Faded Idolatry.name: Faded Idolatry
Faded Idolatry.desc: The Faded Idolatry is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. While equipped, it causes each Fiery Draconid that has been summoned by the Yharon's Kindle Staff to only cost 4 minion slots instead of 5.
Faded Idolatry.tip: Summoned Yharon's Kindle Staff Fiery Draconids cost one less minion slot · 'Once everything has crumbled to dust, what will be left of the world you created?'

Fairy Bell.name: Fairy Bell
Fairy Bell.desc: The Fairy Bell is a Hardmode light pet-summoning item that spawns a Fairy, a glowing creature resembling a Pixie, which follows the player and produces light for an unlimited duration.

Bell.name: Bell
Bell.desc: The Bell is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Wizard for. It is used to the craft the Fairy Bell, a light pet-summoning item.

Fairy Boots.name: Fairy Boots
Fairy Boots.desc: Fairy Boots are an accessory that are made from the Spectre Boots and Flower Boots at a Tinkerer's Workshop. They combine both effects into one pair of boots.
Fairy Boots.tip: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flowers grow on the grass you walk on

calamityChanges.tip: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
calamityChanges.desc: The Fairy Boots are a craftable Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

Flower Boots.name: Flower Boots
Flower Boots.desc: Flower Boots are a rare accessory which cause flowers to grow when the player walks on regular, Jungle, Hallowed, and Ash grass. These flowers are functionally the same as the wild grass plants that grow naturally on grass, and drop Seeds and Hay normally.
Flower Boots.tip: Flowers grow on the grass you walk on

Spectre Boots.name: Spectre Boots
Spectre Boots.desc: The Spectre Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Rocket Boots and either Hermes Boots, Flurry Boots, Sailfish Boots, or Dunerider Boots, and combines their functionality (except the faster speed on sand from Dunerider Boots).
Spectre Boots.tip: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast

Fairy Wings.name: Fairy Wings
Fairy Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Fallen Paladin's Hammer.name: Fallen Paladin's Hammer
Fallen Paladin's Hammer.desc: The Fallen Paladin's Hammer is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon and an upgrade to the Paladin's Hammer and Pwnagehammer. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles.
Fallen Paladin's Hammer.tip: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will explode and return to you after striking an enemy · After returning three times, a homing spectral hammer is summoned with devastating impact
stats: 3 seconds (Spectral Hammer, Small Explosion) / 1.5 seconds (Hammer) / 1 second (Fallen Blast)

Paladin's Hammer.name: Paladin's Hammer
Paladin's Hammer.desc: The Paladin's Hammer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/15 / 29/225 chance of being dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it swings once before being thrown at a high velocity, dealing 33% increased damage on the first hit.

Pwnagehammer.name: Pwnagehammer
Pwnagehammer.desc: The Pwnagehammer is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it throws a slow gravity-affected hammer which cannot pass through tiles and will travel a short distance before falling.
Pwnagehammer.tip: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that creates a loud blast of hallowed energy when it hits something · After hitting four times, a spectral hammer will be summoned to strike the enemy

Solar Veil.name: Solar Veil
Solar Veil.desc: Solar Veils are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Psychos, Reapers and Vampires after Calamitas Clone has been defeated. They are used in the crafting of various rogue items.
Solar Veil.tip: Sunlight cannot penetrate the fabric of this cloth

Fathom Swarmer Breastplate.name: Fathom Swarmer Breastplate
Fathom Swarmer Breastplate.desc: Fathom Swarmer armor is a craftable Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Sea Remains, Planty Mush, and Depth Cells.
Fathom Swarmer Breastplate.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 10% increased summon damage · Reduces defense loss within the Abyss

Planty Mush.name: Planty Mush
Planty Mush.desc: Planty Mush is a block that generates naturally in the second layer of the Abyss. It is able to grow Viper Vines underneath it. It can be mined with any pickaxe. It is used in the crafting of several Silva items, Tenebreus Tides, Life Fruit and Fathom Swarmer armor.

Fathom Swarmer Greaves.name: Fathom Swarmer Greaves
Fathom Swarmer Greaves.desc: Fathom Swarmer armor is a craftable Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Sea Remains, Planty Mush, and Depth Cells.
Fathom Swarmer Greaves.tip: 8% increased summon damage · Grants the ability to swim · 40% increased movement speed while submerged in liquid

Fathom Swarmer Visage.name: Fathom Swarmer Visage
Fathom Swarmer Visage.desc: Fathom Swarmer armor is a craftable Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Sea Remains, Planty Mush, and Depth Cells.
Fathom Swarmer Visage.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 8% increased summon damage · Provides breathing and light underwater · Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss

Fault Line.name: Fault Line
Fault Line.desc: The Fault Line is a craftable Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it creates a small fiery explosion on enemy hits, which deals 50% of the weapon's damage. The yoyo and explosions inflict the Hellfire debuff.
Fault Line.tip: Reach: 30 tiles · Speed: 40 · Infinite throw duration · Explodes on enemy hits

Fearmonger Greathelm.name: Fearmonger Greathelm
Fearmonger Greathelm.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.
Fearmonger Greathelm.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 10% reduced mana cost · 20% increased summon damage · Pure terror radiates from your eyes

Spooky Helmet.name: Spooky Helmet
Spooky Helmet.desc: Spooky armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Spooky Helmet, Spooky Breastplate, and Spooky Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 750 Spooky Wood.
Spooky Helmet.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 11%

Fearmonger Greaves.name: Fearmonger Greaves
Fearmonger Greaves.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.

Spooky Leggings.name: Spooky Leggings
Spooky Leggings.desc: Spooky armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Spooky Helmet, Spooky Breastplate, and Spooky Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 750 Spooky Wood.
Spooky Leggings.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 11% · 20% increased movement speed

Fearmonger Plate Mail.name: Fearmonger Plate Mail
Fearmonger Plate Mail.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.
Fearmonger Plate Mail.tip: 10% increased damage and 5% increased critical strike chance · +100 max life and 8% increased damage reduction

Spooky Breastplate.name: Spooky Breastplate
Spooky Breastplate.desc: Spooky armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Spooky Helmet, Spooky Breastplate, and Spooky Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 750 Spooky Wood.
Spooky Breastplate.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Increases summon damage by 11%

Feather Crown.name: Feather Crown
Feather Crown.desc: The Feather Crown is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it summons a feather that orbits the player every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 5. Each feather orbiting the player grants 2% magic damage and 1% mana cost reduction.
Feather Crown.tip: Summons a Skyline Feather every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 · Each Skyline Feather increases magic damage by 2% and decreases mana cost by 1% · With 5 feathers, increases magic critical strike chance by 5% and all magic attacks inflict Static Discharge · Running out of mana or drinking a mana potion sheds all feathers · Upon shedding a feather, no new feathers can be gained for 5 seconds · Feathers are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled · Hold Shift for moreYoung mages would don feathers and gaze into the starlit night, as if welcoming the breath of the heavens. · To commune with mana was to commune with the world, and further, its draconic masters.

Any Gold Crown.name: Any Gold Crown
Any Gold Crown.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Feather Knife.name: Feather Knife
Feather Knife.desc: The Feather Knife is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gravity affected knife that periodically releases homing explosive feathers. The feather and explosion deal 5% and 50% of the weapon's damage respectively.
Feather Knife.tip: Throws a knife which summons homing feathers · Stealth strike throw a volley of knives

Featherfall Potion.name: Featherfall Potion
Featherfall Potion.desc: The Featherfall Potion is a buff potion which grants the Featherfall buff when consumed. The buff negates fall damage, and reduces the player's fall speed and gravity to 1/3 of normal, allowing them to jump higher and fall slower.

Any Silver Bar.name: Any Silver Bar
Any Silver Bar.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Feral Bobber.name: Feral Bobber
Feral Bobber.desc: The Feral Bobber is a craftable Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Feral Bobber.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Gains fishing power the more life you have lost · Provides a fishing minigame · Hold Right Click while catching fish to drain life and speed up catches · Bobbers can hook onto enemies, dealing damage when life is drained

Feral Double Rod.name: Feral Double Rod
Feral Double Rod.desc: The Feral Double Rod is a craftable Hardmode fishing pole. When swung, two fishing lines are deployed at once instead of one.
Feral Double Rod.tip: Fires two lines at once · Just as you have tamed the jungle monster, you can now tame the fish in the sea

Feralthorn Claymore.name: Feralthorn Claymore
Feralthorn Claymore.desc: The Feralthorn Claymore is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. Upon hitting an enemy, it sprouts a thorn in the center of the enemy that pierces once and deals 50% of the weapon's damage. The blade itself inflicts the Acid Venom debuff.
Feralthorn Claymore.tip: Sprouts thorns from enemies on hit

Fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
Fertilizer.desc: The Fertilizer is a consumable item which immediately grows a sapling or gemcorn into the corresponding tree.
Fertilizer.tip: Causes saplings to instantly grow into trees · 'It’s got what plants crave!'

Ash Block.name: Ash Block
Ash Block.desc: The Ash Block is a block that covers the upper and lower sections of The Underworld, and can occasionally encase Hellstone. It can be used for building and for growing Fireblossom.

Poo.name: Poo
Poo.desc: Poo is a type of decorative block obtained by sitting on a toilet while any tier of the Well Fed buff is active. The time until Poo is produced is random, though it averages to 600 ticks. Having the Tipsy debuff will reduce this time by 66.67%.

Finch Staff.name: Finch Staff
Finch Staff.desc: The Finch Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Baby Finch minion. It flies towards enemies to deal contact damage. The Finch Staff has a 1/3 chance of being found in Living Wood Chests within Living Trees.
Finch Staff.tip: Summons a baby finch to fight for you

Bird.name: Bird
Bird.desc: The Bird, Blue Jay, and Cardinal are flying critters that can spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Much like the Vulture, Birds remain still until approached, whereupon they will fly away.

Magma Stone.name: Magma Stone
Magma Stone.desc: The Magma Stone is an accessory that causes the wearer's melee attacks to inflict the Hellfire debuff for up to 6 seconds on enemies. It also causes direct hits from melee weapons to inflict the Hellfire debuff, and melee projectiles to inflict the On Fire!

Mechanical Glove.name: Mechanical Glove
Mechanical Glove.desc: The Mechanical Glove is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Mechanical Glove.tip: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

Fire Turret.name: Fire Turret
Fire Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.desc: Fireball is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Fireball debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted heat-related debuffs by 50% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted sickness-related debuffs by 50%.
Fireball.tip: 50% increased Heat debuff damage · 50% decreased Sickness debuff damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Living Fire Block.name: Living Fire Block
Living Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Firestorm Cannon.name: Firestorm Cannon
Firestorm Cannon.desc: The Firestorm Cannon is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that is a weaponized version of the Flare Gun. Like the Flare Gun, it uses Flares as ammunition and has a 33% chance to not consume ammo.
Firestorm Cannon.tip: Fires a rapid barrage of flares that builds up a searing heat in the weapon · Firing for too long overheats the weapon, leaving it unusable for a short period and setting you On Fire! · Press Right Click to put away the weapon, which preserves its heat · 33% chance to save ammo · 'What could go wrong?'

Flare Gun.name: Flare Gun
Flare Gun.desc: The Flare Gun is a weapon that is found randomly in Gold Chests underground. When used, it fires Flares, which provide light and stick to the blocks they hit.

Fishing Potion.name: Fishing Potion
Fishing Potion.desc: The Fishing Potion is a buff potion which grants the Fishing buff when consumed. The buff increases Fishing Power by 15.

Flak Kraken.name: Flak Kraken
Flak Kraken.desc: The Flak Kraken is a craftable Hardmode launcher and the direct upgrade to the Flak Toxicannon. When used, it fires two bursts of abyssal flak shots that split into 5 ink shrapnel upon contact with enemies or the cursor.
Flak Kraken.tip: Fires pairs of abyssal flak shells that explode into wide cones of ink shrapnel · Abyssal flak shells burst when they reach the cursor's position · Direct hits with the flak shell will deal reduced shrapnel damage

Flak Toxicannon.name: Flak Toxicannon
Flak Toxicannon.desc: The Flak Toxicannon is a Hardmode launcher that is dropped by Flak Crabs. When used, it fires a flak shell that erupts into 4 sludge shrapnel projectiles upon contact with enemies or the cursor.
Flak Toxicannon.tip: Fires a toxic shell that explodes into a cone of radioactive sludge · Toxic shells burst when they reach the cursor's position · Direct hits with the toxic shell will reduce the damage dealt by the sludge · Uses rockets for ammo

Flame Waker Boots.name: Flame Waker Boots
Flame Waker Boots.desc: The Flame Waker Boots are a vanity accessory obtained by opening Obsidian Crates or Hellstone Crates, found by fishing in Lava. They cause the player’s feet to leave trails of fire while moving on blocks. They are entirely cosmetic and provide no functional benefit of their own.
Flame Waker Boots.tip: Leaves a trail of flames in your wake · 'Never get cold feet again'

calamityChanges.tip: 25% increased Heat debuff damage · Attacks light enemies on fire · 'Never get cold feet again'
calamityChanges.desc: The Flame Waker Boots are a craftable accessory. They can also be obtained by opening Obsidian Crates or Hellstone Crates, found by fishing in Lava. They grant the following effects while equipped;

Flamsteed Ring.name: Flamsteed Ring
Flamsteed Ring.desc: The Flamsteed Ring is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, the player is turned into a giant controllable robot. While mounted, most of their weapons are transformed into attacks.
Flamsteed Ring.tip: Summons a colossal controllable mech · Right Click to display the mech's control panel · The panel has 3 configurations, selected using the brackets on the edges of the UI · Each bracket powers 2 out of 3 possible functions, represented by the circular icons · The bottom left icon miniaturizes the mech to the size of a player, but weakens its weapons · The bottom right icon is a powerful jet booster which greatly enhances movement · The top icon is the mech's weaponry. It must be powered in order to attack · Click the top icon to switch between Regicide, an enormous energy blade, and a powerful Gauss rifle · Exiting the mount while a boss is alive will temporarily hinder your movement · 'Now, make them pay'
stats: 6 seconds (Dismount while a boss is alive)

Vortex Booster.name: Vortex Booster
Vortex Booster.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.
Vortex Booster.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover

Flare Bolt.name: Flare Bolt
Flare Bolt.desc: The Flare Bolt is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires a slow-moving ball of fire that travels in a straight line, is unaffected by gravity, inflicts the On Fire! debuff on hit, and can pierce or bounce off blocks three times before dissipating.
Flare Bolt.tip: Casts a ball of flame · Balls of flame collapse into a swirling backdraft which pulls in enemies

Flarewing Bow.name: Flarewing Bow
Flarewing Bow.desc: The Flarewing Bow is a craftable Hardmode bow and the direct upgrade to the Hellwing Bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into obsidian bats that inflict the Hellfire debuff on hit and home in on enemies after piercing them once.
Flarewing Bow.tip: Shoots a spread of 3 arrows · Wooden arrows are converted into obsidian bats which home in after piercing once

Hellwing Bow.name: Hellwing Bow
Hellwing Bow.desc: The Hellwing Bow is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron bow that fires arrows inaccurately. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into flaming bat projectiles that are unaffected by gravity, can pierce infinitely, and cannot pass through blocks.
Hellwing Bow.tip: Wooden arrows turn into flaming bats

Flash Round.name: Flash Round
Flash Round.desc: Flash Rounds are craftable Pre-Hardmode bullets. They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies.
Flash Round.tip: A ricocheting bullet that deals more damage with each bounce · The damage bonus is 1.13x or +2 flat damage per bounce, depending on which is stronger

Flask of Brimstone.name: Flask of Brimstone
Flask of Brimstone.desc: The Flask of Brimstone is a craftable Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.
Flask of Brimstone.tip: Melee, Whip, and Rogue attacks inflict Brimstone Flames
stats: 2, 4, or 6 seconds (Melee, whip and rogue attacks)

Flask of Crumbling.name: Flask of Crumbling
Flask of Crumbling.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a craftable Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.
Flask of Crumbling.tip: Melee, Whip, and Rogue attacks inflict Crumbling
stats: 2, 4, or 6 seconds (Melee, whip and rogue attacks)

Flask of Holy Flames.name: Flask of Holy Flames
Flask of Holy Flames.desc: The Flask of Holy Flames is a craftable post-Moon Lord flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Holy Flames buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Holy Flames debuff.
Flask of Holy Flames.tip: Melee, Whip, and Rogue attacks inflict Holy Flames

Fledgling Wings.name: Fledgling Wings
Fledgling Wings.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 horizontally and 22 vertically.

Flesh Knuckles.name: Flesh Knuckles
Flesh Knuckles.desc: The Flesh Knuckles are a Hardmode accessory that have a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics. While equipped, they increase the player's defense by and aggro by.
Flesh Knuckles.tip: Enemies are more likely to target you

Putrid Scent.name: Putrid Scent
Putrid Scent.desc: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 chance to be dropped by Corrupt Mimics. While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.
Putrid Scent.tip: Enemies are less likely to target you · 5% increased damage and critical strike chance

Fleshy Geode.name: Fleshy Geode
Fleshy Geode.desc: Fleshy Geode is a Hardmode grab bag that is dropped by Ravager before Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated. It contains several Hardmode crafting materials. After Providence has been defeated, Ravager instead drops Necromantic Geodes.

Necromantic Geode.name: Necromantic Geode
Necromantic Geode.desc: The Necromatic Geode is a post-Moon Lord grab bag that is dropped by the Ravager, replacing Fleshy Geodes after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated. It contains several late-Hardmode crafting materials and a large supply of Bloodstone.

Flipper Potion.name: Flipper Potion
Flipper Potion.desc: The Flipper Potion is a buff potion which grants the Flipper buff when consumed.
Flipper Potion.tip: Lets you move swiftly in liquids

Floodtide.name: Floodtide
Floodtide.desc: The Floodtide is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It can also be obtained by fishing after Leviathan and Anahita have been defeated. When swung, it fires two sharks which deal damage to enemies on contact.
Floodtide.tip: Launches sharks, because sharks are awesome!

Floral Wall.name: Floral Wall
Floral Wall.desc: Floral Wall is a background wall crafted with Perennial Brick, as an alternative to Perennial Brick Wall.

Perennial Brick.name: Perennial Brick
Perennial Brick.desc: Perennial Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Perennial Ore.

Floret Protector Helmet.name: Floret Protector Helmet
Floret Protector Helmet.desc: The Floret Protector set is a vanity set consisting of the Floret Protector Helmet, the Floret Protector Shirt, and the Floret Protector Pants.
Floret Protector Helmet.tip: 'When a cosmic ray penetrates a star cloud, that fantastic light...' · Concept by yikescloud

Daybloom.name: Daybloom
Daybloom.desc: Daybloom is a type of herb that appears as a small yellow flower with a straight green stem. Daybloom can also be dropped by Angry Dandelions.

Floret Protector Pants.name: Floret Protector Pants
Floret Protector Pants.desc: The Floret Protector set is a vanity set consisting of the Floret Protector Helmet, the Floret Protector Shirt, and the Floret Protector Pants.
Floret Protector Pants.tip: 'I am a duck QUACK-QUACK-QUACK' · Concept by yikescloud

Floret Protector Shirt.name: Floret Protector Shirt
Floret Protector Shirt.desc: The Floret Protector set is a vanity set consisting of the Floret Protector Helmet, the Floret Protector Shirt, and the Floret Protector Pants.
Floret Protector Shirt.tip: 'ID.170122 - RSS ZEPHYRUS III' · Concept by yikescloud

Jungle Grass Seeds.name: Jungle Grass Seeds
Jungle Grass Seeds.desc: Jungle Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Jungle grass in Mud Blocks, which can potentially create an artificial Jungle or Underground Jungle (depending on depth) if enough Jungle grass and plants are created.

Jungle Rose.name: Jungle Rose
Jungle Rose.desc: The Jungle Rose is a vanity accessory which can be harvested from the floor of the Jungle and Underground Jungle. Certain small red flowers growing on Jungle grass have a 1/20 chance to drop the item when cut.

Flowers of Mortality.name: Flowers of Mortality
Flowers of Mortality.desc: The Flowers of Mortality is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Wither Blossoms Staff and the final upgrade to the Frost Blossom Staff. When used, it summons up to 5 rainbow flowers that orbit around the player.
Flowers of Mortality.tip: Summons five rainbow flowers over your head

Wither Blossoms Staff.name: Wither Blossoms Staff
Wither Blossoms Staff.desc: The Wither Blossoms Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is an upgrade to the Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff. When used, it summons up to four dark-colored flowers that orbit around the player, and fire homing bolts at nearby targets.
Wither Blossoms Staff.tip: Summons four decaying Plague flowers over your head

Flurrystorm Cannon.name: Flurrystorm Cannon
Flurrystorm Cannon.desc: The Flurrystorm Cannon is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it fires gravity affected snowballs at a gradually increasing rate as it is held out, increasing its fire rate every second until reaching a maximum of 6 seconds.
Flurrystorm Cannon.tip: Fires a chain of snowballs that become faster over time · Has a chance to also fire an ice chunk that shatters into shards · 50% chance to save ammo

Snowball Cannon.name: Snowball Cannon
Snowball Cannon.desc: The Snowball Cannon is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon which uses Snowballs as ammunition. The Snowball Cannon has a 931/6000 chance of being found inside Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as a 1/6 chance of being obtained from Frozen and Boreal Crates.

Forbidden Circlet.name: Forbidden Circlet
Forbidden Circlet.desc: The Forbidden Circlet is a craftable Hardmode helmet armor piece and variant of the Forbidden armor. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Forbidden Circlet.tip: 10% increased summon damage and 15% increased rogue velocity

Forbidden Fragment.name: Forbidden Fragment
Forbidden Fragment.desc: The Forbidden Fragment is a Hardmode crafting material which is always dropped by Sand Elementals, which spawn during Sandstorms in the Desert. To craft all items that require this material, 9 Forbidden Fragments are required.

Bladecrest Oathsword.name: Bladecrest Oathsword
Bladecrest Oathsword.desc: The Bladecrest Oathsword is a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that is dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in The Underworld. When used, it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 3 being able to be stuck into a single enemy.
Bladecrest Oathsword.tip: Throw a sharp blade that impales and slows enemies · Up to three blades can impale an enemy at a time · Consecutive hits past the first three will launch out the previous impaled blades · Hold Shift for moreA ritual blade used by Demons for sacrifices. · The more blood taints the edge, the sharper it becomes.

Old Lord Claymore.name: Old Lord Claymore
Old Lord Claymore.desc: The Old Lord Claymore is a Pre-Hardmode special sword that is dropped by Bone Serpents. When used, it performs a slow but powerful slash, swinging back and forth toward the cursor with high knockback, and inflicts the Hellfire debuff.
Old Lord Claymore.tip: A slow but powerful blade that sets enemies ablaze and has substantial knockback · Hold Shift for moreA gift to outstanding Demons, a replica of the sword used by the greatest of all Demon Lords. · The prosperity he brought to their kind is unmatched even now that they alone rule the Underworld.

Forbidden Sun.name: Forbidden Sun
Forbidden Sun.desc: The Forbidden Sun is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires a fireball that erupts into a giant lingering explosion upon collision. The explosion lingers for two seconds, dealing rapid damage to enemies caught in its radius.
Forbidden Sun.tip: Casts a fire orb that emits a gigantic explosion on hit

Forgotten Apex Wand.name: Forgotten Apex Wand
Forgotten Apex Wand.desc: The Forgotten Apex Wand is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons an Ancient Mineral Shark that follows the player.
Forgotten Apex Wand.tip: Summons ancient mineral sharks to take on your foes. · 'Seems to have lost its jaw some time in the past'

Amethyst.name: Amethyst
Amethyst.desc: Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. Out of all available gems, Amethyst is the least valuable gem, being able to craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes. It can be obtained in the following ways:

Forsaken Saber.name: Forsaken Saber
Forsaken Saber.desc: The Forsaken Saber is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires two sand blades that remain in place for about one second after fired and then rapidly accelerate in the direction of the cursor. One sand blade is always aimed towards the cursor.
Forsaken Saber.tip: Shoots two sand blades that alter their velocity as they travel

Fragments of Another World.name: Fragments of Another World
Fragments of Another World.desc: The Fragments of Another World are a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Fragments of Another World.tip: Grants immunity to Whispering Death · 20% increased melee speed · 1.15x specialist ranged damage · 25% reduced mana usage · +2 maximum sentries · 10% increased rogue attack speed · 'Don't speak of your desires to the shadows, they listen.'

Freedom Star.name: Freedom Star
Freedom Star.desc: The Freedom Star is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is an indirect upgrade to the Charged Blaster Cannon. When used, the player rapidly fires small, non-piercing energy orbs in quick succession which initially deal 70% damage and increase up to 100%.
Freedom Star.tip: Tap Left Click to fire energy orbs · Hold Left Click to charge and fire a beam that explodes on hit

Frigidflash Bolt.name: Frigidflash Bolt
Frigidflash Bolt.desc: The Frigidflash Bolt is a craftable Hardmode spell tome that is a combination of the Frost Bolt and Flare Bolt.
Frigidflash Bolt.tip: Casts a fast ball of flash-freezing magma that bounces off tiles · When hitting a tile, a flarefrost burst is produced · Press Right Click to cast an empowered ball that creates a collapsing flarefrost vortex which explodes

Frost Bolt.name: Frost Bolt
Frost Bolt.desc: The Frost Bolt is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires a slow-moving ball of ice that travels in a straight line, is unaffected by gravity, inflicts the Frostburn debuff on hit, and can pierce one enemy or bounce off two blocks before dissipating.
Frost Bolt.tip: Casts a ball of frost that bounces off tiles · When hitting a tile, a small frost burst is produced · Frost projectiles will fall to the ground after enough time has passed

Frog Leg.name: Frog Leg
Frog Leg.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:
Frog Leg.tip: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

Frost Blossom Staff.name: Frost Blossom Staff
Frost Blossom Staff.desc: The Frost Blossom Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a frozen flower minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing frost beams at nearby enemies once every 0.58 seconds.
Frost Blossom Staff.tip: Summons a frozen flower over your head · There can only be one flower at a time

Boreal Wood.name: Boreal Wood
Boreal Wood.desc: Boreal Wood is a type of wood harvested from Boreal trees found naturally growing in the Snow biome, or from Underground Cabins in the Ice biome. Boreal trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Snow Blocks above surface.

Shiverthorn.name: Shiverthorn
Shiverthorn.desc: Shiverthorn is a type of herb which appears as an icy-blue flower.

Sapphire.name: Sapphire
Sapphire.desc: Sapphire is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes. It can be obtained in the following ways:

Frostcrush Valari.name: Frostcrush Valari
Frostcrush Valari.desc: The Frostcrush Valari is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang that is a direct upgrade to the Kylie. When used, it throws a slow-moving boomerang that travels a long distance before returning to the player.
Frostcrush Valari.tip: Fires a long ranged frosty boomerang that chips off homing icicles on hit · Stealth strikes throw a boomerang which follows the cursor

Kylie.name: Kylie
Kylie.desc: Kylie is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that can be found in surface Chests or dropped from Wooden and Pearlwood Crates. When used, it throws a slow-moving boomerang that returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy.
Kylie.tip: Stealth strikes throw a kylie that weakly seeks out your cursor · 'Also known as Dowak'

Frozen Banana Daiquiri.name: Frozen Banana Daiquiri
Frozen Banana Daiquiri.desc: The Frozen Banana Daiquiri is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Frozen Banana Daiquiri.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Yellow and mellow'

Banana.name: Banana
Banana.desc: The Banana is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Banana.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Good source of potassium!'

Gacruxian Mollusk.name: Gacruxian Mollusk
Gacruxian Mollusk.desc: The Gacruxian Mollusk is a Hardmode non-consumable rogue weapon that can be fished up in the Astral Infection. When used, it throws a snail that drops sparks as it travels. The snail travels in a straight line for a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Gacruxian Mollusk.tip: Releases homing sparks while traveling · Stealth strikes release homing snails that create even more sparks

Polaris Parrotfish.name: Polaris Parrotfish
Polaris Parrotfish.desc: The Polaris Parrotfish is a Hardmode ranged weapon that can be fished up in the Astral Infection. When used, it rapidly fires pink and blue lasers that vanish in a star-shaped flash after traveling a fixed distance or upon hitting enemies or tiles.
Polaris Parrotfish.tip: Rapidly fires an array of colorful star shots · Firing speed increases the closer you are to an enemy · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense · 'It carries the mark of the Northern Star'

Galactus Blade.name: Galactus Blade
Galactus Blade.desc: The Galactus Blade is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword with a custom swing animation and is the direct upgrade to the Star Wrath. When swung, it rains down a barrage of Galactica Comets toward the cursor.
Galactus Blade.tip: Launches a barrage of comets from the sky · Forged with the fury of nuclear chaos

Star Wrath.name: Star Wrath
Star Wrath.desc: The Star Wrath is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it causes three pink stars to fall toward the cursor.
Star Wrath.tip: Causes stars to rain from the sky

True Biome Blade.name: True Biome Blade
True Biome Blade.desc: The True Biome Blade is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings and is an upgraded version of the Biome Blade. By default, it does not fire any projectile nor does it have any special effects.
True Biome Blade.tip: Does nothing.. yet · It seems that upgrading the blade expanded the scope of the previous attunements · Your secondary attunement can now provide passive bonuses · Holding down Right Click for 2 seconds attunes the weapon to the powers of the surrounding biome · Pressing Right Click for a shorter period of time switches your active and passive attunements around · Active Attunement: [None] · Passive Attunement: [None]

Galaxy Smasher.name: Galaxy Smasher
Galaxy Smasher.desc: The Galaxy Smasher is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon and the direct upgrade to the Stellar Contempt. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles.
Galaxy Smasher.tip: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits summon more and more cosmic shards · After hitting eight times, the hammer supercharges itself with galactic energies, · delivering an apocalyptic strike that reverberates through space and time
usedIn: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

Stellar Contempt.name: Stellar Contempt
Stellar Contempt.desc: The Stellar Contempt is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon and the direct upgrade to the Fallen Paladin's Hammer. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles.
Stellar Contempt.tip: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits call down more and more lunar flares from the sky · After hitting five times, the hammer supercharges with lunar energy to pulverize your target
stats: 4 seconds (Explosion) / 3 seconds (Supercharged Hammer, Lunar Flare) / 1.5 seconds (Hammer)

Galeforce.name: Galeforce
Galeforce.desc: The Galeforce is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it shoots arrows along with volleys of three non-piercing feathers, both at a high velocity.
Galeforce.tip: Fires a spread of low-damage feathers

Galileo Gladius.name: Galileo Gladius
Galileo Gladius.desc: The Galileo Gladius is a craftable post-Moon Lord shortsword. When used, the weapon rapidly stabs in front of the player with slightly varying angles, like the Gladius. Glowing blue energy extends a short distance from the weapon's tip with every stab, improving its range.
Galileo Gladius.tip: Rapidly stabs in front of the player, generating Starbursts on hit · Right Click to throw the gladius on a constellation chain, impaling foes and inflicting Voidfrost · When the blade is impaled, use Left Click or Right Click to free it · Left Click pulls it free and deals high damage, consuming 10 Starbursts · Right Click pulls yourself to the blade, allowing you to jump off the foe · Jumping off a foe consumes 20 Starbursts and provides invincibility · 'Figaro, magnifico'

Gladius.name: Gladius
Gladius.desc: The Gladius is a pre-Hardmode shortsword that is dropped by Hoplites with a 1/20 chance. It attacks three times in quick succession per use, with slightly varying angles with each stab.

Galvanizing Glaive.name: Galvanizing Glaive
Galvanizing Glaive.desc: The Galvanizing Glaive is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, the player swings a spear around similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases five gauss energy projectiles, each dealing 40% of the weapon's damage.
Galvanizing Glaive.tip: Swings a spear which envelops struck foes in an energy field · When finished, the spear discharges an extra pulse of energy · 'A tool which quickly and neatly cleaves one object into two. · Its efficiency and reliability as a weapon is unmistakable.'

Gaze of Crysthamyr.name: Gaze of Crysthamyr
Gaze of Crysthamyr.desc: Gaze of Crysthamyr is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item. When used it summons a rideable Shadow Dragon mount which can run and fly at high speeds.
Gaze of Crysthamyr.tip: Summons a shadow dragon · Hold W to ascend faster

Dragon Egg.name: Dragon Egg
Dragon Egg.desc: The Dragon Egg is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Hoardagron that follows the player. The Dragon Egg is dropped by Dark Mages during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/6 / 1/4 chance during Tier 1, and a 1/12 chance during Tier 3.

Gel Dart.name: Gel Dart
Gel Dart.desc: The Gel Dart is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gel dagger that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and inflicts the Slime debuff. They pierce and bounce off tiles 3 times before breaking on the fourth impact.
Gel Dart.tip: Throws bouncing gel darts that cover enemies in Slime (debuff) · Stealth strikes ignore gravity, bounce more vigorously, and constantly leak slime

Gelitic Blade.name: Gelitic Blade
Gelitic Blade.desc: The Gelitic Blade is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it releases a wide wave projectile with both it and the projectile emitting purple slime particles and inflicting the Slime debuff upon striking enemies.
Gelitic Blade.tip: Fires a fast gel wave that speeds up on enemy hits and covers them with Slime (debuff)

Gelpick.name: Gelpick
Gelpick.desc: The Gelpick is a Pre-Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Cobalt Ore and Palladium Ore. It is the fastest pickaxe available before Hardmode.

Gem Tech Body Armor.name: Gem Tech Body Armor
Gem Tech Body Armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Exo Prisms, Galactica Singularities, and Cores of Calamity.
Gem Tech Body Armor.tip: 'You sunk low enough for me to reach.'

Gem Tech Headgear.name: Gem Tech Headgear
Gem Tech Headgear.desc: Gem Tech armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Exo Prisms, Galactica Singularities, and Cores of Calamity.
Gem Tech Headgear.tip: 'The Devil said: Revel in your victory; You've earned your damning. Pack your things and leave.'

Gem Tech Schynbaulds.name: Gem Tech Schynbaulds
Gem Tech Schynbaulds.desc: Gem Tech armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Exo Prisms, Galactica Singularities, and Cores of Calamity.
Gem Tech Schynbaulds.tip: 'If they hurt you, kick them down.'

Gender Change Potion.name: Gender Change Potion
Gender Change Potion.desc: The Gender Change Potion is a pre-Hardmode potion that allows the player to swap their character style between male and female. Hurt sounds and equipment sprites change accordingly. The effect lasts until another Gender Change Potion is used.

Genesis.name: Genesis
Genesis.desc: The Genesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun. When used, it fires an array of eight lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on successive shots.
Genesis.tip: Fire an array of lasers that decreases in spread for each shot · Every sixth shot fires a splitting Genesis Beam and resets the spread of the weapon · Hitting an enemy before the Genesis Beam splits deals increased damage

Laser Rifle.name: Laser Rifle
Laser Rifle.desc: The Laser Rifle is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it fires fast-moving purple lasers that can hit up to three enemies. The lasers will increase in damage, pierce, knockback, and size (only visually) as they travel.

Genesis Pickaxe.name: Genesis Pickaxe
Genesis Pickaxe.desc: The Genesis Pickaxe is a craftable post-Moon Lord pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Exodium Cluster and Uelibloom Ore. It has the same pickaxe power as the Luminite Pickaxes. It has a bonus range of 4 tiles and emits magenta light particles when swung.

Ghastly Visage.name: Ghastly Visage
Ghastly Visage.desc: The Ghastly Visage is a post-Moon Lord magic weapon that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it releases homing ghast energy that travels through blocks and can pierce enemies twice before impacting on the third hit.
Ghastly Visage.tip: Fires homing ghast energy that explodes

Gruesome Eminence.name: Gruesome Eminence
Gruesome Eminence.desc: The Gruesome Eminence is a post-Moon Lord magic weapon, and the exhumed form of the Ghastly Visage. When used, it summons a spirit congregation that loosely follows the cursor and occasionally moves around randomly on its own.
Gruesome Eminence.tip: Summons a gaseous conglomeration of spirits near the cursor that fly around wildly · Over time, the spirits accumulate to create a single, controllable monstrosity

Ghost Bracelet.name: Ghost Bracelet
Ghost Bracelet.desc: The Ghost Bracelet is a craftable Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user.
Ghost Bracelet.tip: Wow.... It looks at me with its hollow eyes full of curiosity

Giant Tortoise Shell.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
Giant Tortoise Shell.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Giant Tortoise Shell.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

Gilded Dagger.name: Gilded Dagger
Gilded Dagger.desc: The Gilded Dagger is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a fast-moving golden dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.
Gilded Dagger.tip: Throws a shiny blade that ricochets towards another enemy on hit · Stealth strikes cause the blade to home in after ricocheting, with each ricochet dealing 5% more damage · Stealth strikes also have increased piercing

Gold Bar.name: Gold Bar
Gold Bar.desc: The Gold Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Gills Potion.name: Gills Potion
Gills Potion.desc: The Gills Potion is a buff potion which grants the Gills buff when consumed. The buff prevents the player's breath meter from depleting and thus prevents drowning.
Gills Potion.tip: Allows you to breathe in liquids

Gleaming Dagger.name: Gleaming Dagger
Gleaming Dagger.desc: The Gleaming Dagger is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a fast-moving platinum dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.
Gleaming Dagger.tip: Throws a shiny blade that ricochets towards another enemy on hit · Stealth strikes cause the blade to home in after ricocheting, with each ricochet dealing 5% more damage · Stealth strikes also have increased piercing

Platinum Bar.name: Platinum Bar
Platinum Bar.desc: The Platinum Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Mana Rose.name: Mana Rose
Mana Rose.desc: The Mana Rose is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a blue flower that decelerates before completely stopping. After 3 seconds have passed or upon contact with enemies or tiles, it will explode into an even spread of 6 damaging small blue petals.
Mana Rose.tip: Casts a mana flower that explodes into petals

Glimmering Ribbon.name: Glimmering Ribbon
Glimmering Ribbon.desc: The Glimmering Ribbon is a craftable Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user.
Glimmering Ribbon.tip: 'We are born colorless. It's the people we meet who give us color.'

Goblin Battle Standard.name: Goblin Battle Standard
Goblin Battle Standard.desc: The Goblin Battle Standard is an event-summoning item that initiates the Goblin Army event when used. The Goblin Battle Standard is consumed when used, so one must be crafted for each invasion the player wishes to summon.

Tattered Cloth.name: Tattered Cloth
Tattered Cloth.desc: The Tattered Cloth is a crafting material dropped by Goblin Scouts.

God Slayer Chestplate.name: God Slayer Chestplate
God Slayer Chestplate.desc: God Slayer armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Cosmilite Bars and Ascendant Spirit Essence. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
God Slayer Chestplate.tip: 15% increased damage and 11% increased critical strike chance

God Slayer Leggings.name: God Slayer Leggings
God Slayer Leggings.desc: God Slayer armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Cosmilite Bars and Ascendant Spirit Essence. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
God Slayer Leggings.tip: 11% increased damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased movement speed

God Slayer Slug.name: God Slayer Slug
God Slayer Slug.desc: God Slayer Slugs are post-Moon Lord bullets crafted from Cosmilite Bars. They initially behave similarly to Luminite Bullets, piercing infinitely and moving at a high velocity.
God Slayer Slug.tip: Heavy ammunition with unlimited piercing that tears through spacetime · Slugs that strike a target will warp back and supercharge, shattering on hit

Luminite Bullet.name: Luminite Bullet
Luminite Bullet.desc: The Luminite Bullet is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord bullet. This can reduce its damage down to 0, but it will continue to travel. It will disappear after 100ticks or upon hitting a block.

Gods' Paranoia.name: Gods' Paranoia
Gods' Paranoia.desc: Gods' Paranoia is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue spiky ball. It automatically fires homing spiky balls. The balls latch onto enemies and unleash god slayer kunai. Both the balls and the kunai go through blocks and inflict the God Slayer Inferno debuff.
Gods' Paranoia.tip: Hurls homing spiky balls which attach to enemies · Attached spiky balls summon a localized storm of god slayer kunai on each hit · Stealth strikes home in faster and hit at a faster rate

Gold Piggy Cage.name: Gold Piggy Cage
Gold Piggy Cage.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Gold Piggy.name: Gold Piggy
Gold Piggy.desc: The Gold Piggy is a critter that spawns in the Forest during the day or at any time while in a town. It is a golden recolor of the ordinary Piggy, with a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of spawning in place of the ordinary version.

Golden Cross Grave Marker.name: Golden Cross Grave Marker
Golden Cross Grave Marker.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Golden Delight.name: Golden Delight
Golden Delight.desc: The Golden Delight is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. It is crafted at the Cooking Pot with any gold critter or Golden Carp.

Golden Grave Marker.name: Golden Grave Marker
Golden Grave Marker.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Golden Gravestone.name: Golden Gravestone
