Golden Gravestone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Golden Headstone.name: Golden Headstone
Golden Headstone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Golden Tombstone.name: Golden Tombstone
Golden Tombstone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Goldplume Spear.name: Goldplume Spear
Goldplume Spear.desc: The Goldplume Spear is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spear that autoswings. At the peak of its thrust it fires a burst of 3 gravity-affected, non-piercing feathers that deal 50% of the weapon's damage.

Golem (Lore).name: Golem (Lore)
Golem (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Golem (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Golem Trophy.name: Golem Trophy
Golem Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Goobow.name: Goobow
Goobow.desc: The Goobow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it fires two short streams of slime alongside a regular arrow.
Goobow.tip: Addtionally fires two streams of damaging slime

Grand Gelatin.name: Grand Gelatin
Grand Gelatin.desc: The Grand Gelatin is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Cleansing Jelly, Life Jelly and Vital Jelly. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Grand Gelatin.tip: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen

Vital Jelly.name: Vital Jelly
Vital Jelly.desc: The Vital Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Green Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies. While equipped, it grants +12% movement and jump speed.

Majestic Guard.name: Majestic Guard
Majestic Guard.desc: The Majestic Guard is a craftable Hardmode special sword. When used, the sword is swung back and forth toward the cursor. Striking an enemy launches them away, and heals the player for 7 health; health gained has diminishing returns on consecutive hits.
Majestic Guard.tip: An intricate blade, heavy enough to crush anything it wouldn't cut · Strongly knocks back enemies and heals you slightly on hit

Grape Beer.name: Grape Beer
Grape Beer.desc: Grape Beer is a craftable Hardmode alcohol.
Grape Beer.tip: Bullets, Arrows, Darts, and Rockets gain homing · 75% reduced critical strike damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Grapes.name: Grapes
Grapes.desc: Grapes are a Hardmode food item that grant the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Grapes have a 1/40 chance of being dropped by Derplings and Giant Flying Foxes.
Grapes.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Wrath not included.'

Grave Grimreaver.name: Grave Grimreaver
Grave Grimreaver.desc: The Grave Grimreaver is a craftable Hardmode non-consumable rogue weapon. When used, it throws a homing scythe which passes through solid tiles and inflicts the Confused debuff.
Grave Grimreaver.tip: Hurls a cursed scythe which homes in · The scythe summons skulls as it flies and explodes into bats on hit · Stealth strikes spawn a flood of bats and falling skulls when destroyed · 'A dapper skeleton's weapon of choice'

Any Tombstone.name: Any Tombstone
Any Tombstone.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Sickle.name: Sickle
Sickle.desc: The Sickle is a tool that produces Hay blocks when used to cut wild grass plants and sea oats. The collected Hay can be used for building purposes and crafted into Target Dummies and Hay Walls.
Sickle.tip: Allows the collection of hay from grass

Grave Marker.name: Grave Marker
Grave Marker.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Gravestone.name: Gravestone
Gravestone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Gravitation Potion.name: Gravitation Potion
Gravitation Potion.desc: The Gravitation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Gravitation buff when consumed. The buff allows the player to invert gravity with Up, making the screen appear upside-down and causing the player to fall upwards and walk on top of ceilings.

Gravity Normalizer Potion.name: Gravity Normalizer Potion
Gravity Normalizer Potion.desc: The Gravity Normalizer Potion is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Gravity Normalizer buff, which causes the player to move normally in space as well as providing immunity to the Distorted debuff.
Gravity Normalizer Potion.tip: Disables the low gravity of space and grants immunity to the Distorted debuff

Aldebaran Alewife.name: Aldebaran Alewife
Aldebaran Alewife.desc: The Aldebaran Alewife is a Hardmode fishing catch caught in the Astral Infection with a 20% chance. It is used in the crafting of the Gravity Normalizer Potion and Seafood Dinner.
Aldebaran Alewife.tip: A star-struck entity in the form of a fish

Grax.name: Grax
Grax.desc: The Grax is a craftable post-Moon Lord hamaxe that is the final upgrade of the Feller of Evergreens. Its range is five tiles larger than most other tools.
Grax.tip: Hitting an enemy will increases your damage by 15% and defense by 15 for 15 seconds · Press Right Click to use without hammering down walls or chopping down trees

Any Lunar Hamaxe.name: Any Lunar Hamaxe
Any Lunar Hamaxe.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Inferna Cutter.name: Inferna Cutter
Inferna Cutter.desc: The Inferna Cutter is a craftable Hardmode axe that is the direct upgrade to the Axe of Purity. When swung, it emits light particles and releases several sparks similar to those fired by the Butcher's Chainsaw, which deal 50% of the weapon's damage.
Inferna Cutter.tip: Critical hits with the blade cause small explosions · Generates a number of small sparks when swung

Gray Zapinator.name: Gray Zapinator
Gray Zapinator.desc: The Gray Zapinator is a pre-Hardmode-exclusive

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Orange Zapinator.name: Orange Zapinator
Orange Zapinator.desc: The Orange Zapinator is a Hardmode magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Greatbay Pickaxe.name: Greatbay Pickaxe
Greatbay Pickaxe.desc: The Greatbay Pickaxe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Obsidian, Crimtane Ore / Demonite Ore and Sea Prism.
Greatbay Pickaxe.tip: Can mine Demonite, Crimtane, Meteorite, Sea Prisms and Sea Prism Crystals

Greater Luck Potion.name: Greater Luck Potion
Greater Luck Potion.desc: The Luck Potions are three types of buff potions which grant the Lucky buff, increasing the player's luck.
Greater Luck Potion.tip: Increases the Luck of the user

Greatsword of Judgement.name: Greatsword of Judgement
Greatsword of Judgement.desc: The Greatsword of Judgement is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword with a custom swing animation. When swung, it fires a large energy wave that slows down as it travels and pierces infinitely, but loses 12% damage per hit.
Greatsword of Judgement.tip: Fires a piercing energy wave that releases homing stars as it flies · Hits with the blade summon two stronger stars from behind you

Green Seeking Mechanism.name: Green Seeking Mechanism
Green Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

Gunk Shot.name: Gunk Shot
Gunk Shot.desc: The Gunk Shot is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used, it fires 3-4 bullets in a shotgun pattern.

Hadal Mantle.name: Hadal Mantle
Hadal Mantle.desc: The Hadal Mantle is a craftable Hardmode wing-type accessory. While equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide.
Hadal Mantle.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Good · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Good · Fueled by the fury of the depths

Hadal Stew.name: Hadal Stew
Hadal Stew.desc: The Hadal Stew is a craftable food item that can also be obtained from Rusty Chests. Upon consumption, it restores 100 health and grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff for 8 minutes. It also inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff for a shorter duration.
Hadal Stew.tip: Only gives 50 seconds of Potion Sickness · Major improvements to all stats

Coastal Demonfish.name: Coastal Demonfish
Coastal Demonfish.desc: The Coastal Demonfish is a fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag with an 8% chance and obtained from Ashen Chests in the Brimstone Crag in stacks of 2-4. It is used in the crafting of the Hadal Stew and Seafood Dinner.
Coastal Demonfish.tip: The horns lay a curse on those who touch it

Hadal Urn.name: Hadal Urn
Hadal Urn.desc: The Hadal Urn is a craftable Hardmode magic weapon and the direct upgrade to the Black Anurian. When used, the player holds an urn which rapidly fires a spread of three random marine creatures.
Hadal Urn.tip: Fires a random assortment of ocean creatures · 'There's no telling how long it was down there... or what lurks inside'

Black Anurian.name: Black Anurian
Black Anurian.desc: The Black Anurian is a Pre-Hardmode magic weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. When used, it shoots violet bubbles that travel in an upward arc, alongside two homing planktons which are fired in a random spread and deal 75% of the weapon's damage.

Hailstorm Bullet.name: Hailstorm Bullet
Hailstorm Bullet.desc: Hailstorm Bullets are craftable Hardmode bullets. The bullets pierce once and drastically slow down when fired, quickly becoming stationary before vanishing.
Hailstorm Bullet.tip: Once shot, bullets rapidly decelerate · Critical hits cause a flash freeze, dealing additional damage based on your crit chance and freezing enemies

Halley's Inferno.name: Halley's Inferno
Halley's Inferno.desc: Halley's Inferno is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it fires a rapid burst of five blue comets that pierce four times.
Halley's Inferno.tip: Fires a burst of intensely concentrated lunar fire jets · Right Click to rapid-fire Starbursts that inflict Voidfrost · Generates Starbursts when hitting enemies, depending on your accuracy · Uses gel for ammo · 50% chance to save ammo · 'Halley arrived sooner than expected'

Elf Melter.name: Elf Melter
Elf Melter.desc: The Elf Melter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition. It is an indirect upgrade to the Flamethrower. When used, it consumes one Gel and releases five bursts of fire in quick succession.
Elf Melter.tip: Uses gel for ammo · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense

Hallow-Point Round.name: Hallow-Point Round
Hallow-Point Round.desc: Hallow-Point Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They sparkle on enemy hits, which deal 6 extra flat damage as long as they have not been converted into other bullets.
Hallow-Point Round.tip: Releases anointed light on hit that increases the bullet's base damage to [DAMAGE] · This effect does not occur if the bullets are converted by special guns

Empty Bullet.name: Empty Bullet
Empty Bullet.desc: Empty Bullets are a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Arms Dealer for / 3 copper each. While they have no function as ammunition on their own, Empty Bullets are used to craft Hardmode bullets with special effects.
Empty Bullet.tip: Used to craft various types of ammo

Hallowed Ore.name: Hallowed Ore
Hallowed Ore.desc: "The hallow has been blessed with consecrated stone!"

Hallowed Rune.name: Hallowed Rune
Hallowed Rune.desc: The Hallowed Rune is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spirit Glyph. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:
Hallowed Rune.tip: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Does not stack with downgrades · Hold Shift for more Hallowed Power grants 10% increased summon damage and rains stars on enemies · Hallowed Defense grants 5 defense · Hallowed Regen grants +1 HP/s life regen

Spirit Glyph.name: Spirit Glyph
Spirit Glyph.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:
Spirit Glyph.tip: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for moreSpirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration

Hand Warmer.name: Hand Warmer
Hand Warmer.desc: The Hand Warmer is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Chilled and Frozen debuffs. It is obtained from Presents, with a chance of about in pre-Hardmode and about in Hardmode.
Hand Warmer.tip: Grants immunity to Chilled and Frozen

Handheld Tank.name: Handheld Tank
Handheld Tank.desc: The Handheld Tank is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a small, high-velocity rocket that causes a small explosion on contact with an enemy or a block.

Rocket Launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
Rocket Launcher.desc: The Rocket Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that has a 1/18 / 35/324 chance of being dropped by Skeleton Commandos in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires rockets as ammunition, which can damage the player for a flat 60 damage.
Rocket Launcher.tip: Does extra damage on a direct hit

Hardened Astral Sand Wall.name: Hardened Astral Sand Wall
Hardened Astral Sand Wall.desc: Hardened Astral Sand Wall is a background wall that replace Hardened Sand Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Hardened Sand Block.name: Hardened Sand Block
Hardened Sand Block.desc: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone.name: Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone
Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone.desc: Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found in the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It is commonly found on the outlines of caves and the sea floor.

Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone Wall.name: Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone Wall
Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone Wall.desc: Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone Wall is a background wall crafted from Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone.

Harvest Staff.name: Harvest Staff
Harvest Staff.desc: The Harvest Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode sentry. When used, it summons a stationary pumpkin patch nest that causes small pumpkins to sprout anywhere on the ground near the nest. Pumpkins will emerge when approached by an enemy or the player.
Harvest Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Grows a pumpkin patch that sprouts pumpkins nearby · Pumpkins will hop out when approached by nearby creatures or players · Once out, they will aggressively tackle enemies, exploding on hit · 'No thoughts behind those eyes'

Pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
Pumpkin.desc: Pumpkin is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Pumpkin plants using any weapon or tool.

Pumpkin Seed.name: Pumpkin Seed
Pumpkin Seed.desc: The Pumpkin Seed is a seed which is used to plant Pumpkins. They may be planted on normal green grass or Hallowed grass (including their mowed versions), and will eventually grow into Pumpkins.

Haunted Scroll.name: Haunted Scroll
Haunted Scroll.desc: The Haunted Scroll is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a stack of three haunted dishes which runs along the ground. It does not deal contact damage, but rapidly throws high velocity dishes at nearby enemies.
Haunted Scroll.tip: Summons a stack of haunted dishes to fight for you

Plate.name: Plate
Plate.desc: The Plate is a decorative furniture item that can be placed. Once placed, food can be placed onto or removed from the Plate by pressing Right Click.
Plate.tip: Right click to place item on plate

Havocplate Wall.name: Havocplate Wall
Havocplate Wall.desc: Havocplate Wall is a background wall crafted with Havocplate.

Hazard Chevron Panels.name: Hazard Chevron Panels
Hazard Chevron Panels.desc: Hazard Chevron Panels are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks that can also be found in Arsenal Labs.

Hazard Chevron Wall.name: Hazard Chevron Wall
Hazard Chevron Wall.desc: Hazard Chevron Wall is a background wall crafted with Hazard Chevron Panels.

Black Paint.name: Black Paint
Black Paint.desc: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks, background walls, and furniture, along with non-collectable environment objects like trees, tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth.

Laboratory Panels.name: Laboratory Panels
Laboratory Panels.desc: Laboratory Panels are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. They can be used to craft Hazard Chevron Panels.

Yellow Paint.name: Yellow Paint
Yellow Paint.desc: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks, background walls, and furniture, along with non-collectable environment objects like trees, tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth.

Headstone.name: Headstone
Headstone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Heart of Darkness.name: Heart of Darkness
Heart of Darkness.desc: The Heart of Darkness is a Pre-Hardmode accessory in Revengeance Mode. It can be obtained from any Treasure Bag at a 2.5% chance or bought from the Shady Salesman during even Moon phases after defeating Skeletron.
Heart of Darkness.tip: You constantly gain rage over time, and rage does not fade away when out of combat · Revengeance

Stress Pills.name: Stress Pills
Stress Pills.desc: Stress Pills are a Pre-Hardmode accessory in Revengeance Mode. They can be obtained from any Treasure Bag at a 2.5% chance or bought from the Shady Salesman during odd Moon phases after defeating Skeletron. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Stress Pills.tip: Adrenaline charges 20% faster · Increases your max movement speed and acceleration by 5% · Revengeance

Heart of the Elements.name: Heart of the Elements
Heart of the Elements.desc: The Heart of the Elements is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It will summon all of the Elementals to assist the player and attack enemies.
Heart of the Elements.tip: Summons all elementals to protect you · The elementals have reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · 'The heart of the world'

Elemental in a Bottle.name: Elemental in a Bottle
Elemental in a Bottle.desc: The Elemental in a Bottle is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Sand Elementals. When equipped, it summons a Sand Elemental minion to fight for the player, which deals summon damage and casts sandstorms in a similar fashion to its enemy counterpart.
Elemental in a Bottle.tip: Summons a sand elemental to fight for you · The elemental has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.desc: The Eye of the Storm is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Cloud Elemental. When equipped, it summons a friendly Cloud Elemental to fight for the player. She attacks enemies by dashing repeatedly towards them to deal damage and she can dash through solid blocks.
Eye of the Storm.tip: Summons a Cloud Elemental to fight for you · The elemental has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled

Oasis Elemental in a Bottle.name: Oasis Elemental in a Bottle
Oasis Elemental in a Bottle.desc: The Oasis Elemental in a Bottle is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Sand Elementals. When equipped, it summons a Oasis Elemental that summons healing orbs while the player is damaged.
Oasis Elemental in a Bottle.tip: Summons an oasis elemental to assist you · The elemental fires healing orbs that restore 10 health while you are damaged · The elemental has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled

Pearl of Enthrallment.name: Pearl of Enthrallment
Pearl of Enthrallment.desc: The Pearl of Enthrallment is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it summons a friendly Water Elemental which remains above the player's head.
Pearl of Enthrallment.tip: Summons a water elemental to fight for you · The elemental stays above you, shooting water spears, ice mist, and treble clefs at nearby enemies · The elemental has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled

Rose Stone.name: Rose Stone
Rose Stone.desc: The Rose Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When equipped, it summons a friendly Brimstone Elemental to protect the player, which attacks nearby enemies by firing brimstone fireballs or through contact damage.
Rose Stone.tip: Summons a Brimstone Elemental to fight for you · The elemental has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled

Heartreach Potion.name: Heartreach Potion
Heartreach Potion.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles.
Heartreach Potion.tip: Increases pickup range for life hearts

Heavenly Gale.name: Heavenly Gale
Heavenly Gale.desc: The Heavenly Gale is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. When used, it converts all arrows into a burst of 9 exo crystals that go through tiles and home in on enemies, consuming 1 arrow per burst.
Heavenly Gale.tip: Fires a rapid stream of supercharged exo-crystals · Holding the bow and waiting for some time before firing causes the crystals to become more powerful · If the crystals are sufficiently powerful enough they will summon torrents of exo-lightning above whatever target they hit · Enemies struck with Exo-lightning are atomized by Miracle Blight

Planetary Annihilation.name: Planetary Annihilation
Planetary Annihilation.desc: The Planetary Annihilation is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that rains arrows from the sky in groups of seven. It converts Wooden Arrows into rainbow blasts that home in on enemies.
Planetary Annihilation.tip: Fires a storm of 7 arrows from the sky · Wooden arrows are converted into homing energy bolts

Telluric Glare.name: Telluric Glare
Telluric Glare.desc: The Telluric Glare is a post-Moon Lord bow that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it rapidly fires volleys of arrows and radiant arrows in a sequential stream, with slight variation in their position of origin.
Telluric Glare.tip: Rapidly fires volleys of arrows · Every other arrow is converted into radiant greatarrows which pierce but quicky disappear after striking · Wooden arrows are converted into more powerful greatarrows that deal increased damage

The Ballista.name: The Ballista
The Ballista.desc: The Ballista is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into ballista arrows that pierce once and shatter into 2 fossil shards upon hitting a second enemy, as well as upon contact with tiles. The fossil shards deal 25% of the weapon's damage.
The Ballista.tip: Converts wooden arrows into greatarrows that cause Armor Crunch and break into shards

Helium Flash.name: Helium Flash
Helium Flash.desc: The Helium Flash is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a burning star core which bursts on impact into an enormous flaming explosion much like the Inferno Fork. The explosion ignores NPC immunity frames.
Helium Flash.tip: Launches volatile star cores which erupt into colossal fusion blasts · Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage · 'The power of a galaxy, if only for mere moments'

Venusian Trident.name: Venusian Trident
Venusian Trident.desc: The Venusian Trident is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand and the direct upgrade to the Inferno Fork.
Venusian Trident.tip: Casts an infernal trident that erupts into a gigantic explosion of fire and magma shards · Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage

Helium Moss Brick.name: Helium Moss Brick
Helium Moss Brick.desc: Helium Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Helium Moss that glows in the dark when placed, and cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

Helium Moss.name: Helium Moss
Helium Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Helium Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Hellfire Flamberge.name: Hellfire Flamberge
Hellfire Flamberge.desc: The Hellfire Flamberge is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires two small fireballs and one large fireball that travel a slow distance before stopping and dissipating on collision or after a short amount of time.
Hellfire Flamberge.tip: Fires a spread of volcanic fireballs

Hellfire Treads.name: Hellfire Treads
Hellfire Treads.desc: The Hellfire Treads are a pre-Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Spectre and Flame Waker Boots.
Hellfire Treads.tip: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Leaves a trail of flames in your wake

calamityChanges.tip: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Leaves a trail of flames in your wake · 50% increased Heat debuff damage, does not stack with downgrades · All attacks inflict Hellfire
calamityChanges.desc: The Hellfire Treads are a craftable Hardmode accessory and a direct upgrade to the Flame Waker Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

Hellion Flower Spear.name: Hellion Flower Spear
Hellion Flower Spear.desc: The Hellion Flower Spear is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, it fires out a spike that pierces twice. Dealing critical hits from the spear or spikes will spawn a single petal from off-screen that flies towards the enemy's position. All projectiles deal 100% base damage.
Hellion Flower Spear.tip: Shoots a flower spear tip · Summons petals from the sky on critical hits

Hellstone.name: Hellstone
Hellstone.desc: Hellstone is a pre-Hardmode ore that can be found in The Underworld. Mining it requires at least a Nightmare/Deathbringer Pickaxe, and it cannot be mined with explosives in pre-Hardmode. Hellstone releases a half-tile of lava when mined in The Underworld.
Hellstone.tip: Burns you when touched without special protection

Infernal Suevite.name: Infernal Suevite
Infernal Suevite.desc: Infernal Suevite is a Hardmode ore that generates in the Brimstone Crag upon world creation. It is used to craft Unholy Cores at a Hellforge. It requires at least a Mythril or Orichalcum Pickaxe to mine. It can also be obtained from Infernal Congealments.

Hellwing Staff.name: Hellwing Staff
Hellwing Staff.desc: The Hellwing Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it spawns 4 non-piercing flaming bats that go through tiles and quickly dissipate after spawning. The way the bats spawn depends on where the cursor spawns them.

Helstorm.name: Helstorm
Helstorm.desc: The Helstorm is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it rapidly auto-fires two bullets at once with a slightly random spread. The gun itself deals contact damage to enemies, a unique property for a ranged weapon that it shares with the Hellborn.
Helstorm.tip: Fires two bullets at once · The gun also deals damage to enemies that touch it

Hermes Boots.name: Hermes Boots
Hermes Boots.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers.
Hermes Boots.tip: The wearer can run super fast

Swiftness Potion.name: Swiftness Potion
Swiftness Potion.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts.

Heron Rod.name: Heron Rod
Heron Rod.desc: The Heron Rod is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing pole. While fishing in space, the player's fishing power is increased by 1.1x.
Heron Rod.tip: Increased fishing power by 1.1x when in space · 'A silent head and beak lanced down and plucked it out by the head, · and the beak swallowed the little fish while its tail waved frantically.'

Holy Fire Bullet.name: Holy Fire Bullet
Holy Fire Bullet.desc: Holy Fire Bullets are craftable post-Moon Lord bullets.
Holy Fire Bullet.tip: Profaned bullets that deal 1.15x damage and explode on impact · The explosion is larger and the bullet deals increased damage if impact occurs immediately after firing · The extra damage bonus caps at 1.15x

Exploding Bullet.name: Exploding Bullet
Exploding Bullet.desc: The Exploding Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It explodes on impact with enemies or blocks, dealing damage and knockback within an area.

Honey Dew.name: Honey Dew
Honey Dew.desc: The Honey Dew is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.
Honey Dew.tip: Natural life regen is 50% more potent

Bottled Honey.name: Bottled Honey
Bottled Honey.desc: Bottled Honey is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion. When used, it restores health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It also grants the player the Honey buff for 15 seconds.
Bottled Honey.tip: Improves natural healing for a short time

Hostile Fire Turret.name: Hostile Fire Turret
Hostile Fire Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Ice Turret.name: Hostile Ice Turret
Hostile Ice Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Lab Turret.name: Hostile Lab Turret
Hostile Lab Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Laser Turret.name: Hostile Laser Turret
Hostile Laser Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Onyx Turret.name: Hostile Onyx Turret
Hostile Onyx Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Plague Turret.name: Hostile Plague Turret
Hostile Plague Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hostile Water Turret.name: Hostile Water Turret
Hostile Water Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Hunter Potion.name: Hunter Potion
Hunter Potion.desc: The Hunter Potion is a buff potion which grants the Hunter buff when consumed. The buff shows the location of enemies, critters, and undiscovered NPCs on the screen by highlighting them in red (enemies) or green (critters and NPCs).

Hydra.name: Hydra
Hydra.desc: The Hydra is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it fires a spread of 3 toxic bullets which inflicts the Acid Venom debuff upon contact. While the weapon is in use, it will summon a gun-head every 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 gun-heads can exist at a time.
Hydra.tip: Fires a spread of 3 blood globs imbued with Acid Venom · Grows a gun-head every 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 heads · Press Left Click to command any existing heads to fire · Press Right Click to launch the heads for powerful explosive damage · Fusion of heavy machinery and Lernaean blood

Quad-Barrel Shotgun.name: Quad-Barrel Shotgun
Quad-Barrel Shotgun.desc: The Quad-Barrel Shotgun is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron gun that can be purchased for from the Arms Dealer when he is spoken to in a Graveyard. When used, it fires eight bullets at a 45° spread, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Hydraulic Volt Crasher.name: Hydraulic Volt Crasher
Hydraulic Volt Crasher.desc: The Hydraulic Volt Crasher is a craftable Hardmode hammer. When an enemy is struck, a stream of electricity is released, striking all enemies within a short range.
Hydraulic Volt Crasher.tip: An electrically charged jackhammer which shocks all nearby foes on hit · Press Right Click to use without hammering down walls · 'A device made to electrically stamp metal plates, instantly fusing them. · Naturally, it can also function as a devastating weapon.'

Hydrothermic Headgear.name: Hydrothermic Headgear
Hydrothermic Headgear.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Headgear.tip: 12% increased ranged damage and 10% increased ranged critical strike chance · 25% chance to save ammo

Hydrothermic Helm.name: Hydrothermic Helm
Hydrothermic Helm.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Helm.tip: 12% increased melee damage and 10% increased melee critical strike chance · 15% increased melee speed

Hydrothermic Helmet.name: Hydrothermic Helmet
Hydrothermic Helmet.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Helmet.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 10% increased summon damage

Hydrothermic Hood.name: Hydrothermic Hood
Hydrothermic Hood.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Hood.tip: 12% increased rogue damage and 10% increased rogue critical strike chance · 5% increased movement speed

Hydrothermic Mask.name: Hydrothermic Mask
Hydrothermic Mask.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Mask.tip: Increases maximum mana by 100 and 15% reduced mana cost · 12% increased magic damage and 10% increased magic critical strike chance

Hydrothermic Subligar.name: Hydrothermic Subligar
Hydrothermic Subligar.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic Subligar.tip: 9% increased critical strike chance · 10% increased movement speed

Hyperius Bullet.name: Hyperius Bullet
Hyperius Bullet.desc: Hyperius Bullets are craftable Hardmode bullets. They can pass through tiles, but upon passing through will begin to rapidly deteriorate and fade away before disappearing.
Hyperius Bullet.tip: Dazzling multicolor bullets that split into swirling lights on impact · Damage that would be dealt from the bullets is instead stored on the target · As more damage is stored, it will begin to overflow, slowly releasing and damaging the enemy · Attacks from sources other than Hyperius Bullets will release some of the charge · Releasing charge in this way is 20% more efficient

Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
Hypothermia.desc: The Hypothermia is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue weapon. It fires a constant barrage of black ice shards that ricochet off of tiles.
Hypothermia.tip: Throws a constant barrage of black ice shards · Stealth strikes hurl a set of razor sharp ice chunks that shatter on impact

Ice Barrage.name: Ice Barrage
Ice Barrage.desc: The Ice Barrage is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that consumes Blood Runes as ammunition. When used, it summons a collapsing ring of icy dust on top of the cursor which can immediately lock onto the closest target within a 31.25-tile radius.
Ice Barrage.tip: Casts a deadly and powerful ice spell in the location of the cursor · This ice spell locks itself to the position of nearby enemies · Consumes 2 Blood Runes every time it's used · 'Oh dear, you are dead!'

Ice Rod.name: Ice Rod
Ice Rod.desc: The Ice Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires blocks of ice, which have the unique ability of placing solid, temporary Ice Blocks at the location of the cursor and which last for 15 seconds before shattering.

Icicle Staff.name: Icicle Staff
Icicle Staff.desc: The Icicle Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it rains down two icicles from above the screen that fall directly towards the cursor. These icicles shatter on collision with an enemy or tile.

Ice Block.name: Ice Block
Ice Block.desc: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions.

Ice Skates.name: Ice Skates
Ice Skates.desc: Ice Skates are a pre-Hardmode accessory that improves a player's movement control on Thin Ice, all Ice Blocks, Ice Rod blocks, Frozen Slime Blocks and Aetherium Blocks.
Ice Skates.tip: Provides extra mobility on ice · Ice will not break when you fall on it

Flinx Fur.name: Flinx Fur
Flinx Fur.desc: Flinx Fur is a crafting material dropped by Snow Flinx, an enemy found in the Ice biome. They drop 1–2 / 1–3 Flinx Fur.

Ice Torch.name: Ice Torch
Ice Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Ice Turret.name: Ice Turret
Ice Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Ichor Arrow.name: Ichor Arrow
Ichor Arrow.desc: The Ichor Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. It inflicts the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds upon contact with enemies.

Ichor.name: Ichor
Ichor.desc: Ichor is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Ichor Stickers in the Underground Crimson and the Tainted Ghoul in the Crimson Underground Desert. It is also obtained from Hematic Crates. It is used to craft many Ichor-related items.

drops.amount: 2–5 (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 3–6 (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Ichor Bullet.name: Ichor Bullet
Ichor Bullet.desc: The Ichor Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It inflicts the Ichor debuff on hit for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), decreasing the enemy's defense by 15. Combined with the bullet's base damage, it effectively deals a total of 21 damage.

Icicle Arrow.name: Icicle Arrow
Icicle Arrow.desc: Icicle Arrows are craftable Hardmode arrows. They ignore gravity and pierce infinitely, but rapidly decelerate during flight before falling straight down as an icicle that deals 75% damage, passes through tiles, and pierces once.
Icicle Arrow.tip: Once shot, arrows quickly freeze into falling icicles · Hitting enemies or tiles before the arrow fully freezes causes it to bounce upwards

Igneous Exaltation.name: Igneous Exaltation
Igneous Exaltation.desc: The Igneous Exaltation is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons an igneous blade that orbits around the player, damaging enemies that come into contact with it. The blade slowly charges up while holding this item and its orbiting circle gets smaller over time.
Igneous Exaltation.tip: Summons an Igneous blade that orbits around you · When your minion slots are full, Left Click again to launch all blades towards the cursor · This ability has a two-second cooldown that requires holding this item · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to change the rotation direction

Illustrious Knives.name: Illustrious Knives
Illustrious Knives.desc: The Illustrious Knives are a craftable post-Moon Lord developer melee weapon. When used, the weapon launches a spread of 4-8 slow moving green knives, similar to the Vampire Knives.
Illustrious Knives.tip: Throws a barrage of fast-moving homing knives that heal the user

Infected Jewel.name: Infected Jewel
Infected Jewel.desc: The Infected Jewel is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Crown Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Infected Jewel.tip: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 6 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'

Crown Jewel.name: Crown Jewel
Crown Jewel.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Crown Jewel.tip: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

Infernal Kris.name: Infernal Kris
Infernal Kris.desc: The Infernal Kris is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a fire dagger that starts to spin after traveling a moderate distance. The daggers are not affected by gravity, pierce once and inflict the On Fire! debuff.
Infernal Kris.tip: Rapidly throws burning daggers · Stealth strikes engulf the dagger in flames, exploding when hitting walls and enemies
stats: 1.5 seconds (Cinder) / 3 seconds (Explosion) / 3-5 seconds (Dagger) / 4-7 seconds (Stealth Strike Dagger)

Infernal Rift.name: Infernal Rift
Infernal Rift.desc: The Infernal Rift is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Sky Fracture. When used, it fires a set of 15 infernal blades that do not pierce or pass through tiles.
Infernal Rift.tip: Summons infernal blades that spawn additional blades on enemy hits

Sky Fracture.name: Sky Fracture
Sky Fracture.desc: The Sky Fracture is a Hardmode wand. When used, it summons three energy swords in quick succession around the player, aiming at the cursor's location. The swords do not pierce enemies and cannot pass through blocks.

Inferno Potion.name: Inferno Potion
Inferno Potion.desc: The Inferno Potion is a buff potion that grants the Inferno buff when consumed. The buff casts a spinning ring of fire around the player that deals 20 damage per second and inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 2 seconds to all enemies inside of it while also giving off light.

Infinity.name: Infinity
Infinity.desc: The Infinity is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the Shredder. When used, it fires a twin stream of charged energy bolts in a sine-wave pattern.
Infinity.tip: Fires a twin stream of energy bolts that split · Ignores 20 points of enemy Defense · 80% chance to save ammo · 'They say infinity is neverending, yet you hold it in your hands'

Shredder.name: Shredder
Shredder.desc: The Shredder is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used, it fires an inaccurate spread of 3 charged energy bolts in a burst of 8. Each bolt splits off into 2 small bolts in a wide backwards spread upon hitting an enemy or tile.
Shredder.tip: Fires a barrage of energy bolts that split and bounce · 'The myth, the legend, the weapon that drops more frames than any other'

Invisibility Potion.name: Invisibility Potion
Invisibility Potion.desc: The Invisibility Potion is a buff potion that grants the Invisibility buff when consumed. The buff is furthermore immediately canceled if the player takes damage of any kind.
Invisibility Potion.tip: Grants invisibility and lowers the spawn rate of enemies

Invisible Dye.name: Invisible Dye
Invisible Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Lens.name: Lens
Lens.desc: A Lens is a common crafting material that has a 1/3 chance to drop from Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes.

Iron Bar.name: Iron Bar
Iron Bar.desc: The Iron Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Ironskin Potion.name: Ironskin Potion
Ironskin Potion.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 /.

Irradiated Slime Banner.name: Irradiated Slime Banner
Irradiated Slime Banner.desc: Banners are functional furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks. The Calamity Mod features banners for many of the enemies and critters introduced in the mod's various biomes.
Irradiated Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: [enemy name]

Gamma Slime Banner.name: Gamma Slime Banner
Gamma Slime Banner.desc: Banners are functional furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks. The Calamity Mod features banners for many of the enemies and critters introduced in the mod's various biomes.
Gamma Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: [enemy name]

Jaws of Oblivion.name: Jaws of Oblivion
Jaws of Oblivion.desc: The Jaws of Oblivion are a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Leviathan Teeth. When used, they rapidly throw a tight spread of 6 gravity-ignoring reaper teeth that stick to enemies and inflict the Acid Venom and Armor Crunch debuffs.
Jaws of Oblivion.tip: Throws a tight spread of six reaper teeth with Acid Venom that stick in enemies · The Acid Venom can stack when more teeth are stuck in an enemy · Stealth strikes cause the teeth to emit a crushing shockwave on impact · 'You're gonna need a bigger boat'

Leviathan Teeth.name: Leviathan Teeth
Leviathan Teeth.desc: The Leviathan Teeth are a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them.
Leviathan Teeth.tip: Rapidly throws a spread of teeth that stick to enemies · After sticking to an enemy, the teeth will gouge through them and shoot out the other side · Stealth strikes create a clamping jaw of teeth to maul your foes

Reaper Tooth.name: Reaper Tooth
Reaper Tooth.desc: Reaper Teeth are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by Reaper Sharks after Polterghast has been defeated. They are used to craft the Reaper Tooth Necklace, Omega Blue armor, and several weapons.

Jelly-Charged Battery.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
Jelly-Charged Battery.desc: The Jelly-Charged Battery is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Voltaic Jelly and Wulfrum Battery. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Jelly-Charged Battery.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs
stats: 1.5 seconds (Energy Orb) / 1 second (20% on minion hits)

Voltaic Jelly.name: Voltaic Jelly
Voltaic Jelly.desc: The Voltaic Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated. When equipped, it grants +1 minion slot and a 20% chance for minions to inflict the Static Discharge debuff.
Voltaic Jelly.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Static Discharge

Wulfrum Battery.name: Wulfrum Battery
Wulfrum Battery.desc: The Wulfrum Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum enemies. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Wulfrum Battery.tip: Your summons emit light if visibility is on · 7% increased summon damage · Wulfrum enemies drop additional scrap · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator

Jester's Arrow.name: Jester's Arrow
Jester's Arrow.desc: The Jester's Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

Karasawa.name: Karasawa
Karasawa.desc: Karasawa is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used, it slowly fires a light blue energy pulse that explodes into a trefoil. Each time the gun fires, it consumes five bullets instead of one.

Kelvin Catalyst.name: Kelvin Catalyst
Kelvin Catalyst.desc: The Kelvin Catalyst is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws an ice scythe that returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting a tile and it can be thrown an unlimited number of times.
Kelvin Catalyst.tip: Throws an icy blade that splits into multiple ice stars on enemy hits · Stealth strikes will briefly gain sentience and ram nearby enemies before returning to the player

Avalanche.name: Avalanche
Avalanche.desc: The Avalanche is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Cryogen. Upon hitting enemies, it spawns 4 ice bombs that orbit around the struck enemy. The ice bombs pass through tiles and explode into 4 gravity affected ice shards on enemy hits or after 3 seconds.
Avalanche.tip: Hitting enemies spawns orbiting ice bombs · After 2 seconds, ice bombs explode into gravity-affected ice shards

Hoarfrost Bow.name: Hoarfrost Bow
Hoarfrost Bow.desc: The Hoarfrost Bow is a Hardmode bow that is dropped by Cryogen. When used, it fires 2 arrows in a random spread. If Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, the arrows are converted into mist arrows that split into 2 frost mists that deal 35% of the arrow's damage.
Hoarfrost Bow.tip: Fires two arrows at once · Converts wooden arrows into mist arrows that spread frost mist on collision

Ice Star.name: Ice Star
Ice Star.desc: The Ice Star is a Hardmode rogue weapon sold by the Archmage NPC for 20 gold. It is a large throwing star made of ice, which pierces 3 times and will fall after traveling a short distance. It also has slight homing abilities.
Ice Star.tip: Throws fast but brittle homing ice stars · Stealth strikes last longer and spawn smaller homing stars on first hits

Icebreaker.name: Icebreaker
Icebreaker.desc: The Icebreaker is a Hardmode rogue boomerang that is dropped by Cryogen. When used, it throws an ice hammer-like boomerang that returns to the player after hitting an enemy or tile, or after traveling a moderate distance.
Icebreaker.tip: Throws an icy hammer that magically returns to the player · Stealth strikes spawn a cosmic explosion and freeze nearby enemies on hit

Snowstorm Staff.name: Snowstorm Staff
Snowstorm Staff.desc: The Snowstorm Staff is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Cryogen. When used, it spawns a large flying snowflake that is controlled with the cursor, staying close to it in a similar manner to the Flying Knife.
Snowstorm Staff.tip: Fires snowflakes that follows the mouse cursor · Snowflakes split into ice stars on enemy hits

King of Constellations, Tenryū.name: King of Constellations, Tenryū
King of Constellations, Tenryū.desc: The King of Constellations, Tenryū is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. It consumes four minion slots to summon two Celestial Dragons which follow the player. Each dragon contains 22 segments with 20 body segments.
King of Constellations, Tenryū.tip: Summons a pair of celestial dragons to fight for you · There can only be one pair of dragons at a time · 'The ones who will devour the Unmoving Star'

Stardust Dragon Staff.name: Stardust Dragon Staff
Stardust Dragon Staff.desc: The Stardust Dragon Staff is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist summon weapon that summons a Stardust Dragon minion. It flies towards enemies, dealing contact damage and dashing to catch up with its target. It can move through and target enemies through blocks.
Stardust Dragon Staff.tip: Summons a stardust dragon to fight for you · 'Who needs a horde of minions when you have a giant dragon?'

King Slime (Lore).name: King Slime (Lore)
King Slime (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
King Slime (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

King Slime Trophy.name: King Slime Trophy
King Slime Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Kingsbane.name: Kingsbane
Kingsbane.desc: The Kingsbane is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the Chain Gun and P90. When used, it shoots at an incredibly high rate after taking 1.5 seconds to rev up.
Kingsbane.tip: After revving up, rapidly fire bullets · When you stop firing you will release a barrage of auric bullets · Auric bullets aggressively home in on enemies, ignore 50 points of defense, and inflict Auric Rebuke · Constantly consumes ammo while in use · 90% chance to save ammo

Chain Gun.name: Chain Gun
Chain Gun.desc: The Chain Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that is dropped by Santa-NK1 during the Frost Moon event with a 6.25%–16.67% / 12.5%–50% chance depending on the current wave. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a wide spread.

P90.name: P90
P90.desc: The P90 is a Hardmode gun sold by the Arms Dealer for 35 gold. When used, it converts all bullets into rapidly-firing, high-velocity rounds with an innate 30 armor penetration. It has a 50% chance to not consume ammo.
P90.tip: Unleashes a stream of armor-piercing rounds at an incredible rate · Armor-piercing rounds ignore 30 defense · 50% chance to save ammo · 'It's a bullet hose'

Krypton Moss Brick.name: Krypton Moss Brick
Krypton Moss Brick.desc: Krypton Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Krypton Moss that glows in the dark when placed.

Krypton Moss.name: Krypton Moss
Krypton Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Krypton Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Lab Hologram Projector.name: Lab Hologram Projector
Lab Hologram Projector.desc: The Lab Hologram Projector is a furniture item that can be found in the Arsenal Labs. When the player is within a 35-block radius around the projector, it will activate, revealing a ghostly replica of Draedon's upper body.

Laboratory Plating.name: Laboratory Plating
Laboratory Plating.desc: Laboratory Plating is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. It is used in the crafting of Laboratory furniture.

Lab Turret.name: Lab Turret
Lab Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Laboratory Console.name: Laboratory Console
Laboratory Console.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Laboratory Containment Box.name: Laboratory Containment Box
Laboratory Containment Box.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Laboratory Display.name: Laboratory Display
Laboratory Display.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Laboratory Door.name: Laboratory Door
Laboratory Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Laboratory Electric Panel.name: Laboratory Electric Panel
Laboratory Electric Panel.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Laboratory Panel Wall.name: Laboratory Panel Wall
Laboratory Panel Wall.desc: Laboratory Panel Wall is a background wall crafted with Laboratory Panels.

Laboratory Pipe Plating.name: Laboratory Pipe Plating
Laboratory Pipe Plating.desc: Laboratory Pipe Plating is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in Arsenal Labs.

Rusted Pipes.name: Rusted Pipes
Rusted Pipes.desc: Rusted Pipes are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. They are used in the crafting of Laboratory Pipe Platings.

Laboratory Plate Beam.name: Laboratory Plate Beam
Laboratory Plate Beam.desc: Laboratory Plate Beam is a background wall crafted with Laboratory Plating.

Laboratory Plate Pillar.name: Laboratory Plate Pillar
Laboratory Plate Pillar.desc: Laboratory Plate Pillar is a background wall crafted with Laboratory Plating.

Laboratory Shelf.name: Laboratory Shelf
Laboratory Shelf.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Laboratory Plating Wall.name: Laboratory Plating Wall
Laboratory Plating Wall.desc: Laboratory Plating Wall is a background wall crafted with Laboratory Plating.

Laboratory Screen.name: Laboratory Screen
Laboratory Screen.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Laboratory Server.name: Laboratory Server
Laboratory Server.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Rusted Shelf.name: Rusted Shelf
Rusted Shelf.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Laboratory Terminal.name: Laboratory Terminal
Laboratory Terminal.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Lacerator.name: Lacerator
Lacerator.desc: The Lacerator is a craftable post-Moon Lord yoyo. Hitting enemies spawns a blood saw on top of the yoyo which rapidly shreds enemies, dealing more damage the more hits are landed with the yoyo itself and inflicting the Laceration debuff for 3 seconds.
Lacerator.tip: Reach: 35 tiles · Speed: 48 · Infinite throw duration · Striking enemies conjures a bloody saw to shred them · The saw does more damage the more often the yoyo hits, and fades away when not striking enemies · Enemies touching the edge of the sawblade get blood orbs torn out of them · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness · The direction of the saw's spin depends on which direction you originally threw the yoyo

Large Ritual Candle.name: Large Ritual Candle
Large Ritual Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Laser Turret.name: Laser Turret
Laser Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Lava Charm.name: Lava Charm
Lava Charm.desc: The Lava Charm is an accessory that grants immunity to lava for 7 seconds. It is found in Chests located in the cavern layer as well as obtained from Hellstone Crates and Obsidian Crates with a 1/20 chance.
Lava Charm.tip: Provides 7 seconds of immunity to lava

Lava Moss Brick.name: Lava Moss Brick
Lava Moss Brick.desc: Lava Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Lava Moss that glows in the dark when placed. It will always glow with the same coloration regardless of the paint that is applied to it.

Lava Moss.name: Lava Moss
Lava Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Lava Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Lead Tomahawk.name: Lead Tomahawk
Lead Tomahawk.desc: The Lead Tomahawk is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is the direct counterpart to the Iron Francisca. It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground.
Lead Tomahawk.tip: The tomahawks have more damage for a short time when initially thrown · Stealth strikes pierce up to 6 times

Lead Bar.name: Lead Bar
Lead Bar.desc: The Lead Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Leather.name: Leather
Leather.desc: Leather is a crafting material that is used to create the Archaeologist's Jacket and the Archaeologist's Pants. It is made using Rotten Chunks, a material only obtainable in Corruption worlds.

Blade Staff.name: Blade Staff
Blade Staff.desc: The Blade Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons an Enchanted Dagger minion. It flies towards enemies and slashes through them repeatedly at a fast pace. It also has 25 armor penetration.
Blade Staff.tip: Summons an Enchanted Dagger to fight for you · Ignores 25 points of enemy Defense · Hits quickly at the expense of 33% tag damage · 'Don't let their small size fool you'

Plantation Staff.name: Plantation Staff
Plantation Staff.desc: The Plantation Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a miniature Plantera minion that cycles between 3 attacks. It starts out by firing thorn balls that stick to enemies and hit twice, then rapidly fires seeds at enemies.
Plantation Staff.tip: Summons a miniature Plantera to devastate enemies with floral fury · There can only be one Mini Plantera at a time

Bouncy Grenade.name: Bouncy Grenade
Bouncy Grenade.desc: The Bouncy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon made of Pink Gel and Grenades. Instead of rolling or sticking in place upon contact with tiles, it will bounce and retain much of its momentum.
Bouncy Grenade.tip: A small explosion that will not destroy tiles · Very bouncy

Lemon.name: Lemon
Lemon.desc: The Lemon is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Lemon.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'When life gives you lemons...'

Lesser Luck Potion.name: Lesser Luck Potion
Lesser Luck Potion.desc: The Luck Potions are three types of buff potions which grant the Lucky buff, increasing the player's luck.
Lesser Luck Potion.tip: Increases the Luck of the user

Leviathan and Anahita (Lore).name: Leviathan and Anahita (Lore)
Leviathan and Anahita (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Leviathan and Anahita (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Leviathan Trophy.name: Leviathan Trophy
Leviathan Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Healing Potion.name: Healing Potion
Healing Potion.desc: The Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 100 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

Life Fruit.name: Life Fruit
Life Fruit.desc: The Life Fruit is a Hardmode plant and permanent booster item that grows on Jungle grass in any area within the Underground layer or below, and only after any mechanical boss has been defeated. Life Fruit grow 25% faster on average in Expert Mode.

Lifeforce Potion.name: Lifeforce Potion
Lifeforce Potion.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details).

Lifeform Analyzer.name: Lifeform Analyzer
Lifeform Analyzer.desc: The Lifeform Analyzer is an informational accessory that displays the name of rare enemies, critters, and undiscovered NPCs (see list below) within 81.25 tiles around the player.
Lifeform Analyzer.tip: Displays the name of rare creatures around you

Lifehunt Scythe.name: Lifehunt Scythe
Lifehunt Scythe.desc: The Lifehunt Scythe is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When swung, it fires a short-range projectile that damages enemies on contact, piercing twice before dissipating on the third hit or after 4 seconds.
Lifehunt Scythe.tip: Heals you on hit and shoots an energy scythe

Light God's Brilliance.name: Light God's Brilliance
Light God's Brilliance.desc: Light God's Brilliance is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome. When used, it rapidly fires a spray of light beads along with light balls.
Light God's Brilliance.tip: Casts small, homing light beads along with explosive light balls

Abyssal Tome.name: Abyssal Tome
Abyssal Tome.desc: The Abyssal Tome is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it fires a slow-moving purple glob that passes through tiles and is not affected by gravity and will slowly decelerate before stopping in place.
Abyssal Tome.tip: Casts a slow-moving ball of dark energy

Shadecrystal Barrage.name: Shadecrystal Barrage
Shadecrystal Barrage.desc: The Shadecrystal Barrage is a craftable Hardmode spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Crystal Storm. When used, it fires two bursts of six inaccurate storm of shadecrystals which pause in between them and inflict the Frostbite debuff.
Shadecrystal Barrage.tip: Summons bursts of shadecrystals that can home in on enemies

Lucrecia.name: Lucrecia
Lucrecia.desc: The Lucrecia is a craftable Hardmode special sword that autoswings. When used, it swings back and forth in front of the player, firing a darklight shard that pierces infinitely but cannot pass through tiles with each swing.
Lucrecia.tip: Fires a spiraling darklight shard when swung · Hits with the blade itself build Darklight Energy · Darklight Energy is lost over time if it has not been gained for a few seconds · Press Right Click with maximum energy to fire a double helix comet

Starlight.name: Starlight
Starlight.desc: The Starlight is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shortsword that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. When used, it rapidly emits short-range light beams that pierce infinitely. It also has a base critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Stohne.name: Stohne
Stohne.desc: Stohne is a Hardmode block that is dropped by Bohldohrs. It is used as a renewable source of Lihzahrd Bricks.

Lime Coral.name: Lime Coral
Lime Coral.desc: Lime Coral is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates.

Limestone.name: Limestone
Limestone.desc: Limestone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Basalt into Shimmer.

Limestone Wall.name: Limestone Wall
Limestone Wall.desc: Limestone Wall is a background wall crafted with Limestone at a Work Bench.

Little E.name: Little E
Little E.desc: The Little E is a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user into an anthropomorphic letter. It can be obtained by throwing an 'E' Statue into Shimmer.
Little E.tip: 'That's a little version of me,. I want you to have it.'

'E' Statue.name: 'E' Statue
'E' Statue.desc: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire—depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies, drop items, or teleport an NPC to the statue's location.

Living Brimstone Fire Block.name: Living Brimstone Fire Block
Living Brimstone Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are craftable Hardmode furniture blocks that resemble small, animated flames and emit a faint light when placed. They deal no damage on contact and can be broken with any pickaxe. The Calamity Mod currently adds four types of Living Fire Blocks to the game.

Living God Slayer Fire Block.name: Living God Slayer Fire Block
Living God Slayer Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are craftable Hardmode furniture blocks that resemble small, animated flames and emit a faint light when placed. They deal no damage on contact and can be broken with any pickaxe. The Calamity Mod currently adds four types of Living Fire Blocks to the game.

Living Holy Fire Block.name: Living Holy Fire Block
Living Holy Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are craftable Hardmode furniture blocks that resemble small, animated flames and emit a faint light when placed. They deal no damage on contact and can be broken with any pickaxe. The Calamity Mod currently adds four types of Living Fire Blocks to the game.

Living Plague Fire Block.name: Living Plague Fire Block
Living Plague Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are craftable Hardmode furniture blocks that resemble small, animated flames and emit a faint light when placed. They deal no damage on contact and can be broken with any pickaxe. The Calamity Mod currently adds four types of Living Fire Blocks to the game.

Living Shard Dye.name: Living Shard Dye
Living Shard Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Long Ranged Sensor Array.name: Long Ranged Sensor Array
Long Ranged Sensor Array.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Luck Potion.name: Luck Potion
Luck Potion.desc: The Luck Potions are three types of buff potions which grant the Lucky buff, increasing the player's luck.
Luck Potion.tip: Increases the Luck of the user

Lucky Horseshoe.name: Lucky Horseshoe
Lucky Horseshoe.desc: The Lucky Horseshoe is an accessory that primarily negates fall damage. The Lucky Horseshoe has a 1/4 chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 chance of being obtained from Sky Crates and Azure Crates.
Lucky Horseshoe.tip: Negates fall damage · 'Said to bring good fortune and keep evil spirits at bay'

Luminite.name: Luminite
Luminite.desc: Luminite is a Hardmode ore dropped by the Moon Lord in stacks of 70–90 (90–110). It does not naturally generate in the world, and can be mined using any pickaxe.

Lunar Kunai.name: Lunar Kunai
Lunar Kunai.desc: The Lunar Kunai is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger. When used, it throws 3 gravity-ignoring lunar kunai that slightly home in on enemies and do not pierce.
Lunar Kunai.tip: Throws out a set of three kunai that ignore gravity and slightly home in on enemies · After traveling enough distance, the kunai supercharge with lunar energy, homing in far more aggressively and exploding on impact · Stealth strikes instantly throw ten supercharged Kunai

Lunarian Bow.name: Lunarian Bow
Lunarian Bow.desc: The Lunarian Bow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow that auto-fires. When used, it fires two arrows at once.
Lunarian Bow.tip: Fires two arrows at once · Converts wooden arrows into sliding energy bolts

Demon Bow.name: Demon Bow
Demon Bow.desc: The Demon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Molten Fury.name: Molten Fury
Molten Fury.desc: The Molten Fury is a pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows, causing them to inflict the On Fire! debuff on hit.

The Bee's Knees.name: The Bee's Knees
The Bee's Knees.desc: The Bee's Knees is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into a line of Bee Arrows.
The Bee's Knees.tip: Wooden arrows turn into a column of bees

Lunic Corps Boots.name: Lunic Corps Boots
Lunic Corps Boots.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set.
Lunic Corps Boots.tip: 7% increased ranged critical strike chance · 15% increased movement speed and acceleration

Lunic Corps Helmet.name: Lunic Corps Helmet
Lunic Corps Helmet.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set.
Lunic Corps Helmet.tip: Increases non-bow ranged damage by 15% · Improves vision and shows the location of enemies

Night Vision Helmet.name: Night Vision Helmet
Night Vision Helmet.desc: The Night Vision Helmet is an armor piece for the helmet slot. For the player wearing it, it increases the apparent light level provided by all light sources on the screen, similarly to the Night Owl buff.

Lunic Corps Vest.name: Lunic Corps Vest
Lunic Corps Vest.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set.
Lunic Corps Vest.tip: 15% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · 25% chance to save ammo

Rover Drive.name: Rover Drive
Rover Drive.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability.
Rover Drive.tip: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator

Mad Alchemist's Cocktail Glove.name: Mad Alchemist's Cocktail Glove
Mad Alchemist's Cocktail Glove.desc: The Mad Alchemist's Cocktail Glove is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it fires flasks of various colors, with each color having a unique on-hit effect. The colors are thrown in order.
Mad Alchemist's Cocktail Glove.tip: Fires a variety of high-velocity flasks · Press Right Click to throw a prismatic flask that inflicts Elemental Mix · Red flasks explode violently · Blue flasks contain poison gas · Green flasks summon lunar flares · Purple flasks explode into homing shrapnel

Toxic Flask.name: Toxic Flask
Toxic Flask.desc: The Toxic Flask is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that has a 1/40 / 79/1600 chance of being dropped by Dr. Man Flies during the Solar Eclipse event.

Magenta Coral.name: Magenta Coral
Magenta Coral.desc: Magenta Coral is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates.

Magic Conch.name: Magic Conch
Magic Conch.desc: The Magic Conch is a tool that teleports the player to the Ocean that is furthest away from them, 0.75 (45 ticks) after being used. Like the Magic Mirror and Demon Conch, it can be used an unlimited amount of times.
Magic Conch.tip: If you listen closely, you can hear the ocean

Shell Pile.name: Shell Pile
Shell Pile.desc: Shell Piles are a decorative block found naturally in the Ocean biome in large clumps. They are affected by gravity and will fall if supporting blocks are removed, dealing damage to any player or enemy they land on. They can also be found in Ocean Crates or in Seaside Crates.

Magic Power Potion.name: Magic Power Potion
Magic Power Potion.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%.

Magnetic Meltdown.name: Magnetic Meltdown
Magnetic Meltdown.desc: The Magnetic Meltdown is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Magnet Sphere. When used, it fires 4 tile-ignoring purple magnetic orbs in a diamond cross shape that move out a short distance before stopping.
Magnetic Meltdown.tip: Launches a diamond cross of supercharged magnet spheres

Magnet Sphere.name: Magnet Sphere
Magnet Sphere.desc: The Magnet Sphere is a Hardmode, post-Plantera spell book that has a 1/300 / 599/90000 chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Rusty Armored Bones, and Hell Armored Bones in the post-Plantera Dungeon.

Magnomaly Cannon.name: Magnomaly Cannon
Magnomaly Cannon.desc: The Magnomaly Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a homing exo rocket with an invisible damaging aura. Upon enemy hits, it creates a large explosion and splits into 8 exo beams that travel in every direction. Both projectiles can pass through tiles.
Magnomaly Cannon.tip: Launches a powerful exo rocket to nuke anything and everything with Miracle Blight · Rockets are surrounded by an invisible damaging aura and split into damaging beams on hit · 50% chance to save ammo

Electrosphere Launcher.name: Electrosphere Launcher
Electrosphere Launcher.desc: The Electrosphere Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Scorched Earth.name: Scorched Earth
Scorched Earth.desc: The Scorched Earth is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a burst of four homing rockets which can travel through tiles.
Scorched Earth.tip: Fires a burst of four heat seeking missiles that rapidly accelerate after a short delay · All rockets explode into napalm cluster bombs on impact · 50% chance to save ammo · 'Burns your targets to a fine crisp'

The Pack.name: The Pack
