The Pack.desc: The Pack is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a large rocket that can pass through tiles. The rocket can also home in on enemies, but not through tiles.
The Pack.tip: Fires large homing rockets that explode into more homing mini rockets when in proximity to an enemy

Gold Broadsword.name: Gold Broadsword
Gold Broadsword.desc: The Gold Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Mana Regeneration Potion.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
Mana Regeneration Potion.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates.

Mana Crystal.name: Mana Crystal
Mana Crystal.desc: The Mana Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's maximum mana by 20, up to a maximum of 200 total. It takes 9 Mana Crystals to reach this maximum.

Nature's Gift.name: Nature's Gift
Nature's Gift.desc: Nature's Gift is an accessory that reduces the mana cost of using magic weapons and other mana-consuming items by 6%. It is acquired by harvesting a rare flower that grows on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, using any weapon or tool.

Mangrove Chakram.name: Mangrove Chakram
Mangrove Chakram.desc: The Mangrove Chakram is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a chakram that inflicts the Acid Venom debuff and it can be thrown an unlimited number of times.
Mangrove Chakram.tip: Stealth strikes leave a trail of lingering flowers

Manhattan.name: Manhattan
Manhattan.desc: Manhattan is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Manhattan debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted cold-related debuffs by 50% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted water-related debuffs by 50%.
Manhattan.tip: 50% increased Cold debuff damage · 50% decreased Water debuff damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Margarita.name: Margarita
Margarita.desc: Margarita is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Margarita debuff, which halves the duration of most debuffs inflicted onto the player, but decreases the damage per second of all player-inflicted debuffs by 50%.
Margarita.tip: Halves the duration of most harmful debuffs · Reduces damage of debuffs you inflict by 50% · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver · 3 minute duration

Mark of Providence.name: Mark of Providence
Mark of Providence.desc: The Mark of Providence is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is also dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It is used to summon three bosses at various locations in the world. Depending on the location it is used in, a different boss will be summoned:
Mark of Providence.tip: An ornate sigil of the Profaned Flame · Hatred yet burns upon its brow · Such power attracts otherworldly beings · Not consumable

Marksman Bow.name: Marksman Bow
Marksman Bow.desc: The Marksman Bow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Jester's Arrows. All ammunition is fired in spreads of three, each with a varying velocity.
Marksman Bow.tip: Fires three arrows at once · Wooden arrows are converted into Jester's arrows

Marksman Round.name: Marksman Round
Marksman Round.desc: Marksman Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They cannot go through tiles nor pierce enemies but are able to collide with tossed coins fired by the Crackshot Colt or Midas Prime.
Marksman Round.tip: A carefully crafted round which can ricochet off of coins · This allows other guns to utilize coins tossed by Crackshot Colt and Midas Prime

Gold Coin.name: Gold Coin
Gold Coin.desc: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria, primarily used for transactions with NPCs. They are obtained by killing enemies, selling items to or interacting with NPCs, or finding them in multiple forms of loot.

Golden Bullet.name: Golden Bullet
Golden Bullet.desc: The Golden Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It inflicts the Midas debuff on hit for 2 seconds, causing enemies to drop 10%-50% more coins when killed.
Golden Bullet.tip: Enemies killed will drop more money

Marnite Architect Headgear.name: Marnite Architect Headgear
Marnite Architect Headgear.desc: Marnite Architect armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode builder armor set.
Marnite Architect Headgear.tip: Increases block placement & tool range by 5

Marble Block.name: Marble Block
Marble Block.desc: The Marble Block is a natural block found in Marble Caves. It can be crafted into Smooth Marble Blocks in order to craft the Marble-themed furniture set.

Marnite Architect Toga.name: Marnite Architect Toga
Marnite Architect Toga.desc: Marnite Architect armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode builder armor set.
Marnite Architect Toga.tip: Increases block & wall placement speed by 50%

Marnite Bathtub.name: Marnite Bathtub
Marnite Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Polished Marnite Block.name: Polished Marnite Block
Polished Marnite Block.desc: Polished Marnite Block is a craftable block crafted with Marble Blocks, Granite Blocks, and Any Gold Ore at a Work Bench. It is used to make the Marnite furniture set.

Marnite Bed.name: Marnite Bed
Marnite Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Bookcase.name: Marnite Bookcase
Marnite Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Candelabra.name: Marnite Candelabra
Marnite Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Candle.name: Marnite Candle
Marnite Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Marnite Chair.name: Marnite Chair
Marnite Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Marnite Chandelier.name: Marnite Chandelier
Marnite Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Chest.name: Marnite Chest
Marnite Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Marnite Clock.name: Marnite Clock
Marnite Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Deconstructor.name: Marnite Deconstructor
Marnite Deconstructor.desc: The Marnite Deconstructor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hammer. When used, it casts a ray similarly to the Laser Drill, gaining a bonus reach of 7 tiles. The hammer has an innate 10 armor penetration.
Marnite Deconstructor.tip: Its engine generates hardlight rays capable of excavating walls from a long distance · Ignores 10 points of enemy Defense

Marnite Door.name: Marnite Door
Marnite Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Dresser.name: Marnite Dresser
Marnite Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Lamp.name: Marnite Lamp
Marnite Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Lantern.name: Marnite Lantern
Marnite Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Obliterator.name: Marnite Obliterator
Marnite Obliterator.desc: The Marnite Obliterator is a craftable Pre-Hardmode drill that is capable of mining blocks up to Obsidian, Crimtane Ore / Demonite Ore and Sea Prism. When used, it casts a ray similarly to the Laser Drill, gaining a bonus reach of 7 tiles.
Marnite Obliterator.tip: Uses a diamond focus to project a long-range digging beam of light · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense

Marnite Organ.name: Marnite Organ
Marnite Organ.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Repulsion Shield.name: Marnite Repulsion Shield
Marnite Repulsion Shield.desc: The Marnite Repulsion Shield is a craftable Pre-Hardmode shield accessory. While equipped, it grants +2 defense and causes players to release short-range energy sparks behind them that constantly damage enemies.
Marnite Repulsion Shield.tip: Enemies behind you are struck by high-knockback hardlight quills · Backstabbers Beware!

Marnite Sink.name: Marnite Sink
Marnite Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Sofa.name: Marnite Sofa
Marnite Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Marnite Table.name: Marnite Table
Marnite Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Marnite Toilet.name: Marnite Toilet
Marnite Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Marnite Work Bench.name: Marnite Work Bench
Marnite Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Mechanical Eye.name: Mechanical Eye
Mechanical Eye.desc: The Mechanical Eye is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons The Twins when used. It can be used in any biome, but only at night.

Mechanical Skull.name: Mechanical Skull
Mechanical Skull.desc: The Mechanical Skull is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons Skeletron Prime when used. It can be used in any biome, but only at night.

Mechanical Worm.name: Mechanical Worm
Mechanical Worm.desc: The Mechanical Worm is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons The Destroyer when used. It can be used in any biome, but only at night.

Rotten Chunk.name: Rotten Chunk
Rotten Chunk.desc: The Rotten Chunk is a crafting material that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped from Eaters of Souls, Devourers, Corruptors, and the Eater of Worlds.

Megalodon.name: Megalodon
Megalodon.desc: The Megalodon is a craftable Hardmode gun that is an upgrade to the Megashark and the Archerfish. When used, it loads a magazine of 30 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and pressurized water jets that pierce once and inflict the Riptide debuff.
Megalodon.tip: Loads a 30 round magazine of bullets and pressurized water jets that are rapidly unleashed · After firing, the gun unleashes a powerful homing rocket before reloading · Rocket damage is based on how many shots hit · 50% chance to save ammo

Archerfish.name: Archerfish
Archerfish.desc: The Archerfish is a Pre-Hardmode gun that is found in the Ancient Treasure Chests within the Abyss. When used, it converts Musket Balls into bubbly streams of water that pierce once and inflict the Riptide and Wet debuffs.
Archerfish.tip: Converts musket balls into streams of water · 33% chance to save ammo

Megashark.name: Megashark
Megashark.desc: The Megashark is a Hardmode, post-The Destroyer gun and the direct upgrade to the Minishark. When used, it fires bullets very rapidly in a small spread. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.
Megashark.tip: 50% chance to save ammo · 'Minishark's older brother'

Metal Monstrosity.name: Metal Monstrosity
Metal Monstrosity.desc: The Metal Monstrosity is a craftable Pre-Hardmode non-consumable spiky ball. It throws a heavy gravity-affected metal ball that breaks upon hitting a tile or enemy.
Metal Monstrosity.tip: Hurls a heavy metal ball that shatters into shards and spiky balls on impact · Stealth strikes cause the ball to impale hit enemies, piercing them with extra shards when it breaks · 'This has to hurt'

Spike.name: Spike
Spike.desc: The Spike is a trap that can be found in the Dungeon. Upon contact, it deals 60 damage to the player, on all difficulties, and inflicts the Bleeding debuff for 10 / 20 / seconds. It can be broken with a pickaxe, drill, or explosives.

Spiky Ball.name: Spiky Ball
Spiky Ball.desc: The Spiky Ball is a consumable ranged weapon that is primarily used as a passive trap by tossing them to the ground, where enemies who pass over them will take damage up to 7 times (after which the Spiky Balls vanish).

Metastasis.name: Metastasis
Metastasis.desc: The Metastasis is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon, and the exhumed form of the Void Eater Marionette. When used, it summons a full-sized Sepulcher that follows the player.
Metastasis.tip: Summons a Sepulcher to fight for you · While the Sepulcher is active, brimstone hearts will begin to appear and orbit you · When too many hearts are present, it will interrupt attacking to attack the hearts instead · This happens more frequently depending on how many hearts are present · Can only be summoned once

Meteor Fist.name: Meteor Fist
Meteor Fist.desc: The Meteor Fist is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it releases a rocket fist which connects to the player via a wire. After 1 second, the fist begins to accelerate and home towards the cursor's position, leaving a fiery trail behind it.
Meteor Fist.tip: Fires a wired-guided rocket fist that seeks the cursor and accelerates over time · Stealth strikes immediately start accelerating and drop a meteorite on the struck enemy

Meteor Staff.name: Meteor Staff
Meteor Staff.desc: The Meteor Staff is a Hardmode wand. When used, it rapidly summons meteors from the sky which fall in the direction of the cursor and explode upon impact with an enemy or block.

Meteorite.name: Meteorite
Meteorite.desc: Meteorite is a pre-Hardmode ore typically mined from Meteorite crash sites. It also spawns in high numbers during a Meteor Shower and rarely drops from Meteor Heads.
Meteorite.tip: Burns you when touched without special protection

Miasma.name: Miasma
Miasma.desc: The Miasma is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a random spread of 3 to 5 fast gas clouds that slow down when they hit an enemy, eventually stopping in place. After being stationary for a short time, the clouds dissipate into dust.
Miasma.tip: Fires a spread of gas clouds that slow down after hitting an enemy

Midnight Sun Beacon.name: Midnight Sun Beacon
Midnight Sun Beacon.desc: The Midnight Sun Beacon is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is the direct upgrade to the Xeno Staff and the Lunar Portal Staff. When used, it throws out a Midnight Sun Beacon that summons a Midnight Sun UFO after a few seconds.
Midnight Sun Beacon.tip: Summons a UFO to vaporize enemies

Xeno Staff.name: Xeno Staff
Xeno Staff.desc: The Xeno Staff is a Hardmode, post-Golem summon weapon that summons a UFO minion. It hovers above enemies, firing blue lasers that hit the target instantaneously. If an enemy is 18.75 to 50 tiles away, it will instantly teleport above it.
Xeno Staff.tip: Summons a UFO to fight for you

Mineral Mortar.name: Mineral Mortar
Mineral Mortar.desc: The Mineral Mortar is a craftable Hardmode launcher. When used, it charges up and converts all rockets into fast onyx bombs that are affected by gravity and create large explosions on contact.
Mineral Mortar.tip: Shoots an onyx bomb that explodes into huge area damage · Uses rockets for ammo

Mini Aged Biolight.name: Mini Aged Biolight
Mini Aged Biolight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Biolight.name: Mini Caged Biolight
Mini Caged Biolight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Blacklight.name: Mini Aged Blacklight
Mini Aged Blacklight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Blacklight.name: Mini Caged Blacklight
Mini Caged Blacklight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Cinderlight.name: Mini Aged Cinderlight
Mini Aged Cinderlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Cinderlight.name: Mini Caged Cinderlight
Mini Caged Cinderlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Flamelight.name: Mini Aged Flamelight
Mini Aged Flamelight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Flamelight.name: Mini Caged Flamelight
Mini Caged Flamelight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Floodlight.name: Mini Aged Floodlight
Mini Aged Floodlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Floodlight.name: Mini Caged Floodlight
Mini Caged Floodlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Frostlight.name: Mini Aged Frostlight
Mini Aged Frostlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Frostlight.name: Mini Caged Frostlight
Mini Caged Frostlight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Aged Lablight.name: Mini Aged Lablight
Mini Aged Lablight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Caged Lablight.name: Mini Caged Lablight
Mini Caged Lablight.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Mini Nuke I.name: Mini Nuke I
Mini Nuke I.desc: The Mini Nuke I is a type of rocket ammunition. Unlike the Mini Nuke II, it does not destroy tiles. It is a direct upgrade to the Rocket III, dealing more damage over a larger blast radius, but with lower knockback.
Mini Nuke I.tip: Huge blast radius. Will not destroy tiles

Rocket III.name: Rocket III
Rocket III.desc: Rockets are a Hardmode, post-Plantera type of ammunition which are mainly sold by the Cyborg. The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.
Rocket III.tip: Large blast radius. Will not destroy tiles

Mini Nuke II.name: Mini Nuke II
Mini Nuke II.desc: The Mini Nuke II is a type of rocket ammunition. Unlike the Mini Nuke I, it destroys tiles. It is a direct upgrade to the Rocket IV, dealing more damage over a larger blast radius, but with lower knockback.
Mini Nuke II.tip: Huge blast radius. Will destroy tiles

Rocket IV.name: Rocket IV
Rocket IV.desc: Rockets are a Hardmode, post-Plantera type of ammunition which are mainly sold by the Cyborg. The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.
Rocket IV.tip: Large blast radius. Will destroy tiles

Mining Potion.name: Mining Potion
Mining Potion.desc: The Mining Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mining buff when consumed. The buff increases mining speed by 25%.

Miracle Fruit.name: Miracle Fruit
Miracle Fruit.desc: The Miracle Fruit is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Tainted Cloudberry, and the Sacred Strawberry.
Miracle Fruit.tip: Permanently increases maximum life by 25 · Can only be used once and requires the max amount of Life Fruits consumed · Refreshing and cool, perhaps even a bit minty

Magic Mirror.name: Magic Mirror
Magic Mirror.desc: The Magic Mirror is a pre-Hardmode tool. When used, it plays an animation before teleporting the player to their spawn point.
Magic Mirror.tip: Gaze in the mirror to return home

Mirror of Kalandra.name: Mirror of Kalandra
Mirror of Kalandra.desc: The Mirror of Kalandra is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons the following weapons respectively: Atziri's Disfavor, Starforge, Paradoxica, Wind Ripper, and Hope Shredder. Only 1 of each weapon can be summoned at a time, each taking up 1 minion slot.
Mirror of Kalandra.tip: Summons five ancient weapons to annihilate your enemies · There can only be one of each individual weapon · Atziri's Disfavor brutally cleaves through enemies · Starforge rips through foes and occasionally induces cosmic explosions · Paradoxica teleports to enemies and blitzes through them at high speed · Wind Ripper unleashes a single high-speed, powerful arrow at enemies · Hope Shredder shoots arrows that split into three and pierce enemies twice · 'Ultimate, Immeasurable, Indescribable'

Mistlestorm.name: Mistlestorm
Mistlestorm.desc: The Mistlestorm is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Razorpine and the Leaf Blower. When used, it rapidly fires 2-4 pine needles and leaves in a random spread.
Mistlestorm.tip: Casts a storm of pine needles and leaves

Leaf Blower.name: Leaf Blower
Leaf Blower.desc: The Leaf Blower is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it rapidly fires a spread of leaf projectiles that begin swirling after traveling for about 15 tiles, and move in a spiral circle pattern while gradually fading away.

Razorpine.name: Razorpine
Razorpine.desc: The Razorpine is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

MOAB.name: MOAB
MOAB.desc: The MOAB is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
MOAB.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.25 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Good · Hold Up to boost faster! · 32% increased jump speed and allows auto-jump · Grants the player cloud, blizzard, and sandstorm mid-air jumps · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Jetpack jetpack · 'The Mother Of All Balloons'

Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.
Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons.tip: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Jetpack.name: Jetpack
Jetpack.desc: The Jetpack is a Hardmode wing-type accessory obtainable after defeating any mechanical boss. Like all wings, it grants the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, it allows traveling at 33 horizontally and 38 vertically.
Jetpack.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Hold Up to boost faster!

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Mollusk Shelleggings.name: Mollusk Shelleggings
Mollusk Shelleggings.desc: Mollusk armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Mollusk Husks and Sea Prisms.
Mollusk Shelleggings.tip: 6% increased damage and 4% increased critical strike chance · Your horizontal movement is slowed

Mollusk Shellmet.name: Mollusk Shellmet
Mollusk Shellmet.desc: Mollusk armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Mollusk Husks and Sea Prisms.
Mollusk Shellmet.tip: 5% increased damage and 4% increased critical strike chance · You can move freely through liquids · Your horizontal movement is slowed

Mollusk Shellplate.name: Mollusk Shellplate
Mollusk Shellplate.desc: Mollusk armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Mollusk Husks and Sea Prisms.
Mollusk Shellplate.tip: 6% increased damage and 5% increased critical strike chance · Your horizontal movement is slowed

Molten Pyre Mantle.name: Molten Pyre Mantle
Molten Pyre Mantle.desc: Molten Pyre Mantle is a block that generates in small veins in the third layer of the Abyss. It requires at least an Adamantite, Titanium, or Shardlight Pickaxe to mine.

Money Trough.name: Money Trough
Money Trough.desc: The Money Trough is a portable storage item that temporarily summons a flying pet-like version of the Piggy Bank. The Money Trough enables players to access the contents of their Piggy Bank without having to manually place the Piggy Bank or any furniture for it to rest on.
Money Trough.tip: Summons a flying piggy bank · Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops

Piggy Bank.name: Piggy Bank
Piggy Bank.desc: The Piggy Bank is a portable storage item which can be purchased from the Merchant for. It requires a flat-surface item for placement. It has 40 slots like other storage items. The Piggy Bank inventory can also be accessed via the Money Trough and Eye Bone.
Piggy Bank.tip: Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops

Monolith Amalgam.name: Monolith Amalgam
Monolith Amalgam.desc: The Monolith Amalgam is a Hardmode furniture item.

Monolith Bathtub.name: Monolith Bathtub
Monolith Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Bed.name: Monolith Bed
Monolith Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Bench.name: Monolith Bench
Monolith Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Monolith Bookcase.name: Monolith Bookcase
Monolith Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Bow.name: Monolith Bow
Monolith Bow.desc: The Monolith Bow is a craftable Hardmode bow. Upon using the item, a flurry of four arrows is released while only consuming one arrow.

Monolith Candelabra.name: Monolith Candelabra
Monolith Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Candle.name: Monolith Candle
Monolith Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Monolith Chair.name: Monolith Chair
Monolith Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Monolith Chandelier.name: Monolith Chandelier
Monolith Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Chest.name: Monolith Chest
Monolith Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Monolith Clock.name: Monolith Clock
Monolith Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Crate.name: Monolith Crate
Monolith Crate.desc: The Monolith Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Astral Infection. The crate contains a pet item and items found in standard crates. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Astral Crate.

Astral Crate.name: Astral Crate
Astral Crate.desc: The Astral Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Astral Infection. The crate contains several items based originally in the Astral Infection. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Monolith Crate.

Monolith Door.name: Monolith Door
Monolith Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Dresser.name: Monolith Dresser
Monolith Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Hammer.name: Monolith Hammer
Monolith Hammer.desc: The Monolith Hammer is a craftable Hardmode hammer.

Monolith Lamp.name: Monolith Lamp
Monolith Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Lantern.name: Monolith Lantern
Monolith Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith of the Accursed.name: Monolith of the Accursed
Monolith of the Accursed.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Monolith Piano.name: Monolith Piano
Monolith Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Sink.name: Monolith Sink
Monolith Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Sword.name: Monolith Sword
Monolith Sword.desc: The Monolith Sword is a craftable Hardmode broadsword. It has an incredibly fast use time, swinging much more frequently than most other broadswords. When swung, it has a smear effect which expands the sword's reach, which can be either orange or teal in color.

Monolith Table.name: Monolith Table
Monolith Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Monolith Work Bench.name: Monolith Work Bench
Monolith Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Tsunami.name: Tsunami
Tsunami.desc: The Tsunami is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it fires a volley of five parallel arrows, consuming one arrow per use.

Lesser Healing Potion.name: Lesser Healing Potion
Lesser Healing Potion.desc: The Lesser Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 50 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

Throwing Knife.name: Throwing Knife
Throwing Knife.desc: The Throwing Knife is a consumable ranged weapon. It can be purchased from the Merchant during a Blood Moon for each and may also be found in Chests. The Throwing Knife is greatly affected by gravity and arcs similarly to Shurikens and Bones.

Moon Walkers.name: Moon Walkers
Moon Walkers.desc: Moon Walkers are a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Angel Treads. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Moon Walkers.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Angel Wings wings · 'Hee hee!'

Moonshine.name: Moonshine
Moonshine.desc: Moonshine is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Moonshine debuff, which increases max health by 25%, but forces all hits to deal at least 50% of defense in defense damage and makes defense damage take three times as long to recover.
Moonshine.tip: Increases maximum health by 25% · Attacks always take at least half of your defense worth in defense damage · Defense damage takes three times as long to recover · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Moonstone Crown.name: Moonstone Crown
Moonstone Crown.desc: The Moonstone Crown is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Feather Crown. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Moonstone Crown.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Summons a Lunar Sigil every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 · Each Lunar Sigil increases magic damage by 2% and reduces mana cost by 1% · With 5 sigils, increases mana regeneration by +5 MP/s · With 10 sigils, increases magic critical strike chance by 10% and all magic attacks inflict Nightwither · Running out of mana or using a mana potion shatters all sigils · Upon shattering a sigil, no new sigils can appear for 5 seconds · Sigils are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled · Hold Shift for moreCountless tears were shed over Chrysadia's marring: when its eventide clouds gave way not to beloved stars, · or to dear patrons, but to a ravenous void and its unyielding dread.

Mortar Round.name: Mortar Round
Mortar Round.desc: Mortar Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They can be used by any gun that does not shoot custom bullets. Upon impact, they create a large explosion that is able to destroy tiles.
Mortar Round.tip: Specialized high explosive rounds · Large blast radius. Will destroy tiles · Used by normal guns

Explosive Powder.name: Explosive Powder
Explosive Powder.desc: Explosive Powder is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Demolitionist for each, once the Wall of Flesh has been defeated. It is solely used to make Exploding Bullets, an ammo type with strong knockback.

Moscow Mule.name: Moscow Mule
Moscow Mule.desc: Moscow Mule is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Moscow Mule debuff, which provides the following effects:
Moscow Mule.tip: 50% increased knockback, all attacks inflict heavy knockback · Reduces the effectiveness of piercing weapons · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Titan Heart.name: Titan Heart
Titan Heart.desc: The Titan Heart is a Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by Atlases. It is used to craft the Titan Heart armor set and summon Astrum Deus when interacting (right-click) with the Astral Beacon.
Titan Heart.tip: Can be offered up at the Astral Beacon

Mossy Stone.name: Mossy Stone
Mossy Stone.desc: Mossy Stone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Limestone into Shimmer.

Mounted Scanner.name: Mounted Scanner
Mounted Scanner.desc: The Mounted Scanner is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a floating machine that surrounds the player. When an enemy is nearby, the machine fires red laser beams at them every 2.08 seconds.
Mounted Scanner.tip: Summons a powerful scanner module above your head that fires lasers at nearby enemies

Solar Eruption.name: Solar Eruption
Solar Eruption.desc: The Solar Eruption is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist melee weapon that swings a long whipsword from the player's position towards the cursor. The whipsword sweeps in a narrow arc of varying length before quickly retracting. It can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely.
Solar Eruption.tip: 'Strike with the fury of the sun'

Muramasa.name: Muramasa
Muramasa.desc: The Muramasa is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron broadsword that has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes. When swung, it creates a blue slash upon enemy hits.

Music Box.name: Music Box
Music Box.desc: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for. When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay.
Music Box.tip: Has a chance to record songs

Wood.name: Wood
Wood.desc: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw. Regular Wood can be harvested from Forest trees, vanity trees, Living Trees, and Underground Cabins in underground or cavern layers, as well as by using the Faecorn.
