Music Box (Plantera).name: Music Box (Plantera)
Music Box (Plantera).desc: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for. When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay.

Musket.name: Musket
Musket.desc: The Musket is a pre-Hardmode gun. It will always drop from the first Shadow Orb destroyed in a Corruption world (along with 100 Musket Balls) and has a 1/5 chance of dropping from destroyed Shadow Orbs afterward.
Musket.tip: 'I have to be ready, said the minuteman'

The Undertaker.name: The Undertaker
The Undertaker.desc: The Undertaker is a pre-Hardmode gun. It will always drop from the first Crimson Heart destroyed in a Crimson world (along with 100 Musket Balls) and has a 1/5 chance of dropping from destroyed Crimson Hearts afterward.

Mythril Knife.name: Mythril Knife
Mythril Knife.desc: The Mythril Knife is a craftable Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a knife that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Mythril Knife.tip: Stealth strikes are coated in deadly toxins, inflicting Irradiated, Poisoned, and Acid Venom

Mythril Bar.name: Mythril Bar
Mythril Bar.desc: The Mythril Bar is a Hardmode bar. It is one of the two ores able to create a Hardmode Anvil, which is used to craft most Hardmode equipment.

Nadir.name: Nadir
Nadir.desc: The Nadir is a craftable post-Moon Lord spear. When used, it attacks like a normal spear and fires void essences that deal 25% of the weapon's damage, travel through blocks, and home in on enemies.
Nadir.tip: Fires void essences which flay nearby enemies with tentacles · 'The abyss has stared back at you long enough. It now speaks, and it does not speak softly'

Vanishing Point.name: Vanishing Point
Vanishing Point.desc: The Vanishing Point is a craftable post-Moon Lord spear. When used, it fires one gravity-affected cyan beam that splits into more beams with similar properties. All beams travel for a long distance before being affected by gravity.
Vanishing Point.tip: Fires a lance beam that splits multiple times as it travels · 'Rend the cosmos asunder!'

Naiad's Warhorn.name: Naiad's Warhorn
Naiad's Warhorn.desc: The Naiad's Warhorn is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Leviathan and Anahita. It can only be used in the Ocean.
Naiad's Warhorn.tip: Summons Anahita when used in the Ocean · Enrages outside the Ocean · Not consumable · 'An instrument used by mermen to call upon Anahita. Its melody is oddly alluring.'

Laser Machinegun.name: Laser Machinegun
Laser Machinegun.desc: The Laser Machinegun is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it fires two inaccurate blue lasers that do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Nanoblack Reaper.name: Nanoblack Reaper
Nanoblack Reaper.desc: The Nanoblack Reaper is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang. It rapidly throws high velocity scythes at a massive range which can pass through tiles. Each scythe thrown summons tesselations that fire zero-point energy strikes with 150 armor penetration.
Nanoblack Reaper.tip: Throws a scythe which rapidly forms a swarm of nanoblack tesselations from hard light · Nanoblack tesselations each emit an instantaneous zero-point energy strike · Zero-point energy strikes have 150 armor penetration and will target bosses whenever possible · Release Left Click just as the scythe begins returning to carve through the enemy closest to your cursor at light speed · Light-speed carves have 150 armor penetration. If timed in a 4-frame window, they supercrit with +100% critical strike chance · Right Click with sufficient stealth to massively increase attack speed for a short time · Scythes thrown during flurries emit supercharged energy strikes but cannot be returned manually · 'She smothered them in Her hatred.' · Hold Shift for more'He who picks up the pen writes the script. · She has no intention of ever putting it down. · Her design eclipses your countable stars. · The gleam She exudes will put them all to shame.'

Ghoulish Gouger.name: Ghoulish Gouger
Ghoulish Gouger.desc: The Ghoulish Gouger is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it throws a set of four ghoulish scythes that go through tiles and return to the player after traveling a moderate distance.
Ghoulish Gouger.tip: Throws sets of four ghoulish scythes at ultra high velocity · Stealth strikes summon a flurry of tormented souls on hit

Nanotech.name: Nanotech
Nanotech.desc: The Nanotech is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue accessory that is a combination of the Rogue Emblem, Raider's Talisman, Vampiric Talisman, and Electrician's Glove. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Nanotech.tip: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

Vampiric Talisman.name: Vampiric Talisman
Vampiric Talisman.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health.
Vampiric Talisman.tip: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch, and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'

Nasty Cholla.name: Nasty Cholla
Nasty Cholla.desc: The Nasty Cholla is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spiky ball. It throws a gravity affected cactus ball that explodes into three to four cactus needles after landing, each dealing 1 damage. The cactus ball will stick to all blocks and enemies.
Nasty Cholla.tip: Throws a spiky ball that sticks to everything · Explodes into cactus spikes after roughly 3 seconds · Can hurt town NPCs · Stealth strikes throw four at once

Cactus.name: Cactus
Cactus.desc: Cactus is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Cactus plants, using an axe or chainsaw just like with trees. In addition to crafting, Cactus can be used as a building material.

Naughty Present.name: Naughty Present
Naughty Present.desc: The Naughty Present is a Hardmode, post-Plantera event-summoning item used to summon the Frost Moon event. It can only be used at night. Attempting to use it during the day will not begin the event, and the item will not be consumed from the player's inventory.

Navy Fishing Rod.name: Navy Fishing Rod
Navy Fishing Rod.desc: The Navy Fishing Rod is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing pole. While held with the bobber deployed, enemies near the player are slightly damaged, and emit damaging electric sparks, on short semi-random intervals.
Navy Fishing Rod.tip: Fires bobbers that inflict Static Discharge on nearby enemies · 'The sea is a city. · Just below are highways, boulevards, streets and roundabouts bustling with submarine traffic.'

Navyplate Wall.name: Navyplate Wall
Navyplate Wall.desc: Navyplate Walls is a background wall crafted with Navyplate.

Navystone Platform.name: Navystone Platform
Navystone Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Navystone Wall.name: Navystone Wall
Navystone Wall.desc: Navystone Wall is a background wall crafted with Navystone. It will not contribute to the creation of an artificial Sunken Sea biome.

Navystone Bathtub.name: Navystone Bathtub
Navystone Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Bed.name: Navystone Bed
Navystone Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Bookcase.name: Navystone Bookcase
Navystone Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Candelabra.name: Navystone Candelabra
Navystone Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Candle.name: Navystone Candle
Navystone Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Navystone Chair.name: Navystone Chair
Navystone Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Navystone Chandelier.name: Navystone Chandelier
Navystone Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Chest.name: Navystone Chest
Navystone Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Navystone Clock.name: Navystone Clock
Navystone Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Door.name: Navystone Door
Navystone Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Dresser.name: Navystone Dresser
Navystone Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Lamp.name: Navystone Lamp
Navystone Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Lantern.name: Navystone Lantern
Navystone Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Lyre.name: Navystone Lyre
Navystone Lyre.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Sink.name: Navystone Sink
Navystone Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Table.name: Navystone Table
Navystone Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Navystone Toilet.name: Navystone Toilet
Navystone Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Navystone Triclinium.name: Navystone Triclinium
Navystone Triclinium.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Unsafe Navystone Wall.name: Unsafe Navystone Wall
Unsafe Navystone Wall.desc: Unsafe Navystone Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall. It can be removed using any hammer.

Navystone Work Bench.name: Navystone Work Bench
Navystone Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Nebula Mantle.name: Nebula Mantle
Nebula Mantle.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.
Nebula Mantle.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover

Nebulous Cataclysm.name: Nebulous Cataclysm
Nebulous Cataclysm.desc: The Nebulous Cataclysm is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a slow and homing cloud core which pierces 2 times. When the cloud core is despawned or killed, it explodes into 6-8 small explosions which each deal 50% damage.
Nebulous Cataclysm.tip: 'The true power of the Nebula Mage rests in your hands...'

Nebula Arcanum.name: Nebula Arcanum
Nebula Arcanum.desc: The Nebula Arcanum is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that fires a swirling purple orb when used.
Nebula Arcanum.tip: 'Conjure masses of astral energy to chase down your foes'

Nebula Blaze.name: Nebula Blaze
Nebula Blaze.desc: The Nebula Blaze is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that inaccurately fires pink, high-velocity projectiles which home in on nearby enemies, with a 1/5 chance to fire a larger blue Nebula Blaze Ex projectile that deals 300% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and moves 60% faster.
Nebula Blaze.tip: 'From Orion's belt to the palm of your hand'

Necklace of Vexation.name: Necklace of Vexation
Necklace of Vexation.desc: The Necklace of Vexation is a craftable Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it increases all damage by up to 30% depending on how low the player's health is. Additionally, all attacks will inflict the Acid Venom debuff.
Necklace of Vexation.tip: Up to 30% increased damage the lower your life is · Current boost: [DAMAGE]% · All attacks inflict Acid Venom · Revenge

Necromantic Dye.name: Necromantic Dye
Necromantic Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Necroplasmic Beacon.name: Necroplasmic Beacon
Necroplasmic Beacon.desc: The Necroplasmic Beacon is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon Polterghast. It can only be used in the Dungeon. Note that, if Polterghast has not been defeated yet, the boss can also be summoned by killing 30 Phantom Spirits in the Dungeon.
Necroplasmic Beacon.tip: Summons Polterghast when used in the Dungeon · Despawns on the surface · Not consumable · 'The wails of the spirits disturbed something far more terrifying.'

Necroplasmic Dye.name: Necroplasmic Dye
Necroplasmic Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Neon Moss Brick.name: Neon Moss Brick
Neon Moss Brick.desc: Neon Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Neon Moss that glows in the dark when placed.

Neon Moss.name: Neon Moss
Neon Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Neon Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Neptune's Bounty.name: Neptune's Bounty
Neptune's Bounty.desc: Neptune's Bounty is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Abyss Blade and the final upgrade to the Depth Crusher. When used, it throws a gravity-affected spinning abyssal sword that pierces infinitely.
Neptune's Bounty.tip: Tosses a spinning abyssal sword which constantly sprays water energy · Once the blade begins falling, it will redirect itself towards enemies with increased velocity and 2x damage

Nettlevine Greatbow.name: Nettlevine Greatbow
Nettlevine Greatbow.desc: The Nettlevine Greatbow is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that fires a spread of four arrows, quickly followed by two more arrows that are either Venom or Chlorophyte Arrows.
Nettlevine Greatbow.tip: Shoots 4 arrows at once · Fires 2 additional venom or chlorophyte arrows

Night Owl Potion.name: Night Owl Potion
Night Owl Potion.desc: The Night Owl Potion is a buff potion that grants the Night Owl buff when consumed. The buff improves the player's night vision, and sharply increases the radius of any available light source. The buff itself has no effect in total darkness.

Night's Edge.name: Night's Edge
Night's Edge.desc: The Night's Edge is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron broadsword. When swung, a circular purple aura follows the swing, reaching slightly farther than the sword itself. Another aura swings towards the cursor, further increasing range.

Blade of Grass.name: Blade of Grass
Blade of Grass.desc: The Blade of Grass is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a Leaf Blade projectile that travels upwards in a circle and homes in on enemies.
Blade of Grass.tip: Has a chance to poison enemies

Light's Bane.name: Light's Bane
Light's Bane.desc: The Light's Bane is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates a dark slash near the tip of the sword.

Volcano.name: Volcano
Volcano.desc: The Volcano is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates an explosion upon enemy hits, dealing 75% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) to the enemy and 2 other targets in an area around the enemy. The Volcano has a 1/2 chance to inflict the On Fire!

Night's Ray.name: Night's Ray
Night's Ray.desc: The Night's Ray is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a purple beam that pierces ten times. When the beam hits an enemy, it spawns 4 four short-range particle beams to damage nearby enemies. If the beam hits more enemies, it will not spawn additional beams.
Night's Ray.tip: Fires a ray of pure, concentrated darkness · When hitting enemies, they are hit by several new beams from their sides

Amber Staff.name: Amber Staff
Amber Staff.desc: The Amber Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires an orange bolt which deals 80% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and 100% of its knockback, and can either pierce through enemies or bounce off blocks up to 2 times, dissipating upon the 3rd hit.
Amber Staff.tip: Ambers carve a path · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.desc: The Magic Missile is a pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a magic missile that follows the cursor when Left Click key is held. If the Left Click key is released mid-drag, the missile will be fired in that direction.

Wand of Frosting.name: Wand of Frosting
Wand of Frosting.desc: The Wand of Frosting is a pre-Hardmode wand and the direct upgrade to the Wand of Sparking. When used, it fires a blue spark that travels in a slight curve for about 23 tiles before dissipating.

Nightmare Dye.name: Nightmare Dye
Nightmare Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Nitro Express Rifle.name: Nitro Express Rifle
Nitro Express Rifle.desc: The Nitro Express Rifle is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it converts Musket Balls into high-velocity nitro shots, which pierce four times and cause the player to recoil.
Nitro Express Rifle.tip: 'The recoil feels strong enough to break your shoulder...'

Norfleet.name: Norfleet
Norfleet.desc: The Norfleet is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When used, it fires 3 purple energy spheres in a tight spread, which go through tiles and explode violently on impact with an enemy.
Norfleet.tip: Fires a cluster of erratic energy spheres that each contain a different element · Every three shots the weapon must recharge its energy to reload · 'Blows up everything!'

Stellar Cannon.name: Stellar Cannon
Stellar Cannon.desc: The Stellar Cannon is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by Novas after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. When used, it fires explosive astral crystals that explode on contact with enemies, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff.
Stellar Cannon.tip: Launches an explosive astral crystal that spreads the Astral Infection (debuff)

Normality Relocator.name: Normality Relocator
Normality Relocator.desc: Normality Relocator is a post-Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor.
Normality Relocator.tip: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
stats: 20 seconds (When used) / 6 seconds (When used if no boss is alive)

Rod of Discord.name: Rod of Discord
Rod of Discord.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 / 1/400 chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds.
Rod of Discord.tip: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state (16x12px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor (11x16px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version)

Poseidon.name: Poseidon
Poseidon.desc: The Poseidon is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss.

Razorblade Typhoon.name: Razorblade Typhoon
Razorblade Typhoon.desc: The Razorblade Typhoon is a Hardmode spell book that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it fires a high-velocity homing typhoon. The typhoon can pierce enemies and bounce off blocks infinitely, and it lasts for 2.5 seconds.

Nucleogenesis.name: Nucleogenesis
Nucleogenesis.desc: Nucleogenesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star-Tainted Generator and Statis' Curse. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Nucleogenesis.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · Grants immunity to Shadowflame and Irradiated · 15% increased summon damage, and increased minion knockback · Minions inflict a variety of debuffs · Minions spawn damaging sparks on enemy hits · Does not stack with downgrades

Star-Tainted Generator.name: Star-Tainted Generator
Star-Tainted Generator.desc: The Star-Tainted Generator is a craftable Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Jelly-Charged Battery, Nuclear Fuel Rod, and Starbuster Core. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Star-Tainted Generator.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades

Statis' Curse.name: Statis' Curse
Statis' Curse.desc: The Statis' Curse is a craftable Hardmode accessory and an upgrade to the Statis' Blessing and The First Shadowflame. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Statis' Curse.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 3, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame, and grants immunity to Shadowflame · Does not stack with downgrades

Nucleosynthesis.name: Nucleosynthesis
Nucleosynthesis.desc: The Nucleosynthesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Photosynthesis. It fires four unique beams behind the player, all aiming towards the mouse cursor, each of which behave differently:
Nucleosynthesis.tip: Casts four celestial beams near the player · Solar beams explode into fire on enemy hits · Nebula beams sweep a little bit over time · Vortex beams act like fast lightning and electrify enemies on hit · Stardust beams release small stars that home on enemy hits

Photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
Photosynthesis.desc: The Photosynthesis is a craftable Hardmode wand that functions similar to the Valkyrie Ray. When used, it shoots a straight green laser beam which pierces infinitely but loses 5% damage for each hit, which lingers long enough to hit enemies 4 times before disappearing.
Photosynthesis.tip: Casts a brilliant ray that dissolves into energy on enemy hits

Obelisk.name: Obelisk
Obelisk.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Obsidian Rose.name: Obsidian Rose
Obsidian Rose.desc: The Obsidian Rose is an accessory that reduces the base damage taken from lava from 80 to 35 and halves the duration of the On Fire! debuff inflicted by it from 7 / 14 / seconds to 3.5 / 7 / seconds.

drops.chance: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 5% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 2%

Obsidian Skin Potion.name: Obsidian Skin Potion
Obsidian Skin Potion.desc: The Obsidian Skin Potion is a buff potion which grants the Obsidian Skin buff when consumed. The buff makes the player immune to lava and the On Fire! debuff.

Occult Platform.name: Occult Platform
Occult Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Occult Brick Wall.name: Occult Brick Wall
Occult Brick Wall.desc: Occult Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Occult Brick.

Occult Legionnaire Banner.name: Occult Legionnaire Banner
Occult Legionnaire Banner.desc: Banners are functional furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks. The Calamity Mod features banners for many of the enemies and critters introduced in the mod's various biomes.
Occult Legionnaire Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: [enemy name]

Occult Skull Crown.name: Occult Skull Crown
Occult Skull Crown.desc: The Occult Skull Crown is a craftable Revengeance Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord accessory that combines the effects of the Heart of Darkness, Laudanum, and Stress Pills. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Occult Skull Crown.tip: You constantly gain rage over time, and rage does not fade when out of combat · Converts certain debuffs into buffs and extends their durations · This also removes immunities to these debuffs if you have them · Adrenaline charges 20% faster · Increases your max movement speed and acceleration by 5% · 'Only a fool would ever wear this...' · Revengeance

Laudanum.name: Laudanum
Laudanum.desc: The Laudanum is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be dropped by Horrible Hog. While equipped, whenever the player is afflicted by any of the following debuffs, it will convert their negative effects into net-positive effects and double their duration:
Laudanum.tip: Converts certain debuffs into buffs and extends their durations · This also removes immunities to these debuffs if you have them

Ocram's Razor.name: Ocram's Razor
Ocram's Razor.desc: Ocram's Razor is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons Mechdusa when used. It can only be used in worlds that combine the For the Worthy and Remix seeds.

Old Fashioned.name: Old Fashioned
Old Fashioned.desc: Old Fashioned is a craftable Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Old Fashioned debuff, which multiplies the damage of most non-weapon damage sources by 1.25x but multiplies weapon damage by 0.75x.
Old Fashioned.tip: Multiplies most non-weapon, non-debuff damage by 1.25x · Multiplies all weapon damage by 0.75x · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Grapefruit.name: Grapefruit
Grapefruit.desc: The Grapefruit is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Old Hunter Hat.name: Old Hunter Hat
Old Hunter Hat.desc: Old Hunter set is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Old Hunter Hat, Old Hunter Shirt and Old Hunter Pants.

Black Ink.name: Black Ink
Black Ink.desc: Black Ink is a dye material that is dropped by Squids, which only spawn in the Ocean biome. Its sole purpose is to make Black Dye.

Old Hunter Pants.name: Old Hunter Pants
Old Hunter Pants.desc: Old Hunter set is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Old Hunter Hat, Old Hunter Shirt and Old Hunter Pants.

Old Hunter Shirt.name: Old Hunter Shirt
Old Hunter Shirt.desc: Old Hunter set is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Old Hunter Hat, Old Hunter Shirt and Old Hunter Pants.

Omega Blue Chestplate.name: Omega Blue Chestplate
Omega Blue Chestplate.desc: Omega Blue armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Reaper Teeth, Depth Cells, and Ruinous Souls. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.
Omega Blue Chestplate.tip: 18% increased damage and 12% increased critical strike chance · 25% chance to save ammo · Your attacks inflict Hadopelagic Pressure · No positive life regen

Omega Blue Helmet.name: Omega Blue Helmet
Omega Blue Helmet.desc: Omega Blue armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Reaper Teeth, Depth Cells, and Ruinous Souls. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.
Omega Blue Helmet.tip: 12% increased damage and 14% increased critical strike chance · You can move freely through liquids

Omega Blue Tentacles.name: Omega Blue Tentacles
Omega Blue Tentacles.desc: Omega Blue armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Reaper Teeth, Depth Cells, and Ruinous Souls. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.
Omega Blue Tentacles.tip: 16% increased damage and 12% increased critical strike chance · 12% increased movement speed

Omega Healing Potion.name: Omega Healing Potion
Omega Healing Potion.desc: The Omega Healing Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 300 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use.

Supreme Healing Potion.name: Supreme Healing Potion
Supreme Healing Potion.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

Omicron.name: Omicron
Omicron.desc: The Omicron is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun that is the final upgrade to the Wingman and Genesis.
Omicron.tip: Fires a continuous array of lasers and spawns two Wingmen which orbit you and fire lasers at your cursor · Press Right Click when firing to shoot an Omicron Beam that splits upon hitting an enemy · After firing an Omicron Beam your Wingmen will launch a pair of grenades · Hitting an enemy with an Omicron Beam right as it is fired will increase the damage done substantially and stop it from splitting

Wingman.name: Wingman
Wingman.desc: The Wingman is a Hardmode magic gun that is dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event.
Wingman.tip: Spawns two Wingmen which orbit you and fire lasers at your cursor · Press Right Click while firing to order the Wingmen to launch grenades · Grenades have a cooldown which is shortened if the Wingmen are fully revved up

Omniblade.name: Omniblade
Omniblade.desc: The Omniblade is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it uses a custom overhead swing animation that does not direct toward the cursor.
Omniblade.tip: An ancient blade forged by the legendary Omnir

Katana.name: Katana
Katana.desc: The Katana is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. The Katana has a base 19% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Ontological Despoiler.name: Ontological Despoiler
Ontological Despoiler.desc: The Ontological Despoiler is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Nullification Pistol. It does not consume any ammo.
Ontological Despoiler.tip: Condenses chargeable pockets of concentrated unreality. Right Click to swap modes only after firing a charged shot · Unstable condensate shots trifurcate and pierce enemies · Null condensate shots fire rapidly and home in on enemies · At 50% charge or higher, rate of fire significantly increases · Fully charged unstable condensate lobs a homing disruption sphere · Fully charge null condensate emits a hitscan null-annihilation beam that always crits · Each mode charges slower when used repeatedly and resets to full speed when swapped · 'Rob them of continuity and the laws of physics they hold so dear.'

Nullification Pistol.name: Nullification Pistol
Nullification Pistol.desc: The Nullification Pistol is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by the Martian Walker during the Martian Madness event. It does not use any ammo.
Nullification Pistol.tip: Fires discrete bolts of polarized energy. Right Click to swap modes · Positive energy splits into three piercing beams · Negative energy shoots rapidly and homes in on enemies · All shots blow away enemies at close range · Each mode weakens with continuous use and resets to full power when swapped · 'Weaponizing alien tech? Now that's what I like to hear!'

Onyx Chain Blaster.name: Onyx Chain Blaster
Onyx Chain Blaster.desc: The Onyx Chain Blaster is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a combination of the Onyx Blaster and Chain Gun. When used, it fires a volley of bullets along with an onyx shard that explodes on hit and deals 200% base damage. The gun has a 50% chance to not consume ammo.
Onyx Chain Blaster.tip: Fires a spread of bullets and an onyx shard · 50% chance to save ammo

Onyx Blaster.name: Onyx Blaster
Onyx Blaster.desc: The Onyx Blaster is a Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Shotgun. When used, it fires a spread of 4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition. It also fires an onyx crystal that explodes upon impact with an enemy or a block, or after traveling for 20 ticks.

Onyx Seeking Mechanism.name: Onyx Seeking Mechanism
Onyx Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

Onyx Turret.name: Onyx Turret
Onyx Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Onyxia.name: Onyxia
Onyxia.desc: The Onyxia is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is the direct upgrade to the Onyx Chain Blaster and the final upgrade to the Onyx Blaster. When used, it rapidly fires bursts of six bullets in a tight spread along with an onyx blast that deals 145% base damage.
Onyxia.tip: Fires a storm of bullets and onyx shards · 50% chance to save ammo

Onyxplate Wall.name: Onyxplate Wall
Onyxplate Wall.desc: Onyxplate Walls is a background wall crafted with Onyxplate.

Optic Staff.name: Optic Staff
Optic Staff.desc: The Optic Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a miniature version of The Twins as minions. The pair of minions, named Spazmamini and Retanimini, fly towards enemies to dash through them and fire lasers at them, respectively.
Optic Staff.tip: Summons twins to fight for you

Orange Coral.name: Orange Coral
Orange Coral.desc: Orange Coral is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained from Eutrophic Crates and Prism Crates.

Orderbringer.name: Orderbringer
Orderbringer.desc: The Orderbringer is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword with a custom swing animation and is a direct upgrade to the Greatsword of Judgement. When swung, it fires a large energy wave that slows down as it travels and pierces infinitely.
Orderbringer.tip: Fires piercing energy waves and summons four homing stars near your cursor · Hits with the blade summon two beams from the sky · 'No matter where you may be you are never alone'

Orichalcum Anvil.name: Orichalcum Anvil
Orichalcum Anvil.desc: The Mythril Anvil and Orichalcum Anvil are Hardmode crafting stations that serve and extend the function of a pre-Hardmode Anvil. These are very crucial to game advancement, as they account for making nearly every Hardmode recipe before the Ancient Manipulator.
Orichalcum Anvil.tip: Used to craft items from mythril, orichalcum, adamantite, and titanium bars

Orichalcum Bar.name: Orichalcum Bar
Orichalcum Bar.desc: The Orichalcum Bar is a Hardmode bar. It is one of the two ores able to create a Hardmode Anvil, which is used to craft most Hardmode equipment.

Orichalcum Spiked Gemstone.name: Orichalcum Spiked Gemstone
Orichalcum Spiked Gemstone.desc: The Orichalcum Spiked Gemstone is a craftable Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a pink dagger that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity. However, once it reaches the ground, it will roll further until it hits a wall or stops.
Orichalcum Spiked Gemstone.tip: Stealth strikes last longer and summon petals on enemy hits

Otherworldly Bathtub.name: Otherworldly Bathtub
Otherworldly Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Stone.name: Otherworldly Stone
Otherworldly Stone.desc: Otherworldly Stone is a craftable post-Moon Lord block. It is used in the crafting of Otherworldly furniture.

Otherworldly Bed.name: Otherworldly Bed
Otherworldly Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Bookcase.name: Otherworldly Bookcase
Otherworldly Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Candelabra.name: Otherworldly Candelabra
Otherworldly Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Candle.name: Otherworldly Candle
Otherworldly Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Otherworldly Chair.name: Otherworldly Chair
Otherworldly Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Otherworldly Chandelier.name: Otherworldly Chandelier
Otherworldly Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Chest.name: Otherworldly Chest
Otherworldly Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Otherworldly Clock.name: Otherworldly Clock
Otherworldly Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Door.name: Otherworldly Door
Otherworldly Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Dresser.name: Otherworldly Dresser
Otherworldly Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Lamp.name: Otherworldly Lamp
Otherworldly Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Lantern.name: Otherworldly Lantern
Otherworldly Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Piano.name: Otherworldly Piano
Otherworldly Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Platform.name: Otherworldly Platform
Otherworldly Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Otherworldly Sink.name: Otherworldly Sink
Otherworldly Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Sofa.name: Otherworldly Sofa
Otherworldly Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Otherworldly Stone Wall.name: Otherworldly Stone Wall
Otherworldly Stone Wall.desc: Otherworldly Stone Wall is a background wall crafted with Otherworldly Stone.

Otherworldly Table.name: Otherworldly Table
Otherworldly Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Otherworldly Work Bench.name: Otherworldly Work Bench
Otherworldly Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Overloaded Sludge.name: Overloaded Sludge
Overloaded Sludge.desc: The Overloaded Sludge is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Slime God. It can be used anywhere at any time.
Overloaded Sludge.tip: Summons the Slime God · Not consumable · 'Writhing and bloated with the pus of Gods long dead.'

Any Evil Block.name: Any Evil Block
Any Evil Block.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Ozzathoth.name: Ozzathoth
Ozzathoth.desc: Ozzathoth is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer yoyo. While deployed, it constantly fires roughly-stationary cosmic orbs. The cosmic orbs do not pass through tiles, and they deal 40% of the weapon's damage and have an innate 100 armor penetration.
Ozzathoth.tip: Reach: 55 tiles · Speed: 60 · Infinite throw duration · Fires cosmic orbs that blast nearby enemies with lasers · 'Destroy the universe in the blink of an eye'

Terrarian.name: Terrarian
Terrarian.desc: The Terrarian is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. It rapidly fires short-lived green orbs towards nearby enemies that bounce off blocks. It also has a base critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

P-GSS: Auger.name: P-GSS: Auger
P-GSS: Auger.desc: The P-GSS: Auger is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates energy slashes directed towards the cursor. Right-clicking spawns a magnetic field at the cursor which pulls in enemies.
P-GSS: Auger.tip: A wrist mounted device which emits a magnetic energy blade · Right Click to create a brief magnetic pull at your cursor and amplify your next slash · 'Initially manufactured to serrate and separate chunks of raw material for transport. · Keeping both hands free without compromising on power made it exceptionally ergonomic.'

P-PLS: Pulse Pistol.name: P-PLS: Pulse Pistol
P-PLS: Pulse Pistol.desc: The P-PLS: Pulse Pistol is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires a pulse orb that pauses momentarily before homing to the nearest enemy. After hitting an enemy, the orb splits into two smaller pulse orbs that deal 25% base damage.
P-PLS: Pulse Pistol.tip: Fires a pulse orb that tracks nearby targets · After hitting an enemy, the pulse orb will split in two · Pulse orb pierce will increase when killing enemies

P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone.name: P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone
P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone.desc: The P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. It spends 4 minion slots to summon an arsenal shrimp minion that floats around the player. When an enemy is nearby, it will launch a burst of homing plasma missiles.
P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone.tip: Summons a shrimp drone that fires bursts of homing plasma missiles · Right Click while holding any summon weapon to command the shrimp to launch a vertical missile barrage · Vertical missiles aim towards your cursor and leave a lingering blast if they hit solid ground · Each shrimp uses 4 minion slots · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense · 'When pursuing the adherents of gods, Yharim believed no stone should be left unturned. · Weaponry for underwater contingencies was an unusually heavy focus, but no models ever saw deployment'

P-TSL: Short Circuit.name: P-TSL: Short Circuit
P-TSL: Short Circuit.desc: The P-TSL: Short Circuit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it rapidly fires electric shots with slight inaccuracy which pierce once.
P-TSL: Short Circuit.tip: Press Left Click to rapidly fire stunning bolts with high knockback · Press Right Click to shoot a hook that attaches to enemies and rapidly electrocutes them · After electrocuting an enemy enough, the hook will create a shock explosion before returning to you · Successful hook attacks have a short cooldown that is applied unless the hook kills an enemy · Ignores 10 points of enemy Defense

Palladium Javelin.name: Palladium Javelin
Palladium Javelin.desc: The Palladium Javelin is a craftable Hardmode javelin. It throws a javelin that pierces twice, travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Palladium Javelin.tip: Stealth strikes split into more javelins and boost natural life regeneration on hits

Palladium Bar.name: Palladium Bar
Palladium Bar.desc: The Palladium Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Pandemic.name: Pandemic
Pandemic.desc: The Pandemic is a craftable Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it gains increasing size, power and airtime with each unique enemy struck that is infected with the Plague debuff and refreshes the target's Plague duration. Counterweights move twice as fast and also inflict Plague.
Pandemic.tip: Reach: 30 tiles · Speed: 24 · Duration: 15 seconds · Each unique enemy struck that is infected with Plague increases the yoyo's size, power, and airtime · Refreshes Plague duration if a target is already infected · Counterweights inflict Plague and move twice as fast

Hive-Five.name: Hive-Five
Hive-Five.desc: The Hive-Five is a pre-Hardmode yoyo. Upon enemy hits, it has a 1/3 chance of summoning a homing Bee projectile.
Hive-Five.tip: Summons killer bees after striking your foe

Parasitic Scepter.name: Parasitic Scepter
Parasitic Scepter.desc: The Parasitic Scepter is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires 2 to 4 leeches that latch onto enemies on contact.
Parasitic Scepter.tip: Fires a spread of radioactive water leeches that latch onto enemies · Deals stacking Irradiated damage over time per leech

Pearl God.name: Pearl God
Pearl God.desc: The Pearl God is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the Arietes 41 and the final upgrade to the Handgun. When fired, it alternates between firing 3 bullets imbued with pearlescence and 1 bullet imbued with lifesteal with every other shot.
Pearl God.tip: Alternates between firing a bullet imbued with lifesteal and 3 bullets imbued with pearlescence · Pearlescent imbued bullets create a radiant flash on impact, dealing additional damage to the enemy they hit

Penumbra.name: Penumbra
Penumbra.desc: The Penumbra is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue bomb. When used, it throws a shadow bomb that charges in the direction of the player's cursor and explodes into homing souls. The shadow bombs inflict the Daybroken and Nightwither debuffs for 3 seconds.
Penumbra.tip: Throws a shadow bomb that explodes into homing souls and flames · Stealth strikes make the bomb manifest on the cursor and explode into more souls

Perennial Brick Wall.name: Perennial Brick Wall
Perennial Brick Wall.desc: Perennial Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Perennial Brick.

Scoria Ore.name: Scoria Ore
Scoria Ore.desc: Scoria Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates naturally in the Abyss. It can generate on the underside of the floating Abyss Gravel or Pyre Mantle islands, dropping harmful lava particles into the water beneath itself. These lava particles deal a base damage of 25.

Pestilent Defiler.name: Pestilent Defiler
Pestilent Defiler.desc: The Pestilent Defiler is a craftable Hardmode gun. It slowly fires extremely powerful shots at high velocity. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, bullets are converted into sickness rounds that inflict the Plague debuff.
Pestilent Defiler.tip: Converts musket balls into Plague rounds that explode and split apart on hit

Slag Magnum.name: Slag Magnum
Slag Magnum.desc: The Slag Magnum is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Earth Elementals. When used, it converts Musket Balls into slag rounds that split into 4 shards on hit. The shards deal 35% of the weapon's damage. All of its projectiles inflict the Armor Crunch debuff and do not pierce.
Slag Magnum.tip: Converts musket balls into fossil shards that inflict Armor Crunch and split into additional shards on impact

Phantasmal Fury.name: Phantasmal Fury
Phantasmal Fury.desc: The Phantasmal Fury is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Spectre Staff. When used, it fires a swirling vortex of souls around the player. While swirling around the player, souls deal 30% base damage but have twice as much knockback.
Phantasmal Fury.tip: Casts a vortex of homing souls around you that repels enemies and will fly towards your cursor after a few seconds

Spectre Staff.name: Spectre Staff
Spectre Staff.desc: The Spectre Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 / 39/400 chance of being dropped by Ragged Casters in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a homing orb that pierces two enemies but cannot pass through blocks.
Spectre Staff.tip: Summons a lost soul to chase your foes

drops.chance: 5% (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 2.5% (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)9.75%

Phantasmal Ruin.name: Phantasmal Ruin
Phantasmal Ruin.desc: The Phantasmal Ruin is a craftable Hardmode, post-Plantera non-consumable javelin. When used, it throws a fast ghost lance that goes through tiles and explodes into 4 homing spirits on enemy hits while disappearing on direct hit.
Phantasmal Ruin.tip: Fires a large ghost lance that explodes into spirits on enemy hits · Stealth strikes pierce twice and summon many spirits from the depths on the first hit

Spectre Bar.name: Spectre Bar
Spectre Bar.desc: The Spectre Bar is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bar.

Phantom Heart.name: Phantom Heart
Phantom Heart.desc: The Phantom Heart is a craftable post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item that can only be consumed once, and upon consumption, increases the player's maximum mana by 60. There are 2 other items that function identically to this: the Comet Shard and the Ethereal Core.

Phantomic Artifact.name: Phantomic Artifact
Phantomic Artifact.desc: The Phantomic Artifact is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the final upgrade to the Spirit Glyph. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:
Phantomic Artifact.tip: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Does not stack with downgrades · Hold Shift for more Phantomic Empowerment grants 10% increased summon damage and throws knives at enemies · Phantomic Shield grants 8 defense and a 20% damage reduction bulwark · Phantomic Regen grants 1 HP/s life regen and occasionally drops phantom hearts which grant an additional 1 HP/s life regen

Phaseslayer.name: Phaseslayer
Phaseslayer.desc: The Phaseslayer is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon. When used, a long red laser blade is created that deals continuous contact damage to enemies.
Phaseslayer.tip: Projects a colossal laser blade which is controlled by the cursor · Move the cursor to swing the blade and rip and tear through enemies · Faster swings deal more damage and release additional sword beams

Valkyrie Ray.name: Valkyrie Ray
Valkyrie Ray.desc: The Valkyrie Ray is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it charges for half a second, then releases a straight magenta laser beam that fades out very shortly after. The beam pierces infinitely, cannot pass through tiles, and cannot be aimed after its release.
Valkyrie Ray.tip: Casts a devastating ray of holy power

Photosynthesis Potion.name: Photosynthesis Potion
Photosynthesis Potion.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

Photoviscerator.name: Photoviscerator
Photoviscerator.desc: The Photoviscerator is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 95% chance to not consume ammo.
Photoviscerator.tip: Emits a continuous beam of Miracle Blight that disintegrates everything · Press Right Click to fire homing exo flares which stick to and incinerate enemies · Uses gel for ammo · The beam has a 95% chance to save ammo

Piggy Cage.name: Piggy Cage
Piggy Cage.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Piggy.name: Piggy
Piggy.desc: The Piggy is a critter that spawns in the Forest during the day or at any time while in a town. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net. It passively walks back and forth and occasionally idles in place.

Pink Cosmic Flame Dye.name: Pink Cosmic Flame Dye
Pink Cosmic Flame Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Pink Pearl Pile.name: Pink Pearl Pile
Pink Pearl Pile.desc: Pink Pearl Pile is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block.

Pink Pearl.name: Pink Pearl
Pink Pearl.desc: Pearls are crafting materials obtained from opening Oysters, and are used to craft Luck Potions. Each of the three pearls have different rarities, with the rarer ones being crafted into stronger potions.

Pink Statigel Dye.name: Pink Statigel Dye
Pink Statigel Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Pink Vase.name: Pink Vase
Pink Vase.desc: The Pink Vase is a decorative furniture item. A placed Pink Vase also serves as a Placed Bottle for potion crafting.

Plague Goo Dye.name: Plague Goo Dye
Plague Goo Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Plague Humidifier.name: Plague Humidifier
Plague Humidifier.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Plague Infuser.name: Plague Infuser
Plague Infuser.desc: The Plague Infuser is a Hardmode crafting station that is used to craft the Plague furniture set themed around the Jungle Plague.

Plague Plate Dye.name: Plague Plate Dye
Plague Plate Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Plague Reaper Mask.name: Plague Reaper Mask
Plague Reaper Mask.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set crafted from Necro armor, Plague Cell Canisters and Nanites. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Plague Reaper Mask.tip: 10% increased ranged damage and 8% increased ranged critical strike chance · 25% chance to save ammo

Necro Helmet.name: Necro Helmet
Necro Helmet.desc: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet, Necro Breastplate, and Necro Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones.

Plague Reaper Striders.name: Plague Reaper Striders
Plague Reaper Striders.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set crafted from Necro armor, Plague Cell Canisters and Nanites. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Plague Reaper Striders.tip: 8% increased ranged critical strike chance · 15% increased movement speed

Necro Greaves.name: Necro Greaves
Necro Greaves.desc: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet, Necro Breastplate, and Necro Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones.

Plague Reaper Vest.name: Plague Reaper Vest
Plague Reaper Vest.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set crafted from Necro armor, Plague Cell Canisters and Nanites. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Plague Reaper Vest.tip: 16% increased ranged damage · Grants immunity to Plague

Necro Breastplate.name: Necro Breastplate
Necro Breastplate.desc: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet, Necro Breastplate, and Necro Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones.

Plague Tainted SMG.name: Plague Tainted SMG
Plague Tainted SMG.desc: The Plague Tainted SMG is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it converts all bullets into plague bullets that inflict the Plague debuff on hit, dealing 150% damage and knockback if the target is within 50 tiles of the player.
Plague Tainted SMG.tip: Shoots Plague bullets that spawn drones on critical hits · Bullets deal more damage and knockback the closer the enemy is · Drones have a much higher crit chance upon hitting an enemy inflicted with Plague · Press Right Click to fire a drone swarm

Black Hawk Remote.name: Black Hawk Remote
Black Hawk Remote.desc: The Black Hawk Remote is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it summons a fighter jet that follows the player around and attacks by aiming and firing at enemies.
Black Hawk Remote.tip: Summons a Black Hawk jet to fight for you · Jets will fire bullets from your inventory · 50% chance to save ammo

Uzi.name: Uzi
Uzi.desc: The Uzi is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by Angry Trappers. When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a high velocity.
Uzi.tip: Shoots a powerful, high velocity bullet

Plague Turret.name: Plague Turret
Plague Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Plaguebringer Carapace.name: Plaguebringer Carapace
Plaguebringer Carapace.desc: Plaguebringer armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set and an upgrade to the Bee armor set. While wearing the Plaguebringer Carapace, the player has a tank equipped behind them.
Plaguebringer Carapace.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 20% increased summon damage · Grants immunity to Plague

Bee Breastplate.name: Bee Breastplate
Bee Breastplate.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 30 Bee Wax.
Bee Breastplate.tip: Increases summon damage by 4% · Increases your max number of minions by 1

Plaguebringer Goliath (Lore).name: Plaguebringer Goliath (Lore)
Plaguebringer Goliath (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Plaguebringer Goliath (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Plaguebringer Goliath Trophy.name: Plaguebringer Goliath Trophy
Plaguebringer Goliath Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Plaguebringer Pistons.name: Plaguebringer Pistons
Plaguebringer Pistons.desc: Plaguebringer armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set and an upgrade to the Bee armor set. While wearing the Plaguebringer Carapace, the player has a tank equipped behind them.
Plaguebringer Pistons.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 20% increased summon damage and 15% increased movement speed · Flowers grow on the grass you walk on, and dye plants rarely grow on grassless dirt you walk on

Bee Greaves.name: Bee Greaves
Bee Greaves.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 30 Bee Wax.

Plaguebringer Visor.name: Plaguebringer Visor
Plaguebringer Visor.desc: Plaguebringer armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set and an upgrade to the Bee armor set. While wearing the Plaguebringer Carapace, the player has a tank equipped behind them.
Plaguebringer Visor.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 20% increased summon damage

Bee Headgear.name: Bee Headgear
Bee Headgear.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 30 Bee Wax.
Bee Headgear.tip: Increases summon damage by 4% · Increases your max number of minions by 1

Plagued Bathtub.name: Plagued Bathtub
Plagued Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Bookcase.name: Plagued Bookcase
Plagued Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Candelabra.name: Plagued Candelabra
Plagued Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Candle.name: Plagued Candle
Plagued Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Plagued Chair.name: Plagued Chair
Plagued Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Plagued Chandelier.name: Plagued Chandelier
Plagued Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Plagued Shelf.name: Plagued Shelf
Plagued Shelf.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Plagued Containment Wall.name: Plagued Containment Wall
Plagued Containment Wall.desc: Plagued Containment Wall is a background wall crafted with Plagued Containment Bricks.

Plagued Door.name: Plagued Door
Plagued Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Dresser.name: Plagued Dresser
Plagued Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Lamp.name: Plagued Lamp
Plagued Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Lantern.name: Plagued Lantern
Plagued Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Piano.name: Plagued Piano
Plagued Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Sink.name: Plagued Sink
Plagued Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Sofa.name: Plagued Sofa
Plagued Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Plagued Table.name: Plagued Table
Plagued Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plagued Work Bench.name: Plagued Work Bench
Plagued Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Plaguenade.name: Plaguenade
Plaguenade.desc: The Plaguenade is a craftable Hardmode bomb. It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.
Plaguenade.tip: Releases a swarm of angry Plague bees · Stealth strikes spawn more bees and generate a larger explosion

Plagueplate Wall.name: Plagueplate Wall
Plagueplate Wall.desc: Plagueplate Walls are background walls crafted with Plagueplate.

Planebreaker's Pouch.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
Planebreaker's Pouch.desc: The Planebreaker's Pouch is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Planebreaker's Pouch.tip: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

Any Quiver.name: Any Quiver
Any Quiver.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Daedalus Stormbow.name: Daedalus Stormbow
Daedalus Stormbow.desc: The Daedalus Stormbow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it causes a wide spread of arrows to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor.

Vernal Bolter.name: Vernal Bolter
Vernal Bolter.desc: The Vernal Bolter is a craftable Hardmode bow that is a direct upgrade to the Lunarian Bow.
Vernal Bolter.tip: Fires a tight column of three arrows · Converts wooden arrows into sliding energy bolts

Plantera (Lore).name: Plantera (Lore)
Plantera (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Plantera (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Plantera Trophy.name: Plantera Trophy
Plantera Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Plasma Caster.name: Plasma Caster
Plasma Caster.desc: The Plasma Caster is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun. When used with the primary fire (left-click), it slowly fires a plasma bolt that does not pierce and creates a large explosion on hit.
Plasma Caster.tip: Press Left Click to fire a large, exploding plasma bolt · Press Right Click to fire in turbo mode, increasing rate of fire but with hindered accuracy

Plasma Grenade.name: Plasma Grenade
Plasma Grenade.desc: The Plasma Grenade is a craftable post-Moon Lord bomb. When used, the bomb is affected by gravity after a short time. When it collides with a surface or enemy, it explodes, dealing damage within the area.
Plasma Grenade.tip: Throws a grenade that explodes into plasma on collision · Stealth strikes explode violently on collision into a vaporizing blast · 'Each grenade contains a heavily condensed and heated unit of plasma. Use with extreme caution.'

Plasma Rifle.name: Plasma Rifle
Plasma Rifle.desc: The Plasma Rifle is a craftable Hardmode magic gun. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires bolts that create an explosion that deals 70% base damage.
Plasma Rifle.tip: Fires an explosive plasma blast with pinpoint accuracy · Press Right Click to rapidly fire non-explosive blasts

Platinum Ore.name: Platinum Ore
Platinum Ore.desc: Platinum Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Platinum Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Ursa Sergeant.name: Ursa Sergeant
Ursa Sergeant.desc: The Ursa Sergeant is a Hardmode accessory that is rarely fished up in the Astral Infection. While equipped, it will make an astral claw swipe that deals 325 flat typeless damage spawn when attacking enemies on a 5 second cooldown.
Ursa Sergeant.tip: Attacks maul enemies with astral claw swipes that inflict Astral Infection (debuff) · Taking damage reduces the cooldown, but inflicts you with Astral Infection (debuff) · Enemy kills also reduce the cooldown · Swipes will be translucent and silent if visibility is disabled

Pole Warper.name: Pole Warper
Pole Warper.desc: The Pole Warper is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. It summons a pair of Warper Magnet minions that orbit around the player. When an enemy is found, the magnets disperse, pause for a brief moment, then charge at the target.
Pole Warper.tip: Summons a pair of floating magnets that repel each other and relentlessly swarm enemies · Magnetic devices which tear at foes by propelling themselves off their opposite counterparts

Polished Marnite Platform.name: Polished Marnite Platform
Polished Marnite Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Polished Marnite Wall.name: Polished Marnite Wall
Polished Marnite Wall.desc: Polished Marnite Walls are background walls crafted with Polished Marnite Blocks.

Any Gold Ore.name: Any Gold Ore
Any Gold Ore.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Polished Navystone Brick.name: Polished Navystone Brick
Polished Navystone Brick.desc: Polished Navystone Brick is a Pre-Hardmode block that is crafted from Navystone at a Furnace.

Polterghast (Lore).name: Polterghast (Lore)
Polterghast (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Polterghast (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Polterghast Trophy.name: Polterghast Trophy
Polterghast Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Polyp Sand.name: Polyp Sand
Polyp Sand.desc: Polyp Sand is a decorative block that is only obtainable via shimmering Eutrophic Sand.

Portabulb.name: Portabulb
Portabulb.desc: The Portabulb is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Plantera. It can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.
Portabulb.tip: Summons Plantera when used in the Jungle · Enrages outside the Underground Jungle · Not consumable

Vernal Soil.name: Vernal Soil
Vernal Soil.desc: Vernal Soil is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found naturally generated in the Vernal Pass within the Underground Jungle. Giant Plantera Bulbs can automatically grow from its surface. It can be mined with any pickaxe.

Potion of Omniscience.name: Potion of Omniscience
Potion of Omniscience.desc: The Potion of Omniscience is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Omniscience buff, which grants the effects of the Hunter, Spelunker, and Dangersense potions simultaneously. This causes enemies, treasures, and traps onscreen to be highlighted.
Potion of Omniscience.tip: Highlights nearby creatures, enemy projectiles, · danger sources, and treasure

Spelunker Potion.name: Spelunker Potion
Spelunker Potion.desc: The Spelunker Potion is a buff potion which grants the Spelunker buff when consumed. The buff illuminates valuable nearby objects and highlights them with a yellow tint.
Spelunker Potion.tip: Shows the location of treasure and ore

Potion of Return.name: Potion of Return
Potion of Return.desc: The Potion of Return is a potion that teleports the player back to their spawn point, similar to the Recall Potion, and additionally creates a portal exit at the location where the potion was consumed.
Potion of Return.tip: Teleports you home and creates a portal · Use portal to return when you are done · 'Good for one round trip!'

Prelude (Lore).name: Prelude (Lore)
Prelude (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Prelude (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Lunatic Cultist Trophy.name: Lunatic Cultist Trophy
Lunatic Cultist Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper.name: Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper
Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper.desc: The Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used, it rapidly fires bullets. Musket balls turn into fast lightning bolts which do not pierce enemies or tiles, inflict the Electrified debuff, and explode when enemies are killed.
Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper.tip: Every fourth shot deals 135% damage · Converts musket balls into Electrified lightning bolts · Lightning bolts travel extremely fast and explode on enemy kills · Lightning bolt crits grant a stacking speed boost to the player · This stacks up to 20 percent bonus movement speed and acceleration · The boost will reset if the player holds a different item · 50% chance to save ammo

Primordial Ancient.name: Primordial Ancient
Primordial Ancient.desc: The Primordial Ancient is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Primordial Earth. When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff.
Primordial Ancient.tip: Casts five primordial sand blasts that converge at your cursor after a moment and create a giant explosion · Casting this spell at max mana while without mana sickness will cause it to give you and any player it hits the Aeolian Earth buff

Primordial Earth.name: Primordial Earth
