Primordial Earth.desc: The Primordial Earth is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. It is a direct upgrade to the Death Valley Duster, firing 2 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff.
Primordial Earth.tip: Casts two enchanted blasts of sand that converge with each other and explode · Casting this spell at max mana while without mana sickness will cause it to give you and any player it hits the Sand's Wind buff

Primrose Keepsake.name: Primrose Keepsake
Primrose Keepsake.desc: The Primrose Keepsake is a craftable pet summoning item that is a combination of Bear's Eye and the Romajeda Orchid, allowing both pets to be summoned at once. It summons a guardian angel cat named Bear and a dog named Kendra to follow the player.

Bear's Eye.name: Bear's Eye
Bear's Eye.desc: Bear's Eye is a pet summoning item that is sold by the Bandit for 5 platinum. It summons a guardian angel cat named Bear to follow the player. If the player moves too fast, Bear will use blue wings to fly towards them.

Romajeda Orchid.name: Romajeda Orchid
Romajeda Orchid.desc: The Romajeda Orchid is a pet summoning item that is sold by the Dryad for 40 gold. It summons a dog named Kendra to follow the player. When the player is idle, Kendra will either waggle its tail, yawn or bark to alert the player.

Prismalline.name: Prismalline
Prismalline.desc: The Prismalline is a craftable Hardmode dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Crystalline. When used, it throws a prism dagger that is affected by gravity and pierces infinitely. Shortly after it is thrown, it splits into 3 copies of itself in a random spread.
Prismalline.tip: Throws daggers that split after a while · Stealth strikes additionally explode into prism shards and briefly stun enemies

Prismatic Breaker.name: Prismatic Breaker
Prismatic Breaker.desc: The Prismatic Breaker is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword and ranged weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), the player will hold the sword similarly to a staff, firing bursts of stars from the tip of the sword.
Prismatic Breaker.tip: Fires several bursts of magic stars as the weapon charges up · After charging up, a massive rainbow laser is unleashed to devastate your foes · This weapon is boosted by both melee and ranged damage · Seems to belong to a certain magical girl. Radiates with intense cosmic energy

Solstice Claymore.name: Solstice Claymore
Solstice Claymore.desc: The Solstice Claymore is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When used, it shoots a different colored sword based on the real-time season.
Solstice Claymore.tip: Changes projectile color based on the time of year · Inflicts Daybroken during the day and Nightwither during the night

Prismatic Greaves.name: Prismatic Greaves
Prismatic Greaves.desc: Prismatic armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Armored Shells, Exodium Clusters, Divine Geodes, and Nanites. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Prismatic Greaves.tip: 10% increased magic damage and 12% increased magic critical strike chance · 20% decreased non-magic damage · 10% increased flight time and 2% increased jump speed

Prismatic Helmet.name: Prismatic Helmet
Prismatic Helmet.desc: Prismatic armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Armored Shells, Exodium Clusters, Divine Geodes, and Nanites. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Prismatic Helmet.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 and 15% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 12% increased magic critical strike chance · 20% decreased non-magic damage · Enemies with less than 500 max health deal no contact damage · This does not occur while a boss is alive

Prismatic Regalia.name: Prismatic Regalia
Prismatic Regalia.desc: Prismatic armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Armored Shells, Exodium Clusters, Divine Geodes, and Nanites. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.
Prismatic Regalia.tip: 15% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · 20% decreased non-magic damage · Magic attacks have a 5% chance to fire a pair of homing rockets

Profaned Bathtub.name: Profaned Bathtub
Profaned Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Rock.name: Profaned Rock
Profaned Rock.desc: Profaned Rock is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Stone Blocks and Unholy Essences at a Hardmode Forge. It is used in the crafting of Profaned furniture.

Profaned Bed.name: Profaned Bed
Profaned Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Bench.name: Profaned Bench
Profaned Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Profaned Bookcase.name: Profaned Bookcase
Profaned Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Candelabra.name: Profaned Candelabra
Profaned Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Candle.name: Profaned Candle
Profaned Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Profaned Chair.name: Profaned Chair
Profaned Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Profaned Chandelier.name: Profaned Chandelier
Profaned Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Chest.name: Profaned Chest
Profaned Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Profaned Clock.name: Profaned Clock
Profaned Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Crucible.name: Profaned Crucible
Profaned Crucible.desc: The Profaned Crucible is a post-Moon Lord crafting station used to craft the Profaned furniture set themed around Providence, as well as the Profaned Soul Crystal. The Profaned Crucible also counts as a basin.

Profaned Crystal.name: Profaned Crystal
Profaned Crystal.desc: Profaned Crystal is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Glass and Unholy Essences at an Ancient Manipulator. It is used in the crafting of Runic Profaned Bricks.

Profaned Crystal Wall.name: Profaned Crystal Wall
Profaned Crystal Wall.desc: Profaned Crystal Wall is an aesthetic building material. It is crafted with Profaned Crystal.

Profaned Crystal Dye.name: Profaned Crystal Dye
Profaned Crystal Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Profaned Door.name: Profaned Door
Profaned Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Dresser.name: Profaned Dresser
Profaned Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Flame Dye.name: Profaned Flame Dye
Profaned Flame Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Profaned Moonlight Dye.name: Profaned Moonlight Dye
Profaned Moonlight Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Profaned Lamp.name: Profaned Lamp
Profaned Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Lantern.name: Profaned Lantern
Profaned Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Partisan.name: Profaned Partisan
Profaned Partisan.desc: The Profaned Partisan is a craftable post-Moon Lord javelin that is an upgrade to the Spear of Paleolith. On use, it throws a javelin that splits into holy spears on hit. Holy spears have oscillating velocity and can pierce through enemies.
Profaned Partisan.tip: Throws a profaned spear that splits into miniature spears upon hitting an enemy · Stealth strikes remain impaled in an enemy for 10 seconds · While an enemy is impaled, all spears that strike them instead shatter into exploding stars

Spear of Paleolith.name: Spear of Paleolith
Spear of Paleolith.desc: The Spear of Paleolith is a craftable Hardmode non-consumable javelin. On use, it throws a javelin that shatters into 2 fossil shards on hit that deal 28 damage. Fossil shards linger on surfaces, piercing enemies twice.
Spear of Paleolith.tip: Throws an ancient spear that shatters into fossil shards upon hitting an enemy · Stealth strikes remain impaled in the enemy for 10 seconds · While an enemy is impaled, all spears that strike them erupt into even more fossil shards

Profaned Piano.name: Profaned Piano
Profaned Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Platform.name: Profaned Platform
Profaned Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Profaned Rock Wall.name: Profaned Rock Wall
Profaned Rock Wall.desc: Profaned Rock Wall is a background wall crafted with Profaned Rock.

Profaned Rock Dye.name: Profaned Rock Dye
Profaned Rock Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Profaned Shard.name: Profaned Shard
Profaned Shard.desc: The Profaned Shard is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Profaned Guardians. It can only be used in The Hallow or The Underworld.
Profaned Shard.tip: Summons the Profaned Guardians when used in the Hallow or Underworld · Not consumable · 'Her Guardians seek the holder of such vast stolen power.'

Profaned Sink.name: Profaned Sink
Profaned Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Slab.name: Profaned Slab
Profaned Slab.desc: Profaned Slab is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Profaned Rocks at an Ancient Manipulator.

Profaned Slab Wall.name: Profaned Slab Wall
Profaned Slab Wall.desc: Profaned Slab Walls are background walls crafted with Profaned Slabs.

Profaned Soul Artifact.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
Profaned Soul Artifact.desc: The Profaned Soul Artifact is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.
Profaned Soul Artifact.tip: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity

Profaned Soul Crystal.name: Profaned Soul Crystal
Profaned Soul Crystal.desc: The Profaned Soul Crystal is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer accessory that is also dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess if the player defeats her in Expert Mode using only the Profaned Soul Artifact.
Profaned Soul Crystal.tip: Transforms you into an emissary of the profaned goddess · Provides passive buffs depending on the time of day · Greatly boosts the power of the Guardian's relics · Grants additional effects if you have 10 unused minion slots · Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · All non-summon attacks are transformed, and are empowered if no minions are active · Melee attacks become a barrage of spears · Ranged attacks become a flurry of fireballs and meteors · Magic attacks become a giant splitting fireball, costing 100 mana · Whips become overtaken by profaned crystal · Rogue attacks become a deadly crystalline spiral · Thinking back, it was a boring life · And so we burn it all in the name of purity
stats: No value / 56 gold (after Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas have been defeated)

Profaned Table.name: Profaned Table
Profaned Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Profaned Work Bench.name: Profaned Work Bench
Profaned Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Protolith Bangle.name: Protolith Bangle
Protolith Bangle.desc: The Protolith Bangle is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown.
Protolith Bangle.tip: Ranged enemy hits create a marble flash that always critically strikes and can hit multiple enemies · This effect has a 7 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The cold marble against your wrist puts your mind at ease'

Providence, the Profaned Goddess (Lore).name: Providence, the Profaned Goddess (Lore)
Providence, the Profaned Goddess (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Providence, the Profaned Goddess (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Providence Trophy.name: Providence Trophy
Providence Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Pulse Bow.name: Pulse Bow
Pulse Bow.desc: The Pulse Bow is a Hardmode bow that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for after defeating all three mechanical bosses. When used, it converts any type of arrow into a high-velocity Pulse Bolt.

Pulse Dragon.name: Pulse Dragon
Pulse Dragon.desc: The Pulse Dragon is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail. When used, the player swings two glowing electric dragon heads which move in a whip-like manner. As they converge, up to eight short-lasting electrosphere projectiles are spawned per flail.
Pulse Dragon.tip: Throws two mechanical dragon heads that emit damaging electrical fields · 'Yharim specifically requested this weapon to be modelled after the Dragons of old. · How trite.'

Pulse Turret Remote.name: Pulse Turret Remote
Pulse Turret Remote.desc: The Pulse Turret Remote is a craftable Hardmode sentry. It summons a stationary turret sentry that fires a purple homing pulse blast towards nearby enemies. Every third shot, a spread of three blasts is fired.
Pulse Turret Remote.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a turret to fire explosive pulse blasts at your enemies · Only one pulse turret may exist at a time

Pumpkaboom.name: Pumpkaboom
Pumpkaboom.desc: The Pumpkaboom is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws a pumpkin bomb that sticks to enemies on hit. Upon sticking to enemies for 1.83 seconds, it explodes in a 10.625 tile radius for 200% damage.
Pumpkaboom.tip: Throws a pumpkin which sticks to enemies and explodes after a delay · Stealth strikes throw larger pumpkins which pull enemies in before releasing a larger explosion

Pumpkin Moon Medallion.name: Pumpkin Moon Medallion
Pumpkin Moon Medallion.desc: The Pumpkin Moon Medallion is a Hardmode, post-Plantera event-summoning item used to summon the Pumpkin Moon event. It can only be used at night. Attempting to use it during the day will not begin the event, and the item will not be consumed from the player's inventory.

Pumpler.name: Pumpler
Pumpler.desc: The Pumpler is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, the weapon slowly charges, indicated by the barrel increasing in size after each charge.
Pumpler.tip: Hold Left Click to load up to five pumpkin grenades at once

Purple Distorted Monolith.name: Purple Distorted Monolith
Purple Distorted Monolith.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Purple Haze.name: Purple Haze
Purple Haze.desc: Purple Haze is a craftable Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Purple Haze debuff which, for 5 seconds after performing a stealth strike, increases non-stealth strike rogue damage by 25% but reduces stealth strike damage by 25%.
Purple Haze.tip: For 5 seconds after a stealth strike, all damage increased by 25%, but stealth strike damage reduced by 25% · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Plum.name: Plum
Plum.desc: The Plum is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Pwnhammer.name: Pwnhammer
Pwnhammer.desc: The Pwnhammer is a Hardmode hammer that is always dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It is able to destroy Demon Altars and Crimson Altars, causing one type of Hardmode ore to appear in the world.
Pwnhammer.tip: Strong enough to destroy Demon Altars

Pyre Mantle Wall.name: Pyre Mantle Wall
Pyre Mantle Wall.desc: Pyre Mantle Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the 3rd layer of the Abyss. It is able to spawn water in front of the wall whenever a nearby tile updates.

Quagmire.name: Quagmire
Quagmire.desc: The Quagmire is a craftable Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it fires spore clouds randomly around it, which move slowly and dissipate after a short time. The spore clouds pierce infinitely, can pass through tiles, and deal 75% of the weapon's damage.
Quagmire.tip: Reach: 30 tiles · Speed: 36 · Infinite throw duration · Fires spore clouds

Queen Bee (Lore).name: Queen Bee (Lore)
Queen Bee (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Queen Bee (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Queen Bee Trophy.name: Queen Bee Trophy
Queen Bee Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Queen Slime (Lore).name: Queen Slime (Lore)
Queen Slime (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Queen Slime (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Queen Slime Trophy.name: Queen Slime Trophy
Queen Slime Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Quiver of Nihility.name: Quiver of Nihility
Quiver of Nihility.desc: The Quiver of Nihility is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. While equipped, it grants +5% ranged critical strike chance. It also summons four void fields that orbit around the player. Arrows that pass through a void field gain a 1.75x damage boost and one extra update.
Quiver of Nihility.tip: 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Summons a ring of four void fields to orbit you · Arrows that pass through these fields gain a 75% damage boost and double speed · 'Filled with a substance darker than the night sky'

R-GSS: Vulcan.name: R-GSS: Vulcan
R-GSS: Vulcan.desc: The R-GSS: Vulcan is a craftable Hardmode magic gun. When used, it winds up to rapidly fire gauss blasts with a brief downtime in between. Right-clicking fires an extremely fast harpoon that deals 500% base damage on a 3 second cooldown.
R-GSS: Vulcan.tip: A mana-fueled Gatling cannon that fires in bursts · Press Right Click to launch a magnetic harpoon which attracts your shots · Launching a harpoon makes burst mode fire last longer · When a harpoon expires, all magnetized shots launch at nearby enemies with increased damage · 'Originally a ceiling mounted mining beam, the removal of its battery reduced its heft only marginally. · It saw little use and many complaints from the battlemage corps.'

R-PLS: Pulse Grenade.name: R-PLS: Pulse Grenade
R-PLS: Pulse Grenade.desc: The R-PLS: Pulse Grenade is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, the player throws a grenade, which has a custom throw animation and homes in on enemies.
R-PLS: Pulse Grenade.tip: A regenerating grenade that will track enemies and burst into 8 pulse orbs · Pulse orbs will return to you and reform the grenade, hitting anything in their path · Stealth strikes throw the grenade at high speeds and burst into twice as many orbs

R-PMA: Holofibre Immolator.name: R-PMA: Holofibre Immolator
R-PMA: Holofibre Immolator.desc: The R-PMA: Holofibre Immolator is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it fires a spread of 3 gravity-affected plasma drops which can pierce 3 times. Holding left-click quickly charges the bow over 0.5 seconds.
R-PMA: Holofibre Immolator.tip: Fires three gravity-affected plasma drops which dissolve through foes · Holding Left Click quickly charges the bow, firing a high-speed plasma arrow · Plasma arrows will detonate after impact, creating stronger explosions if stuck into tiles · Holding Right Click will repeatedly fire uncharged shots · 'The elegance of holofibre is unmatched. · However, mechanical tension may have produced more consistent results.'

Radar.name: Radar
Radar.desc: The Radar is an informational accessory that displays the number of nearby enemies in a 125-tile radius around the player.

Radiance.name: Radiance
Radiance.desc: The Radiance is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Ambrosial Ampoule and Infected Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Radiance.tip: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 12 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 75% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

Radiant Star.name: Radiant Star
Radiant Star.desc: The Radiant Star is a craftable Hardmode dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Prismalline. When used, it throws an astral dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces 3 times.
Radiant Star.tip: Throws daggers that explode and split after a while and spread the Astral Infection (debuff) · Stealth strike splits more with a devastating explosion that sucks enemies in

Rage Potion.name: Rage Potion
Rage Potion.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%.

Raider's Talisman.name: Raider's Talisman
Raider's Talisman.desc: The Raider's Talisman is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, if the player performs a stealth strike, non-stealth strike rogue hits will gain a temporary 15% bonus to their critical strike chance that lasts 10 seconds.
Raider's Talisman.tip: Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

Rainbow Party Cannon.name: Rainbow Party Cannon
Rainbow Party Cannon.desc: The Rainbow Party Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer magic gun. When used, a cannon appears locked to the player's location, pointing either left or right towards the direction of the cursor. It is unable to change direction until released.
Rainbow Party Cannon.tip: 'Let the rainbow remind you that together we will always shine...'

Celebration Mk2.name: Celebration Mk2
Celebration Mk2.desc: The Celebration Mk2 is a Hardmode launcher that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it consumes rockets and fires one of seven special rocket types, distinguished by color.
Celebration Mk2.tip: 50% chance to save ammo · 'All good things end with a bang... or many!'

Confetti.name: Confetti
Confetti.desc: Confetti is a crafting material used to make several festive items. It is purchased from the Party Girl for each, or dropped by Confetti Slimes.

Confetti Cannon.name: Confetti Cannon
Confetti Cannon.desc: The Confetti Cannon is a Hardmode novelty furniture/mechanism. It is purchased from the Party Girl for, when the Pirate is present. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing Left Click key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed).
Confetti Cannon.tip: Right click to adjust trajectory · Use a torch or wire signal to fire

Rampart of Deities.name: Rampart of Deities
Rampart of Deities.desc: The Rampart of Deities is a craftable post-Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Frozen Shield and Deific Amulet. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Rampart of Deities.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey (buff) after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace Panic Necklace's effect

Frozen Shield.name: Frozen Shield
Frozen Shield.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Frozen Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

Reality Rupture.name: Reality Rupture
Reality Rupture.desc: The Reality Rupture is a craftable post-Moon Lord non-consumable javelin which is a direct upgrade to the Spear of Destiny. It alternates between throwing 3 small homing spears which pierce twice, and 1 piercing lance which deals 400% base damage, but loses 5% damage on each hit.
Reality Rupture.tip: Cycles between throwing 3 small homing spears and throwing a single piercing lance · Stealth Strikes throw a high-velocity reality shattering lance that explodes on hit

Spear of Destiny.name: Spear of Destiny
Spear of Destiny.desc: The Spear of Destiny is a craftable Hardmode javelin. When used, it alternates between throwing 3 small homing spears and 1 piercing lance which deals 300% base damage, but loses 10% damage on each hit. Small spears have 2 extra updates, but lose 20% damage on each hit.
Spear of Destiny.tip: Cycles between throwing 3 small homing spears and throwing a single piercing lance · Stealth Strikes throw a high-velocity holy lance that explodes on hit

Reaper Tooth Necklace.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
Reaper Tooth Necklace.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.
Reaper Tooth Necklace.tip: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

Sand Shark Tooth Necklace.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
Sand Shark Tooth Necklace.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a craftable Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.
Sand Shark Tooth Necklace.tip: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage

Reaver Cuisses.name: Reaver Cuisses
Reaver Cuisses.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.

Reaver Dye.name: Reaver Dye
Reaver Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Reaver Headgear.name: Reaver Headgear
Reaver Headgear.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.
Reaver Headgear.tip: 20% increased mining speed · 50% increased block & wall placement speed · Grants immunity to lava and can move freely through liquids

Reaver Helm.name: Reaver Helm
Reaver Helm.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.
Reaver Helm.tip: +50 max life and +4 HP/s life regen

Reaver Scale Mail.name: Reaver Scale Mail
Reaver Scale Mail.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.

Reaver Visage.name: Reaver Visage
Reaver Visage.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.
Reaver Visage.tip: 15% increased movement speed and 10% increased jump speed

Samsara Slicer.name: Samsara Slicer
Samsara Slicer.desc: The Samsara Slicer is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a disk that quickly returns to the player after hitting an enemy or after traveling for a short distance.
Samsara Slicer.tip: Throws a disk that has a chance to generate several disks if enemies are near it · Stealth strikes shred enemies and are rapidly orbited by the smaller disks

Recall Potion.name: Recall Potion
Recall Potion.desc: The Recall Potion is a potion that will teleport the player to their spawn point 0.166666666 (10 ticks) after being used. It is identical in function to a Magic Mirror or Ice Mirror, but significantly faster in use time.

Recitation of the Beast.name: Recitation of the Beast
Recitation of the Beast.desc: The Recitation of the Beast is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome and the direct upgrade to the Demon Scythe. When used, it casts a ring of six homing Beast Scythes around the player that then fly off toward the cursor.
Recitation of the Beast.tip: Summons beast scythes around the player in a small circle · Beast scythes fire toward the cursor and home in to nearby enemies

Demon Scythe.name: Demon Scythe
Demon Scythe.desc: The Demon Scythe is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 1/35 chance of being dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons. When used, it fires a sickle projectile that is initially static before gradually accelerating.

Recon Scope.name: Recon Scope
Recon Scope.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Recon Scope.tip: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

Rifle Scope.name: Rifle Scope
Rifle Scope.desc: The Rifle Scope is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory. It grants the ability to increase view range while holding a gun by pressing and holding Right Click and moving the cursor.
Rifle Scope.tip: Increases view range for guns · Right click to zoom out

Red Seeking Mechanism.name: Red Seeking Mechanism
Red Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

Red Sun.name: Red Sun
Red Sun.desc: The Red Sun is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer broadsword. When it is swung, a large number of solar flares fall from the sky at varying speeds and angles. The flares explode after some time or upon hitting an enemy, releasing multiple homing fragments when they do.
Red Sun.tip: Drops a barrage of solar flares from the sky · 'Over paradise'

Mandible Blade.name: Mandible Blade
Mandible Blade.desc: The Mandible Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Antlion Chargers and Antlion Swarmers.

Red Wine.name: Red Wine
Red Wine.desc: Red Wine is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, vertical speed is increased by 10%, but flight time is reduced by 25%.
Red Wine.tip: 10% increased vertical speed · 25% decreased flight time · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Fire Feather.name: Fire Feather
Fire Feather.desc: The Fire Feather is a Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft the Flame Wings. It has a 1/50 / 1/75 chance of being dropped by Red Devils in The Underworld after defeating any mechanical boss.

drops.chance: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 2% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 1.33%

Reed Blowgun.name: Reed Blowgun
Reed Blowgun.desc: The Reed Blowgun is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. It fires a stream of high velocity bubbles, and does not consume any ammo.
Reed Blowgun.tip: Fires a high-pressure stream of bubbles · 'The Old Sea Kingdom never truly sought to expand beyond its initial borders. · However, they had a perfect track record of repelling any invasions, thanks to their insurmountable advantage in the water.'

Reefclaw Hamaxe.name: Reefclaw Hamaxe
Reefclaw Hamaxe.desc: The Reefclaw Hamaxe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hamaxe.

Regeneration Potion.name: Regeneration Potion
Regeneration Potion.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health.

Reinforced Crate.name: Reinforced Crate
Reinforced Crate.desc: Laboratory furniture are a set of furniture items that are usually found in Arsenal Labs. Aged and normal Laboratory variants can be crafted using Dubious Plating and either Laboratory Platings or Rusted Platings.

Rem's Revenge.name: Rem's Revenge
Rem's Revenge.desc: The Rem's Revenge is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail. When used, it spins a flail around the player, throwing out the flail towards the cursor when the attack button is released. Upon travelling far enough or on contact with 4 targets, the flail returns to the player.
Rem's Revenge.tip: Summons blood explosions and inflicts Wither on hit · 'A deadly morning star befitting its demonic owner'

Repair Unit Cage.name: Repair Unit Cage
Repair Unit Cage.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Repair Unit.name: Repair Unit
Repair Unit.desc: The Repair Unit is a critter that can be found in all five Bio-center Labs. It passively walks back and forth, jumping over gaps and solid blocks in its path. Every 5 seconds, it will latch onto a nearby wall if available for up to 10.33 seconds or until it leaves a wall.

Requiem (Lore).name: Requiem (Lore)
Requiem (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Requiem (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Moon Lord Trophy.name: Moon Lord Trophy
Moon Lord Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Respiteblock.name: Respiteblock
Respiteblock.desc: The Respiteblock is a craftable Hardmode chainsaw that is a direct upgrade to the Butcher's Chainsaw. When used, it rapidly fires gravity-affected green and purple blood that pierce 4 times and deal 40% of the weapon's damage.
Respiteblock.tip: A glistening white chainsaw that spews green and purple blood all over · Hitting enemies with the blade will heal you and deal immense damage · 'It's Ok To Be Dangerous'

Butcher's Chainsaw.name: Butcher's Chainsaw
Butcher's Chainsaw.desc: The Butcher's Chainsaw is a Hardmode, post-Plantera chainsaw that has a 1/40 / 79/1600 chance to drop from Butchers during the Solar Eclipse event.

Resurrection Butterfly.name: Resurrection Butterfly
Resurrection Butterfly.desc: The Resurrection Butterfly is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used with 2 or more minion slots, it summons two butterflies of different colors.
Resurrection Butterfly.tip: Summons a pair of butterflies to fight for you · 'Remembering the melancholy of human existence · Even ghosts stray from the path of righteousness'

Butterfly Dust.name: Butterfly Dust
Butterfly Dust.desc: Butterfly Dust is a rare Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Butterfly Wings. It has a 1/2 chance of being dropped by Moths in the Underground Jungle.

Rift Reeler.name: Rift Reeler
Rift Reeler.desc: The Rift Reeler is a craftable Hardmode fishing pole. When swung, four fishing lines are deployed at once instead of one. In addition to this, it can be used to fish in Lava.
Rift Reeler.tip: Fires four lines at once. Bobbers deal damage upon contact with enemies · Allows fishing in lava · 'The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. · The winner will be the one who controls that chaos, both the pole and the fish.'

Hotline Fishing Hook.name: Hotline Fishing Hook
Hotline Fishing Hook.desc: Fishing poles are tools used with bait for fishing.

Phantasm.name: Phantasm
Phantasm.desc: The Phantasm is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist bow. When used, it fires a burst of four arrows that are loosely grouped together, while only consuming one arrow per use. Its fire rate will gradually increase while in use.

Riptide.name: Riptide
Riptide.desc: The Riptide is a craftable Pre-Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, the yoyo will fire streams of water in a clockwise spiral, each piercing once.
Riptide.tip: Reach: 18 tiles · Speed: 25 · Duration: 18 seconds · Sprays a spiral of aqua streams

Ritual Candle.name: Ritual Candle
Ritual Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Rocket I.name: Rocket I
Rocket I.desc: Rockets are a Hardmode, post-Plantera type of ammunition which are mainly sold by the Cyborg. The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.
Rocket I.tip: Small blast radius. Will not destroy tiles

Rocket II.name: Rocket II
Rocket II.desc: Rockets are a Hardmode, post-Plantera type of ammunition which are mainly sold by the Cyborg. The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.
Rocket II.tip: Small blast radius. Will destroy tiles

Summoner Emblem.name: Summoner Emblem
Summoner Emblem.desc: The Summoner Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases summon damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panel Wall.name: Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panel Wall
Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panel Wall.desc: Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panel Walls are background walls crafted with Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels.

Roxcalibur.name: Roxcalibur
Roxcalibur.desc: Roxcalibur is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that can also be found in Pre-Hardmode, though the sword cannot be swung until the Wall of Flesh is defeated.
Roxcalibur.tip: Hold Left Click to charge up a strike · Release with the cursor above you to swing normally, releasing rock shards · Release with the cursor below you to dive downwards and bounce off enemies · Diving into blocks creates a shockwave · You couldn't get it out of the rock, so you just brought the rock instead

Rubber Mortar Round.name: Rubber Mortar Round
Rubber Mortar Round.desc: Rubber Mortar Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets that are an upgrade to Mortar Rounds. They can be used by any gun that does not shoot custom bullets. They bounce up to two times, creating a large explosion that is able to destroy tiles on each bounce.
Rubber Mortar Round.tip: Specialized high explosive rounds · Large blast radius. Will destroy tiles on each bounce · Used by normal guns

Rubico Prime.name: Rubico Prime
Rubico Prime.desc: The Rubico Prime is a craftable Hardmode gun that is a direct upgrade to the Nitro Express Rifle. When used, it fires bullets at a high velocity, producing recoil. Every 5 shots, the weapon must be reloaded. Its shots can hit up to 5 targets.
Rubico Prime.tip: A powerful sniper rifle that must reload after 5 shots · Fires impact rounds that deal increased critical damage

Rum.name: Rum
Rum.desc: Rum is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Rum debuff, which multiplies summon damage that aren't minions or minion shots by 1.15x but multiplies damage of minions and minion shots by 0.85x.
Rum.tip: 15% increased non-minion summon damage · 15% decreased minion damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Runestone.name: Runestone
Runestone.desc: Runestone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Navystone into Shimmer.

Runestone Wall.name: Runestone Wall
Runestone Wall.desc: Runestone Wall is a background wall crafted with Runestone.

Runic Profaned Brick.name: Runic Profaned Brick
Runic Profaned Brick.desc: Runic Profaned Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Profaned Rocks and Profaned Crystals at a Hardmode Forge.

Runic Profaned Brick Wall.name: Runic Profaned Brick Wall
Runic Profaned Brick Wall.desc: Runic Profaned Brick Wall is a post-Moon Lord background wall crafted with Runic Profaned Brick.

Rusted Plate Beam.name: Rusted Plate Beam
Rusted Plate Beam.desc: Rusted Plate Beams are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.

Rusted Plate Pillar.name: Rusted Plate Pillar
Rusted Plate Pillar.desc: Rusted Plate Pillars are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.

Rusted Plating Wall.name: Rusted Plating Wall
Rusted Plating Wall.desc: Rusted Plating Walls are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.

Rusty Chest.name: Rusty Chest
Rusty Chest.desc: Rusty Chests are chests found only in the Sulphurous Sea that contain rare and unique items. Each Rusty Chest will contain one unique item along with other standard loot.

Sacred Strawberry.name: Sacred Strawberry
Sacred Strawberry.desc: The Sacred Strawberry is a craftable post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Miracle Fruit, and the Tainted Cloudberry.
Sacred Strawberry.tip: Permanently increases maximum life by 25 · Can only be used once and requires the max amount of Life Fruits consumed · Though somewhat bland, what taste can be described is unlike any other experienced

Sacrilegious Bathtub.name: Sacrilegious Bathtub
Sacrilegious Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Bed.name: Sacrilegious Bed
Sacrilegious Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Bench.name: Sacrilegious Bench
Sacrilegious Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Sacrilegious Bookcase.name: Sacrilegious Bookcase
Sacrilegious Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Candelabra.name: Sacrilegious Candelabra
Sacrilegious Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Candle.name: Sacrilegious Candle
Sacrilegious Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Sacrilegious Chair.name: Sacrilegious Chair
Sacrilegious Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Sacrilegious Chandelier.name: Sacrilegious Chandelier
Sacrilegious Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Chest.name: Sacrilegious Chest
Sacrilegious Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Sacrilegious Clock.name: Sacrilegious Clock
Sacrilegious Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Door.name: Sacrilegious Door
Sacrilegious Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Dresser.name: Sacrilegious Dresser
Sacrilegious Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Lamp.name: Sacrilegious Lamp
Sacrilegious Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Lantern.name: Sacrilegious Lantern
Sacrilegious Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Organ.name: Sacrilegious Organ
Sacrilegious Organ.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Sink.name: Sacrilegious Sink
Sacrilegious Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Table.name: Sacrilegious Table
Sacrilegious Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sacrilegious Work Bench.name: Sacrilegious Work Bench
Sacrilegious Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sand Block.name: Sand Block
Sand Block.desc: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions.
Sand Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you
stats: Until the player gets out from under the Sand Blocks

Shark Tooth Necklace.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
Shark Tooth Necklace.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 / 1/75 chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by when equipped.

Sand Sharknado Staff.name: Sand Sharknado Staff
Sand Sharknado Staff.desc: The Sand Sharknado Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Forgotten Apex Wand. When used, it summons a sandnado to attack nearby enemies by firing miniature high velocity Sand Sharks at them.
Sand Sharknado Staff.tip: Summons a sandnado to fight for you

Sandblaster.name: Sandblaster
Sandblaster.desc: The Sandblaster is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Sandgun. When used, it uses Sand Blocks as ammo and fires non-piercing sand blasts which explode into a visual eruption of sand particles on impact.
Sandblaster.tip: Fires sand bullets that explode and slow enemies on hit · Uses sand as ammo · 50% chance to save ammo

Sandgun.name: Sandgun
Sandgun.desc: The Sandgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires sand ball projectiles that are affected by gravity. Upon contact with an enemy or block, the sand ball turns into its respective form of block (if the space is not occupied).

Sandstone Block.name: Sandstone Block
Sandstone Block.desc: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome. Like Sand and Hardened Sand, they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption, Crimson, and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone, Crimsandstone, and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Sandstorm in a Bottle.name: Sandstorm in a Bottle
Sandstorm in a Bottle.desc: The Sandstorm in a Bottle is an accessory found inside Gold Chests within Pyramids. it can also be obtained by throwing a Pharaoh's Mask into Shimmer, opening Oasis/Mirage Crates, and via crafting in Hardmode.
Sandstorm in a Bottle.tip: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump

Sandstorm's Core.name: Sandstorm's Core
Sandstorm's Core.desc: The Sandstorm's Core is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons the Great Sand Shark. It can only be used in the Desert or Underground Desert. When used, it will also start a Sandstorm event.
Sandstorm's Core.tip: Summons the Great Sand Shark when used in the desert · Not consumable

Sanguine Flare.name: Sanguine Flare
Sanguine Flare.desc: The Sanguine Flare is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it charges a flare for up to 3 seconds. Upon reaching max charge or releasing early, the flare shoots out to damage the first enemy hit for up to 500% damage scaling with charge time.
Sanguine Flare.tip: Charges up a sanguine flare that gains power over time · When striking an enemy, this flare causes a bloodsplosion and splits into blood orbs · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness

Sanguine Tangerine.name: Sanguine Tangerine
Sanguine Tangerine.desc: The Sanguine Tangerine is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Miracle Fruit, the Tainted Cloudberry, and the Sacred Strawberry.
Sanguine Tangerine.tip: Permanently increases maximum life by 25 · Can only be used once and requires the max amount of Life Fruits consumed · It has a distinctly sweet flavor and a strong aroma

Saros Possession.name: Saros Possession
Saros Possession.desc: Saros Possession is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to Sirius. When used, it summons a spinning solar aura that fires homing light orbs that can bounce between enemies and pierce twice.
Saros Possession.tip: Summons a radiant aura harnessing the power of primordial light · Repeated summons increase the power of the aura · Left Click with full summon slots to channel Totality Ray · Totality Ray decays while in use and recharges when not in use · 'A ballet of light and shadow, torn from the sky'

Sirius.name: Sirius
Sirius.desc: Sirius is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Vengeful Sun Staff. When used, it summons a star which hovers over the player and fires homing fireballs at enemies.
Sirius.tip: Summons the brightest star in the sky, Sirius, to protect you · Continue summoning to complete Canis Major · Repeated summons increase its power greatly, even after the constellation is complete · Sirius passively generates Starbursts when targeting enemies · When Starbursts are full, Sirius consumes them to launch a powerful piercing quasar that inflicts Voidfrost · 'A guide to a dream never realized'

Sashimi.name: Sashimi
Sashimi.desc: Sashimi is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Sashimi.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'It's raw! It's exotic!'

Crag Bullhead.name: Crag Bullhead
Crag Bullhead.desc: The Crag Bullhead is a fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag. It is used to craft Sashimi.

Scab Ripper.name: Scab Ripper
Scab Ripper.desc: The Scab Ripper is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a tiny Blood Crawler minion that flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it deals contact damage in addition to spawning 2 damaging blood particles from the sky that pierce once.
Scab Ripper.tip: Summons a baby blood crawler to protect you

Shadewood.name: Shadewood
Shadewood.desc: Shadewood is a type of wood harvested from Shadewood trees and Shadewood Palm trees found naturally growing in Crimson biomes.

Tissue Sample.name: Tissue Sample
Tissue Sample.desc: The Tissue Sample is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from Creepers (and the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Scarlet Devil.name: Scarlet Devil
Scarlet Devil.desc: The Scarlet Devil is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer javelin. When used, it throws an extremely fast spear that pierces 4 times and releases scarlet bullets as it travels. The scarlet bullets are not affected by gravity and home in on enemies after a short delay.
Scarlet Devil.tip: Throws an ultra high velocity spear, which leaves a trail of homing bullets · The spear creates a Scarlet Blast upon hitting an enemy · Stealth strikes grant you lifesteal and summon a star of projectiles upon hitting an enemy · 'Divine Spear "Spear the Gungnir"'

Wrathwing.name: Wrathwing
Wrathwing.desc: The Wrathwing is a post-Moon Lord javelin that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it throws a fiery javelin which homes in on enemies while releasing gravity-affected fireballs as it travels, which explode violently on contact.
Wrathwing.tip: Throws an agile, homing winged spear that constantly spits Dragonfire · Stealth strikes create an eruption of cinders on hit

Schematic (Sunken Sea).name: Schematic (Sunken Sea)
Schematic (Sunken Sea).desc: Schematics are items found in all five Bio-center Labs. They are used to unlock various items crafted with Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry by decrypting them with Draedon Power Cells at The Codebreaker.

Scorched Bone Wall.name: Scorched Bone Wall
Scorched Bone Wall.desc: Scorched Bone Walls are background walls crafted with Scorched Bones.

Scorpio.name: Scorpio
Scorpio.desc: The Scorpio is a craftable Hardmode launcher. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it warms up for a moment before firing a burst of 7 nano missiles (consuming one rocket per missile fired), with a short cooldown between each burst.
Scorpio.tip: Hold Left Click to fire a barrage of homing nano missiles and charge energy · Maximum charge is reached after firing 3 barrages · Right Click while holding Left Click at max charge to launch a nano nuke · Nano nukes deal massive damage and reset the cooldown of missile barrages

Scoria Brick.name: Scoria Brick
Scoria Brick.desc: Scoria Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Scoria Ore at a Furnace.

Scoria Brick Wall.name: Scoria Brick Wall
Scoria Brick Wall.desc: Scoria Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Scoria Brick.

Scoria Dye.name: Scoria Dye
Scoria Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Snowman Cannon.name: Snowman Cannon
Snowman Cannon.desc: The Snowman Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave..

Scourge of the Cosmos.name: Scourge of the Cosmos
Scourge of the Cosmos.desc: The Scourge of the Cosmos is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade of the Scourge of the Corruptor. When used, it throws a mini scourge head that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and bounces twice before dissipating.
Scourge of the Cosmos.tip: Throws a bouncing cosmic scourge that emits tiny homing cosmic scourges on enemy and tile hits

Scourge of the Corruptor.name: Scourge of the Corruptor
Scourge of the Corruptor.desc: The Scourge of the Corruptor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When used, it fires an Eater's Bite, a fast javelin-like projectile, that splits into weaker Tiny Eater projectiles upon contact with enemies or blocks.
Scourge of the Corruptor.tip: A powerful javelin that unleashes tiny eaters

Screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
Screwdriver.desc: Screwdriver is a craftable Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Screwdriver debuff, which increases building range by 5 tiles and tile and wall placement speed by 100%, but multiplies all damage by 0.75x.
Screwdriver.tip: Greatly increases tile and wall placement range and speed · Greatly reduces damage dealt · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

SDFMG.name: SDFMG
SDFMG.desc: The SDFMG (or Space Duke Fishron Machine Gun) is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the S.D.M.G. when used, it rapidly fires bullets, with every seventh shot instead firing a water rocket that homes in on nearby enemies.
SDFMG.tip: 66% chance to save ammo · 'It came from the edge of Terraria'

S.D.M.G..name: S.D.M.G.
S.D.M.G..desc: The S.D.M.G. (Space Dolphin Machine Gun) is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also has a 66% chance not to consume ammunition. The S.D.M.G.
S.D.M.G..tip: 66% chance to save ammo · 'It came from the edge of space'

Sea Minnow Jar.name: Sea Minnow Jar
Sea Minnow Jar.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Sea Prism Brick.name: Sea Prism Brick
Sea Prism Brick.desc: Sea Prism Brick is a craftable brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Sea Prisms at a Furnace.

Seashell.name: Seashell
Seashell.desc: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.
Seashell.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Starfish.name: Starfish
Starfish.desc: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.
Starfish.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Seadragon.name: Seadragon
Seadragon.desc: The Seadragon is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is an upgrade to the Megalodon. When used, it loads a magazine of 50 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and pressurized water jets that inflict the Riptide debuff.
Seadragon.tip: Loads a 50 round magazine of alternating bullets and pressurized water jets · Water jets summon small fish that swim around you · When all bullets are fired, summoned fish swarm the cursor while you reload · 66% chance to save ammo

Bomb.name: Bomb
Bomb.desc: The Bomb is an explosive that explodes 3 seconds after being thrown. The explosion breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a 4-tile radius, except explosion-proof objects.
Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will destroy most tiles

Seafood.name: Seafood
Seafood.desc: Seafood is a craftable boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Aquatic Scourge. It can only be used in the Sulphurous Sea.
Seafood.tip: Summons the Aquatic Scourge when used in the Sulphurous Sea · Enrages outside the Sulphurous Sea · Not consumable · 'Large bait for a large catch. Beware the monsters of the seas.'

Seafood Dinner.name: Seafood Dinner
Seafood Dinner.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Seafood Dinner.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'I sea food, I eat it.'

Sunken Sailfish.name: Sunken Sailfish
Sunken Sailfish.desc: The Sunken Sailfish is a fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea with a 15% chance. It is used for the crafting of the Soaring Potion and Seafood Dinner.

Bloodfin.name: Bloodfin
Bloodfin.desc: The Bloodfin is a post-Moon Lord healing potion-type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.
Bloodfin.tip: Grants a buff that restores 1 HP every 0.25 seconds · 10 second duration · 'The wonders of angiogenesis'

Shadowfish.name: Shadowfish
Shadowfish.desc: The Shadowfish is an uncommon fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag or during the night while below the Space layer. It is used for the crafting of the Shadow Potion and Seafood Dinner.

Sealed Singularity.name: Sealed Singularity
Sealed Singularity.desc: The Sealed Singularity is a craftable post-Moon Lord bomb. When used, it throws a circular, void-containing flask that stops moving after a short time, shattering if enough time has passed or upon any collision with solid tiles or enemies.
Sealed Singularity.tip: Disables normal stealth generation · Throws a contained singularity bomb that slows down and creates a damaging field after a short fuse · Hold Left Click to generate stealth, but burn through the bomb's fuse · After the field collapses, the singularity seeks out the strongest target that it hit and explodes · Stealth strikes increase the size and duration of the damaging field · Will explode in your hand if you hold the fuse too long

Seashine Sword.name: Seashine Sword
Seashine Sword.desc: The Seashine Sword is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a glowing aquamarine sword beam that deals 100% base damage. The beam disappears upon hitting a block or an enemy, or after 2 seconds of travel.

Security Chest.name: Security Chest
Security Chest.desc: Security Chests are chests found only in the Arsenal Labs that contain rare and unique items. Each Security Chest will contain two or more unique items depending on the type of lab, along with other standard loot.

Seeking Scorcher.name: Seeking Scorcher
Seeking Scorcher.desc: The Seeking Scorcher is a craftable post-Moon Lord thrown melee weapon and the direct upgrade of the Possessed Hatchet. When used, it throws a massive crystalline hatchet which can bounce between up to four enemies, losing 20% damage per hit.
Seeking Scorcher.tip: Throws a massive crystalline axe which bounces to three additional targets after hitting · Crystallizes in place if all bounces have not been exhausted · Crystallized hatchets can be shattered by another axe · Doing so empowers the hatchet based on the amount shattered but prevents it from crystallizing · 'May your enemies burn in hell for the sins they have committed'

Possessed Hatchet.name: Possessed Hatchet
Possessed Hatchet.desc: The Possessed Hatchet is a Hardmode, post-Golem boomerang that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped from Golem. When thrown, it homes in on enemies within 50 tiles and inflicts the Hemorrhage debuff on hit.

Seismic Hampick.name: Seismic Hampick
Seismic Hampick.desc: The Seismic Hampick is a Hardmode pickaxe and hammer combination that is capable of mining blocks up to Lihzahrd Brick and Scoria Ore. Left clicking allows it to be used as a pickaxe, while right clicking allows it to be used as a hammer.
Seismic Hampick.tip: Capable of mining Lihzahrd Bricks · Press Left Click to use as a pickaxe · Press Right Click to use as a hammer

Seraph Tracers.name: Seraph Tracers
Seraph Tracers.desc: The Seraph Tracers are a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. They are the direct upgrade to the Void Striders and final upgrade to the Hermes Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Seraph Tracers.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Angel Wings wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

Void Striders.name: Void Striders
Void Striders.desc: Void Striders are a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Void Striders.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Angel Wings wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'

Seraphim.name: Seraphim
Seraphim.desc: The Seraphim is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Shattered Dawn and the final upgrade to the Wulfrum Knife.
Seraphim.tip: Throws an extraordinarily fast dagger which slows down exponentially and dissipates into light · Once dissipation has ended, 6 splitting blades that slice nearby targets are released, along with a large laserbeam · Stealth strikes release a volley of 8 lights which explode into smaller laser beams along with the dagger

Shattered Dawn.name: Shattered Dawn
Shattered Dawn.desc: The Shattered Dawn is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Radiant Star. When used, it throws a profaned dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces infinitely.
Shattered Dawn.tip: Throws daggers that split into scorching homing daggers · Stealth strikes fire volleys of homing daggers from the player on dagger hits that suck enemies in

Sergeant United Shield.name: Sergeant United Shield
Sergeant United Shield.desc: The Sergeant United Shield is a Hardmode boomerang that is rarely sold by the Traveling Merchant for. When thrown, it homes in on enemies within 50 tiles and will attempt to hit up to five enemies before returning to the player, but loses 20% of its damage for each enemy struck..

Crystal Storm.name: Crystal Storm
Crystal Storm.desc: The Crystal Storm is a Hardmode spell book that rapidly fires a slight spread of small crystal shards. The shards last for 150 ticks each and slow down as they travel. They can bounce off blocks an unlimited amount of times for their duration, and do not pierce.

Shadow Potion.name: Shadow Potion
Shadow Potion.desc: The Shadow Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:
Shadow Potion.tip: 8% increased stealth generation · Turns the player into a shadow with glowing eyes · Visual effects can be disabled with the Stealth Invisibility config

Blinkroot.name: Blinkroot
Blinkroot.desc: Blinkroot is a type of herb that appears as stems with glowing dots.

Shadowbolt Staff.name: Shadowbolt Staff
Shadowbolt Staff.desc: The Shadowbolt Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Shadowbeam Staff. When used, it fires a shadowbolt that can pass through tiles.
Shadowbolt Staff.tip: Fires a shadow beam that creates a platform to redirect itself back at enemies for increased damage

Shadowbeam Staff.name: Shadowbeam Staff
Shadowbeam Staff.desc: The Shadowbeam Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 / 39/400 chance of being dropped by Necromancers in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a purple beam that travels almost instantly to its maximum distance (112.5 tiles), bouncing off blocks on impact.
Shadowbeam Staff.tip: Creates a shadow beam that bounces off walls

drops.chance: 5% (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 2.5% (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)9.75%

Shadowspec Dye.name: Shadowspec Dye
Shadowspec Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Shard of Antumbra.name: Shard of Antumbra
Shard of Antumbra.desc: The Shard of Antumbra is a craftable Hardmode rogue javelin. It pierces infinitely and travels significant distances before being affected by gravity. Its damage is decreased by 10% every time it pierces an enemy.
Shard of Antumbra.tip: Throws a cosmic javelin that sticks into enemies and tiles, creating a small rift nearby on enemy hits · After hitting a target, it will charge with energy and teleport to the rift, aiming itself at the nearest target · Stealth strikes create a multitude of rifts to spawn additional javelins upon teleporting

Shardlight Pickaxe.name: Shardlight Pickaxe
Shardlight Pickaxe.desc: The Shardlight Pickaxe is a craftable Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Adamantite Ore, Titanium Ore and Hallowed Ore. It inflicts the Frostbite debuff on contact.

Shattered Community.name: Shattered Community
Shattered Community.desc: The Shattered Community is a post-Moon Lord developer accessory. It is the exhumed form of The Community. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Shattered Community.tip: 'Ruined by unknowable hatred, it still contains (most of) the power of The Community...' · Increases damage, max health, and movement speed by 10% · Increases defense by 10, and life regen by 1 HP/s · Increases critical strike chance and damage reduction by 5%, and flight time by 20% · You generate rage over time and rage does not fade out of combat · Gain rage after taking damage regardless of defensive stats · While Rage Mode is active, taking damage gives only half as much rage · Deal damage with Rage Mode to further empower your wrath · Current level: [LEVEL] (+[BOOST]% Rage Mode damage) · Progress to next level: [PROGRESS RATIO]% · Total Rage Mode damage: [CUMULATIVE DAMAGE DEALT]

The Community.name: The Community
The Community.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.
The Community.tip: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

Shell Trim Brick Wall.name: Shell Trim Brick Wall
Shell Trim Brick Wall.desc: Shell Trim Brick Walls are unobtainable background walls. They can be crafted with the unobtainable Shell Trim Brick.

Shell Trim Brick.name: Shell Trim Brick
Shell Trim Brick.desc: Shell Trim Brick is an unobtainable block.

Shellstone Wall.name: Shellstone Wall
Shellstone Wall.desc: Shellstone Wall is a background wall crafted with Shellstone at a Work Bench.

Shellstone Slab.name: Shellstone Slab
Shellstone Slab.desc: Shellstone Slab is a Pre-Hardmode block crafted from Shellstone at a Heavy Work Bench.

Shellstone Slab Wall.name: Shellstone Slab Wall
Shellstone Slab Wall.desc: Shellstone Slab Wall is a background wall crafted with Shellstone Slab at a Work Bench.

Shield of the High Ruler.name: Shield of the High Ruler
Shield of the High Ruler.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a craftable Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Shield of the High Ruler.tip: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

Shield of Cthulhu.name: Shield of Cthulhu
Shield of Cthulhu.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.
Shield of Cthulhu.tip: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction

Shield of the Ocean.name: Shield of the Ocean
Shield of the Ocean.desc: The Shield of the Ocean is a craftable Pre-Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Shield of the Ocean.tip: Increased defense by 5 when submerged in liquid · 10% increased movement speed and +1 HP/s life regen while wearing Victide armor

Shifting Sands.name: Shifting Sands
Shifting Sands.desc: The Shifting Sands is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Magic Missile. When used, it fires a sand shard that follows the cursor and pierces 4 times before exploding on the fifth or upon tile contact.
Shifting Sands.tip: Casts a sand shard that follows the mouse cursor

Shimmerspark.name: Shimmerspark
Shimmerspark.desc: The Shimmerspark is a craftable Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it fires slow-moving purple stars towards enemies within 20 tiles. The stars do not pierce or go through tiles, and they inflict the Frostbite debuff on hit.
Shimmerspark.tip: Reach: 28 tiles · Speed: 36 · Infinite throw duration · Fires stars when enemies are near

Shine Potion.name: Shine Potion
Shine Potion.desc: The Shine Potion is a buff potion which grants the Shine buff when consumed. The buff makes the player glow brightly, which is useful for exploring caves or while exploring underwater.

Shiny Red Balloon.name: Shiny Red Balloon
Shiny Red Balloon.desc: The Shiny Red Balloon is an accessory that increases the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the height that the player can jump from 6 tiles to ~10½ tiles, effectively a ~75% boost.

White String.name: White String
White String.desc: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos.

SHPC.name: SHPC
SHPC.desc: The SHPC (or Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon) is a craftable Hardmode magic gun.
SHPC.tip: Consumes Souls as ammo · Ejects orbs of unstable, concentrated soulpower that linger and explode · Orbs emit seeking souls and lingering pickup souls after collapse · Orbs have varying effects depending on Soul type used · [SOUL DESCRIPTION] · Press Right Click to use the machine as a vacuum, pulling in lingering souls · Once released, a torrent of soul lasers is discharged scaling with the number of souls pulled in · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to eject the currently loaded Soul · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer'Though soul-powered machines were a near failure, potential remained in souls as a form of fuel. · To avoid my last experiments' main flaw, the Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon was designed to expel souls as projectiles before they exert control over the weapon. · Each soul type appears to react differently to the base plasma. Yet, lacking volunteers, obtaining potential ammunition is currently too difficult to undergo further testing. · A shame, for a weapon that could have practically unlimited ammunition in the battlefield. Perhaps some day, its potential can be truly tested.'

Prototype Plasma Drive.name: Prototype Plasma Drive
Prototype Plasma Drive.desc: The Prototype Plasma Drive is a crafting material obtained from the Security Chest found in the Planetoid Arsenal Lab in Space. It is used to craft the SHPC.
Prototype Plasma Drive.tip: Despite all the time it spent in storage, its furnace still burns strong

Suspicious Scrap.name: Suspicious Scrap
Suspicious Scrap.desc: Suspicious Scrap is a crafting material found in the Abandoned Research Facility and Abandoned Workshop variants of the Arsenal Labs in the Cavern layer. They are used to craft the SHPC.
Suspicious Scrap.tip: Looks like it may be part of a greater whole...

Frostbite Blaster.name: Frostbite Blaster
