Frostbite Blaster.desc: The Frostbite Blaster is a Hardmode gun that is sold by the Archmage for 20 gold. When used, it converts Musket Balls into icicles that inflict the Frostbite debuff.
Frostbite Blaster.tip: Fires a spread of 6 bullets · Converts musket balls into icicles

Shroom Bowl.name: Shroom Bowl
Shroom Bowl.desc: The Shroom Bowl is a craftable Pre-Hardmode food item. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 10 minutes.
Shroom Bowl.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'He has been grounded'

Shroomble.name: Shroomble
Shroomble.desc: The Shroomble is a critter that spawns on the Surface during the day. It passively walks back and forth and occasionally idles or jumps in place. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net.

Shroomble Cage.name: Shroomble Cage
Shroomble Cage.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Fungicide.name: Fungicide
Fungicide.desc: The Fungicide is a Pre-Hardmode gun that is dropped by Crabulon. When Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a fungus bullet that, upon impact with an enemy or tile, splits into smaller spores which are affected by gravity.
Fungicide.tip: Converts musket balls into fungal rounds that split upon impact

Celestial Emblem.name: Celestial Emblem
Celestial Emblem.desc: The Celestial Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that offers 15% increased magic damage and a 18.75-tile increased pickup range for Stars (21.375 tile total range).
Celestial Emblem.tip: Increases pickup range for mana stars · 15% increased magic damage

Signus (Lore).name: Signus (Lore)
Signus (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Signus (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Signus Trophy.name: Signus Trophy
Signus Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Silva Basin.name: Silva Basin
Silva Basin.desc: Basins are furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. Unlike the other furniture sets, only six types of basins exist in the Calamity Mod.

Silva Crystal.name: Silva Crystal
Silva Crystal.desc: Silva Crystal is a craftable post-Moon Lord block. It is used in the crafting of Silva furniture.

Silva Bathtub.name: Silva Bathtub
Silva Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Bed.name: Silva Bed
Silva Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Bench.name: Silva Bench
Silva Bench.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Silva Bookcase.name: Silva Bookcase
Silva Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Candelabra.name: Silva Candelabra
Silva Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Candle.name: Silva Candle
Silva Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Silva Chandelier.name: Silva Chandelier
Silva Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Chest.name: Silva Chest
Silva Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Silva Clock.name: Silva Clock
Silva Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Platform.name: Silva Platform
Silva Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Silva Wall.name: Silva Wall
Silva Wall.desc: Silva Wall is a background wall crafted with Silva Crystal.

Silva Door.name: Silva Door
Silva Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Dresser.name: Silva Dresser
Silva Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Dye.name: Silva Dye
Silva Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Silva Lamp.name: Silva Lamp
Silva Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Lantern.name: Silva Lantern
Silva Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Piano.name: Silva Piano
Silva Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Sink.name: Silva Sink
Silva Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Table.name: Silva Table
Silva Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Silva Wings.name: Silva Wings
Silva Wings.desc: Silva Wings are a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
Silva Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'The purest of nature'

Silva Work Bench.name: Silva Work Bench
Silva Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sirenproof Earmuffs.name: Sirenproof Earmuffs
Sirenproof Earmuffs.desc: The Sirenproof Earmuffs are a craftable Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable??? spawns.
Sirenproof Earmuffs.tip: Toggle this item to prevent Anahita from spawning · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Vengeful Sun Staff.name: Vengeful Sun Staff
Vengeful Sun Staff.desc: The Vengeful Sun Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Sun Spirit Staff. When used, it summons a Vengeful Solar Spirit above the player's head that fires yellow non-piercing beams at nearby enemies.
Vengeful Sun Staff.tip: Summons a sun spirit to protect you · Repeated summons eclipse the spirit and increase its power

Skeletron (Lore).name: Skeletron (Lore)
Skeletron (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Skeletron (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Skeletron Trophy.name: Skeletron Trophy
Skeletron Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Skeletron Prime (Lore).name: Skeletron Prime (Lore)
Skeletron Prime (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Skeletron Prime (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Skeletron Prime Trophy.name: Skeletron Prime Trophy
Skeletron Prime Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

Skyfin Bombers.name: Skyfin Bombers
Skyfin Bombers.desc: The Skyfin Bombers are a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, they fire a skyfin bomb that homes in on enemies below them, erupting into three sulphuric clouds on hit.
Skyfin Bombers.tip: Launches a skyfin nuke that homes in on enemies below it · Stealth strikes rapidly home in regardless of enemy position · 'Fishy bombers inbound!'

Contaminated Bile.name: Contaminated Bile
Contaminated Bile.desc: The Contaminated Bile is a Pre-Hardmode bomb dropped by Gnashers. It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.
Contaminated Bile.tip: Throws a flask of Irradiated bile which shatters and lingers in a cloud · Stealth strikes cause sulphuric bubbles to quickly rise from the cloud

Skyfringe Pickaxe.name: Skyfringe Pickaxe
Skyfringe Pickaxe.desc: The Skyfringe Pickaxe is a Pre-Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Cobalt Ore and Palladium Ore. It is one of the fastest pickaxes available before Hardmode.

Skyline Wings.name: Skyline Wings
Skyline Wings.desc: Skyline Wings are a craftable Pre-Hardmode wing-type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.
Skyline Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average

Skynamite.name: Skynamite
Skynamite.desc: Skynamite is a craftable Pre-Hardmode consumable explosive. When thrown, it explodes following a 5-second delay, breaking most nearby blocks, similarly to its predecessor Dynamite. Unlike other dynamites, the Skynamite is not affected by gravity and smoothly bounces off surfaces.
Skynamite.tip: Throws a floaty explosive that defies gravity · 'You don't need an aerodynamics major to use this...'

Dynamite.name: Dynamite
Dynamite.desc: Dynamite is an explosive that explodes 5 seconds after being thrown. The explosion breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a radius of 7 tiles, except explosion-proof objects.
Dynamite.tip: A large explosion that will destroy most tiles

Slag Crate.name: Slag Crate
Slag Crate.desc: The Slag Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in lava in the Brimstone Crag. The crate contains items found in standard crates. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Brimstone Crate.

Brimstone Crate.name: Brimstone Crate
Brimstone Crate.desc: The Brimstone Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in lava in the Brimstone Crag. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Slag Crate.

Slagsplitter Pauldron.name: Slagsplitter Pauldron
Slagsplitter Pauldron.desc: The Slagsplitter Pauldron is a craftable Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Slagsplitter Pauldron.tip: Your dashes become empowered by Hellfire, erupting on contact with enemies · Grants immunity to knockback and 10% damage reduction while dashing · Enemies hit by your dashes are afflicted with Armor Crunch · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

Slime God Dye.name: Slime God Dye
Slime God Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Slime Puppet Staff.name: Slime Puppet Staff
Slime Puppet Staff.desc: The Slime Puppet Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a floating slime ball that does not take up minion slots and follows slightly above the player.
Slime Puppet Staff.tip: Summons a slime ball that follows you · The ball flies toward nearby enemies and explodes into slime on enemy hits · Does not consume minion slots

Slime Staff.name: Slime Staff
Slime Staff.desc: The Slime Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Baby Slime minion. It bounces towards enemies, dealing contact damage.
Slime Staff.tip: Summons a baby slime to fight for you

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Gel.name: Gel
Gel.desc: Gel is a common crafting material dropped by most slimes and Slimed Zombies. Gel is vital due to it being an ingredient in Torches, and is used regularly from the beginning stages all the way through to endgame scenarios.

Sludge Splotch.name: Sludge Splotch
Sludge Splotch.desc: The Sludge Splotch is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon. It throws a gravity-affected sludge ball that inflicts the Slime debuff on enemies. The sludge ball dissipates upon hitting a tile or striking an enemy.
Sludge Splotch.tip: Stealth strikes cause the main ball of sludge to split on hit, inflicting more damage

Smoking Comet.name: Smoking Comet
Smoking Comet.desc: The Smoking Comet is a craftable Pre-Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it causes stars to rain from the sky, which pierce twice and can pass through tiles. The Smoking Comet's hitbox is also much larger than other yoyos.
Smoking Comet.tip: Reach: 20 tiles · Speed: 20 · Duration: 21 seconds · Rains stars from the sky

Smooth Abyss Gravel Platform.name: Smooth Abyss Gravel Platform
Smooth Abyss Gravel Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Smooth Abyss Gravel Wall.name: Smooth Abyss Gravel Wall
Smooth Abyss Gravel Wall.desc: Smooth Abyss Gravel Wall is a background wall crafted with Smooth Abyss Gravel.

Smooth Brimstone Slag Wall.name: Smooth Brimstone Slag Wall
Smooth Brimstone Slag Wall.desc: Smooth Brimstone Slag Wall is a background wall crafted from Smooth Brimstone Slag.

Smooth Navystone Wall.name: Smooth Navystone Wall
Smooth Navystone Wall.desc: Smooth Navystone Wall is a background wall crafted with Smooth Navystone.

Smooth Voidstone.name: Smooth Voidstone
Smooth Voidstone.desc: Smooth Voidstone is a craftable block crafted from Voidstone at a Work Bench. It is used in the crafting of Void furniture and the Hadal Urn.

Smooth Voidstone Platform.name: Smooth Voidstone Platform
Smooth Voidstone Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Smooth Voidstone Wall.name: Smooth Voidstone Wall
Smooth Voidstone Wall.desc: Smooth Voidstone Wall is a background wall crafted from Smooth Voidstone.

Snake Eyes.name: Snake Eyes
Snake Eyes.desc: The Snake Eyes is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. It summons a circular drone which primarily moves by teleporting in a random area that is close to its destination.
Snake Eyes.tip: Summons a levitating drone which fires piercing, highly calibrated energy bolts · If a bolt hits, the drone will teleport into its path and reflect the bolt · Reflected bolts home in and explode on impact · 'Equipped with high-end sensors, little can evade them. Even less are able to escape their ever watchful eyes. · An excellent bridge between my experiments with the sight-based soul powered machines and my latest project.'

Snow Block.name: Snow Block
Snow Block.desc: Snow Blocks are blocks found naturally-placed in the Snow biome. Snow Blocks placed in the Surface layer, either naturally or by a player, will cause a snowfall effect. This is purely visual, and has no functional effects.

Snow Coat.name: Snow Coat
Snow Coat.desc: Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Snow Hood, Snow Coat, and Snow Pants. Each piece has a 1/30 chance to be dropped by Frozen Zombies.

Snow Globe.name: Snow Globe
Snow Globe.desc: The Snow Globe is a Hardmode event-summoning item used to summon the Frost Legion event. The player also must have at least 200 maximum health to initiate the event, but can then be used in any world at any time afterward.

Snow Hood.name: Snow Hood
Snow Hood.desc: Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Snow Hood, Snow Coat, and Snow Pants. Each piece has a 1/30 chance to be dropped by Frozen Zombies.

Snow Pants.name: Snow Pants
Snow Pants.desc: Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Snow Hood, Snow Coat, and Snow Pants. Each piece has a 1/30 chance to be dropped by Frozen Zombies.

Snow Ruffian Chestplate.name: Snow Ruffian Chestplate
Snow Ruffian Chestplate.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set crafted from Boreal Wood, Silk and Flinx Fur.

Snow Ruffian Greaves.name: Snow Ruffian Greaves
Snow Ruffian Greaves.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set crafted from Boreal Wood, Silk and Flinx Fur.

Snow Ruffian Mask.name: Snow Ruffian Mask
Snow Ruffian Mask.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set crafted from Boreal Wood, Silk and Flinx Fur.

Snowball.name: Snowball
Snowball.desc: The Snowball is a consumable ranged weapon that can be crafted from Snow Blocks. Snowballs can also be used as ammunition for the Snowball Cannon.

Soaring Potion.name: Soaring Potion
Soaring Potion.desc: The Soaring Potion is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time by 10%.

Solar Wings.name: Solar Wings
Solar Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Beam Sword.name: Beam Sword
Beam Sword.desc: The Beam Sword is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Armored Skeletons. When swung, it fires a yellow Sword Beam projectile that can pierce one enemy or bounce off blocks three times before dissipating.

Soma Prime.name: Soma Prime
Soma Prime.desc: The Soma Prime is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also converts Musket Balls into high-damage High Velocity Bullets which have 4 additional base damage. Each shot has a 5% chance to inflict the Shred debuff.
Soma Prime.tip: This weapon can supercrit if its crit chance is over 100% · All bullets fired have a 5% chance to inflict Shred, a stacking bleed debuff · Critical strikes deal 3x damage instead of 2x by default and have a 30% chance to inflict Shred · Shred deals 600 DPS per stack and scales with your ranged stats · Damage ticks of Shred can critically strike for 3x damage and can supercrit · Replaces musket balls with enhanced High Velocity Bullets · 80% chance to save ammo

Venus Magnum.name: Venus Magnum
Venus Magnum.desc: The Venus Magnum is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage.
Venus Magnum.tip: Shoots a powerful, high velocity bullet

Sonar Potion.name: Sonar Potion
Sonar Potion.desc: The Sonar Potion is a buff potion which grants the Sonar buff when consumed. The buff displays the name of a fishing catch above a fishing pole's bobber when it receives a bite while fishing, along with a.

Soul Harvester.name: Soul Harvester
Soul Harvester.desc: The Soul Harvester is a craftable Hardmode broadsword. It works similarly to the Death Sickle, as it shoots out spinning plague scythes, which stop after a certain time and spin in place, inflicting the Plague debuff to enemies.
Soul Harvester.tip: Shoots a soul scythe · Enemies explode when on low health, spreading the plague

Soul Piercer.name: Soul Piercer
Soul Piercer.desc: The Soul Piercer is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a long-range beam that functions similarly to the Shadowbeam Staff.
Soul Piercer.tip: Casts a powerful ray that summons extra rays on its first hit

Cursed Dagger.name: Cursed Dagger
Cursed Dagger.desc: The Cursed Dagger is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Clingers. When used, it throws a set of three daggers with one always aimed at the cursor while the other two are inaccurate.
Cursed Dagger.tip: Throws a fast cursed dagger and two inaccurate weaker daggers · Stealth strikes throw a single dagger that bursts into a Cursed Inferno vortex

Spectralstorm Cannon.name: Spectralstorm Cannon
Spectralstorm Cannon.desc: The Spectralstorm Cannon is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade of the Firestorm Cannon. It uses Flares as ammunition and has a 33% chance of not consuming flares.
Spectralstorm Cannon.tip: Fires a barrage of spectral Nightwither flares that builds up a searing heat in the weapon · While cooling down, heat-seeking phantoms are continuously released · Firing for too long overheats the weapon, leaving it unusable for a short period and inflicting you with Nightwither · However, triggering overheat releases a powerful burst of souls and resets heat · Press Right Click to put away the weapon, which preserves its heat · 33% chance to save ammo · 'Ectoplasmic blast rated visor mandatory'

Speed Blaster.name: Speed Blaster
Speed Blaster.desc: The Speed Blaster is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Paintball Gun. When used, it fires 1 paintball per shot. Paintball shots have a short range and low accuracy by default and drop visual paint on collision that slowly fades away overtime.
Speed Blaster.tip: Rapidly fires phosphorescent paintball shots · Press Right Click to eject a powerful paint stream of a different color · Using this ability rapidly propels you in the direction you are moving · This ability has a 5 second cooldown · During this cooldown, you fire more rapidly with greater accuracy

Paintball Gun.name: Paintball Gun
Paintball Gun.desc: The Paintball Gun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires a three-shot burst of slow-moving, arcing multicolored Paintball projectiles which consume no mana or ammunition, dissipating upon contact with an enemy or surface.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Spelunker's Amulet.name: Spelunker's Amulet
Spelunker's Amulet.desc: The Spelunker's Amulet is a craftable Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it increases mining speed by 10% and grants the player the Spelunker Potion effect, which reveals the location of ores, herbs, chests, etc.
Spelunker's Amulet.tip: Spelunker effect and 10% increased mining speed

Gold Dust.name: Gold Dust
Gold Dust.desc: Gold Dust is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Merchant for each. Its sole purpose is to craft the Flask of Gold and Golden Bullets, which both allow the player to inflict the Midas debuff.

Desert Spirit Lamp.name: Desert Spirit Lamp
Desert Spirit Lamp.desc: The Desert Spirit Lamp is a decorative Hardmode furniture item and crafting material. It can only be placed on flat-surface furniture. It has a 1/40 chance of being dropped from Desert Spirits, which can be encountered in the Corrupted or Crimson Underground Desert.

Spore Knife.name: Spore Knife
Spore Knife.desc: The Spore Knife is a craftable Pre-Hardmode dagger. It releases damaging spore clouds upon contact with a surface or enemy.
Spore Knife.tip: Throws an overgrown dagger that bursts into a cloud of poisonous spores · Stealth strikes erupt into hungry homing buds that stick to enemies and gnaw them

Spring Stool.name: Spring Stool
Spring Stool.desc: The Spring Stool is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Step Stool. While equipped, holding Up extends the Spring Stool, granting the following effects:
Spring Stool.tip: Hold Up to reach higher · Press Spring Stool Jump Hotkey to jump super high · Super jumps can only be performed once every 20 seconds and after landing · +5% critical strike chance when striking enemies below you

Step Stool.name: Step Stool
Step Stool.desc: The Step Stool is a pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, holding Up while stationary extends the Step Stool, granting the following effects:

Sprouting Arrow.name: Sprouting Arrow
Sprouting Arrow.desc: Sprouting Arrows are craftable Hardmode arrows. They start out as energy arrows which deal 30% damage, pierce infinitely, and pass through tiles.
Sprouting Arrow.tip: Fires an energy arrow that quickly splits into two arrows · These arrows ignore 8 points of defense

Spyker.name: Spyker
Spyker.desc: The Spyker is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the Needler.
Spyker.tip: Converts musket balls into Acid Venom infused spikes that stick to enemies, tiles and explode into shrapnel

Needler.name: Needler
Needler.desc: The Needler is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Moss Hornets. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, bullets are converted into needles that stick to enemies and tiles which explode after a delay and inflict the Acid Venom debuff.
Needler.tip: Converts musket balls into Acid Venom infused needles that stick to enemies and explode

Stynger.name: Stynger
Stynger.desc: The Stynger is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that consumes Stynger Bolts as ammunition. When used, it fires high-velocity Stynger Bolts that explode upon contact with enemies or blocks.
Stynger.tip: Shoots an explosive bolt · Does extra damage on a direct hit

Squirrel Squire Staff.name: Squirrel Squire Staff
Squirrel Squire Staff.desc: The Squirrel Squire Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode sentry that is also obtained from the Starter Bag. When used, it summons a stationary squirrel sentry at the nearest block to the player's location. If there are no blocks directly underneath it, it will start falling.
Squirrel Squire Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a squirrel to throw acorns at your enemies

Acorn.name: Acorn
Acorn.desc: The Acorn is a type of seed used to plant trees. Acorns can be planted on regular green grass, Hallowed grass, Corrupt grass, Crimson grass, Jungle grass, Sand, or Snow, where they will create saplings that will grow into trees, under the right conditions.

Staff of Blushie.name: Staff of Blushie
Staff of Blushie.desc: The Staff of Blushie is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer wand. Upon holding the Left Click button with the weapon in hand, five blue gears will appear on the screen which are connected by a series of chains, and a row of blue fire appears some distance below.
Staff of Blushie.tip: Hold your mouse, wait, wait, wait, and put your trust in the power of blue magic

Sapphire Staff.name: Sapphire Staff
Sapphire Staff.desc: The Sapphire Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires 2 blue bolts which move in a helix pattern and do not pierce, and each deal 60% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and 100% of its knockback.
Sapphire Staff.tip: Sapphires swirl in pairs · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Star Beam Rye.name: Star Beam Rye
Star Beam Rye.desc: Star Beam Rye is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Star Beam Rye debuff, which provides the following effects:
Star Beam Rye.tip: Increases Mana regeneration, even while using an item · Magic weapons deal 0.9x damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Star Fruit.name: Star Fruit
Star Fruit.desc: The Star Fruit is a Hardmode food and fruit item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.

Star of Destruction.name: Star of Destruction
Star of Destruction.desc: The Star of Destruction is a craftable Hardmode bomb. On use, it throws a large spread of cosmic bolts which converge into a bomb. The bomb weakly follows the cursor, exploding when it hits an enemy or after 5 seconds.
Star of Destruction.tip: Throws a fan of cosmic bolts that meld together into a star of destruction · The explosive star will slowly follow your cursor until it expires or hits an enemy · Upon running out of time, the star will burst into a huge explosion that deals increased damage · Stealth strikes throw additional bolts that converge into a faster star that can pierce, exploding on every hit

Star Struck Water.name: Star Struck Water
Star Struck Water.desc: The Star Struck Water is a craftable Hardmode consumable classless weapon that acts as the Astral Infection variant of the Thrown Water. When thrown, it converts a small, square-shaped area with a radius of five blocks from the center into the Astral Infection.
Star Struck Water.tip: Spreads the Astral Infection to some blocks

Astral Grass Seeds.name: Astral Grass Seeds
Astral Grass Seeds.desc: Astral Grass Seeds are Hardmode seeds that are dropped by harvesting wild grass in the Astral Infection at a 5% chance. They can only be planted on Astral Dirt. Once planted, Astral Grass will begin to spread to nearby Astral Dirt blocks.

Star Swallower Unit.name: Star Swallower Unit
Star Swallower Unit.desc: The Star Swallower Unit is a craftable pet summoning item. It summons a biomechanical frog pet that idles near the player along the ground and occasionally spews plasma.

Nuclear Fuel Rod.name: Nuclear Fuel Rod
Nuclear Fuel Rod.desc: The Nuclear Fuel Rod is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Cragmaw Mire. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Nuclear Fuel Rod.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minions release an Irradiated aura on enemy hits · Grants immunity to Irradiated

Starbuster Core.name: Starbuster Core
Starbuster Core.desc: The Starbuster Core is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Stellar Culex after Astrum Aureus has been defeated.
Starbuster Core.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Summons release an astral explosion on enemy hits

Starcore.name: Starcore
Starcore.desc: The Starcore is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Astrum Deus. It can only be used at an Astral Beacon in the Astral Infection.
Starcore.tip: Summons Astrum Deus at the Astral Beacon, but is not consumed · 'May the stars guide your way'

Stardust Wings.name: Stardust Wings
Stardust Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Starfleet.name: Starfleet
Starfleet.desc: The Starfleet is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Super Star Shooter. It uses Fallen Stars as ammo. Upon using left-click, the gun fires a spread of piercing star shots. Right click fires a short-range blast on a cooldown.
Starfleet.tip: Left Click fires a spread of starshots · Right Click fires a concussive short range starburst · Starshots can be accelerated by firing when the starburst goes off · Perfect timing reduces spread and increases damage · Imperfect timing still increases damage, but heavily increases spread · Uses fallen stars, 50% chance to save ammo · 'Etoile, et toi"

Super Star Shooter.name: Super Star Shooter
Super Star Shooter.desc: The Super Star Shooter is a Hardmode ranged weapon that, as a direct upgrade to the Star Cannon, consumes and fires Fallen Stars.
Super Star Shooter.tip: 'Sure, Brain, but where are you going to get enough stars for this?'

Starlight Wings.name: Starlight Wings
Starlight Wings.desc: Starlight Wings are a craftable Hardmode wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
Starlight Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.83 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Good · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Good · Vertical acceleration: Average · Wings of the Nightingale

Starmada.name: Starmada
Starmada.desc: The Starmada is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Starfleet and a final upgrade to the Star Cannon. Left Click fires a spread of piercing star shots while pressing Right Click fires a short-range blast on a cooldown.
Starmada.tip: Left Click fires a spread of starshots · Right Click fires a concussive short range starburst · Starshots can be accelerated by firing when the starburst goes off · Perfect timing reduces spread, increases damage, and adds a stacking weapon power buff · Imperfect timing still increases damage, but heavily increases spread and reduces weapon power · The weapon power buff strengthens both starshots and the concussive starburst · Uses fallen stars, 50% chance to save ammo · 'Et toi, et moi"

Starmageddon.name: Starmageddon
Starmageddon.desc: The Starmageddon is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. It does not consume ammo. When used, it fires a pair of stars, one blue and the other orange. The stars orbit each other and home in on enemies, then stick onto them on hit.
Starmageddon.tip: Projects the finality of cosmic annihilation with Darksun power

Starnight Lance.name: Starnight Lance
Starnight Lance.desc: The Starnight Lance is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, it fires a starlight beam that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before dissipating. The spear and beams inflict the Frostbite debuff.

Static Refiner.name: Static Refiner
Static Refiner.desc: The Static Refiner is a craftable Pre-Hardmode furniture item.

Statigel Block.name: Statigel Block
Statigel Block.desc: Statigel Block is a craftable block crafted from Purified Gel at a Solidifier. It is used in the crafting of Statigel furniture.

Statigel Bathtub.name: Statigel Bathtub

Statigel Clock.name: Statigel Clock
Statigel Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Dresser.name: Statigel Dresser
Statigel Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Greaves.name: Statigel Greaves
Statigel Greaves.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.

Statigel Headgear.name: Statigel Headgear
Statigel Headgear.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.
Statigel Headgear.tip: 10% increased ranged damage · 7% increased ranged critical strike chance

Statigel Helm.name: Statigel Helm
Statigel Helm.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.
Statigel Helm.tip: 10% increased melee damage and melee speed · 7% increased melee critical strike chance

Statigel Hood.name: Statigel Hood
Statigel Hood.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.
Statigel Hood.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 5% increased summon damage

Statigel Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Mask.name: Statigel Mask
Statigel Mask.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.
Statigel Mask.tip: 10% increased rogue damage · 7% increased rogue critical strike chance and 5% increased movement speed

Statigel Piano.name: Statigel Piano
Statigel Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Sink.name: Statigel Sink
Statigel Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statigel Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Statigel Work Bench.name: Statigel Work Bench
Statigel Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Statis' Blessing.name: Statis' Blessing
Statis' Blessing.desc: The Statis' Blessing is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Statis' Blessing.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback

Papyrus Scarab.name: Papyrus Scarab
Papyrus Scarab.desc: The Papyrus Scarab is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the bonuses of the Necromantic Scroll and the Hercules Beetle. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Papyrus Scarab.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases your summon damage by 15% and the knockback of your minions

Pygmy Necklace.name: Pygmy Necklace
Pygmy Necklace.desc: The Pygmy Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that provides the player with one additional minion slot. It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for at night.
Pygmy Necklace.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1

The First Shadowflame.name: The First Shadowflame
The First Shadowflame.desc: The First Shadowflame is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Goblin Warlock. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The First Shadowflame.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame, and grants immunity to Shadowflame

Statis' Ninja Belt.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
Statis' Ninja Belt.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Statis' Ninja Belt.tip: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws Climbing Claws

Frog Flipper.name: Frog Flipper
Frog Flipper.desc: The Frog Flipper is an accessory crafted from a Frog Leg and a Flipper. It combines the abilities of these two items, increasing the player's jump speed and safe falling distance, allowing auto-jump, and giving the player the ability to swim.
Frog Flipper.tip: Grants the ability to swim · Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

Master Ninja Gear.name: Master Ninja Gear
Master Ninja Gear.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear.
Master Ninja Gear.tip: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks

Black Belt.name: Black Belt
Black Belt.desc: The Black Belt is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that grants a 1/10 chance to dodge an attack, including instances of damage taken from hazards such as traps and lava. A cloud of smoke surrounds the player when performing a dodge.
Black Belt.tip: Gives a chance to dodge attacks

Frog Gear.name: Frog Gear
Frog Gear.desc: The Frog Gear is an accessory that combines the effects of the Frog Leg, Flipper, and Tiger Climbing Gear.
Frog Gear.tip: Grants the ability to swim · Allows the ability to climb walls · Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance · 'It ain't easy being green'

Tabi.name: Tabi
Tabi.desc: The Tabi is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory which allows the player to perform a dash by double-tapping either the Left Click or Right Click key. The dash ability has a one-second cooldown between uses.
Tabi.tip: Allows the ability to dash · Double tap a direction

Statis' Void Sash.name: Statis' Void Sash
Statis' Void Sash.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Statis' Void Sash.tip: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws Climbing Claws

Stellar Torus Staff.name: Stellar Torus Staff
Stellar Torus Staff.desc: The Stellar Torus Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons an orbital disk that follows the player and attacks enemies by charging up a sweeping laser for 1 second.
Stellar Torus Staff.tip: Summons a Torus Orbital that fries foes with a telescoping light beam

Stink Potion.name: Stink Potion
Stink Potion.desc: The Stink Potion is a thrown potion that functions similarly to Thrown Waters. Upon colliding with solid blocks, it inflicts the Stinky debuff on players (including the user), enemies, critters, and NPCs within a radius of 9 tiles.
Stink Potion.tip: Throw this to make someone smell terrible

Stone Block.name: Stone Block
Stone Block.desc: The Stone Block is a type of block that is generated naturally in very large parts of the world. The majority of the Underground and Cavern layers is comprised of Stone Blocks. As a crafting ingredient, they are vital early in the game to craft the Furnace and Wooden Arrows.

Storm Ruler.name: Storm Ruler
Storm Ruler.desc: The Storm Ruler is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung it shoots out a beam which, upon impact with an enemy or tile, spawns a small tornado similar to the one the Cloud Elemental spawns.
Storm Ruler.tip: Fires beams that generate tornadoes where they strike · Tornadoes suck enemies in · 'Only a storm can fell a greatwood'

Storm Saber.name: Storm Saber
Storm Saber.desc: The Storm Saber is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It has a chance to be dropped from Cloud Elementals. When swung, it fires a slow and homing glowing sword-like projectile from the blade, and another from the sky towards the cursor.
Storm Saber.tip: Fires two homing storm beams · One from blade and one from the sky

Wind Blade.name: Wind Blade
Wind Blade.desc: The Wind Blade is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a wind cyclone toward the cursor that deals 60% base damage, pierces once and drags non-boss enemies nearby toward it.
Wind Blade.tip: Fires cyclones that suck enemies in

Storm Surge.name: Storm Surge
Storm Surge.desc: The Storm Surge is a Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. It fires a glowing blue shockwave that can pass through solid blocks and pierce a single enemy, making it useful for dispatching enemies through walls and searching for nearby caves. However, the shockwave has a short range.
Storm Surge.tip: Fires a blue shockwave that passes through blocks · Does not consume ammo · 'Fear the storm'

Storm Weaver (Lore).name: Storm Weaver (Lore)
Storm Weaver (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Storm Weaver (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Storm Weaver Trophy.name: Storm Weaver Trophy
Storm Weaver Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Stormfront Razor.name: Stormfront Razor
Stormfront Razor.desc: The Stormfront Razor is a craftable Hardmode non-consumable dagger that is an upgrade to the Cinquedea. When used, it automatically throws a dagger that summons lightning bolts if it hits a solid tile or enemy. The daggers do not pierce.
Stormfront Razor.tip: Throws a knife that summons lightning on hit · Stealth strikes cause the knife to be faster and summon multiple lightning bolts on hit · 'Strike and stem the flow'

Cinquedea.name: Cinquedea
Cinquedea.desc: The Cinquedea is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable dagger that is sold by the Bandit for 10 gold. When used, it throws a dagger that is affected by gravity and pierces once.
Cinquedea.tip: Stealth strikes stick into enemies before launching forward, slicing everything

Stratus Dye.name: Stratus Dye
Stratus Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Stratus Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Stratus Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Stratus Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.
