Stratus Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Stratus Sofa.name: Stratus Sofa
Stratus Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Stratus Sphere.name: Stratus Sphere
Stratus Sphere.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a craftable post-Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.
Stratus Sphere.tip: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · Right Click to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'

Stratus Table.name: Stratus Table
Stratus Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Stratus Work Bench.name: Stratus Work Bench
Stratus Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Stream Gouge.name: Stream Gouge
Stream Gouge.desc: The Stream Gouge is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon. When used, the spear spins around the player but does not deal damage while spinning.
Stream Gouge.tip: Summons a portal that the spear crosses through · Shortly after going through the portal, portals appear near the mouse that release copies of the spear's cutting edge · Enemies hit by the copies create lacerations in space, revealing a cosmic background

Stygian Shield.name: Stygian Shield
Stygian Shield.desc: The Stygian Shield is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon. While the weapon is in use, it provides the player 8 defense and grants immunity to knockback, at the cost of being unable to perform dashes.
Stygian Shield.tip: Hold Left Click to charge an omni-directional dash which slams through enemies · Right Click to throw a buckler which bounces towards a nearby foe upon collision · Grants knockback immunity and 8 defense while held · However, dashes are disabled until you stop holding this weapon for 1.5 seconds

Subsuming Vortex.name: Subsuming Vortex
Subsuming Vortex.desc: The Subsuming Vortex is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome.
Subsuming Vortex.tip: Press Left Click to release a barrage of vortices that race towards enemies · Press Right Click to cast a gigantic vortex in front of you with a bias towards the mouse · When enemies are near the vortex, it sends multiple fast-moving smaller vortices towards them · Releasing Right Click fires the vortex towards the mouse if enough time has passed · Damage scales based on how long the vortex was held out · Struck enemies are completely consumed by Miracle Blight

Tears of Heaven.name: Tears of Heaven
Tears of Heaven.desc: The Tears of Heaven is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires a spread of two slow-moving balls of heavenly light that accelerate to home in on enemies, inflict the Hellfire and Frostbite debuffs on hit, and can travel through blocks.
Tears of Heaven.tip: Casts slow-moving homing balls of heavenly light

Sulphur Sea (Lore).name: Sulphur Sea (Lore)
Sulphur Sea (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Sulphur Sea (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Sulphuric Treasure.name: Sulphuric Treasure
Sulphuric Treasure.desc: Sulphuric Treasure is a grab bag obtained from breaking Sulphurous Pots. It contains several items that typically drop from pots.

Abyssal Treasure.name: Abyssal Treasure
Abyssal Treasure.desc: Abyssal Treasure is a grab bag obtained from breaking Abyssal Pots. It contains several potions, as well as items that facilitate exploring the Abyss.

Sulphurous Breastplate.name: Sulphurous Breastplate
Sulphurous Breastplate.desc: Sulphurous armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Acidwood and Sulphuric Scales.

Sulphurous Crate.name: Sulphurous Crate
Sulphurous Crate.desc: The Sulphurous Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sulphurous Sea. The crate contains several items based originally in the Sulphurous Sea and serves as an alternative way of getting these items through fishing.

Hydrothermal Crate.name: Hydrothermal Crate
Hydrothermal Crate.desc: The Hydrothermal Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sulphurous Sea. The crate contains several items based originally in the Sulphurous Sea and the Abyss and serves as an alternative way of getting these items through fishing.

Sulphurous Helmet.name: Sulphurous Helmet
Sulphurous Helmet.desc: Sulphurous armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Acidwood and Sulphuric Scales.
Sulphurous Helmet.tip: 6% increased rogue critical strike chance · Grants underwater breathing

Sulphurous Leggings.name: Sulphurous Leggings
Sulphurous Leggings.desc: Sulphurous armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Acidwood and Sulphuric Scales.

Sulphurous Sandstone.name: Sulphurous Sandstone
Sulphurous Sandstone.desc: Sulphurous Sandstone is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found in the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It composes most of the lower portion of the biome and is incredibly common. It also can be obtained by opening Hydrothermal and Sulphurous Crates.

Sulphurous Sand Wall.name: Sulphurous Sand Wall
Sulphurous Sand Wall.desc: Sulphurous Sand Walls are background walls crafted from Sulphurous Sand.

Sulphurous Sandstone Wall.name: Sulphurous Sandstone Wall
Sulphurous Sandstone Wall.desc: Sulphurous Sandstone Walls are background walls crafted from Sulphurous Sandstone.

Sulphurous Shale Wall.name: Sulphurous Shale Wall
Sulphurous Shale Wall.desc: Sulphurous Shale Wall is a background wall crafted with Sulphurous Shale and is also found naturally in the first layer of the Abyss.

Sulphurskin Potion.name: Sulphurskin Potion
Sulphurskin Potion.desc: The Sulphurskin Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion that can also be found in Rusty Chests.
Sulphurskin Potion.tip: Reduces the effects of the sulphuric waters

Waterleaf.name: Waterleaf
Waterleaf.desc: Waterleaf is a type of herb which appears as a small, turquoise-colored sprout.

Summoning Potion.name: Summoning Potion
Summoning Potion.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's minion slots by 1.
Summoning Potion.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1

Sun Spirit Staff.name: Sun Spirit Staff
Sun Spirit Staff.desc: The Sun Spirit Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a Solar Spirit minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing yellow energy beams at nearby enemies once every 0.83 seconds.
Sun Spirit Staff.tip: Summons a solar spirit to protect you · Repeated summons increase its power

Palm Wood.name: Palm Wood
Palm Wood.desc: Palm Wood is a type of wood harvested from Palm trees found naturally growing in the Ocean biome and Oasis biome. Palm trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of regular Sand Blocks above surface.

Sunken Sinker.name: Sunken Sinker
Sunken Sinker.desc: The Sunken Sinker is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Sunken Sinker.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Provides a fishing minigame · The bobber will float at your height underwater, allowing underwater fishing · Move in the indicated direction while fishing to catch items

Super Dummy.name: Super Dummy
Super Dummy.desc: The Super Dummy is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoning item. When used with its primary function (left-click), it spawns a Super Dummy enemy. This enemy is nigh-invincible, with 9,999,999 health that it is constantly regenerating.
Super Dummy.tip: Creates a super dummy · Regenerates 1 million life per second · Will not die when taking damage over time from debuffs · Right Click to kill all super dummies · Can only spawn 50 super dummies at once

Target Dummy.name: Target Dummy
Target Dummy.desc: The Target Dummy is a furniture item that serves as a test target for player attacks.

Supernova.name: Supernova
Supernova.desc: The Supernova is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue bomb.
Supernova.tip: Disables normal stealth generation · Hold Left Click to generate stealth, or hold Right Click to toss the bomb without generating stealth · Tosses a smart bomb that locks onto and tracks targets · If no target is found it will return to you · Each bomb creates a miniature Miracle Blight supernova that drags in weak enemies and chases strong enemies · Stealth strikes create a blast that shakes the foundations of reality itself

Totality Breakers.name: Totality Breakers
Totality Breakers.desc: The Totality Breakers are a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, they throw a flask that explodes on impact with tiles or enemies. The flasks create shortly lingering explosions and fire 5 explosive tar projectiles that each release lingering flames.
Totality Breakers.tip: Explodes into highly flammable black tar · Black tar makes enemies Oiled and sets them alight · Stealth strikes leak black tar as they fly · 'I need a bigger breaker'

Superradiant Slaughterer.name: Superradiant Slaughterer
Superradiant Slaughterer.desc: The Superradiant Slaughterer is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When held, it charges up a handheld buzzsaw which deals 150% damage on contact.
Superradiant Slaughterer.tip: Hold Left Click to rev up an elemental buzzsaw that deals close-range damage · Release Left Click to fire the buzzsaw which bounces off tiles, releasing homing bolts when returning depending on hits · Revving up the saw increases its damage and allows it to pierce more enemies · Press Right Click to eject a lingering buzzsaw towards the cursor on a 6 second cooldown · Double Right Click to rapidly propel yourself in the direction you are moving · During the cooldown, buzzsaws home to the cursor and constantly release homing bolts while returning · 'No one knows how it turns blood into rainbows...'

Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station.name: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station
Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station.desc: The Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station is a craftable Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station.tip: Increases fishing power by 50 · Fishing line will never break and decreases chance of bait consumption · Allows fishing in lava
Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station.wiki: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

Lavaproof Tackle Bag.name: Lavaproof Tackle Bag
Lavaproof Tackle Bag.desc: The Lavaproof Tackle Bag is an accessory that combines the functionalities of its components: the Angler Earring's 10% boost to Fishing Power, the Tackle Box's chance not to consume bait, the unbreakable quality of the High Test Fishing Line, and the ability to fish in lava from the Lavaproof Fishing Hook.
Lavaproof Tackle Bag.tip: Fishing line will never break, decreases chance of bait consumption, increases fishing power by 10 · Allows fishing in lava
usedIn: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

Master Bait.name: Master Bait
Master Bait.desc: Bait is a category of items required for fishing. When a fishing pole is cast, at least one bait item must be in the player's inventory; otherwise, nothing can be caught. Fishing poles will cast their lines with no baits, but there will be no "bites" and no catches.
usedIn: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

Super Healing Potion.name: Super Healing Potion
Super Healing Potion.desc: The Super Healing Potion is a recovery potion that heals health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

Supreme Mana Potion.name: Supreme Mana Potion
Supreme Mana Potion.desc: The Supreme Mana Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord potion. Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

Svantechnical.name: Svantechnical
Svantechnical.desc: The Svantechnical is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it fires three streams of charged energy bolts in a sine-wave pattern.
Svantechnical.tip: Fires a trinity of energy bolts that split into beams that track your cursor · Ignores 200 points of enemy Defense · 80% chance to save ammo · 'The age old balance of trading damage for frames'

Swirling Cosmic Flame Dye.name: Swirling Cosmic Flame Dye
Swirling Cosmic Flame Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Swordsplosion.name: Swordsplosion
Swordsplosion.desc: The Swordsplosion is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When used, it fires several beam swords that converge on the cursor and causes even more beam swords to rain from the sky when swung. It rotates between firing different colored beam swords.
Swordsplosion.tip: Fires multiple rainbow beam swords that rain from the sky · Sword swarm

Sylvestaff.name: Sylvestaff
Sylvestaff.desc: The Sylvestaff is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer wand. When used, it fires a beam with a pink, white, and blue trail that bounces off tiles in quick succession and pierces infinitely.
Sylvestaff.tip: Casts a bouncing beam that splits when enemies are near it · 'Also known as the Karma Staff!'

System Bane.name: System Bane
System Bane.desc: The System Bane is a craftable Hardmode spiky ball. When used, the player throws a gravity-affected electric machine that continuously deals damage to targets that come into contact with it.
System Bane.tip: Hurls an unstable device which sticks to the ground and shocks nearby enemies with lightning · Stealth strikes make the device emit a large, damaging electromagnetic field

Fuel Cell Bundle.name: Fuel Cell Bundle
Fuel Cell Bundle.desc: The Fuel Cell Bundle is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When used, it throws a small gravity-affected flask that deals no damage but summons a small and armed miniature Plaguebringer minion upon tile contact.
Fuel Cell Bundle.tip: Releases a small, special variant of the plaguebringers

Tactician's Trump Card.name: Tactician's Trump Card
Tactician's Trump Card.desc: The Tactician's Trump Card is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon that behaves similarly to a broadsword. When swung, it fires an electric beam which pierces twice and spawns an electric explosion on each hit.
Tactician's Trump Card.tip: Fires an Electrified sword beam · 'Faint memories of a Princess from the future cross your mind...'

Copper Shortsword.name: Copper Shortsword
Copper Shortsword.desc: The Copper Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. Newly created characters spawn with a Copper Shortsword (Iron Shortsword in Journey Mode).

Tradewinds.name: Tradewinds
Tradewinds.desc: The Tradewinds is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires fast moving aero feathers. These feathers emit light particles and are capable of piercing or ricocheting once, disappearing on its second impact.

Deathweed.name: Deathweed
Deathweed.desc: Deathweed is a type of herb which appears as a short, withered purple stalk.

Tainted Cloudberry.name: Tainted Cloudberry
Tainted Cloudberry.desc: The Tainted Cloudberry is a craftable post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Miracle Fruit, and the Sacred Strawberry.
Tainted Cloudberry.tip: Permanently increases maximum life by 25 · Can only be used once and requires the max amount of Life Fruits consumed · A tangy, tart flavor with a somewhat earthen touch

Tarragon Dye.name: Tarragon Dye
Tarragon Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Tarragon Throwing Dart.name: Tarragon Throwing Dart
Tarragon Throwing Dart.desc: The Tarragon Throwing Dart is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger. It fires a long, spear-like projectile which pierces 5 times. It travels a significantly further distance than most other thrown items.
Tarragon Throwing Dart.tip: Fires a piercing dart · Stealth strikes erupt into thorns on enemy hits

Tarragon Wings.name: Tarragon Wings
Tarragon Wings.desc: Tarragon Wings are a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
Tarragon Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'

Tau Cannon.name: Tau Cannon
Tau Cannon.desc: The Tau Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. It is one of the final upgrades to the Magna Cannon and Opal Striker, alongside the Ontological Despoiler.
Tau Cannon.tip: A bulky assault rifle with three charge levels that fires astral energy · Charge level one fires a burst of bolts · Charge level two fires a beam of energy that quickly fizzles out · Charge level three fires a massive laser and creates astral portals around you · 'This weapon is very ethically questionable'

Teapot.name: Teapot
Teapot.desc: The Teapot is a crafting station used solely to make Teacups. It can be placed anywhere.

Water Bolt.name: Water Bolt
Water Bolt.desc: The Water Bolt is a pre-Hardmode spell book that can be found hidden within the shelves of the Dungeon, along with having a 1/40 chance to be dropped by Water Bolt Mimics. When used, it fires a slow-moving piercing water ball projectile that can bounce off blocks.
Water Bolt.tip: Casts a slow moving bolt of water

Tectonic Truncator.name: Tectonic Truncator
Tectonic Truncator.desc: The Tectonic Truncator is a craftable Hardmode axe. When swung, it produces light particles. On strike, it inflicts the Hellfire debuff.

Teleportation Potion.name: Teleportation Potion
Teleportation Potion.desc: The Teleportation Potion is a potion that teleports the user to a random location. In addition to being crafted, it can be found in Chests located in the Cavern layer and in Shadow Chests.
Teleportation Potion.tip: Teleports you to a random location

Chaos Fish.name: Chaos Fish
Chaos Fish.desc: Chaos Fish are a type of fish which are found rarely by fishing in the Underground Hallow. They are used to craft Seafood Dinner and Teleportation Potions.

Temporal Umbrella.name: Temporal Umbrella
Temporal Umbrella.desc: The Temporal Umbrella is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, it summons a Magic Hat on the player's head which in turn summons five tools, including an arrow, axe, hammer, rifle, and an umbrella.
Temporal Umbrella.tip: Summons a variety of tools to assist you in battle: · - A vermilion arrow to pierce your adversaries · - A marmalade hammer to bonk enemies in style · - A jade axe to cleave monsters and occasionally fell a tree · - A cyan umbrella to beat down your foes with grace · - A lavender rifle to snipe those who stand in your way · Best of all, you get to wear a top hat · There can only be one set of tools at a time · 'Surprisingly sturdy, I reckon this could defeat the Mafia in a single blow'

Top Hat.name: Top Hat
Top Hat.desc: The Tuxedo set is a vanity set consisting of the Top Hat, Tuxedo Shirt and Tuxedo Pants.

Umbrella.name: Umbrella
Umbrella.desc: The Umbrella is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It has a 1/11 chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer, and can also be purchased for from the Skeleton Merchant during a Waning Gibbous.
Umbrella.tip: You will fall slower while holding this

Virid Vanguard.name: Virid Vanguard
Virid Vanguard.desc: The Virid Vanguard is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it alternates between summoning giant axes and blades that orbit around the player, inflicting Sage Poison which deals 50 damage per second, per summoned Virid Vanguard.
Virid Vanguard.tip: Alternates between summoning axes and swords, both laced with a powerful poison · Axes orbit the player, dealing high damage at a close range · Swords chase down enemies with extreme precision, tearing them to shreds · All weapons inflict Sage Poison, which becomes more powerful the more weapons are summoned · When all minion slots are full, Left Click again to spin up a flurry of slashes aimed at your cursor · This ability has a five-second cooldown that requires holding this item · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to change the rotation direction

Tendon Hook.name: Tendon Hook
Tendon Hook.desc: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it.

Worm Hook.name: Worm Hook
Worm Hook.desc: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it.

Tenebreus Tides.name: Tenebreus Tides
Tenebreus Tides.desc: The Tenebreus Tides is a craftable Hardmode spear. When swung, it launches a water spear that pierces four times and deals 75% of the spear's damage. When an enemy is struck with the spear or its main projectile, two swords or spears appear around the struck target.
Tenebreus Tides.tip: Shoots a water spear that pierces enemies and terrain · Striking enemies summons liquid blades and spears to assault the struck foe · 'Inundatio ex Laminis'
stats: 5 seconds (Main Spear) / 3 seconds (Water Spear) / 2 seconds (Additional Spear/Sword)

Amidias' Trident.name: Amidias' Trident
Amidias' Trident.desc: Amidias' Trident is a Pre-Hardmode spear that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it shoots an aquamarine whirlpool that goes through tiles, homes in on enemies, and disappears after traveling a short distance or contacting an enemy.

Atlantis.name: Atlantis
Atlantis.desc: The Atlantis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. When used, it fires aquatic spears which pierce 3 times and lose 20% damage per hit.
Atlantis.tip: Casts aquatic spears that split as they travel

Influx Waver.name: Influx Waver
Influx Waver.desc: The Influx Waver is a Hardmode, post-Golem broadsword that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When swung, it fires a blue sword projectile.

Tequila.name: Tequila
Tequila.desc: Tequila is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Tequila debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted electric-related debuffs by 50% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted cold-related debuffs by 50%.
Tequila.tip: 50% increased Electric debuff damage · 50% decreased Cold debuff damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Tequila Sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
Tequila Sunrise.desc: Tequila Sunrise is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Tequila Sunrise debuff, which greatly accelerates natural life regeneration after a debuff expires, but increases the damage per second of debuffs inflicted onto the player by 50%.
Tequila Sunrise.tip: Greatly increases natural life regeneration after suffering a damaging debuff · 50% increased damage from damaging debuffs · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Teratoma.name: Teratoma
Teratoma.desc: The Teratoma is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Hive Mind. It can only be used in The Corruption or Underground Corruption. Note that the boss can also be summoned by killing a Hive Tumor, which spawns rarely in the Corruption.
Teratoma.tip: Summons the Hive Mind when used in the Corruption · Despawns outside the Corruption · Not consumable · 'An exquisitely hideous tumor for those diseased in the head.'

Terra Blade.name: Terra Blade
Terra Blade.desc: The Terra Blade is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword. When swung, a green aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself. The aura can hit up to three enemies.

True Night's Edge.name: True Night's Edge
True Night's Edge.desc: The True Night's Edge is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Night's Edge. When swung, a circular purple aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself. The aura can hit up to two enemies.

Terror Talons.name: Terror Talons
Terror Talons.desc: The Terror Talons are a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, they fire small and swift claws, alternating and creating a double sinewave like movement from the player towards the direction of the cursor. The claws do not pierce or go through tiles.
Terror Talons.tip: Fires small wavering claws · Stealth strikes launch a large, high speed claw which slashes multiple times

Tesla Cannon.name: Tesla Cannon
Tesla Cannon.desc: The Tesla Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun. When used, it fires a large blue beam that creates a large dust explosion upon contact with a block or enemy. The beam will arc towards other nearby enemies on enemy hits.
Tesla Cannon.tip: A lightweight energy cannon that blasts an intense electrical beam that explodes · The beam can arc to nearby targets

Tesla's Amulet.name: Tesla's Amulet
Tesla's Amulet.desc: Tesla's Amulet is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it spawns an electric aura around the player that deals 12 typeless damage and inflicts the Static Discharge and Galvanic Corrosion debuffs.
Tesla's Amulet.tip: Generates an electrifying field around you · The field inflicts Static Discharge and Galvanic Corrosion · The field has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · Reduces the duration of Static Discharge

Teslastaff.name: Teslastaff
Teslastaff.desc: The Teslastaff is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a straight beam of lightning which slowly tracks the cursor. Each hit increases the damage of the beam by 10%, up to a maximum of 500%.
Teslastaff.tip: Fires a channeled beam of pinpoint-accurate lightning · The beam has limited turning speed capability · Each successive hit on the same enemy increases damage per hit · The damage increases 10% per hit to a maximum of 500% damage · This damage will rapidly decrease after the enemy stops being hit

Thunder Zapper.name: Thunder Zapper
Thunder Zapper.desc: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.

Thaumatic Chair.name: Thaumatic Chair
Thaumatic Chair.desc: The Thaumatic Chair is a craftable post-Moon Lord chair. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on the Thaumatic Chair by right-clicking on it.

Void Chair.name: Void Chair
Void Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Wulfrum Chair.name: Wulfrum Chair
Wulfrum Chair.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

The Absorber.name: The Absorber
The Absorber.desc: The Absorber is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The Absorber.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

The Abyss (Lore).name: The Abyss (Lore)
The Abyss (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
The Abyss (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

The Amalgam.name: The Amalgam
The Amalgam.desc: The Amalgam is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The Amalgam.tip: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

The Anomaly's Nanogun.name: The Anomaly's Nanogun
The Anomaly's Nanogun.desc: The Anomaly's Nanogun is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), a reticle appears at the cannon's muzzle for 0.67 seconds.
The Anomaly's Nanogun.tip: Press Left Click to charge up 5 rapid-fire plasma beams · Press Right Click to launch 3 fission bombs · 'Welcome to the party, pal'

The Archmage (Lore).name: The Archmage (Lore)
The Archmage (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
The Archmage (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Cryogen Trophy.name: Cryogen Trophy
Cryogen Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Marrow.name: Marrow
Marrow.desc: The Marrow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/200 chance to be dropped by Skeleton Archers.
Marrow.tip: Shoots fast bone arrows that shatter into shards

The Brain of Cthulhu (Lore).name: The Brain of Cthulhu (Lore)
The Brain of Cthulhu (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
The Brain of Cthulhu (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Brain of Cthulhu Trophy.name: Brain of Cthulhu Trophy
Brain of Cthulhu Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

The Camper.name: The Camper
The Camper.desc: The Camper is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The Camper.tip: You deal 50% less damage unless stationary · Standing still grants buffs depending on held item, and creates a damaging aura around you · While moving, you regenerate health as if standing still · Increases visibility range in the abyss when standing still · 'In rest may we find victory'

Ammo Box.name: Ammo Box
Ammo Box.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for in Hardmode.
Ammo Box.tip: Usable when placed · 20% chance to save ammo

Any Food Item.name: Any Food Item
Any Food Item.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. The Calamity Mod adds several new groups of alternate ingredients.

Bewitching Table.name: Bewitching Table
Bewitching Table.desc: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed. It fulfills a house's table requirement.
Bewitching Table.tip: Usable when placed · Increased your max number of minions by 1

Campfire.name: Campfire
Campfire.desc: The Campfire is a type of furniture and crafting station that emits light and provides the Cozy Fire buff to players in its vicinity.
Campfire.tip: Life regen is increased when near a campfire

Crystal Ball.name: Crystal Ball
Crystal Ball.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for. Pressing Right Click on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.
Crystal Ball.tip: Usable when placed · Magic powers are increased

Heart Lantern.name: Heart Lantern
Heart Lantern.desc: The Heart Lantern is a functional lantern that grants the Heart Lamp buff, providing a health regeneration of 1 HP per second to all players within a.
Heart Lantern.tip: Increases life regeneration when placed nearby

Sharpening Station.name: Sharpening Station
Sharpening Station.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for.
Sharpening Station.tip: Usable when placed · Melee weapons have armor penetration

Shiny Stone.name: Shiny Stone
Shiny Stone.desc: The Shiny Stone is an Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that is always dropped from Golem's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.
Shiny Stone.tip: Greatly increases life regen when not moving

The Cart of Gods.name: The Cart of Gods
The Cart of Gods.desc: The Cart of Gods is a craftable post-Moon Lord mount summoning item. When used on Minecart Tracks, it summons a rideable cart with a trail of 17 body segments and 1 tail segment.

The Cauldron.name: The Cauldron
The Cauldron.desc: The Cauldron is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic weapon. When used, the player holds the cauldron overhead which lobs gravity-affected lava bombs towards the cursor.
The Cauldron.tip: Launches lava bombs which explode into more lava bombs · 80% reduced mana usage while submerged in lava or while in the underworld · 'Believe it or not, its original wielder was only a few centimeters tall!'

The Commander's Cap.name: The Commander's Cap
The Commander's Cap.desc: The High-Flying Finery is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the The Commander's Cap, The Grand Garment and The Formal Footwear.

Blue Dye.name: Blue Dye
Blue Dye.desc: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat.

The Dance of Light.name: The Dance of Light
The Dance of Light.desc: The Dance of Light is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it rapidly summons four pairs of fast inaccurate light blades from a cone around the player towards the cursor's direction.
The Dance of Light.tip: Barrages enemies with a hailstorm of Light Blades · 'And in a flash of light, nothing remains'

Lunar Flare.name: Lunar Flare
Lunar Flare.desc: The Lunar Flare is a Hardmode spell book that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it summons a spread of three lunar flares that rain down towards the cursor.

The Dark Master.name: The Dark Master
The Dark Master.desc: The Dark Master is a craftable Hardmode broadsword. While the player is at 75% health or higher, they fire a fast-accelerating red slash towards the cursor. The slash deals an additional 0.1% damage for each additional point of max health the player has, starting from 400.
The Dark Master.tip: Fires red echo slash projectiles when above 75% health · Projectile damage increases for every HP above 400 · Press Right Click to spawn three shadow clones in a Delta formation · The clones will mirror your sword swings and release projectiles · Projectiles are fired regardless of your own HP, but deal less damage · The clones may only exist while holding this weapon · 'The blade by which the shadows levy their foes with a terrible fate'

The Devourer of Cods.name: The Devourer of Cods
The Devourer of Cods.desc: The Devourer of Cods is a craftable post-Moon Lord fishing pole. When swung, ten fishing lines are deployed at once instead of one. In addition to this, fishing lines will not break in a similar manner to equipping the High Test Fishing Line and it can be used to fish in lava.
The Devourer of Cods.tip: Fires ten lines at once. Line never breaks and allows fishing in lava · 'The devourer was once just an Eater of Shoals'

The Etomer.name: The Etomer

The Etomer.tip: Summons an electric troublemaker · A little note is attached: · 'Thank you, Aloe! Very much appreciated from Ben'

The Eye of Cthulhu (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
The Eye of Cthulhu (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Eye of Cthulhu Trophy.name: Eye of Cthulhu Trophy
Eye of Cthulhu Trophy.desc: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 chance to be dropped from most bosses. While they can be considered the "boss version of ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses.

The Formal Footwear.name: The Formal Footwear
The Formal Footwear.desc: The High-Flying Finery is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the The Commander's Cap, The Grand Garment and The Formal Footwear.

The God's Gambit.name: The God's Gambit
The God's Gambit.desc: The God's Gambit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it fires streams of slime towards enemies within 20 tiles. The streams of slime do not pierce or go through tiles, and they inflict the Slime debuff.
The God's Gambit.tip: Reach: 25 tiles · Speed: 32 · Infinite throw duration · Fires a stream of damaging slime when enemies are near

The Grand Garment.name: The Grand Garment
The Grand Garment.desc: The High-Flying Finery is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the The Commander's Cap, The Grand Garment and The Formal Footwear.

The Hive.name: The Hive
The Hive.desc: The Hive is a craftable Hardmode launcher. When used, it fires a spread of 4 short-ranged plague missiles that explode on impact with tiles or enemies, each releasing 2 homing plague bees.
The Hive.tip: Launches a wide spread of 4 missiles that explode on contact with enemies and tiles · Charging the launcher decreases the spread and increases the velocity of the missile barrage · Fully charging the launcher will cause it to fire a Plague nuke to decimate a massive area on impact

The Hive Mind (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.

Hive Mind Trophy.name: Hive Mind Trophy
Hive Mind Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

The Last Mourning.name: The Last Mourning
The Last Mourning.desc: The Last Mourning is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that is an upgrade to The Horseman's Blade. Upon striking an enemy, mourning skulls and flaming pumpkins will spawn from all directions off-screen and move in towards the enemy that was struck.
The Last Mourning.tip: Summons flaming pumpkins and mourning skulls · Pumpkins and skulls split into homing fire orbs on enemy hits

The Maelstrom.name: The Maelstrom
The Maelstrom.desc: The Maelstrom is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. When used, it slowly and accurately fires charged reaper sharks which inflict the Hadopelagic Pressure debuff and are not affected by gravity.
The Maelstrom.tip: Fires charged Reaper Sharks that cause water explosions

The Storm.name: The Storm
The Storm.desc: The Storm is a post-Moon Lord bow that is dropped by the Storm Weaver. When used, it rapidly fires a barrage of arrows and homing lightning bolts with an innate 20 armor penetration from the sky.
The Storm.tip: Fires a spread of homing lightning bolts and arrows from the sky · Converts wooden arrows into powerful lightning bolts

The Mutilator.name: The Mutilator
The Mutilator.desc: The Mutilator is a craftable post-Moon Lord special sword that swings in a sweeping arc. Hitting enemies inflicts Laceration for 1 second and adds charge to the sword, increasing damage by 14.29% per charge. Charge decays over time if the sword does not hit enemies.
The Mutilator.tip: Striking enemies empowers The Mutilator, increasing its damage · At full charge, striking enemies causes a blood orb explosion · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness

The Old Duke (Lore).name: The Old Duke (Lore)
The Old Duke (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.

Old Duke Trophy.name: Old Duke Trophy
Old Duke Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

The Oracle.name: The Oracle
The Oracle.desc: The Oracle is a craftable post-Moon Lord yoyo. While deployed, it emits a yellow aura that constantly damages enemies within a 4-block radius and can pass through tiles.
The Oracle.tip: Reach: 50 tiles · Speed: 60 · Infinite throw duration · Emits an aura of auric lightning which charges up when hitting enemies · Fires auric orbs when supercharged · 'Gaze into the past, the present, the future... and the circumstances of your inevitable demise'

Burning Revelation.name: Burning Revelation
Burning Revelation.desc: The Burning Revelation is a post-Moon Lord yoyo that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. While deployed, it constantly builds up charge as it is held out and can pass through tiles.
Burning Revelation.tip: Reach: 42.5 tiles · Speed: 54 · Infinite throw duration · An ever burning yoyo that constantly charges power · Direct hits greatly increase the charge and release profaned energy that scales with charge level · At maximum charge, the yoyo unleashes a volley of homing stars that gain damage the farther they travel · Stars with maximum damage let off an additional explosion on hit · 'It burns, but you hold it close to your heart. Clarity and purpose fill your soul'

The Obliterator.name: The Obliterator
The Obliterator.desc: The Obliterator is a post-Moon Lord yoyo that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. While deployed, it is able to charge towards an enemy every 2 seconds, dealing 600% damage and inflicting the God Slayer Inferno debuff. Counterweight hits can instantly trigger charges.
The Obliterator.tip: Reach: 45 tiles · Speed: 54 · Infinite throw duration · Occasionally performs a miniature Dimensional Drive at nearby foes · Counterweight hits instantly begin another Dimensional Drive

Smooth Marble Block.name: Smooth Marble Block
Smooth Marble Block.desc: The Smooth Marble Block is a smoother version of the Marble Block. It can be used to craft the Marble furniture set.

The Pointer.name: The Pointer
The Pointer.desc: The Pointer is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, an arrow is drawn above the target nearest to the cursor.
The Pointer.tip: Allows automatic targeting of enemies · Press The Pointer Lock On to cycle through targets near your mouse · After cycling through all close enemies, the next press will disable it · 'Great for cats!'

The Prince.name: The Prince
The Prince.desc: The Prince is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand which is an upgrade to the Arch Amaryllis. When used, it casts a gravity-defying holy fireball. It explodes into six smaller homing flames after hitting four enemies, colliding with a solid tile, or after 0.58 seconds.
The Prince.tip: Casts a holy fireball that explodes into six homing flames · 'So you're telling me that the prince exploded, and then turned into a flower?' · -Dain, the sailor druid

The Sevens Striker.name: The Sevens Striker
The Sevens Striker.desc: The Sevens Striker is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), the slot machine on the gun spins for two seconds, rolling one of four attacks at a random chance based on the type of coin.
The Sevens Striker.tip: Press Left Click to consume 1 coin and play a slot machine · The quality of the outcome depends on the coin used · 'A gun given to a great gunslinger · Forged by the arms of a man given no name' · Hold Shift for more'LET'S GO GAMBLING!'

Coin Gun.name: Coin Gun
Coin Gun.desc: The Coin Gun is a Hardmode ranged weapon that uses coins as ammunition, which affects its damage and velocity depending on the type of coin fired. The weapon itself has 0 base damage, with the entirety of its damage value stemming from the coins used to fire it.
Coin Gun.tip: Uses coins for ammo · Higher valued coins do more damage

Platinum Coin.name: Platinum Coin
Platinum Coin.desc: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria, primarily used for transactions with NPCs. They are obtained by killing enemies, selling items to or interacting with NPCs, or finding them in multiple forms of loot.

The Slime God (Lore).name: The Slime God (Lore)
The Slime God (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
The Slime God (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Slime God Trophy.name: Slime God Trophy
Slime God Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

The Sponge.name: The Sponge
The Sponge.desc: The Sponge is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction.
The Sponge.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer

The Swarmer.name: The Swarmer
The Swarmer.desc: The Swarmer is a craftable Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Bee Gun and Wasp Gun. When used, it rapidly fires 2 homing bees and wasps per shot that dissipate upon contact with enemies or tiles.
The Swarmer.tip: Fires a swarm of bees and wasps

Bee Gun.name: Bee Gun
Bee Gun.desc: The Bee Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it fires a burst of Bee projectiles that home in on enemies, can pierce enemies twice or bounce on blocks three times, and have a 1/2 chance to deal 1 extra damage.
Bee Gun.tip: Shoots bees that will chase your enemy

Wasp Gun.name: Wasp Gun
Wasp Gun.desc: The Wasp Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it fires 2–4 homing wasp projectiles that ricochet or hit enemies a maximum of three times before dissipating. The wasp projectiles also have 10 armor penetration.

The Transformer.name: The Transformer
The Transformer.desc: The Transformer is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The Transformer.tip: Generates an aura around you that creates morphing globs when projectiles pass through it or when enemies are killed · The globs encircle you and deal low damage and knockback to enemies they collide with · The circle can contain up to 30 globs at once · Press Transformer Hot Key to transform all globs into needles and launch them at your cursor · 'How did this come out of the junk you cobbled together? You're lucky it doesn't transform you'

Phoenix Blaster.name: Phoenix Blaster
Phoenix Blaster.desc: The Phoenix Blaster is a pre-Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Handgun, with increased damage and velocity but slightly less knockback.

Thorn Blossom.name: Thorn Blossom
Thorn Blossom.desc: The Thorn Blossom is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Arch Amaryllis.
Thorn Blossom.tip: Casts a beaming flower that explodes into homing petals alongside a deadly thorn · Costs 3 HP to fire · 'Every rose has its thorn'

Thorns Potion.name: Thorns Potion
Thorns Potion.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them.

Red Brick.name: Red Brick
Red Brick.desc: Red Bricks are bricks crafted from Clay Block.

Time Bolt.name: Time Bolt
Time Bolt.desc: The Time Bolt is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger. When used, it throws a knife that emits glowing blue particles as it travels. When the knife hits an enemy or a tile, it releases a large blue field in a 19-tile range that inflicts the Time Distortion debuff.
Time Bolt.tip: Throws a temporal knife that causes Time Distortion around enemies · Stealth strikes can hit more enemies and create a larger time field · 'There should be no boundary to human endeavor'
stats: 1 second (Time Field) / 2 seconds (Stealth Strike Time Field)

Gold Watch.name: Gold Watch
Gold Watch.desc: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Stellar Knife.name: Stellar Knife
Stellar Knife.desc: The Stellar Knife is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated. When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time.
Stellar Knife.tip: Throws knives that stop midair and then home into enemies, inflicting Astral Infection (debuff) · Stealth strikes throw a volley of 10 knives in a spread · 'ZA WARUDO'

Tired Tail.name: Tired Tail
Tired Tail.desc: The Tired Tail is a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. When equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide along with abilities to hover and upwards boost. Pressing Down will toggle the hover option on while pressing Up will toggle it off.
Tired Tail.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Average · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster!

Titan Heart Boots.name: Titan Heart Boots
Titan Heart Boots.desc: Titan Heart armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Astral Monoliths and Titan Hearts.

Titan Heart Mantle.name: Titan Heart Mantle
Titan Heart Mantle.desc: Titan Heart armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Astral Monoliths and Titan Hearts.
Titan Heart Mantle.tip: 10% increased rogue damage and 50% increased rogue knockback

Titan Heart Mask.name: Titan Heart Mask
Titan Heart Mask.desc: Titan Heart armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Astral Monoliths and Titan Hearts.
Titan Heart Mask.tip: 7% increased rogue damage and 10% increased rogue velocity · Rogue weapons inflict Astral Infection (debuff)

Titan Potion.name: Titan Potion
Titan Potion.desc: The Titan Potion is a buff potion which grants the Titan buff when consumed. The buff increases the amount of knockback the player inflicts on enemies by 50%.

Titanium Ore.name: Titanium Ore
Titanium Ore.desc: Titanium Ore belongs to the third tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the third altar broken, either it or Adamantite Ore can spawn in the cavern layer, roughly at lava depth. Mining Titanium Ore requires a Mythril/Orichalcum Pickaxe or better.

Titanium Railgun.name: Titanium Railgun
Titanium Railgun.desc: The Titanium Railgun is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When holding left click, it will begin charging energy, signified by a pair of converging sights illuminating a cone-shaped area in the aiming direction.
Titanium Railgun.tip: Hold down to charge up a decimating titanium blast · Longer hold time increases power, leading to more damage, size, and knockback · Power is capped when the cannon's sights have fully converged

Titanium Bar.name: Titanium Bar
Titanium Bar.desc: The Titanium Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Titanium Shuriken.name: Titanium Shuriken
Titanium Shuriken.desc: The Titanium Shuriken is a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. It pierces twice and can travel in the air for a brief moment before falling to the ground.
Titanium Shuriken.tip: Stealth strikes act like a boomerang that spawns clones on enemy hits

Tombstone.name: Tombstone
Tombstone.desc: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies. It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration. By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Molotov Cocktail.name: Molotov Cocktail
Molotov Cocktail.desc: The Molotov Cocktail is a consumable ranged weapon with a relatively short throwing arc.
Molotov Cocktail.tip: A small explosion that puts enemies on fire · Lights nearby area on fire for a while

Tranquility Candle.name: Tranquility Candle
Tranquility Candle.desc: The Tranquility Candle is a craftable Hardmode furniture item that emits light and grants the Tranquility Candle buff, which reduces enemy spawn rates by 40% and maximum spawn count by 40%.
Tranquility Candle.tip: The mere presence of this candle calms surrounding enemies drastically

Peace Candle.name: Peace Candle
Peace Candle.desc: The Peace Candle is a furniture item that emits a low amount of light and can be placed only on flat-surface items. When placed or held, it gives nearby players the Peace Candle buff.

Zen Potion.name: Zen Potion
Zen Potion.desc: The Zen Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Zen buff, which reduces enemy spawn rates and maximum spawn count by 60%. It is also used in the crafting of the Tranquility Candle.

Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of.name: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of.desc: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer thrown melee weapon. When used, it throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to the player after striking an enemy.
Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of.tip: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Enemy hits release prismatic light flares which orbit around the struck foe · Instead of returning, the fourth hit transforms flares into hardlight hammers · These hammers converge and form a universe-collapsing explosion that always critically strikes
Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of.wiki: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

Trimarang.name: Trimarang
Trimarang.desc: The Trimarang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang crafted using three different boomerangs. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of three Trimarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

Ice Boomerang.name: Ice Boomerang
Ice Boomerang.desc: The Ice Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 931/6000 chance of being found inside Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as a 1/6 chance of being obtained from Frozen and Boreal Crates.

Shroomerang.name: Shroomerang
Shroomerang.desc: The Shroomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by Spore Bats with a 1/40 chance.

Excalibur.name: Excalibur
Excalibur.desc: The Excalibur is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss broadsword. When swung, a large yellow aura follows the swing, reaching about twice the distance of the sword itself. The aura can hit up to three enemies.

Sunfury.name: Sunfury
Sunfury.desc: The Sunfury is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/5 chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff.name: Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff
Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff.desc: The Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons up to three pink flowers that orbit around the player.
Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff.tip: Summons three flarefrost orchids over your head · Each flower consumes one minion slot

Turbulance.name: Turbulance
Turbulance.desc: The Turbulance is a craftable Pre-Hardmode non-consumable javelin. When used, it throws a javelin that releases three wind slashes in random directions on collision with enemies or blocks.
Turbulance.tip: Fires a cloudy javelin that bursts into wind slashes on hit · Wind slashes occasionally home, and always home if the javelin crits · Stealth strikes are trailed by homing wind slashes

Twinkler in a Bottle.name: Twinkler in a Bottle
Twinkler in a Bottle.desc: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters. A critter caught with any Bug Net is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage.

Twinkler.name: Twinkler
Twinkler.desc: The Twinkler is a Hardmode critter found within the Astral Infection that acts similarly to a Firefly. Twinklers can be caught with any type of Bug Net and may be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 40%.

Twisting Thunder.name: Twisting Thunder
Twisting Thunder.desc: The Twisting Thunder is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is an upgrade to the Stormfront Razor and the final upgrade of the Cinquedea. It automatically throws a gravity-defying lightning bolt that does not pierce and travels faster while raining.
Twisting Thunder.tip: Fires a lightning bolt to electrocute enemies · The lightning bolt travels faster while it is raining · Summons lightning from the sky on impact · Stealth strikes summon more lightning and travel faster

Typhon's Greed.name: Typhon's Greed
Typhon's Greed.desc: The Typhon's Greed is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon. On use, it spins in a 360-degree circle and summons floating bubbles that pass through tiles and travel from off-screen towards the player, exploding into particles upon contact with enemies or after some time has passed.
Typhon's Greed.tip: Summons water spirits while in use · These water spirits will home in on enemies after traveling towards the player

Tyranny's End.name: Tyranny's End
Tyranny's End.desc: The Tyranny's End is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is the direct upgrade to the Anti-materiel Rifle and the final upgrade to the Sniper Rifle.
Tyranny's End.tip: Converts musket balls into.70 caliber sniper rounds that deal devastating damage · Causes enemies to become Marked for Death and bypasses defense · Critical hits summon a swarm of 6 additional bullets · 'Pierce the heart of even the most heavily-armored foe'

Uelibloom Brick Wall.name: Uelibloom Brick Wall
Uelibloom Brick Wall.desc: Uelibloom Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Uelibloom Brick.

Ultima.name: Ultima
Ultima.desc: Ultima is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. Upon firing initially, it fires rainbow bolts which bounce off surfaces and do not pierce, firing in a manner parallel from the bow to the cursor with a random offset around the bow's sprite position.
Ultima.tip: Casts a continuous stream of plasma bolts · Over time bolts power up into solid beams as you continue shooting · 66% chance to save ammo

Ultra Liquidator.name: Ultra Liquidator
Ultra Liquidator.desc: The Ultra Liquidator is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Infernal Rift. When used, it fires a set of five rainbow blades that do not pierce or pass through tiles.
Ultra Liquidator.tip: Summons liquidation blades that summon more blades on enemy hits

Ultrabright Torch.name: Ultrabright Torch
Ultrabright Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Umbraphile Boots.name: Umbraphile Boots
Umbraphile Boots.desc: Umbraphile armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Solar Veils and Hallowed Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.
Umbraphile Boots.tip: 9% increased rogue damage and 6% increased rogue critical strike chance · 20% increased movement speed

Umbraphile Hood.name: Umbraphile Hood
Umbraphile Hood.desc: Umbraphile armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Solar Veils and Hallowed Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.
Umbraphile Hood.tip: 8% increased rogue damage and 10% increased rogue velocity

Umbraphile Regalia.name: Umbraphile Regalia
Umbraphile Regalia.desc: Umbraphile armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Solar Veils and Hallowed Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.
Umbraphile Regalia.tip: 10% increased rogue damage and critical strike chance

Undine's Retribution.name: Undine's Retribution
Undine's Retribution.desc: Undine's Retribution is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it spawns 3 aqua spears from below the screen that quickly home in on nearby enemies. The spears can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.
Undine's Retribution.tip: Casts a swarm of homing spears

Unholy Tonic.name: Unholy Tonic
Unholy Tonic.desc: The Unholy Tonic is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.
Unholy Tonic.tip: Increases defense by 3 while in the corruption · Grants immunity to Brain Rot

Vile Powder.name: Vile Powder
Vile Powder.desc: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their pure, Crimson, or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword, and produce a fair amount of light.

Universal Genesis.name: Universal Genesis
Universal Genesis.desc: The Universal Genesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun which is an upgrade to the Conference Call. When used, it fires a tight spread of six bullets from the gun and five additional stars from above which are aimed towards the cursor.
Universal Genesis.tip: Fires a spread of bullets from the gun and a flurry of stars to rain down on the cursor · Converts musket balls into starcaller shots that summon additional stars on enemy hits · 'Let the starry sky fall upon your enemies'

Star Cloak.name: Star Cloak
Star Cloak.desc: The Star Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that causes three stars to fall around the player whenever the player takes damage. It consumes no mana. The stars pass through blocks until reaching the player's altitude, at which point they continue falling until hitting blocks.
Star Cloak.tip: Causes stars to fall after taking damage

Universe Splitter.name: Universe Splitter
Universe Splitter.desc: The Universe Splitter is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, a field appears at the player's cursor. After two seconds, a red laser sweeps down from the sky towards the field every second for six seconds, slightly randomized in the angle shot.
Universe Splitter.tip: Summons an energy field at the mouse cursor · After the field has been deployed, it begins to summon multiple small beams · After several seconds have passed, an enormous laser beam appears at the field's position · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Attempting to use this item during the cooldown will cause it to short circuit and do damage to you · 'An ancient artifact from a previous age, it waits for your command. · This is a terrible idea, but it isn't yours anyways... right?'

Burrower Beacon.name: Burrower Beacon
Burrower Beacon.desc: The Burrower Beacon is a light pet summoning item that summons a friendly Burrower to follow the player around. It can be obtained by killing the Burrower while it is inflicted with an electrical debuff.
Burrower Beacon.tip: Requests a friendly burrower to follow you around and illuminate ores · Counts as a light pet

Unstable Caster's Gauntlet.name: Unstable Caster's Gauntlet
Unstable Caster's Gauntlet.desc: The Unstable Caster's Gauntlet is a craftable Post-Moon Lord magic weapon. It does not consume mana, instead using Vis, a unique resource which recharges by 0.1 every 0.067 seconds while the item is held.
Unstable Caster's Gauntlet.tip: Left Click to fire piercing needles · Right Click to summon a ring of sigils, each representing a primordial element · Hold Left Click with sigils available to consume random sigils, each unleashing an attack · Right Click again while the elemental ring is out to replace all empty slots with Warped sigils · Warped sigils automatically fire barrages of inaccurate purple blasts · All actions require sufficient Vis to use · Vis is restored over time · Ordo sigils always land critical strikes · Perdito sigils ignore 25 points of enemy defense · Ignis sigils inflict Daybroken · Aqua sigils inflict Crush Depth · Aer sigils boast substantial knockback · Terra sigils split into sharp rocks

Urchin Mace.name: Urchin Mace
Urchin Mace.desc: The Urchin Mace is a craftable Pre-Hardmode flail. When used, the player starts spinning the mace around, creating a whirlpool around themselves.
Urchin Mace.tip: Throws out a whirlpool when released · 'The people of the sea were adept hunters, but they abhorred unnecessary violence. · Unfortunately, neighboring nations were brutish, so they fashioned their tools for war.'

V8 Engine.name: V8 Engine
V8 Engine.desc: The V8 Engine is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the Left Click or Right Click keys, with a base distance of 3 blocks.
V8 Engine.tip: Grants a short dash with a long cooldown that works while mounted

V8000 Engine.name: V8000 Engine
V8000 Engine.desc: The V8000 Engine is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade of the V8 Engine. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the Left Click or Right Click keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks, accompanied by a trail of harmless souls.
V8000 Engine.tip: Grants a dash with a long cooldown that works while mounted · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Are soul-powered engines eco-friendly?'

Broken Bat Wing.name: Broken Bat Wing
Broken Bat Wing.desc: The Broken Bat Wing is a rare Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Bat Wings. It has a 1/40 chance of being dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse.

Rotten Dogtooth.name: Rotten Dogtooth
Rotten Dogtooth.desc: The Rotten Dogtooth is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Rotdogs. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and inflict the Crumbling debuff.
Rotten Dogtooth.tip: Stealth strikes inflict Crumbling and deal 8% more damage

Vanquisher Arrow.name: Vanquisher Arrow
Vanquisher Arrow.desc: Vanquisher Arrows are craftable post-Moon Lord arrows. They appear as pink or magenta colors, can pass through tiles and aggressively seek the closest target within 4 tiles of range, inflicting the God Slayer Inferno debuff.
Vanquisher Arrow.tip: Pierces through tiles and homes in on enemies · Tears a rift in space on enemy hits

Veering Wind.name: Veering Wind
Veering Wind.desc: The Veering Wind is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it fires an even ring of 12 fast air waves which travel outwards from the player and deal heavy knockback.
Veering Wind.tip: Casts a circular spread of wind waves with high knockback · Press Right Click to cast a circular spread of frost waves

Moon Stone.name: Moon Stone
Moon Stone.desc: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 / 69/1225 chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.
Moon Stone.tip: During nighttime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

drops.chance: 1/10 (10%) (In what a horrible night to have a curse worlds (underground / cavern))

Inferno Fork.name: Inferno Fork
Inferno Fork.desc: The Inferno Fork is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 / 39/400 chance of being dropped by Diabolists in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a fireball that causes a lingering explosion upon contact with an enemy or a block.
Inferno Fork.tip: Launches a ball of fire that explodes into a raging inferno

Verium Bolt.name: Verium Bolt
Verium Bolt.desc: Verium Bolts are craftable Hardmode arrows. When hitting enemies, it marks them, causing the enemy to emit star particles for 1.5 seconds before exploding, dealing additional flat damage.
Verium Bolt.tip: Marks enemies on hit, dealing extra damage after a short time · This damage stacks based on how many bolts hit the enemy · 'There is no escape...'

Hallowed Repeater.name: Hallowed Repeater
Hallowed Repeater.desc: The Hallowed Repeater is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss repeater.

Mud Block.name: Mud Block
Mud Block.desc: Mud Blocks are a very common block type that comprises the majority of the Jungle, Underground Jungle, and Glowing Mushroom biome. It also generates in irregular patches in the Cavern layer.

Verstaltite Fishing Rod.name: Verstaltite Fishing Rod
Verstaltite Fishing Rod.desc: The Verstaltite Fishing Rod is a craftable Hardmode fishing pole. While fishing in the Snow biome, the player's fishing power is increased by 1.1x.
Verstaltite Fishing Rod.tip: Increased fishing power by 1.1x when in the tundra · The ancient alloy's prismatic qualities are perfect for attracting fish

Vicious Tonic.name: Vicious Tonic
Vicious Tonic.desc: The Vicious Tonic is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.
Vicious Tonic.tip: Increases defense by 3 while in the crimson · Grants immunity to Burning Blood

Vicious Powder.name: Vicious Powder
Vicious Powder.desc: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their pure, Crimson, or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword, and produce a fair amount of light.

Victide Breastplate.name: Victide Breastplate
Victide Breastplate.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.
Victide Breastplate.tip: 5% increased damage reduction and critical strike chance · +5 defense and 10% increased damage reduction while submerged in liquid

Victide Coral Turban.name: Victide Coral Turban
Victide Coral Turban.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Victide Greaves.name: Victide Greaves
Victide Greaves.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.
Victide Greaves.tip: Movement speed increased by 8% · Movement speed increased by 30% while submerged in liquid

Victide Headcrab.name: Victide Headcrab
Victide Headcrab.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Victide Hermit Helmet.name: Victide Hermit Helmet
Victide Hermit Helmet.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Victide Mask.name: Victide Mask
Victide Mask.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Victide Shellmet.name: Victide Shellmet
Victide Shellmet.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Ebonwood.name: Ebonwood
Ebonwood.desc: Ebonwood is a type of wood harvested from Ebonwood trees and Ebonwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Corruption biomes.

Shadow Scale.name: Shadow Scale
Shadow Scale.desc: The Shadow Scale is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from the Eater of Worlds (and its Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Viral Sprout.name: Viral Sprout
Viral Sprout.desc: The Viral Sprout is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a flower-shaped spirit that attacks nearby enemies by firing gravity-affected needles.
Viral Sprout.tip: Summons a sage spirit to fight for you · Inflicts Sage Poison, a debuff that becomes stronger the more spirits you own

Viscera.name: Viscera
Viscera.desc: The Viscera is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a burst of 4 solid beams of blood that bounce off of tiles. The first enemy hit by the beams spawns 2 blood orbs, which reduce Potion Sickness cooldown by 0.083 seconds.
Viscera.tip: Fires a rapid barrage of piercing blood beams · The first enemy struck by each beam will burst into blood orbs · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness · Each successive beam in the barrage deals more damage · The last beam of the barrage instead explodes upon hitting an enemy

Vivid Clarity.name: Vivid Clarity
Vivid Clarity.desc: The Vivid Clarity is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is the final upgrade of the Night's Ray. It fires a set of 5 beams towards the player's cursor that breaks upon contact with an enemy or tile. Once it breaks, it does one of the following:
Vivid Clarity.tip: Fires five randomized rays of exo-energy towards the cursor · Enemy and tile hits either cause a big flash explosion, an additional laser from the sky, or split into energy orbs · Struck enemies are liquified by Miracle Blight · 'Its majesty inspires a stroke of unparalleled genius'

Vodka.name: Vodka
Vodka.desc: Vodka is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Vodka debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted typeless debuffs by 25% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted debuffs of any element type by 50%.
Vodka.tip: 25% increased Typeless debuff damage · 50% decreased elemental debuff damage · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Void Bathtub.name: Void Bathtub
Void Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Bed.name: Void Bed
Void Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Bookcase.name: Void Bookcase
Void Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Candelabra.name: Void Candelabra
Void Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Candle.name: Void Candle
Void Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Void Chandelier.name: Void Chandelier
Void Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Chest.name: Void Chest
Void Chest.desc: Chests are furniture items that are used to store items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 21 types of chests, most of which correspond to their specific set of furniture. Various chests such as Ancient Treasure Chests and Security Chests are generated within the world.

Void Condenser.name: Void Condenser
Void Condenser.desc: The Void Condenser is a craftable crafting station that is used to craft furniture themed around the Abyss. It can be used to create two different furniture sets, one made from Smooth Abyss Gravel and the other from Smooth Voidstone.

Void Door.name: Void Door
Void Door.desc: Doors are furniture items that can be opened and closed to allow or prevent entry respectively. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of doors to the game, with seventeen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Dresser.name: Void Dresser
Void Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Edge.name: Void Edge
