Void Edge.desc: The Void Edge is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When used, it releases three ghastly souls that will home on nearby enemies after a brief moment and cause an explosion upon hitting them for additional damage. The souls can home on enemies through tiles.
Void Edge.tip: Fires the ghastly souls of long-deceased abyss dwellers · Striking with the blade summons additional souls from below

Void Lamp.name: Void Lamp
Void Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Lantern.name: Void Lantern
Void Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Obelisk.name: Void Obelisk
Void Obelisk.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Piano.name: Void Piano
Void Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Sink.name: Void Sink
Void Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Sofa.name: Void Sofa
Void Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Void Table.name: Void Table
Void Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Void Vortex.name: Void Vortex
Void Vortex.desc: The Void Vortex is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Voltaic Climax.
Void Vortex.tip: Conjures a swirling vortex of supercharged magnet spheres around the cursor that explodes into a storm of homing mini spheres

Voltaic Climax.name: Voltaic Climax
Voltaic Climax.desc: The Voltaic Climax is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it summons a circular spread of 9 tile-ignoring magnetic orbs around the cursor that spread out before stopping.
Voltaic Climax.tip: Conjures a ring of supercharged magnet spheres around the cursor

Void Work Bench.name: Void Work Bench
Void Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Voidragon.name: Voidragon
Voidragon.desc: The Voidragon is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer gun which is the upgraded version of Seadragon and the final upgrade to the Minishark.
Voidragon.tip: Loads a 50 round magazine of alternating bullets and concentrated void blasts · When all bullets are fired, the gun unleashes an enormous jet of abyssal fire · The power of the abyssal fire scales with the amount of shots hit · 66% chance to save ammo · 'Fade to black'

Dragon's Breath.name: Dragon's Breath
Dragon's Breath.desc: The Dragon's Breath is a post-Moon Lord flamethrower that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. It uses Gel for ammunition, with an 80% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a stream of fireballs that pierce infinitely but lose 5% damage per hit.
Dragon's Breath.tip: Fires intense blasts of Dragonfire at an accelerating pace · Upon firing for long enough, you will begin using a cartridge of energy · While using a cartridge you will shoot a draconic beam of pure Dragonfire that doesn't consume ammo · Once a cartridge has been ejected you will return to the original fire rate · 80% chance to save ammo

Voidstone Wall.name: Voidstone Wall
Voidstone Wall.desc: Voidstone Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the two bottom layers of the Abyss, replacing Abyss Gravel Wall. It can also be crafted.

Voidstone Slab.name: Voidstone Slab
Voidstone Slab.desc: Voidstone Slab is a craftable block crafted from Smooth Voidstone at a Void Condenser.

Voidstone Slab Wall.name: Voidstone Slab Wall
Voidstone Slab Wall.desc: Voidstone Slab Walls are background walls crafted with Voidstone Slabs at a Work Bench.

Volcanic Sinker.name: Volcanic Sinker
Volcanic Sinker.desc: The Volcanic Sinker is a craftable Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Volcanic Sinker.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Allows fishing in lava · Provides a fishing minigame · Moving while fishing instead moves your bobbers · Rifts appear over time in liquids, containing an item · When bobbers touch a rift, they automatically reel in the item within

Voltage Regulation System.name: Voltage Regulation System
Voltage Regulation System.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

Voodoo Demon Voodoo Doll.name: Voodoo Demon Voodoo Doll
Voodoo Demon Voodoo Doll.desc: The Voodoo Demon Voodoo Doll is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable Voodoo Demon spawns.
Voodoo Demon Voodoo Doll.tip: Toggle this item to prevent voodoo demons from spawning near you · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Vortexpopper.name: Vortexpopper
Vortexpopper.desc: The Vortexpopper is a craftable Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Xenopopper. When used, it fires a spread of bubbles from the gun, and extra bubbles off-screen from any direction. After a short delay, the bubbles will pop and fire a bullet towards the cursor.
Vortexpopper.tip: Fires bubbles everywhere that pop into bullets

Xenopopper.name: Xenopopper
Xenopopper.desc: The Xenopopper is a Hardmode, post-Golem gun that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it fires a burst of 4–5 purple bubbles, consuming one bullet.

Vulcanite Lance.name: Vulcanite Lance
Vulcanite Lance.desc: The Vulcanite Lance is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, it creates explosions when hitting enemies. Dealing critical hits will spawn two flares from off-screen that will home into nearby enemies. The flares deal half of the spear's damage.
Vulcanite Lance.tip: Explodes on enemy hits and summons homing flares on critical hits

W-LSR: Phalanx Surge.name: W-LSR: Phalanx Surge
W-LSR: Phalanx Surge.desc: The W-LSR: Phalanx Surge is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. When used, it fires a wide spread of lasers. Holding right-click charges the weapon, taking 1 second to fully charge.
W-LSR: Phalanx Surge.tip: Fires a spread of lasers · Holding Right Click charges the weapon, allowing it to thrust forward and imaple enemies with an energy spear · Holding Left Click when firing the charge attack will launch you forward at high speeds and deal extra damage · Using the charged attack has a short cooldown · 'Though Godseeker Knights are often brutish, not all prefer close quarters melee combat. · As such, Yharim personally requested that I create heavy weaponry for them despite being few in number.'

Wand of Sparking.name: Wand of Sparking
Wand of Sparking.desc: The Wand of Sparking is a pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a spark that travels in a slight curve for about 23 tiles before dissipating. The spark can pierce one enemy and has a 1/2 chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff.

Wandering Jingasa.name: Wandering Jingasa
Wandering Jingasa.desc: The Wandering set or Wandering Ronin set is a vanity set consisting of the Wandering Jingasa, the Wandering Yukata, and the Wandering Geta.
Wandering Jingasa.tip: 'Your most loyal travel companion. The glowing orb is soft and welcoming.' · Concept by crowflux

Firefly.name: Firefly
Firefly.desc: The Firefly is a harmless critter that gives off a tiny amount of light. Fireflies will spawn near grass on the surface at night, except inside houses. Their spawn rate will be randomly set everyday, making their spawn amount varying greatly each night.

Warloks' Moon Fist.name: Warloks' Moon Fist
Warloks' Moon Fist.desc: The Warloks' Moon Fist is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a blue cosmic fist that hovers above the player.
Warloks' Moon Fist.tip: Summons a celestial fist to punch enemies for you

Golem Fist.name: Golem Fist
Golem Fist.desc: The Golem Fist is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires a large, high-velocity fist attached to a chain that retracts on impact with enemies or blocks, or after traveling for more than 31.25 tiles away from the player..
Golem Fist.tip: Punches with the force of a golem

Warmth Potion.name: Warmth Potion
Warmth Potion.desc: The Warmth Potion is a buff potion that grants the Warmth buff when consumed, which provides +30% damage reduction from cold-themed enemies (see below). It also reduces the duration of Chilled by 75% and Frozen by 50%.

Water Turret.name: Water Turret
Water Turret.desc: Turrets are placeable furniture items that function as weapons. They will fire at enemies if they are within their line of sight and within specific ranges. The normal turrets will not attack while a boss is alive.

Water Walking Boots.name: Water Walking Boots
Water Walking Boots.desc: Water Walking Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that grants the ability to walk on water, honey, and Shimmer. They do not allow walking on lava. While on said liquids, pressing Down will cause the player to fall through the liquid, similarly to platforms.
Water Walking Boots.tip: Provides the ability to walk on water & honey

Water Walking Potion.name: Water Walking Potion
Water Walking Potion.desc: The Water Walking Potion is a buff potion which grants the Water Walking buff when consumed. The buff allows the player to walk on the surface of all liquids (water, lava, honey, and Shimmer), and prevents fall damage when falling onto liquid surfaces.
Water Walking Potion.tip: Allows the ability to walk on water

Wave Pounder.name: Wave Pounder
Wave Pounder.desc: The Wave Pounder is a craftable post-Moon Lord bomb. When used, it throws a gravity-affected bomb that sticks onto solid tiles for 3 seconds or until a target is struck before it explodes.
Wave Pounder.tip: Throws a bomb which explodes into a agonizingly forceful shockwave · Stealth strikes emit absurdly powerful shockwaves

Wave Skipper.name: Wave Skipper
Wave Skipper.desc: The Wave Skipper is a craftable Hardmode javelin that is an upgraded version of the Scourge of the Desert. When used it will throw a Wave Skipper that will bounce five times before disappearing.
Wave Skipper.tip: Throws a spear that bounces a lot · Stealth strikes throw three high speed spears

Scourge of the Desert.name: Scourge of the Desert
Scourge of the Desert.desc: The Scourge of the Desert is a javelin dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.
Scourge of the Desert.tip: A javelin that will burrow through the ground and launch itself at enemies · Stealth strikes throw three javelins that will burrow multiple times

Web Ball.name: Web Ball
Web Ball.desc: The Web Ball is a craftable consumable Pre-Hardmode spiky ball. It throws a gravity affected web-covered ball that inflicts the Webbed debuff onto enemies for half a second, slowing their movement speed.
Web Ball.tip: Throws a web-covered ball that gets enemies Webbed and slows them down · Stealth strikes slow enemies down longer

Cobweb.name: Cobweb
Cobweb.desc: Cobwebs are crafting materials used to craft Silk and other items. Cobwebs can also be placed. Placed Cobwebs catch players who fall into them and reset fall damage.

Whiskey.name: Whiskey
Whiskey.desc: Whiskey is a craftable Hardmode alcohol.
Whiskey.tip: Provides between -15% and 15% damage to the held weapon's class · Each class tracks this boost individually · This boost lowers the longer you hold weapons of the same class, taking 10 seconds to fully decay · This boost recharges when holding weapons of a different class, taking 5 seconds to fully recharge · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Spicy Pepper.name: Spicy Pepper
Spicy Pepper.desc: The Spicy Pepper is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

White Pearl Pile.name: White Pearl Pile
White Pearl Pile.desc: White Pearl Pile is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block.

White Seeking Mechanism.name: White Seeking Mechanism
White Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

White Wine.name: White Wine
White Wine.desc: White Wine is a craftable Hardmode alcohol.
White Wine.tip: You regain flight time the closer you are to an enemy · 50% reduced flight time · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Giant Harpy Feather.name: Giant Harpy Feather
Giant Harpy Feather.desc: The Giant Harpy Feather is a rare crafting material used solely to craft Harpy Wings. It has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Harpies.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.desc: The Flamethrower is a Hardmode, post-Skeletron Prime ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it consumes one Gel and releases five bursts of fire in quick succession.
Flamethrower.tip: Uses gel for ammo · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense

Meowthrower.name: Meowthrower
Meowthrower.desc: The Meowthrower is a Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires a slight spread of blue and pink flames at a short range, each piercing twice. It additionally fires homing cat projectiles.
Meowthrower.tip: Cooks your foes to purrfection with catty smoke · Occasionally launches homing feline entities · Uses gel for ammo

Wormhole Potion.name: Wormhole Potion
Wormhole Potion.desc: The Wormhole Potion is a potion which allows a player to instantly teleport to another team member's location in multiplayer, done by selecting their player icon in the full-screen map (accessible by pressing the map key) once consumed.
Wormhole Potion.tip: Teleports you to a party member · Click their head on the fullscreen map

Wrath Potion.name: Wrath Potion
Wrath Potion.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%.

Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack.name: Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack
Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack.desc: The Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack.tip: Provides a wulfrum slingshot grappling hook · This slingshot's stats scale with your equipped hook · If the hook has special effects, the slingshot also benefits from them · The slingshot allows for advanced rope-swinging physics · Hold Up or Down to retract or extend the slingshot's rope · Automatically grapples nearby walls if a lethal fall is detected · This safety feature won't activate if Down is held · 8% increased movement speed

Wulfrum Bathtub.name: Wulfrum Bathtub
Wulfrum Bathtub.desc: Bathtubs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bathtubs to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Plating.name: Wulfrum Plating
Wulfrum Plating.desc: Wulfrum Plating is a craftable block crafted from Stone Blocks and Wulfrum Metal Scraps at a Heavy Work Bench. It is used in the crafting of Wulfrum furniture.

Wulfrum Bed.name: Wulfrum Bed
Wulfrum Bed.desc: Beds are furniture items that allows the player to set their spawn point. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of beds to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Blunderbuss.name: Wulfrum Blunderbuss
Wulfrum Blunderbuss.desc: The Wulfrum Blunderbuss is a craftable pre-Hardmode ranged weapon which uses Wulfrum Metal Scraps or Silver Coins as ammunition.
Wulfrum Blunderbuss.tip: Consumes wulfrum scrap or silver coins to fire · The shot's spread can be diminished by aiming further away, at the cost of less damage · Ignores 3 points of enemy Defense · 'The good thing about Wulfrum is that while it breaks fast, it can be reused even faster. · In fact, it is quite common for a robot to be turned into ammo right after it stops functioning.'

Wulfrum Bobber.name: Wulfrum Bobber
Wulfrum Bobber.desc: The Wulfrum Bobber is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory. While equipped, bobbers emit a blue pulse ring in a random cardinal direction every second while fishing conditions are valid.
Wulfrum Bobber.tip: Provides a fishing minigame · Hold movement inputs in the indicated directions while fishing to catch items · The rod empowers the longer you go without a mistake, speeding it up · 'There's supposed to be a fish finder installed, but it only beeps when you point it at yourself...'

Wulfrum Bookcase.name: Wulfrum Bookcase
Wulfrum Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Candelabra.name: Wulfrum Candelabra
Wulfrum Candelabra.desc: Candelabras are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds seventeen types of candelabras to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Candle.name: Wulfrum Candle
Wulfrum Candle.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light.
stats: 60 copper (Most candles) / 1 silver (Chaos and Tranquility candles) / 40 gold (Wizard candles)

Wulfrum Chandelier.name: Wulfrum Chandelier
Wulfrum Chandelier.desc: Chandeliers are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of chandeliers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Clock.name: Wulfrum Clock
Wulfrum Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items that tell the in-game time. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of grandfather clocks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Complex Panel Wall.name: Wulfrum Complex Panel Wall
Wulfrum Complex Panel Wall.desc: Wulfrum Complex Panel Walls are a background wall crafted with Wulfrum Metal Scraps, Anodized Wulfrum Metal, and Energy Cores at a Work Bench.

Wulfrum Controller.name: Wulfrum Controller
Wulfrum Controller.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon.
Wulfrum Controller.tip: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold Right Click while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them

Wulfrum Digging Turtle.name: Wulfrum Digging Turtle
Wulfrum Digging Turtle.desc: Wulfrum Digging Turtles are craftable Pre-Hardmode consumable tools. When used, the player throws a gravity-affected digging turtle which does not deal damage. Upon collision with a tile, it starts to break tiles in its path for up to 5.83 seconds before breaking.
Wulfrum Digging Turtle.tip: Throws a rickety mining contraption to dig out a small tunnel · In case of an emergency, press Right Click to instantly detonate all your digging turtles · The turtle scales with your pickaxe power

Wulfrum Dresser.name: Wulfrum Dresser
Wulfrum Dresser.desc: Dressers are furniture items that allow the player to change their character's appearance. They additionally can be used as storage, similar to Chests. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of dressers to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Drill.name: Wulfrum Drill
Wulfrum Drill.desc: The Wulfrum Drill is a craftable Pre-Hardmode drill that is capable of mining blocks up to Gold Ore / Platinum Ore. It has an innate 15 armor penetration.

Wulfrum Dye.name: Wulfrum Dye
Wulfrum Dye.desc: Dyes are cosmetic items that can be placed in the Dye Slots of a player's inventory to alter the colors/textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Calamity Mod currently adds 44 types of dyes to the game, most of them being crafted at a Dye Vat.

Wulfrum Energy Barrier.name: Wulfrum Energy Barrier
Wulfrum Energy Barrier.desc: Wulfrum Energy Barriers are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block made from Glass and Energy Cores at a Heavy Work Bench.

Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall.name: Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall
Wulfrum Energy Barrier Wall.desc: Wulfrum Energy Barrier Walls are a background wall crafted with Wulfrum Energy Barriers.

Wulfrum Fishing Pole.name: Wulfrum Fishing Pole
Wulfrum Fishing Pole.desc: The Wulfrum Fishing Pole is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing pole. It has slightly higher fishing power than the Wood Fishing Pole. It has:
Wulfrum Fishing Pole.tip: Can fish up Wulfrum Metal Scrap and Wulfrum Energy Cores · 'This barely works, but it's better than nothing...'

Wulfrum Hat & Goggles.name: Wulfrum Hat & Goggles
Wulfrum Hat & Goggles.desc: Wulfrum armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Wulfrum Metal Scraps and Energy Cores.
Wulfrum Hat & Goggles.tip: 5% increased summon damage · Comes equipped with hair extensions

Wulfrum Jacket.name: Wulfrum Jacket
Wulfrum Jacket.desc: Wulfrum armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Wulfrum Metal Scraps and Energy Cores.
Wulfrum Jacket.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1

Wulfrum Labstation.name: Wulfrum Labstation
Wulfrum Labstation.desc: The Wulfrum Labstation is a craftable Pre-Hardmode furniture item. It counts as a table for NPC housing.

Wulfrum Lamp.name: Wulfrum Lamp
Wulfrum Lamp.desc: Lamps are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of lamps to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Lantern.name: Wulfrum Lantern
Wulfrum Lantern.desc: Lanterns are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of lanterns to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Lure.name: Wulfrum Lure
Wulfrum Lure.desc: The Wulfrum Lure is a craftable Pre-Hardmode furniture item. Pressing Right Click on the Wulfrum Lure while having an Energy Core in the inventory will cause it to release a signal that spawns up to 4 Wulfrum enemies every 4 seconds.
Wulfrum Lure.tip: Consumes Energy Core to emit a wulfrum signal that lures Wulfrum automatons out · The signal lasts for 30 seconds

Wulfrum Platform.name: Wulfrum Platform
Wulfrum Platform.desc: Platforms are furniture items that function as tiles and can be walked on. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty types of platforms to the game.

Wulfrum Overalls.name: Wulfrum Overalls
Wulfrum Overalls.desc: Wulfrum armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Wulfrum Metal Scraps and Energy Cores.

Wulfrum Panel Wall.name: Wulfrum Panel Wall
Wulfrum Panel Wall.desc: Wulfrum Panel Walls are a background wall crafted with Wulfrum Panels.

Wulfrum Panels.name: Wulfrum Panels
Wulfrum Panels.desc: Wulfrum Panels are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block made with Stone Blocks and Wulfrum Metal Scrap at a Furnace.

Wulfrum Piano.name: Wulfrum Piano
Wulfrum Piano.desc: Pianos are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of pianos to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Pillar.name: Wulfrum Pillar
Wulfrum Pillar.desc: Wulfrum Pillars are a background wall crafted with Anodized Wulfrum Metal and Wulfrum Metal Scraps at a Work Bench.

Wulfrum Plating Wall.name: Wulfrum Plating Wall
Wulfrum Plating Wall.desc: Wulfrum Plating Wall is a background wall crafted from Wulfrum Plating.

Wulfrum Prosthesis.name: Wulfrum Prosthesis
Wulfrum Prosthesis.desc: The Wulfrum Prosthesis is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic weapon. When used with its primary fire (Left Click), it fires fast blue energy bolts that do not pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies.
Wulfrum Prosthesis.tip: Casts a wulfrum bolt · Press Right Click to drain mana from creatures in front of you · 'Technology and magic have been forever locked in an arms race of imitation and retaliation. · At times they work in tandem, as seen in certain prosthetic limbs.'

Wulfrum Scaffold Kit.name: Wulfrum Scaffold Kit
Wulfrum Scaffold Kit.desc: The Wulfrum Scaffold Kit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode tool. When used, the player can place Wulfrum Pipes on air tiles that are orthogonally or diagonally adjacent to an existing solid tile.
Wulfrum Scaffold Kit.tip: Places down temporary metal scaffolding. Uses up Wulfrum Metal Scrap for 40 tiles built · Scaffold needs to be adjacent to a solid tile to be placed down · 'For when you need something built fast and don't need it to last.'

Wulfrum Screwdriver.name: Wulfrum Screwdriver
Wulfrum Screwdriver.desc: The Wulfrum Screwdriver is a craftable Pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, the player holds the screwdriver in the direction of the cursor. The screwdriver hits faster as it continuously hits any targets. Each hit has a 20% chance to spawn a screw if one is not present.
Wulfrum Screwdriver.tip: Can be used to rapidly and royally screw over foes · Striking an enemy sometimes gives you a wulfrum screw that you can throw with Right Click · Hit a thrown screw with the screwdriver to launch it forward at high speed · 'Who makes flatheads this large?? The hell am I supposed to use it for? · This thing could take an eye out!' · '...Ah.'

Wulfrum Sheet Wall.name: Wulfrum Sheet Wall
Wulfrum Sheet Wall.desc: Wulfrum Sheet Walls are a background wall crafted with Wulfrum Sheets.

Wulfrum Sheets.name: Wulfrum Sheets
Wulfrum Sheets.desc: Wulfrum Sheets are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block crafted from Stone Blocks and Anodized Wulfrum Metal.

Wulfrum Siding.name: Wulfrum Siding
Wulfrum Siding.desc: Wulfrum Sidings are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks made with Stone Blocks, Anodized Wulfrum Metal, and Wulfrum Metal Scraps at a Furnace.

Wulfrum Siding Wall.name: Wulfrum Siding Wall
Wulfrum Siding Wall.desc: Wulfrum Siding Walls are a background wall crafted with Wulfrum Sidings.

Wulfrum Sink.name: Wulfrum Sink
Wulfrum Sink.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Sofa.name: Wulfrum Sofa
Wulfrum Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds 18 types of sofas to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla sofas, players can sit on sofas by right-clicking on them.

Wulfrum Table.name: Wulfrum Table
Wulfrum Table.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wulfrum Toilet.name: Wulfrum Toilet
Wulfrum Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Wulfrum Treasure Pinger.name: Wulfrum Treasure Pinger
Wulfrum Treasure Pinger.desc: The Wulfrum Treasure Pinger is a craftable Pre-Hardmode tool. When used, a signal travels outwards from the player which causes tiles that can be detected by the Spelunker Potion to glow with a yellow outline and a scanning effect. Tiles can be highlighted up to 5.83 seconds.
Wulfrum Treasure Pinger.tip: Locates nearby metal that's hopefully more valuable than wulfrum · This contraption seems incredibly shoddy. It'll break sooner than later for sure

Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb.name: Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb
Wulfrum Wall Mounted Bulb.desc: Wall Mounted Bulbs are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds 30 types of wall mounted bulbs.

Wulfrum Work Bench.name: Wulfrum Work Bench
Wulfrum Work Bench.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Sky Glaze.name: Sky Glaze
Sky Glaze.desc: The Sky Glaze is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is rarely dropped by Harpies. When used, it rains down three feathers from the sky that stick to objects and explode after a few seconds. Note that the feathers that fall directly on the enemy do contact damage.
Sky Glaze.tip: Fires feathers from the sky that stick to enemies and tiles and explode

Xenon Moss Brick.name: Xenon Moss Brick
Xenon Moss Brick.desc: Xenon Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Xenon Moss that glows in the dark when placed.

Xenon Moss.name: Xenon Moss
Xenon Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.
Xenon Moss.tip: 'A sight to dwell upon and never forget' · Can be extractinated

Yateveo Bloom.name: Yateveo Bloom
Yateveo Bloom.desc: The Yateveo Bloom is a craftable Pre-Hardmode flail. It throws out a rose flail that is affected by gravity, pierces infinitely, and inflicts the Poisoned debuff. If the player holds down left-click, the flail will spin around the player, damaging any enemy it contacts.
Yateveo Bloom.tip: A synthesis of jungle flora · Throws a powerful rose flail · Press Right Click to stab with a flower spear

Yellow Seeking Mechanism.name: Yellow Seeking Mechanism
Yellow Seeking Mechanism.desc: Seeking Mechanisms are craftable Pre-Hardmode tools. They are used to locate different kinds of Bio-center Labs, with each color corresponding to a specific lab type.

Yharon, Resplendent Phoenix (Lore).name: Yharon, Resplendent Phoenix (Lore)
Yharon, Resplendent Phoenix (Lore).desc: Lore items are miscellaneous items that have a piece of lore written into them as their sole purpose. Most of these items are dropped by their respective boss on their first kill. Most of them can be crafted using related items, typically the boss's respective trophy.
Yharon, Resplendent Phoenix (Lore).tip: Whispers from on high dance in your ears... · Hold Shift to listen closer

Yharon Trophy.name: Yharon Trophy
Yharon Trophy.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

Yin-Yo.name: Yin-Yo
Yin-Yo.desc: The Yin-Yo is a craftable Hardmode yoyo. While deployed, it randomly fires Dark Shards towards the target or Light Shards away from the target. Both shards will rebound to the position they were fired from two times before dissipating.
Yin-Yo.tip: Reach: 25 tiles · Speed: 32 · Infinite throw duration · Fires light or dark shards when enemies are near · Shards fly back and forth

Valor.name: Valor
Valor.desc: The Valor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron yoyo that has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Zenith.name: Zenith
Zenith.desc: The Zenith is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee weapon. When used, it rapidly fires fast-moving sword sprites towards the cursor in an arc returning to the player.

Bee Keeper.name: Bee Keeper
Bee Keeper.desc: The Bee Keeper is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When swung, it will inflict the Confused debuff on hit for 2 seconds.
Bee Keeper.tip: Summons killer bees after striking your foe · Causes confusion

Meowmere.name: Meowmere
Meowmere.desc: The Meowmere is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it fires a cat head projectile with a visual rainbow trail every ticks.

Seedler.name: Seedler
Seedler.desc: The Seedler is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When swung, it fires Seedler Nut projectiles that travel in a downwards arc before exploding into 4–7 Seedler Thorns upon hitting an enemy or after 0.33–2.15 seconds.

Zenith Throne.name: Zenith Throne
Zenith Throne.desc: The Zenith Throne is a craftable post-Moon Lord furniture item. Similarly to chairs, players can sit on the Zenith Throne by right-clicking on it.
Zenith Throne.tip: 'There will be no games, only damage per second...'

Abandoned Slime Staff.name: Abandoned Slime Staff
Abandoned Slime Staff.desc: The Abandoned Slime Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astral Slimes after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. When used, it summons a rocky Astral Jelly slime minion.
Abandoned Slime Staff.tip: Summons an astral slime that spreads the Astral Infection (debuff) · Consumes all of the remaining minion slots on use · Must be used from the hotbar · Increased power and size based on the number of minion slots used · Holding this weapon grants 10% increased jump speed · Cast down from the heavens in disgust, this relic sings a song of quiet tragedy...

Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet.name: Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet
Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet.desc: The Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet is a vanity accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Amplifiers. If worn in the helmet slot, the helmet is equipped normally.
Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet.tip: A worn and rusty helmet resembling older models of wulfrum armor · Transforms the holder into a wulfrum robot · Can also be worn in the helmet slot as a regular helm · 'This rather flimsy armor was commonly worn by scavengers and looters. · Its versatility and common nature led it to be used as currency in trades.'

Abyss Shell Fossil.name: Abyss Shell Fossil
Abyss Shell Fossil.desc: The Abyss Shell Fossil is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Eidolon Wyrm and Primordial Wyrm and can also be found as an ambient fossil tile in the 4th layer of the Abyss. It summons an Eidolon Snail to follow the player.
Abyss Shell Fossil.tip: Summons a pet Eidolon Snail to follow you · Slightly reduces creatures' ability to detect you in the abyss while equipped

Abyss Shocker.name: Abyss Shocker
Abyss Shocker.desc: The Abyss Shocker is a Pre-Hardmode magic gun that is dropped by Box Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies after Skeletron has been defeated. It also has a chance to be inside the Abyss Shrine's Void Chest.
Abyss Shocker.tip: Fires an erratic lightning bolt that arcs and bounces between enemies

Aegis Blade.name: Aegis Blade
Aegis Blade.desc: The Aegis Blade is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Golem. When used, it will deal damage in a normal manner. Striking an enemy with the sword causes a shortly lingering eruption that is capable of hitting twice before dissipating.
Aegis Blade.tip: Striking an enemy with the blade causes an earthen eruption · Press Right Click to fire an aegis bolt

Aero Stone.name: Aero Stone
Aero Stone.desc: The Aero Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Wyvern. When equipped, it increases flight time by a flat 50 frames, and regenerates 1 frame of flight time every 4 frames while not flying or gliding.
Aero Stone.tip: Grants 0.83 additional seconds of flight time · You slowly recover flight time while in the air while not flying or gliding · 'One of the ancient relics'

Affliction.name: Affliction
Affliction.desc: Affliction is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.
Affliction.tip: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage

Alula Australis.name: Alula Australis
Alula Australis.desc: The Alula Australis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it fires an aurora beam which travels in a cosine pattern. As the beam travels, homing astral stars trail with the beam and rain down from the sky.
Alula Australis.tip: Fires a beautiful aurora that spreads the Astral Infection (debuff) and is trailed by a star shower

Amidias' Pendant.name: Amidias' Pendant
Amidias' Pendant.desc: Amidias' Pendant is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Giant Clam. While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.
Amidias' Pendant.tip: Periodically rains down prism shards that can briefly stun enemies

Anahita's Arpeggio.name: Anahita's Arpeggio
Anahita's Arpeggio.desc: Anahita's Arpeggio is a Hardmode magic weapon that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It is an indirect upgrade to the Magical Harp. When holding left-click, up to six music notes can spawn, which orbit around the player.
Anahita's Arpeggio.tip: Holding Left Click casts up to 6 treble clefs that orbit the player · Releasing Left Click causes the treble clefs to converge at the cursor · After converging, treble clefs seek your cursor

Ancient God Slayer set.name: Ancient God Slayer set
Ancient God Slayer set.desc: Ancient God Slayer set is a post-Moon Lord vanity set which consists of the Ancient God Slayer Helm, Ancient God Slayer Chestplate and Ancient God Slayer Leggings. The set is collectively dropped by the Storm Weaver, Ceaseless Void and Signus at a 5% chance.

Ancient Ice Chunk.name: Ancient Ice Chunk
Ancient Ice Chunk.desc: The Ancient Ice Chunk is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Ice Claspers. When used, it summons a flying Ice Clasper that follows the player. It attacks by dashing at enemies and moving in an erratic pattern.
Ancient Ice Chunk.tip: Summons an ice clasper to fight for you · The clasper fires ice shards at distant enemies · While you are close to enemies, it will aggressively bash them with frozen fury

Animosity.name: Animosity
Animosity.desc: The Animosity is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires a narrow spread of 6 bullets that inflicts the Brimstone Flames debuff regardless of what ammo type was used.
Animosity.tip: Fires a shotgun blast with a tight spread which is imbued with Brimstone Flames · Press Right Click to fire a powerful brimstone round that causes enemies to become Marked for Death

Antlion Skewer.name: Antlion Skewer
Antlion Skewer.desc: The Antlion Skewer is a Pre-Hardmode javelin dropped by Antlions. When used, it throws a skewered Antlion javelin that is unaffected by gravity. After 0.25 seconds, the Antlion spits a sand ball in its direction which deals 50% damage, then accelerates for the next 0.5 seconds.
Antlion Skewer.tip: Throws living, skewered Antlions that fire sand blasts · Stealth strikes spew a mess of sand balls and gust · Sand clouds temporarily lower enemy contact damage

Aorta.name: Aorta
Aorta.desc: The Aorta is a Pre-Hardmode yoyo that is dropped by The Perforators. While deployed, it fires blood clots to enemies within 16 tiles, which first travel a short distance in that direction before homing in on the target; only then can they deal damage.
Aorta.tip: Reach: 20.625 tiles · Speed: 25 · Duration: 24 seconds · Fires homing blood when enemies are near

Aquatic Emblem.name: Aquatic Emblem
Aquatic Emblem.desc: The Aquatic Emblem is an Expert Mode Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Aquatic Emblem.tip: Most ocean enemies become friendly and allows breathing underwater · Being underwater gradually increases defense but slows movement speed over 10 seconds · This effect slowly vanishes outside of water and resets while mounted · Maximum defense boost is 15 and movement speed reduction is 10% · Provides a small amount of light and moderately reduces breath loss in the abyss

Aquatic Heart.name: Aquatic Heart
Aquatic Heart.desc: The Aquatic Heart is a Pre-Hardmode accessory dropped by???. Equipping it transforms the user into a water elemental and causes them to emit light. After Skeletron is defeated, they gain a wide variety of bonuses including:
Aquatic Heart.tip: Transforms the holder into a light-emitting water elemental · Wow, you can swim now! · Being underwater increases max speed and acceleration by 15% · Greatly reduces breath loss and reduces the darkness intensity in the abyss · Attackers are inflicted with Frozen · Gain a fragile ice barrier that grants 20% damage reduction for one hit · The ice shield regenerates after 30 seconds

Arc Flash Ring.name: Arc Flash Ring
Arc Flash Ring.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post-Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver.
Arc Flash Ring.tip: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

Ares' Exoskeleton.name: Ares' Exoskeleton
Ares' Exoskeleton.desc: Ares' Exoskeleton is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last. When used, the player throws out a box which opens up a control panel.
Ares' Exoskeleton.tip: Creates a panel with four slots and four choices above it: Plasma, Tesla, Laser, and Gauss · Clicking one of the choices and then clicking one of the slots summons a cannon of that type · Clicking on a slot that's already occupied destroys its associated cannon and clears the slot

Ashen Horns.name: Ashen Horns
Ashen Horns.desc: Ashen Horns are a post-Moon Lord vanity item that can only be worn in the helmet slot. They are dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas at a 14.29% chance along with the Calamitous set.

Ashen Stalactite.name: Ashen Stalactite
Ashen Stalactite.desc: The Ashen Stalactite is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Fire Imps in The Underworld or found in an Ashen Chest in the Brimstone Crag. It automatically throws a gravity-affected stalactite that does not pierce and breaks into cosmetic dust shortly after.
Ashen Stalactite.tip: Throws a small stalactite that crumbles to dust after travelling a short distance · Stealth strikes cause a larger, more damaging stalagmite to be thrown which travels slower and further before crumbling to damaging dust

Astral Scythe.name: Astral Scythe
Astral Scythe.desc: The Astral Scythe is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Mantises after defeating Astrum Aureus. When swung, it fires a spinning scythe ring projectile that accelerates over time and deals 100% base damage.
Astral Scythe.tip: Shoots a scythe ring that accelerates over time and spreads the Astral Infection (debuff)

Astralachnea Staff.name: Astralachnea Staff
Astralachnea Staff.desc: The Astralachnea Staff is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Astralachneas after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. It fires 3-4 homing astral fangs that inflict the Astral Infection debuff on their target.
Astralachnea Staff.tip: Fires a spread of homing astral spider fangs that spread the Astral Infection (debuff)

Astrophage.name: Astrophage
Astrophage.desc: The Astrophage is a pet summoning item that is obtained from Astral and Monolith Crates. It summons an Astrophage to follow the player around. If the player is far away, it will teleport to keep up with them.
Astrophage.tip: Summons an astrophage to follow you around

Atlas Munitions Beacon.name: Atlas Munitions Beacon
Atlas Munitions Beacon.desc: Atlas Munitions Beacon is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XM-05 Thanatos has been defeated last. When used, a drop pod falls from the sky down towards the cursor's position.
Atlas Munitions Beacon.tip: Summons a sentry · Brings forth an exo-powered, stationary cannon · The cannon will fire at enemies within its range · If an enemy is in close proximity, it will enter Overdrive · When in Overdrive the cannon uses its full power to bring down any foe · While in Overdrive, the cannon will build up heat, eventually overheating · Press Right Click while holding this item to pick up the cannon and use it yourself · When held, the cannon will always be in Overdrive · If the cannon overheats while you hold it, you will be forced to drop it · Pressing Right Click allows you to drop it manually · If dropped near the base, it will re-attach automatically · 'It's surprisingly easy to pick up'

Aurora Blazer.name: Aurora Blazer
Aurora Blazer.desc: The Aurora Blazer is a Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires astral flames that travel in a star-shaped pattern, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff on hit.
Aurora Blazer.tip: Spews a nebula stream which forms a star shaped pattern and spreads the Astral Infection (debuff) · Uses gel for ammo

Auroradical Throw.name: Auroradical Throw
Auroradical Throw.desc: The Auroradical Throw is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it throws an astral star that splits into 5 stars in a pentagon shape after traveling a moderate distance.
Auroradical Throw.tip: Launches a star that splits after a short period of time · Split stars home in on nearby enemies after a few seconds · Stealth strikes summon a meteor upon enemy impact · Spreads the Astral Infection (debuff)

Banshee Hook.name: Banshee Hook
Banshee Hook.desc: The Banshee Hook is a post-Moon Lord spear that is dropped by Polterghast. It is swung in front of the player at an odd angle, similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases a line of five projectiles at once, each dealing 85% of the weapon's damage.
Banshee Hook.tip: Swings a banshee hook that fires blades and explodes on hit

Barberry.name: Barberry
Barberry.desc: The Barberry is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking regular monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.

Barinade.name: Barinade
Barinade.desc: The Barinade is a Pre-Hardmode bow that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it converts all arrows into two fast fin arrows that meet at the cursor and do not pierce.
Barinade.tip: Fires two converging high-velocity fin arrows that easily soar through the air

Barinautical.name: Barinautical
Barinautical.desc: The Barinautical is a Hardmode bow that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it fires bursts of 3 arrows with a 1/3 second of a delay. When Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, arrows are replaced with electric arrows that explode upon impact.
Barinautical.tip: Converts wooden arrows into strings of 3 electric bolt arrows that explode

Belching Saxophone.name: Belching Saxophone
Belching Saxophone.desc: The Belching Saxophone is a Hardmode magic weapon that is dropped by Belching Corals. When used, it fires two volleys of projectiles, including a dirty reed and one of two possible additional projectiles with varying effects.
Belching Saxophone.tip: Fires an array of dirty reeds, music notes, and sulphuric bubbles · Doot

Blasphemous Donut.name: Blasphemous Donut
Blasphemous Donut.desc: The Blasphemous Donut is a post-Moon Lord food item that is dropped by Impious Immolators. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 1 hour.
Blasphemous Donut.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Donut worry, it's perfectly edible'

Blast Barrel.name: Blast Barrel
Blast Barrel.desc: The Blast Barrel is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it throws a barrel that rolls across the ground and pierces infinitely. The barrel lasts for a moderate duration until it despawns or collides with a wall.
Blast Barrel.tip: Throws a rolling barrel that explodes on wall collision · Stealth strikes make the barrel bounce twice before disappearing with varied effects after each bounce · 'Some people used to jump over these'

Blighted Slime Staff.name: Blighted Slime Staff
Blighted Slime Staff.desc: The Blighted Slime Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it summons a Blighted Slime minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by jumping around, dealing contact damage similarly to the Slime Staff.
Blighted Slime Staff.tip: Summons a blighted slime to fight for you

Blissful Bombardier.name: Blissful Bombardier
Blissful Bombardier.desc: The Blissful Bombardier is a post-Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it launches a large missile into the sky, with smaller missiles raining down around the cursor, followed by a final missile that causes a large explosion.
Blissful Bombardier.tip: Launches a crystalline missile high into the sky, raining holy fire on the cursor · The missile relentlessly seeks out a target before bursting into a massive explosion

Blood Bath.name: Blood Bath
Blood Bath.desc: The Blood Bath is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by The Perforators. When used, it spawns 2-3 blood raindrops from the sky that pierce once but cannot pass through tiles. The raindrops inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

Bloodflare Core.name: Bloodflare Core
Bloodflare Core.desc: The Bloodflare Core is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by the Ravager after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.
Bloodflare Core.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Recovering defense damage heals you, each defense recovered gives 1 HP · Taking damage converts at least half of your total defense in defense damage

Bloodworm.name: Bloodworm
Bloodworm.desc: The Bloodworm is a post-Moon Lord critter that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net.
Bloodworm.tip: Summons The Old Duke if used as bait in the Sulphurous Sea · Enrages outside the Sulphurous Sea

Bloody Vein.name: Bloody Vein
Bloody Vein.desc: The Bloody Vein is a Pre-Hardmode pet summoning item that is dropped by The Perforators. It summons a Mini Perforator Hive to follow the player around. It floats around and attempts to stay behind the player's line of sight.
Bloody Vein.tip: Summons an amalgamated pile of flesh

Bloom Stone.name: Bloom Stone
Bloom Stone.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Bloom Stone.tip: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

Bobbit Hook.name: Bobbit Hook
Bobbit Hook.desc: The Bobbit Hook is a post-Moon Lord grappling hook that is dropped by Bobbit Worms. It reaches 40 tiles and up to two hooks can be launched, however only one hook can attach to a block or platform at a time.
Bobbit Hook.tip: Retracts upon attaching to a tile with extreme speeds · Reach: 40 tiles · Launch Velocity: 25 · Reelback Velocity: 28 · Pull Velocity: 24

Borealis Bomber.name: Borealis Bomber
Borealis Bomber.desc: The Borealis Bomber is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it summons an Aureus Bomber that does not take up minion slots.
Borealis Bomber.tip: Summons aureus bombers to chase down your enemies · Aureus bombers explode violently on enemy impact, spreading the Astral Infection (debuff) · Does not consume minion slots

Bouncing Eyeball.name: Bouncing Eyeball
Bouncing Eyeball.desc: The Bouncing Eyeball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that drops from Wandering Eye Fish. When used, it throws a bouncing eyeball that pierces two enemies, bounces five times, or lasts 5 seconds before dissipating. Its knockback is increased by 3 during a Blood Moon.
Bouncing Eyeball.tip: Throws an eyeball that bounces off of surfaces · Stealth strikes cause the eyeballs to move much faster and bounce more energetically · Knockback is much stronger during a blood moon

Brimlance.name: Brimlance
Brimlance.desc: The Brimlance is a Hardmode spear that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. Upon hitting an enemy with the spear, it causes a brimstone explosion along with firing 2 lingering brimstone sparks in random directions.
Brimlance.tip: Creates an explosion of Brimstone Flames on enemy hits

Brimstone Jewel.name: Brimstone Jewel
Brimstone Jewel.desc: The Brimstone Jewel is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item. It is obtained from the Treasure Coffer dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas in Expert Mode. It summons a miniature Supreme Calamitas to follow the player.
Brimstone Jewel.tip: 'The ultimate reward for defeating such a beast... · Who knew she'd be so darn cute!'

Briny Baron.name: Briny Baron
Briny Baron.desc: The Briny Baron is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Duke Fishron. Pressing Left Click swings the sword and deals damage in a normal manner.
Briny Baron.tip: Striking an enemy with the blade causes a briny typhoon to appear · Press Right Click to fire a razorwind aqua blade

Brittle Star Staff.name: Brittle Star Staff
Brittle Star Staff.desc: The Brittle Star Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage.
Brittle Star Staff.tip: Summons a small brittle starfish that will dash through enemies until it shatters · Starfish will quickly regenerate after shattering · Holding Right Click will swap starfish between dashing and circling you · When the starfish are circling, each one provides you with 3 defense

Broken Water Filter.name: Broken Water Filter
Broken Water Filter.desc: The Broken Water Filter is a Pre-Hardmode spawn-blocking tool that can be found in Rusty Chests. It can be toggled by right-clicking on the item to disable or enable the Acid Rain from occurring.
Broken Water Filter.tip: Toggle this item to prevent Acid Rain from occurring · Press Right Click to toggle · Spawns are currently [STATE]

Burning Strife.name: Burning Strife
Burning Strife.desc: The Burning Strife is a Hardmode rogue spiky ball that is dropped by Goblin Warlocks. When used, it throws a shadowflame spiky ball that bounces off tiles and is affected by gravity.
Burning Strife.tip: Throws an enchanted spiky ball that explodes into Shadowflame · Stealth strikes make the ball erupt into tentacles on hit · 'Definitely not pocket safe'

Burnt Sienna.name: Burnt Sienna
Burnt Sienna.desc: The Burnt Sienna is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that drops from Tomb Crawlers. When swung, it emits visual light particles. Enemies killed using the weapon will drop three small orbs that each heal the player for 2 HP when picked up.
Burnt Sienna.tip: Causes enemies to erupt into healing projectiles on death

Cadaverous Carrion.name: Cadaverous Carrion
Cadaverous Carrion.desc: The Cadaverous Carrion is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.
Cadaverous Carrion.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a gross, shark-puking Old Duke head on the ground

Calamitous set.name: Calamitous set
Calamitous set.desc: Calamitous set is a post-Moon Lord vanity set which consists of the Calamitous Hood, Calamitous Robes and Calamitous Boots. The set is collectively dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas at a 14.29% chance along with the Ashen Horns.

Calamity.name: Calamity
Calamity.desc: Calamity is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor.
Calamity.tip: Lights your cursor ablaze with the Witch's flames, engulfing it in a blazing aura · Enemies touching the blaze take immense damage and are inflicted with Vulnerability Hex · Focusing an enemy for 2.5 seconds curses them, ascending Vulnerability Hex to its True form · Foes afflicted with True Vulnerability Hex take 1.15x damage from all sources · This effect is increased to 2.5x for the blazing cursor itself · Equip in a vanity slot to change the cursor without dealing damage · These changes work in conjunction with the Rainbow Cursor

Carnage.name: Carnage
Carnage.desc: The Carnage is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When it kills an enemy, it spawns 6-8 homing blood bolts that deal 30% base damage. The bolts heal the player for 7.5% of the damage dealt upon contact with an enemy.
Carnage.tip: Enemies explode into homing blood on death

Caustic Croaker Staff.name: Caustic Croaker Staff
Caustic Croaker Staff.desc: The Caustic Croaker Staff is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Nuclear Toads. It summons a miniature white Nuclear Toad sentry that stays on the ground. It attacks enemies by exploding itself into nine damaging chunks which inflict the Irradiated debuff.
Caustic Croaker Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a toad that explodes if enemies are nearby

Celestial Claymore.name: Celestial Claymore
Celestial Claymore.desc: The Celestial Claymore is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Biome Mimics. On each swing, it will spawn 2 red, blue, or yellow cosmic stars at locations near the cursor's position.
Celestial Claymore.tip: Spawns cosmic energy stars near the cursor

Celestial Onion.name: Celestial Onion
Celestial Onion.desc: The Celestial Onion is a permanent power-up item that is dropped by the Moon Lord. Upon consumption, it permanently gives the player a sixth (seventh) accessory slot.
Celestial Onion.tip: Permanently increases the number of accessory slots · This item does nothing in Master Mode · Alien power pulses inside its layers

drops.chance: 100% / 100% (Expert) / 100% (if the player has not used the Demon Heart)

Chaos Stone.name: Chaos Stone
Chaos Stone.desc: The Chaos Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. When equipped, the player gains the ability to use mana even without the required amount, with the mana going into negative values and inflicting both the player and enemies with the Mana Burn debuff.
Chaos Stone.tip: Disables automatic potion consumption · Items that consume mana can be used even without the required mana amount · Mana usage can overflow into negative mana, causing you to both receive and inflict Mana Burn · The lower your mana, the more intense the manafire burns · Negative Mana is capped at your maximum mana amount · Current maximum intensity with your maximum mana: -[REGEN] HP/s, and burns enemies for [DAMAGE]% of dealt damage

Charred Relic.name: Charred Relic
Charred Relic.desc: The Charred Relic is a Hardmode pet summoning item that summons a Brimling to follow the player around. It is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Brimstone Elemental in Revengeance Mode.
Charred Relic.tip: Contains a small amount of brimstone

Chicken Cannon.name: Chicken Cannon
Chicken Cannon.desc: The Chicken Cannon is a post-Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it rapidly fires chicken rockets that bounce straight up when hitting the ground before causing a gigantic explosion after a short delay, inflicting the Dragonfire debuff.
Chicken Cannon.tip: Fires chicken flares which create enormous Dragonfire explosions

Chromatic Orb.name: Chromatic Orb
Chromatic Orb.desc: The Chromatic Orb is a Hardmode light pet summoning item that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons an ancient dragon to follow the player around. The player can control the movement of the pet by pressing the direction keys similar to the Wisp in a Bottle.
Chromatic Orb.tip: Summons an ancient dragon light pet that highlights nearby enemies and danger sources · Provides a small amount of light in the abyss · 'It glows warmly in your hand'

Cinder Blossom Seeds.name: Cinder Blossom Seeds
Cinder Blossom Seeds.desc: Cinder Blossom Seeds are seeds that have a 5% chance to drop when breaking Wilder Cinder Blossom Grass. They can only be planted on Scorched Remains. Once planted, Cinder Blossom grass will begin to spread to nearby Scorched Remains blocks.
Cinder Blossom Seeds.tip: Places cinder blossom grass on scorched remains

Clam Crusher.name: Clam Crusher
Clam Crusher.desc: The Clam Crusher is a Hardmode flail that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss in the Sunken Sea. It throws out a giant gravity-affected clam that will inflict the Eutrophication debuff onto enemies.
Clam Crusher.tip: Launches a huge clam that inflicts Eutrophication, stunning enemies for a short amount of time · Starts being affected by gravity and does much more damage after being airborne for a while

Clamor Rifle.name: Clamor Rifle
Clamor Rifle.desc: The Clamor Rifle is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss. It transforms Musket Balls into aquatic energy bolts that will home in on enemies.
Clamor Rifle.tip: Converts musket balls into homing energy bolts · Energy bolts briefly stun enemies

Clothier's Wrath.name: Clothier's Wrath
Clothier's Wrath.desc: Clothier's Wrath is a Hardmode magic weapon that is dropped by the Clothier. When used, it fires three shadowflame skulls that pierce twice and inflict the Shadowflame debuff. The skulls cannot go through tiles and will explode after traveling a short distance.

Coldheart Icicle.name: Coldheart Icicle
Coldheart Icicle.desc: The Coldheart Icicle is a post-Moon Lord item that is dropped by Supreme Ultramage, Permafrost. When selected, it is held stationary in front of the player and can deal damage to enemies that intersect it while held.

Cometfruit.name: Cometfruit
Cometfruit.desc: The Cometfruit is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking snowy monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.
Cometfruit.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Tastes stellar!'

Condemnation.name: Condemnation
Condemnation.desc: Condemnation is a post-Moon Lord repeater that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used the player holds the crossbow and charges up, increasing the number of arrows which is also indicated by a ring of dust.
Condemnation.tip: Fires powerful scarlet bolts suffused with hateful magics · Hold Left Click to load up to nine bolts for powerful burst fire

Corpus Avertor.name: Corpus Avertor
Corpus Avertor.desc: The Corpus Avertor is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it throws a black knife that spawns smaller homing red knives as it travels.
Corpus Avertor.tip: Throws a spinning dagger that spawns a rebounding clone · Deals more damage the lower your health, and grants lifesteal · Stealth strikes throw a piercing rainbow dagger which spawns an extra slash in its wake, at a blood cost · This dagger grants players on your team 10% damage and +2 HP/s life regen on hit, and heals them for a portion of damage dealt · 'Seems like it has worn down over time'

Corrosive Spine.name: Corrosive Spine
Corrosive Spine.desc: The Corrosive Spine is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Corrosive Spine.tip: 5% increased movement speed · 50% increased Sickness and Water debuff damage · All attacks inflict Irradiated and reduces the severity of the sulphuric waters · You burst into radioactive clouds when struck

Cosmic Kunai.name: Cosmic Kunai
Cosmic Kunai.desc: The Cosmic Kunai is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by Signus. When used, it rapidly fires a stream of quick-moving, short-range kunai that go through tiles and are not affected by gravity.
Cosmic Kunai.tip: Fires a rapid stream of short-range kunai · Stealth strikes make kunai pierce foes, travel farther, and spawn 9 homing scythes

Cosmic Plushie.name: Cosmic Plushie
Cosmic Plushie.desc: The Cosmic Plushie is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item that summons a miniature Devourer of Gods gijinka. It is obtained from the Devourer of Gods' Treasure Bag with a Hardcore character while Death Mode is active.
Cosmic Plushie.tip: Summons the devourer of the cosmos...? · 'Sharp objects possibly included'

Cranium Smasher.name: Cranium Smasher
Cranium Smasher.desc: The Cranium Smasher is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it alternates between throwing rolling disks and explosive disks.
Cranium Smasher.tip: Alternates between throwing piercing, rolling disks and explosive disks · Stealth strikes embed into the hit foe, exploding multiple times

Cryo Stone.name: Cryo Stone
Cryo Stone.desc: The Cryo Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen.
Cryo Stone.tip: 50% increased Cold debuff damage · Creates a rotating ice shield around you that damages and slows down enemies on contact · 'One of the ancient relics'

Daemon's Flame.name: Daemon's Flame
Daemon's Flame.desc: The Daemon's Flame is a post-Moon Lord bow that is dropped by Polterghast. It fires arrows as well as a daemon flame, which moves in an up and down squiggly pattern, moves through blocks and explodes after a certain amount of time.
Daemon's Flame.tip: Shoots daemon flame fireballs as well as 4 regular arrows · 66% chance to save ammo

Dank Staff.name: Dank Staff
Dank Staff.desc: The Dank Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it summons a miniature Dank Creeper that attempts to latch onto enemies to deal damage and inflicts the Brain Rot debuff upon contact.
Dank Staff.tip: Summons a dank creeper to fight for you

Dazzling Stabber Staff.name: Dazzling Stabber Staff
Dazzling Stabber Staff.desc: The Dazzling Stabber Staff is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It summons 3 daggers per use, taking up a combined 3 minion slots.
Dazzling Stabber Staff.tip: Summons three holy daggers made of profaned materials to fight for you · Holy flame daggers gallantly turn all that oppose them to ashes · Crystalline daggers gracefully carve foes to ribbons · Profane daggers brutishly splinter and reform eternally · 'Ever onward, towards Her future'

Deathstare Rod.name: Deathstare Rod
Deathstare Rod.desc: The Deathstare Rod is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu. When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball above the player's head that fires lasers at nearby enemies once every second. On hit, the laser deals damage in a tiny area of effect.
Deathstare Rod.tip: Summons an eye above your head that watches you and shoots at enemies · There can only be one eye at a time

Deep Sea Dumbbell.name: Deep Sea Dumbbell
Deep Sea Dumbbell.desc: The Deep Sea Dumbbell is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that is dropped by Reaper Sharks after Polterghast has been defeated. When used, it throws a dark blue dumbbell that is not affected by gravity and bounces twice off of tiles or enemies, breaking on the third impact.
Deep Sea Dumbbell.tip: Throws a dumbbell that bounces and flings weights with each bounce · Press Right Click to flex, increasing the damage of your next attack up to 5 times damage · Flexes can hit enemies directly
stats: 4 seconds (First Dumbbell Hit) / 3 seconds (Second Dumbbell Hit) / 2 seconds (Third Dumbbell Hit, Weight)

Deepsea Staff.name: Deepsea Staff
Deepsea Staff.desc: The Deepsea Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it summons an aquatic starfish to follow the player around and attack enemies by rapidly dashing at them to deal damage.
Deepsea Staff.tip: Summons an aquatic star to fight for you

Defective Sphere.name: Defective Sphere
Defective Sphere.desc: The Defective Sphere is a Hardmode rogue boomerang that is dropped by Deadly Spheres. They can be thrown up to five times. Spheres thrown can become one of four variants, listed below.
Defective Sphere.tip: Fires a variety of deadly spheres with different effects · Up to five spheres can be thrown at a time · Stealth strikes launch all 4 sphere types at once

Delicious Meat.name: Delicious Meat
Delicious Meat.desc: The Delicious Meat is a non-consumable food item dropped by Divine Swine. When used, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 15 minutes. It has a 15 minute cooldown between uses.
Delicious Meat.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · Not consumable, but takes 15 minutes to regenerate · 'A blessed strip of pork that never seems to be entirely consumed...'

Divine Providence.name: Divine Providence
Divine Providence.desc: The Divine Providence is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, pressing the Accessory Ability key will briefly encase the player in a profaned crystal.
Divine Providence.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · The searing core of the Profaned Goddess · Pressing Accessory Ability will activate a parry, encasing you in luminous profaned crystal · Being hit shortly after encasement will shatter the crystal · Upon shattering, holy stars spiral outwards and damage taken is negated · After shattering, this damage reduction effect goes on cooldown · Damage parried whilst on cooldown summons additional healing stars, and will not be reduced

Doomsday Device.name: Doomsday Device
Doomsday Device.desc: The Doomsday Device is a Hardmode rogue bomb that can drop from the majority of enemies that spawn during the Martian Madness event, with an increased drop chance from Martian Officers.
Doomsday Device.tip: Direct hits from the weapon grant stealth · Non-stealth strikes do not consume stealth when fully charged · Holding a stealth strike charge beyond its limit rapidly drains stealth · Stealth strikes ricochet between multiple enemies, ending in a strong impact · 'A high-tech explosive with devastating power... If only you could figure out how to arm it' · 'At least you can throw it really hard!'

Dormant Brimseeker.name: Dormant Brimseeker
Dormant Brimseeker.desc: The Dormant Brimseeker is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, it summons a Brimseeker that charges towards enemies in a straight line to deal damage and it is able to target and attack enemies through tiles.
Dormant Brimseeker.tip: Summons a brimseeker to keep you company · Firing another brimseeker when all minion slots are filled summons a brimstone aura · The aura empowers your brimseeker summons and produces damaging Brimstone Flames fireballs · Only one aura can persist at a time · You could've sworn that they turned even scarier when you looked at their reflections in a mirror

Downpour.name: Downpour
Downpour.desc: The Downpour is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it fires a fast sand blast that quickly loses velocity when it hits an enemy. The sand blast pierces once and creates a damaging sand dust explosion on collision.
Downpour.tip: Fires an explosive stream of sand that falls after hitting an enemy · The explosion only occurs when the projectile expires

Draedon's Heart.name: Draedon's Heart
Draedon's Heart.desc: Draedon's Heart is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by the Exo Mechs. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Draedon's Heart.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'

Dragon Rage.name: Dragon Rage
Dragon Rage.desc: The Dragon Rage is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, a baton is held at the player's position, rotating and spawning an explosion which deals 25% base damage on every hit.
Dragon Rage.tip: Twirls a baton that causes explosions of Dragonfire on enemy hits · Once every two seconds, hits summon a ring of fireballs that target the enemy with the most health

Duke's Decapitator.name: Duke's Decapitator
Duke's Decapitator.desc: Duke's Decapitator is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.
Duke's Decapitator.tip: Throws a hydro axe which shreds enemies when it comes into contact with them · The faster the axe is spinning, the more times it hits before disappearing · Stealth strikes emit short-ranged bubbles

Dynamo Stem Cells.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
Dynamo Stem Cells.desc: The Dynamo Stem Cells are an Expert Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Dragonfolly. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Dynamo Stem Cells.tip: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire

Earthen Pike.name: Earthen Pike
Earthen Pike.desc: The Earthen Pike is a Hardmode spear that is dropped by the Earth Elemental. When used, it releases four gravity-affected fossil shards that deal 50% of the weapon's damage. Both the spear and shards inflict the Armor Crunch debuff.

Ectoheart.name: Ectoheart
Ectoheart.desc: The Ectoheart is a post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Polterghast.
Ectoheart.tip: Permanently increases Adrenaline Mode damage by 20% and damage reduction by 5% · Revengeance drop

Effigy of Decay.name: Effigy of Decay
Effigy of Decay.desc: The Effigy of Decay is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item that can be found in Rusty Chests within the Sulphurous Sea. When placed down, all nearby players are granted water-breathing while underwater however the effect does not work in the Abyss.
Effigy of Decay.tip: When placed down, nearby players can breathe underwater · This effect does not work in the abyss · Nearby players are also immune to the sulphuric poisoning

Eidolic Wail.name: Eidolic Wail
Eidolic Wail.desc: The Eidolic Wail is a post-Moon Lord magic gun that drops from Eidolon Wyrms after Polterghast has been defeated, as well as from the Primordial Wyrm. When used, it fires a burst of three sound waves that can pierce ten times and bounce off of tiles, slowing down on enemy hits.
Eidolic Wail.tip: Fires a string of bouncing sound waves that slow down on enemy hits · RIP headphone users

Eidolon Staff.name: Eidolon Staff
Eidolon Staff.desc: The Eidolon Staff is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by Eidolon Wyrms after Polterghast is defeated. When used, it fires a spread of 5 non-piercing blue stars and an ice ball that pierces infinitely.
Eidolon Staff.tip: Fires a spread of ancient light and a spinning ice cluster

Eidolon Tablet.name: Eidolon Tablet
Eidolon Tablet.desc: The Eidolon Tablet is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that is dropped by Eidolists. If the Lunar Events are currently not active, it is used to summon the Lunatic Cultist near the player.
Eidolon Tablet.tip: Summons the Lunatic Cultist · Not consumable · 'An aged artifact venerated by the Dragon Cult.'

Electrolyte Gel Pack.name: Electrolyte Gel Pack
Electrolyte Gel Pack.desc: The Electrolyte Gel Pack is a permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Slime God.
Electrolyte Gel Pack.tip: Permanently increases Adrenaline Mode damage by 20% and damage reduction by 5% · Revengeance drop

Elephant Killer.name: Elephant Killer
Elephant Killer.desc: The Elephant Killer is a Hardmode rogue weapon dropped by the Shady Salesman at a 1/4 chance. Natural stealth generation and stealth damage are disabled when holding this weapon.
Elephant Killer.tip: Can be tossed to gain 25% of max stealth on hit · Right Click to spend 10% of max stealth and fire the gun with increased damage · All gun shots always critically strike, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage · Stealth strikes fire a Spectral Elephant from the gun · Any gun shots that pass through the Spectral Elephant are redirected and greatly empowered · Natural stealth generation and stealth damage is disabled when holding this weapon · 'Why's my gun called the Elephant Killer? · ... · Don't worry about it'

Elysian Wings.name: Elysian Wings
Elysian Wings.desc: Elysian Wings are a post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
Elysian Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame

Enchanted Knife Staff.name: Enchanted Knife Staff
Enchanted Knife Staff.desc: The Enchanted Knife Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that can be found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates. When used, it summons a floating knife that float over the player's head.
Enchanted Knife Staff.tip: Summons an Enchanted Knife to fight for you

Eviscerator.name: Eviscerator
Eviscerator.desc: The Eviscerator is a Pre-Hardmode gun that is dropped by The Perforators. When Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a medium-speed blood clot bullet that does not pierce and inflicts the Burning Blood debuff.
Eviscerator.tip: Converts musket balls into fast-moving blood clots

Exo Armaments Kit.name: Exo Armaments Kit
Exo Armaments Kit.desc: The Exo Armaments Kit is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that drops from the Exo Mechs in Master or Revengeance Mode. When used, it summons a rideable Exo Tank which has an extremely high running speed and acceleration.
Exo Armaments Kit.tip: Summons a rideable war machine · 'A superweapon just right for your stature'

Exo Box.name: Exo Box
Exo Box.desc: The Exo Box is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that is dropped by the Exo Mechs.
Exo Box.tip: Materializes a quite cozy and extremely nimble flying Exo throne · Hold Exo Chair Slow Down while sitting in the throne to move slower for more precision · 'A comfortable gamer is a dangerous gamer'

Fate's Reveal.name: Fate's Reveal
Fate's Reveal.desc: The Fate's Reveal is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it spawns 6 red ghostly flames around the cursor that follow the player when they are further away from them.
Fate's Reveal.tip: Spawns ghostly fireballs that follow the player

Fetid Emesis.name: Fetid Emesis
Fetid Emesis.desc: The Fetid Emesis is a post-Moon Lord gun that is dropped by The Old Duke. It fires bullets at a gradually increasing rate, up to a maximum of 20 bullets per second after 5 seconds.
Fetid Emesis.tip: Fires an accelerating stream of bullets until the barrel overheats · When the barrel overheats, a spread of fetid chunks is vomited out · After firing, the gun must cool back down before it can be used again · 66% chance to save ammo

Filthy Glove.name: Filthy Glove
