Filthy Glove.desc: The Filthy Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and have +8 armor penetration.
Filthy Glove.tip: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage

Flame-Licked Shell.name: Flame-Licked Shell
Flame-Licked Shell.desc: The Flame-Licked Shell is an Expert Mode Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Flame-Licked Shell.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Pressing Activate Accessory Parry will activate a parry, encasing you in rocks · Being hit shortly after encasement will implode the rocks · Upon implosion, a ring of brimstone hellfire is launched outwards and you receive 90% DR for that hit · After imploding, this damage reduction effect goes on cooldown · Damage parried whilst on cooldown summons weaker brimstone flames, and will not be reduced

Flesh of Infidelity.name: Flesh of Infidelity
Flesh of Infidelity.desc: The Flesh of Infidelity is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Perforators. When used, it summons a flesh ball that jumps around erratically near the player.
Flesh of Infidelity.tip: Summons a tentacled ball of flesh that splashes blood onto enemies

Flesh Totem.name: Flesh Totem
Flesh Totem.desc: The Flesh Totem is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Ravager. It grants the following effects when equipped:
Flesh Totem.tip: 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases maximum mana by 20 · Summons an effigy above your head that stores mana as you use it, up to 600 mana · The effigy occasionally pulses, restoring 25 mana · Pulses appear more frequently the more mana is stored · Upon being struck, the effigy unleashes half of all stored up mana as vengeful souls that chase your enemies · The effigy is transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

Folly Feed.name: Folly Feed
Folly Feed.desc: The Folly Feed is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that is dropped by Dragonfolly. When used, it summons a rideable Bumbledoge which has a very high running speed.

Forgotten Dragon Egg.name: Forgotten Dragon Egg
Forgotten Dragon Egg.desc: The Forgotten Dragon Egg is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it summons Akato, the son of Yharon to follow the player.
Forgotten Dragon Egg.tip: Calls Akato, son of Yharon, to your side

Fox Drive.name: Fox Drive
Fox Drive.desc: The Fox Drive is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item that summons a fox pet to follow the player. It is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth in Revengeance Mode.

Frost Barrier.name: Frost Barrier
Frost Barrier.desc: The Frost Barrier is a Hardmode shield accessory that is dropped by Ice Claspers. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Frost Barrier.tip: You will freeze nearby enemies when you are struck · Grants immunity to Chilled and Frostburn

Frost Flare.name: Frost Flare
Frost Flare.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Frost Flare.tip: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn, Chilled and Frozen

Frosty Bat Bottle.name: Frosty Bat Bottle
Frosty Bat Bottle.desc: The Frosty Bat Bottle is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by Ice Bats. When used, it summons a Frosty Bat pet that follows the player around and flies towards the cursor as the player dashes, providing a small amount of light in its path.
Frosty Bat Bottle.tip: Summons an icy bat to light your way that flies towards your cursor when you dash · 'All the world's bats are prime to squeak!'

Fungal Clump.name: Fungal Clump
Fungal Clump.desc: The Fungal Clump is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon.
Fungal Clump.tip: Summons a fungal clump to fight for you · The clump latches onto enemies and steals their life for you

Gael's Greatsword.name: Gael's Greatsword
Gael's Greatsword.desc: Gael's Greatsword is a post-Moon Lord developer broadsword that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas in Death Mode. While attacking, it cycles through the following functions:
Gael's Greatsword.tip: First swing fires homing skulls · Second swing fires a giant, powerful skull · Third swing has no projectiles · Constantly generates rage when in use · Swings leave behind exploding blood trails when below 50% health · Occasionally summons a barrage of lightning bolts when below 50% health · Replaces Rage Mode with an enormous barrage of skulls · This attack has a 30 second cooldown · 'Hand it over, that thing. Your dark soul'

Gamma Heart.name: Gamma Heart
Gamma Heart.desc: The Gamma Heart is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Nuclear Terrors. When used, it summons a Gamma Hydra that is attached to the player; summoning the item again will add a head in exchange for taking up another minion slot.
Gamma Heart.tip: Summons radioactive heads that are bound by your body

Gastric Belcher Staff.name: Gastric Belcher Staff
Gastric Belcher Staff.desc: The Gastric Belcher Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita.
Gastric Belcher Staff.tip: Summons aquatic aberrations to protect you · Aberrations fire vomit at nearby enemies with every third attack firing bubbles

Geyser Shell.name: Geyser Shell
Geyser Shell.desc: The Geyser Shell is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Baby Flak Crabs when caught with any type of Bug Net. It summons a pet Flak Hermit that is undisguised and runs along the ground but will disguise itself once the player idles for too long.

Giant Pearl.name: Giant Pearl
Giant Pearl.desc: The Giant Pearl is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss.
Giant Pearl.tip: You have a light aura around you · Enemies within the aura are slowed down · Increases visibility range in the abyss

Gilded Proboscis.name: Gilded Proboscis
Gilded Proboscis.desc: The Gilded Proboscis is a post-Moon Lord spear that is dropped by the Dragonfolly. Holding Left Click charges up a thrust that scales from 0% to 300% base damage, depending on the charge duration. It reaches maximum damage after 5 seconds, at which point the spear begins shaking.
Gilded Proboscis.tip: Steals life proportional to the damage dealt to foes · Left Click to charge up a precise thrust · The thrust begins weak, but becomes more powerful the longer it's held · Right Click to dash forward with a mighty upstrike · The distance you dash depends on if you are moving with or against the dash · Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage

Glacial Embrace.name: Glacial Embrace
Glacial Embrace.desc: The Glacial Embrace is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Cryogen. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will first encase the player with an icy shield, then with subsequent uses adding one shield spike around it at the cost of a single minion slot.
Glacial Embrace.tip: Summons the power of the ancient ice castle · For each minion slot used, you will gain an additional orbiting shield spike · These spikes accelerate rapidly towards a nearby enemy to inflict heavy damage · They take some time to regenerate after launching themselves at the target, however · On Right Click, summons a duplicate ring around the targeted enemy, which slowly converges before exploding

Glorious End.name: Glorious End
Glorious End.desc: The Glorious End is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Novas when they explode on tile contact. Upon use, it summons a star on the player's feet which causes the player to move in the direction of the mouse cursor, up to a top speed of 72mph.
Glorious End.tip: Casts a meteor star for the player to ride in the direction of the cursor · The meteor star explodes after hitting an enemy, crashing into a wall, or after 6 seconds · This explosion hurts both enemies and the player · Releasing the cursor before the star explodes will cause it to explode prematurely for less damage · Mounts are disabled while this weapon is in use

Golden Eagle.name: Golden Eagle
Golden Eagle.desc: The Golden Eagle is a post-Moon Lord gun that is dropped by the Dragonfolly. It rapidly fires five bullets in a small spread.

Grand Dad.name: Grand Dad
Grand Dad.desc: The Grand Dad is a post-Moon Lord special sword that is dropped by Eidolon Wyrms after Polterghast has been defeated. When used, it performs a slow but devastating strike, swinging back and forth with high knockback.
Grand Dad.tip: An unfathomably heavy blade that rips through enemies using its sheer mass · Provides healing over time to you and all nearby allies on hit · Striking low health enemies will launch them with incredible force · Launched enemies are killed instantly on impact with walls and floors · 'How are you swinging something that has half the mass of a star?'

Grand Marquis Bait.name: Grand Marquis Bait
Grand Marquis Bait.desc: The Grand Marquis Bait is a Pre-Hardmode bait rewarded for completing fishing quests given by the Angler. It is always rewarded after completing 30 quests, in stacks of 2-5. It can also be obtained from Golden or Titanium Crates in stacks of 3-7.

Greentide.name: Greentide
Greentide.desc: The Greentide is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings and is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. On swing, it fires a spread of 5 leviathan teeth, with the center tooth being faster, piercing infinitely and inflicting the Riptide and Wet debuffs.
Greentide.tip: Launches a spread of four teeth with one stronger piercing tooth in the center · Hitting with the blade creates two jaws of teeth to chomp on the enemy closest to your cursor

Guidelight of Oblivion.name: Guidelight of Oblivion
Guidelight of Oblivion.desc: The Guidelight of Oblivion is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Scryllars after defeating Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It summons a soul lantern that floats up and down near the location it was summoned.
Guidelight of Oblivion.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a lantern that swarms your enemies with flames · 'Shadows dream of endless fire, flames devour and embers swoop'

Ha-pu Fruit.name: Ha-pu Fruit
Ha-pu Fruit.desc: The Ha-pu Fruit is a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user. It is obtained from shaking trees at a 1% chance.
Ha-pu Fruit.tip: 'A fruit that calms your nerves (may have unintended side effects)'

Hadarian Wings.name: Hadarian Wings
Hadarian Wings.desc: Hadarian Wings are a Hardmode wing-type accessory that are dropped by Hadarians after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide. Pressing the Down key will toggle the hover option on while pressing the Up key will toggle it off.
Hadarian Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.8 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Powered by the Astral Infection

Halibut Cannon.name: Halibut Cannon
Halibut Cannon.desc: The Halibut Cannon is a gun that is dropped by the Primordial Wyrm. When used, it fires out between 25 and 35 bullets per shot that slowly spread out, while only consuming one unit of ammo.

Hardened Honeycomb.name: Hardened Honeycomb
Hardened Honeycomb.desc: The Hardened Honeycomb is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it throws honeycomb projectiles that are slightly affected by gravity and shatter into 2 fragments upon collision with an enemy or tile.
Hardened Honeycomb.tip: Fires a honeycomb that shatters into fragments · Stealth strikes grant the Honey (buff) buff on hit and spawn bees

Havoc's Breath.name: Havoc's Breath
Havoc's Breath.desc: The Havoc's Breath is a Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by the Cataclysmic Construct. It uses Gel for ammunition.
Havoc's Breath.tip: Projects cone-shaped blasts of scorching Brimstone Flames · Uses gel for ammo

Heavenfallen Stardisk.name: Heavenfallen Stardisk
Heavenfallen Stardisk.desc: The Heavenfallen Stardisk is a Hardmode post-Astrum Aureus rogue weapon. It is always found inside the Dungeon's Astral Chest. Astrum Aureus must be defeated in order to open the chest.
Heavenfallen Stardisk.tip: Throws a stardisk upwards which then launches itself towards your mouse cursor · Explodes into a star of astral bolts which spread the Astral Infection (debuff) · Stealth strikes rain astral energy bolts from the sky

Hellborn.name: Hellborn
Hellborn.desc: The Hellborn is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, the player twirls the gun in their hand, dealing 8% base damage to enemies. Each hit with the gun itself adds 1 charge to the gun, up to a maximum of 12.
Hellborn.tip: An ornate firearm created during the Draconic Era by Azafure's finest forgemaster · Hold Left Click to twirl the gun in your hand, rapidly hitting nearby enemies · Hits with the gun itself add rounds to the gun, up to a max of 12 · At the cost of one round, hold Right Click to fire a giant energy sphere with potent recoil · 'Know the grace of a gun forged through beauteous inspiration'

Hellkite.name: Hellkite
Hellkite.desc: The Hellkite is a Hardmode special sword that is dropped by the Renegade Warlock after defeating Plantera that autoswings. On use, the sword is swung back and forth. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player.
Hellkite.tip: An ancient blade created during the Draconic Era by Azafure's finest forgemaster · Swings a slow and heavy blade with powerful knockback · Holding Right Click will begin charging a strengthened swing · Releasing Right Click while fully charged will unleash a devastating slash that always critically strikes · 'Feel the strength of a blade forged through passion'

Hematemesis.name: Hematemesis
Hematemesis.desc: The Hematemesis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it fires 10 blood bolts that spawn from below the screen and move upwards at high speed near the cursor's position. The blood bolts can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.
Hematemesis.tip: Casts a barrage of blood geysers from below

Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines.name: Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines
Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines.desc: Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines is a Hardmode pet summoning item that is dropped by Wall of Flesh. When used, it summons a small flying snake that follows the player.
Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines.tip: Summons the Third Sage · 'As the ice melts in the springs · And waves wash the old moss' hair... · Thank you, Goodbye'
Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines.wiki: Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines

Herring Staff.name: Herring Staff
Herring Staff.desc: The Herring Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. It summons three Herrings that follow the player. They attack nearby enemies by swiftly darting at them to deal damage.
Herring Staff.tip: Summons a school of herrings to fight for you

Hide of Astrum Deus.name: Hide of Astrum Deus
Hide of Astrum Deus.desc: The Hide of Astrum Deus is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Deus. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Hide of Astrum Deus.tip: True melee strikes drop astral stars from the sky · Releases an explosion and temporarily increases true melee damage by 30% when damaged · Boost duration scales with the amount of damage you took, up to 10 seconds · Nullifies the Astral Infection (debuff)

Hive Pod.name: Hive Pod
Hive Pod.desc: The Hive Pod is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Astraglomerates after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. The Astral Hive will spawn Hivelings if there are any enemies nearby, which will home onto the closest enemy to them, even through walls.
Hive Pod.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons an astraglomerate to spawn glomerings at your enemies · Glomerings spread the Astral Infection (debuff) on impact

Holy Collider.name: Holy Collider
Holy Collider.desc: The Holy Collider is a post-Moon Lord special sword that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. Pressing Left Click swings the sword back and forth toward the cursor, dealing 20% base damage and creating 6 short-lived flares on hit that deal 1% base damage.
Holy Collider.tip: Swings a holy greatsword that can be charged for higher damage · Charged swings create four lingering flares that float around the point of impact · Striking a flare with an uncharged swing will push it around and extend its lifetime · Charged swings can empower flares, turning them into massive fireballs on hit and launching them to your cursor

Hyperdeath Rift Scepter.name: Hyperdeath Rift Scepter
Hyperdeath Rift Scepter.desc: The Hyperdeath Rift Scepter is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. It fires down a large beam at the cursor's position to disintegrate nearly anything it is aimed at.
Hyperdeath Rift Scepter.tip: Tears space in two with Hyperdeath Rift Ripper

Hyphae Rod.name: Hyphae Rod
Hyphae Rod.desc: The Hyphae Rod is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by Crabulon. When used, it spawns 3 hovering mushroom spores near the player that explode on enemy contact and are able to move through tiles. These spores last for 3 seconds before dissipating.
Hyphae Rod.tip: Creates mushroom spores near the player

Ichor Spear.name: Ichor Spear
Ichor Spear.desc: The Ichor Spear is a Hardmode javelin that is dropped by Ichor Stickers. When used, it throws a fast ichor javelin that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity. Javelins pierce 5 times, grant 50 local immunity frames and inflict the Ichor debuff.
Ichor Spear.tip: Throws a high-velocity Ichor (debuff) tipped javelin that pierces through enemies · Stealth strikes impale enemies and deal repeated damage

Ilmeris' Spark.name: Ilmeris' Spark
Ilmeris' Spark.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage.
Ilmeris' Spark.tip: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks

Infected Remote.name: Infected Remote
Infected Remote.desc: The Infected Remote is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When used, it summons Virili, a humanoid-hybrid Plaguebringer, who flies around the player and attacks enemies with various attacks set in the following pattern:
Infected Remote.tip: Summons a humanoid-hybrid Plaguebringer, codenamed 'Virili', to aid you in battle · Virili can only be summoned once · Virili uses a variety of attacks which she cycles through on a timer · All attacks spread the Plague, as was her original design intention · 'There's a single label on the back: · WARNING: Subject is extremely corrosive and contagious. Avoid direct contact.'
stats: 3 seconds (Contact, Missile) / 2 seconds (Baby Plaguebringer) / 1 second (Plague Bee)

Infernal Blood.name: Infernal Blood
Infernal Blood.desc: The Infernal Blood is a Hardmode permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ravager. Upon consumption, it increases the duration of Rage Mode by one second.
Infernal Blood.tip: Permanently increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second · Revengeance drop

Infested Clawmerang.name: Infested Clawmerang
Infested Clawmerang.desc: The Infested Clawmerang is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is dropped by Crabulon. When used, it throws a slow-moving boomerang that pierces infinitely before returning to the player.
Infested Clawmerang.tip: Fires a slow, long-ranged boomerang · Stealth strikes grant the Mushy buff to the user on enemy hits and summon homing spores

Insidious Impaler.name: Insidious Impaler
Insidious Impaler.desc: The Insidious Impaler is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it throws a harpoon that slows down before launching itself toward enemies, dealing 120% base damage.
Insidious Impaler.tip: Throws self-propelling radioactive harpoons which chase foes · Harpoons ricochet at close range for additional hits

Interstellar Stompers.name: Interstellar Stompers
Interstellar Stompers.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Interstellar Stompers.tip: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

Jackfruit.name: Jackfruit
Jackfruit.desc: The Jackfruit is a Pre-Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking Acidwood Trees in the Sulphurous Sea. When consumed, it grants the Well Fed buff for 5 minutes.

Joyful Heart.name: Joyful Heart
Joyful Heart.desc: The Joyful Heart is a pet summoning item dropped by Sharks. It summons a white shark pet to fly around the player, occasionally spinning around itself.
Joyful Heart.tip: It's oddly warm. Attracts the forbidden one

Keelhaul.name: Keelhaul
Keelhaul.desc: The Keelhaul is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Giant Cursed Skulls in the Dungeon after Leviathan and Anahita have been defeated. When used, a small blue projectile is fired in the cursor's direction that creates a geyser upon impact with a tile or an enemy.
Keelhaul.tip: Summons a lingering geyser upon hitting an enemy · Only one geyser can exist at a time · 'Crumple 'em like paper'

Lashes of Chaos.name: Lashes of Chaos
Lashes of Chaos.desc: The Lashes of Chaos is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. When used, it alternates between firing 5 hellfireballs and 10 piercing hellblasts every 4.17 seconds.
Lashes of Chaos.tip: Alternates between exploding hellfireballs and piercing hellblasts · 'Watch the world burn...'

Lava Chicken Broth.name: Lava Chicken Broth
Lava Chicken Broth.desc: The Lava Chicken Broth is a post-Moon Lord food item that is dropped by XB-∞ Hekate in a Get fixed boi world. When used, the player slowly starts drinking it over the course of 15 seconds.
Lava Chicken Broth.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'It's tasty as hell'

Leonid Progenitor.name: Leonid Progenitor
Leonid Progenitor.desc: The Leonid Progenitor is a Hardmode rogue weapon that drops from Astrum Aureus. When used with its primary fire (left-click), gravity-affected bombshells are thrown which will explode on enemies and tiles, causing a large explosive meteor to rain down which deals half damage.
Leonid Progenitor.tip: Throws a bombshell that explodes, summoning a meteor to impact the site and spread the Astral Infection (debuff) · Press Right Click to throw a spread of gravity affected comets that explode, leaving behind a star · Stealth strikes lob a bombshell that additionally splits into comets on hit
stats: 4 seconds (Bombshells, Large Comets) / 2 seconds (Small Comets, Stars)

Levi.name: Levi
Levi.desc: Levi is a post-Moon Lord, Death Mode-exclusive pet summoning item dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas that summons a miniature Leviathan that follows the player.

Leviathan Ambergris.name: Leviathan Ambergris
Leviathan Ambergris.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Leviathan Ambergris.tip: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

Leviatitan.name: Leviatitan
Leviatitan.desc: The Leviatitan is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. When used, it rapidly fires aqua blasts that inflict the Riptide debuff. Holding Right Click (default: Right Click) slowly fires arcing meteors that explode on hit, both dealing 200% base damage.
Leviatitan.tip: Fires high velocity aqua blasts · Releases homing aberrations that shred enemy defense every six shots · Right Click to vomit a meteor that explodes on hit · 'The L in LMG stands for Leviathan'

Lionfish.name: Lionfish
Lionfish.desc: The Lionfish is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. When used, it hurls a Lionfish which travels in a straight line for a long distance before being affected by gravity.
Lionfish.tip: Sticks to enemies and injects a potent Acid Venom · The Acid Venom can stack when more lionfish are stuck in an enemy · Stealth strikes spawn homing urchin spikes as they travel

Little Light.name: Little Light
Little Light.desc: The Little Light is a post-Moon Lord light pet summoning item that is dropped by the Storm Weaver. It summons a light construct to follow behind the player. While summoned, the construct provides a large amount of light to the player's surroundings.
Little Light.tip: Summons a small construct that follows you and provides a great amount of light · Provides a large amount of light in the abyss · 'It's been looking for you for a long time'

Lotus.name: Lotus
Lotus.desc: The Lotus is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking regular monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.

Malachite.name: Malachite
Malachite.desc: The Malachite is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will rapidly throw kunai that are affected by gravity and stick to enemies or tiles, exploding after a brief delay.
Malachite.tip: Throws a stream of kunai that stick to enemies and explode · Press Right Click to throw a single kunai that pierces, after piercing an enemy it emits a massive explosion on the next enemy hit · Stealth strikes fire three kunai that home in, stick to enemies, and explode · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer · > STATUS_ · Extensive hull damage. Repairs initiated. · Sensor arrays offline. Repairs scheduled T+2200. · > UPDATE_DIRECTIVE_ · Error 0x00017F80. Device sector unreadable. · Initializing search for external directive. · Searching... (383526 more) · Directive found. · New directive compiled. Rebooting... · > PLAGUE UNIT 194-QB-03d ONLINE. · Directive summary: · Continue propagation of unified frequency band and lead satellite units.

Malevolence.name: Malevolence
Malevolence.desc: The Malevolence is a Hardmode bow that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When used, it fires 2 arrows in a slight spread. If Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, they are converted into plague arrows.
Malevolence.tip: Fires two arrows at once · Converts wooden arrows into Plague arrows that explode into bees

Mana Polarizer.name: Mana Polarizer
Mana Polarizer.desc: The Mana Polarizer is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Slime God. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Mana Polarizer.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life

Mangosteen.name: Mangosteen
Mangosteen.desc: The Mangosteen is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking snowy monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.
Mangosteen.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Queen of fruits'

Mantis Claws.name: Mantis Claws
Mantis Claws.desc: The Mantis Claws are a Hardmode special sword that is dropped by Mantis Shrimps after Plantera has been defeated. When used, it swings and spawns slash projectiles that curve outwards and linger for a short time, inflicting the Heavy Bleeding debuff.
Mantis Claws.tip: Rapidly swing a mantis claw which slashes foes in short range · Press Right Click to form a pressurized bubble in front of you · Once fully formed, the bubble is instantly snapped down on, blasting foes with a water jet · 'It's just that shrimple'

McNuggets.name: McNuggets
McNuggets.desc: The McNuggets is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it summons a Son of Yharon that follows the player. If the player stands still for a while, the Son of Yharon will sit near the player.
McNuggets.tip: 'These chicken nuggets aren't for you to eat!'

Midas Prime.name: Midas Prime
Midas Prime.desc: The Midas Prime is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Pirate Deadeyes, and is the indirect upgrade to the Crackshot Colt. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it converts any suitable bullets into Marksman Rounds.
Midas Prime.tip: Press Right Click to toss a Gold Coin or Silver Coin in the air · Striking a coin with a bullet causes it to ricochet into the nearest enemy · Up to 4 coins can be tossed simultaneously, and shots will ricochet off multiple coins if possible · Coins guarantee a critical strike after a short delay and bullets do bonus damage based on coins used

Mirror Blade.name: Mirror Blade
Mirror Blade.desc: The Mirror Blade is a post-Moon Lord special sword that is dropped by the Ceaseless Void. When used, the sword is swung in a circular motion around the player, inflicting the Nightwither debuff and releasing 2 smaller slashes on hit that deal 50% base damage.
Mirror Blade.tip: Striking an enemy or a hostile projectile summons up to 10 orbiting mirror shards · Any shards above 10 instead seek out enemies · Holding Right Click coalesces the orbiting mirror shards into a shield · Hold Shift for moreEach shard reduces the damage of a projectile that hit the shield by 10% · The shield shatters after one projectile, launching the shards at enemies with increased damage · With all 10 shards, you gain a brief period of invulnerability when shattering the shield'A blade taken from your own reflection within the Ceaseless Void'

Murasama.name: Murasama
Murasama.desc: The Murasama is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon. It can be found in The Underworld's Bio-center Arsenal Lab, contained within a Security Chest.
Murasama.tip: A high-frequency blade that can cleanly slice through even the mightiest foe · Every third swing deals immense damage · Prove your worth by slaying The Devourer of Gods to unsheath this sword · 'There will be blood!'

Mushroom Plasma Root.name: Mushroom Plasma Root
Mushroom Plasma Root.desc: The Mushroom Plasma Root is a permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. Upon consumption, it increases the duration of Rage Mode by one second.
Mushroom Plasma Root.tip: Permanently increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second · Revengeance drop

Mutated Truffle.name: Mutated Truffle
Mutated Truffle.desc: The Mutated Truffle is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke.
Mutated Truffle.tip: Summons a younger fishron to irradiate your foes · The fishron will cycle between charging, projectiles, and a typhoon · There can only be one minion

Mycelial Claws.name: Mycelial Claws
Mycelial Claws.desc: The Mycelial Claws are a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that is dropped by Crabulon. They function similar to the Fetid Baghnakhs, having extremely fast swing speed and very short range. The weapon grants the Mushy buff for 6 seconds on enemy hits.
Mycelial Claws.tip: Grants the Mushy buff for 6 seconds on enemy hits

Mycoroot.name: Mycoroot
Mycoroot.desc: The Mycoroot is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Crabulon. When used, it auto-fires a continuous stream of short-range fungal roots. The fungal roots cannot pierce or pass through tiles.
Mycoroot.tip: Fires a stream of short-range fungal roots · Stealth strikes spawn an explosion of fungi spores · This grants you and nearby players on your team the Mushy buff for 15 seconds

Nebulash.name: Nebulash
Nebulash.desc: The Nebulash is a Hardmode flail that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. Similar to the Solar Eruption, it fires a long whipsword from the player's position that quickly retracts. The whipsword can hit through tiles and pierces infinitely.
Nebulash.tip: Fires a whip sword that emits particle explosions on hit and spreads the Astral Infection (debuff)

Nebulous Core.name: Nebulous Core
Nebulous Core.desc: The Nebulous Core is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Nebulous Core.tip: 12% increased damage · Summons floating nebula stars to protect you · Taking a fatal hit revives you to 300 HP · This effect has a 90 second cooldown

NO.name: NO
NO.desc: NO is a post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon THE LORDE. It is dropped by Bohldohrs in the Jungle Temple after Supreme Witch, Calamitas and the Exo Mechs have been defeated in the Get fixed boi seed.

Oblivion.name: Oblivion
Oblivion.desc: The Oblivion is a Hardmode yoyo that is dropped by the Calamitas Clone. While deployed, it slowly releases homing hellfireballs that deal 85% base damage. Landing hits with the yoyo itself charges it up, increasing the frequency of the hellfireballs.
Oblivion.tip: Reach: 32 tiles · Speed: 36 · Duration: 15 seconds · A highly unstable yoyo that slowly releases homing brimstone hellblasts · Enemy hits with the yoyo charge its power, greatly increasing the fire rate of the hellblasts · At maximum charge, the yoyo bursts into brimstone darts and resets its flight duration · Striking an enemy at maximum charge will overload the yoyo, causing it to release all stored up power and shatter · Shattering the yoyo deals immense damage but leaves it unable to be used for several seconds

Ocean Crest.name: Ocean Crest
Ocean Crest.desc: The Ocean Crest is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Desert Scourge. When equipped, it allows the player to recover air while standing completely still underwater and increases mining speed by 15% when wet.
Ocean Crest.tip: You recover air while standing still underwater · 15% increased mining speed while wet

Odd Mushroom.name: Odd Mushroom
Odd Mushroom.desc: The Odd Mushroom is a Hardmode consumable item that is sold by the Truffle for 5 gold.
Odd Mushroom.tip: Causes you to see many fake, vibrant copies of all nearby entities · These visual effects may be nauseating or harmful to those with photosensitivity issues · 'Trippy'

Old Die.name: Old Die
Old Die.desc: The Old Die is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be purchased from the Bandit for 20 gold. When equipped, the player's luck stat is increased by 0.2.
Old Die.tip: Increases luck by 20% · 'Lucky for you, the curse doesn't affect you. Mostly'

Old Duke's Scales.name: Old Duke's Scales
Old Duke's Scales.desc: The Old Duke's Scales are a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by The Old Duke. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Old Duke's Scales.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction, max movement speed, and acceleration · 25% increased dash velocity and length · Adds a stamina tracker to the cooldown rack

Oracle Headphones.name: Oracle Headphones
Oracle Headphones.desc: The Oracle Headphones are a Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user. They have a 1/20 (5%) chance of being dropped by Shockstorm Shuttles.

Orthocera Shell.name: Orthocera Shell
Orthocera Shell.desc: The Orthocera Shell is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Orthoceras. It summons a stationary flying Orthocera sentry that shoots streams of acid at nearby enemies. The acid streams pierce up to two enemies along with inflicting the Acid Venom and Irradiated debuffs.
Orthocera Shell.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a flying orthocera to spit Irradiated and Acid Venom streams at your enemies

Overloaded Blaster.name: Overloaded Blaster
Overloaded Blaster.desc: The Overloaded Blaster is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by The Slime God. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 25% chance to not consume ammo.
Overloaded Blaster.tip: Converts gel into a spread of energized slime pearls that overload when they come to a stop · Overloaded slime pearls deal 60% more damage but no longer pierce · Slime pearls bounce off of walls at very high speed · Uses gel for ammo · 25% chance to save ammo

Perdition.name: Perdition
Perdition.desc: Perdition is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used, it summons a fire beacon that follows the player around and attempts to stay above the player's head.
Perdition.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a beacon at the position of the mouse · When a target is manually selected via Right Click it releases torrents of souls from below onto the target · Only one beacon may exist at a time

Perfect Dark.name: Perfect Dark
Perfect Dark.desc: The Perfect Dark is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When swung, it fires a dark ball that is affected by gravity and sticks to any tile that it contacts.
Perfect Dark.tip: Fires a vile ball that sticks to tiles and explodes

Phoenix Flame Barrage.name: Phoenix Flame Barrage
Phoenix Flame Barrage.desc: The Phoenix Flame Barrage is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it rains down a barrage of holy flames in a vertical column which explode after a short delay, dealing additional damage. The flames inflict the Dragonfire debuff.
Phoenix Flame Barrage.tip: Casts a barrage of Dragonfire from the sky · 'Baptism by draconic fire'

Phosphorescent Gauntlet.name: Phosphorescent Gauntlet
Phosphorescent Gauntlet.desc: The Phosphorescent Gauntlet is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is dropped by Nuclear Terrors. When used, the player lunges towards the direction of the cursor and performs a close-ranged punch.
Phosphorescent Gauntlet.tip: Releases rapid sulphurous punches · On use, you lunge in the direction of the mouse · On collision, you are knocked back

Photon Ripper.name: Photon Ripper
Photon Ripper.desc: The Photon Ripper is a post-Moon Lord chainsaw that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last. When used, it rapidly fires out rainbow teeth which circle back after passing through the cursor or past a set distance.
Photon Ripper.tip: Projects a directed stream of hardlight teeth at ultra high velocity · This weapon and its projectiles function as a chainsaw · Press Right Click to use without chopping down trees

Pineapple (calamity).name: Pineapple (calamity)
Pineapple (calamity).desc: The Pineapple is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Goldfish at a very rare chance. It summons a spinning pineapple that hovers over the player.

Plague Caller.name: Plague Caller
Plague Caller.desc: The Plague Caller is a Hardmode pet summoning item that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. It summons a miniature Plaguebringer Bab to follow the player around.

Plague Staff.name: Plague Staff
Plague Staff.desc: The Plague Staff is a Hardmode wand dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. It shoots out a spread of 4 plague fangs while one is always directed at the cursor, which are colored green and are trailed by pink light.
Plague Staff.tip: Fires a tight spread of 4 Plague fangs

Pristine Fury.name: Pristine Fury
Pristine Fury.desc: The Pristine Fury is a post-Moon Lord flamethrower that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It uses Gel for ammunition.
Pristine Fury.tip: Fires an intense helix of Holy Flames that explode into a column of smoke · Right Click to disperse a limited supply of flammable crystalline powder that restores over time · Powder can be ignited, causing it to explode for extra damage · Both helix flames and other nearby explosions can ignite the powder · Uses gel for ammo · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer'I and many others lost everything in this world's darkest hour. · I saw a beast descend from the heavens. A hulking cosmic monstrosity that heralded countless angels of death. · My family was torn from me, my people forsake me. Even our supposed protectors did nothing to aid us. · And thus I swore to those I lost that I would do what is right, that my blaze's light would dwarf even that of Zeratros' Sun; · That one day, this cruel world would know nothing less than My perfect fury.'

Profaned Core.name: Profaned Core
Profaned Core.desc: The Profaned Core is a post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is dropped by the Profaned Guardians. It is used to summon Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It can only be used in The Hallow or The Underworld.
Profaned Core.tip: Summons Providence when used in the Hallow or Underworld · Not consumable · 'The heart of Her Guardians, Her wicked wrath shall burn upon whoever now wields it.'

Puff Shroom.name: Puff Shroom
Puff Shroom.desc: The Puff Shroom is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Crabulon. When used, it summons a Puff Warrior which stays grounded and follows the player. The Puff Warrior attempts to stay on the same side of where the player is facing.
Puff Shroom.tip: Summons a cute mushroom warrior to fight for you

Purge Guzzler.name: Purge Guzzler
Purge Guzzler.desc: The Purge Guzzler is a post-Moon Lord magic gun dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it fires a barrage of beams which gets faster but more inaccurate as the weapon is fired.
Purge Guzzler.tip: Fires a barrage of holy rays that converge into two massive sweeping beams · 'Baptism by holy fire'

Radiating Crystal.name: Radiating Crystal
Radiating Crystal.desc: The Radiating Crystal is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by white-colored Radiators when caught with any type of Bug Net. When used, it summons a Radiator pet that follows the player around and emits a faint green glow.
Radiating Crystal.tip: Summons a radiator light pet · Provides a small amount of light in the abyss · 'The crystal contains traces of holothurin'

Rage Bait.name: Rage Bait
Rage Bait.desc: The Rage Bait is a Pre-Hardmode bait that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 15 silver during odd moon phases. It has the highest bait power of all baits at 100%, with the exception of the boss-summoning baits Truffle Worm and Bloodworm which cannot be used in normal fishing.

Red Lightning Container.name: Red Lightning Container
Red Lightning Container.desc: The Red Lightning Container is a post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Dragonfolly. Upon consumption, it increases the duration of Rage Mode by one second.
Red Lightning Container.tip: Permanently increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second · Revengeance drop

Refraction Rotor.name: Refraction Rotor
Refraction Rotor.desc: The Refraction Rotor is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XM-05 Thanatos has been defeated last. When used, it throws a gravity-defying disk that passes through tiles and pierces nine times.
Refraction Rotor.tip: Throws a huge prismatic shuriken · The shuriken shatters moments after impact into homing blades · Stealth strikes throw 3 shurikens that rapidly home on enemies

Regenerator.name: Regenerator
Regenerator.desc: The Regenerator is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Regenerator.tip: Your health cannot exceed 50% of its maximum · Increases length of invincibility after taking damage · Provides powerful special life regen to heal you for 7.5 HP/s · All normal life regen is negated and converted into damage · Current damage boost: [DAMAGE]%

Regulus Riot.name: Regulus Riot
Regulus Riot.desc: The Regulus Riot is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it fires a spinning disk towards the cursor's position, traveling a moderate distance before dissipating.
Regulus Riot.tip: Fires a swift homing disk that inflicts Astral Infection (debuff) · Stealth strikes explode into energy stars

Relic of Convergence.name: Relic of Convergence
Relic of Convergence.desc: The Relic of Convergence is a post-Moon Lord usable tool that is dropped by the Guardian Healer. When used, it creates an aura at the cursor's location.
Relic of Convergence.tip: Creates a profaned crystal at the cursor that channels a healing aura before shattering · All players within the area of effect are healed for 50 HP · Allies gain 50% extra healing · Holding out the crystal reduces the damage of all summons, decreases defense, and increases incoming damage · Never once had I known kindness. Neither my peers or family had a shred of compassion for me. · I wished for someone I could confide. A presence that cleansed me of anxiety. · And when I saw Her radiant smile when we met, I knew I had finally found it.

Relic of Deliverance.name: Relic of Deliverance
Relic of Deliverance.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post-Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.
Relic of Deliverance.tip: Using Left Click mounts you on the spear; holding Left Click revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press Right Click to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.

Relic of Resilience.name: Relic of Resilience
Relic of Resilience.desc: The Relic of Resilience is a post-Moon Lord tool that is dropped by the Guardian Defender. When used, it summons an orbit of rocks around the player while held.
Relic of Resilience.tip: Holding this item creates orbiting rock shards around you and nearby allies · After 5 seconds, the relic will retain orbiting rocks even when not holding the item · Continuing to hold the item will steadily increase the number of rocks and defenses until reaching max power · While they orbit you, your minimum defense is set to 200 and minimum damage reduction to 10% · Taking a hit or pressing while holding this item will pull in the shards, then blast them outward, crippling hit enemies · This effect has a 10 second cooldown after taking a hit, but recharges faster if holding the item · Holding out the shield heavily reduces the damage of all summons · I saw a massacre and did nothing to stop it. My vow broken, I was shunned. · My will to forge ahead vanished. My final wish was simply to not die alone. · But when She put faith in my shield, I would never again let it falter.

Rot Ball.name: Rot Ball
Rot Ball.desc: The Rot Ball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it throws a rot ball that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and pierces twice.
Rot Ball.tip: Stealth strikes spawn rain clouds on enemy hits

Rotting Eyeball.name: Rotting Eyeball
Rotting Eyeball.desc: The Rotting Eyeball is a Pre-Hardmode pet summoning item that is dropped by The Hive Mind. It summons a miniature Hive Mind to follow the player around.

Rouge Slash.name: Rouge Slash
Rouge Slash.desc: The Rouge Slash is a post-Moon Lord spell tome that is dropped by Dragonfolly. When used, it fires three curved waves out from the player, which each vary in their size and speed and pass through tiles. The waves each pierce twice and disappear upon contact with a third.
Rouge Slash.tip: Fires a wave of 3 rouge air slashes

Rusted Jingle Bell.name: Rusted Jingle Bell
Rusted Jingle Bell.desc: The Rusted Jingle Bell is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by Baby Ghost Bells when hit with any type of Bug Net or obtained rarely by fishing in the Sunken Sea. It summons a Baby Ghost Bell pet to follow the player and provide a large amount of light while underwater.
Rusted Jingle Bell.tip: Summons a baby ghost bell light pet · Provides a moderate amount of light while underwater

Rusty Beacon Prototype.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
Rusty Beacon Prototype.desc: The Rusty Beacon Prototype is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that can be found in Rusty Chests. When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.
Rusty Beacon Prototype.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a long-abandoned drone that passively emits Irradiated waves

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.desc: Sacrifice is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used with the left-click, it rapidly throws daggers that stick to enemies and constantly deal damage for 0.83 seconds. Up to a maximum of 15 daggers can be stuck at a time.
Sacrifice.tip: Throws sacrificial daggers that lodge themselves in enemies · Press Right Click to cause all stuck daggers to fly back at you and give you life · Daggers stuck to enemies release bloodsplosions over time · Stealth strikes lodge for longer and provide much more life when returning to you

Sahara Slicers.name: Sahara Slicers
Sahara Slicers.desc: The Sahara Slicers are a Pre-Hardmode shortsword that are dropped by the Desert Scourge. When swung, a pair of dual daggers rapidly stab in front of the player. Hitting an enemy with one of the daggers will spawn 2 bolts which appear behind the player, up to a maximum of 10.
Sahara Slicers.tip: A pair of dual daggers with short range · Hitting enemies with the daggers will give you two bolts for each hit, up to 10 · Pressing Right Click will allow you to toss collected bolts at enemies

Salak.name: Salak
Salak.desc: The Salak is a Pre-Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking Acidwood Trees in the Sulphurous Sea. When consumed, it grants the Well Fed buff for 5 minutes.

Sanctified Spark.name: Sanctified Spark
Sanctified Spark.desc: The Sanctified Spark is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Impious Immolators. When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff.
Sanctified Spark.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'

Sand Cloak.name: Sand Cloak
Sand Cloak.desc: The Sand Cloak is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When equipped, dashing creates a large damaging dust veil around the player that follows the player for 15 seconds, or until the player dashes again.
Sand Cloak.tip: Dashing creates a large protective sand veil which damages enemies inside it · The sand veil lasts 15 seconds, but dissipates early if you dash again · The veil slowly follows you, and any player inside it gains 3 defense and 75% acceleration · After dissipating, the sand veil has a 15 second cooldown before it can be used again

Sandstream Scepter.name: Sandstream Scepter
Sandstream Scepter.desc: The Sandstream Scepter is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it fires a fast sand blast that quickly loses velocity when it hits an enemy. The sand blast pierces once and explodes into visual sand dust clouds upon contact.
Sandstream Scepter.tip: Fires an explosive stream of sand that falls after hitting an enemy · The explosion only occurs when the projectile expires

Sausage Maker.name: Sausage Maker
Sausage Maker.desc: The Sausage Maker is a Pre-Hardmode spear that is dropped by The Perforators. When hitting an enemy with the spear, it fires a blood bolt that homes in on enemies. Both the spear and blood bolts inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

Scions Curio.name: Scions Curio
Scions Curio.desc: The Scions Curio is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Rusty Chests. When equipped, it makes killing an enemy or getting hit create a blast that inflicts Irradiated for 5 seconds.
Scions Curio.tip: Ranged hits increase the effectiveness of Irradiated · Irradiated damage over time scales off of your ranged damage and crit chance · On kill, enemies burst, spreading Irradiated · Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation · Current Irradiated damage: [DAMAGE]

Scourge of the Seas.name: Scourge of the Seas
Scourge of the Seas.desc: The Scourge of the Seas is a Hardmode javelin that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it throws a javelin that gains velocity while in flight before being affected by gravity.
Scourge of the Seas.tip: Snaps apart into Irradiated clouds upon striking an enemy · Stealth strikes cause a longer Irradiated and are additionally coated with Acid Venom
stats: 3 seconds (Stealth strike javelin) / 2 seconds (Stealth strike toxic cloud)

Scuttler's Jewel.name: Scuttler's Jewel
Scuttler's Jewel.desc: The Scuttler's Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawlers. When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage.
Scuttler's Jewel.tip: Stealth strike projectiles spawn a jewel spike on hit or when destroyed · Can also be broken down at an extractinator

Sea's Searing.name: Sea's Searing
Sea's Searing.desc: The Sea's Searing is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge.
Sea's Searing.tip: Fires a string of bubbles summoning a shower of bubbles on hit · Press Right Click to fire a slower, larger water blast that summons a water spout

Seething Discharge.name: Seething Discharge
Seething Discharge.desc: The Seething Discharge is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, it fires an arc of 5 hellblasts that accelerate over time.
Seething Discharge.tip: Fires an accelerating arc of brimstone hellblasts · Every third attack spawns a brimstone dart ring which chases after foes

Septic Skewer.name: Septic Skewer
Septic Skewer.desc: The Septic Skewer is a post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it fires harpoons that stick into enemies. After being stuck for 1 second, harpoons return to the player, releasing gore projectiles from the stuck enemy.
Septic Skewer.tip: Launches a vile chained harpoon infested with toxins · Harpoons stick into enemies and inflict Sulphuric Poisoning for a long time · After being impaled for one second, harpoons rip themselves back out and spray damaging gores · Press Right Click to manually rip out all harpoons, dealing bonus damage · Enemies close to death are dragged back with returning harpoons and executed when they reach you · Executions heal you for 25 health and launch an additional harpoon automatically

Serpentine.name: Serpentine
Serpentine.desc: The Serpentine is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Sea Serpents.
Serpentine.tip: Casts a serpent that follows the mouse cursor · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense

Set of Calamity.name: Set of Calamity
Set of Calamity.desc: The Set of Calamity is a Hardmode vanity set that consists of the Hood of Calamity and Robes of Calamity. The set is collectively dropped by Calamitas Clone at a 10% chance.

Shaderain Staff.name: Shaderain Staff
Shaderain Staff.desc: The Shaderain Staff is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it fires a spread of 2 gravity-affected raindrops along with a decelerating cloud ball. Both the cloud balls and raindrops inflict the Brain Rot debuff and do not pierce.
Shaderain Staff.tip: Fires a spray of evil clouds and rain

Shadethrower.name: Shadethrower
Shadethrower.desc: The Shadethrower is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by The Hive Mind. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires four bursts of shade clouds at a short range.
Shadethrower.tip: Spits clouds of shade which afflict enemies with Brain Rot · Uses gel for ammo

Sharky Plush.name: Sharky Plush
Sharky Plush.desc: The Sharky Plush is a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user. It drops from Sharks at a 1% chance.
Sharky Plush.tip: 'Like lovers and heroes, and the restless part of everyone...'

Shellfish Staff.name: Shellfish Staff
Shellfish Staff.desc: The Shellfish Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Giant Clam. When used, it summons a Shellfish that follows the player and attacks nearby enemies by attaching itself to them. Each Shellfish takes up 2 minion slots.
Shellfish Staff.tip: Summons a shellfish to latch onto enemies and inflict Shellfish Claps

Shinobi Blade.name: Shinobi Blade
Shinobi Blade.desc: The Shinobi Blade is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Dark Casters. When used, it throws a fast dagger that is unaffected by gravity and does not pierce or pass through tiles. Enemies killed by the dagger spawn homing blue orbs that heal the player for 5 health.
Shinobi Blade.tip: Throws a fast blade that spawns healing orbs when it kills an enemy · Stealth strikes repeatedly stab the struck enemy from random directions

Skytide Dragoon.name: Skytide Dragoon
Skytide Dragoon.desc: The Skytide Dragoon is a post-Moon Lord spear that is dropped by the Storm Weaver. When used, the spear is held upwards, calling down a powerful thunderbolt to charge it. The spear then unleashes a spread of 5 lightning energy bolts 6 times before needing to recharge.
Skytide Dragoon.tip: Calls down a thunderbolt to strike and charge the tip of the spear · Press Left Click to discharge the electricity as a spread of bolts that narrows as you spend the energy · Hold Right Click when the spear catches the thunderbolt to redirect it to the cursor

Slagfire Douser.name: Slagfire Douser
Slagfire Douser.desc: The Slagfire Douser is a Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that can be found in Ashen Chests in the Brimstone Crag or from Slag or Brimstone Crates. Upon use, the weapon fires a rapid burst of four lava globs which can damage Town NPCs.
Slagfire Douser.tip: Sprays bursts of molten pollen · Molten pollen ignores 10 points of enemy defense and covers your enemies in Searing Lava · Capable of dousing townsfolk in lava too...

Slithering Eels.name: Slithering Eels
Slithering Eels.desc: The Slithering Eels is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Acid Eels after Aquatic Scourge has been defeated. When used, it fires a slithering acid eel that moves erratically in random directions and roughly follows the cursor around.
Slithering Eels.tip: Casts a magical acid eel that releases acid drops as it moves

Slurper Pole.name: Slurper Pole
Slurper Pole.desc: The Slurper Pole is a Pre-Hardmode fishing pole that is dropped by Soul Slurpers. Unlike most fishing poles, the Slurper Pole can be used to fish in Lava.
Slurper Pole.tip: Allows fishing in lava · 'It is the burning lava of the soul that has a furnace within--a very volcano of grief and sorrow.'

Soul of Cryogen.name: Soul of Cryogen
Soul of Cryogen.desc: The Soul of Cryogen is an Expert Mode Hardmode wing-type accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Soul of Cryogen.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Good · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average · Icicles rain down as you fly

Spectral Veil.name: Spectral Veil
Spectral Veil.desc: The Spectral Veil is an Expert Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord rogue accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Signus. While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.
Spectral Veil.tip: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'

Spent Fuel Container.name: Spent Fuel Container
Spent Fuel Container.desc: The Spent Fuel Container is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Cragmaw Mire. When used, it throws a gravity-affected flask that erupts into a nuclear explosion on impact that inflicts the Irradiated debuff. The explosion does not occur if no tiles are below it.
Spent Fuel Container.tip: Throws a fuel container with trace amounts of plutonium that causes a nuclear explosion · The explosion does not occur if there are no tiles below it · Stealth strikes leave a lingering Irradiated zone after the explosion dissipates · 'War Never Changes'

Spikecrag Staff.name: Spikecrag Staff
Spikecrag Staff.desc: The Spikecrag Staff is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it summons a Spikecrag sentry that attacks enemies by firing an intense upward spray of gravity-affected spikes; a total of 1 to 2 spikes are fired every 1/6th of a second.
Spikecrag Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a bed of stalagmites to spray spikes at your enemies

Spine of Thanatos.name: Spine of Thanatos
Spine of Thanatos.desc: The Spine of Thanatos is a post-Moon Lord flail that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XM-05 Thanatos has been defeated last. It launches one flail forward towards the cursor with two flails swiping from the sides.
Spine of Thanatos.tip: Releases 3 fast metallic whips outward · Once all three collide, a prism of light is shot outward · If an enemy is within the line of sight of the whips on collision, the light will fire towards it

Star Sputter.name: Star Sputter
Star Sputter.desc: The Star Sputter is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by Astrum Deus. It uses Fallen Stars as ammo.
Star Sputter.tip: Fires a chain of comets that spread the Astral Infection (debuff) · Fires a bigger, more powerful comet every four rounds · 'Look to the stars for a galaxy far, far away'

Starlight Fuel Cell.name: Starlight Fuel Cell
Starlight Fuel Cell.desc: The Starlight Fuel Cell is a Hardmode permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus.
Starlight Fuel Cell.tip: Permanently increases Adrenaline Mode damage by 20% and damage reduction by 5% · Revengeance drop

Starspawn Helix Staff.name: Starspawn Helix Staff
Starspawn Helix Staff.desc: The Starspawn Helix Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons an Astral Probe minion that orbits around the player and fires homing astral lasers that go through tiles.
Starspawn Helix Staff.tip: Summons astral probes that spread the Astral Infection (debuff)

Stormjaw Staff.name: Stormjaw Staff
Stormjaw Staff.desc: The Stormjaw Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Stormlions. When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion.
Stormjaw Staff.tip: Summons a baby stormlion to fight for you

Strange Orb.name: Strange Orb
Strange Orb.desc: The Strange Orb is a light pet summoning item that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. It summons an Ocean Spirit to follow the player. If the player is not submerged in water or honey, it sleeps while holding the orb and gives a small amount of light.
Strange Orb.tip: Summons a miniature Ocean Spirit light pet · Provides a large amount of light while underwater

Submarine Shocker.name: Submarine Shocker
Submarine Shocker.desc: The Submarine Shocker is a Hardmode shortsword that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When swung, it releases electric sparks upon enemy hits. The sparks linger for 1 second, can pierce 2 enemies, and can hit up to 5 times before dissipating.
Submarine Shocker.tip: Enemies release electric sparks on hit

Sulphuric Acid Cannon.name: Sulphuric Acid Cannon
Sulphuric Acid Cannon.desc: The Sulphuric Acid Cannon is a post-Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by the Mauler miniboss in the Tier 3 Acid Rain. When used, it slowly fires acid rockets which home in on enemies and stick to them.
Sulphuric Acid Cannon.tip: Fires homing Acid Rockets · Acid Rockets stick to enemies and explode into toxic mist after a short delay

Sulphurous Grabber.name: Sulphurous Grabber
Sulphurous Grabber.desc: The Sulphurous Grabber is a Hardmode yoyo that is dropped by Sulphurous Skaters. While deployed, it fires three bubbles in a triangular pattern in a random direction. The bubbles can be either green or purple.
Sulphurous Grabber.tip: Reach: 25 tiles · Speed: 32 · Infinite throw duration · Occasionally releases a ring of colored bubbles · The yoyo powers up after touching a green bubble

Surge Driver.name: Surge Driver
Surge Driver.desc: The Surge Driver is a post-Moon Lord gun that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XS-01 Artemis and XS-03 Apollo have been defeated last. Holding Left Click (default: Left Click) fires a laser beam which creates a large glowing explosion upon hitting an enemy or tile.
Surge Driver.tip: Press Left Click to release a laser ray that explodes on collision · Press Right Click to release a barrage of laser beams that release homing energy on enemy hits

Suspicious Looking Jelly Bean.name: Suspicious Looking Jelly Bean
Suspicious Looking Jelly Bean.desc: The Suspicious Looking Jelly Bean is a Hardmode mount summoning item that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it summons a Squishy Bean mount that functions similarly to the Slimy Saddle.

Suspicious Looking NO U.name: Suspicious Looking NO U
Suspicious Looking NO U.desc: The Suspicious Looking NO U is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by THE LORDE. It summons a miniature version of THE LORDE to follow the player which emits a relatively strong rainbow light.
Suspicious Looking NO U.tip: Summons a Lil Lorde that provides light · 'It lives!'

Teardrop Cleaver.name: Teardrop Cleaver
Teardrop Cleaver.desc: The Teardrop Cleaver is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu. Hitting enemies inflicts the Temporal Sadness debuff, which reduces their movement speed by 20% per frame.

Terror Blade.name: Terror Blade
Terror Blade.desc: The Terror Blade is a post-Moon Lord broadsword that is dropped by Polterghast. On every swing, it fires a red terror beam that can bounce off tiles or pierce enemies a total of three times before exploding on the fourth impact.
Terror Blade.tip: Fires a terror beam that bounces off tiles · On every bounce it emits an explosion

Thank You.name: Thank You
Thank You.desc: Thank You is a painting that can be dropped by any boss from vanilla and the Calamity Mod.
Thank You.tip: Thanks to the entire team, everyone who supported, and those who all play the mod and keep it alive! · The confines of this painting is not enough to fit the entire team · Hold Shift to see a list of developers and press Shift to switch between current and past developers

The Atom Splitter.name: The Atom Splitter
The Atom Splitter.desc: The Atom Splitter is a post-Moon Lord javelin that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XS-01 Artemis and XS-03 Apollo have been defeated last. When used, it throws out a gravity-defying javelin that travels through tiles and emits light.
The Atom Splitter.tip: Throws a quantum-superimposed javelin that strikes from numerous timelines at once · Stealth strikes perform far more simultaneous strikes

The Bee.name: The Bee
The Bee.desc: The Bee is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Queen Bee. While equipped and the player is at full health, their damage stat will be increased by 50% of their damage reduction, excluding separated damage reduction boosts.
The Bee.tip: When at full HP, your damage is increased based on your damage reduction · Damage taken at full HP is halved · Any energy shields must be fully charged for this effect to apply · This has a 6 second cooldown

The Burning Sky.name: The Burning Sky
The Burning Sky.desc: The Burning Sky is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, the player holds the weapon out similarly to a wand, and a stream of burning meteors rain down from the sky in the direction of the cursor.
The Burning Sky.tip: Rains down a stream of Dragonfire at the cursor · 'Hold the blade to the sky, and witness Armageddon'

The Comb.name: The Comb
The Comb.desc: The Comb is a Pre-Hardmode vanity accessory that can be found in Sandstone Chests or dropped from Oasis and Mirage Crates. It adds a sparkle effect to the character's hair, similarly to Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo.
The Comb.tip: Gives the wearer's hair a lustrous finish · Sparkles are attracted to nearby chests · 'We ain't found shit!'

The Evolution.name: The Evolution
The Evolution.desc: The Evolution is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:
The Evolution.tip: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Black Belt Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · Black Belt This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Black Belt Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

The Final Dawn.name: The Final Dawn
The Final Dawn.desc: The Final Dawn is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it charges up and swings a large scythe that damages enemies and replenishes 40% of the player's maximum rogue stealth.
The Final Dawn.tip: Attack enemies with a giant scythe swing to replenish stealth · Press up and attack to throw the scythe · Stealth strikes perform a horizontal swing that leaves a lingering fire aura · Stealth strikes performed while pressing up fling yourself at the enemy and slice through them, causing homing fireballs to emerge · 'We shall ride into the sunrise once more'
stats: 5 seconds (Slash, Horizontal Slash) / 4 seconds (Thrown, Fireball) / 3 seconds (Flame)

The Jailor.name: The Jailor
The Jailor.desc: The Jailor is a post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last. When used, it fires an electric mine that decelerates to a stop after as it travels and pierces infinitely.
The Jailor.tip: Releases electric mines outward that connect to each-other via arcs

The Microwave.name: The Microwave
The Microwave.desc: The Microwave is a Hardmode yoyo that is dropped by Astrum Deus. While deployed, it emits an aura that constantly damages enemies within a roughly 6-tile radius. The aura deals 35% of the weapon's damage and inflicts the Astral Infection debuff on hit.
The Microwave.tip: Reach: 32 tiles · Speed: 54 · Infinite throw duration · Fries nearby enemies with radiation and spreads the Astral Infection (debuff) · 'Cooking, Astral Infection style'

The Old Reaper.name: The Old Reaper
The Old Reaper.desc: The Old Reaper is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that drops from The Old Duke. When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.
The Old Reaper.tip: Throws a scythe that cuts through enemies · Deposits unstable isotopes on hit, which create delayed nuclear explosions when they decay · Stealth strikes are thrown into the sky and fall upon enemies a few seconds later · On hit, stealth strikes create a focused deluge of acid rain

The Syringe.name: The Syringe
The Syringe.desc: The Syringe is a Hardmode rogue weapon dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. It auto-fires a high velocity syringe that increases damage as it travels and inflicts the Plague debuff. On contact with an enemy or block, it will shatter into glass and plague cinders.
The Syringe.tip: Throws a high velocity syringe that increases damage as it travels · Shatters into glass and cinders on impact · Stealth strikes also shatter into Plague bees · 'I'm pretty sure this isn't healthy'

The Wand.name: The Wand
The Wand.desc: The Wand is a post-Moon Lord wand sold by the Shady Salesman after defeating Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. It fires a small projectile that inflicts Dragonfire, and erupts into a massive translucent infernado on impact with any tile or enemy.

Thread of Eradication.name: Thread of Eradication
Thread of Eradication.desc: The Thread of Eradication is a post-Moon Lord bow that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. Upon use, it takes 1 second to charge up a magenta laser beam.
Thread of Eradication.tip: Charges up God's Bane Doombeam · Channelling the weapon causes it to charge up Hyperdeath Rift instead · While charging Hyperdeath Rift, the bow's turning speed is slowed down · Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage

Titan Arm.name: Titan Arm
Titan Arm.desc: The Titan Arm is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Atlases after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. It has an abnormally high knockback, similar to the Slap Hand, and is guaranteed to inflict critical hits.
Titan Arm.tip: Sends enemies straight to the stars at the speed of light · Slap Hand but better

Toasty Bat Bottle.name: Toasty Bat Bottle
Toasty Bat Bottle.desc: The Toasty Bat Bottle is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by Hellbats. When used, it summons a Toasty Bat Friend pet that follows the player around.
Toasty Bat Bottle.tip: Summons a fiery bat to light your way that leaves a trail of glowing embers · 'Guaranteed to NOT knock you off your hellbridge'

Tooth Ball.name: Tooth Ball
Tooth Ball.desc: The Tooth Ball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by The Perforators. When used, it throws a tooth ball that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and pierces twice.
Tooth Ball.tip: Stealth strikes spawn rain clouds on enemy hits

Torrential Tear.name: Torrential Tear
Torrential Tear.desc: The Torrential Tear is a non-consumable Pre-Hardmode event-summoning item that starts the Rain event shortly after usage. If used while it is raining, the rain will stop shortly afterwards. It cannot be used while a Slime Rain is active.
Torrential Tear.tip: Summons the rain · Rain will start some time after this item is used · If used while it's raining, the rain will stop some time afterward

Toxic Heart.name: Toxic Heart
Toxic Heart.desc: The Toxic Heart is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath.
Toxic Heart.tip: Your heart beats with the Plague, pulsing outside of your body · Pulse frequency scale with regen, and pulses that kill enemies pulse again to heal you · 50% increased Sickness debuff damage · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

Toxicant Twister.name: Toxicant Twister
Toxicant Twister.desc: The Toxicant Twister is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it throws a fan of 4 boomerangs that spin and cluster around the cursor.
Toxicant Twister.tip: Throws a fan of four spinning disks that swirl around your cursor · Stealth strikes swirl in a wider range and create a vortex of raindrops that home in on enemies

Trash Can (pet).name: Trash Can (pet)
Trash Can (pet).desc: Trash Can is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Trashers. It summons a little Danny Devito to follow the player. If the player moves too far away, Danny Devito will use a little red carpet to fly towards them.

Tundra Leash.name: Tundra Leash
Tundra Leash.desc: The Tundra Leash is a Pre-Hardmode mount summoning item that is dropped by Rimehounds. When used, it summons a Rimehound mount which acts similarly to the Basilisk summoned by the Ancient Horn but is much slower.

Ultimus Cleaver.name: Ultimus Cleaver
Ultimus Cleaver.desc: The Ultimus Cleaver is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by the Ravager. When swung, it fires five homing gravity-affected sparks. The sparks deal 10% of the weapon's damage and pierce once. Each spark lasts for 1.5 seconds before dissipating.
Ultimus Cleaver.tip: Launches damaging homing sparks and explodes on enemy hits

Urchin Stinger.name: Urchin Stinger
Urchin Stinger.desc: Urchin Stingers are Pre-Hardmode rogue weapons dropped by Aquatic Urchins. When used, they fire an urchin stinger that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. The urchin stinger pierces once and inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit.
Urchin Stinger.tip: Sticks into enemies and injects an extremely potent poison · Stealth strikes stick into and make enemies Poisoned for longer · Sticking seven stingers in an enemy with a stealth strike stuck in it spawns an irradiated blast

Utensil Poker.name: Utensil Poker
Utensil Poker.desc: The Utensil Poker is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it fires a set of three random utensils.
Utensil Poker.tip: Fires utensils in bursts of three · Stealth strikes replace any utensil with a powerful butcher knife · 'Space chickens, that is all'

Valediction.name: Valediction
Valediction.desc: The Valediction is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by the Reaper Shark after Polterghast has been defeated.
Valediction.tip: Throws a homing reaper scythe · Stealth strikes spawn razorblade typhoons on enemy hits

Vehemence.name: Vehemence
Vehemence.desc: The Vehemence is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It fires a high-velocity hellish bolt that explodes into 18 skull clouds upon contact with enemies or tiles which deal 11% of the weapon's damage.
Vehemence.tip: Casts intense bolts of hellish power that explode into skulls

Vein Burster.name: Vein Burster
Vein Burster.desc: The Vein Burster is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by The Perforators. When swung, it fires a blood ball that is affected by gravity and sticks to any tile that it contacts.
Vein Burster.tip: Fires a blood ball that sticks to tiles and explodes

Vesuvius.name: Vesuvius
Vesuvius.desc: The Vesuvius is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Ravager. Its left-click attack is similar to the Meteor Staff; it calls down a swarm of four molten asteroids that explode and inflict the Hellfire debuff upon hitting a tile or an enemy.
Vesuvius.tip: Calls down a swarm of molten asteroids · Press Right Click to fire a spread of molten asteroids from the staff

Vigilance.name: Vigilance
Vigilance.desc: Vigilance is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It summons a soul seeker which flies in place at a set distance from the player, forming a ring around the player if multiple seekers are present.
Vigilance.tip: Summons a soul seeker to fight for you

Violence.name: Violence
