Violence.desc: Violence is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used, it summons a spinning demonic pitchfork which follows the cursor, rapidly dealing contact damage.
Violence.tip: A demonic pitchfork, cursed to cause endless bloodshed · Left Click commands the trident to follow your cursor and shred enemies with devastating speed · Right Click throws the trident, violently tearing through enemies with immense power and inflicting Vulnerability Hex

Virulence.name: Virulence
Virulence.desc: The Virulence is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings and is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When swung, it fires a fast-traveling plague wave towards the cursor's position, which dissipates when it travels at least 37 tiles.

Vitriolic Viper.name: Vitriolic Viper
Vitriolic Viper.desc: The Vitriolic Viper is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it charges up to fire a spread of radioactive beams that inflict the Irradiated debuff, whose spread gets tighter the longer it is charged.
Vitriolic Viper.tip: Charges up and fires a slithering beam of radiation · If fully charged, instead fires a huge spread of short range fangs

Void Concentration Staff.name: Void Concentration Staff
Void Concentration Staff.desc: The Void Concentration Staff is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Ceaseless Void. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will engulf the player with a void aura which uses up three minion slots and increases the player's summon damage by 5%.
Void Concentration Staff.tip: Surrounds you with dark energy, which makes all attacks deal 15% less damage · Right Click to condense the energy onto a target, focusing your minions on them and creating homing beams · When the focused enemy takes damage from any source, they will be struck by additional dark energies · These dark energy are twice as strong when the strike was from a minion or sentry · After 10 seconds, the dark energy will resume orbiting you

Void of Calamity.name: Void of Calamity
Void of Calamity.desc: The Void of Calamity is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Calamitas Clone. When equipped, it increases all damage by 12% and causes brimstone fire to fall from the sky when the player takes damage.
Void of Calamity.tip: 12% increased damage · Calamitous flames rain down while invincible

Volterion.name: Volterion
Volterion.desc: Volterion is a post-Moon Lord magic gun that is dropped by the Storm Weaver. When used, it fires an ultracharged electric filament that bursts into 5 balls of lightning upon contact with an enemy or tile, accompanied by a muzzle flash which can damage enemies.
Volterion.tip: Discharges a high-voltage stream which bursts into 5 balls of lightning on hit · Each ball lightning emits two additional lightning bolts before exploding

Walking Cane.name: Walking Cane
Walking Cane.desc: The Walking Cane is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Deerclops. Holding the item increases movement speed by 20%. When used, it thrusts out a short-ranged cane toward the cursor in a swiping motion.
Walking Cane.tip: Swipes a pointed walking cane · Stealth strikes drain the sanity of foes, causing shadow hands to be summoned when attacked · While held, increases movement speed by 20% · 'Is it walking me, or am I walking it?'

Warbanner of the Righteous.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
Warbanner of the Righteous.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.
Warbanner of the Righteous.tip: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 1.15x, minimum damage boost is 0.85x · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

Whitewater.name: Whitewater
Whitewater.desc: The Whitewater is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. When used, it throws a whitewater flask that follows the cursor. Hitting an enemy with the flask causes it to burst into 4 water spears before returning to the player.
Whitewater.tip: Throws a flask of magic white water at the cursor that glows after a short while · Flasks that hit enemies while glowing release four water spears that converge back on the flask's position · If the flask hits an enemy or gets too far, it will return to the owner · Stealth strikes create six water spears and summon a swirling whitewater vortex that heals players and knocks back enemies · Allies that enter the vortex will heal for twice as long

Wings of Rebirth.name: Wings of Rebirth
Wings of Rebirth.desc: The Wings of Rebirth are a post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory that are dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
Wings of Rebirth.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 6 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Resplendent to the very end'

Xyk's Blessing.name: Xyk's Blessing
Xyk's Blessing.desc: The Xyk's Blessing is a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user. It additionally replaces user's wings with a custom visual effect, adds an additional particle trail while dashing, and an explosive death effect. It drops from Crawlers at a 4% chance.

Yharim's Crystal.name: Yharim's Crystal
Yharim's Crystal.desc: Yharim's Crystal is a post-Moon Lord magic weapon that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth, that functions like the Last Prism.
Yharim's Crystal.tip: Fires Dragonfire beams of total annihilation

Yharim's Gift.name: Yharim's Gift
Yharim's Gift.desc: The Yharim's Gift is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Yharim's Gift.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Increases damage by 10% and movement speed by 20% · All attacks inflict Auric Rebuke · Flaming meteors rain down while invincible · 'The power to kill a god pulses from within this artifact'

Yharon's Kindle Staff.name: Yharon's Kindle Staff
Yharon's Kindle Staff.desc: The Yharon's Kindle Staff is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it summons a Fiery Draconid to attack enemies by slamming into them and rebounding away and firing homing dragon fireballs.
Yharon's Kindle Staff.tip: Summons a fiery draconid to fight for you

Demonshade armor.name: Demonshade armor
Demonshade armor.desc: Demonshade armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer armor set crafted from Shadowspec Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits afterimages and purple dust while moving.

Gem Tech armor.name: Gem Tech armor
Gem Tech armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Exo Prisms, Galactica Singularities, and Cores of Calamity.

Candles.name: Candles
Candles.desc: Candles are a type of furniture and light source. Candles can only be placed on flat-surface items. Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off with Right Click and by mechanisms.

Rod of Harmony.name: Rod of Harmony
Rod of Harmony.desc: The Rod of Harmony is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord tool. It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.
Rod of Harmony.tip: Teleports you to the position of the cursor

Celestial Shell.name: Celestial Shell
Celestial Shell.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.
Celestial Shell.tip: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

Spectre Wings.name: Spectre Wings
Spectre Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Reaver armor.name: Reaver armor
Reaver armor.desc: Reaver armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Perennial Bars.

Greater Healing Potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
Greater Healing Potion.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

Gladiator's Locket.name: Gladiator's Locket
Gladiator's Locket.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity.
Gladiator's Locket.tip: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below

Magiluminescence.name: Magiluminescence
Magiluminescence.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants.
Magiluminescence.tip: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'

Extra jump.name: Extra jump
Extra jump.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

Gi.name: Gi
Gi.desc: The Gi is an armor item that can be equipped in the shirt slot. It provides 4 defense along with a 5% damage and critical strike chance boost to weapons. It also provides a 10% melee and movement speed increase. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Gi.tip: 5% increased damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased melee and movement speed

Gold armor.name: Gold armor
Gold armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Silver armor.name: Silver armor
Silver armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Silver Bars (240 Silver Ore). The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

Roasted Bird.name: Roasted Bird
Roasted Bird.desc: The Roasted Bird is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Roasted Bird.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Serving Size: 1 child.'

Omega Blue armor.name: Omega Blue armor
Omega Blue armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Reaper Teeth, Depth Cells, and Ruinous Souls. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

Lightning Boots.name: Lightning Boots
Lightning Boots.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Lightning Boots.tip: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

Crimson armor.name: Crimson armor
Crimson armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Crimtane Bars (180 Crimtane Ore) and 45 Tissue Samples.

Shadow armor.name: Shadow armor
Shadow armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore) and 45 Shadow Scales.

Betsy's Wings.name: Betsy's Wings
Betsy's Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.
Betsy's Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover

Empress Wings.name: Empress Wings
Empress Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.
Empress Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Hold Up to boost faster!

Fishron Wings.name: Fishron Wings
Fishron Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.
Fishron Wings.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Allows quick travel in water

Betsy's Wrath.name: Betsy's Wrath
Betsy's Wrath.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post-Golem wand that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs.

Crystal Assassin armor.name: Crystal Assassin armor
Crystal Assassin armor.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.

Astral armor.name: Astral armor
Astral armor.desc: Astral armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Astral Bars and Meteorite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

Butterfly Wings.name: Butterfly Wings
Butterfly Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Flame Wings.name: Flame Wings
Flame Wings.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Celestial Starboard.name: Celestial Starboard
Celestial Starboard.desc: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 horizontal, 115 vertical, and 51 while falling.
Celestial Starboard.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'

Obsidian Shield.name: Obsidian Shield
Obsidian Shield.desc: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.
Obsidian Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks

Honeyfin.name: Honeyfin
Honeyfin.desc: The Honeyfin is a pre-Hardmode fish and recovery potion that restores health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

Slice of Cake.name: Slice of Cake
Slice of Cake.desc: The Slice of Cake is a furniture item acquired by being the first player to talk to the Party Girl during a randomly occurring Party.
Slice of Cake.tip: Usable when placed · 'Stuff your face. Stuff someone else's face. Whatever.'

Bone Glove.name: Bone Glove
Bone Glove.desc: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second.
Bone Glove.tip: Shoots crossbones at enemies while you are attacking

Auric Tesla armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
Auric Tesla armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from several post-Moon Lord armors, Auric Bars, and other materials. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.

Oblatory.name: Oblatory
Oblatory.desc: Enchanting is a game mechanic unlocked after defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, which allows the player to apply enchantments to their items, granting them unique additional qualities.

Arcane Flower.name: Arcane Flower
Arcane Flower.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro-reducing effect of the Putrid Scent. It also gains the Putrid Scent's bonus 5% damage and 5% critical strike chance, but this is only applied to magic weapons.
Arcane Flower.tip: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you

Destroyer Emblem.name: Destroyer Emblem
Destroyer Emblem.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.
Destroyer Emblem.tip: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

Brimflame armor.name: Brimflame armor
Brimflame armor.desc: Brimflame armor is a craftable Hardmode mage armor set crafted from Ashes of Calamity and Unholy Cores. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.

Hydrothermic armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
Hydrothermic armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Scoria Bars.
Hydrothermic armor.tip: 13% increased damage · Grants immunity to lava and On Fire!

Bat Scepter.name: Bat Scepter
Bat Scepter.desc: The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. When used, it fires a burst of 2–3 homing bats, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.
Bat Scepter.tip: Summons bats to attack your enemies

Charged Blaster Cannon.name: Charged Blaster Cannon
Charged Blaster Cannon.desc: The Charged Blaster Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/800 chance to drop from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event.

Band of Starpower.name: Band of Starpower
Band of Starpower.desc: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 40.

Diamond Robe.name: Diamond Robe
Diamond Robe.desc: The Diamond Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. When worn, the Diamond Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to hit in a larger radius and pierce an additional enemy.
Diamond Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 · 15% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Diamonds shine brilliantly

Magic Hat.name: Magic Hat
Magic Hat.desc: The Magic Hat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece that can be equipped in the helmet slot. While equipped, it grants + defense and increases the player's magic damage and magic critical strike chance by 6% each. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Magic Hat.tip: 6% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Mana Potion.name: Mana Potion
Mana Potion.desc: The Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 100 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It can be crafted or occasionally obtained from any Crates except for Wooden and Pearlwood Crates. They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for.

Bloodflare armor.name: Bloodflare armor
Bloodflare armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Bloodstone, Blood Orbs and Ruinous Souls. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.
stats: 5 seconds (15th true melee strike while wearing Ram Mask)

Prismatic armor.name: Prismatic armor
Prismatic armor.desc: Prismatic armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Armored Shells, Exodium Clusters, Divine Geodes, and Nanites. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.

Mana Flower.name: Mana Flower
Mana Flower.desc: The Mana Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory that reduces mana usage by 8%, and enables auto-consumption of any mana-restoring potions in the player's inventory when mana is depleted. The Mana Flower stacks with other mana cost-reduction items, including Nature's Gift.
Mana Flower.tip: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed

Jungle armor.name: Jungle armor
Jungle armor.desc: Jungle armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Jungle Shirt, Jungle Hat, and Jungle Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 32 Jungle Spores, 2 Vines, and 10 Stingers.

Victide armor.name: Victide armor
Victide armor.desc: Victide armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Sea Remains.

Sparkling Empress.name: Sparkling Empress
Sparkling Empress.desc: The Sparkling Empress is a Pre-Hardmode magic weapon obtained by fishing in the Sunken Sea after defeating Desert Scourge. When used, it briefly charges, then releases a concentrated light-blue laser that pierces infinitely.
Sparkling Empress.tip: Fires a concentrated laser to annihilate your foes · Defeated enemies explode into prism shards

Meteor armor.name: Meteor armor
Meteor armor.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite).

Space Gun.name: Space Gun
Space Gun.desc: The Space Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires fast green lasers that can hit up to three enemies. The lasers will increase in damage, pierce, knockback and size (only visually) as they travel.

Hallowed armor.name: Hallowed armor
Hallowed armor.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.

Spectre armor.name: Spectre armor
Spectre armor.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.

Permafrost's Concoction.name: Permafrost's Concoction
Permafrost's Concoction.desc: Permafrost's Concoction is a Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Archmage for 24 gold. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Permafrost's Concoction.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 and reduces mana cost by 15% · +0.5 HP/s life regen below half health, +1 HP/s when below 25% health and +2 HP/s when below 10% health · +3 HP/s life regen while afflicted with any fire debuff · You will survive fatal damage and revive with 30% life on a 3 minute cooldown · You are encased in an ice barrier for 3 seconds when revived

Sorcerer Emblem.name: Sorcerer Emblem
Sorcerer Emblem.desc: The Sorcerer Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases magic damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Cobalt armor.name: Cobalt armor
Cobalt armor.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Palladium armor.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Blood Thorn.name: Blood Thorn
Blood Thorn.desc: The Blood Thorn is a Hardmode magic weapon that summons three penetrating Blood Thorn projectiles upon use, which erupt from solid blocks and platforms to damage enemies near the player's cursor. It has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks.
Blood Thorn.tip: Summons blood thorns from the ground

Hive Pack.name: Hive Pack
Hive Pack.desc: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants a 1/2 chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees.
Hive Pack.tip: Increases the strength of friendly bees

Chlorophyte armor.name: Chlorophyte armor
Chlorophyte armor.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.

Venom Staff.name: Venom Staff
Venom Staff.desc: The Venom Staff is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses wand and the direct upgrade to the Poison Staff. When used, it fires a burst of 4–7 Venom Fangs in a spread. Each projectile pierces four enemies and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 30 seconds.
Venom Staff.tip: Shoots a venom fang that pierces multiple enemies

Tarragon armor.name: Tarragon armor
Tarragon armor.desc: Tarragon armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Uelibloom Bars and Divine Geodes. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

Nebula armor.name: Nebula armor
Nebula armor.desc: Nebula armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet, Nebula Breastplate, and Nebula Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Nebula Fragments.

Aerospec armor.name: Aerospec armor
Aerospec armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Aerialite Bars and Feathers. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

Statigel armor.name: Statigel armor
Statigel armor.desc: Statigel armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode armor set crafted from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel.

Silva armor.name: Silva armor
Silva armor.desc: The Silva armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Planty Mush, Effulgent Feathers, and Ascendant Spirit Essences. It is the mage/summoner counterpart to God Slayer armor.
Silva armor.tip: 15% increased damage and 11% increased critical strike chance

Beetle armor.name: Beetle armor
Beetle armor.desc: Beetle armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee armor set consisting of the Beetle Helmet and Beetle Leggings, as well as two different chestpieces: the Beetle Scale Mail and Beetle Shell, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.

Valhalla Knight armor.name: Valhalla Knight armor
Valhalla Knight armor.desc: Valhalla Knight armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Valhalla Knight's Helm, Valhalla Knight's Breastplate, and Valhalla Knight's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.

Christmas Tree Sword.name: Christmas Tree Sword
Christmas Tree Sword.desc: The Christmas Tree Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

Feral Claws.name: Feral Claws
Feral Claws.desc: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Feral Claws.tip: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and whips

Counterweights.name: Counterweights
Counterweights.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.

Molten armor.name: Molten armor
Molten armor.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Hellstone Bars (135 Hellstone and 45 Obsidian).

The Meatball.name: The Meatball
The Meatball.desc: The Meatball is a pre-Hardmode flail.

Flask of Venom.name: Flask of Venom
Flask of Venom.desc: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post-Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, as well as the Potent Acid debuff for 1 second.
Flask of Venom.tip: Melee and Whip attacks inflict Potent Venom on enemies

Flying Dragon.name: Flying Dragon
Flying Dragon.desc: The Flying Dragon is a Hardmode, post-Golem broadsword that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event.

Power Glove.name: Power Glove
Power Glove.desc: The Power Glove is a Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Power Glove.tip: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

Flask of Cursed Flames.name: Flask of Cursed Flames
Flask of Cursed Flames.desc: The Flask of Cursed Flames is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff on hit for 3–6 seconds, which deals 24 damage per second and increases knockback on targets.
Flask of Cursed Flames.tip: Melee and Whip attacks inflict enemies with cursed flames

Bananarang.name: Bananarang
Bananarang.desc: The Bananarang is a Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by the Clown during Blood Moon with a 1/10 chance. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of ten Bananarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

Shadowflame Knife.name: Shadowflame Knife
Shadowflame Knife.desc: The Shadowflame Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/6 / 1/3 chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during the Goblin Army event.

Turtle armor.name: Turtle armor
Turtle armor.desc: Turtle armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses melee armor set consisting of the Turtle Helmet, Turtle Scale Mail, and Turtle Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 54 Chlorophyte Bars (270 Chlorophyte Ore) and 3 Turtle Shells.

Flask of Ichor.name: Flask of Ichor
Flask of Ichor.desc: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Flask of Ichor.tip: Melee and Whip attacks decrease enemies defense

Solar Flare armor.name: Solar Flare armor
Solar Flare armor.desc: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet, Solar Flare Breastplate, and Solar Flare Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Solar Fragments.

Flask of Fire.name: Flask of Fire
Flask of Fire.desc: The Flask of Fire is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Flask of Fire.tip: Melee and Whip attacks set enemies on fire

Flask of Poison.name: Flask of Poison
Flask of Poison.desc: The Flask of Poison is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Flask of Poison.tip: Melee and Whip attacks poison enemies

Yoyo Bag.name: Yoyo Bag
Yoyo Bag.desc: The Yoyo Bag is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionalities of the Yoyo Glove, a counterweight, and string. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Yoyo Bag.tip: Gives the user master yoyo skills

God Slayer armor.name: God Slayer armor
God Slayer armor.desc: God Slayer armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set crafted from Cosmilite Bars and Ascendant Spirit Essence. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

Sniper Scope.name: Sniper Scope
Sniper Scope.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Sniper Scope.tip: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

Chlorophyte Bullet.name: Chlorophyte Bullet
Chlorophyte Bullet.desc: The Chlorophyte Bullet is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses bullet. It strongly homes in on the nearest enemy.

Cluster Rocket I.name: Cluster Rocket I
Cluster Rocket I.desc: The Cluster Rocket I is a type of rocket ammunition. Unlike the Cluster Rocket II, it does not destroy tiles.

Plague Reaper armor.name: Plague Reaper armor
Plague Reaper armor.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set crafted from Necro armor, Plague Cell Canisters and Nanites. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.

Shroomite armor.name: Shroomite armor
Shroomite armor.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.

Frostburn Arrow.name: Frostburn Arrow
Frostburn Arrow.desc: The Frostburn Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has a 1/3 chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 3 seconds on enemies.

Silver Bullet.name: Silver Bullet
Silver Bullet.desc: The Silver Bullet is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It deals more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. It also deals 300% damage to Werewolves.

Unholy Arrow.name: Unholy Arrow
Unholy Arrow.desc: The Unholy Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

Fossil armor.name: Fossil armor
Fossil armor.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 60 Sturdy Fossils.

Snow Ruffian armor.name: Snow Ruffian armor
Snow Ruffian armor.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set crafted from Boreal Wood, Silk and Flinx Fur.

Flintlock Pistol.name: Flintlock Pistol
Flintlock Pistol.desc: The Flintlock Pistol is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be bought from the Arms Dealer for.

Shimmer Arrow.name: Shimmer Arrow
Shimmer Arrow.desc: The Shimmer Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow that is obtained by throwing a Wooden or Hellfire Arrow into Shimmer. It experiences reversed gravity when fired. Upon contact with enemies or blocks, it creates a visual rainbow explosion.

Blood Rain Bow.name: Blood Rain Bow
Blood Rain Bow.desc: The Blood Rain Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Mermen. When used, it converts any type of arrow into a spread of 1–3 streams of blood (average of 1.83 streams) to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor.
Blood Rain Bow.tip: Rains blood from the sky · 'Reign in Blood'

Meteor Shot.name: Meteor Shot
Meteor Shot.desc: The Meteor Shot is a pre-Hardmode bullet. When fired, it can either bounce from a solid block once or pierce through one enemy.

Venom Arrow.name: Venom Arrow
Venom Arrow.desc: The Venom Arrow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera arrow. It has the highest base damage of all arrows and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 10 seconds, as well as the Potent Acid debuff for 2 seconds.

Venom Bullet.name: Venom Bullet
Venom Bullet.desc: The Venom Bullet is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bullet. It creates a conical splash of venom upon impact that afflicts the target it struck, as well as those within the area, with the Potent Acid debuff for two seconds and Acid Venom for 10.
Venom Bullet.tip: Inflicts Potent Venom in an area

Aerial Bane.name: Aerial Bane
Aerial Bane.desc: The Aerial Bane is a Hardmode, post-Golem bow that has a 1/4 of being dropped from Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it converts any type of arrow into Aerial Bane arrows. The Aerial Bane fires a volley of six arrows per use, which travel in a sharp arc.
Aerial Bane.tip: Shoots splitting arrows, deals more damage to airborne enemies

Magic Quiver.name: Magic Quiver
Magic Quiver.desc: The Magic Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that boosts arrow- and Stake-firing weapons.
Magic Quiver.tip: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance to not consume arrows

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)
2.5% (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 1.25% (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Cursed Dart.name: Cursed Dart
Cursed Dart.desc: The Cursed Dart is a Hardmode dart. As it travels, it releases cursed flames that fall and land on blocks, lingering for 180 ticks before dissipating. The cursed flames cannot pierce enemies and deal 80% of the Cursed Dart's damage and 50% of its knockback.
Cursed Dart.tip: Drops cursed flames on the ground

Endless Musket Pouch.name: Endless Musket Pouch
Endless Musket Pouch.desc: The Endless Musket Pouch is a Hardmode ammunition item. While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

Lunic Corps armor.name: Lunic Corps armor
Lunic Corps armor.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a craftable Hardmode ranger armor set.

Chlorophyte Arrow.name: Chlorophyte Arrow
Chlorophyte Arrow.desc: The Chlorophyte Arrow is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses arrow. It can bounce off blocks up to three times, dissipating upon hitting blocks for the fourth time.
Chlorophyte Arrow.tip: Bounces back after hitting a wall

Chlorophyte Shotbow.name: Chlorophyte Shotbow
Chlorophyte Shotbow.desc: The Chlorophyte Shotbow is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses repeater. When used, it fires 2–3 arrows per shot, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Luminite Arrow.name: Luminite Arrow
Luminite Arrow.desc: The Luminite Arrow is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord arrow. When a Luminite Arrow dissipates, a Luminite Arrow Trail projectile will be fired after a short delay which copies the arrow's flying trail and deals the same base damage as the arrow.
Luminite Arrow.tip: 'Shooting them down at the speed of sound!'

Vortex armor.name: Vortex armor
Vortex armor.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Vortex Fragments.

Necro armor.name: Necro armor
Necro armor.desc: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet, Necro Breastplate, and Necro Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones.

Glove of Precision.name: Glove of Precision
Glove of Precision.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Glove of Precision.tip: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

Shinobi Infiltrator armor.name: Shinobi Infiltrator armor
Shinobi Infiltrator armor.desc: Shinobi Infiltrator armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet, Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso, and Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.

Desert Prowler armor.name: Desert Prowler armor
Desert Prowler armor.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Stormlion Mandibles and Silk.

Gladiator armor.name: Gladiator armor
Gladiator armor.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

Sulphurous armor.name: Sulphurous armor
Sulphurous armor.desc: Sulphurous armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Acidwood and Sulphuric Scales.

Sand Dollar.name: Sand Dollar
Sand Dollar.desc: The Sand Dollar is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it throws up to 2 sand dollars that return to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy.
Sand Dollar.tip: Throws up to 2 returning sand dollars · Stealth strikes throw 2 long ranged sand dollars that explode into coral shards on enemy hits

Umbraphile armor.name: Umbraphile armor
Umbraphile armor.desc: Umbraphile armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Solar Veils and Hallowed Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.

Titan Heart armor.name: Titan Heart armor
Titan Heart armor.desc: Titan Heart armor is a craftable Hardmode rogue armor set crafted from Astral Monoliths and Titan Hearts.

Daedalus armor.name: Daedalus armor
Daedalus armor.desc: Daedalus armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Cryonic Bars.

Monk armor.name: Monk armor
Monk armor.desc: Monk armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap, Monk's Shirt, and Monk's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.

Deep Wounder.name: Deep Wounder
Deep Wounder.desc: The Deep Wounder is a Hardmode non-consumable rogue weapon that is sold by the Bandit for 48 gold after Calamitas Clone has been defeated. When used, it throws a fast-spinning hatchet that pierces twice and inflicts the Crush Depth and Heavy Bleeding debuffs.
Deep Wounder.tip: Throws an abyssal hatchet · Stealth strikes cause the hatchet to stick to struck enemies, releasing a barrage of water projectiles · Water projectiles launch at the closest enemy after a brief delay

Empyrean armor.name: Empyrean armor
Empyrean armor.desc: Empyrean armor is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue armor set crafted from Meld Blobs and Luminite Bars. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages.

Celestial Reaper.name: Celestial Reaper
Celestial Reaper.desc: The Celestial Reaper is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that is sold by the Bandit for 3 platinum after the Moon Lord has been defeated.
Celestial Reaper.tip: Throws a fast homing scythe · The scythe will bounce after hitting an enemy up to six times · Stealth strikes create damaging afterimages

War Table.name: War Table
War Table.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 / 1/1 chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 / 1/4 chance during Tier 3.
War Table.tip: Usable when placed · Increased your max number of sentries by 1

Kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
Kaleidoscope.desc: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Kaleidoscope.tip: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

Dark Harvest.name: Dark Harvest
Dark Harvest.desc: The Dark Harvest is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that is dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. It has a 10% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Dark Harvest.tip: Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with dark energy to gain whip attack speed · Dark energy jumps from enemies hit by summons

Flinx Fur Coat.name: Flinx Fur Coat
Flinx Fur Coat.desc: The Flinx Fur Coat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece. When equipped, it gives the player an additional minion slot, and increases summon damage by 5%.
Flinx Fur Coat.tip: Increases summon damage by 5% · Increases your max number of minions by 1

Wulfrum armor.name: Wulfrum armor
Wulfrum armor.desc: Wulfrum armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Wulfrum Metal Scraps and Energy Cores.

Leather Whip.name: Leather Whip
Leather Whip.desc: The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is virtually always available to be purchased from the Zoologist for (save for certain scenarios). It has a 50% multihit penalty, and inflicts 4 tag damage on enemies.
Leather Whip.tip: 4 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · 'Die monster!'

Stardust armor.name: Stardust armor
Stardust armor.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Stardust Fragments.

Lunar Portal Staff.name: Lunar Portal Staff
Lunar Portal Staff.desc: The Lunar Portal Staff is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Lunar Portal sentry. It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair.
Lunar Portal Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a lunar portal to shoot lasers at your enemies

Enchanted Conch.name: Enchanted Conch
Enchanted Conch.desc: The Enchanted Conch is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it summons a Hermit Crab minion that runs on the ground or jumps around, dealing contact damage to enemies.
Enchanted Conch.tip: Summons a hermit crab to fight for you

Polyp Launcher.name: Polyp Launcher
Polyp Launcher.desc: Polyp Launcher is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies.
Polyp Launcher.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a polyp bunch that launches coral chunks at nearby enemies

Snapthorn.name: Snapthorn
Snapthorn.desc: The Snapthorn is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 40% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Snapthorn.tip: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed

Obsidian armor.name: Obsidian armor
Obsidian armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian, 30 Silk, and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples.

Fathom Swarmer armor.name: Fathom Swarmer armor
Fathom Swarmer armor.desc: Fathom Swarmer armor is a craftable Hardmode summoner armor set crafted from Sea Remains, Planty Mush, and Depth Cells.

Squire armor.name: Squire armor
Squire armor.desc: Squire armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Squire's Great Helm, Squire's Plating, and Squire's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.

Tiki armor.name: Tiki armor
Tiki armor.desc: Tiki armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Tiki Mask, Tiki Shirt, and Tiki Pants. The set can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for a total of.

Desert Tiger Staff.name: Desert Tiger Staff
Desert Tiger Staff.desc: The Desert Tiger Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Desert Tiger minion. It runs towards enemies to deal contact damage.
Desert Tiger Staff.tip: Summons a white tiger to fight for you

Morning Star.name: Morning Star
Morning Star.desc: The Morning Star is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/200 / 399/40000 chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Rusty Armored Bones, and Hell Armored Bones in the Hardmode Dungeon. It has a 5% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Morning Star.tip: 8 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

Plaguebringer armor.name: Plaguebringer armor
Plaguebringer armor.desc: Plaguebringer armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set and an upgrade to the Bee armor set. While wearing the Plaguebringer Carapace, the player has a tank equipped behind them.

Spider armor.name: Spider armor
Spider armor.desc: Spider armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Spider Mask, Spider Breastplate, and Spider Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 36 Spider Fangs.

Spider Staff.name: Spider Staff
Spider Staff.desc: The Spider Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Spider minion. It runs towards enemies and latches onto them, repeatedly dealing damage while latched and inflicting the Acid Venom debuff for 2–4 seconds. It can climb background walls and jump high.
Spider Staff.tip: Summons spiders to fight for you

Queen Spider Staff.name: Queen Spider Staff
Queen Spider Staff.desc: The Queen Spider Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Spider Turret sentry. It fires Spider Eggs towards enemies once per second, which can bounce and roll on blocks, and are heavily affected by gravity.
Queen Spider Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a spider queen to spit eggs at your enemies
stats: 9Category:Pages with information based on outdated versions of Terraria's source code

Stardust Cell Staff.name: Stardust Cell Staff
Stardust Cell Staff.desc: The Stardust Cell Staff is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist summon weapon that summons a Stardust Cell minion. It hovers near enemies, firing a homing mini-cell that attaches itself to the target, inflicting the Celled debuff to deal 20 damage per second for 5 seconds.
Stardust Cell Staff.tip: Summons a stardust cell to fight for you · 'Cultivate the most beautiful cellular infection'

Durendal.name: Durendal
Durendal.desc: The Durendal is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss whip. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Durendal.tip: 9 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with enchanted energy to gain whip attack speed · The enchantment smites enemies hit by summons

Rainbow Crystal Staff.name: Rainbow Crystal Staff
Rainbow Crystal Staff.desc: The Rainbow Crystal Staff is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Rainbow Crystal sentry. It fires spreads of three multicolored light beams towards enemies, but cannot target through blocks. Each beam releases a star that explodes shortly after.
Rainbow Crystal Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons a radiant crystal that banishes your enemies · 'The colors, Duke, the colors!'

Lilies of Finality.name: Lilies of Finality
Lilies of Finality.desc: The Lilies of Finality is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is found in the Brimstone Crag after Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth has been defeated, always placed in a structure with walls. Upon use with two or more minion slots, it summons 2 minions at the cursor, Ariane and Elster.
Lilies of Finality.tip: Can only be summoned once · 'Wake up'

Bee armor.name: Bee armor
Bee armor.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 30 Bee Wax.

Hornet Staff.name: Hornet Staff
Hornet Staff.desc: The Hornet Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Hornet minion. It hovers above enemies, firing stingers that inflict the Poisoned debuff for 4–7 seconds and do not pierce.
Hornet Staff.tip: Summons a hornet to fight for you

Houndius Shootius.name: Houndius Shootius
Houndius Shootius.desc: The Houndius Shootius is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Houndius Shootius sentry. It shoots fireballs towards enemies, which dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Deerclops.
Houndius Shootius.tip: Summons a sentry · Summons an arcane construct to shoot optic blasts at your enemies · 'Oh me oh my, look at that eye!'
stats: 12.5Category:Pages with information based on outdated versions of Terraria's source code

Spinal Tap.name: Spinal Tap
Spinal Tap.desc: The Spinal Tap is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron whip. It has a 10% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Spinal Tap.tip: 7 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Performs better against multiple targets than most whips · 'This goes to eleven'

Fearmonger armor.name: Fearmonger armor
Fearmonger armor.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post-Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.

Absolute Zero.name: Absolute Zero
Absolute Zero.desc: The Absolute Zero is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It is sold by the Archmage for 60 gold after defeating all three minibosses in the Frost Moon event.
Absolute Zero.tip: Shoots dark ice crystals · The blade creates frost explosions on direct hits · Ancient blade imbued with the Archmage of Ice's magic

Acceleration Round.name: Acceleration Round
Acceleration Round.desc: Acceleration Rounds were craftable Pre-Hardmode bullets. They gained speed over time as they travelled, but did not pierce.

Acidic Rain Barrel.name: Acidic Rain Barrel
Acidic Rain Barrel.desc: The Acidic Rain Barrel was a craftable Hardmode bomb and the direct upgrade to the Blast Barrel. When used, it threw a barrel that rolled across the ground and pierced infinitely. The barrel lasted for a moderate time until it despawned or collided with a wall.
Acidic Rain Barrel.tip: Throws a rolling barrel that explodes on wall collision · Stealth strikes make it rain on collision

Adrenaline Meter.name: Adrenaline Meter
Adrenaline Meter.desc: The Adrenaline Meter is a mechanic added in Revengeance Mode, along with the Rage Meter. In order to fill up the bar, the player must not get hit for a certain amount of time while fighting a boss.

Aftershock.name: Aftershock
Aftershock.desc: The Aftershock was a Hardmode broadsword that was dropped by Earth Elementals. Hitting enemies with the sword spawned a spiked boulder from the sky that pierced twice and could pass through tiles to hit enemies.
Aftershock.tip: Summons boulders from the sky on enemy hits

Alicorn on a Stick.name: Alicorn on a Stick
Alicorn on a Stick.desc: The Alicorn on a Stick was a post-Moon Lord item that was dropped by Supreme Alchemist, Cirrus. When selected, it was held stationary in front of the player to give the illusion that they were riding the Alicorn mount.
Alicorn on a Stick.tip: 'Congratulations, you're winner! Here's my head on a stick.'

Alluring Bait.name: Alluring Bait
Alluring Bait.desc: Alluring Bait is a Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory that is caught while fishing in the Sulphurous Sea. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Alluring Bait.tip: Increases fishing power by 10 · Increases the yield of potion ingredient fish

Alpha Virus.name: Alpha Virus
Alpha Virus.desc: The Alpha Virus was a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that was a direct upgrade to the Epidemic Shredder.
Alpha Virus.tip: Throws a giant plague cell with a lethal aura that explodes into 6 homing plague seekers · Stealth strikes cause the plague cell to move slower, accumulating an aura of swirling plague seekers as it flies

Ancient Crusher.name: Ancient Crusher
Ancient Crusher.desc: The Ancient Crusher was a craftable Hardmode broadsword. When hitting enemies, it created spikes that dealt additional damage for a few seconds. Spikes that critically hit dealt 50% damage.
Ancient Crusher.tip: Summons fossil spikes on enemy hits

Ancient Feather.name: Ancient Feather
Ancient Feather.desc: Ancient Feathers were a Hardmode crafting material crafted using Wyvern Feathers and Living Dew Droplets. They were solely used to make Perennial Bars.

Ancient Shiv.name: Ancient Shiv
Ancient Shiv.desc: The Ancient Shiv was a Pre-Hardmode shortsword that was dropped by Dark Casters. Upon killing an enemy with this sword, they would release a small blue aura cloud that had infinite pierce and lingered for 5 seconds. The cloud dealt 50% damage.
Ancient Shiv.tip: Enemies release a blue aura cloud on death

Ancient Treasure Chest.name: Ancient Treasure Chest
Ancient Treasure Chest.desc: Ancient Treasure Chests are chests found only in the Abyss that contain rare and unique items. Each Ancient Treasure Chest will contain one unique item along with other standard loot.

Androomba.name: Androomba
Androomba.desc: The Androomba is a rare critter that spawns in Arsenal Labs. It passively rolls back and forth, turning around upon getting close to a block. If a player enters its line of sight, it will panic then start rolling quickly in one direction until hitting a block.
Androomba.tip: Press Right Click on the roomba with a solution to insert it · While a solution is inserted, the roomba will start spreading its contents

Animus.name: Animus
Animus.desc: The Animus was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswung. Hitting an enemy applied the Brimstone Flames debuff for a significantly long time of 100 seconds.
Animus.tip: Randomizes its damage on enemy hits

Aquatic Dissolution.name: Aquatic Dissolution
Aquatic Dissolution.desc: The Aquatic Dissolution was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that was a direct upgrade to the Mariana. When used, it fired 3 aquatic spears from the sky, which bounced off tiles twice, disappearing on the third. Spears could pass through tiles for a second after spawning.
Aquatic Dissolution.tip: Fires whaling spears from the sky that bounce off tiles

Arcanum of the Void.name: Arcanum of the Void
Arcanum of the Void.desc: The Arcanum of the Void was an Expert Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord accessory that was obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. When equipped, it granted the ability to reflect some projectiles, such as arrows or magic bolts, that did not damage the player.
Arcanum of the Void.tip: You reflect projectiles when they hit you · Reflected projectiles deal no damage to you · This reflect has a 90 second cooldown which is shared with all other dodges and reflects

Arctic Arrow.name: Arctic Arrow
Arctic Arrow.desc: Arctic Arrows were craftable Hardmode arrows. They inflicted the Glacial State debuff, did not pierce, and created visual ice particles upon shattering.
Arctic Arrow.tip: Freezes enemies for a short time

Arctic Bear Paw.name: Arctic Bear Paw
Arctic Bear Paw.desc: The Arctic Bear Paw is a Hardmode magic weapon that is sold by the Archmage for 35 gold after all three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated. It fires large ice claws that deal high knockback, go through tiles, and pierce four times.
Arctic Bear Paw.tip: Fires spiritual claws that ignore walls · 'The savage mauling that fits in your pocket'

Arcturus Astroidean.name: Arcturus Astroidean
Arcturus Astroidean.desc: The Arcturus Astroidean is a Hardmode bait caught in the Astral Infection that has a base bait power of 40%. While in the Astral Infection or Sulphurous Sea, the player's fishing power is increased by 1.1x.
Arcturus Astroidean.tip: Increases fishing power by 1.1x if used in the Astral Infection or Sulphurous Sea

Armageddon.name: Armageddon
Armageddon.desc: Armageddon was an item that could be obtained from the Starter Bag. It could be activated and deactivated. When active, it had multiple effects on gameplay:
Armageddon.tip: Enables/disables Armageddon, can be used in any difficulty mode · While active, any hit while a boss is alive will instantly kill you · If you defeat a boss for the first time with this mode active, they will drop 5 extra treasure bags · These extra bags will drop even if you are not in Expert Mode · Right click with this item to toggle whether your dodges are disabled · Dodges can be disabled independently of whether or not Armageddon is not enabled

Ashen Key.name: Ashen Key
Ashen Key.desc: The Ashen Key was a crafting material whose sole use was to craft with an Ashen Chest to remove the lock.

Asteroid Staff.name: Asteroid Staff
Asteroid Staff.desc: The Asteroid Staff was a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that was a direct upgrade to the Meteor Staff. When used, it rained down 2-3 asteroids from the sky that quickly fell in the direction of the cursor and emitted green lingering trails as they travelled.

Astral Blade.name: Astral Blade
Astral Blade.desc: The Astral Blade was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. It had the unique ability of increasing its damage, knockback, and critical strike chance by 125% when hitting an enemy that is above 50% of its maximum health.
Astral Blade.tip: Deals more damage the more life an enemy has left

Astral Bow.name: Astral Bow
Astral Bow.desc: The Astral Bow was a craftable Hardmode bow. It shot out 3 arrows one after another in quick bursts. Arrows travelled at a moderate velocity. Each arrow had a use time of 6.
Astral Bow.tip: Fires a burst of three arrows

Astral Bulwark.name: Astral Bulwark
Astral Bulwark.desc: The Astral Bulwark was a Hardmode Expert Mode-exclusive accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Deus. When equipped, it caused five stars to drop from the sky when the player was hit. It also granted immunity to the Astral Infection debuff.
Astral Bulwark.tip: Taking damage drops astral stars from the sky · Provides immunity to the astral infection debuff

Astral Grass Wall.name: Astral Grass Wall
Astral Grass Wall.desc: Astral Grass Walls are background walls that replace Grass Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

Astral Solution.name: Astral Solution
Astral Solution.desc: Astral Solution is a Hardmode solution that is sold by the Steampunker when not in a Don't dig up or Get fixed boi world. It is usable with the Clentaminator and Terraformer. It converts certain blocks and walls into their Astral Infection variants.
Astral Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Astral Infection

Bacon Oil.name: Bacon Oil
Bacon Oil.desc: Bacon Oil is a Pre-Hardmode alcohol that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 30 silver during moon phases 1-4. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Bacon Oil debuff, which causes the following movement effects on its user:
Bacon Oil.tip: Provides "good" mobility that scales with your damage stat boosts · Counts as 3 alcohols for Alcohol Poisoning · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver

Barrel Cactus.name: Barrel Cactus
Barrel Cactus.desc: Barrel Cacti are unobtainable background objects. They do not generate naturally.

Bars.name: Bars
Bars.desc: Bars are crafting materials generally crafted from mined ores at their representative crafting stations. Crafting most ore-related items requires that raw ores are first crafted into bars.

Bazooka.name: Bazooka
Bazooka.desc: The Bazooka was a craftable Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fired a rocket that was affected by gravity after half a second of travel, and exploded when hitting an enemy or a tile.
Bazooka.tip: Uses Grenade Shells · Can be used twice per boss battle

Beetle Juice.name: Beetle Juice
Beetle Juice.desc: Beetle Juice was a crafting material that was dropped by Beetles and Derplings. It was used to craft Vitamins.

Bittercold Staff.name: Bittercold Staff
Bittercold Staff.desc: The Bittercold Staff was a Hardmode wand that was dropped by Cryogen. When used, it fired 2 to 4 small ice spikes that homed on enemies and inflicted the Frostburn debuff on contact.
Bittercold Staff.tip: Fires a spread of homing ice spikes

Blade of Enmity.name: Blade of Enmity
Blade of Enmity.desc: The Blade of Enmity was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. It had an average range and no projectile but swung very quickly and dealt high damage. The blade inflicted the Brimstone Flames debuff.

Bleached Angling Kit.name: Bleached Angling Kit
Bleached Angling Kit.desc: The Bleached Angling Kit was a grab bag that was dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. It contained several fishing equipment and potions.
Bleached Angling Kit.tip: Has a chance to contain various fishing gear · Right Click to open

Blighted Lens.name: Blighted Lens
Blighted Lens.desc: Blighted Lenses were Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Blighted Eyes, Calamity Eyes, and Calamitas. They were used to craft Archery Potions, Magic Quiver and the Eye of Desolation, a summoning item used to summon Calamitas.

Blood Clot Staff.name: Blood Clot Staff
Blood Clot Staff.desc: The Blood Clot Staff was a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that could also be dropped by The Perforators. It was statistically identical to its Corruption equivalent, the Dank Staff. It summoned a meaty blood clot minion, which followed the player and attacked enemies.
Blood Clot Staff.tip: Summons a blood clot to fight for you

Blood Fountain of Revengeance.name: Blood Fountain of Revengeance
Blood Fountain of Revengeance.desc: Blood Fountain of Revengeance was an item found within the Starter Bag in Expert Mode. When used in Expert Mode, it activated or disabled Revengeance Mode. Attempting to use it in Normal Mode or during a boss battle would have no effects.
Blood Fountain of Revengeance.tip: Enables/disables Revengeance Mode, can only be used in Expert Mode. · Enables the Rage mechanic. When Rage is maxed press Rage Mode to activate Rage Mode. · You gain Rage when in proximity of enemies or by using special items. · Enables the Adrenaline mechanic. When Adrenaline is maxed press Adrenaline Mode to activate Adrenaline Mode. · You gain Adrenaline whenever a boss is alive. Getting hit drops Adrenaline back to 0. · All enemies spawn 17.65% more frequently. · Certain non-boss enemies and projectiles deal between 10% and 25% more damage. · Makes certain enemies block life steal and nerfs the effectiveness of life steal. · Nerfs the effectiveness of the Titanium Armor set bonus. · All boss minions no longer drop hearts. · Changes all boss AIs and some enemy AIs. · Increases the health and damage of all bosses.

Blood Relic.name: Blood Relic
Blood Relic.desc: The Blood Relic was a craftable Hardmode event-summoning item that summoned a Blood Moon when used during the night. Using it during the day or while a Blood Moon was already occurring would do nothing.
Blood Relic.tip: Summons a blood moon · Not consumable

Blood Rune.name: Blood Rune
Blood Rune.desc: Blood Runes are post-Moon Lord ammunition that are sold by the Archmage for 1 gold each while the Ice Barrage is in the player's inventory. They are consumed by the Ice Barrage as ammunition.
Blood Rune.tip: Used by the Ice Barrage · 'Found in some sort of runic landscape'

Blood Sample.name: Blood Sample
Blood Sample.desc: Blood Samples were Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by The Perforators. They were used in the crafting of equipment dropped by The Perforators and the Bloody Worm Food.

Bloodletting Essence.name: Bloodletting Essence
Bloodletting Essence.desc: Bloodletting Essences were Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Face Monsters and Herplings in The Crimson. They were used to craft the Blood Relic, Vicious Tonic and Guide Voodoo Doll. They were the Crimson counterpart to Fetid Essences.

Bloody Edge.name: Bloody Edge
Bloody Edge.desc: The Bloody Edge was a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. It was the Crimson variant of the Night's Edge and used the same crafting recipes. Upon striking enemies, the player had a 50% chance to recover 2 to 3 HP.
Bloody Edge.tip: Chance to heal the player on enemy hits · Inflicts Burning Blood

Bloody Rupture.name: Bloody Rupture
Bloody Rupture.desc: The Bloody Rupture was a craftable Pre-Hardmode shortsword that was also dropped by The Perforators. Upon killing an enemy with it, it would release orbs of blood that homed in on enemies, and upon impact, healed the player for 2 health.
Bloody Rupture.tip: Enemies release homing blood orbs on death

Bookcases.name: Bookcases
Bookcases.desc: Bookcases are craftable furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of bookcases to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Boss Health Bar.name: Boss Health Bar
Boss Health Bar.desc: The Calamity Mod adds a custom boss health bar that can be toggled via the settings menu. When enabled, this will replace the vanilla boss health bar.

Bottled Panacea.name: Bottled Panacea
Bottled Panacea.desc: The Bottled Panacea is an unobtainable potion that removes all sickness and electricity debuffs upon use.
Bottled Panacea.tip: Cures you of all sickness and electricity debuffs when consumed · This has a 30 second cooldown

Bouncing Betty.name: Bouncing Betty
Bouncing Betty.desc: Bouncing Betties were consumable rogue bombs sold by the Bandit for 4 silver after defeating any Mechanical Boss. They threw an explosive grenade that bounced off of enemies twice, exploding with each bounce.
Bouncing Betty.tip: Throws a grenade which bounces after exploding · Stealth strikes explode into a violent blast of fire and shrapnel when it bounces

Bouncy Spiky Ball.name: Bouncy Spiky Ball
Bouncy Spiky Ball.desc: Bouncy Spiky Balls were craftable Pre-Hardmode consumable spiky balls. They threw gravity-affected spiky balls that bounced off solid blocks. When a ball hit an enemy, it ricochetted to other nearby enemies and gained a multiplicative boost of 1.1x per enemy hit.
Bouncy Spiky Ball.tip: Throws a very bouncy ball that ricochets off walls and enemies · Receives a small boost in damage and velocity after bouncing off an enemy · Stealth strikes throw four at once

Brimlash Buster.name: Brimlash Buster
Brimlash Buster.desc: The Brimlash Buster was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. It was an upgraded version of the Brimlash.
Brimlash Buster.tip: 50% chance to do triple damage on enemy hits · Fires a brimstone bolt that explodes into more bolts on death

Brimstone Fish.name: Brimstone Fish
Brimstone Fish.desc: The Brimstone Fish was a fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag with a variable chance.

Brimstone Flameblaster.name: Brimstone Flameblaster
Brimstone Flameblaster.desc: The Brimstone Flameblaster was a Hardmode flamethrower that was dropped by the Cataclysmic Construct. When used, it fired a brimstone ball that bounced off of tiles, ricocheting up to five times before dissipating.

Brimstone Key.name: Brimstone Key
Brimstone Key.desc: The Brimstone Key was an unobtainable item. It had no purpose when it was removed.

Brimstone Lava Fountain.name: Brimstone Lava Fountain
Brimstone Lava Fountain.desc: The Brimstone Lava Fountain is furniture item that is sold by the Witch Doctor for 4 gold. Similarly to water fountains, when activated via right-click or through wiring, it changes the color of all nearby lava to a mode=image pink color like the lava in the Brimstone Crag.

Burden Breaker.name: Burden Breaker
Burden Breaker.desc: The Burden Breaker was a Hardmode Legendary accessory that was dropped by Skeletron Prime in Malice Mode.
Burden Breaker.tip: The good time · Go fast · WARNING: May have disastrous results · Increases horizontal movement speed beyond comprehension · Does not work while a boss is alive

Cadance Potion.name: Cadance Potion
Cadance Potion.desc: The Cadance Potion was a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it granted the player the Cadance's Grace buff, which provided the following effects:
Cadance Potion.tip: Gives the cadance buff which increases life regen and heart pickup range · Increases max life by 25% · While this potion's buff is active, Regeneration Potion and Lifeforce Potion buffs are disabled

Calamity Canvas.name: Calamity Canvas
Calamity Canvas.desc: The Calamity Canvases are paintings sold by the Painter. When right clicked, a UI appears displaying a large image filled with various smaller drawings, which has the following controls:
Calamity Canvas.tip: Right Click when placed to open a UI which allows customizing the focus of the painting · Left Click to make the focus follow the cursor, Left Click again to set it · Arrow keys can also be used to manually adjust the focus point · The scroll wheel zooms the focus in and out · Hold Left Shift to hide the UI without closing it

Calamity Spawner.name: Calamity Spawner
Calamity Spawner.desc: The Calamity Spawner was a Hardmode item used to generate the Calamity Biome and all of the mod's ores into the world.
Calamity Spawner.tip: Only use if you don't have the Calamity biome in your world · Don't panic if your game freezes, you need to wait while the biome generates · Spawns all 5 Calamity ores as well

Carnage Ray.name: Carnage Ray
Carnage Ray.desc: The Carnage Ray was a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it created a red particle beam which dealt much more damage the farther away the enemy was from the player, up to a maximum of 3x its base damage. It was the Crimson counterpart to the Night's Ray.
Carnage Ray.tip: Fires a wretched, bloody ray · The farther along the ray hit enemies are, the more damage they take

Catastrophe Claymore.name: Catastrophe Claymore
Catastrophe Claymore.desc: The Catastrophe Claymore was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. When swung, it fired one of three bolts with various colors: red, blue, or yellow, which all inflicted various debuffs depending on their color.
Catastrophe Claymore.tip: Fires sparkles which inflict Frostbite, Hellfire, or Ichor

Chairs.name: Chairs
Chairs.desc: Chairs are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds nineteen types of chairs to the game, with eighteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture. Like vanilla chairs, players can sit on chairs by right-clicking on them.

Chaos Serpent Shard.name: Chaos Serpent Shard
Chaos Serpent Shard.desc: Chaos Serpent Shards were Hardmode crafting materials crafted using Twisted Tendrils and Living Shards. They were solely used to make Scoria Bars, then called Cruptix Bars.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.desc: Charge is a mechanic implemented by Seeking Mechanisms. Items that use this mechanic will display remaining charge in their tooltips. For these items, charge is required and also depleted when used, similarly to ammunition.

Charged Dart Blaster.name: Charged Dart Blaster
Charged Dart Blaster.desc: The Charged Dart Blaster was a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that was a direct upgrade to the Dart Rifle/Dart Pistol. When used, it fired an energy dart that travelled very fast and split into other darts when hitting an enemy or a block alongside a spread of 2 to 4 darts.
Charged Dart Blaster.tip: Fires a shotgun spread of darts and a splitting energy blast · Right Click to fire a more powerful exploding energy blast that bounces

Charger Test Item.name: Charger Test Item
Charger Test Item.desc: The Charger Test Item was an unobtainable tool. When used, it automatically filled the charge of all Draedon's Arsenal items in the player's inventory.
Charger Test Item.tip: Testing/Cheat Item · Charges all Draedon's Arsenal weapons in your inventory.

Charred Lasher.name: Charred Lasher
Charred Lasher.desc: The Charred Lasher is a very rare fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag. Its only use is to be sold for a fair amount of money.
Charred Lasher.tip: This elusive fish is a prized commodity

Cirrus Couch.name: Cirrus Couch
Cirrus Couch.desc: The Cirrus Couch was a Hardmode sofa that was sold by the Drunk Princess for 25 gold if she was happy enough and while the Stylist and Zoologist were both alive. Like vanilla sofas, players could sit on the Cirrus Couch by right-clicking on it.

Cirrus' Dress.name: Cirrus' Dress
Cirrus' Dress.desc: Cirrus' Dress was a Hardmode armor chest piece that was sold by the Stylist for 2 platinum 80 gold if the player had the Alcohol Poisoning debuff while the Drunk Princess was alive. It granted the following effects while equipped:
Cirrus' Dress.tip: 5% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · 20% decreased movement speed and increases maximum fall speed to 61 mph · Allows for drinking 5 alcohols before your liver is poisoned · 'Here, this should help you drink a lot more than usual!' · 'You feel thick...'

Cloaking Gland.name: Cloaking Gland
Cloaking Gland.desc: The Cloaking Gland was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped by several aquatic cloaking enemies. It was solely used to craft Anechoic Coating.

Clock Gatlignum.name: Clock Gatlignum
Clock Gatlignum.desc: The Clock Gatlignum was a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it converted Musket Balls into High Velocity Bullets and fired them in 3-round bursts (with each bullet fired having a use time of 3). It had a 33% chance to not consume ammo.
Clock Gatlignum.tip: Converts musket balls into strings of 3 high velocity bullets · 33% chance to save ammo

Coco's Feather.name: Coco's Feather
Coco's Feather.desc: The Coco's Feather was a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transformed the user. It was rarely dropped by Harpies at a 0.1% chance.

Conclave Crossfire.name: Conclave Crossfire
Conclave Crossfire.desc: The Conclave Crossfire was a craftable Hardmode gun that was a direct upgrade to the Tactical Shotgun. When used, it fired two shotgun blasts; one was fired from the gun itself while the other rained from the sky towards the cursor.
Conclave Crossfire.tip: 50% chance to not consume ammo · Fires two spreads of bullets, one from the gun and one from the sky

Coral Cannon.name: Coral Cannon
Coral Cannon.desc: The Coral Cannon was a Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that was sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it fired a small piece of coral that did not consume any ammo.
Coral Cannon.tip: Has a 20% chance to shoot a big coral that stuns enemies · Does not consume ammo

Core of Eleum.name: Core of Eleum
Core of Eleum.desc: Cores of Eleum were craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted from Essences of Eleum and Ectoplasm at a Hardmode Anvil.

Core of Havoc.name: Core of Havoc
Core of Havoc.desc: Cores of Havoc were craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted from Essences of Havoc and Ectoplasm at a Hardmode Anvil.

Core of Sunlight.name: Core of Sunlight
Core of Sunlight.desc: Cores of Sunlight were craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted from Essences of Sunlight and Ectoplasm at a Hardmode Anvil.

Corrupted Crusher Blade.name: Corrupted Crusher Blade
Corrupted Crusher Blade.desc: The Corrupted Crusher Blade was a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it emitted glowing purple particles and inflicted the Cursed Inferno debuff upon striking enemies.
Corrupted Crusher Blade.tip: Inflicts cursed inferno and critical hits reduce enemy defense by 10

Crates.name: Crates
