Crates.desc: Crates are grab bag-type items which can be hooked while fishing, containing random loot. The Calamity Mod currently adds eight new crates and adds loot to vanilla crates.

Crimsaber.name: Crimsaber
Crimsaber.desc: The Crimsaber was a craftable Hardmode broadsword. Upon striking an enemy, it inflicted the Ichor debuff and many streams of ichor would rain from the sky towards the player's cursor.
Crimsaber.tip: A sword fused with the blood of the gods

Crimslime Staff.name: Crimslime Staff
Crimslime Staff.desc: The Crimslime Staff was a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that was dropped by The Slime God. When used, it summoned a Crimslime minion that followed the player and attacked enemies by jumping around, dealing contact damage similarly to the Slime Staff.
Crimslime Staff.tip: Summons a crim slime to fight for you

Crimson Crusher Blade.name: Crimson Crusher Blade
Crimson Crusher Blade.desc: The Crimson Crusher Blade was a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it emitted faint blood particles and inflicted the Ichor debuff upon striking enemies. While no bosses were alive, critical strikes caused by this weapon reduced the target's base contact damage by 5.
Crimson Crusher Blade.tip: Inflicts ichor and critical hits lower enemy contact damage

Cryophobia.name: Cryophobia
Cryophobia.desc: Cryophobia is a Hardmode magic gun that is sold by the Archmage for 35 gold after defeating all the mechanical bosses. When used, it fires a light blue growing wave that splits into 3 twice, for 9 final waves.
Cryophobia.tip: Fires an icy wave that splits multiple times and explodes into shards · 'Chill'

Crystal Blade.name: Crystal Blade
Crystal Blade.desc: The Crystal Blade was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung and was also dropped by Crystal Crawlers. When swung, it fired a slow-moving projectile consisting of colorful particles.
Crystal Blade.tip: Fires slow-moving clouds of crystal dust

Crystal Flare Staff.name: Crystal Flare Staff
Crystal Flare Staff.desc: The Crystal Flare Staff was a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fired two frost flames that gradually faded in, which exploded on contact with anything, producing a large, blue explosion.
Crystal Flare Staff.tip: Fires blue frost flames that explode

Crystal Heart Vodka.name: Crystal Heart Vodka
Crystal Heart Vodka.desc: The Crystal Heart Vodka was a developer vanity accessory which transformed the user. It was obtained from throwing a Purple Haze into shimmer.

Crystallite.name: Crystallite
Crystallite.desc: Crystallite was a Hardmode crafting material crafted using Starblight Soot and Crystal Shards. It was solely used to make Cryonic Bars and Devastation.

Daylight (tool).name: Daylight (tool)
Daylight (tool).desc: The Daylight was a Hardmode tool and the counterpart to Moonlight, moving the clock to day when it was night, "summoning" the sun. It could only be used during the night.

Deepcore GK2.name: Deepcore GK2
Deepcore GK2.desc: The Deepcore GK2 is a Hardmode gun that is sold by the Demolitionist for 20 gold after any Mechanical Boss has been defeated. It rapidly fires bullets which are twice as large with an innate 10 armor penetration.
Deepcore GK2.tip: Bullets are twice as large and ignore 10 points of enemy defense · 'For rock and stone!'

Defiled Feather.name: Defiled Feather
Defiled Feather.desc: The Defiled Feather was a craftable item that when favorited, would prevent Wings from working. It was obtained from opening a Starter Bag or by crafting it at a Demon Altar or Crimson Altar.
Defiled Feather.tip: It's a long way down from a mountain... · Favorite this item to disable wings.

Demon Trophy.name: Demon Trophy
Demon Trophy.desc: The Demon Trophy was a Hardmode permanent power-up that was dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it increased enemy spawn rates in the current world by 33.33% and was not reversible after used. It could only be consumed once.
Demon Trophy.tip: Boosts spawn rate by 1.25 times · Effects cannot be reversed

Demonic Bone Ash.name: Demonic Bone Ash
Demonic Bone Ash.desc: Demonic Bone Ash was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by most enemies in The Underworld. It was used in the crafting of the Archaic Powder, Demon Conch, Devil's Sunrise, The Etomer, Slagsplitter Pauldron and Zerg Potions.

Demonic Pitchfork.name: Demonic Pitchfork
Demonic Pitchfork.desc: The Demonic Pitchfork was a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fired a demonic pitchfork that could pierce twice.

Desert Feather.name: Desert Feather
Desert Feather.desc: Desert Feathers were Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Vultures in the Desert. They were used to craft some weapons, the Desert Prowler armor set, and the Sandstorm in a Bottle.

Determination Breaker.name: Determination Breaker
Determination Breaker.desc: The Determination Breaker was a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it removed the player's immunity frames and any contact to Lava would instantly kill the player.
Determination Breaker.tip: The bad time · Removes immunity frames · If you want a crazy challenge, equip this · Touching lava kills you instantly

Devastation.name: Devastation
Devastation.desc: The Devastation was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswung and was the direct upgrade to the Catastrophe Claymore. When swung, it fired one of three galaxy beams with various colors: red, blue, or purple, which all inflicted various debuffs depending on their color.

Diamond Dust.name: Diamond Dust
Diamond Dust.desc: Diamond Dust was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material. It was solely used to make the Blizzard in a Bottle, Cloud in a Bottle, and Sandstorm in a Bottle.

Diseased Pike.name: Diseased Pike
Diseased Pike.desc: The Diseased Pike was a Hardmode spear that was dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. Hitting enemies with the spear fired plague seekers that homed in on enemies and dealt additional damage. The plague seekers dealt 75% of the weapon's damage.

Disenchanted Aerialite Ore.name: Disenchanted Aerialite Ore
Disenchanted Aerialite Ore.desc: Disenchanted Aerialite Ore is a Pre-Hardmode ore which generates inside of Clouds on Floating Islands upon world generation.

Disgusting Meat.name: Disgusting Meat
Disgusting Meat.desc: The Disgusting Meat is a pre-Hardmode item dropped by Horrible Hog.
Disgusting Meat.tip: Left Click will remove health and mana upgrades, use with no Calamity upgrades to remove vanilla upgrades · Right Click will remove Rage and Adrenaline upgrades, plus other miscellaneous boosters such as Demon Heart · Removed boosters will be vomited out of you as items

Disgusting Slop.name: Disgusting Slop
Disgusting Slop.desc: Disgusting Slop is a consumable item that drops from the Gluttony Blender. Its only use is being converted by the Extractinator and Chlorophyte Extractinator.

Disseminator.name: Disseminator
Disseminator.desc: The Disseminator was a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that was a direct upgrade to the Conference Call. When used, it shot a tight spread of four bullets with tripled velocity.
Disseminator.tip: Fires a tight spread of bullets that call a great number of bullets from the sky · 50% chance to save ammo · @everyone

Divine Retribution.name: Divine Retribution
Divine Retribution.desc: Divine Retribution was a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that was a direct upgrade to Undine's Retribution. When used, it spawned 5 divine spears from below the screen that quickly homed in on nearby enemies. The spears could pass through tiles but could not pierce.
Divine Retribution.tip: Mage is superior to rogue; look, we got a donor weapon to prove it!

Dodu's Handcannon.name: Dodu's Handcannon
Dodu's Handcannon.desc: Dodu's Handcannon was a craftable post-Moon Lord gun. When used, it converted all bullets into fast peanut shells which exploded on contact with enemies or tiles.
Dodu's Handcannon.tip: Fires high explosive peanut shells, literally · 'The power of the nut rests in your hands'

Draconic Elixir.name: Draconic Elixir
Draconic Elixir.desc: The Draconic Elixir was a craftable post-Moon Lord buff potion. Upon consumption it granted the Draconic Surge buff which increased the flight time of Wings by 20% and increased horizontal flight speed and acceleration by 10%.
Draconic Elixir.tip: Greatly increases wing flight time and speed and increases defense by 16 · Silva invincibility heals you to half HP when triggered · If you trigger the above heal you cannot drink this potion again for 60 seconds and you gain 30 seconds of potion sickness

Draedon's Remote.name: Draedon's Remote
Draedon's Remote.desc: Draedon's Remote was a non-consumable Hardmode summoning item that was dropped by Armored Diggers. While in the player's inventory, Armored Digger spawn rate was reduced by 0.2x. When used at night, it would summon all three Mechanical Bosses at once.

Dragon Scales.name: Dragon Scales
Dragon Scales.desc: Dragon Scales are a post-Moon Lord rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 15 platinum after Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Dragon Scales.tip: Rogue projectiles spawn slow fireballs as they travel · Stealth strikes create infernados where they hit · +10% max run speed and acceleration · Grants immunity to Dragonfire · 'Only a living dragon holds true treasure'

Dragoon Drizzlefish.name: Dragoon Drizzlefish
Dragoon Drizzlefish.desc: The Dragoon Drizzlefish is a Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that is rarely fished up in the Brimstone Crag. It does not consume ammunition. When used, it fires one of two flame projectiles:
Dragoon Drizzlefish.tip: Fires an assortment of hellfire and brimstone fireballs · Sometimes fires a larger splitting fireball · The brimstone sac appears to contain fuel · 'Revenge is a dish best served flaming hot'
stats: 1 second (Main Red Fireball) / 0.5 seconds (Split Red Fireball)
2 seconds (Main Orange Fireball) / 1 second (Split Orange Fireball)

Dualpoon.name: Dualpoon
Dualpoon.desc: The Dualpoon was a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that was a direct upgrade to the Harpoon. When used, it fired two harpoons that were unaffected by gravity. The harpoons traveled for a short range before returning to the player.

Ectoblood.name: Ectoblood
Ectoblood.desc: Ectoblood was a Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by various enemies in the post-Plantera Dungeon. Its sole purpose was to craft Ectoplasm.

Enchanted Metal.name: Enchanted Metal
Enchanted Metal.desc: Enchanted Metal was a Hardmode crafting material sold by the Archmage NPC. It was used as an alternative to craft the summoning items for the Mechanical Bosses.

Enchantment.name: Enchantment
Enchantment.desc: Enchanting is a game mechanic unlocked after defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, which allows the player to apply enchantments to their items, granting them unique additional qualities.

Energy Orb.name: Energy Orb
Energy Orb.desc: The Energy Orb was a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Golem. It was solely used to make Uelibloom Bars and Tarragon Wings.

Enhanced Nano Round.name: Enhanced Nano Round
Enhanced Nano Round.desc: Enhanced Nano Rounds were craftable Hardmode bullets. They inflicted the Confused debuff on contact, and when killing an enemy, they released 2 homing nanomachines that dealt 30% damage of the bullet's damage.
Enhanced Nano Round.tip: Confuses enemies and releases a cloud of nanites when enemies die

Eternal Blizzard.name: Eternal Blizzard
Eternal Blizzard.desc: The Eternal Blizzard is a Hardmode repeater that is sold by the Archmage for 60 gold after defeating all three minibosses in the Frost Moon event.
Eternal Blizzard.tip: Fires an additional icicle arrow that freezes into a falling icicle

Ethereal Extorter.name: Ethereal Extorter
Ethereal Extorter.desc: The Ethereal Extorter is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 1 platinum after Golem has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Ethereal Extorter.tip: Rogue projectiles explode into homing souls on hit · 8% increased rogue damage and +5 maximum stealth

Eutrophic Scimitar.name: Eutrophic Scimitar
Eutrophic Scimitar.desc: The Eutrophic Scimitar was a Hardmode broadsword that was dropped by the Blinded Angler. When swung, it fired 2 electric shock projectiles which inflicted the Eutrophication debuff. The projectiles dealt 70% of the weapon's damage and did not pierce or pass through tiles.
Eutrophic Scimitar.tip: Fires two beams that stun enemies

Eutrophic Shank.name: Eutrophic Shank
Eutrophic Shank.desc: The Eutrophic Shank was a Pre-Hardmode shortsword that was dropped by Eutrophic Rays with a 1/3 (33.33%) chance after the Desert Scourge has been defeated. When used, it fired electrical sparks which lingered on the ground and dealt 40% of the weapon's base damage.

Evil Smasher.name: Evil Smasher
Evil Smasher.desc: The Evil Smasher is a Hardmode all-class weapon that is obtained by sacrificing a Pwnhammer to certain Demon or Crimson Altars. Holding Left Click charges up the hammer for a powerful overhead swing when the button is released.
Evil Smasher.tip: Channels a powerful hammer strike with the capability to crush all evil · Striking a tile with the hammer strike will cause an explosion and push you back · Striking enemies inflicts Smashed Evil on both the user and target · Charging strikes increases damage, explosion radius, and Smashed Evil duration · 'EViL! sMaSH eVIl! SmAsh... ER!'

Excalibur Shortsword.name: Excalibur Shortsword
Excalibur Shortsword.desc: The Excalibur Shortsword was a craftable Hardmode shortsword that autoswung. It emitted light with a sparkle effect when swung.
Excalibur Shortsword.tip: Don't underestimate the power of shortswords

Exo Gladius.name: Exo Gladius
Exo Gladius.desc: The Exo Gladius was a craftable post-Moon Lord shortsword that autoswung. It was the final upgrade to the Night's Stabber. When swung, it autofired rainbow orbs that travelled through tiles and homed in on enemies.
Exo Gladius.tip: Do not underestimate the power of Exoblade`s younger brother · Striking an enemy with the blade makes you immune for a short time and summons comets from the sky · Fires a rainbow orb that summons sword beams on hit

Explosive Shotgun Shell.name: Explosive Shotgun Shell
Explosive Shotgun Shell.desc: Explosive Shotgun Shells were Hardmode ammunition that were used exclusively by the Hydra. They could be purchased from the Arms Dealer if the Hydra was in the player's inventory.

Fetid Essence.name: Fetid Essence
Fetid Essence.desc: Fetid Essences were Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Devourers and World Feeders in The Corruption. They were used to craft the Blood Relic, Guide Voodoo Doll, and the Unholy Tonic. They were the Corruption counterpart to Bloodletting Essences.

Field Generator.name: Field Generator
Field Generator.desc: The Field Generator was a background object that generated naturally in Arsenal Labs. It fired symmetrical 8-way patterned lasers in addition to singular lasers periodically at players who entered a 60-tile radius around it. The lasers dealt 54 damage.

Fish of Flight.name: Fish of Flight
Fish of Flight.desc: The Fish of Flight is a Hardmode grab bag-type fish that can be caught in Space. When opened, the player will receive between 2 to 5 Souls of Flight.
Fish of Flight.tip: Press Right Click to extract Soul of Flight souls

Fish of Light.name: Fish of Light
Fish of Light.desc: The Fish of Light was a Hardmode grab bag-type fish that could be caught in the Underground Hallow. When opened, the player would receive between 2 to 5 Souls of Light.
Fish of Light.tip: Press Right Click to extract souls

Fish of Night.name: Fish of Night
Fish of Night.desc: The Fish of Night was a Hardmode grab bag-type fish that could be caught in the Underground Corruption or Underground Crimson. When opened, the player would receive between 2 to 5 Souls of Night.
Fish of Night.tip: Press Right Click to extract souls

Fish Stocks.name: Fish Stocks
Fish Stocks.desc: The Fish Stocks is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 7 gold 77 silver. While equipped, a display of the fish stocks chart appears at the top of the screen.
Fish Stocks.tip: Pulls up a view of the fish stocks · Provides stats that are multiplied by the state of fish stocks · When unequipped, the effects will only be disabled once stocks are even or higher

Flameburst Shortsword.name: Flameburst Shortsword
Flameburst Shortsword.desc: The Flameburst Shortsword was a craftable Pre-Hardmode shortsword. When hitting an enemy, it would cause a small explosion that inflicted the On Fire! debuff.

Flight Time Bar.name: Flight Time Bar
Flight Time Bar.desc: The Flight Time Bar is a mechanic added by the Calamity Mod. The Flight Time Bar displays a percentage of how much flight time is currently remaining on certain equipment that supports flight.

Forgiveness.name: Forgiveness
Forgiveness.desc: Forgiveness is a painting that can be purchased from the Princess for 15 gold when the Brimstone Witch is present.

Frigid Bar.name: Frigid Bar
Frigid Bar.desc: Frigid Bars were Hardmode bars dropped by Cryogen. They were used to make various ice-themed items.

Frigid Bulwark.name: Frigid Bulwark
Frigid Bulwark.desc: The Frigid Bulwark was a craftable Hardmode shield accessory and a direct upgrade to the Frozen Turtle Shell and the Paladin's Shield. It granted the following effects while equipped:
Frigid Bulwark.tip: Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team · Only active above 25% life · Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage · The shell becomes more powerful when below 15% life and reduces damage even further

Frostspark Bullet.name: Frostspark Bullet
Frostspark Bullet.desc: Frostspark Bullets were craftable Hardmode bullets. They inflicted the following debuffs:
Frostspark Bullet.tip: Has a chance to freeze enemies and explode into electricity · Enemies that are immune to being frozen take more damage from these bullets

Frosty Flare.name: Frosty Flare
Frosty Flare.desc: The Frosty Flare is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is sold by the Archmage for 35 gold after defeating all the Mechanical Bosses. When thrown, icicle shards rain down from the sky around the flare which each deal 75% damage.
Frosty Flare.tip: Throw a flare that sticks to enemies and rains a hailstorm on them · Stealth strikes summon phantom copies instead of ice shards · 'Do not insert in flare gun'

Frozen Cube.name: Frozen Cube
Frozen Cube.desc: Frozen Cube is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be obtained from the Frozen Chest found in the Ice biome shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 15 gold during a Waxing Crescent after the item has been found. When equipped, it summons an elephant on top of the player's head.
Frozen Cube.tip: A frozen block of ice with something inside · Summons an Elumphant to sit atop your head and protect you · The Elumphant will cycle between shooting cold air that inflicts Wind Chilled, and headbutting enemies · Elumphant's headbutts only target enemies inflicted with Wind Chilled · Reduces your defense by 33%, but uses that defense to boost the Elumphant's power and your cold debuff damage · Equip this accessory to view its statistics · 'What I wanna know is, where's the mammoth?'

Fulguration Halberd.name: Fulguration Halberd
Fulguration Halberd.desc: The Fulguration Halberd was a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that autoswung. When used, it could be swung both as a broadsword and a spear by pressing left and right click respectively. It would inflict Burning Blood on each successful hit.
Fulguration Halberd.tip: Inflicts burning blood on enemy hits · Right click to use as a spear

Fungal Carapace.name: Fungal Carapace
Fungal Carapace.desc: The Fungal Carapace was a Pre-Hardmode accessory that was dropped by the Anomura Fungus. When equipped, it provided 6 defense. When the player was hurt, 4 floating mushroom spores spawned in random positions around them, which exploded after 5 seconds, dealing 70 damage.
Fungal Carapace.tip: You emit a mushroom spore explosion when you are hit

Fungal Symbiote.name: Fungal Symbiote
Fungal Symbiote.desc: The Fungal Symbiote is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtained from the Glowing Mushroom biome shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 15 gold during a Waning Crescent after the item has been found. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Fungal Symbiote.tip: You grow mushrooms on the grass beneath you · Consuming mushrooms provides Mushy, granting 3 defense and +1 HP/s life regen · 10% increased damage while you have Mushy

Galactica Singularity.name: Galactica Singularity
Galactica Singularity.desc: Galactica Singularities were craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted with Lunar Fragments. They were used to craft various post-Moon Lord items.

Gehenna.name: Gehenna
Gehenna.desc: Gehenna was a Hardmode accessory that was dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When equipped, it occasionally caused fireballs to fall from the sky.
Gehenna.tip: Drops brimstone fireballs from the sky occasionally

Giant Plantera Bulb.name: Giant Plantera Bulb
Giant Plantera Bulb.desc: Giant Plantera Bulbs are background objects that are found in the Vernal Pass, growing on top of Vernal Soil. These bulbs are initially green and indestructible in Pre-Hardmode, blooming and turning pink once the Wall of Flesh is defeated.

Glacial Crusher.name: Glacial Crusher
Glacial Crusher.desc: The Glacial Crusher was a Hardmode broadsword that was dropped by Cryogen. When swung, it fired a slow, icy projectile that did not pierce and inflicted the Glacial State debuff. Enemies affected by Glacial State would take twice the amount of damage from the sword.
Glacial Crusher.tip: Fires slow frost projectiles that freeze enemies · True melee strikes cause tremendous damage to frozen enemies

Glimmering Gemfish.name: Glimmering Gemfish
Glimmering Gemfish.desc: The Glimmering Gemfish is a grab bag-type fish that can be caught in the cavern layer at a 6.67% chance. When opened, the player will receive between 1 to 3 various gems.
Glimmering Gemfish.tip: Press Right Click to extract gems

Glove of Recklessness.name: Glove of Recklessness
Glove of Recklessness.desc: The Glove of Recklessness is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Glove of Recklessness.tip: Increases rogue attack speed by 15%, but decreases damage by 10% and crit by 5% · 15% increased stealth regeneration · Makes rogue weapons slightly inaccurate

Gluttony Blender.name: Gluttony Blender
Gluttony Blender.desc: Gluttony Blender is a furniture item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold. Pressing Left Click on the tile while holding a food item consumes it and throws it onto the blender. After two seconds, either Quality Slop or Disgusting Slop drops.
Gluttony Blender.tip: A strange industrial contraption which appears to process food · Has the potential to turn food into something more nutritious... maybe

Golden Gun.name: Golden Gun
Golden Gun.desc: The Golden Gun was a craftable Hardmode classless weapon. It functioned similarly to the Golden Shower, firing ichor projectiles that travelled in a straight line which were not affected by gravity and inflicted the Ichor debuff.
Golden Gun.tip: Shoots a straight line of pure ichor

Gorecodile.name: Gorecodile
Gorecodile.desc: The Gorecodile is a grab bag-type fish that can be caught on the Surface during a Blood Moon with a 6.67% chance. When opened, the player will receive between 5 to 15 Blood Orbs.
Gorecodile.tip: Press Right Click to extract blood orbs

Greenwave Loach.name: Greenwave Loach
Greenwave Loach.desc: The Greenwave Loach is a very rare fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea. Its only use is to be sold for a fair amount of money.
Greenwave Loach.tip: An endangered fish that is highly prized in the market

Grenade Shell.name: Grenade Shell
Grenade Shell.desc: Grenade Shells were Hardmode ammunition that were used exclusively by the Bazooka. They were sold by the Arms Dealer if the Bazooka was in the player's inventory.

Gypsy Powder.name: Gypsy Powder
Gypsy Powder.desc: The Gypsy Powder was a Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by Moths, and sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 gold after Golem was defeated.

Hadarian Membrane.name: Hadarian Membrane
Hadarian Membrane.desc: Hadarian Membranes were Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Hadarians after Astrum Aureus was defeated. They were used solely to craft Hadarian Wings.
Hadarian Membrane.tip: The membrane of an astral creature's wings

Hadopelagic Echo.name: Hadopelagic Echo
Hadopelagic Echo.desc: The Hadopelagic Echo was a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun that was a direct upgrade to the Eidolic Wail. When used, it fired a burst of four sound waves that could pierce infinitely and ricochet off of walls in quick succession.
Hadopelagic Echo.tip: Fires a string of bouncing sound waves that become stronger as they travel · Sound waves echo additional sound waves on enemy hits

Heart Rapier.name: Heart Rapier
Heart Rapier.desc: The Heart Rapier was a craftable Hardmode spear. Whenever it damaged an enemy, it healed the player for 5 HP.
Heart Rapier.tip: Heals the player on enemy hits

Hell Burst.name: Hell Burst
Hell Burst.desc: The Hell Burst was a craftable Hardmode wand that was a direct upgrade to the Crystal Vile Shard. When used, it fired out a consecutive chain of large fire spikes, which lingered for a second and inflicted the On Fire! debuff.

Hell's Sun.name: Hell's Sun
Hell's Sun.desc: The Hell's Sun was a post-Moon Lord rogue spiky ball. It automatically fired up to 10 spiky balls. The balls moved slowly and decelerated to a stop after travelling a short distance.
Hell's Sun.tip: Hurls up to 10 gravity-defying spiky balls · Once stationary, periodically emit small suns that explode on hit · Stealth strikes emit suns at a faster rate and last for a longer amount of time · Press Right Click to delete all existing spiky balls · 'The Subterranean Sun in the palm of your hand'

Holiday Halberd.name: Holiday Halberd
Holiday Halberd.desc: The Holiday Halberd was a Hardmode broadsword that was dropped by Present Mimics during the Frost Moon event.
Holiday Halberd.tip: idk I'm miserable with names · - The General · Fires red and green bouncing gift bags that emit clouds as they travel

Howl's Heart.name: Howl's Heart
Howl's Heart.desc: Howl's Heart is a Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Wizard for 20 gold. When equipped, it summons Howl, Calcifer and Turnip-Head to assist the player:
Howl's Heart.tip: Summons Howl to fight for you, Calcifer to light your way, and Turnip-Head to follow you around · Placing this accessory in vanity slots will summon the trio without the combat or exploration utilities

Icicle Trident.name: Icicle Trident
Icicle Trident.desc: The Icicle Trident is a Hardmode wand that is sold by the Archmage for 20 gold. When used, it fires a volley of three icicle shards that pierce once and spread out as they travel. The icicle shards inflict the Frostbite debuff.

Impaler.name: Impaler
Impaler.desc: The Impaler was a craftable Hardmode repeater that was a direct upgrade to the Stake Launcher. When used, it rapidly fired fire stakes with a 33.33% chance to fire an exploding stake instead.
Impaler.tip: Fires explosive and flaming stakes · Instantly kills vampires and vampire bats

IOU an item.name: IOU an item
IOU an item.desc: The IOU an item was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by the Siren and Leviathan in Pre-Hardmode in place of their regular drops. It could be crafted into any of the boss's weapons when combined with a Living Shard.
IOU an item.tip: Use to craft any Leviathan weapon you want · Combined with Living Shards from Plantera to get your item!

Iridescent Excalibur.name: Iridescent Excalibur
Iridescent Excalibur.desc: The Iridescent Excalibur was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that was the final upgrade to the Greatsword of Judgement.
Iridescent Excalibur.tip: True melee strikes freeze enemies · Fires rainbow beams that change their behavior based on their color · Press Right Click for true melee

Iron Ball.name: Iron Ball
Iron Ball.desc: The Iron Ball is a Pre-Hardmode pet summoning item which generates on top of Stone Blocks in the Cavern layer as a collectable ambient object. It summons an iron ball to follow the player.
Iron Ball.tip: Summons a living iron ball · Left Click the pet to pet it · Right Click the pet to have it sit on your shoulder

Iron Heart.name: Iron Heart
Iron Heart.desc: The Iron Heart was an item placed in a newly spawned player's inventory. Upon being used in Expert Mode, it enabled or disabled several effects on every character in the current world:
Iron Heart.tip: Healing with potions and all positive life regen is disabled. · Enemy damage scales with your max health. · Can be toggled on and off.

IV Drip on the Rocks.name: IV Drip on the Rocks
IV Drip on the Rocks.desc: The IV Drip on the Rocks is an accessory that is sold by the Bandit when the Nurse is present. It can copy the effect of any Alcohol by placing the Alcohol item on the same item slot. This effect can stack with the original Alcohol.
IV Drip on the Rocks.tip: Place an alcoholic beverage on this item in your inventory to pour its contents in · Filled with [NAME] · Inserted alcohols contribute toward alcohol poisoning · Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to empty its contents · '(drunken mumbling)'

Lantern Center.name: Lantern Center
Lantern Center.desc: The Lantern Center is a Hardmode mechanism furniture item that is sold by the Princess NPC for 20 gold. Pressing the Right Click key on a Lantern Center will toggle the Lantern Night event.
Lantern Center.tip: Lights up the night sky with celebratory lanterns

Latcher Mine.name: Latcher Mine
Latcher Mine.desc: Latcher Mines were Hardmode consumable rogue bombs that were sold by the Bandit for 3 silver each after defeating one of the Mechanical Bosses. They automatically threw tiny flat mines that stuck to enemies and detonated 3 seconds after latching onto them.
Latcher Mine.tip: Sticks to enemies on hit and detonates after 3 seconds · Breaks upon hitting blocks · Stealth Strike Effect: On explosion, fire and shrapnel are released · Stealth strike mines can stick to the ground and last much longer when doing so

Lazhar.name: Lazhar
Lazhar.desc: The Lazhar was a craftable Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Heat Ray. When used, it rapidly fired heat rays that created small explosions on enemy hits and did not pierce. The explosions dealt 50% of the weapon's damage and inflicted the Daybroken debuff.
Lazhar.tip: Fires a highly volatile concentrated solar beam

Lazinator.name: Lazinator
Lazinator.desc: The Lazinator was a craftable Hardmode magic gun. When used, it automatically rapidly fired a straight, gravity-defying purple or green laser projectile. Green lasers were very slightly shorter and slower than purple ones.

Lead Core.name: Lead Core
Lead Core.desc: The Lead Core was a Hardmode accessory that was dropped by Irradiated Slimes and Gamma Slimes during the Acid Rain event. When equipped, it provided immunity to the Irradiated debuff. It was used in the crafting of the Daawnlight Spirit Origin.
Lead Core.tip: Grants immunity to the irradiated debuff

Lead Wizard.name: Lead Wizard
Lead Wizard.desc: The Lead Wizard was a Hardmode gun that was dropped by Golem in Malice Mode. When fired, bullets were transformed into yellow high-velocity bullets that shoot out from the gun at angles above and below the cursor's position forming roughly a 30-degree angle.
Lead Wizard.tip: Something's not right... · 33% chance to not consume ammo

Leeching Dagger.name: Leeching Dagger
Leeching Dagger.desc: The Leeching Dagger was a craftable Pre-Hardmode shortsword that was also dropped by The Hive Mind. Upon hitting an enemy with it, it would release leech orbs that homed in on enemies, and upon impact, healed the player for 2 health.
Leeching Dagger.tip: Enemies release homing leech orbs on hit

Level Meters.name: Level Meters
Level Meters.desc: Level Meters were accessories that were sold by the Goblin Tinkerer for 5 gold. When equipped, they told the player their current levels of proficiency with a certain class, as well as the exact stats gained depending on the class.
Level Meters.tip: Tells you how high your [CLASS] proficiency is · While equipped you will gain [CLASS] proficiency faster

Lightning Hawk.name: Lightning Hawk
Lightning Hawk.desc: The Lightning Hawk was a craftable Hardmode classless weapon that was a direct upgrade to the Magnum. When used, it fired a bullet similar to a High Velocity Bullet that did not pierce. 1.33% of the target's health was added to the damage of each bullet.
Lightning Hawk.tip: Uses Magnum Rounds · Can be used thrice per boss battle

Lion Heart.name: Lion Heart
Lion Heart.desc: The Lion Heart is a post-Moon Lord true melee broadsword that is sold by the Cyborg for 1 platinum 75 gold after Polterghast has been defeated.
Lion Heart.tip: Summons an energy explosion on hit · Press Right Click to summon an energy shell for a few seconds that halves all damage sources · This has a 45 second cooldown

Living Dew Droplet.name: Living Dew Droplet
Living Dew Droplet.desc: Living Dew Droplets were Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by some Jungle enemies. They were solely used to make Everglade Spray and Ancient Feathers.

Living Fire Blocks.name: Living Fire Blocks
Living Fire Blocks.desc: Living Fire Blocks are craftable Hardmode furniture blocks that resemble small, animated flames and emit a faint light when placed. They deal no damage on contact and can be broken with any pickaxe. The Calamity Mod currently adds four types of Living Fire Blocks to the game.

Luci's set.name: Luci's set
Luci's set.desc: Luci's set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Luci's Hairstyle, Luci's Military Uniform, Luci's Boots, and Luci's Sight. Each piece can be bought from the Steampunker for 10 gold.

Lul.name: Lul
Lul.desc: lul was an unobtainable accessory. When equipped, the player would have taken no damage.
Lul.tip: Grants complete invulnerability to almost everything

Luxor's Gift.name: Luxor's Gift
Luxor's Gift.desc: Luxor's Gift is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtained from the Sandstone Chest found in the Underground Desert shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 15 gold during a Waning Gibbous after the item has been found.
Luxor's Gift.tip: Summons a scarab launcher that follows you closely · The scarab launcher fires different projectiles at enemies depending on what class the held weapon belongs to · Held item class is not updated when holding a tool · When not in use, the scarab will condense itself into a small orb of light

M1 Garand.name: M1 Garand
M1 Garand.desc: The M1 Garand is a Pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 20 gold after Skeletron has been defeated.
M1 Garand.tip: Converts bullets into.30-06 rounds which inherit the damage of the converted bullet · Fires 8 bullets before ejecting the rifle's cartridge · Bullets which ricochet off coins can ricochet off cartridges too · 'Mind your thumb'

Magic Scarf and Hat.name: Magic Scarf and Hat
Magic Scarf and Hat.desc: The Magic Scarf and Hat are a Hardmode developer accessory that are sold by the Archmage for 5 platinum. Equipping them grants the player the Popo buff, which transforms them into a snowman.
Magic Scarf and Hat.tip: Transforms the holder into a snowman · 'Don't let the demons steal your nose'

Magnum.name: Magnum
Magnum.desc: The Magnum was a craftable Pre-Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fired a bullet similar to a High Velocity Bullet which could not pierce. 1.33% of the target's health was added to the damage of each bullet.
Magnum.tip: Uses Magnum Rounds · Can be used thrice per boss battle

Magnum Round.name: Magnum Round
Magnum Round.desc: Magnum Rounds were Pre-Hardmode ammunition that were used by the Magnum, Lightning Hawk, and Elephant Killer.

Mandible Bow.name: Mandible Bow
Mandible Bow.desc: The Mandible Bow was a Pre-Hardmode bow that was dropped by Antlions, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers. When used, it fired arrows at a very high velocity.

Mandible Claws.name: Mandible Claws
Mandible Claws.desc: The Mandible Claws were a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that were dropped by Antlions, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers. They featured an extremely fast swing speed and very short range, functioned similarly to the Fetid Baghnakhs.

Maneater Bulb.name: Maneater Bulb
Maneater Bulb.desc: Maneater Bulbs were Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by Man Eaters. Additionally, it was possible to obtain 1-3 Maneater Bulbs from Jungle Crates at a 20% chance. They were used to craft the Living Dew and Portabulb.

Mariana.name: Mariana
Mariana.desc: The Mariana was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. After hitting an enemy, the enemy exploded into four or five bubbles that travelled for a long distance.
Mariana.tip: Tropical and deadly · Enemies explode into water orbs on hit

Marked Magnum.name: Marked Magnum
Marked Magnum.desc: The Marked Magnum was a Pre-Hardmode classless weapon which shot pink bullet-like projectiles, which got their damage multiplied by damage bonuses from all classes. The projectile inflicted the Marked for Death debuff to enemies, which reduced enemy damage reduction by 50%.
Marked Magnum.tip: Shots reduce enemy protection · This weapon scales with all your damage stats at once

Marnite Architect armor.name: Marnite Architect armor
Marnite Architect armor.desc: Marnite Architect armor is a craftable Pre-Hardmode builder armor set.

Marnite Bayonet.name: Marnite Bayonet
Marnite Bayonet.desc: The Marnite Bayonet was a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun that can be considered an earlier alternative to the Musket or The Undertaker. Upon use, it auto-fired bullets at an average rate.
Marnite Bayonet.tip: The gun damages enemies that touch it

Marnite Spear.name: Marnite Spear
Marnite Spear.desc: The Marnite Spear was a craftable Pre-Hardmode spear that autoswings.

Martian Distress Remote.name: Martian Distress Remote
Martian Distress Remote.desc: The Martian Distress Remote is a Hardmode event-summoning item that starts the Martian Madness event upon use. It is sold by the Cyborg for 50 gold after Golem has been defeated.

Masks.name: Masks
Masks.desc: Masks are vanity items that are dropped by most bosses added in the Calamity Mod. They are worn in the social head slot, like vanilla masks. Each boss has a 14.29% (1 in 7) chance to drop its own mask. The Calamity Mod currently adds 31 new masks.

Meld Construct.name: Meld Construct
Meld Construct.desc: Meld Constructs were Hardmode crafting materials that were crafted with Starblight Soot and Meld Blobs.

Mollusk armor.name: Mollusk armor
Mollusk armor.desc: Mollusk armor is a craftable Hardmode armor set crafted from Mollusk Husks and Sea Prisms.

Momentum Capacitor.name: Momentum Capacitor
Momentum Capacitor.desc: The Momentum Capacitor is a Hardmode tool that is sold by the Bandit for 50 gold after all three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated. When holding left-click, the player gains a random movement speed increase ranging from 1% to 7% every use, or 30% to 210% every second.
Momentum Capacitor.tip: While using the Momentum Capacitor, · your top speed will continuously and uncontrollably increase · This effect only works if there are no bosses alive

Monkey Darts.name: Monkey Darts
Monkey Darts.desc: Monkey Darts were consumable Hardmode daggers that were sold by the Bandit for 4 silver each after Plantera had been defeated. When used, they threw a gravity affected dart that pierced 5 times, and instantly broke upon contact with a block.
Monkey Darts.tip: Stealth strikes throw 3 bouncing darts at high speed · 'Perfect for popping'

Monoliths.name: Monoliths
Monoliths.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during certain bosses, biomes, or events.

Moonlight.name: Moonlight
Moonlight.desc: The Moonlight was a Hardmode tool and the counterpart to Daylight, moving the clock to night when it is day, "summoning" the moon. It could only be used during the day.

Murky Paste.name: Murky Paste
Murky Paste.desc: Murky Paste was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped by Arapaimas and Spiked Jungle Slimes. It was used to craft Bezoar, Honey Dew and the Portabulb.

Murky Sludge.name: Murky Sludge
Murky Sludge.desc: Murky Sludge was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by Mother Slimes, Corrupt Slimes and Crimslimes. It was used in the crafting of the Radiant Ooze accessory, Zerg Potions, and Sludge Splotches.

Nanodroid.name: Nanodroid
Nanodroid.desc: Nanodroids are critters found within Bio-center Labs. They act similarly to Fireflies, and solely exist for ambience. They come in four different variants that have different spawn conditions. Nanodroids can be caught with any type of Bug Net.

Night's Stabber.name: Night's Stabber
Night's Stabber.desc: The Night's Stabber was a craftable Pre-Hardmode shortsword. Upon hitting an enemy with it, the enemy would release a homing projectile.
Night's Stabber.tip: Don't underestimate the power of stabby knives · Enemies release homing dark energy on hit

Novae Slag.name: Novae Slag
Novae Slag.desc: Novae Slag is a Hardmode block which replaces Silt Blocks and Slush Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. Like its counterpart, it can be used in the Extractinator.

Nychthemeron.name: Nychthemeron
Nychthemeron.desc: The Nychthemeron was a craftable Hardmode spiky ball. It threw up to 10 gravity-ignoring spiky balls that decelerated over time. The spiky balls broke after hitting four enemies, contacting a solid block, recalling to the player, or completely stopping.
Nychthemeron.tip: Throws a spiky ball that ignores gravity and summons a pair of dark and light orbs that orbit the player · Once the spiky ball disappears the orbs will home in on the nearest target · Up to 10 spiky balls can exist at a time · Stealth strikes cause all spiky balls and orbs to be thrown at once · Press Right Click to recall all existing spiky balls

Old Hunter set.name: Old Hunter set
Old Hunter set.desc: Old Hunter set is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Old Hunter Hat, Old Hunter Shirt and Old Hunter Pants.
Old Hunter set.tip: 'Attire fashioned after the appearance of hunters from a faraway land'

Old Power Cell.name: Old Power Cell
Old Power Cell.desc: The Old Power Cell was a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summoned Golem. It could only be used in the Jungle Temple under certain conditions.
Old Power Cell.tip: Summons the Golem when used in the Jungle Temple · Enrages outside the Jungle Temple · Not consumable

Onyx Excavator Key.name: Onyx Excavator Key
Onyx Excavator Key.desc: The Onyx Excavator Key is a Pre-Hardmode mount summoning item that is obtained from the Cavern Bio-center Lab. When used, it summons an Onyx Excavator which acts similarly to the Basilisk summoned by the Ancient Horn but allows the player to drill through tiles.
Onyx Excavator Key.tip: Summons a rideable Onyx Drill mount · Hold Left Click to drill blocks while moving either horizontally or downwards · The drill's pickaxe power and mining speed copy the best pickaxe in your inventory · 'Irresponsibly destroying all the neat world generation and causing unchecked geological devastation? Splendid'

Ores.name: Ores
Ores.desc: Ores are crafting materials necessary for game progress. They usually must be crafted into bars, after which they can craft many essential tools, weapons, armor, and other items. Some items require raw ores themselves, most commonly potions.

Paintings.name: Paintings
Paintings.desc: Paintings are placeable furniture that can be placed on background walls. The Calamity Mod currently adds four new paintings.

Particle Accelerator.name: Particle Accelerator
Particle Accelerator.desc: The Particle Accelerator was a Hardmode crafting station that was used to craft "advanced" items. It counted as a Hardmode Forge and a Hardmode Anvil.

Penumbra Potion.name: Penumbra Potion
Penumbra Potion.desc: The Penumbra Potion was a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it granted the Penumbra buff, which increased the rate that rogue stealth builds by 10% while moving and 15% while standing still.
Penumbra Potion.tip: Rogue stealth generates 10% faster while moving and 15% faster while standing still

Phantom Lance.name: Phantom Lance
Phantom Lance.desc: Phantom Lances were craftable Hardmode javelins. They automatically threw spears that slowed down and faded away over time. Each spear left a trail of homing lost souls that dealt less damage the later they were released.
Phantom Lance.tip: Fires a spectral javelin that rapidly releases lost souls · Fades away and slows down over time · Lost souls released later deal less damage · Stealth strikes don't slow down and souls always deal full damage

Phoenix Blade.name: Phoenix Blade
Phoenix Blade.desc: The Phoenix Blade was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. Like the Breaker Blade, it had a very large range, but it also caused explosions and spawned healing orbs when killing enemies.
Phoenix Blade.tip: Enemies explode and emit healing flames on death

Plague Hive.name: Plague Hive
Plague Hive.desc: The Plague Hive was a Hardmode accessory. It granted the following effects while equipped:
Plague Hive.tip: All attacks inflict the Plague and grants immunity to the Plague · Releases bees when damaged that inflict the Plague · Projectiles spawn plague seekers on enemy hits
stats: 2, 4, or 6 seconds (On attack) / 5 seconds (Bees/Wasps) / 3 seconds (Plague Seekers)

Plague Keeper.name: Plague Keeper
Plague Keeper.desc: The Plague Keeper was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that was an upgrade to the Bee Keeper and Virulence. When swung, it released a large cloud of plague dust that went through tiles and could pierce infinitely, spawning 25 bees in its path.
Plague Keeper.tip: Fires a plague and bee cloud

Poison Pack.name: Poison Pack
Poison Pack.desc: The Poison Pack was a craftable Pre-Hardmode non-consumable spiky ball. It threw up to 3 gravity-affected spiky balls. The balls inflicted the Poisoned debuff, bounced and slid on contact with solid blocks, and decelerated to a stop as it travelled.
Poison Pack.tip: Throws up to 3 poisonous spiky balls · Stealth strikes cause the balls to release spore clouds · Press Right Click to delete all existing spiky balls

Pots.name: Pots
Pots.desc: Pots are common items generated at world creation in random areas. When broken with any weapon or tool, they will drop coins and/or random common items. Pots cannot be picked up, never respawn, and cannot be crafted.

Power Cell Factory.name: Power Cell Factory
Power Cell Factory.desc: Power Cell Factory is a furniture item that is found in Arsenal Labs. They are naturally found inactive but can be broken and replaced by the player to make them functional.
Power Cell Factory.tip: Produces Draedon Power Cells over time · One cell is produced every 15 seconds

Princess Spirit in a Bottle.name: Princess Spirit in a Bottle
Princess Spirit in a Bottle.desc: Princess Spirit in a Bottle was a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that was dropped by The Devourer of Gods while the player was under the effect of Purple Haze. When used, it summoned a rideable Alicorn mount which could run and fly at extreme speeds.
Princess Spirit in a Bottle.tip: Summons the spirit of Cirrus, the Drunk Princess, in her alicorn form · Mounting will transform Cirrus, dismounting transforms her back

Profaned Rage Potion.name: Profaned Rage Potion
Profaned Rage Potion.desc: The Profaned Rage Potion was a craftable post-Moon Lord buff potion that was an upgrade to the Rage Potion. Upon consumption, it granted the player the Profaned Rage buff, which increased critical strike chance by 12%.
Profaned Rage Potion.tip: Increases critical strike chance by 12% · While this potion's buff is active the Rage Potion's buff is disabled

Proporse Pistol.name: Proporse Pistol
Proporse Pistol.desc: The Proporse Pistol was a Hardmode gun that was dropped by Pirate Deadeyes in the Pirate Invasion event. When used, it fired energy blasts that bounced off tiles and pierced twice, ignoring some immunity frames.
Proporse Pistol.tip: Fires a blue energy blast that bounces

Psychotic Amulet.name: Psychotic Amulet
Psychotic Amulet.desc: The Psychotic Amulet was a Hardmode accessory that was rarely dropped by Possessed Armors. It benefited both the Rogue and Ranged classes, increasing the damage and critical strike chance of Rogue and Ranged attacks by 5%.
Psychotic Amulet.tip: Boosts rogue and ranged damage and critical strike chance by 5% · Grants a massive boost to these stats if you aren't moving

Purified Jam.name: Purified Jam
Purified Jam.desc: The Purified Jam was a Pre-Hardmode buff potion that was dropped by The Slime God.
Purified Jam.tip: Makes you immune to all damage and most debuffs for 10 / 5 seconds · Causes potion sickness when consumed · Cannot be consumed while potion sickness is active

Pylons.name: Pylons
Pylons.desc: Pylons are furniture items that appear as a large stone or crystal hovering and rotating above a biome-themed stand.

Quality Slop.name: Quality Slop
Quality Slop.desc: The Quality Slop is a Pre-Hardmode food item that drops from the Gluttony Blender. When consumed, it grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff for 30 minutes.
Quality Slop.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'You only like it because it's good'

Quasar.name: Quasar
Quasar.desc: The Quasar was a Hardmode non-consumable dagger that was dropped by Astrum Deus in Malice Mode. It functioned identically to the Radiant Star with the main difference being that the explosion would pull in enemies. The black hole-like effect did not affect bosses.
Quasar.tip: Succ · Stealth strikes spawn more explosions

Rage Meter.name: Rage Meter
Rage Meter.desc: The Rage Meter is a mechanic added in Revengeance Mode, along with the Adrenaline Meter. Once the meter has filled up completely, the Rage Mode buff can be activated by pressing the Rage Mode key. The Rage Meter has a minimum value of 0 and a maximum value of 100.

Raider's Glory.name: Raider's Glory
Raider's Glory.desc: The Raider's Glory was a Hardmode repeater that was dropped by Pirate Crossbowers in the Pirate Invasion event. When used, it turned any arrows fired into Ichor Arrows which travelled at a higher velocity and inflicted the Ichor and Midas debuffs.
Raider's Glory.tip: Fires ichor arrows with increased velocity · These arrows also cause enemies to drop more money

Redtide Spear.name: Redtide Spear
Redtide Spear.desc: The Redtide Spear was a craftable Pre-Hardmode spear. When used, it acted like a normal spear. However, if held in the direction the player is running, the player would hold the spear in front of them, gaining immunity to knockback and dealing 35% increased knockback.
Redtide Spear.tip: Poisons enemies on hit · Aiming the spear in front of you while running holds it down with increased knockback · Releasing the attack button after the charge makes an upwards slash, sending enemies flying into the air · 'The people of the sea were adept hunters, but they abhorred unnecessary violence. · Unfortunately, neighboring nations were brutish, so they fashioned their tools for war.'

Relics.name: Relics
Relics.desc: Relics are furniture items dropped by bosses in Master Mode or Revengeance Mode. They are golden depictions of their respective boss that hover above a pedestal, have a golden particle effect, and emit light when placed close to a light source. All relics drop with a 100% chance.

Resilient Candle.name: Resilient Candle
Resilient Candle.desc: The Resilient Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold after Moon Lord has been defeated.
Resilient Candle.tip: Right Click when placed to make defense block 15% more damage · (65% in Classic, 90% in Expert, and 115% in Master) · This cannot be stacked with other candle buffs · 'Neither rain nor wind can snuff its undying flame'

Revivify Potion.name: Revivify Potion
Revivify Potion.desc: The Revivify Potion was a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it granted the player the Revivify buff for 3 minutes, which caused enemy attacks to heal the player for 1/15 of their damage.
Revivify Potion.tip: Causes enemy attacks to heal you for a fraction of their damage

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.desc: The Rogue is a new class added by the Calamity Mod. The rogue class utilizes a unique Stealth mechanic granted by its armors, and makes use of thrown rogue weapons.

Rotten Matter.name: Rotten Matter
Rotten Matter.desc: Rotten Matter was a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that was dropped by The Hive Mind. It was used in the crafting of equipment dropped by The Hive Mind and the Teratoma.

Runestone Terracotta.name: Runestone Terracotta
Runestone Terracotta.desc: Runestone Terracotta is an unobtainable block.

Rusty Lockpick.name: Rusty Lockpick
Rusty Lockpick.desc: The Rusty Lockpick was a craftable item which allowed the player to access locked Rusty Chests while in the player's inventory. A Rusty Lockpick was consumed upon use, so unlocking each Rusty Chest would require an additional key.

Sandslasher.name: Sandslasher
Sandslasher.desc: The Sandslasher was a craftable Hardmode non-consumable rogue weapon. It automatically threw a large sand shuriken projectile that pierced twice and was unaffected by gravity.
Sandslasher.tip: Throws a huge shuriken made out of fused sand unaffected by gravity which slowly accelerates horizontally · It does more damage depending on how fast it goes horizontally and how long it has been flying for · Stealth strikes periodically release sand clouds

Sandy Angling Kit.name: Sandy Angling Kit
Sandy Angling Kit.desc: The Sandy Angling Kit was a Pre-Hardmode grab bag that was dropped by the Desert Scourge. It contained several fishing equipment and potions.
Sandy Angling Kit.tip: Has a chance to contain various fishing gear · Right Click to open

Satanic Scepter of Death.name: Satanic Scepter of Death
Satanic Scepter of Death.desc: Satanic Scepter of Death was an item found within the Starter Bag in Expert Mode. When used in Revengeance Mode, it activated or disabled Death Mode. Attempting to use it while not in Revengeance Mode or during a boss battle would have no effects.
Satanic Scepter of Death.tip: Enables/disables Death Mode, can only be used in Revengeance Mode. · All effects from Revengeance Mode are enabled, including the following: · Greatly boosts enemy spawn rates during the Blood Moon. · Makes the Abyss more treacherous to navigate. · Certain non-boss enemies and projectiles deal between 6% and 15% more damage. · Nerfs the effectiveness of life steal a bit more. · The Nurse no longer heals you while a boss is alive. · Increases damage done by 50% for several debuffs and all alcohols that reduce life regen. · Changes all boss AIs and most enemy AIs. · Increases the damage of all bosses a bit more.

Scarred Angelfish.name: Scarred Angelfish
Scarred Angelfish.desc: The Scarred Angelfish was a Hardmode fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea. It had no use apart from selling for money.
Scarred Angelfish.tip: The mark of a fallen angel

Sconce.name: Sconce
Sconce.desc: Sconces are placeable furniture items unique to the Calamity Mod. They are placed on background walls in a similar manner to torches and emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds one type of sconce.

Scorched Remains.name: Scorched Remains
Scorched Remains.desc: Scorched Remains are blocks that generate naturally in the Brimstone Crag in massive conic patches. Their surfaces can be covered with Cinder Blossom grass and Lava Lilies, or manually grown with Cinder Blossom Seeds. They require at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.

Sea Shell.name: Sea Shell
Sea Shell.desc: The Sea Shell was a Pre-Hardmode accessory that was dropped by Sea Snails. When equipped, it provided 3 defense and allowed free movement in liquids. When submerged in liquids, it provided an extra 3 defense and increased damage reduction by 5% and movement speed by 15%.
Sea Shell.tip: Increased defense and damage reduction when submerged in liquid · Increased movement speed when submerged in liquid

Seared Pan.name: Seared Pan
Seared Pan.desc: The Seared Pan was a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue weapon. It threw a gravity-affected pan which could not pierce through enemies nor solid tiles.
Seared Pan.tip: Fires a frying pan at high velocity · Enemy hits summon fireballs that linger around the target · Landing three consecutive hits will launch a golden pan on the next throw · Golden pans cause all fireballs to aggressively home in on their target on hit · Stealth strikes act similar to golden pans but also explode into golden sparks · Stealth strikes also summon additional fireballs on hit · 'dAMaGe iS rAthEr cOnSisTeNT'

Serpent's Bite.name: Serpent's Bite
Serpent's Bite.desc: The Serpent's Bite is a Hardmode grappling hook that is obtained from fishing in the Sunken Sea. It reaches 28.125 tiles and up to three hooks can be launched simultaneously, however only two hooks can attach to a block or platform at a time.
Serpent's Bite.tip: Reach: 28.125 tiles · Launch Velocity: 18 · Reelback Velocity: 14 · Pull Velocity: 12

Shadowdrop Staff.name: Shadowdrop Staff
Shadowdrop Staff.desc: The Shadowdrop Staff was a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand that could also drop from The Hive Mind. When used, it caused groups of thin, grey projectiles to fall from the sky, dealing damage to any enemy they touched.
Shadowdrop Staff.tip: Summons dark aura rain from the sky

Shattering Potion.name: Shattering Potion
Shattering Potion.desc: The Shattering Potion was a craftable Hardmode buff potion and a direct upgrade to the Crumbling Potion. Upon consumption, it granted the Armor Shattering buff, which provided the following effects:
Shattering Potion.tip: Increases melee and rogue damage and critical strike chance by 8% · Melee and rogue attacks break enemy armor · While this potion's buff is active the Crumbling Potion's buff is disabled

Shroomite Visage.name: Shroomite Visage
Shroomite Visage.desc: The Shroomite Visage was a craftable Hardmode helmet armor piece. While equipped, it granted +11 defense and +25% ranged damage for flamethrowers.

Sinks.name: Sinks
Sinks.desc: Sinks are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of sinks to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Skullmasher.name: Skullmasher
Skullmasher.desc: The Skullmasher was a post-Moon Lord gun that was dropped by The Devourer of Gods in Malice Mode. When used, it fired four high velocity bullets.
Skullmasher.tip: Makes their brain hurt · Fires a spread of 4 high velocity bullets that split into additional bullets upon hitting an enemy

Sky Stabber.name: Sky Stabber
Sky Stabber.desc: The Sky Stabber was a craftable Pre-Hardmode spiky ball. When used, it threw up to 4 gravity-ignoring spiky balls. The balls moved very slowly and decelerated to a stop after travelling a short distance.
Sky Stabber.tip: Throws up to 4 gravity-defying spiky balls · Stealth strikes make the balls rain feathers onto enemies when they hit · Press Right Click to delete all existing spiky balls

Small Spine.name: Small Spine
Small Spine.desc: Small Spine is a type of seed obtained by cutting down Spine Trees in the Brimstone Crag. It is used to place Spine Saplings on Brimstone Slag, which can grow into Spine Trees in a similar manner to Acorns.
Small Spine.tip: Plants Giant Spine saplings on Brimstone Slag

Snap Clam.name: Snap Clam
Snap Clam.desc: The Snap Clam is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that can be purchased from the Sea King for 2 gold at any time. For the first half second upon being thrown, the snap clam is open. Afterwards, the clam will visually close up and deal 20 percent less damage.
Snap Clam.tip: Can latch on enemies and inflict Clammed · Stealth strikes throw five clams at once

Spadefish.name: Spadefish
Spadefish.desc: The Spadefish is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that can be fished up in the underground layer. It throws a spadefish that bounces off enemies and sticks into blocks. Stealth strikes cause the player to spin it up, damaging enemies at close range, before throwing it extra fast.
Spadefish.tip: Throws a spadefish at enemies · Stealth Strikes cause you to spin the spade before throwing, damaging nearby enemies · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to [TOGGLE] breaking tiles · 'How can a fish be used to dig through the ground? · Some questions are best left unanswered...'

Spectral Feather.name: Spectral Feather
Spectral Feather.desc: Spectral Feathers were unobtainable items. They served no functional purpose.

Spectre Rifle.name: Spectre Rifle
Spectre Rifle.desc: The Spectre Rifle was a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it turned any Musket Balls into high-velocity, homing spectre projectiles that homed on a nearby enemy and pierced three times.
Spectre Rifle.tip: Converts musket balls into powerful homing souls

Speedrun Timer.name: Speedrun Timer
Speedrun Timer.desc: The Speedrun Timer is a timer that tracks how long the player has been playing on the current world. It can be toggled in the Configuration options menu.

Spiteful Candle.name: Spiteful Candle
Spiteful Candle.desc: The Spiteful Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold after Moon Lord has been defeated. It emits light and right-clicking the placed candle grants the Spite buff, which causes enemies to take 1.07x damage from the player's attacks.
Spiteful Candle.tip: Right Click when placed to deal 1.07x damage to all enemies · The extra 0.07x damage bypasses enemy defense and damage reduction · This cannot be stacked with other candle buffs · 'Its hateful glow flickers with ire'

Star Cannon EX.name: Star Cannon EX
Star Cannon EX.desc: The Star Cannon EX was a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that was a direct upgrade to the Star Cannon. When used, it consumed Fallen Stars to rapidly fire three different types of star projectiles: red, yellow, and pink.
Star Cannon EX.tip: Fires a mix of normal, starfury, and astral stars

Starter Bag.name: Starter Bag
Starter Bag.desc: The Starter Bag is a grab bag that is given to every newly spawned player. Right-clicking on the bag while it is in the inventory will give the player many items, all of which will help them progress through the beginning of the game more quickly and easily.

Stat Meter.name: Stat Meter
Stat Meter.desc: The Stat Meter is a Pre-Hardmode tool that is sold by the Goblin Tinkerer for 5 gold. It tells the player their stats in the tooltip. The following stats are displayed in order:
Stat Meter.tip: Displays almost all player stats · Offensive/utility stats displayed vary with held item

Sticky Spiky Ball.name: Sticky Spiky Ball
Sticky Spiky Ball.desc: Sticky Spiky Balls were craftable consumable Pre-Hardmode spiky balls. They threw gravity-affected spiky balls that stuck to solid blocks. They additionally latched onto enemies and dealt damage every second for 5 seconds, as well as inflicting the Slime debuff.
Sticky Spiky Ball.tip: Throws a spiky ball that sticks to everything · Stealth strikes throw four at once and last a lot longer

Stress.name: Stress
Stress.desc: Stress was a mechanic added in Revengeance Mode which increased or decreased over time. Many factors such as the biome the player character was in, the time of day, the presence of bosses, and more contributed to altering the rate of stress gain or loss.

Stuffed Fish.name: Stuffed Fish
Stuffed Fish.desc: The Stuffed Fish is a grab bag-type fish that can be caught on the surface during the day at a 6.67% chance. It contains various herbs and seeds.
Stuffed Fish.tip: Press Right Click to extract herbs and seeds

Sulphurous Sea World Side Changer.name: Sulphurous Sea World Side Changer
Sulphurous Sea World Side Changer.desc: The Sulphurous Sea World Side Changer is an unobtainable tool. When used, it changes the side of the Abyss and Sulphurous Sea with the Ocean.
Sulphurous Sea World Side Changer.tip: Spawn and use this if your regular ocean counts as a Sulphurous Sea · This will also fix the Abyss if it is broken

Superball Bullet.name: Superball Bullet
Superball Bullet.desc: Superball Bullets were craftable Pre-Hardmode bullets. They started off with slow velocity, which increased each time they bounced on a block or pierce an enemy, to a maximum of 5 times.

Sylvan Slasher.name: Sylvan Slasher
Sylvan Slasher.desc: The Sylvan Slasher was a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that was bought from the Bandit for 5 platinum after Providence, the Profaned Goddess had been defeated. When used, it created a small barrage of slashes at the cursor's position that were visually similar to the Arkhalis.
Sylvan Slasher.tip: Summons a slash attack at the cursor's position · Enemy hits build stealth and cause sword waves to fire from the player in the opposite direction · Does not consume stealth and cannot stealth strike

Tables.name: Tables
Tables.desc: Tables are furniture items that also function as minor crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of tables to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Temporal Floe Sword.name: Temporal Floe Sword
Temporal Floe Sword.desc: The Temporal Floe Sword was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. When used, it fired an ice beam that dealt 65% of the blade's damage. Upon contact with an enemy or tile, the beam split into two more beams that dealt 32.5% of the sword's damage.
Temporal Floe Sword.tip: The iceman cometh... · Fires a frozen sword beam that splits into two more beams · The direction of the beams depends on in game time

Tenebris.name: Tenebris
Tenebris.desc: Tenebris was a Hardmode block found naturally generated within the Abyss. After Calamitas Clone had been defeated, it could also convert nearby Planty Mush into more Tenebris blocks. It required at least a Pickaxe Axe or Drax to mine.

Terminus.name: Terminus
Terminus.desc: Terminus is an event-summoning item that is used to start and cancel the Boss Rush event. It can only be obtained by finding it in the shrine in the 4th layer of the Abyss.
Terminus.tip: Hold Left Click to start or end the Boss Rush

Terra Edge.name: Terra Edge
Terra Edge.desc: The Terra Edge was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. When swung, it shot a single projectile that dealt 75% of the weapon's base damage and inflicted Ichor for 0.75 seconds.
Terra Edge.tip: Heals the player on enemy hits · Fires a beam that inflicts ichor for a short time

Terra Shiv.name: Terra Shiv
Terra Shiv.desc: The Terra Shiv was a craftable Hardmode shortsword that autoswung. On each swing it would fire a shot that will pierce three times before stopping on the fourth enemy. The projectile only moved horizontally to the left or right.
Terra Shiv.tip: Don't underestimate the power of shivs

Terra-cotta.name: Terra-cotta
Terra-cotta.desc: The Terra-cotta was a Hardmode broadsword that dropped from Dune Splicers after Plantera had been defeated, and was the indirect upgrade to the Burnt Sienna.
Terra-cotta.tip: Causes enemies to erupt into healing projectiles on death · Enemies explode on hit

The Codebreaker.name: The Codebreaker
The Codebreaker.desc: The Codebreaker is a piece of constructible furniture that consists of six different components scattered throughout progression: Codebreaker Base, Decryption Computer, Long Ranged Sensor Array, Advanced Display, Voltage Regulation System, and Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.

The Concoction.name: The Concoction
The Concoction.desc: The Concoction is a Pre-Hardmode recovery potion that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 1 gold during even moon phases. Upon direct use, it provides no healing, inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff, and is not consumed.
The Concoction.tip: Can even be used while you have Potion Sickness if Quick Heal is repeatedly pressed

The Elixir.name: The Elixir
The Elixir.desc: The Elixir is a Pre-Hardmode potion that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 silver during odd moon phases. It acts identically to the Potion of Return.
The Elixir.tip: Functions as a Potion of Return · Occasionally sends you... somewhere else

The Enforcer.name: The Enforcer
The Enforcer.desc: The Enforcer was a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswung. Hitting enemies with the blade spawned 5 essence flames around the hit enemy that quickly homed on nearby enemies and exploded on contact. Essence flames dealt 25% of the weapon's damage.

The Gift.name: The Gift
The Gift.desc: The Gift is a unique item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 5 gold. If the item is dropped and contacts a Town NPC, the item is consumed and the happiness of the targeted NPC is set to either a price factor of 50% or 175%, at an equal chance between either outcome.
The Gift.tip: Drop this gift on one of your Town NPCs as a token of appreciation · May make them either love you or hate you, you'll never know until they open it! · Effect will last for 24 hours

The High-Flying Finery.name: The High-Flying Finery
The High-Flying Finery.desc: The High-Flying Finery is a craftable Pre-Hardmode vanity set which consists of the The Commander's Cap, The Grand Garment and The Formal Footwear.

The Housing Contract.name: The Housing Contract
The Housing Contract.desc: The Housing Contract is a consumable item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 5 gold in Hardmode.
The Housing Contract.tip: Use to adopt a piggy for your town

The Monument.name: The Monument
The Monument.desc: The Monument is a furniture item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 1 platinum in Hardmode. While placed, it increases the amount of tax collected from each NPC in screen range of The Monument by 50%, but decreases happiness by a price factor of 15%.
The Monument.tip: A monument celebrating the accomplishments of capitalism · Funded by the taxes of nearby Town NPCs, though they may not be too happy about that

The Omnigun.name: The Omnigun
The Omnigun.desc: The Omnigun is a Hardmode gun that is sold by the Shady Salesman after Golem has been defeated for 1 platinum. It performs the following behavior on a loop:
The Omnigun.tip: A multipurpose weapon with several modes which are used in sequence · The first shot is a sniper round which gains damage over time and always critically strikes · The second shot is a burst of 10 standard bullets · The third shot is a devastating point blank spread · The fourth shot is a dangerous but powerful grenade which destroys everything, including you

The Pact.name: The Pact
The Pact.desc: The Pact is a Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold during a Blood Moon after defeating Dreadnautilus. While equipped, the player gains 2x max health, but has a 25% chance to be critically struck when damaged.
The Pact.tip: Increases your max health by 2x · Causes 25% of hits you take to critically strike you · These crits deal 2.25x damage and inflict Fulfilled Contract

The Sandwich.name: The Sandwich
The Sandwich.desc: The Sandwich is a Pre-Hardmode food item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 55 silver during moon phases 5-8. When consumed, it grants the Malnourished debuff, which provides the following effects:
The Sandwich.tip: A sandwich made of the finest bread, cheese, and fish in the land! · Minor reductions to all stats · 5% increased damage for every alcohol you are affected by · Allows you to drink 2 more alcohols than normal · Alcohol effects will not expire while under the effects of The Sandwich · 'Might actually taste good if it was the only thing you'd ever eaten...'

Thief's Dime.name: Thief's Dime
Thief's Dime.desc: The Thief's Dime is a Hardmode light pet that is sold by the Bandit for 1 platinum after the Pirate Invasion has been defeated. When equipped, the coin orbits around the player and occasionally shines.
Thief's Dime.tip: Summons Goldie the rogue coin to collect nearby coins and light your way · Provides a small amount of light in the abyss · 'Once worthless treasure, now a relic of a thief's companionship'

Titan Scale Potion.name: Titan Scale Potion
Titan Scale Potion.desc: The Titan Scale Potion was a craftable Hardmode buff potion and an upgrade to the Titan Potion. Upon consumption, it granted the player the Titan Scale buff, which provided the following effects:
Titan Scale Potion.tip: Increases knockback, defense by 5 and damage reduction by 5% · Increases defense by 20 and damage reduction by 5% for a few seconds after a true melee strike

Toilets.name: Toilets
Toilets.desc: Toilets are furniture items. The Calamity Mod currently adds seven new toilets. Like vanilla toilets, players can sit on the toilets added by the mod by right-clicking on them.

Tormented Mind of Malice.name: Tormented Mind of Malice
Tormented Mind of Malice.desc: Tormented Mind of Malice was an item found within the Starter Bag in Expert Mode. When Death Mode was active, it activated or disabled Malice Mode. Attempting to use it while not in Death Mode or during a boss fight would have no effects.
Tormented Mind of Malice.tip: Enables/disables Malice Mode, can only be used in Death Mode. · This mode is subjective, play how you want, don't expect to live. · All effects from Death Mode are enabled, including the following: · Nerfs the effectiveness of life steal a bit more. · Enrages all bosses and gives them far more aggressive AI.

Trapper Bulb.name: Trapper Bulb
Trapper Bulb.desc: The Trapper Bulb was a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Angry Trappers. It was used to craft the Living Dew, Miracle Fruit, Photosynthesis Potion, and the Portabulb.

Treasure Bag.name: Treasure Bag
Treasure Bag.desc: Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag-like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses.

Trinity.name: Trinity
Trinity.desc: The Trinity was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswung. When swung, it fired 4 glowing bolts in a small spread. These bolts could have been red, purple, or blue, and were unaffected by gravity. All bolts could not pierce nor pass through tiles.
Trinity.tip: Fires a spread of energy bolts

Trinket of Chi.name: Trinket of Chi
Trinket of Chi.desc: The Trinket of Chi is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Surface/Underground shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold during a Waxing Gibbous after the item has been found.
Trinket of Chi.tip: Increases damage reduction by 20% if you avoid taking damage for 10 seconds · This buff expires on hit · +0.5 HP/s life regen for you and your teammates

Triploon.name: Triploon
Triploon.desc: The Triploon was a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that was the direct upgrade to the Dualpoon and the final upgrade to the Harpoon. When used, it rapidly fired three harpoons that were unaffected by gravity. The harpoons traveled a short distance before returning to the player.

Triumph Potion.name: Triumph Potion
Triumph Potion.desc: The Triumph Potion was a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it granted the player the Triumph buff, which reduced enemy contact damage by a percentage equal to the percentage of the enemy's missing health multiplied by 0.15.
Triumph Potion.tip: Enemy contact damage is reduced, the lower their health the more it is reduced

Trophies.name: Trophies
Trophies.desc: Trophies are rare drops (10%) from most bosses and are essentially the boss version of banners. Unlike banners, trophies do not provide any special effects. They are purely decorative background objects that can be placed on background walls.

True Bloody Edge.name: True Bloody Edge
True Bloody Edge.desc: The True Bloody Edge was a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It was a direct upgrade to the Bloody Edge and could be used to craft the Terra Blade or Terra Edge.
True Bloody Edge.tip: Chance to heal the player on enemy hits · Inflicts Burning Blood · Fires a bloody blade

True Excalibur Shortsword.name: True Excalibur Shortsword
True Excalibur Shortsword.desc: The True Excalibur Shortsword was a craftable Hardmode shortsword that autoswung. On each swing, it fired a projectile that pierced twice before stopping on the third enemy. The projectile only moved horizontally to the left or right.
True Excalibur Shortsword.tip: Don't underestimate the power of shortswords

True Night's Stabber.name: True Night's Stabber
True Night's Stabber.desc: The True Night's Stabber was a craftable Hardmode shortsword that autoswung. On each swing, it fired a projectile that pierced twice before stopping on the third enemy. The projectile only moved horizontally to the left or right.
True Night's Stabber.tip: Don't underestimate the power of stabby knives

Trusty Old Rod.name: Trusty Old Rod
Trusty Old Rod.desc: The Trusty Old Rod is a Pre-Hardmode fishing pole that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 35 gold during even moon phases. It has a 33.33% chance to fish out enemies, selected from a predetermined list based on liquid, biome, and progression.

Twisted Tendril.name: Twisted Tendril
Twisted Tendril.desc: Twisted Tendrils were Hardmode crafting materials that were dropped by the Wall of Flesh and some Underworld enemies. They were solely used to craft Chaos Serpent Shards.

Unstable Granite Core.name: Unstable Granite Core
Unstable Granite Core.desc: The Unstable Granite Core is a Pre-Hardmode accessory found in the Granite Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a New Moon after the item has been found.
Unstable Granite Core.tip: Gain an energy field that periodically zaps enemies with arcing energy · The arcing energy ignores a substantial amount of enemy defense

Urchin Flail.name: Urchin Flail
Urchin Flail.desc: The Urchin Flail was a Pre-Hardmode launched flail that was sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it threw out an urchin ball that shot an urchin spike upon hitting an enemy, inflicting the Poisoned debuff.
Urchin Flail.tip: Launch an urchin ball, which shoots a spike on contact with an enemy

Urn of Avarice.name: Urn of Avarice
Urn of Avarice.desc: Urn of Avarice is a furniture item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 5 gold. Pressing or holding Left Click on the tile while holding an ore consumes it and throws it over the urn. After two seconds, either a different, higher tier ore or a Stone Block drops.
Urn of Avarice.tip: Offer your treasures to the Urn, and your avarice may at last be satiated

Venerated Locket.name: Venerated Locket
Venerated Locket.desc: The Venerated Locket is a post-Moon Lord rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 10 platinum after The Devourer of Gods has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Venerated Locket.tip: 10% increased rogue damage · Rogue projectiles summon a clone from above the cursor · Stealth strikes unleash a ring of seeking cosmilite knives · 'You'll never be alone, no matter where you go'

Verdant.name: Verdant
Verdant.desc: The Verdant was a craftable post-Moon Lord yoyo. If enemies were nearby, it would randomly fire leaf crystals at them, which dealt 80% of the yoyo's damage. The leaves could pass through tiles but could not pierce.
Verdant.tip: Fires crystal leaves when enemies are near · A very agile yoyo

Vigorous Candle.name: Vigorous Candle
