Vigorous Candle.desc: The Vigorous Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold after Moon Lord has been defeated. It emits light and right-clicking the placed candle grants the Vigor buff, which causes players to regenerate 0.4% of their maximum health per second.
Vigorous Candle.tip: Right Click when placed to regenerate 0.4% of your maximum health per second · This regeneration is at full power even while moving · This cannot be stacked with other candle buffs · 'Its brilliant light suffuses those nearby with hope'

Waraxe.name: Waraxe
Waraxe.desc: The Waraxe was a Pre-Hardmode axe that was dropped by Skeletons, Hoplites, Armored Skeletons and Skeleton Archers. Critical strikes inflicted the War Cleave debuff.
Waraxe.tip: Critical hits cleave enemy armor, reducing their defense by 15 and protection by 25%

Warblade.name: Warblade
Warblade.desc: The Warblade was a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that autoswung and was dropped by Goblin Warriors. Critical hits inflicted the War Cleave debuff.
Warblade.tip: Critical hits cleave enemy armor, reducing their defense by 15 and protection by 25%

Water fountains.name: Water fountains
Water fountains.desc: Water fountains are furniture items that change the color of all nearby water. They can be activated via right-click or wiring. The Calamity Mod currently adds four different fountains to the game, all of which are purchased from the Witch Doctor for 4 gold.

Waywasher.name: Waywasher
Waywasher.desc: The Waywasher is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold. When used, it rapidly fires inaccurate water bolts that emit water drips as they travel, and can pierce once before dissipating on the second.
Waywasher.tip: Casts a deluge of inaccurate water bolts

Weightless Candle.name: Weightless Candle
Weightless Candle.desc: The Weightless Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold after Moon Lord has been defeated.
Weightless Candle.tip: Right Click when placed to gain 10% increased movement speed, wing time and acceleration · This cannot be stacked with other candle buffs · 'The floating flame seems to uplift your very spirit'

Will O Wisp.name: Will O Wisp
Will O Wisp.desc: The Will O Wisp is an unobtainable item.

Winter's Fury.name: Winter's Fury
Winter's Fury.desc: The Winter's Fury is a Hardmode spell tome that is sold by the Archmage for 60 gold after defeating all three minibosses in the Frost Moon event. When used, it fires one to three different projectiles towards the cursor, each having various effects. All projectiles do not pierce.
Winter's Fury.tip: Fires a stream of ice orbs and a barrage of ice shards towards the cursor · 'The pages are freezing to the touch'

Work Benches.name: Work Benches
Work Benches.desc: Work Benches are furniture items that function as crafting stations. The Calamity Mod currently adds eighteen types of Work Benches to the game, each corresponding to specific sets of furniture.

Wrath of the Ancients.name: Wrath of the Ancients
Wrath of the Ancients.desc: The Wrath of the Ancients was a Hardmode spell tome that dropped from Necromancers in the post-Plantera Dungeon. When used, it cast an energy pulse at the mouse cursor, which fired homing spirits at intervals for a significant amount of time.
Wrath of the Ancients.tip: Summons an energy pulse at the cursor to periodically summon homing spirits

Wulfrum Axe.name: Wulfrum Axe
Wulfrum Axe.desc: The Wulfrum Axe was a craftable Pre-Hardmode axe.

Wulfrum Hammer.name: Wulfrum Hammer
Wulfrum Hammer.desc: The Wulfrum Hammer was a craftable Pre-Hardmode hammer.

Wyvern Feather.name: Wyvern Feather
Wyvern Feather.desc: Wyvern Feathers were unobtainable items. They served no functional purpose.

Yanmei's Knife.name: Yanmei's Knife
Yanmei's Knife.desc: Yanmei's Knife was a craftable Hardmode classless weapon. When swung, a short-ranged green slash appeared in front of the player towards the mouse cursor. After the swing, the player was temporarily unable to use the weapon for 3 seconds.
Yanmei's Knife.tip: Enemies you hit are crippled · Hits will also give you enhanced movement speed and damage for 10 seconds · 'A knife from an unknown world · An owner whose heart is pure and free of taint · A heart of iron and valor'

Yharim's Stimulants.name: Yharim's Stimulants
Yharim's Stimulants.desc: Yharim's Stimulants were craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potions made from various combat-related potions. They granted the user the Yharim's Power buff when consumed, granting the following effects:
Yharim's Stimulants.tip: Gives decent buffs to ALL offensive and defensive stats

Bacon.name: Bacon
Bacon.desc: The Bacon is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Bacon has a 1/15 chance of being dropped by Pigron. Statue-spawned Pigrons do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Bacon.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Bacon? Bacon.'

Bloody Spine.name: Bloody Spine
Bloody Spine.desc: The Bloody Spine is a boss-summoning item that summons the Brain of Cthulhu when used. It can only be used in The Crimson or Underground Crimson, at any time.

Crags Pylon.name: Crags Pylon
Crags Pylon.desc: Pylons are furniture items that appear as a large stone or crystal hovering and rotating above a biome-themed stand.

High Velocity Bullet.name: High Velocity Bullet
High Velocity Bullet.desc: The High Velocity Bullet is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss bullet. It is the bullet with the highest velocity.

Tiger Skin.name: Tiger Skin
Tiger Skin.desc: The animal skins are decorative furniture items that are used like paintings. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each.

Wood Fishing Pole.name: Wood Fishing Pole
Wood Fishing Pole.desc: Fishing poles are tools used with bait for fishing.

Worm Food.name: Worm Food
Worm Food.desc: Worm Food is a boss-summoning item that summons the Eater of Worlds when used. It can only be used in The Corruption or Underground Corruption, at any time.

0x33's Aviators.name: 0x33's Aviators
0x33's Aviators.desc: 0x33's Aviators are a vanity item obtained by defeating the Eye of Cthulhu in Master Mode.
0x33's Aviators.tip: Enables your inner wingman · 'Great for impersonating streamers!'

Aaron's Breastplate.name: Aaron's Breastplate
Aaron's Breastplate.desc: They are acquired simultaneously. They are the set made for AaronC, an artist who formerly developed graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Aaron's Helmet.name: Aaron's Helmet
Aaron's Helmet.desc: They are acquired simultaneously. They are the set made for AaronC, an artist who formerly developed graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Aaron's Leggings.name: Aaron's Leggings
Aaron's Leggings.desc: They are acquired simultaneously. They are the set made for AaronC, an artist who formerly developed graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Abeemination.name: Abeemination
Abeemination.desc: The Abeemination is a boss-summoning item that summons the Queen Bee when used. It can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle, at any time.

Abigail's Flower.name: Abigail's Flower
Abigail's Flower.desc: Abigail's Flower is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Abigail minion. She floats towards enemies and inflicts continuous contact damage, as well as pausing to emit damaging flashes of light.
Abigail's Flower.tip: Summons a friendly ghost to fight for you · 'It's hauntingly beautiful.'

Acid Dye.name: Acid Dye
Acid Dye.desc: Acid Dye is a dye acquired as a random reward from the Dye Trader for giving him a Strange Plant. When equipped in the dye slot, it applies a dark green rippling effect that pulses outward, similar to Blue Acid Dye and Red Acid Dye.

Acorn Slingshot.name: Acorn Slingshot
Acorn Slingshot.desc: The Acorn Slingshot is a weapon that uses Acorns as ammo. It fires arcing acorns that plant themselves upon landing on a suitable soil block for a tree, but otherwise bounce and roll on blocks.
Acorn Slingshot.tip: Fires acorns that plant themselves when they land

Active Stone Block.name: Active Stone Block
Active Stone Block.desc: The Active Stone Block and Inactive Stone Block are blocks that act as mechanisms. A given pair behave as a single block whose presence can be switched "on" or "off" using wire and a trigger. When triggered, an Active Stone Block becomes an Inactive Stone Block, and vice versa.

Inactive Stone Block.name: Inactive Stone Block
Inactive Stone Block.desc: The Active Stone Block and Inactive Stone Block are blocks that act as mechanisms. A given pair behave as a single block whose presence can be switched "on" or "off" using wire and a trigger. When triggered, an Active Stone Block becomes an Inactive Stone Block, and vice versa.

Actuation Rod.name: Actuation Rod
Actuation Rod.desc: The Actuation Rod is a post-Skeletron, craftable tool which allows directly switching the states of Actuators without having to activate them via wire. It is compatible with Smart cursor.

Actuator.name: Actuator
Actuator.desc: The Actuator is a mechanism item purchased from the Mechanic for each, or harvested from sand traps, lava traps, boulder traps, or Dead Man's Chest traps. It has to be placed on a tile and connected with wiring to function.
Actuator.tip: Enables solid blocks to be toggled on and off

Adamantite Breastplate.name: Adamantite Breastplate
Adamantite Breastplate.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Adamantite Headgear.name: Adamantite Headgear
Adamantite Headgear.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Adamantite Headgear.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 · 12% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Adamantite Helmet.name: Adamantite Helmet
Adamantite Helmet.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Adamantite Helmet.tip: 7% increased melee critical strike chance · 14% increased melee damage

Adamantite Leggings.name: Adamantite Leggings
Adamantite Leggings.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Adamantite Leggings.tip: 7% increased critical strike chance · 5% increased movement speed

Adamantite Mask.name: Adamantite Mask
Adamantite Mask.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Adamantite Mask.tip: 14% increased ranged damage · 10% increased ranged critical strike chance

Adamantite Beam.name: Adamantite Beam
Adamantite Beam.desc: The Adamantite Beam is a Hardmode brick.

Adamantite Beam Wall.name: Adamantite Beam Wall
Adamantite Beam Wall.desc: Adamantite Beam Wall is a type of wall crafted from Adamantite Beam.

Adamantite Chainsaw.name: Adamantite Chainsaw
Adamantite Chainsaw.desc: The Adamantite Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Adamantite Waraxe.

Adamantite Drill.name: Adamantite Drill
Adamantite Drill.desc: The Adamantite Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Adamantite Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.
stats: 0.5 (Extremely weak) (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 0 (No knockback) (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Adamantite Glaive.name: Adamantite Glaive
Adamantite Glaive.desc: The Adamantite Glaive is a Hardmode spear.

Adamantite Ore.name: Adamantite Ore
Adamantite Ore.desc: Adamantite Ore belongs to the third tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the third altar broken, either it or Titanium Ore can spawn in the cavern layer, roughly at lava depth. Mining Adamantite Ore requires a Mythril/Orichalcum Pickaxe or better.

Adamantite Pickaxe.name: Adamantite Pickaxe
Adamantite Pickaxe.desc: The Adamantite Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Adamantite Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Adamantite Repeater.name: Adamantite Repeater
Adamantite Repeater.desc: The Adamantite Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Adamantite Sword.name: Adamantite Sword
Adamantite Sword.desc: The Adamantite Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Adamantite Waraxe.name: Adamantite Waraxe
Adamantite Waraxe.desc: The Adamantite Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Adamantite Chainsaw.

Adhesive Bandage.name: Adhesive Bandage
Adhesive Bandage.desc: The Adhesive Bandage is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Bleeding debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Rusty Armored Bones, Werewolves, and Angler Fish.

Advanced Combat Techniques.name: Advanced Combat Techniques
Advanced Combat Techniques.desc: Advanced Combat Techniques is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the defense of Town NPCs by 8, their attack damage by 25%, their attack speed by 20%, and their health by 250. Advanced Combat Techniques can only be obtained by fishing during a Blood Moon.
Advanced Combat Techniques.tip: Increases the defense and strength of all villagers · 'Contains offensive and defensive fighting techniques'

Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two.name: Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two
Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two.desc: Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two is a Hardmode permanent booster item that permanently increases the defense of Town NPCs by 8, their attack damage by 25%, their attack speed by 20%, and their health by 250, similar to the increases after each type of boss is defeated.
Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two.tip: Increases the defense and strength of all villagers · 'Contains offensive and defensive fighting techniques, volume two!'

Aegis Fruit.name: Aegis Fruit
Aegis Fruit.desc: The Aegis Fruit is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's defense by 4. It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing a Life Fruit into Shimmer.

Aetherium Brick.name: Aetherium Brick
Aetherium Brick.desc: The Aetherium Brick is a pre-Hardmode brick. It emits light when placed. Standing on Aetherium Bricks causes occasional particles of iridiscent star dust to appear. Walking or running on them causes a trail of particles to follow the player.

Aetherium Brick Wall.name: Aetherium Brick Wall
Aetherium Brick Wall.desc: Aetherium Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Aetherium Bricks.

Aetherium Wall.name: Aetherium Wall
Aetherium Wall.desc: Aetherium Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Aetherium Blocks.

Alchemy Flask.name: Alchemy Flask
Alchemy Flask.desc: The Alchemy Flask is a post-Skeletron crafting station used to craft potions. It has the same effect as the Alchemy Table when crafting potions: 1/3 chance for each ingredient not to be consumed. It is obtained by throwing an Alchemy Table into Shimmer.
Alchemy Flask.tip: Usable when placed · Fresh buffs last longer · 'A mysterious bottle from far away'

Alchemy Table.name: Alchemy Table
Alchemy Table.desc: The Alchemy Table is a post-Skeletron crafting station that shares recipes with Placed Bottles. When a potion is crafted with the Alchemy Table, there is a 1/3 chance for each ingredient not to be consumed.
Alchemy Table.tip: 33% chance to not consume potion crafting ingredients

Ale.name: Ale
Ale.desc: Ale is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff for 120 when consumed. Ale can be crafted at a Keg or purchased from the Tavernkeep for each.
Ale.tip: Minor improvements to melee stats & lowered defense · 'Down the hatch!'

Ale Tosser.name: Ale Tosser
Ale Tosser.desc: The Ale Tosser is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped from the Tavernkeep.

Alien Hornet Banner.name: Alien Hornet Banner
Alien Hornet Banner.desc: The Alien Hornet is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events, summoned from opened portals in groups of two. If not killed fast enough, it will fairly quickly grow into an Alien Queen.
Alien Hornet Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Alien Hornet

Alien Larva Banner.name: Alien Larva Banner
Alien Larva Banner.desc: The Alien Larva is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. They move fairly slowly along the ground, and will only naturally spawn in groups of two or three upon the death of an Alien Queen.
Alien Larva Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Alien Larva

Alien Queen Banner.name: Alien Queen Banner
Alien Queen Banner.desc: The Alien Queen is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. It attacks by shooting Alien Goop projectiles that have a 1/2 / 100% chance to inflict the Distorted debuff for 6–12 / 5–9 seconds.
Alien Queen Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Alien Queen

Crimson Altar.name: Crimson Altar
Crimson Altar.desc: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson, and less frequently underground.

Demon Altar.name: Demon Altar
Demon Altar.desc: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson, and less frequently underground.

Amarok.name: Amarok
Amarok.desc: The Amarok is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/300 chance of being dropped from any enemy in the Snow biome or Ice biome, and can also drop in a Corrupted, Crimsoned, or Hallowed version of these biomes. It has a 67/100 chance to inflict the Frostbite debuff for 2–5 seconds upon hit.

Amazon.name: Amazon
Amazon.desc: The Amazon is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Amber Horseshoe Balloon.name: Amber Horseshoe Balloon
Amber Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The Amber Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that increases jump height by 75% (6 blocks → 10.5 blocks), reduces it by 15% when underwater (8 blocks → 7 blocks), makes the player immune to fall damage, and releases bees when attacked, which seek out and damage enemies.
Amber Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Amber Mosquito.name: Amber Mosquito
Amber Mosquito.desc: The Amber Mosquito is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Dinosaur that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, a pterosaur will carry it by the tail to continue following them.

Amber Robe.name: Amber Robe
Amber Robe.desc: The Amber Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Amber Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to pierce an additional 2 enemies, and bounce up to 2 times on blocks, at the cost of dealing 80% damage.
Amber Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 13% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Ambers carve a path

Ambrosia.name: Ambrosia
Ambrosia.desc: Ambrosia is a permanent booster item that permanently grants the following effects:
Ambrosia.tip: Permanently increases mining and building speed

Amethyst Robe.name: Amethyst Robe
Amethyst Robe.desc: The Amethyst Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Amethyst Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to home in towards the nearest enemy. The Amethyst Staff instead receives a flat damage buff of 4.
Amethyst Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 20 · 5% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Amethysts find their path

Amphibian Boots.name: Amphibian Boots
Amphibian Boots.desc: The Amphibian Boots are an accessory crafted by combining the Sailfish Boots and Frog Leg at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It provides the benefits of both.
Amphibian Boots.tip: The wearer can run super fast · Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

Amulet of the Night.name: Amulet of the Night
Amulet of the Night.desc: The Amulet of the Night is a Hardmode transformation mount item that turns the player into a Bat. While in bat form, the player has infinite flight and their hurt sound is replaced with a squeak.
Amulet of the Night.tip: Inflicts the bearer with the curse of the bat

drops.chance: 1/4 (25%) (In what a horrible night to have a curse worlds)

Anchor.name: Anchor
Anchor.desc: The Anchor is a Hardmode flail that has a 302679/8000000 chance of being found in Pearlwood Crates, obtained from fishing. When used, it fires an Anchor in an arc, which is attached to the player via a rope.

Ancient Cobalt Breastplate.name: Ancient Cobalt Breastplate
Ancient Cobalt Breastplate.desc: Ancient Cobalt armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Cobalt Helmet, Ancient Cobalt Breastplate, and Ancient Cobalt Leggings. Each piece has a 1/300 chance of being dropped by Hornets and Man Eaters.
Ancient Cobalt Breastplate.tip: Increases maximum mana by 20 · 6% increased magic damage

Ancient Cobalt Helmet.name: Ancient Cobalt Helmet
Ancient Cobalt Helmet.desc: Ancient Cobalt armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Cobalt Helmet, Ancient Cobalt Breastplate, and Ancient Cobalt Leggings. Each piece has a 1/300 chance of being dropped by Hornets and Man Eaters.
Ancient Cobalt Helmet.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 6% increased magic critical strike chance

Ancient Cobalt Leggings.name: Ancient Cobalt Leggings
Ancient Cobalt Leggings.desc: Ancient Cobalt armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Cobalt Helmet, Ancient Cobalt Breastplate, and Ancient Cobalt Leggings. Each piece has a 1/300 chance of being dropped by Hornets and Man Eaters.
Ancient Cobalt Leggings.tip: Increases maximum mana by 20 · 6% increased magic critical strike chance

Ancient Cobalt Brick.name: Ancient Cobalt Brick
Ancient Cobalt Brick.desc: Ancient Cobalt Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Cobalt Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Cobalt Brick prior to 1.2.

Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall.name: Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall
Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall.desc: Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Cobalt Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Cobalt Brick Wall prior to 1.2.

Ancient Copper Brick.name: Ancient Copper Brick
Ancient Copper Brick.desc: Ancient Copper Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Copper Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Copper Brick prior to 1.2.

Ancient Copper Brick Wall.name: Ancient Copper Brick Wall
Ancient Copper Brick Wall.desc: Ancient Copper Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Copper Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Copper Brick Wall prior to 1.2.

Ancient Blue Brick Wall.name: Ancient Blue Brick Wall
Ancient Blue Brick Wall.desc: The Ancient Dungeon Brick Walls are types of walls that are crafted from their respective Ancient Dungeon Brick.

Ancient Green Brick Wall.name: Ancient Green Brick Wall
Ancient Green Brick Wall.desc: The Ancient Dungeon Brick Walls are types of walls that are crafted from their respective Ancient Dungeon Brick.

Ancient Pink Brick Wall.name: Ancient Pink Brick Wall
Ancient Pink Brick Wall.desc: The Ancient Dungeon Brick Walls are types of walls that are crafted from their respective Ancient Dungeon Brick.

Ancient Blue Brick.name: Ancient Blue Brick
Ancient Blue Brick.desc: Ancient Dungeon Bricks are types of bricks that can be obtained by throwing the respective Dungeon Brick into Shimmer.

Ancient Green Brick.name: Ancient Green Brick
Ancient Green Brick.desc: Ancient Dungeon Bricks are types of bricks that can be obtained by throwing the respective Dungeon Brick into Shimmer.

Ancient Pink Brick.name: Ancient Pink Brick
Ancient Pink Brick.desc: Ancient Dungeon Bricks are types of bricks that can be obtained by throwing the respective Dungeon Brick into Shimmer.

Ancient Gold Brick.name: Ancient Gold Brick
Ancient Gold Brick.desc: Ancient Gold Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Gold Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Gold Brick prior to 1.2.

Ancient Gold Brick Wall.name: Ancient Gold Brick Wall
Ancient Gold Brick Wall.desc: Ancient Gold Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Gold Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Gold Brick Wall prior to 1.2.

Ancient Hallowed Greaves.name: Ancient Hallowed Greaves
Ancient Hallowed Greaves.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.

Ancient Hallowed Headgear.name: Ancient Hallowed Headgear
Ancient Hallowed Headgear.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.
Ancient Hallowed Headgear.tip: Increases maximum mana by 100 · 12% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Ancient Hallowed Helmet.name: Ancient Hallowed Helmet
Ancient Hallowed Helmet.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.
Ancient Hallowed Helmet.tip: 15% increased ranged damage · 8% increased ranged critical strike chance

Ancient Hallowed Hood.name: Ancient Hallowed Hood
Ancient Hallowed Hood.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.
Ancient Hallowed Hood.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Ancient Hallowed Mask.name: Ancient Hallowed Mask
Ancient Hallowed Mask.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.
Ancient Hallowed Mask.tip: 10% increased melee damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased melee speed

Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail.name: Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail
Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail.desc: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.

Ancient Hellstone Brick.name: Ancient Hellstone Brick
Ancient Hellstone Brick.desc: Ancient Hellstone Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Hellstone Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Hellstone Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Hellstone Brick.tip: Burns you when touched without special protection

Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall.name: Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall
Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall.desc: Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Hellstone Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Hellstone Brick Wall prior to 1.2.

Ancient Horn.name: Ancient Horn
Ancient Horn.desc: The Ancient Horn is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Basilisk Mount, which gives the player an additional jump and the ability to charge through enemies, damaging them in the process. The Ancient Horn has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Basilisks.

Ancient Mythril Brick.name: Ancient Mythril Brick
Ancient Mythril Brick.desc: Ancient Mythril Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Mythril Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Mythril Brick prior to 1.2.

Ancient Mythril Brick Wall.name: Ancient Mythril Brick Wall
Ancient Mythril Brick Wall.desc: Ancient Mythril Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Mythril Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Mythril Brick Wall prior to 1.2.

Ancient Obsidian Brick.desc: Ancient Obsidian Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Obsidian Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Obsidian Brick prior to 1.2.

Angel Halo.desc: The Angel Halo is a vanity accessory purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Angler Hat.name: Angler Hat
Angler Hat.desc: Angler armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Angler Hat, Angler Vest, and Angler Pants. The Hat is given by the Angler after completing 10 fishing quests, the Vest after 15, and the Pants after 20.

Angler Pants.name: Angler Pants
Angler Pants.desc: Angler armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Angler Hat, Angler Vest, and Angler Pants. The Hat is given by the Angler after completing 10 fishing quests, the Vest after 15, and the Pants after 20.

Angler Vest.name: Angler Vest
Angler Vest.desc: Angler armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Angler Hat, Angler Vest, and Angler Pants. The Hat is given by the Angler after completing 10 fishing quests, the Vest after 15, and the Pants after 20.

Angler Earring.name: Angler Earring
Angler Earring.desc: The Angler Earring is an accessory that increases the player's current Fishing Power by 10 when equipped.

Angler Fish Banner.name: Angler Fish Banner
Angler Fish Banner.desc: The Angler Fish is a Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Cavern layer and in the Jungle. It swims faster than Piranhas when chasing the player, and can inflict the Bleeding debuff for 45 / 90 / seconds.
Angler Fish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angler Fish

Angler Tackle Bag.name: Angler Tackle Bag
Angler Tackle Bag.desc: The Angler Tackle Bag is an accessory that combines the functionality of its components: the Angler Earring's +10 boost to Fishing Power, the Tackle Box's chance to not consume bait, and the unbreakable quality of the High Test Fishing Line.
Angler Tackle Bag.tip: Fishing line will never break, decreases chance of bait consumption, increases fishing power by 10

Angry Bones Banner.name: Angry Bones Banner
Angry Bones Banner.desc: The Angry Bones is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Dungeon. They follow the Fighter AI and can open closed doors after one or two hits. They will sometimes leap towards the player when they get close, or if the player is above them.
Angry Bones Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angry Bones

Angry Dandelion Banner.name: Angry Dandelion Banner
Angry Dandelion Banner.desc: The Angry Dandelion is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on grass during the Windy Day event at daytime. It is stationary and shoots 1–3 damaging Dandelion Seed projectiles at the player every 40ticks.
Angry Dandelion Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angry Dandelion

Angry Nimbus Banner.name: Angry Nimbus Banner
Angry Nimbus Banner.desc: The Angry Nimbus is a Hardmode enemy that spawns when the weather is rainy in any surface biome except for the Snow biome. It will follow players around the map and attempt to release damaging raindrops on top of them similar to that of the Crimson Rod and the Nimbus Rod.
Angry Nimbus Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angry Nimbus

Angry Trapper Banner.name: Angry Trapper Banner
Angry Trapper Banner.desc: The Angry Trapper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes and is a much stronger version of the Man Eater and Snatcher.
Angry Trapper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angry Trapper

Angry Tumbler Banner.name: Angry Tumbler Banner
Angry Tumbler Banner.desc: The Angry Tumbler is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during a Sandstorm. It attacks by rolling towards the player, moving at very high speeds when rolling with in the direction of the Mighty Wind.
Angry Tumbler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Angry Tumbler

Leopard Skin.name: Leopard Skin
Leopard Skin.desc: The animal skins are decorative furniture items that are used like paintings. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each.

Zebra Skin.name: Zebra Skin
Zebra Skin.desc: The animal skins are decorative furniture items that are used like paintings. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each.

Ankh Charm.name: Ankh Charm
Ankh Charm.desc: The Ankh Charm is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the following debuffs:

Ankh Shield.name: Ankh Shield
Ankh Shield.desc: The Ankh Shield is a Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Ankh Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback and fire blocks · Grants immunity to most debuffs

Announcement Box.name: Announcement Box
Announcement Box.desc: The Announcement Box is a special sign that, when powered, will announce (in the chat) what was written on the sign. They support the usage of tags, allowing (for example) the display of messages in different colors.
Announcement Box.tip: Sends a message to everyone when signalled

Anomura Fungus Banner.name: Anomura Fungus Banner
Anomura Fungus Banner.desc: The Anomura Fungus is an enemy found in aboveground Glowing Mushroom biomes at any point in the game, including pre-Hardmode. During Hardmode, they can also spawn in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.
Anomura Fungus Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Anomura Fungus

Anti-Gravity Hook.name: Anti-Gravity Hook
Anti-Gravity Hook.desc: The Anti-Gravity Hook is a Hardmode, post-Golem grappling hook that fires up to three hooks which reach 31.25 tiles at maximum. When any hook latches onto a block, the player will be pushed 12 blocks away from the latch point if there is room to do so.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Anti-Portal Block.name: Anti-Portal Block
Anti-Portal Block.desc: The Anti-Portal Block is a Hardmode block that prevents portals from the Portal Gun or Portal Gun Station to form on it. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Anti-Portal Block.tip: Portals cannot be created on the surface of these blocks

Antlion Banner.name: Antlion Banner
Antlion Banner.desc: The Antlion is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in Deserts during the day and in Underground Deserts at any time.
Antlion Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Antlion

Antlion Charger Banner.name: Antlion Charger Banner
Antlion Charger Banner.desc: The Antlion Charger is an enemy similar in appearance to the Antlion, and is found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during pre-Hardmode Sandstorms.
Antlion Charger Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Antlion Charger

Antlion Eggs.name: Antlion Eggs
Antlion Eggs.desc: Antlion Eggs are background objects that are found in naturally-generated clusters in the Underground Desert. They spawn an Antlion Larva when hit with nearly any tool, weapon, or projectile.

Antlion Larva Banner.name: Antlion Larva Banner
Antlion Larva Banner.desc: The Antlion Larva is a pre-Hardmode enemy that is only spawned when Antlion Eggs are destroyed. Its speed, jump height, occurrence in numbers, and small size make it a significant threat in the early game.
Antlion Larva Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Antlion Larva

Antlion Swarmer Banner.name: Antlion Swarmer Banner
Antlion Swarmer Banner.desc: The Antlion Swarmer is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during Sandstorms. It is a large dragonfly-like creature that looks similar to the Antlion and Antlion Charger.
Antlion Swarmer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Antlion Swarmer

Apple.name: Apple
Apple.desc: The Apple is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Apple.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'An apple a day keeps Doctor Bones away!'

Apple Juice.name: Apple Juice
Apple Juice.desc: Apple Juice is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Apple Juice.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Hungry for Apples?'

Apple Pie.name: Apple Pie
Apple Pie.desc: The Apple Pie is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Apple Pie has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Illuminant Bats, Illuminant Slimes, and Chaos Elementals.
Apple Pie.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Nothing is as Terrarian as apple pie.'

Apple Pie Slice.name: Apple Pie Slice
Apple Pie Slice.desc: The Apple Pie Slice is an unimplemented item.
Apple Pie Slice.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Mmmm... pie.'

Apprentice's Hat.name: Apprentice's Hat
Apprentice's Hat.desc: Apprentice armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Apprentice's Hat, Apprentice's Robe, and Apprentice's Trousers. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Apprentice's Hat.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 1, 10% increased magic damage and 10% reduced mana cost

Apprentice's Robe.name: Apprentice's Robe
Apprentice's Robe.desc: Apprentice armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Apprentice's Hat, Apprentice's Robe, and Apprentice's Trousers. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Apprentice's Robe.tip: 20% increased summon damage and 10% increased magic damage

Apprentice's Trousers.name: Apprentice's Trousers
Apprentice's Trousers.desc: Apprentice armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Apprentice's Hat, Apprentice's Robe, and Apprentice's Trousers. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Apprentice's Trousers.tip: 10% increased summon damage, 20% increased magic critical strike chance and movement speed

Apprentice's Scarf.name: Apprentice's Scarf
Apprentice's Scarf.desc: The Apprentice's Scarf is an accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. It is dropped by the Dark Mage with a 1/4 / 1/2 chance.
Apprentice's Scarf.tip: Increase your max number of sentries by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Apricot.name: Apricot
Apricot.desc: The Apricot is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Apricot.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'You'll apricate this!'

Aquarium Block.name: Aquarium Block
Aquarium Block.desc: Aquarium Blocks are a block crafted from Glass near water, Sink, or a Water fountain. Their main use is crafting Aquarium furniture and Aquarium Walls.

Aquarium Wall.name: Aquarium Wall
Aquarium Wall.desc: Aquarium Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Aquarium Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Arapaima Banner.name: Arapaima Banner
Arapaima Banner.desc: The Arapaima is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in pools of water within the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes. It swims much faster than most fish and deals high damage, but it has no knockback resistance, so high-knockback weapons are useful.
Arapaima Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Arapaima

Arc Surge.name: Arc Surge
Arc Surge.desc: The Arc Surge is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic weapon that has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.
Arc Surge.tip: Unleashes powerful lightning to strike your foes · 'Unlimited POWER!'

Arcane Rune Wall.name: Arcane Rune Wall
Arcane Rune Wall.desc: Arcane Rune Wall is a background wall that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. It is one of the few animated walls, as the runes displayed change every few seconds.

Archaeologist's Hat.name: Archaeologist's Hat
Archaeologist's Hat.desc: The Archaeologist's set is a vanity set composed of the Archaeologist's Hat, the Archaeologist's Jacket and the Archaeologist's Pants.

Archaeologist's Jacket.name: Archaeologist's Jacket
Archaeologist's Jacket.desc: The Archaeologist's set is a vanity set composed of the Archaeologist's Hat, the Archaeologist's Jacket and the Archaeologist's Pants.

Archaeologist's Pants.name: Archaeologist's Pants
Archaeologist's Pants.desc: The Archaeologist's set is a vanity set composed of the Archaeologist's Hat, the Archaeologist's Jacket and the Archaeologist's Pants.

Architect Gizmo Pack.name: Architect Gizmo Pack
Architect Gizmo Pack.desc: The Architect Gizmo Pack is a construction accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Architect Gizmo Pack.tip: Increases block & wall placement speed · Increases block placement & tool range by 3 · Automatically paints or coats placed objects

Argon Moss Brick Wall.name: Argon Moss Brick Wall
Argon Moss Brick Wall.desc: Argon Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Argon Moss and the Argon Moss Brick it is made from.

Arkhalis.name: Arkhalis
Arkhalis.desc: The Arkhalis is a Hardmode melee weapon that is part of Arkhalis' set and is only obtainable through Hardmode Treasure Bags in Expert Mode (except Queen Slime's). It appears to be a sword, but does not present an actual blade when used.
Arkhalis.tip: 'I didn't get this off of a Schmoo'

Arkhalis' Bodice.name: Arkhalis' Bodice
Arkhalis' Bodice.desc: It is the vanity set made for Arkhayla, a former Quality Director at Re-Logic.
Arkhalis' Bodice.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'I didn't get this from the Grid'

Arkhalis' Hood.name: Arkhalis' Hood
Arkhalis' Hood.desc: It is the vanity set made for Arkhayla, a former Quality Director at Re-Logic.
Arkhalis' Hood.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'I didn't get this from the Grid'

Arkhalis' Tights.name: Arkhalis' Tights
Arkhalis' Tights.desc: It is the vanity set made for Arkhayla, a former Quality Director at Re-Logic.
Arkhalis' Tights.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'I didn't get this from the Grid'

Armlet Of Ruin.name: Armlet Of Ruin
Armlet Of Ruin.desc: The Armlet Of Ruin is a Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Armlet Of Ruin.tip: Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 1 · Increases whip knockback · Periodically recharges with faint light · Minion tag hits discharge ancient power

Armor Bracing.name: Armor Bracing
Armor Bracing.desc: Armor Bracing is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Weak and Broken Armor debuffs.
Armor Bracing.tip: Grants immunity to Weakness and Broken Armor

Armor Polish.name: Armor Polish
Armor Polish.desc: The Armor Polish is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Broken Armor debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Armored Skeletons and Blue Armored Bones.

Armored Cavefish.name: Armored Cavefish
Armored Cavefish.desc: Armored Cavefish are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in the Underground, Cavern, and Underworld layers, in any biome except the Desert. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Endurance Potions.

Armored Skeleton Banner.name: Armored Skeleton Banner
Armored Skeleton Banner.desc: The Armored Skeleton is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It has a 1/6 chance to inflict the Broken Armor debuff for 2 / 4 / minutes on contact.
Armored Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Armored Skeleton

Armored Viking Banner.name: Armored Viking Banner
Armored Viking Banner.desc: The Armored Viking is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. It is similar to the Undead Viking, but has greatly increased defense, damage and health.
Armored Viking Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Armored Viking

Arrow Sign.name: Arrow Sign
Arrow Sign.desc: Arrow Signs are furniture items used in Golfing. They are purely decorative and come in a regular and a painted variety. They are both purchased from the Golfer for each.

Painted Arrow Sign.name: Painted Arrow Sign
Painted Arrow Sign.desc: Arrow Signs are furniture items used in Golfing. They are purely decorative and come in a regular and a painted variety. They are both purchased from the Golfer for each.

Artery.name: Artery
Artery.desc: The Artery is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Artisan Loaf.name: Artisan Loaf
Artisan Loaf.desc: The Artisan Loaf is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the range that the player can access crafting stations by 4 tiles in all directions. The Artisan Loaf can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for during a Waning Crescent, New Moon, or Waxing Crescent.
Artisan Loaf.tip: Consume to permanently increase crafting station range · 'Legendary Bread that once reminded Teddy of home'

Ash Grass Seeds.name: Ash Grass Seeds
Ash Grass Seeds.desc: Ash Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Ash grass. They are purchased from the Dryad for each, when she is talked to in The Underworld. They can also be gathered by clearing Ash grass foliage in the Underworld. Ash trees can grow on planted Ash grass.

Ash Wood Breastplate.name: Ash Wood Breastplate
Ash Wood Breastplate.desc: Ash Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ash Wood Helmet, Ash Wood Breastplate, and Ash Wood Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 75 Ash Wood.

Ash Wood Greaves.name: Ash Wood Greaves
Ash Wood Greaves.desc: Ash Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ash Wood Helmet, Ash Wood Breastplate, and Ash Wood Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 75 Ash Wood.

Ash Wood Helmet.name: Ash Wood Helmet
Ash Wood Helmet.desc: Ash Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ash Wood Helmet, Ash Wood Breastplate, and Ash Wood Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 75 Ash Wood.

Ash Wood Bow.name: Ash Wood Bow
Ash Wood Bow.desc: The Ash Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Ash Wood Hammer.name: Ash Wood Hammer
Ash Wood Hammer.desc: The Ash Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Ash Wood Sword.name: Ash Wood Sword
Ash Wood Sword.desc: The Ash Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Ash Wood Wall.name: Ash Wood Wall
Ash Wood Wall.desc: Ash Wood Wall is a type of background wall crafted using Ash Wood.

Asphalt Block.name: Asphalt Block
Asphalt Block.desc: The Asphalt Block is a unique Hardmode block that multiplies the top speed of players running along it by 3.5×, and doubles the rate of deceleration when slowing down.

Astra Brick.name: Astra Brick
Astra Brick.desc: Astra Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Third Quarter.

Astra Brick Wall.name: Astra Brick Wall
Astra Brick Wall.desc: Astra Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Astra Bricks.

Atlantic Cod.name: Atlantic Cod
Atlantic Cod.desc: Atlantic Cods are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in a Snow biome in any layer.

Autohammer.name: Autohammer
Autohammer.desc: The Autohammer is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Shroomite Bars as well as Mini Nuke I and II. It can be purchased from the Truffle for after Plantera has been defeated.
Autohammer.tip: Converts Chlorophyte Bars into Shroomite Bars

Axe of Regrowth.name: Axe of Regrowth
Axe of Regrowth.desc: The Axe of Regrowth is a pre-Hardmode tool that has the functionalities of the Staff of Regrowth along with the ability to function as an axe and automatically plant Acorns when trees are chopped.
Axe of Regrowth.tip: Creates grass on dirt · Increases alchemy plant collection when used to gather · Plants acorns when cutting down trees

Axearang.name: Axearang
Axearang.desc: The Axearang is a pre-Hardmode axe and boomerang obtained by throwing an Axe of Regrowth into Shimmer. It chops down any tree in its path upon throwing, but not when returning to the player. It can chop down Glowing Mushroom Trees and gem trees, but not Cacti.

Azure Crate.name: Azure Crate
Azure Crate.desc: The Azure Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in Space, e.g. in Floating Lakes. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally found in Skyware Chests (with the exception of the Sky Mill).
Azure Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle.name: Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle
Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle.desc: The Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Grinch that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, a red balloon will carry the Baby Grinch to catch up with them.

Badger's Hat.name: Badger's Hat
Badger's Hat.desc: Badger's Hat is a Hardmode vanity item dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu or the Wall of Flesh when they are both defeated on the same day (from 7:30 PM to 7:30 PM the next day).
Badger's Hat.tip: You seem to have a problem with your green screen · 'Great for impersonating streamers!'

Apprentice Bait.name: Apprentice Bait
Apprentice Bait.desc: Bait is a category of items required for fishing. When a fishing pole is cast, at least one bait item must be in the player's inventory; otherwise, nothing can be caught. Fishing poles will cast their lines with no baits, but there will be no "bites" and no catches.

Journeyman Bait.name: Journeyman Bait
Journeyman Bait.desc: Bait is a category of items required for fishing. When a fishing pole is cast, at least one bait item must be in the player's inventory; otherwise, nothing can be caught. Fishing poles will cast their lines with no baits, but there will be no "bites" and no catches.

Ball O' Fuse Wire.name: Ball O' Fuse Wire
Ball O' Fuse Wire.desc: The Ball O' Fuse Wire is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Dynamite Kitten, which resembles the Orange Tabby variant of the Town Cat, that follows the player.
Ball O' Fuse Wire.tip: Summons a dynamite kitten · 'It's like yarn, but more exciting!'

Balla Hat.name: Balla Hat
Balla Hat.desc: The Balla Hat is a vanity item purchased from the Clothier after the Frost Legion has been defeated.

Ballista Cane.name: Ballista Cane
Ballista Cane.desc: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed.
Ballista Cane.tip: Summons a sentry · A slow but high damage tower that shoots piercing bolts · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Ballista Rod.name: Ballista Rod
Ballista Rod.desc: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed.
Ballista Rod.tip: Summons a sentry · A slow but high damage tower that shoots piercing bolts · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Ballista Staff.name: Ballista Staff
Ballista Staff.desc: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed.
Ballista Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · A slow but high damage tower that shoots piercing bolts · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Balloon Animal.name: Balloon Animal
Balloon Animal.desc: The Balloon Animal is a vanity accessory purchased from the Clothier for while a Party is active. When worn, the Balloon Animal will be shown being held by the player, bobbing up and down.

Balloon Pufferfish.name: Balloon Pufferfish
Balloon Pufferfish.desc: The Balloon Pufferfish is an accessory that has identical function to the Shiny Red Balloon.

Bamboo.name: Bamboo
Bamboo.desc: Bamboo is a placeable block obtained by harvesting Bamboo stalks, which generate naturally in the Jungle biome, with any pickaxe or drill. It can also be found in Jungle and Bramble Crates. Bamboo can be used to craft themed furniture, blocks, and walls.

Bamboo Leaf.name: Bamboo Leaf
Bamboo Leaf.desc: The Bamboo Leaf is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Red Panda to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Red Panda will fly towards them while surfing on a bamboo leaf to catch up to them.

Bamboo Wall.name: Bamboo Wall
Bamboo Wall.desc: Bamboo Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Bamboo Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Banana Split.name: Banana Split
Banana Split.desc: The Banana Split is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Banana Split has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Antlions, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers.
Banana Split.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Make like a banana and split!'

Band of Regeneration.name: Band of Regeneration
Band of Regeneration.desc: The Band of Regeneration is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern biomes and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second.

Barrel.desc: The Barrel is a storage item that has 40 slots for storing items, similar to a Chest.

Barrel Launcher.name: Barrel Launcher
Barrel Launcher.desc: The Barrel Launcher is a Hardmode ranged weapon that fires multi-colored Barrels without consuming any ammunition. The Barrels are heavily affected by gravity, bounce off blocks, and explode upon contact with an enemy or after 180 ticks have passed.
Barrel Launcher.tip: Barrels deal more damage when bounced. · 'Derelict Distillery, 2020 Vintage'

Basilisk Banner.name: Basilisk Banner
Basilisk Banner.desc: The Basilisk is a Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Desert biome. The Basilisk attacks by charging quickly towards the player while being highly resistant to knockback.
Basilisk Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Basilisk

Bass.name: Bass
Bass.desc: Bass are a type of fish which are found plentifully by fishing in any biome that is not the Ocean or Desert in any layer.

Bat Bat.name: Bat Bat
Bat Bat.desc: The Bat Bat is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/300 chance of being dropped by any type of bat. When swung, it restores 1 health to the user upon hitting an enemy.
Bat Bat.tip: Heals user slightly on hit · 'Maybe I could bat some bats with this.'

Bat Hook.name: Bat Hook
Bat Hook.desc: The Bat Hook is a rare pre-Hardmode grappling hook that fires a single hook which reaches 31.25 tiles at maximum length, and has the longest reach of all pre-Hardmode hooks. The Bat Hook has a 149/22500 chance of being obtained from Goodie Bags.

Bernie's Button.name: Bernie's Button
Bernie's Button.desc: Bernie's Button is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns Bernie to follow the player. Bernie's Button can be purchased from the Princess for.
Bernie's Button.tip: Summons a cherished teddy bear · 'My childhood buddy - Bernie!'

Berserker's Glove.name: Berserker's Glove
Berserker's Glove.desc: The Berserker's Glove is a Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Berserker's Glove.tip: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and whips · Increases the size of melee weapons · Enemies are more likely to target you

Betsy's Egg.name: Betsy's Egg
Betsy's Egg.desc: Betsy's Egg is a Hardmode, post-Golem pet-summoning item that spawns Itsy Betsy to follow the player. Betsy's Egg has a 1/4 of being dropped from Betsy in Master Mode.
Betsy's Egg.tip: Summons Itsy Betsy · 'No fire sacrifices required!'

Bezoar.name: Bezoar
Bezoar.desc: The Bezoar is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Poisoned debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Hornets, Moss Hornets, and Toxic Sludges.

Binoculars.name: Binoculars
Binoculars.desc: The Binoculars are a tool that can be held in order to shift the player's view based on the cursor location. They must be placed in the hotbar and selected.

Corruption Key.name: Corruption Key
Corruption Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Corruption Key.tip: Unlocks a Corruption Chest in the dungeon

Crimson Key.name: Crimson Key
Crimson Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Crimson Key.tip: Unlocks a Crimson Chest in the dungeon

Desert Key.name: Desert Key
Desert Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Desert Key.tip: Unlocks a Desert Chest in the dungeon

Frozen Key.name: Frozen Key
Frozen Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Frozen Key.tip: Unlocks an Ice Chest in the dungeon

Hallowed Key.name: Hallowed Key
Hallowed Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Hallowed Key.tip: Unlocks a Hallowed Chest in the dungeon

Jungle Key.name: Jungle Key
Jungle Key.desc: Biome Keys are Hardmode items used to open the Biome Chests in the Dungeon. Opening a Chest consumes the key. Though unusable until Plantera is defeated, they can be dropped at any time during Hardmode.
Jungle Key.tip: Unlocks a Jungle Chest in the dungeon

Birdie Rattle.name: Birdie Rattle
Birdie Rattle.desc: The Birdie Rattle is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Lil' Harpy that follows the player. The Lil' Harpy, when summoned, will fly above and behind the player, and will behave similar to the Zephyr Fish, continually flying around and looking side to side.
Birdie Rattle.tip: Summons a baby harpy · 'Not for your everyday cockatiel'

Bird Banner.name: Bird Banner
Bird Banner.desc: The Bird, Blue Jay, and Cardinal are flying critters that can spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Much like the Vulture, Birds remain still until approached, whereupon they will fly away.
Bird Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Bird

Blue Jay.name: Blue Jay
Blue Jay.desc: The Bird, Blue Jay, and Cardinal are flying critters that can spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Much like the Vulture, Birds remain still until approached, whereupon they will fly away.

Cardinal.name: Cardinal
Cardinal.desc: The Bird, Blue Jay, and Cardinal are flying critters that can spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Much like the Vulture, Birds remain still until approached, whereupon they will fly away.

Black Fairy Dust.name: Black Fairy Dust
Black Fairy Dust.desc: Black Fairy Dust is a crafting material used solely to craft Tattered Fairy Wings. It is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Black Graduation Cap.name: Black Graduation Cap
Black Graduation Cap.desc: The Black Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Black Graduation Cap and the Black Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waxing Gibbous.

Black Graduation Gown.name: Black Graduation Gown
Black Graduation Gown.desc: The Black Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Black Graduation Cap and the Black Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waxing Gibbous.

Black Recluse Banner.name: Black Recluse Banner
Black Recluse Banner.desc: The Black Recluse is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in and around Spider Nests in the Cavern layer. It has a 1/10 chance to inflict the Acid Venom debuff for 4 / 8 / seconds. In Expert Mode, it gains a special spit attack that inflicts the Webbed debuff for 0.5–2.5 seconds.
Black Recluse Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Black Recluse

Black Slime Banner.name: Black Slime Banner
Black Slime Banner.desc: The Black Slime is a variety of slime that only spawns in the Cavern layer. When a Black Slime attacks, it has a chance to inflict the Darkness debuff, which decreases the radius that light sources will illuminate, making it more difficult to see.
Black Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Black Slime

Blackcurrant.name: Blackcurrant
Blackcurrant.desc: The Blackcurrant is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Blackened Fish.name: Blackened Fish
Blackened Fish.desc: The Blackened Fish is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Bladed Glove.name: Bladed Glove
Bladed Glove.desc: The Bladed Glove is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a roughly 1/2000 chance of being dropped by any weak enemy during the Halloween seasonal event. It has a very short range, but an exceptionally high attack speed.

Bladetongue.name: Bladetongue
Bladetongue.desc: The Bladetongue is a Hardmode broadsword that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in the Crimson biome in any layer.
Bladetongue.tip: Spits an Ichor stream on contact

Blend-O-Matic.name: Blend-O-Matic
Blend-O-Matic.desc: The Blend-O-Matic is a crafting station that is purchased from the Steampunker for. it can only be purchased at night. Its sole purpose is to craft Asphalt Blocks which are used to run faster when walked on.

Blessed Apple.name: Blessed Apple
Blessed Apple.desc: The Blessed Apple is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Unicorn Mount, capable of an extra jump as well as the ability to sprint and charge through enemies, damaging them in the process. The Blessed Apple has a 1/40 / 1/30 chance of being dropped by Unicorns.

Blindfold.name: Blindfold
Blindfold.desc: The Blindfold is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Darkness debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Corrupt Slimes, Slimelings, Crimslimes, Dark Mummies, and Blood Mummies.

Blinkroot Seeds.name: Blinkroot Seeds
Blinkroot Seeds.desc: Blinkroot Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Blinkroots while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Blinkroots while they are fully grown. A Blinkroot plant switches between its blooming and non-blooming state at random.

Blizzard in a Balloon.name: Blizzard in a Balloon
Blizzard in a Balloon.desc: The Blizzard in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Blizzard in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.
Blizzard in a Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height

Bone Wand.name: Bone Wand
Bone Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Hive Wand.name: Hive Wand
Hive Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Leaf Wand.name: Leaf Wand
Leaf Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Living Mahogany Wand.name: Living Mahogany Wand
Living Mahogany Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Living Wood Wand.name: Living Wood Wand
Living Wood Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Rich Mahogany Leaf Wand.name: Rich Mahogany Leaf Wand
Rich Mahogany Leaf Wand.desc: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below).

Blood Butcherer.name: Blood Butcherer
Blood Butcherer.desc: The Blood Butcherer is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it inflicts the Blood Butchered debuff upon enemy hits, dealing 4 damage per second for 9 seconds and causing enemies to visibly bleed.

Blood Crawler Banner.name: Blood Crawler Banner
Blood Crawler Banner.desc: The Blood Crawler is a pre-Hardmode enemy commonly found in The Crimson. In addition to walking, it can crawl on background walls.
Blood Crawler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Crawler

Blood Eel Banner.name: Blood Eel Banner
Blood Eel Banner.desc: The Blood Eel is a flying Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Blood Eel or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish.
Blood Eel Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Eel

Blood Feeder Banner.name: Blood Feeder Banner
Blood Feeder Banner.desc: The Blood Feeder is a Hardmode enemy that spawn in pools of water in The Crimson during Hardmode. They have higher stats than Corrupt and Vicious Goldfish.
Blood Feeder Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Feeder

Blood Lust Cluster.name: Blood Lust Cluster
Blood Lust Cluster.desc: The Blood Lust Cluster is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Blood Orange.name: Blood Orange
Blood Orange.desc: The Blood Orange is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Blood Orange.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'A vegan option for vampires'

Blood Squid Banner.name: Blood Squid Banner
Blood Squid Banner.desc: The Blood Squid is a flying Hardmode enemy summoned by the Dreadnautilus during a Blood Moon. It resembles a regular Squid, but is larger, redder-colored, and has multiple eyes on its body, similar to the Drippler. The Dreadnautilus always summons Blood Squids in groups of three.
Blood Squid Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Squid

Blood Zombie Banner.name: Blood Zombie Banner
Blood Zombie Banner.desc: The Blood Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that only spawns during a Blood Moon.
Blood Zombie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Zombie

Bloodbath Dye.name: Bloodbath Dye
Bloodbath Dye.desc: Bloodbath Dye is a dye purchased from the Dye Trader during a Blood Moon for. When applied, it gives the item an appearance similar to dripping blood.

Bloody Machete.name: Bloody Machete
Bloody Machete.desc: The Bloody Machete is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 1/2000 chance of being dropped by any weak enemy during the Halloween seasonal event. When thrown, it falls downward after reaching a medium range, then returns to the player upon contact with a block or an enemy.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Bloody Moscato.name: Bloody Moscato
Bloody Moscato.desc: The Bloody Moscato is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff.
Bloody Moscato.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Not really blood... or is it?'

Blowgun.name: Blowgun
Blowgun.desc: The Blowgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for. It is an indirect upgrade to the Blowpipe. When used, it fires Seeds and darts as ammunition.
Blowgun.tip: Allows the collection of seeds for ammo

Blowpipe.name: Blowpipe
Blowpipe.desc: The Blowpipe is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that has a 1/11 chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer. When used, it fires Seeds and darts as ammunition.
Blowpipe.tip: Allows the collection of seeds for ammo

Blue Acid Dye.name: Blue Acid Dye
Blue Acid Dye.desc: Blue Acid Dye is a dye acquired as a random reward from the Dye Trader for giving him a Strange Plant. When equipped in a dye slot, it applies a dark blue rippling effect that pulses outward, similar to Acid Dye and Red Acid Dye.

Blue Armored Bones Banner.name: Blue Armored Bones Banner
Blue Armored Bones Banner.desc: The Blue Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties, follow the Fighter AI, and can open closed doors after two or five hits.
Blue Armored Bones Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blue Armored Bones

Blue Berries.name: Blue Berries
Blue Berries.desc: Blue Berries are a dye material and type of plant. Placed Blue Berries have the appearance of a blueberry bush. They can grow on regular grass or Jungle grass above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe.

Blue Bikini Bottom.name: Blue Bikini Bottom
Blue Bikini Bottom.desc: The Blue Bikini set is a vanity set consisting of the Blue Bikini Top and the Blue Bikini Bottom.

Blue Bikini Top.name: Blue Bikini Top
Blue Bikini Top.desc: The Blue Bikini set is a vanity set consisting of the Blue Bikini Top and the Blue Bikini Bottom.

Blue Chicken Egg.name: Blue Chicken Egg
Blue Chicken Egg.desc: The Blue Chicken Egg is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Blue Chicken that follows the player. The Blue Chicken Egg can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Blue Chicken Egg.tip: Summons a blue chicken · 'A regular blue chicken egg'

Blue Graduation Cap.name: Blue Graduation Cap
Blue Graduation Cap.desc: The Blue Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Blue Graduation Cap and the Blue Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waning Crescent.

Blue Graduation Gown.name: Blue Graduation Gown
Blue Graduation Gown.desc: The Blue Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Blue Graduation Cap and the Blue Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waning Crescent.

Blue Horseshoe Balloon.name: Blue Horseshoe Balloon
Blue Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The Blue Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 75%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck.
Blue Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Blue Slime Banner.name: Blue Slime Banner
Blue Slime Banner.desc: The Blue Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime, as well at any time in the Underground layer. Blue Slimes only target the player when damaged, during the night, or at any time when underground.
Blue Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blue Slime

Blue Starry Block.name: Blue Starry Block
Blue Starry Block.desc: The Blue Starry Block is an animated decorative block that depicts twinkling blue stars on a black background. It is the blue-themed variant of the Gold Starry Block.

Blue Starry Wall.name: Blue Starry Wall
Blue Starry Wall.desc: Blue Starry Wall is a decorative wall crafted from Blue Starry Blocks. It is one of only a few animated background walls.

Bomb Fish.name: Bomb Fish
Bomb Fish.desc: The Bomb Fish is an explosive that functions identically to the Sticky Bomb, but does not slow down in water. It is obtained through fishing, with the number obtained depending on the player's Fishing Power.
Bomb Fish.tip: A small explosion that will destroy most tiles

Bone Arrow.name: Bone Arrow
Bone Arrow.desc: The Bone Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for each, during moon phases 1 (full), 2, 5 (new), and 6. Bone Arrows can pierce one enemy.

Bone Block.name: Bone Block
Bone Block.desc: Bone Blocks are blocks that are placed by the Bone Wand at the cost of 1 Bone per block.

Bone Block Wall.name: Bone Block Wall
Bone Block Wall.desc: The Bone Block Wall is a type of wall which is crafted from Bones. Despite the naming similarity to Bone Blocks, it has never been able to craft them, nor been used to craft them.

Bone Feather.name: Bone Feather
Bone Feather.desc: The Bone Feather is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material used solely to craft Bone Wings. It has a 1/300 chance of being dropped by any Armored Bones variant (Blue, Rusty, or Hell Armored Bones) in the Dungeon after Plantera has been defeated.

drops.chance: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 0.33% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.22%
(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 0.33% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.22%

Bone Helm.name: Bone Helm
Bone Helm.desc: The Bone Helm is a pre-Hardmode accessory that summons Shadow Hand projectiles to damage enemies. These Shadow Hands spawn a distance from enemies before flying at them, piercing anything in their path including through blocks.
Bone Helm.tip: Summons shadow hands to attack your foes · 'I've got a headache just looking at it.'

Bone Key.name: Bone Key
Bone Key.desc: The Bone Key is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Skeletron Head that follows the player. The Baby Skeletron Head floats around the player and sometimes spins its head, similarly to Skeletron's spinning head attack or the Dungeon Guardians in general.

Bone Lee Banner.name: Bone Lee Banner
Bone Lee Banner.desc: Bone Lee is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It moves at an extraordinary speed, deals large amounts of damage, and has high knockback resistance.
Bone Lee Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Bone Lee

Bone Pickaxe.name: Bone Pickaxe
Bone Pickaxe.desc: The Bone Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe that has a 1/20 chance of being dropped by Undead Miners. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian.
Bone Pickaxe.tip: 'I've got a bone to pick with you'

Bone Rattle.name: Bone Rattle
Bone Rattle.desc: The Bone Rattle is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Face Monster that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Face Monster will appear to hold onto a flying Crimera-like creature to catch up to them.

Bone Serpent Banner.name: Bone Serpent Banner
Bone Serpent Banner.desc: The Bone Serpent is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in The Underworld. Due to their large size, speed, and high damage, they can be dangerous enemies to encounter, especially if they attack while the player is exploring a Ruined House.
Bone Serpent Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Bone Serpent

Bone Sword.name: Bone Sword
Bone Sword.desc: The Bone Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/200 chance of being dropped by Skeletons and Spore Skeletons.

Bone Throwing Knife.name: Bone Throwing Knife
Bone Throwing Knife.desc: The Bone Throwing Knife is a consumable ranged weapon similar to Throwing Knives. Combined with fossil armor, it can be an effective weapon against the Eater of Worlds due to its piercing.

Bone Welder.name: Bone Welder
Bone Welder.desc: The Bone Welder is a crafting station used to craft Bone furniture out of Bones and Gothic furniture out of Gothic Bricks, and can also craft Dungeon Shelves when combined with Ecto Mist.

Book of Skulls.name: Book of Skulls
Book of Skulls.desc: The Book of Skulls is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 36/343 / 1/3 chance of being dropped by Skeletron.

Aetherium Bookcase.name: Aetherium Bookcase
Aetherium Bookcase.desc: Bookcases are a type of flat-surface furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons (the Crystal Storm, Cursed Flames, and Golden Shower) as well as the Librarian furniture out of Librarian Blocks.

Booster Track.name: Booster Track
Booster Track.desc: Booster Tracks are placeable furniture-type blocks that can be placed next to Minecart Tracks to automatically boost the speed of a Minecart that rides over it.
Booster Track.tip: Hammer or signal to change direction

Boreal Crate.name: Boreal Crate
Boreal Crate.desc: The Boreal Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Snow and Ice biome. Boreal Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in Frozen Chests. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Frozen Crate.
