Boreal Wood Breastplate.name: Boreal Wood Breastplate
Boreal Wood Breastplate.desc: Boreal Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Boreal Wood Helmet, Boreal Wood Breastplate, and Boreal Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Boreal Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Boreal Wood Greaves.name: Boreal Wood Greaves
Boreal Wood Greaves.desc: Boreal Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Boreal Wood Helmet, Boreal Wood Breastplate, and Boreal Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Boreal Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Boreal Wood Helmet.name: Boreal Wood Helmet
Boreal Wood Helmet.desc: Boreal Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Boreal Wood Helmet, Boreal Wood Breastplate, and Boreal Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Boreal Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Boreal Wood Bow.name: Boreal Wood Bow
Boreal Wood Bow.desc: The Boreal Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Boreal Wood Hammer.name: Boreal Wood Hammer
Boreal Wood Hammer.desc: The Boreal Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Boreal Wood Sword.name: Boreal Wood Sword
Boreal Wood Sword.desc: The Boreal Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Boreal Wood Wall.name: Boreal Wood Wall
Boreal Wood Wall.desc: Boreal Wood Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Boreal Wood.

Boring Bow.name: Boring Bow
Boring Bow.desc: The Boring Bow is an unimplemented item. It has no name set and will thus display as "ItemName.BoringBow". No other stats, behaviors, or associated projectiles exist for this item.

Bottomless Honey Bucket.name: Bottomless Honey Bucket
Bottomless Honey Bucket.desc: Bottomless Buckets are tools that are capable of placing an infinite amount of liquids by pressing the Left Click button.
Bottomless Honey Bucket.tip: Contains an endless amount of honey · Can be poured out

Bottomless Lava Bucket.name: Bottomless Lava Bucket
Bottomless Lava Bucket.desc: Bottomless Buckets are tools that are capable of placing an infinite amount of liquids by pressing the Left Click button.
Bottomless Lava Bucket.tip: Contains an endless amount of lava · Can be poured out

Bottomless Shimmer Bucket.name: Bottomless Shimmer Bucket
Bottomless Shimmer Bucket.desc: Bottomless Buckets are tools that are capable of placing an infinite amount of liquids by pressing the Left Click button.
Bottomless Shimmer Bucket.tip: Contains an endless amount of Shimmer · Can be poured out

Bottomless Water Bucket.name: Bottomless Water Bucket
Bottomless Water Bucket.desc: Bottomless Buckets are tools that are capable of placing an infinite amount of liquids by pressing the Left Click button.
Bottomless Water Bucket.tip: Contains an endless amount of water · Can be poured out

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.desc: The Boulder is a unique placeable foreground object that is stationary when placed. When unsupported, it falls and begins to roll away, picking up speed and damaging players, enemies, critters, and NPCs along its path.

Boulder Block.name: Boulder Block
Boulder Block.desc: Boulder Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Boulders. Their main use is crafting Boulder furniture and Boulder Walls.

Boulder Wall.name: Boulder Wall
Boulder Wall.desc: Boulder Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Boulder Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Bouncy Bomb.name: Bouncy Bomb
Bouncy Bomb.desc: The Bouncy Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but bounces off blocks more intensely.
Bouncy Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will destroy most tiles · Very bouncy

Bouncy Boulder.name: Bouncy Boulder
Bouncy Boulder.desc: The Bouncy Boulder is a placeable object that begins to roll and bounce when it becomes unsupported. Once it is in motion, it will bounce several times before coming to a stop. Its motion is similar to a Bouncy Bomb but faster, and it does damage like a Boulder.

Bouncy Dynamite.name: Bouncy Dynamite
Bouncy Dynamite.desc: Bouncy Dynamite is an explosive that functions like Dynamite, but bounces off blocks more intensely.
Bouncy Dynamite.tip: A large explosion that will destroy most tiles · 'This will prove to be a terrible idea'

Bouncy Glowstick.name: Bouncy Glowstick
Bouncy Glowstick.desc: The Bouncy Glowstick is a consumable light source that bounces off surfaces while also providing light. Bouncy Glowsticks are the opposite of Sticky Glowsticks, bouncing off of surfaces instead of sticking to them.

Dynasty Bowl.name: Dynasty Bowl
Dynasty Bowl.desc: Bowls are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on flat-surface items. Unlike plates, food cannot be placed in bowls. Only the regular Bowl can be used in crafting.

Glass Bowl.name: Glass Bowl
Glass Bowl.desc: Bowls are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on flat-surface items. Unlike plates, food cannot be placed in bowls. Only the regular Bowl can be used in crafting.

Brain in a Jar.name: Brain in a Jar
Brain in a Jar.desc: The Brain in a Jar is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Spider Brain, a miniature version of the Brain of Cthulhu, that follows the player. The Brain in a Jar has a 1/4 of being dropped by the Brain of Cthulhu in Master Mode.
Brain in a Jar.tip: Summons a spider brain · 'Pickled and shrunken, this brain can no longer hurt you.'

Martian Brain Scrambler Banner.name: Martian Brain Scrambler Banner
Martian Brain Scrambler Banner.desc: The Brain Scrambler is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. It fires green laser projectiles, at a maximum fire rate of once every 0.67 seconds (40 ticks), which have a chance to inflict the Confused debuff.
Martian Brain Scrambler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Brain Scrambler

Brain Scrambler.name: Brain Scrambler
Brain Scrambler.desc: The Brain Scrambler is a Hardmode, post-Golem mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Scutlix Mount. The Brain Scrambler has a 1/30 chance to drop from Scutlix Gunners during the Martian Madness event.

Brain Suckler Banner.name: Brain Suckler Banner
Brain Suckler Banner.desc: The Brain Suckler is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Brain Suckler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Brain Suckler

Bramble Crate.name: Bramble Crate
Bramble Crate.desc: The Bramble Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Jungle. Bramble Crates contain items found in standard crates, and they always contain an item normally found in Ivy Chests within Jungle Shrines. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Jungle Crate.

Brand of the Inferno.name: Brand of the Inferno
Brand of the Inferno.desc: The Brand of the Inferno is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss broadsword. It has a 1/4 chance of inflicting the Hellfire debuff for five seconds on hit and also allows the player to "parry" incoming damage while equipped with a shield.
Brand of the Inferno.tip: Right click to guard with a shield

Breathing Reed.name: Breathing Reed
Breathing Reed.desc: The Breathing Reed is a tool that aids in underwater breathing, and also functions as a broadsword. It has a 9/40 chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates.
Breathing Reed.tip: Increases breath time and allows breathing in water

Brick Layer.name: Brick Layer
Brick Layer.desc: The Brick Layer is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing blocks.

Bride of Frankenstein Dress.name: Bride of Frankenstein Dress
Bride of Frankenstein Dress.desc: The Bride of Frankenstein set is a vanity set that can be obtained from a Goodie Bag with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Bride of Frankenstein Mask and Bride of Frankenstein Dress.

Bride of Frankenstein Mask.name: Bride of Frankenstein Mask
Bride of Frankenstein Mask.desc: The Bride of Frankenstein set is a vanity set that can be obtained from a Goodie Bag with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Bride of Frankenstein Mask and Bride of Frankenstein Dress.

Bubble.name: Bubble
Bubble.desc: Bubbles are animated background furniture blocks, which have special behavior regarding liquids, interacting as if the Bubble was a solid block. When Bubbles are placed together in groups, they connect to make a larger Bubble or more complex structures.

Bubble Machine.name: Bubble Machine
Bubble Machine.desc: The Bubble Machine is a novelty furniture mechanism purchased from the Party Girl for during the day / at any time. When placed, it continuously produces bubbles. These bubbles are purely visual, have no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost.

Bubble Wand.name: Bubble Wand
Bubble Wand.desc: The Bubble Wand is an auto-swing novelty item that produces rainbow-colored bubbles. The bubbles are purely visual, have no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost. The Bubble Wand is purchased from the Party Girl for.

Bubblegum Block.name: Bubblegum Block
Bubblegum Block.desc: The Bubblegum Block is a Hardmode building material crafted from Stone Blocks and Orichalcum Ore. When placed, it resembles Stone Blocks coated with bubblegum. It is essentially the Orichalcum Ore's equivalent of a brick.

Bubblegum Block Wall.name: Bubblegum Block Wall
Bubblegum Block Wall.desc: Bubblegum Block Wall is a background wall crafted from Bubblegum Blocks.

Buccaneer Bandana.name: Buccaneer Bandana
Buccaneer Bandana.desc: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana, Buccaneer Tunic, and Buccaneer Pantaloons.

Buccaneer Pantaloons.name: Buccaneer Pantaloons
Buccaneer Pantaloons.desc: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana, Buccaneer Tunic, and Buccaneer Pantaloons.

Buccaneer Tunic.name: Buccaneer Tunic
Buccaneer Tunic.desc: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana, Buccaneer Tunic, and Buccaneer Pantaloons.

Empty Bucket.name: Empty Bucket
Empty Bucket.desc: Buckets are tools used to carry water, lava, or honey, allowing them to be removed or placed.
Empty Bucket.tip: Can be used to scoop up a small amount of liquid · Collects water in the rain

Bug Net.name: Bug Net
Bug Net.desc: The Bug Net is a tool used to capture most critters as inventory items. It is swung like a broadsword, but it deals no damage. The Bug Net is nearly required in order to go fishing, as it is the initial and primary method of obtaining bait.
Bug Net.tip: Used to catch critters and bait

Buggy.name: Buggy
Buggy.desc: Buggy is one of three critters that occasionally spawn in the Jungle or Underground Jungle biome when a player breaks a plant, the others being Sluggy (more common) and Grubby (most common). Buggy is the rarest of the three.

Bundle of Balloons.name: Bundle of Balloons
Bundle of Balloons.desc: The Bundle of Balloons is an accessory that allows the wearer to perform a quadruple jump, as well as increasing the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%.
Bundle of Balloons.tip: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height

Bundled Party Balloons.name: Bundled Party Balloons
Bundled Party Balloons.desc: Bundled Party Balloons are a vanity accessory purchased from the Clothier for while a Party is active. When worn, the balloons will be shown being held by the player, bobbing up and down.

Bunny.name: Bunny
Bunny.desc: The Bunny is a harmless critter that spawns in the Forest biome. They are the most common critters in Terraria, and are usually the first ones a new player will see.

Bunny Banner.name: Bunny Banner
Bunny Banner.desc: The Bunny is a harmless critter that spawns in the Forest biome. They are the most common critters in Terraria, and are usually the first ones a new player will see.
Bunny Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Bunny

Bunny Cannon.name: Bunny Cannon
Bunny Cannon.desc: The Bunny Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon. It can be purchased from the Pirate for when the Party Girl is present and one of the mechanical bosses has been defeated.
Bunny Cannon.tip: Right click to adjust trajectory · Use a torch or wire signal to fire

Bunny Hood.name: Bunny Hood
Bunny Hood.desc: The Bunny Hood is a vanity headgear item. It has a 1/75 chance of being dropped by Corrupt Bunnies and Vicious Bunny. it can also be dropped by Diseaster Bunnies or Lepus.

Bunny License.name: Bunny License
Bunny License.desc: The Bunny License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for after filling out 45% of the Bestiary.
Bunny License.tip: Use to adopt a bunny for your town · Already have a bunny? · Use additional licenses to activate the Pet Exchange Program! · Find the perfect fit for you and your bunny!

Bunny Ears.name: Bunny Ears
Bunny Ears.desc: The Bunny set is a vanity set composed of the Bunny Tail and Bunny Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a First Quarter or a Waxing Gibbous for.

Bunny Tail.name: Bunny Tail
Bunny Tail.desc: The Bunny set is a vanity set composed of the Bunny Tail and Bunny Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a First Quarter or a Waxing Gibbous for.

Bunny Stew.name: Bunny Stew
Bunny Stew.desc: The Bunny Stew is a food item crafted at the Cooking Pot. When consumed, it grants the Well Fed buff.
Bunny Stew.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'This one's luck has run out.'

Burger.name: Burger
Burger.desc: The Burger is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Burger has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by Crimeras and Eaters of Souls. Statue-spawned Eaters of Souls do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Burger.tip: Major improvements to all stats · '...but wait! It was 99 cents.'

Burning Hades Dye.name: Burning Hades Dye
Burning Hades Dye.desc: Burning Hades Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When applied, it turns the item orange and adds fire effects.

Butcher Banner.name: Butcher Banner
Butcher Banner.desc: The Butcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It slowly builds up speed over time, similarly to an Antlion Charger, and wields a bloodied chainsaw that deals heavy damage to players on contact.
Butcher Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Butcher

Butcher Mask.name: Butcher Mask
Butcher Mask.desc: The Butcher's set is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity set consisting of the Butcher Mask, Butcher's Bloodstained Apron, and Butcher's Bloodstained Pants. Each piece has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Butchers during the Solar Eclipse event.

Butcher's Bloodstained Apron.name: Butcher's Bloodstained Apron
Butcher's Bloodstained Apron.desc: The Butcher's set is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity set consisting of the Butcher Mask, Butcher's Bloodstained Apron, and Butcher's Bloodstained Pants. Each piece has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Butchers during the Solar Eclipse event.

Butcher's Bloodstained Pants.name: Butcher's Bloodstained Pants
Butcher's Bloodstained Pants.desc: The Butcher's set is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity set consisting of the Butcher Mask, Butcher's Bloodstained Apron, and Butcher's Bloodstained Pants. Each piece has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Butchers during the Solar Eclipse event.

Gold Butterfly Jar.name: Gold Butterfly Jar
Gold Butterfly Jar.desc: Butterfly jars are pieces of decorative furniture created by combining a butterfly, captured with a Bug Net, with a Bottle. By throwing a butterfly jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the butterfly as an item.

Hell Butterfly Jar.name: Hell Butterfly Jar
Hell Butterfly Jar.desc: Butterfly jars are pieces of decorative furniture created by combining a butterfly, captured with a Bug Net, with a Bottle. By throwing a butterfly jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the butterfly as an item.

Candy Cane Block.name: Candy Cane Block
Candy Cane Block.desc: Candy Cane Blocks are blocks that are dropped in stacks of 20–49 from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 16.803% in pre-Hardmode and 15.683% in Hardmode. They have no value other than as building material, and in crafting Candy Cane Wall.

Green Candy Cane Block.name: Green Candy Cane Block
Green Candy Cane Block.desc: Candy Cane Blocks are blocks that are dropped in stacks of 20–49 from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 16.803% in pre-Hardmode and 15.683% in Hardmode. They have no value other than as building material, and in crafting Candy Cane Wall.

Candy Cane Pickaxe.name: Candy Cane Pickaxe
Candy Cane Pickaxe.desc: The Candy Cane Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian. It is obtained from Presents dropped during the Christmas event, with a chance of 0.634% in pre-Hardmode and 0.592% in Hardmode.

Candy Cane Sword.name: Candy Cane Sword
Candy Cane Sword.desc: The Candy Cane Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 0.639% (pre-Hardmode) / 0.596% (Hardmode) chance to be obtained from Presents dropped during the Christmas event.

Candy Cane Wall.name: Candy Cane Wall
Candy Cane Wall.desc: Candy Cane Walls are background walls crafted from Candy Cane Blocks. They can only be obtained during Christmas, but will remain in the world after Christmas passes.

Green Candy Cane Wall.name: Green Candy Cane Wall
Green Candy Cane Wall.desc: Candy Cane Walls are background walls crafted from Candy Cane Blocks. They can only be obtained during Christmas, but will remain in the world after Christmas passes.

Candy Corn.name: Candy Corn
Candy Corn.desc: The Candy Corn Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that consumes Candy Corn as ammunition. When used, it rapidly fires Candy Corn shots that pierce up to two enemies and ricochet up to four times, dissipating on their fifth impact or upon hitting a third enemy.

Candy Corn Rifle.name: Candy Corn Rifle
Candy Corn Rifle.desc: The Candy Corn Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that consumes Candy Corn as ammunition. When used, it rapidly fires Candy Corn shots that pierce up to two enemies and ricochet up to four times, dissipating on their fifth impact or upon hitting a third enemy.

Cannon.name: Cannon
Cannon.desc: The Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon, purchased from the Pirate for. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing Left Click key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed). The Cannon fires an arcing Cannonball that explodes upon contact with a block.
Cannon.tip: Right click to adjust trajectory · Use a torch or wire signal to fire

Cannonball.name: Cannonball
Cannonball.desc: The Cannonball is a type of decorative block sold by the Pirate for each.
Cannonball.tip: Hammer to change alignment · Not for use with cannon

Crimson Cloak.name: Crimson Cloak
Crimson Cloak.desc: Capes are vanity accessories which provide no stats or bonuses. Most are purchased from the Traveling Merchant, though the Hunter Cloak can also be purchased from the Clothier and the Prince Cape is exclusively sold by the Princess.

Mysterious Cape.name: Mysterious Cape
Mysterious Cape.desc: Capes are vanity accessories which provide no stats or bonuses. Most are purchased from the Traveling Merchant, though the Hunter Cloak can also be purchased from the Clothier and the Prince Cape is exclusively sold by the Princess.

Capricorn Chestplate.name: Capricorn Chestplate
Capricorn Chestplate.desc: The Capricorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Capricorn Helmet, the Capricorn Chestplate, the Capricorn Hooves, and the Capricorn Tail.
Capricorn Chestplate.tip: 'As protective as glass!' · Concept by R-MK

Capricorn Helmet.name: Capricorn Helmet
Capricorn Helmet.desc: The Capricorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Capricorn Helmet, the Capricorn Chestplate, the Capricorn Hooves, and the Capricorn Tail.
Capricorn Helmet.tip: 'Embodiment of the star's majesty, shiny!' · Concept by R-MK

Capricorn Hooves.name: Capricorn Hooves
Capricorn Hooves.desc: The Capricorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Capricorn Helmet, the Capricorn Chestplate, the Capricorn Hooves, and the Capricorn Tail.
Capricorn Hooves.tip: 'Now you can wear shoes! Maybe!' · Right click to transform · Concept by R-MK

Capricorn Tail.name: Capricorn Tail
Capricorn Tail.desc: The Capricorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Capricorn Helmet, the Capricorn Chestplate, the Capricorn Hooves, and the Capricorn Tail.
Capricorn Tail.tip: 'Sadly, does not provide the ability to swim.' · Right click to transform · Concept by R-MK

Captain Hat.name: Captain Hat
Captain Hat.desc: Captain armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Captain Hat, Captain Vest, and Captain Pants.
Captain Hat.tip: Increases fishing power by 5 · 'You are the captain now'

Captain Pants.name: Captain Pants
Captain Pants.desc: Captain armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Captain Hat, Captain Vest, and Captain Pants.

Captain Vest.name: Captain Vest
Captain Vest.desc: Captain armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Captain Hat, Captain Vest, and Captain Pants.

Carrot.name: Carrot
Carrot.desc: The Carrot is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Bunny that follows the player. If the player gets too far away from the bunny, it will fly at a fast speed while emitting a trail of smoke to catch up to the player.

Carton of Milk.name: Carton of Milk
Carton of Milk.desc: The Carton of Milk is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. The Carton of Milk has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Skeletons and Spore Skeletons. Statue-spawned Skeletons do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Carton of Milk.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'For strong, healthy bones'

Cat Ears.name: Cat Ears
Cat Ears.desc: Cat Ears are a headpiece vanity item that can be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween with a 2/57 chance.

Cat License.name: Cat License
Cat License.desc: The Cat License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for.
Cat License.tip: Use to adopt a cat for your town · Already have a cat? · Use additional licenses to activate the Pet Exchange Program! · Find the perfect fit for you and your cat!

Cat Mask.name: Cat Mask
Cat Mask.desc: The Cat set is a vanity set consisting of the Cat Mask, Cat Shirt, and Cat Pants. It has a 2/57 chance to be dropped by Goodie Bags.

Cat Pants.name: Cat Pants
Cat Pants.desc: The Cat set is a vanity set consisting of the Cat Mask, Cat Shirt, and Cat Pants. It has a 2/57 chance to be dropped by Goodie Bags.

Cat Shirt.name: Cat Shirt
Cat Shirt.desc: The Cat set is a vanity set consisting of the Cat Mask, Cat Shirt, and Cat Pants. It has a 2/57 chance to be dropped by Goodie Bags.

Catacomb.name: Catacomb
Catacomb.desc: The Catacomb is a decorative item that can be placed on background walls in a manner similar to a painting. It resembles a rectangular pit in the wall with a skeleton resting inside.
Catacomb.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Catalyst Band.name: Catalyst Band
Catalyst Band.desc: The Catalyst Band is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Poison Barb and a Philosopher's Stone at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%, and causes arrows fired by the player to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 90 ticks.
Catalyst Band.tip: Reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Arrows inflict poison · Increases damage of afflictions on enemies.

Cattiva.name: Cattiva
Cattiva.desc: Cattiva is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Cattiva minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage.
Cattiva.tip: Summons Cattiva to fight for you · A lovely pal that also helps your mining efforts · Right click to pet it!

Trusty Cattiva.name: Trusty Cattiva
Trusty Cattiva.desc: Cattiva is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Cattiva minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage.
Trusty Cattiva.tip: Summons Trusty Cattiva to fight for you · A lovely pal that also helps your mining efforts · Right click to pet it! · Its trust empowers it, and improved its 'Punch Flurry'!

Cave Bat Banner.name: Cave Bat Banner
Cave Bat Banner.desc: The Cave Bat is a common pre-Hardmode bat enemy found only in the Cavern layer. It is fairly small and can be difficult to hit with certain weapons.
Cave Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cave Bat

Cave Dirt Wall.name: Cave Dirt Wall
Cave Dirt Wall.desc: The Cave Dirt Wall, Craggy Stone Wall, Fractured Stone Wall, Mottled Stone Wall, Old Stone Wall, Rocky Dirt Wall, Rough Dirt Wall, Stalactite Stone Wall, and Worn Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers, considered unsafe.

Celebration.name: Celebration
Celebration.desc: The Celebration is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that fires two firework rocket projectiles at once, consuming one rocket. The firework rockets travel for 45 ticks before exploding. The Celebration can be purchased from the Party Girl for.

Celestial Cuffs.name: Celestial Cuffs
Celestial Cuffs.desc: The Celestial Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which restores mana when the wearer is damaged and increases pickup range for Stars. It also increases maximum mana by 40 and provides 2 defense.
Celestial Cuffs.tip: Increases pickup range for mana stars · Restores mana when damaged · Increases maximum mana by 20

Celestial Magnet.name: Celestial Magnet
Celestial Magnet.desc: The Celestial Magnet is an accessory that greatly increases the pickup range for Stars. The increase in pickup range is 18.75 tiles, extending the base range of 2.625 tiles to 21.375 tiles. This effect does not stack with that of any of the Celestial Magnet's upgrades.
Celestial Magnet.tip: Increases pickup range for mana stars

Celestial Sigil.name: Celestial Sigil
Celestial Sigil.desc: The Celestial Sigil is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist boss-summoning item that summons the Moon Lord when used. It can be used in any biome, at any time. Rather than summoning the Moon Lord instantly, it triggers a 12-second countdown before he spawns.

Celestial Stone.name: Celestial Stone
Celestial Stone.desc: The Celestial Stone is a Hardmode post-Golem accessory crafted from a Moon Stone and a Sun Stone at the Tinkerer's Workshop. It offers the same boosts as its components do, and as such, it is active during both day and night.
Celestial Stone.tip: Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

Celestial Wand.name: Celestial Wand
Celestial Wand.desc: The Celestial Wand is a pet-summoning item that spawns Estee to follow the player. When the player is far enough away, Estee will emit a bright yellow beam trail while flying at high speed in order to catch up to them, which resembles that of a Fallen Star.

Cell Phone.name: Cell Phone

Chicken Bones' Pants.name: Chicken Bones' Pants
Chicken Bones' Pants.desc: It is the vanity set made for Chicken Bones, who is a programmer at Re-Logic and part of the tModLoader development team.

Chicken Bones' Robe.name: Chicken Bones' Robe
Chicken Bones' Robe.desc: It is the vanity set made for Chicken Bones, who is a programmer at Re-Logic and part of the tModLoader development team.

Chicken Bones' Vest.desc: It is the vanity set made for Chicken Bones, who is a programmer at Re-Logic and part of the tModLoader development team.

Chicken Bones' Visor.name: Chicken Bones' Visor
Chicken Bones' Visor.desc: It is the vanity set made for Chicken Bones, who is a programmer at Re-Logic and part of the tModLoader development team.

Chicken Nugget.name: Chicken Nugget
Chicken Nugget.desc: The Chicken Nugget is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Chicken Nugget has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Harpies. Statue-spawned Harpies do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Chicken Nugget.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Caution: may contain harpy.'

Chillet.name: Chillet
Chillet.desc: Chillet and Chillet Ignis are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items. When used, they summon the Chillet or Chillet Ignis mount, respectively, which increases damage dealt by 10% while mounted and is capable of performing "Rocket Slam", a dash.
Chillet.tip: Summons Chillet for a ride! · Empowers your attacks while mounted. · Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam! · Right click to pet it!

Chillet Ignis.name: Chillet Ignis
Chillet Ignis.desc: Chillet and Chillet Ignis are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items. When used, they summon the Chillet or Chillet Ignis mount, respectively, which increases damage dealt by 10% while mounted and is capable of performing "Rocket Slam", a dash.
Chillet Ignis.tip: Summons Chillet Ignis for a ride! · Empowers your attacks while mounted. · Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam! · Right click to pet it!

Trusty Chillet.name: Trusty Chillet
Trusty Chillet.desc: Chillet and Chillet Ignis are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items. When used, they summon the Chillet or Chillet Ignis mount, respectively, which increases damage dealt by 10% while mounted and is capable of performing "Rocket Slam", a dash.
Trusty Chillet.tip: Summons Trusty Chillet for a ride! · Empowers your attacks while mounted. · Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam! · Right click to pet it! · Its trust empowers it, and increases its speed!

Trusty Chillet Ignis.name: Trusty Chillet Ignis
Trusty Chillet Ignis.desc: Chillet and Chillet Ignis are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items. When used, they summon the Chillet or Chillet Ignis mount, respectively, which increases damage dealt by 10% while mounted and is capable of performing "Rocket Slam", a dash.
Trusty Chillet Ignis.tip: Summons Trusty Chillet Ignis for a ride! · Empowers your attacks while mounted. · Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam! · Right click to pet it! · Its trust empowers it, and increases its speed!

Chimney.name: Chimney
Chimney.desc: The Chimney is a decorative structure with a style similar to a Fireplace. It serves no in-game purpose, aside from cosmetics.

Chippy's Cloak (Inactive).name: Chippy's Cloak (Inactive)
Chippy's Cloak (Inactive).desc: Chippy's Cloak (Inactive) is a crafting material used solely to craft Chippy's Cloak. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant along with the rest of Chippy's set.
Chippy's Cloak (Inactive).tip: 'Great for impersonating Terraria Enthusiasts!' · Can be activated with the right materials

Chippy's Couch.name: Chippy's Couch
Chippy's Couch.desc: Chippy's Couch is a furniture item that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Skeletron.
Chippy's Couch.tip: Heeellllllo Terraria enthusiasts! · 'Great for chilling like a streamer!'

Chippy's Chestplate.name: Chippy's Chestplate
Chippy's Chestplate.desc: Chippy's set is a set of vanity items consisting of Chippy's Helmet, Chippy's Chestplate, Chippy's Greaves, and Chippy's Headband. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant.
Chippy's Chestplate.tip: 'Great for impersonating Terraria Enthusiasts!' · 'Stylish, and functional'

Chippy's Greaves.name: Chippy's Greaves
Chippy's Greaves.desc: Chippy's set is a set of vanity items consisting of Chippy's Helmet, Chippy's Chestplate, Chippy's Greaves, and Chippy's Headband. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant.
Chippy's Greaves.tip: 'Great for impersonating Terraria Enthusiasts!' · 'Trousers, not pants'

Chippy's Headband.name: Chippy's Headband
Chippy's Headband.desc: Chippy's set is a set of vanity items consisting of Chippy's Helmet, Chippy's Chestplate, Chippy's Greaves, and Chippy's Headband. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant.
Chippy's Headband.tip: 'Great for impersonating Terraria Enthusiasts!' · 'The remains of a Red Hat'

Chippy's Helmet.name: Chippy's Helmet
Chippy's Helmet.desc: Chippy's set is a set of vanity items consisting of Chippy's Helmet, Chippy's Chestplate, Chippy's Greaves, and Chippy's Headband. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant.
Chippy's Helmet.tip: 'Great for impersonating Terraria Enthusiasts!' · 'To be worn only in battle'

Chlorophyte Greaves.name: Chlorophyte Greaves
Chlorophyte Greaves.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Greaves.tip: 8% increased critical strike chance · 5% increased movement speed

Chlorophyte Headgear.name: Chlorophyte Headgear
Chlorophyte Headgear.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Headgear.tip: Increases maximum mana by 80 and 17% reduced mana cost · 16% increased magic damage

Chlorophyte Helmet.name: Chlorophyte Helmet
Chlorophyte Helmet.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Helmet.tip: 16% increased ranged damage · 20% chance to save ammo

Chlorophyte Mask.name: Chlorophyte Mask
Chlorophyte Mask.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Mask.tip: 16% increased melee damage · 6% increased melee critical strike chance

Chlorophyte Plate Mail.name: Chlorophyte Plate Mail
Chlorophyte Plate Mail.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Plate Mail.tip: 5% increased damage · 7% increased critical strike chance

Chlorophyte Visor.name: Chlorophyte Visor
Chlorophyte Visor.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
Chlorophyte Visor.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 16%

Chlorophyte Brick.name: Chlorophyte Brick
Chlorophyte Brick.desc: Chlorophyte Bricks are Hardmode bricks crafted from Chlorophyte Ore and Stone Blocks.

Chlorophyte Brick Wall.name: Chlorophyte Brick Wall
Chlorophyte Brick Wall.desc: Chlorophyte Brick Walls are Walls that can be manually crafted. When placed, it presents a dark shade of green followed by a gemstone-like pattern.

Chlorophyte Chainsaw.name: Chlorophyte Chainsaw
Chlorophyte Chainsaw.desc: The Chlorophyte Chainsaw is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses chainsaw and the alternative to the Chlorophyte Greataxe.

Chlorophyte Claymore.name: Chlorophyte Claymore
Chlorophyte Claymore.desc: The Chlorophyte Claymore is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword. When swung, a large green aura with a bright edge follows the swing, extending its reach and also covering behind the player.
Chlorophyte Claymore.tip: Emits spore clouds as it is swung · Smashing the ground unleashes many spore clouds

Chlorophyte Drill.name: Chlorophyte Drill
Chlorophyte Drill.desc: The Chlorophyte Drill is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses drill. It is the alternative to the Chlorophyte Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore.

Chlorophyte Dye.name: Chlorophyte Dye
Chlorophyte Dye.desc: Chlorophyte Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It can only be obtained after defeating any mechanical boss. When equipped, it gives items a black and green color palette which glows in the dark.

Chlorophyte Extractinator.name: Chlorophyte Extractinator
Chlorophyte Extractinator.desc: The Chlorophyte Extractinator is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses crafting station and the upgrade to the Extractinator. It has the following upgraded functions:
Chlorophyte Extractinator.tip: Placing some items into the extractinator turns them into something more useful · Place contaminated blocks into the extractinator to purify them · Other items placed inside may have interesting effects · Processes items from adjacent chests when signalled

Chlorophyte Greataxe.name: Chlorophyte Greataxe
Chlorophyte Greataxe.desc: The Chlorophyte Greataxe is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses axe and the alternative to the Chlorophyte Chainsaw.

Chlorophyte Jackhammer.name: Chlorophyte Jackhammer
Chlorophyte Jackhammer.desc: The Chlorophyte Jackhammer is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses hammer.

Chlorophyte Pickaxe.name: Chlorophyte Pickaxe
Chlorophyte Pickaxe.desc: The Chlorophyte Pickaxe is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Chlorophyte Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore.

Chlorophyte Saber.name: Chlorophyte Saber
Chlorophyte Saber.desc: The Chlorophyte Saber is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses shortsword. When swung, the sword is thrusted in repeated stabbing motions, akin to Gladius and Starlight.

Chlorophyte Warhammer.name: Chlorophyte Warhammer
Chlorophyte Warhammer.desc: The Chlorophyte Warhammer is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses hammer.

Chocolate Chip Cookie.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
Chocolate Chip Cookie.desc: The Chocolate Chip Cookie is a Hardmode food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Chocolate Chip Cookie has a 1/75 chance of being dropped by Gastropods.
Chocolate Chip Cookie.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Fresh from the oven'

Blue Light.name: Blue Light
Blue Light.desc: Christmas lights are decorative furniture items and light sources that resemble Christmas string lights and emit very dim light. They can be placed on all four sides of blocks and can be toggled with wires. Christmas lights are purchased from Santa Claus for each.

Green Light.name: Green Light
Green Light.desc: Christmas lights are decorative furniture items and light sources that resemble Christmas string lights and emit very dim light. They can be placed on all four sides of blocks and can be toggled with wires. Christmas lights are purchased from Santa Claus for each.

Red Light.desc: Christmas lights are decorative furniture items and light sources that resemble Christmas string lights and emit very dim light. They can be placed on all four sides of blocks and can be toggled with wires. Christmas lights are purchased from Santa Claus for each.

Christmas Pudding.name: Christmas Pudding
Christmas Pudding.desc: Christmas Pudding is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. Christmas Pudding can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 3.601% in pre-Hardmode and 3.361% in Hardmode.
Christmas Pudding.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'A cozy treat by the fireplace.'

Christmas Tree.name: Christmas Tree
Christmas Tree.desc: The Christmas Tree is a decorative Hardmode furniture item purchased from Santa Claus for. It can be decorated with toppers, garlands, bulbs, and lights to alter its appearance.

Chromatic Cloak.name: Chromatic Cloak
Chromatic Cloak.desc: The Chromatic Cloak is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, touching Shimmer does not immediately inflict the Shimmering debuff, and the player can instead start Shimmering at any time by holding the Down key.
Chromatic Cloak.tip: Grants immunity to Shimmer Phasing · Hold Down to Phase while submerged in Shimmer

Chum Bucket.name: Chum Bucket
Chum Bucket.desc: The Chum Bucket is a consumable item that increases Fishing Power when thrown into a liquid.
Chum Bucket.tip: Toss in water up to 3 times to increase fishing power · 'Plankton!'

Classy Cane.name: Classy Cane
Classy Cane.desc: The Classy Cane is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 chance to be dropped by the Tax Collector. Like the Flymeal, it has the special ability to damage town NPCs, but will always only deal 1 damage to them.

Clay Bud Staff.name: Clay Bud Staff
Clay Bud Staff.desc: The Clay Bud Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Clay Bud minion. The Clay Bud walks and jumps into enemies, dealing contact damage to them when slamming down with its arms.
Clay Bud Staff.tip: Summons a clay bud to fight for you

Clentaminator.name: Clentaminator
Clentaminator.desc: The Clentaminator is a Hardmode tool which can be used to create or destroy biomes. It uses Solutions as ammunition, with each Solution spreading a different biome.
Clentaminator.tip: Creates and destroys biomes when sprayed · Uses colored solution

Climbing Claws.name: Climbing Claws
Climbing Claws.desc: The Climbing Claws are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair. Jumps can also be performed off the sides of blocks. By repeatedly sticking and jumping, vertical blocks can be scaled.
Climbing Claws.tip: Allows the ability to slide down walls · Improved ability if combined with Shoe Spikes

Clinger Banner.name: Clinger Banner
Clinger Banner.desc: The Clinger is a Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Corruption biome. Clingers spawn anchored to a block, with their head attached to an extendable "stem" that does not damage the player.
Clinger Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Clinger

Clockwork Assault Rifle.name: Clockwork Assault Rifle
Clockwork Assault Rifle.desc: The Clockwork Assault Rifle is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it fires in three-shot bursts, with each burst consuming one piece of ammunition.
Clockwork Assault Rifle.tip: Three round burst · Only the first shot consumes ammo

Clothier Voodoo Doll.name: Clothier Voodoo Doll
Clothier Voodoo Doll.desc: The Clothier Voodoo Doll is a boss-summoning item used to summon Skeletron after it has been defeated. It has a 1/300 chance to drop from Angry Bones, Dark Casters, and Librarian Skeletons in the Dungeon.

Clothier's Jacket.name: Clothier's Jacket
Clothier's Jacket.desc: The Clothier's set is a vanity set consisting of the Red Hat, Clothier's Jacket, and Clothier's Pants.

Clothier's Pants.name: Clothier's Pants
Clothier's Pants.desc: The Clothier's set is a vanity set consisting of the Red Hat, Clothier's Jacket, and Clothier's Pants.

Red Hat.name: Red Hat
Red Hat.desc: The Clothier's set is a vanity set consisting of the Red Hat, Clothier's Jacket, and Clothier's Pants.

Cloud in a Balloon.name: Cloud in a Balloon
Cloud in a Balloon.desc: The Cloud in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functionality of the Cloud in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.
Cloud in a Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height

Cloud Wall.name: Cloud Wall
Cloud Wall.desc: The Cloud Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated on Floating Islands. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Clown Banner.name: Clown Banner
Clown Banner.desc: The Clown is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that only appears during Blood Moons.
Clown Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Clown

Clown Hat.name: Clown Hat
Clown Hat.desc: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat, the Clown Shirt, and the Clown Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, once a Clown has been defeated.

Clown Pants.name: Clown Pants
Clown Pants.desc: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat, the Clown Shirt, and the Clown Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, once a Clown has been defeated.

Clown Shirt.name: Clown Shirt
Clown Shirt.desc: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat, the Clown Shirt, and the Clown Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, once a Clown has been defeated.

Cluster Rocket II.name: Cluster Rocket II
Cluster Rocket II.desc: The Cluster Rocket II is a type of rocket ammunition. Unlike the Cluster Rocket I, it destroys tiles. Unique from other rockets, cluster rockets shoot out shrapnel that create several secondary explosions which deal half of the base damage.

Coal.name: Coal
Coal.desc: Coal is an item with no use. It can drop from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 1/30 in pre-Hardmode and 7/225 in Hardmode.

Cobalt Breastplate.name: Cobalt Breastplate
Cobalt Breastplate.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Cobalt Hat.name: Cobalt Hat
Cobalt Hat.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Cobalt Hat.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 10% increased magic damage · 9% increased magic critical strike chance

Cobalt Helmet.name: Cobalt Helmet
Cobalt Helmet.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Cobalt Helmet.tip: 10% increased movement speed · 15% increased melee damage

Cobalt Leggings.name: Cobalt Leggings
Cobalt Leggings.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Cobalt Leggings.tip: 10% increased movement speed and 3% increased damage

Cobalt Mask.name: Cobalt Mask
Cobalt Mask.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Cobalt Mask.tip: 10% increased ranged damage · 10% increased ranged critical strike chance

Cobalt Brick.name: Cobalt Brick
Cobalt Brick.desc: Cobalt Brick is a сobalt tier brick.

Cobalt Brick Wall.name: Cobalt Brick Wall
Cobalt Brick Wall.desc: Cobalt Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Cobalt Bricks.

Cobalt Chainsaw.name: Cobalt Chainsaw
Cobalt Chainsaw.desc: The Cobalt Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Cobalt Waraxe.

Cobalt Drill.name: Cobalt Drill
Cobalt Drill.desc: The Cobalt Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Cobalt Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Mythril and Orichalcum Ore.

Cobalt Naginata.name: Cobalt Naginata
Cobalt Naginata.desc: The Cobalt Naginata is a Hardmode spear.

Cobalt Pickaxe.name: Cobalt Pickaxe
Cobalt Pickaxe.desc: The Cobalt Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Cobalt Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Mythril and Orichalcum Ore.

Cobalt Repeater.name: Cobalt Repeater
Cobalt Repeater.desc: The Cobalt Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Cobalt Sword.name: Cobalt Sword
Cobalt Sword.desc: The Cobalt Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Cobalt Waraxe.name: Cobalt Waraxe
Cobalt Waraxe.desc: The Cobalt Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Cobalt Chainsaw.

Cobwhip.name: Cobwhip
Cobwhip.desc: The Cobwhip is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 60% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Cobwhip.tip: 3 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to summon a tiny spider

Cochineal Beetle Banner.name: Cochineal Beetle Banner
Cochineal Beetle Banner.desc: The Cochineal Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It drops the Red Husk, which can be used to make Red Dye.
Cochineal Beetle Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cochineal Beetle

Gray Cockatiel.name: Gray Cockatiel
Gray Cockatiel.desc: The Yellow Cockatiel and Gray Cockatiel are critters that spawn in the Jungle during the daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree during the day. They may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Yellow Cockatiel.name: Yellow Cockatiel
Yellow Cockatiel.desc: The Yellow Cockatiel and Gray Cockatiel are critters that spawn in the Jungle during the daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree during the day. They may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Coconut.name: Coconut
Coconut.desc: The Coconut is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Coconut.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Are you suggesting that coconuts can migrate?'

Code 1.name: Code 1
Code 1.desc: The Code 1 is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for once the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Code 2.name: Code 2
Code 2.desc: The Code 2 is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Coffee.name: Coffee
Coffee.desc: Coffee is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Coffee has a 1/30 chance of being dropped by Snatchers, Man Eaters, and Angry Trappers, and a 1/10 chance of being dropped by Bone Lees.
Coffee.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Hello darkness my old friend'

Cog Wall.name: Cog Wall
Cog Wall.desc: Cog Walls are a type of background wall made from Cogs. The wall is animated similar to placed cogs.

Coin Ring.name: Coin Ring
Coin Ring.desc: The Coin Ring is a Hardmode accessory created by other accessories exclusively dropped from pirate enemies during Pirate Invasion.
Coin Ring.tip: Increases coin pickup range · Hitting enemies will sometimes drop extra coins

Silver Coin.name: Silver Coin
Silver Coin.desc: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria, primarily used for transactions with NPCs. They are obtained by killing enemies, selling items to or interacting with NPCs, or finding them in multiple forms of loot.

Combat Wrench.name: Combat Wrench
Combat Wrench.desc: The Combat Wrench is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron boomerang that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by the Mechanic. It can pierce multiple targets before returning.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Companion Cube.name: Companion Cube
Companion Cube.desc: The Companion Cube is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Companion Cube that follows the player. The Companion Cube can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Compass.name: Compass
Compass.desc: The Compass is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the player's horizontal position. Position is shown in the number of feet (1 foot = 1/2 tile) to the east or west of the center of the map.

Compass Rose.name: Compass Rose
Compass Rose.desc: The Compass Rose is a decorative item that can be placed on background walls. It is randomly awarded by the Angler NPC for completing quests.

Confetti Block.name: Confetti Block
Confetti Block.desc: The Confetti Block is an animated block type showing falling confetti. It is one of the few items that uses the Crystal Ball as a crafting station. Besides the confetti, it is transparent, like Glass. The Midnight Confetti Block is a dark, non-transparent version of it.

Confetti Gun.name: Confetti Gun
Confetti Gun.desc: The Confetti Gun is a consumable novelty weapon that fires a cloud of colorful confetti. This effect is purely visual and causes no damage or functional effect. Confetti Guns are consumed upon use; they can only be used once each. They are purchased from the Party Girl for each.

Confetti Wall.name: Confetti Wall
Confetti Wall.desc: Confetti Walls are a type of background wall made from Confetti Blocks. They resemble Glass Walls with falling confetti. They are one of only a few animated background walls. Midnight Confetti Walls are an opaque version of them.

Constellation.name: Constellation
Constellation.desc: The Constellation is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist whip. It has a 10% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Constellation.tip: 15 summon tag damage · 15% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with cosmic energy · Cosmic energy grows from enemies hit by summons · Strike again to scatter a constellation of stars

Conveyor Belt (Clockwise).name: Conveyor Belt (Clockwise)
Conveyor Belt (Clockwise).desc: Conveyor Belts (Clockwise and Counter Clockwise) are blocks obtained from Conveyor Slimes or, in Hardmode, purchased from the Steampunker for each. The Conveyor Slime drops only the clockwise variant; however, the two variants are interchangeable via crafting.

Conveyor Belt (Counter Clockwise).name: Conveyor Belt (Counter Clockwise)
Conveyor Belt (Counter Clockwise).desc: Conveyor Belts (Clockwise and Counter Clockwise) are blocks obtained from Conveyor Slimes or, in Hardmode, purchased from the Steampunker for each. The Conveyor Slime drops only the clockwise variant; however, the two variants are interchangeable via crafting.

Cooked Marshmallow.name: Cooked Marshmallow
Cooked Marshmallow.desc: The Cooked Marshmallow is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Cooked Marshmallow.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'How can I have some more of nothing?'

Cauldron.name: Cauldron
Cauldron.desc: The Cooking Pot is a crafting station that is solely used to turn various items into food, consumables that induce the Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied and Exquisitely Stuffed buffs. Such food material include the Bowl of Soup, Cooked Fish, Cooked Shrimp, and Grub Soup.

Cooking Pot.name: Cooking Pot
Cooking Pot.desc: The Cooking Pot is a crafting station that is solely used to turn various items into food, consumables that induce the Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied and Exquisitely Stuffed buffs. Such food material include the Bowl of Soup, Cooked Fish, Cooked Shrimp, and Grub Soup.

Copper Chainmail.name: Copper Chainmail
Copper Chainmail.desc: Copper armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Copper Helmet, Copper Chainmail, and Copper Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Copper Bars (144 Copper Ore). The full set grants 6 defense while equipped.

Copper Greaves.name: Copper Greaves
Copper Greaves.desc: Copper armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Copper Helmet, Copper Chainmail, and Copper Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Copper Bars (144 Copper Ore). The full set grants 6 defense while equipped.

Copper Helmet.name: Copper Helmet
Copper Helmet.desc: Copper armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Copper Helmet, Copper Chainmail, and Copper Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Copper Bars (144 Copper Ore). The full set grants 6 defense while equipped.

Copper Axe.name: Copper Axe
Copper Axe.desc: The Copper Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe. Newly created characters spawn with a Copper Axe (Iron Axe in Journey Mode).

Copper Bar.name: Copper Bar
Copper Bar.desc: The Copper Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Copper Bow.name: Copper Bow
Copper Bow.desc: The Copper Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Copper Brick.name: Copper Brick
Copper Brick.desc: Copper Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material. Like the ore used to make it, placed Copper Bricks will sparkle. As copper becomes fairly useless quite early in the game, this is an inexpensive ore brick to build with.

Copper Brick Wall.name: Copper Brick Wall
Copper Brick Wall.desc: Copper Brick Walls are a type of background wall crafted from Copper Bricks. Like most walls, they will stop enemy spawning, and can be used for NPC houses.

Copper Broadsword.name: Copper Broadsword
Copper Broadsword.desc: The Copper Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Copper Hammer.name: Copper Hammer
Copper Hammer.desc: The Copper Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Copper Ore.name: Copper Ore
Copper Ore.desc: Copper Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Copper Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Copper Pickaxe.name: Copper Pickaxe
Copper Pickaxe.desc: The Copper Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite. Newly created characters spawn with a Copper Pickaxe (Iron Pickaxe in Journey Mode). It can also be purchased from the Merchant for.

Copper Plating.name: Copper Plating
Copper Plating.desc: Copper Plating is a pre-Hardmode brick.

Copper Plating Wall.name: Copper Plating Wall
Copper Plating Wall.desc: Copper Plating Wall is a background wall made of Copper Plating.

Coralstone Block.name: Coralstone Block
Coralstone Block.desc: Coralstone Blocks are decorative blocks. When placed, they can have one of the many kinds of coral on it. Much like Sunplate Blocks, Coralstone Blocks show a special, non-changing image if a square of nine or more are put next to each other.

Corite Banner.name: Corite Banner
Corite Banner.desc: The Corite is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It is a flying enemy that shrouds itself in fire before charging toward the player at high speeds, all while traveling through blocks.
Corite Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corite

Corrupt Bunny Banner.name: Corrupt Bunny Banner
Corrupt Bunny Banner.desc: The Corrupt Bunny is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Bunny that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vile Powder on it or when a Bunny spawns during a Blood Moon in a Corruption world.
Corrupt Bunny Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corrupt Bunny

Corrupt Crate.name: Corrupt Crate
Corrupt Crate.desc: The Corrupt Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in The Corruption. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally dropped by destroying a Shadow Orb. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Defiled Crate.
