Corrupt Goldfish Banner.name: Corrupt Goldfish Banner
Corrupt Goldfish Banner.desc: The Corrupt Goldfish is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Goldfish being corrupted, either by the player using Vile Powder on it or when a Goldfish spawns during a Blood Moon in a Corruption world. Corrupt Goldfish can also spawn naturally in the waters of The Corruption.
Corrupt Goldfish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corrupt Goldfish

Corrupt Grass Wall.name: Corrupt Grass Wall
Corrupt Grass Wall.desc: The Corrupt Grass Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in The Corruption, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, by purchasing it from the Dryad during a Blood Moon for each.

Corrupt Penguin Banner.name: Corrupt Penguin Banner
Corrupt Penguin Banner.desc: The Corrupt Penguin is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Penguin that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vile Powder on it or when a Penguin spawns during a Blood Moon in a Corruption world.
Corrupt Penguin Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corrupt Penguin

Corrupt Seeds.name: Corrupt Seeds
Corrupt Seeds.desc: Corrupt Seeds are seeds used to plant Corrupt grass on Dirt Blocks, which will then spread The Corruption in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for each during a Blood Moon in a world with Corruption.

Corrupt Slime Banner.name: Corrupt Slime Banner
Corrupt Slime Banner.desc: The Corrupt Slime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Corruption and Underground Corruption. It splits into two to three Slimelings upon death.
Corrupt Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corrupt Slime

Corrupt Growth Wall.name: Corrupt Growth Wall
Corrupt Growth Wall.desc: The Corrupt Growth Wall, Corrupt Mass Wall, Corrupt Pustule Wall, and Corrupt Tendril Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Corruption, considered unsafe.

Corrupt Mass Wall.name: Corrupt Mass Wall
Corrupt Mass Wall.desc: The Corrupt Growth Wall, Corrupt Mass Wall, Corrupt Pustule Wall, and Corrupt Tendril Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Corruption, considered unsafe.

Corrupt Pustule Wall.name: Corrupt Pustule Wall
Corrupt Pustule Wall.desc: The Corrupt Growth Wall, Corrupt Mass Wall, Corrupt Pustule Wall, and Corrupt Tendril Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Corruption, considered unsafe.

Corrupt Tendril Wall.name: Corrupt Tendril Wall
Corrupt Tendril Wall.desc: The Corrupt Growth Wall, Corrupt Mass Wall, Corrupt Pustule Wall, and Corrupt Tendril Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Corruption, considered unsafe.

Corruptor Banner.name: Corruptor Banner
Corruptor Banner.desc: The Corruptor is a Hardmode enemy that spawns within The Corruption and resembles a larger version of the Eater of Souls. It intermittently fires Vile Spit projectiles that inflict the Weak debuff.
Corruptor Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corruptor

Cosmic Car Key.name: Cosmic Car Key
Cosmic Car Key.desc: The Cosmic Car Key is a Hardmode, post-Golem mount-summoning item. When used, it summons a rideable UFO Mount that allows the player to fly and hover indefinitely. The Cosmic Car Key has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Cosmic Ember Brick.name: Cosmic Ember Brick
Cosmic Ember Brick.desc: Cosmic Ember Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Waxing Gibbous.

Cosmic Ember Brick Wall.name: Cosmic Ember Brick Wall
Cosmic Ember Brick Wall.desc: Cosmic Ember Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Cosmic Ember Bricks.

Cosmic Skateboard.name: Cosmic Skateboard
Cosmic Skateboard.desc: The Cosmic Skateboard is a Hardmode, post-Golem pet-summoning item that spawns an Alien Skater that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Alien Skater turns its skateboard into a rocket-powered hoverboard to catch up to them.
Cosmic Skateboard.tip: Summons an alien skater · 'Kickflips are a lot easier in Zero-G!'

Countercurse Mantra.name: Countercurse Mantra
Countercurse Mantra.desc: The Countercurse Mantra is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Silenced and Cursed debuffs.
Countercurse Mantra.tip: Grants immunity to Silenced and Cursed

Black Counterweight.name: Black Counterweight
Black Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Black Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Blue Counterweight.name: Blue Counterweight
Blue Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Blue Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Green Counterweight.name: Green Counterweight
Green Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Green Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Purple Counterweight.name: Purple Counterweight
Purple Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Purple Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Red Counterweight.name: Red Counterweight
Red Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Red Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Yellow Counterweight.name: Yellow Counterweight
Yellow Counterweight.desc: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player.
Yellow Counterweight.tip: Throws a counterweight after hitting an enemy with a yoyo

Country Club Cap.name: Country Club Cap
Country Club Cap.desc: The Country Club set is a vanity set. It is purchased from the Golfer for.

Country Club Trousers.name: Country Club Trousers
Country Club Trousers.desc: The Country Club set is a vanity set. It is purchased from the Golfer for.

Country Club Vest.name: Country Club Vest
Country Club Vest.desc: The Country Club set is a vanity set. It is purchased from the Golfer for.

Country Club Visor.name: Country Club Visor
Country Club Visor.desc: The Country Club set is a vanity set. It is purchased from the Golfer for.

Cowboy Hat.name: Cowboy Hat
Cowboy Hat.desc: The Cowboy set is a Hardmode vanity set that includes the Cowboy Hat, Cowboy Jacket, and Cowboy Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, during the first-quarter moon phase.

Cowboy Jacket.name: Cowboy Jacket
Cowboy Jacket.desc: The Cowboy set is a Hardmode vanity set that includes the Cowboy Hat, Cowboy Jacket, and Cowboy Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, during the first-quarter moon phase.

Cowboy Pants.name: Cowboy Pants
Cowboy Pants.desc: The Cowboy set is a Hardmode vanity set that includes the Cowboy Hat, Cowboy Jacket, and Cowboy Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, during the first-quarter moon phase.

Crab Banner.name: Crab Banner
Crab Banner.desc: The Crab is a weak pre-Hardmode enemy found in Oceans, walking along the bottom and occasionally jumping. They may also walk on land, and whether or not they are in water has no effect on their behavior.
Crab Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crab

Cracked Blue Brick.name: Cracked Blue Brick
Cracked Blue Brick.desc: Cracked Dungeon Bricks are bricks which can be found in the Dungeon and appear very similar to ordinary Dungeon Bricks.

Cracked Green Brick.name: Cracked Green Brick
Cracked Green Brick.desc: Cracked Dungeon Bricks are bricks which can be found in the Dungeon and appear very similar to ordinary Dungeon Bricks.

Cracked Pink Brick.name: Cracked Pink Brick
Cracked Pink Brick.desc: Cracked Dungeon Bricks are bricks which can be found in the Dungeon and appear very similar to ordinary Dungeon Bricks.

Crawdad Banner.name: Crawdad Banner
Crawdad Banner.desc: The Crawdad is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has two color variants that share identical stats and behavior. The Crawdad acts like a Crab, walking along the ground and jumping at the player when in close enough proximity, though it is slightly faster.
Crawdad Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crawdad

Crawltipede Banner.name: Crawltipede Banner
Crawltipede Banner.desc: The Crawltipede is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, worm enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. Uniquely, it has no visible health bar, and its tail is the only segment that is vulnerable to attacks, which takes 10× damage.
Crawltipede Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crawltipede

Cream Soda.name: Cream Soda
Cream Soda.desc: The Cream Soda is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Cream Soda has a 1/70 chance of being dropped by Cursed Skulls, and a 1/35 chance of being dropped by Giant Cursed Skulls.
Cream Soda.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'It's so fizzy!'

Creature From The Deep Banner.name: Creature From The Deep Banner
Creature From The Deep Banner.desc: The Creature from the Deep is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It attacks like most other fighter-type enemies on land, but it also has the ability to swim in liquids. While swimming, its speed and maneuverability increase dramatically.
Creature From The Deep Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Creature from the Deep

Creeper Egg.name: Creeper Egg
Creeper Egg.desc: The Creeper Egg is a Hardmode light pet-summoning item that spawns a Flickerwick to follow the player around. When active, it is similar to the Wisp in a Bottle, where it provides light wherever the player goes.
Creeper Egg.tip: Summons a pet flickerwick to provide light

Creeper Mask.name: Creeper Mask
Creeper Mask.desc: The Creeper set is a vanity set consisting of the Creeper Mask, Creeper Shirt, and Creeper Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Creeper Pants.name: Creeper Pants
Creeper Pants.desc: The Creeper set is a vanity set consisting of the Creeper Mask, Creeper Shirt, and Creeper Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Creeper Shirt.name: Creeper Shirt
Creeper Shirt.desc: The Creeper set is a vanity set consisting of the Creeper Mask, Creeper Shirt, and Creeper Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Crescent Wall.name: Crescent Wall
Crescent Wall.desc: Crescent Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Crescent Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Crimera Banner.name: Crimera Banner
Crimera Banner.desc: The Crimera is a common pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns predominantly in The Crimson.
Crimera Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crimera

Crimslime Banner.name: Crimslime Banner
Crimslime Banner.desc: The Crimslime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Crimson. It spawns with either 85%, 100%, or 115% of its usual size, with the stats altered accordingly. it has a chance to inflict the Darkness debuff on contact.
Crimslime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crimslime

Crimson Greaves.name: Crimson Greaves
Crimson Greaves.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Crimtane Bars (180 Crimtane Ore) and 45 Tissue Samples.

Crimson Helmet.name: Crimson Helmet
Crimson Helmet.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Crimtane Bars (180 Crimtane Ore) and 45 Tissue Samples.

Crimson Scalemail.name: Crimson Scalemail
Crimson Scalemail.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Crimtane Bars (180 Crimtane Ore) and 45 Tissue Samples.

Crimson Axe Banner.name: Crimson Axe Banner
Crimson Axe Banner.desc: The Crimson Axe is a Hardmode enemy which is found in the Underground Crimson. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any damage dealt to it stops its attack, forcing it to pause and spin again.
Crimson Axe Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crimson Axe

Crimson Crate.name: Crimson Crate
Crimson Crate.desc: The Crimson Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in The Crimson. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally dropped by destroying a Crimson Heart. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Hematic Crate.
Crimson Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Crimson Grass Wall.name: Crimson Grass Wall
Crimson Grass Wall.desc: The Crimson Grass Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in The Crimson, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, by purchasing it from the Dryad during a Blood Moon for each.

Crimson Heart.name: Crimson Heart
Crimson Heart.desc: The Crimson Heart is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a fast-moving bleeding Crimson Heart that emits dim, red light. It follows the player around while affected by gravity, rolling or hopping along the ground.
Crimson Heart.tip: Summons a heart to provide light

Crimson Seeds.name: Crimson Seeds
Crimson Seeds.desc: Crimson Seeds are seeds used to plant Crimson grass on Dirt Blocks, which will then spread The Crimson in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for each during a Blood Moon in a world with Crimson.

Crimson Tigerfish.name: Crimson Tigerfish
Crimson Tigerfish.desc: Crimson Tigerfish are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in The Crimson in any layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Heartreach Potions.

Crimson Blister Wall.name: Crimson Blister Wall
Crimson Blister Wall.desc: The Crimson Crust Wall, Crimson Scab Wall, Crimson Teeth Wall, and Crimson Blister Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Crimson, considered unsafe.

Crimson Crust Wall.name: Crimson Crust Wall
Crimson Crust Wall.desc: The Crimson Crust Wall, Crimson Scab Wall, Crimson Teeth Wall, and Crimson Blister Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Crimson, considered unsafe.

Crimson Scab Wall.name: Crimson Scab Wall
Crimson Scab Wall.desc: The Crimson Crust Wall, Crimson Scab Wall, Crimson Teeth Wall, and Crimson Blister Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Crimson, considered unsafe.

Crimson Teeth Wall.name: Crimson Teeth Wall
Crimson Teeth Wall.desc: The Crimson Crust Wall, Crimson Scab Wall, Crimson Teeth Wall, and Crimson Blister Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Crimson, considered unsafe.

Crimstone Block.name: Crimstone Block
Crimstone Block.desc: Crimstone is a block type found in The Crimson. Before Hardmode, it is most prominent in the lining of Chasms. It requires at least 65% Pickaxe power or explosives to mine.

Crimstone Brick.name: Crimstone Brick
Crimstone Brick.desc: Crimstone Brick is a type of brick. Unlike its raw block counterpart, the Crimstone Block, it does not spread The Crimson, nor does it turn the area into a Crimson biome, thus making it a safe construction material for NPC houses and other structures.

Crimstone Brick Wall.name: Crimstone Brick Wall
Crimstone Brick Wall.desc: The Crimstone Brick Wall is a placeable item that looks like a blood-stained brick wall.

Crimstone Wall.name: Crimstone Wall
Crimstone Wall.desc: The Crimstone Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in The Crimson, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Crimtane Brick.name: Crimtane Brick
Crimtane Brick.desc: Crimtane Brick is a brick made from Crimtane Ore and Crimstone. A box of it appears after the Wall of Flesh has been defeated in a Crimson world. It is red and black in color, it is not resistant to explosions, and it gives off a faint red glow when placed.

Crimtane Brick Wall.name: Crimtane Brick Wall
Crimtane Brick Wall.desc: The Crimtane Brick Wall is a background wall. It emits faint red light when placed.

Crimtane Ore.name: Crimtane Ore
Crimtane Ore.desc: Crimtane Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It is primarily dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Crimson worlds. Crimtane Ore can also be found rarely in small veins underground.

Crispy Honey Block.name: Crispy Honey Block
Crispy Honey Block.desc: The Crispy Honey Block is a block formed when honey comes into contact with lava. It can also be crafted.

Critter Shampoo.name: Critter Shampoo
Critter Shampoo.desc: Critter Shampoo is a vanity accessory equipped in a social accessory slot that changes the color of summoned minions when paired with a dye in the corresponding dye slot. It is purchased from the Zoologist for after completing at least 30% of the Bestiary.

Crossed Heart Necklace.name: Crossed Heart Necklace
Crossed Heart Necklace.desc: The Crossed Heart Necklace is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Panic Necklace and a Cross Necklace at a Tinkerer's Workshop.
Crossed Heart Necklace.tip: Increases movement speed after taking damage · Increases length of invincibility after taking damage

Crowno's Breastplate.name: Crowno's Breastplate
Crowno's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Crowno, an artist that develops graphics for Terraria.

Crowno's Leggings.name: Crowno's Leggings
Crowno's Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for Crowno, an artist that develops graphics for Terraria.

Crowno's Mask.name: Crowno's Mask
Crowno's Mask.desc: It is the vanity set made for Crowno, an artist that develops graphics for Terraria.

Cryocore Brick.name: Cryocore Brick
Cryocore Brick.desc: Cryocore Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a First Quarter.

Cryocore Brick Wall.name: Cryocore Brick Wall
Cryocore Brick Wall.desc: Cryocore Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Cryocore Bricks.

Crystal Assassin Hood.name: Crystal Assassin Hood
Crystal Assassin Hood.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.
Crystal Assassin Hood.tip: 5% increased critical strike chance · 10% reduced mana cost

Crystal Assassin Pants.name: Crystal Assassin Pants
Crystal Assassin Pants.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.
Crystal Assassin Pants.tip: 20% increased movement speed · 10% increased melee speed

Crystal Assassin Shirt.name: Crystal Assassin Shirt
Crystal Assassin Shirt.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.
Crystal Assassin Shirt.tip: 5% increased damage · 10% chance to save ammo

Crystal Block.name: Crystal Block
Crystal Block.desc: The Crystal Block is a Hardmode decorative building block crafted from Crystal Shards at an Adamantite or Titanium Forge. It has a luminous shade with colors ranging from magenta to blue. It can be made into Crystal Block Walls and other Crystal furniture.

Crystal Block Wall.name: Crystal Block Wall
Crystal Block Wall.desc: The Crystal Block Wall is a type of Wall that can be crafted with Crystal Blocks. It has a purple-blue color, along with a dark tone.

Crystal Dart.name: Crystal Dart
Crystal Dart.desc: The Crystal Dart is a Hardmode dart. It can bounce between enemies and blocks, automatically targeting nearby enemies. The Crystal Dart can either bounce off blocks or hit enemies for a total of 5 times, reducing its damage by 15% per bounce.

Crystal Serpent.name: Crystal Serpent
Crystal Serpent.desc: The Crystal Serpent is a Hardmode wand that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in The Hallow biome in any layer.

Crystal Vile Shard.name: Crystal Vile Shard
Crystal Vile Shard.desc: The Crystal Vile Shard is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it extends a crystal spike from the player's position, which passes through blocks and pierces infinite enemies. It also has 10 armor penetration.
Crystal Vile Shard.tip: Summons a massive crystal spike · Ignores 10 points of enemy Defense

Lunar Cultist Hood.name: Lunar Cultist Hood
Lunar Cultist Hood.desc: The Cultist set is a vanity set purchased from the Clothier for after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated. Its appearance is based on the clothing worn by Cultists, but its design is different from the robes worn either by normal Lunatic Devotees or the Lunatic Cultist itself.

Lunar Cultist Robe.name: Lunar Cultist Robe
Lunar Cultist Robe.desc: The Cultist set is a vanity set purchased from the Clothier for after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated. Its appearance is based on the clothing worn by Cultists, but its design is different from the robes worn either by normal Lunatic Devotees or the Lunatic Cultist itself.

Solar Cultist Hood.name: Solar Cultist Hood
Solar Cultist Hood.desc: The Cultist set is a vanity set purchased from the Clothier for after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated. Its appearance is based on the clothing worn by Cultists, but its design is different from the robes worn either by normal Lunatic Devotees or the Lunatic Cultist itself.

Solar Cultist Robe.name: Solar Cultist Robe
Solar Cultist Robe.desc: The Cultist set is a vanity set purchased from the Clothier for after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated. Its appearance is based on the clothing worn by Cultists, but its design is different from the robes worn either by normal Lunatic Devotees or the Lunatic Cultist itself.

Blue Cultist Archer Banner.name: Blue Cultist Archer Banner
Blue Cultist Archer Banner.desc: The Cultists are Hardmode, post-Golem enemies that spawn along with a Mysterious Tablet at the entrance to the Dungeon after Golem has been defeated. Four Cultists will appear there: two Cultist Archers and two Lunatic Devotees.
Blue Cultist Archer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cultist Archer

Lunatic Devotee Banner.name: Lunatic Devotee Banner
Lunatic Devotee Banner.desc: The Cultists are Hardmode, post-Golem enemies that spawn along with a Mysterious Tablet at the entrance to the Dungeon after Golem has been defeated. Four Cultists will appear there: two Cultist Archers and two Lunatic Devotees.
Lunatic Devotee Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lunatic Devotee

Chalice.name: Chalice
Chalice.desc: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table, Work Bench, or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations.

Dynasty Cup.name: Dynasty Cup
Dynasty Cup.desc: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table, Work Bench, or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations.

Honey Cup.name: Honey Cup
Honey Cup.desc: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table, Work Bench, or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations.

Wine Glass.name: Wine Glass
Wine Glass.desc: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table, Work Bench, or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations.

Cursed Flames.name: Cursed Flames
Cursed Flames.desc: The Cursed Flames are a Hardmode spell book that fire gravity-affected bouncing green fireballs. The fireballs can bounce off blocks four times and pierce enemies once, and they inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, dealing 24 damage per second.

Cursed Hammer Banner.name: Cursed Hammer Banner
Cursed Hammer Banner.desc: The Cursed Hammer is a Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Underground Corruption. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any damage dealt to it stops its attack, forcing it to pause and spin again.
Cursed Hammer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cursed Hammer

Cursed Piper Flute.name: Cursed Piper Flute
Cursed Piper Flute.desc: The Cursed Piper Flute is a transformation mount item that turns the player into a Rat. While in this form, the player has a small hitbox and can fit in 1-tile gaps, but loses their ability to use items; using items will result in the player dismounting and returning to normal.
Cursed Piper Flute.tip: Inflicts the bearer with the nature of the rat

Cursed Sapling.name: Cursed Sapling
Cursed Sapling.desc: The Cursed Sapling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Cursed Sapling that follows the player. It appears as a small, dark blue tree stump with a jagged head, a jack-o-lantern face, and roots on which it walks.
Cursed Sapling.tip: Summons a cursed sapling to follow you

Cursed Skull Banner.name: Cursed Skull Banner
Cursed Skull Banner.desc: The Cursed Skull is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns in the Dungeon. It is similar to the Meteor Head, with high damage, slow speed, and the ability to travel through tiles.
Cursed Skull Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cursed Skull

Cutlass.name: Cutlass
Cutlass.desc: The Cutlass is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/200 chance of being dropped by regular Pirate Invasion enemies (excluding the Parrot), a 1/50 chance from Pirate Captains, and a 1/10 chance from the Flying Dutchman.

Cyan Beetle Banner.name: Cyan Beetle Banner
Cyan Beetle Banner.desc: The Cyan Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome in the Cavern Layer. When killed, it will always drop the Cyan Husk, which can be used to craft Cyan Dye.
Cyan Beetle Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Cyan Beetle

Cyan Husk.name: Cyan Husk
Cyan Husk.desc: The Cyan Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cyan Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Snow biome. Its sole purpose is to make Cyan Dye.

Cyborg Helmet.name: Cyborg Helmet
Cyborg Helmet.desc: The Cyborg set is a vanity set which consists of the Cyborg Helmet, Cyborg Shirt, and Cyborg Pants, resembling the Cyborg NPC.

Cyborg Pants.name: Cyborg Pants
Cyborg Pants.desc: The Cyborg set is a vanity set which consists of the Cyborg Helmet, Cyborg Shirt, and Cyborg Pants, resembling the Cyborg NPC.

Cyborg Shirt.name: Cyborg Shirt
Cyborg Shirt.desc: The Cyborg set is a vanity set which consists of the Cyborg Helmet, Cyborg Shirt, and Cyborg Pants, resembling the Cyborg NPC.

D-Town's Breastplate.name: D-Town's Breastplate
D-Town's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for D-Town, the Business Director at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, as well as a glow effect similar to Spooky armor.

D-Town's Helmet.name: D-Town's Helmet
D-Town's Helmet.desc: It is the vanity set made for D-Town, the Business Director at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, as well as a glow effect similar to Spooky armor.

D-Town's Leggings.name: D-Town's Leggings
D-Town's Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for D-Town, the Business Director at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, as well as a glow effect similar to Spooky armor.

Damage Booster.name: Damage Booster
Damage Booster.desc: The Damage Booster is one of the three power-ups occasionally dropped when striking enemies while wearing a full set of Nebula armor. When picked up, it grants the Damage Nebula buff which immediately provides the player with a 15% damage boost for 8 seconds.

Damselfish.name: Damselfish
Damselfish.desc: Damselfish are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in pure Space layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Calming Potions.

Dark Artist's Hat.name: Dark Artist's Hat
Dark Artist's Hat.desc: Dark Artist armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Dark Artist's Hat, Dark Artist's Robes, and Dark Artist's Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Dark Artist's Hat.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 2 · 15% increased summon & magic damage

Dark Artist's Leggings.name: Dark Artist's Leggings
Dark Artist's Leggings.desc: Dark Artist armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Dark Artist's Hat, Dark Artist's Robes, and Dark Artist's Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Dark Artist's Leggings.tip: 20% increased summon damage and 25% increased magic critical strike chance · 20% increased movement speed

Dark Artist's Robes.name: Dark Artist's Robes
Dark Artist's Robes.desc: Dark Artist armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Dark Artist's Hat, Dark Artist's Robes, and Dark Artist's Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Dark Artist's Robes.tip: 25% increased summon damage and 10% increased magic damage · 15% reduced mana cost

Dark Caster Banner.name: Dark Caster Banner
Dark Caster Banner.desc: The Dark Caster is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Dungeon. They follow the Caster AI, firing three Water Sphere projectiles before teleporting to another on-screen location. Water Spheres travel through walls but can be destroyed with a single hit from any weapon.
Dark Caster Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dark Caster

Dark Celestial Brick.name: Dark Celestial Brick
Dark Celestial Brick.desc: Dark Celestial Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Waning Crescent.

Dark Celestial Brick Wall.name: Dark Celestial Brick Wall
Dark Celestial Brick Wall.desc: Dark Celestial Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Dark Celestial Bricks.

Dark Mage's Tome.name: Dark Mage's Tome
Dark Mage's Tome.desc: The Dark Mage's Tome is a mount-summoning item that places the player on a Book Mount which grants limited flight. The Dark Mage's Tome has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Dark Mage in Master Mode.
Dark Mage's Tome.tip: Summons a magic tome mount · 'A book said to be at its holder's behest.'

Dart Trap.name: Dart Trap
Dart Trap.desc: The Dart Trap is a trap that can be found naturally placed in Cavern layer and Dungeon. It fires a dart when triggered via wire which does not consume any ammunition. It has a cooldown of 31/3 seconds / 3 seconds between firing.

Daybloom Seeds.name: Daybloom Seeds
Daybloom Seeds.desc: Daybloom Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Dayblooms while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Dayblooms while they are fully grown. Daybloom will only bloom during daytime, showing off a sunflower-like head.

Daybloom Staff.name: Daybloom Staff
Daybloom Staff.desc: The Daybloom Staff is an early pre-Hardmode wand which fires a short ranged burst of 4 non-piercing yellow pellets toward the cursor with slight inaccuracy.
Daybloom Staff.tip: Shoots small magical pellets · 'Full of hopes, dreams, and sticky gel!'

Daybreak.name: Daybreak
Daybreak.desc: The Daybreak is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist melee weapon that fires a gravity-affected sun spear projectile. It sticks onto the targeted enemy upon contact, dealing damage and inflicting the Daybroken debuff, which deals 100 damage per second for a duration of 5 seconds.
Daybreak.tip: 'Rend your foes asunder with a spear of light!'

Deactivated Probe.name: Deactivated Probe
Deactivated Probe.desc: The Deactivated Probe is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Destroyer-Lite, a miniature version of The Destroyer that follows the player. The Deactivated Probe has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by The Destroyer in Master Mode.
Deactivated Probe.tip: Summons a miniature tool of destruction · 'It's safe to operate this, right?'

Dead Man's Chest.name: Dead Man's Chest
Dead Man's Chest.desc: The Dead Man's Chest is a naturally-generated Chest rigged with a large variety of traps in order to kill the player upon opening it.

Dead Man's Sweater.name: Dead Man's Sweater
Dead Man's Sweater.desc: The Dead Man's Sweater is an armor item with a 1/3 chance of being found inside Dead Man's Chests. It provides 4 defense, and reduces the duration of the debuffs inflicted by trap projectiles and the damage dealt by them by 50%.
Dead Man's Sweater.tip: 50% reduced damage and debuff time from traps

Deadly Sphere Banner.name: Deadly Sphere Banner
Deadly Sphere Banner.desc: The Deadly Sphere is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Upon spawning, it flies randomly in the direction of the player until it is within close enough proximity while traveling through blocks.
Deadly Sphere Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Deadly Sphere

Deadly Sphere Staff.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
Deadly Sphere Staff.desc: The Deadly Sphere Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Deadly Sphere minion. It flies and charges through enemies at a high velocity but cannot move through blocks.
Deadly Sphere Staff.tip: Summons a deadly sphere to fight for you

Deathbringer Pickaxe.name: Deathbringer Pickaxe
Deathbringer Pickaxe.desc: The Deathbringer Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode, post-Brain of Cthulhu pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Hellstone, Crimstone Blocks, and Ebonstone Blocks.

Deathweed Seeds.name: Deathweed Seeds
Deathweed Seeds.desc: Deathweed Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Deathweeds while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Deathweeds while they are fully grown. A Deathweed plant only blooms during Blood Moons and Full Moons.

Decay Chamber.name: Decay Chamber
Decay Chamber.desc: The Decay Chamber is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Lesion furniture (Corruption-themed furniture) out of Lesion Blocks. The Decay Chamber can be purchased from the Steampunker for but only appears for sale in worlds that are generated with The Corruption.

Decorative Cobweb.name: Decorative Cobweb
Decorative Cobweb.desc: Decorative Cobweb is a building material that is visually identical to Cobwebs, with the exception that it is not destroyed by weapons, projectiles, or contact with entities. Additionally, it does not slow down entities on contact.
Decorative Cobweb.tip: Is neither sticky nor broken by weapons · 'For display purposes only!'

Decorative Healing Potion.name: Decorative Healing Potion
Decorative Healing Potion.desc: The Decorative Healing Potion is a furniture item and crafting station that can only be placed on flat-surface items. It generates naturally on Dungeon shelves, and drops a Lesser Healing Potion when mined. It shares recipes with Placed Bottles.

Decorative Mana Potion.name: Decorative Mana Potion
Decorative Mana Potion.desc: The Decorative Mana Potion is a furniture item and crafting station that can only be placed on flat-surface items. It generates naturally on Dungeon shelves, and drops a Lesser Mana Potion when mined. It shares recipes with Placed Bottles.

Deer Thing.name: Deer Thing
Deer Thing.desc: The Deer Thing is a boss-summoning item that summons Deerclops when used. It can only be used in the Snow or Ice biome, at any time.

Deerclops Eyeball.name: Deerclops Eyeball
Deerclops Eyeball.desc: The Deerclops Eyeball is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Tiny Deerclops that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, Tiny Deerclops flies while holding onto a bird to catch up with them.
Deerclops Eyeball.tip: Summons a tiny Deerclops · 'You lookin' at me? Are YOU lookin' at ME?'

Defender Medal.name: Defender Medal
Defender Medal.desc: Defender Medals are a form of currency used to purchase items from the Tavernkeep. They are obtained in the Old One's Army event, being dropped by the Eternia Crystal at the end of each wave, beginning with the third wave.
Defender Medal.tip: Currency for trading with the Tavernkeep

Defender's Forge.name: Defender's Forge
Defender's Forge.desc: The Defender's Forge is a portable, personal storage item which is purchased from the Tavernkeep for.
Defender's Forge.tip: Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops

Defiled Crate.name: Defiled Crate
Defiled Crate.desc: The Defiled Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in The Corruption. Defiled Crates contain items found in standard crates, and additionally always drop an item normally obtained by destroying a Shadow Orb. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Corrupt Crate.
Defiled Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Demon Banner.name: Demon Banner
Demon Banner.desc: The Demon is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in The Underworld. It attacks by summoning volleys of four spinning purple blades that gradually accelerate toward the player, which are similar to those fired by the Demon Scythe that it has a chance to drop.
Demon Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Demon

Demon Eye Banner.name: Demon Eye Banner
Demon Eye Banner.desc: The Demon Eye is a common pre-Hardmode flying enemy that appears in most surface biomes during nighttime, particularly in Forests. It has a slow turn rate, follows the player, and bounces off blocks. Its trajectory is changed when hit with a weapon that causes knockback.
Demon Eye Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Demon Eye

Demon Heart.name: Demon Heart
Demon Heart.desc: The Demon Heart is a Hardmode permanent booster item that permanently grants the player an extra accessory slot, for use only within Expert and Master Mode worlds. This effect does not stack and may only be used once per player.
Demon Heart.tip: Permanently increases the number of accessory slots

Demon Horns.name: Demon Horns
Demon Horns.desc: The Demon Horns are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Demonite Brick.name: Demonite Brick
Demonite Brick.desc: Demonite Brick is a brick crafted from Demonite Ore and Ebonstone. A box of it also appears after the Wall of Flesh has been defeated on a Corruption world ( in any type of world). It is not resistant to explosions, and gives off a faint glow when placed.

Demonite Brick Wall.name: Demonite Brick Wall
Demonite Brick Wall.desc: Demonite Brick Wall is a wall crafted from a Demonite Brick. It emits a faint blue glow when placed.

Demonite Ore.name: Demonite Ore
Demonite Ore.desc: Demonite Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It is primarily dropped from the Eater of Worlds, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Corruption worlds. Demonite Ore can also be found rarely in small veins underground.

Depth Meter.name: Depth Meter
Depth Meter.desc: The Depth Meter is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the player's vertical position, or depth. Depth is relative to the boundary between the Surface and Underground layers, which has a depth of 0 and is displayed as "GameUI.DepthLevel".

Derpling Banner.name: Derpling Banner
Derpling Banner.desc: The Derpling is a Hardmode, insect-like enemy which spawns on the surface Jungle during the day in place of the Giant Flying Foxes which spawn at night. It jumps high, can strafe to the sides in mid-air, and attempts to land on top of the player.
Derpling Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Derpling

Desert Fossil.name: Desert Fossil
Desert Fossil.desc: Desert Fossil is a type of block found in the Underground Desert biome in medium to large veins. Desert Fossils can be used with an Extractinator or Chlorophyte Extractinator to produce Sturdy Fossils, along with regular Extractinator drops.

Desert Fossil Wall.name: Desert Fossil Wall
Desert Fossil Wall.desc: The Desert Fossil Wall is a type of background wall that can be crafted from Desert Fossils.

Desert Spirit Banner.name: Desert Spirit Banner
Desert Spirit Banner.desc: The Desert Spirit is a Hardmode enemy that can be found in Corrupted or Crimson Underground Desert biomes. The Desert Spirit has an attack pattern that is unique compared to most enemies.
Desert Spirit Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Desert Spirit

Detonator.name: Detonator
Detonator.desc: Detonators are activation Mechanisms that can be found underground as part of Traps, wired to Explosives. They are often found planted on top of suspiciously large veins of underground metals (E.g. Silver).
Detonator.tip: Right click when placed to signal · 'Guts... and Gory!'

Devil Horns.name: Devil Horns
Devil Horns.desc: The Devil Horns are a vanity item that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Devourer Banner.name: Devourer Banner
Devourer Banner.desc: The Devourer is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in the Corruption, though it is less common than the abundant Eaters of Souls. Like other worms, it attacks by burrowing through blocks to reach the player.
Devourer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Devourer

Diabolist Banner.name: Diabolist Banner
Diabolist Banner.desc: The Diabolist is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks by firing Inferno Bolts at the player, which can travel through blocks.
Diabolist Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Diabolist

Diamond Ring.name: Diamond Ring
Diamond Ring.desc: The Diamond Ring is a vanity accessory. When worn, it places a blue dot on each of the player's wrists. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Diamond Staff.name: Diamond Staff
Diamond Staff.desc: The Diamond Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a bright white bolt which can pierce once and has a deceivingly large hitbox.
Diamond Staff.tip: Diamonds shine brilliantly · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Digging Molecart.name: Digging Molecart
Digging Molecart.desc: The Digging Molecart is a minecart that automatically digs a tunnel and lays down regular Minecart Tracks. It is sold by the Zoologist for once the Bestiary is 25% completed.
Digging Molecart.tip: Will dig through blocks and lay new track if carrying minecart tracks · Only digs when underground

Digtoise.name: Digtoise
Digtoise.desc: Digtoise is a pre-Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Digtoise that follows the player. While holding the item, pressing Left Click causes it to roll in the direction of the cursor.
Digtoise.tip: Summons Digtoise to help mining! · Left click to direct Digtoise · Right click away to recall Digtoise · Right click to pet it!

Trusty Digtoise.name: Trusty Digtoise
Trusty Digtoise.desc: Digtoise is a pre-Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Digtoise that follows the player. While holding the item, pressing Left Click causes it to roll in the direction of the cursor.
Trusty Digtoise.tip: Summons Trusty Digtoise to help mining! · Left click to direct Digtoise · Right click away to recall Digtoise · Right click to pet it! · Its trust empowers it, and it now matches your pickaxe power!

Dirt Bomb.name: Dirt Bomb
Dirt Bomb.desc: The Dirt Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but its explosion will place Dirt Blocks in open spaces, instead of destroying blocks. Existing blocks within the explosion radius will remain unaffected.
Dirt Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will spread dirt

Dirt Rod.name: Dirt Rod
Dirt Rod.desc: The Dirt Rod is a unique tool that is used solely to move Dirt Blocks around, and is unlike the use of ordinary mining tools and block placement.

Dirt Wall.name: Dirt Wall
Dirt Wall.desc: The Dirt Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in most caves and under overhangs on the surface, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Natural Dirt Wall.name: Natural Dirt Wall
Natural Dirt Wall.desc: The Dirt Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in most caves and under overhangs on the surface, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.
Natural Dirt Wall.tip: A dangerous clump of dirt wall that will spawn monsters

Cracked Dirt Wall.name: Cracked Dirt Wall
Cracked Dirt Wall.desc: The Cracked Dirt Wall, Crumbling Dirt Wall, Layered Dirt Wall, and Wavy Dirt Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Crumbling Dirt Wall.name: Crumbling Dirt Wall
Crumbling Dirt Wall.desc: The Cracked Dirt Wall, Crumbling Dirt Wall, Layered Dirt Wall, and Wavy Dirt Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Layered Dirt Wall.name: Layered Dirt Wall
Layered Dirt Wall.desc: The Cracked Dirt Wall, Crumbling Dirt Wall, Layered Dirt Wall, and Wavy Dirt Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Wavy Dirt Wall.name: Wavy Dirt Wall
Wavy Dirt Wall.desc: The Cracked Dirt Wall, Crumbling Dirt Wall, Layered Dirt Wall, and Wavy Dirt Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Disc Wall.name: Disc Wall
Disc Wall.desc: The Disc Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated on Floating Islands. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Disco Ball.name: Disco Ball
Disco Ball.desc: The Disco Ball is a novelty Hardmode light source that can be placed on the underside of blocks, generating short pulses of colored light that cycle through the spectrum (the Disco Ball will cycle through red, green, and blue only). The light can be toggled with wires.

Discount Card.name: Discount Card
Discount Card.desc: The Discount Card is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it reduces NPC shop buy prices, Nurse healing, and reforging prices by 1/5. The card must be equipped before talking to an NPC to enable discounts.

Divine Crate.name: Divine Crate
Divine Crate.desc: The Divine Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in The Hallow. Divine Crates contain items found in standard crates, and additionally have a chance to drop Crystal Shards or Souls of Light.
Divine Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Diving Gear.name: Diving Gear
Diving Gear.desc: The Diving Gear is an accessory that combines the functionality of the Flipper and Diving Helmet:
Diving Gear.tip: Grants the ability to swim · Greatly extends underwater breathing

Diving Helmet.name: Diving Helmet
Diving Helmet.desc: The Diving Helmet is an armor piece for the helmet slot. It has a 1/20 chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas. When equipped, it causes the breath meter to deplete much slower and slows the rate at which drowning damage is taken.

Dizzy's Rare Gecko Chester.name: Dizzy's Rare Gecko Chester
Dizzy's Rare Gecko Chester.desc: Dizzy's Rare Gecko Chester is a vanity item that has a 1/14 chance of being dropped by Deerclops.
Dizzy's Rare Gecko Chester.tip: 'The Blue Traktor is coming' · 'Great for impersonating streamers!'

Djinn's Curse.name: Djinn's Curse
Djinn's Curse.desc: Djinn's Curse is a Hardmode armor item that can be equipped in the "pants" slot. It visually replaces the player's feet with a genie-like effect, similar to the Desert Spirit's appearance.
Djinn's Curse.tip: Grants slow fall in exchange for your feet

Doctor Bones Banner.name: Doctor Bones Banner
Doctor Bones Banner.desc: Doctor Bones is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that rarely appears in the Jungle and Underground Jungle at night.
Doctor Bones Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Doctor Bones

Dog License.name: Dog License
Dog License.desc: The Dog License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for after filling out 25% of the Bestiary.
Dog License.tip: Use to adopt a dog for your town · Already have a dog? · Use additional licenses to activate the Pet Exchange Program! · Find the perfect fit for you and your dog!

Dog Ears.name: Dog Ears
Dog Ears.desc: The Dog set is a vanity set composed of the Dog Tail and Dog Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a Full Moon or a Waning Gibbous for.

Dog Tail.name: Dog Tail
Dog Tail.desc: The Dog set is a vanity set composed of the Dog Tail and Dog Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a Full Moon or a Waning Gibbous for.

Dog Whistle.name: Dog Whistle
Dog Whistle.desc: The Dog Whistle is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Puppy that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Puppy flies by twirling its tail like a propeller to catch up to them.

Double Cod.name: Double Cod
Double Cod.desc: Double Cod are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in the Sky or Surface layers of the Jungle. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Ammo Reservation Potions.

Dr. Man Fly Banner.name: Dr. Man Fly Banner
Dr. Man Fly Banner.desc: Dr. Man Fly is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. He mainly attacks by throwing Toxic Flasks at the player, dealing area-of-effect damage. He gives the player a warning about an oncoming Toxic Flask attack by pausing in place.
Dr. Man Fly Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dr. Man Fly

Dr. Man Fly Mask.name: Dr. Man Fly Mask
Dr. Man Fly Mask.desc: The Dr. Man Fly set is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity set consisting of the Dr. Man Fly Mask and the Dr. Man Fly's Lab Coat. Each piece has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Dr. Man Flies during the Solar Eclipse event.

Dr. Man Fly's Lab Coat.name: Dr. Man Fly's Lab Coat
Dr. Man Fly's Lab Coat.desc: The Dr. Man Fly set is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity set consisting of the Dr. Man Fly Mask and the Dr. Man Fly's Lab Coat. Each piece has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Dr. Man Flies during the Solar Eclipse event.

Dragon Fruit.name: Dragon Fruit
Dragon Fruit.desc: The Dragon Fruit is a Hardmode food and fruit item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.

Black Dragonfly.name: Black Dragonfly
Black Dragonfly.desc: Dragonflies are small, rare critters which can be found on surface. When approached, they will fly a short distance up and away from the player.

Black Dragonfly Jar.desc: A dragonfly jar is a piece of decorative furniture created by combining a dragonfly, captured with any Bug Net, with a Bottle. By throwing a dragonfly jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the dragonfly as an item.

Drakin Banner.name: Drakin Banner
Drakin Banner.desc: The Drakin is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 4–7, and Tier 3 during waves 3–7.
Drakin Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Drakin

Drakomire Banner.name: Drakomire Banner
Drakomire Banner.desc: The Drakomire is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, ground-based enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It periodically comes to a stop and shoots three Solar Flares at the player.
Drakomire Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Drakomire

Drakomire Rider Banner.name: Drakomire Rider Banner
Drakomire Rider Banner.desc: The Drakomire Rider is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that is a combination of a Drakanian and a Drakomire, and spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Drakomire Rider Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Drakomire Rider

Drax.name: Drax
Drax.desc: The Drax is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses drill and axe. It is the alternative to the Pickaxe Axe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore.
Drax.tip: 'Not to be confused with a picksaw'

Dreadnautilus Banner.name: Dreadnautilus Banner
Dreadnautilus Banner.desc: The Dreadnautilus is a Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon.
Dreadnautilus Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dreadnautilus

Drill Containment Unit.name: Drill Containment Unit
Drill Containment Unit.desc: The Drill Containment Unit (sometimes abbreviated to DCU) is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mount-summoning item that summons a Drill Mount, a rideable, flying vehicle that mines tiles extremely quickly via a stream of blue lasers.
Drill Containment Unit.tip: Summons a rideable Drill mount · Left click to mine blocks, Right click to mine walls

Drippler Banner.name: Drippler Banner
Drippler Banner.desc: The Drippler is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns during a Blood Moon. It hovers above the ground and floats slowly towards the player, but can be easily knocked back with most weapons.
Drippler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Drippler

Drippler Crippler.name: Drippler Crippler
Drippler Crippler.desc: The Drippler Crippler is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Blood Eels. When thrown, it fires a thorny ball from the flail's head, which deals of the weapon's damage ( base damage).

Druidic Serpent Cloak.name: Druidic Serpent Cloak
Druidic Serpent Cloak.desc: The Druidic Serpent Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Druidic Serpent Cloak.tip: Every 3 swings, joins and attacks with your second whip · Causes stars to fall after taking damage

Drum Set.name: Drum Set
Drum Set.desc: The Drum Set is a novelty furniture item used in conjunction with the Drumstick to produce drum sounds.

Drumstick.name: Drumstick
Drumstick.desc: The Drum Set is a novelty furniture item used in conjunction with the Drumstick to produce drum sounds.
Drumstick.tip: Playable next to Drum Set · 'The coffee is strong...and vulgar'

Dryad Coverings.name: Dryad Coverings
Dryad Coverings.desc: The Dryad set is a vanity set which is purchased from the Dryad for, during Halloween. It resembles the clothing that the Dryad wears regularly. It consists of the Dryad Coverings and Dryad Loincloth.

Dryad Loincloth.name: Dryad Loincloth
Dryad Loincloth.desc: The Dryad set is a vanity set which is purchased from the Dryad for, during Halloween. It resembles the clothing that the Dryad wears regularly. It consists of the Dryad Coverings and Dryad Loincloth.

Dual Hook.name: Dual Hook
Dual Hook.desc: The Dual Hook is a Hardmode grappling hook that reaches 27.5 tiles and has two hooks which can be launched simultaneously; however, only one hook can be attached to a block at any time.

Duck.name: Duck
Duck.desc: The Duck and Mallard Duck are critters. They can usually only spawn in the middle third of the above-ground world, or in areas near an NPC's house if water is present. They only appear in pools of water, regardless of their size or if they are naturally generated.

Mallard Duck.name: Mallard Duck
Mallard Duck.desc: The Duck and Mallard Duck are critters. They can usually only spawn in the middle third of the above-ground world, or in areas near an NPC's house if water is present. They only appear in pools of water, regardless of their size or if they are naturally generated.

Dune Splicer Banner.name: Dune Splicer Banner
Dune Splicer Banner.desc: The Dune Splicer is a worm-type Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Desert, or much more commonly on the surface of the Desert during a Sandstorm. It is the Hardmode counterpart of the Tomb Crawler.
Dune Splicer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dune Splicer

Dunerider Boots.name: Dunerider Boots
Dunerider Boots.desc: The Dunerider Boots are an accessory that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert, and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Dunerider Boots.tip: The wearer can run super fast, and even faster on sand · 'Walk without rhythm and you won't attract the worm'

Blue Brick Wall.desc: Dungeon Brick Walls are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Dungeon, considered unsafe. They drop as items when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting on. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

Dungeon Crate.name: Dungeon Crate
Dungeon Crate.desc: The Dungeon Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Dungeon after Skeletron has been defeated.

Dungeon Slime Banner.name: Dungeon Slime Banner
Dungeon Slime Banner.desc: The Dungeon Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Dungeon. It is an indigo-colored slime that contains a Golden Key inside, and always drops it when defeated. Unlike most other slimes, it does not drop Gel.
Dungeon Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dungeon Slime

Dungeon Spirit Banner.name: Dungeon Spirit Banner
Dungeon Spirit Banner.desc: The Dungeon Spirit is a flying Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It can only spawn when another enemy is defeated, having a 1/13 / 1/9 chance to rise from the enemy's remains.
Dungeon Spirit Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dungeon Spirit

Dye Trader's Turban.name: Dye Trader's Turban

Dye Vat.name: Dye Vat
Dye Vat.desc: The Dye Vat is a crafting station used to craft dyes, paints, and colored string and Golf Balls. It is purchased from the Dye Trader for.
