Blue Dynasty Shingles.name: Blue Dynasty Shingles
Blue Dynasty Shingles.desc: Dynasty Shingles are blocks purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each, and are only sold when the Traveling Merchant is also selling Dynasty Wood. They cannot be crafted into any background walls.

Red Dynasty Shingles.name: Red Dynasty Shingles
Red Dynasty Shingles.desc: Dynasty Shingles are blocks purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each, and are only sold when the Traveling Merchant is also selling Dynasty Wood. They cannot be crafted into any background walls.

Blue Dynasty Wall.name: Blue Dynasty Wall
Blue Dynasty Wall.desc: White Dynasty Wall and Blue Dynasty Wall are background walls crafted from Dynasty Wood, which is sold by the Traveling Merchant.

White Dynasty Wall.name: White Dynasty Wall
White Dynasty Wall.desc: White Dynasty Wall and Blue Dynasty Wall are background walls crafted from Dynasty Wood, which is sold by the Traveling Merchant.

Dynasty Wood.name: Dynasty Wood
Dynasty Wood.desc: Dynasty Wood is a type of wood purchased from the Traveling Merchant for per block. When placed, it forms continuous structures with automatic frames.

Easter Block.name: Easter Block
Easter Block.desc: Easter Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks purchased from the Dye Trader for each. Their main use is crafting Easter furniture and Easter Walls.

Easter Wall.name: Easter Wall
Easter Wall.desc: Easter Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Easter Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Eater of Souls Banner.name: Eater of Souls Banner
Eater of Souls Banner.desc: The Eater of Souls is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns predominantly in The Corruption. It is the Corruption counterpart to The Crimson's Crimera. Eaters of Souls spawn from both Ebonstone and Corrupt grass, with large groups coming from chasms.
Eater of Souls Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Eater of Souls

Eater's Bone.name: Eater's Bone
Eater's Bone.desc: The Eater's Bone is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Eater that follows the player. The Baby Eater will not teleport to the player when it is far away, unlike most other pets. The Eater's Bone has a 1/20 chance of being dropped by the Eater of Worlds.
Eater's Bone.tip: Summons a Baby Eater of Souls

Ebonkoi.name: Ebonkoi
Ebonkoi.desc: Ebonkoi are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in The Corruption in any layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Wrath Potions.

Ebonstone Block.name: Ebonstone Block
Ebonstone Block.desc: Ebonstone is a block type found in The Corruption. Before Hardmode, it is most prominent in the lining of Chasms.

Ebonstone Brick.name: Ebonstone Brick
Ebonstone Brick.desc: Ebonstone Brick is a type of brick. Unlike its raw block counterpart, the Ebonstone Block, it does not spread The Corruption, nor does it turn the area into a Corruption biome, thus making it a safe construction material for NPC houses and other structures.

Ebonstone Brick Wall.name: Ebonstone Brick Wall
Ebonstone Brick Wall.desc: Ebonstone Brick Wall is a wall crafted from Ebonstone Brick. Like the brick, Ebonstone Brick Walls do not spread The Corruption.

Ebonstone Wall.name: Ebonstone Wall
Ebonstone Wall.desc: The Ebonstone Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in The Corruption, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Ebonwood Breastplate.name: Ebonwood Breastplate
Ebonwood Breastplate.desc: Ebonwood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ebonwood Helmet, Ebonwood Breastplate, and Ebonwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Ebonwood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Ebonwood Greaves.name: Ebonwood Greaves
Ebonwood Greaves.desc: Ebonwood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ebonwood Helmet, Ebonwood Breastplate, and Ebonwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Ebonwood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Ebonwood Helmet.name: Ebonwood Helmet
Ebonwood Helmet.desc: Ebonwood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ebonwood Helmet, Ebonwood Breastplate, and Ebonwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Ebonwood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Ebonwood Bow.name: Ebonwood Bow
Ebonwood Bow.desc: The Ebonwood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Ebonwood Hammer.name: Ebonwood Hammer
Ebonwood Hammer.desc: The Ebonwood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Ebonwood Sword.name: Ebonwood Sword
Ebonwood Sword.desc: The Ebonwood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Ebonwood Wall.name: Ebonwood Wall
Ebonwood Wall.desc: Ebonwood Wall is a type of wall made from Ebonwood.

Echo Block.name: Echo Block
Echo Block.desc: The Echo Block is a type of block which turns completely invisible once placed. It is sold by the Cyborg NPC for when he is spoken to in a Graveyard.

Echo Chamber.name: Echo Chamber
Echo Chamber.desc: The Echo Chamber is a furniture item. It can be activated and deactivated similarly to a monolith. When active, it grants the ability to see Echo Blocks, Echo Platforms, Echo Walls, Ghostly Stinkbug Blockers, and tiles painted with Echo Coating.
Echo Chamber.tip: Enables Echo Sight, showing hidden blocks

Echo Wall.name: Echo Wall
Echo Wall.desc: The Echo Wall is a type of background wall made from Echo Blocks. It appears completely invisible once placed and cannot be seen by the player unless they have the Spectre Goggles equipped or are near an Echo Chamber.

Eggnog.name: Eggnog
Eggnog.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds.

Elderberry.name: Elderberry
Elderberry.desc: The Elderberry is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Elderberry.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Smells like your father'

Electric Eel.name: Electric Eel
Electric Eel.desc: The Electric Eel is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. It has a 5% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Electric Eel.tip: 12 summon tag damage · 5% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with electric energy · Electric energy resonates between enemies hit by summons

Elf Archer Banner.name: Elf Archer Banner
Elf Archer Banner.desc: The Elf Archer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 2 of the Frost Moon event. She is very similar to the Pirate Crossbower, Goblin Archer, and Skeleton Archer, shooting Flaming Arrows which inflict the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / seconds.
Elf Archer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Elf Archer

Elf Copter Banner.name: Elf Copter Banner
Elf Copter Banner.desc: The Elf Copter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 6 of the Frost Moon event. It travels through blocks, firing bullets rapidly at players within its line of sight.
Elf Copter Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Elf Copter

Elf Hat.name: Elf Hat
Elf Hat.desc: The Elf set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Elf Hat, the Elf Shirt, and the Elf Pants. Each piece has a 1/600 chance of being dropped by a Zombie Elf.

Elf Pants.name: Elf Pants
Elf Pants.desc: The Elf set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Elf Hat, the Elf Shirt, and the Elf Pants. Each piece has a 1/600 chance of being dropped by a Zombie Elf.

Elf Shirt.name: Elf Shirt
Elf Shirt.desc: The Elf set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Elf Hat, the Elf Shirt, and the Elf Pants. Each piece has a 1/600 chance of being dropped by a Zombie Elf.

Emerald.name: Emerald
Emerald.desc: Emerald is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes. It can be obtained in the following ways:

Emerald Robe.name: Emerald Robe
Emerald Robe.desc: The Emerald Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Emerald Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to stick to blocks, as well as increasing their pierce by 1.
Emerald Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 11% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Emeralds light the night

Emerald Staff.name: Emerald Staff
Emerald Staff.desc: The Emerald Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a high-velocity green bolt which gradually slows down and then lingers in place. The green bolt can pierce once, and can stick to blocks and deal damage to enemies that walk into it.
Emerald Staff.tip: Emeralds light the night · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Empty Dropper.name: Empty Dropper
Empty Dropper.desc: The Empty Dropper is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Wizard for. It is used in the crafting of Magic Droppers. The Crystal Ball must be near water, lava, or honey, to craft the respective liquid's dropper.

Enchanted Moondial.name: Enchanted Moondial
Enchanted Moondial.desc: The Enchanted Moondial is a Hardmode furniture item. It can be triggered by the Right Click key or wires, doing so will advance time to dusk (7:30 PM) on the current or following day (depending on whether it is activated during day or night).
Enchanted Moondial.tip: Allows time to fast forward to dusk one day per week · Instantly reusable after certain celestial events

Enchanted Nightcrawler.name: Enchanted Nightcrawler
Enchanted Nightcrawler.desc: The Enchanted Nightcrawler is a critter that appears as a glowing pink and sparkly Worm.

Enchanted Pixie Dust.name: Enchanted Pixie Dust
Enchanted Pixie Dust.desc: The Enchanted Pixie Dust is a Hardmode transformation mount item that turns the player into a Pixie. While in this form, the player will emit a dim light in a 15-block radius and gain infinite flight.
Enchanted Pixie Dust.tip: Grants the user an air of a pixie · 'Great idea, Sprite! Too bad it’s terrible'

Enchanted Sword Banner.name: Enchanted Sword Banner
Enchanted Sword Banner.desc: The Enchanted Sword is a Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Underground Hallow. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any damage dealt to it stops its attack, forcing it to pause and spin again.
Enchanted Sword Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Enchanted Sword

Enchanted Timer.name: Enchanted Timer
Enchanted Timer.desc: The Enchanted Timer is an unobtainable accessory that periodically guarantees a critical hit.

Uncumbering Stone.name: Uncumbering Stone
Uncumbering Stone.desc: The Encumbering Stone is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents item pickup while inside the player's inventory. While in the inventory, the Encumbering Stone will prevent the pickup of any items, even if the player already has a stackable item in their inventory.
Uncumbering Stone.tip: Prevents item pickups while locked · Right click to lock · 'You are over-encumbered'

Endless Quiver.name: Endless Quiver
Endless Quiver.desc: The Endless Quiver is a Hardmode ammunition item. While in the user's inventory, it acts as a Wooden Arrow that cannot be depleted. It is also compatible with bows that convert Wooden Arrows into a special type (e.g. The Bee's Knees).

Engineering Helmet.name: Engineering Helmet
Engineering Helmet.desc: The Engineering Helmet is a vanity item equipped on the Social Helmet Slot. It is purchased from the Mechanic for.

Escargot.name: Escargot
Escargot.desc: Escargot is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Escargot.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Look at that S Car Go!'

Eternia Crystal.name: Eternia Crystal
Eternia Crystal.desc: The Eternia Crystal is an event-summoning item. When used on the Eternia Crystal Stand while under the correct terrain requirements, the Old One's Army event begins.
Eternia Crystal.tip: Place in the Eternia Crystal Stand to summon Etheria's portals

Eternia Crystal Stand.name: Eternia Crystal Stand
Eternia Crystal Stand.desc: The Eternia Crystal Stand is a furniture item that initiates the Old One's Army event when an Eternia Crystal is placed on it with Right Click. The Eternia Crystal Stand can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for.
Eternia Crystal Stand.tip: Holds the Eternia Crystal · Interact while carrying an Eternia Crystal to summon Etheria's portals · Interact with the crystal to skip extra time between waves

Etherian Goblin Banner.name: Etherian Goblin Banner
Etherian Goblin Banner.desc: The Etherian Goblin is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It is by far the event's most common enemy, spawning during every wave regardless of the current tier.
Etherian Goblin Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Etherian Goblin

Etherian Goblin Bomber Banner.name: Etherian Goblin Bomber Banner
Etherian Goblin Bomber Banner.desc: The Etherian Goblin Bomber is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 2–5, Tier 2 during waves 3 and 5–7, and Tier 3 during waves 1–2 and 5–7.
Etherian Goblin Bomber Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Etherian Goblin Bomber

Etherian Javelin.name: Etherian Javelin
Etherian Javelin.desc: The Etherian Javelin is an unobtainable item resembling the weapons used by Etherian Javelin Throwers. It only exists as an ID and an image in the game's files. Attempting to use third-party tools to obtain it will result in it instantly disappearing.

Etherian Javelin Thrower Banner.name: Etherian Javelin Thrower Banner
Etherian Javelin Thrower Banner.desc: The Etherian Javelin Thrower is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 3–5, Tier 2 during waves 1–4 and 6–7, and Tier 3 during waves 1–4 and 6.
Etherian Javelin Thrower Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Etherian Javelin Thrower

Etherian Lightning Bug Banner.name: Etherian Lightning Bug Banner
Etherian Lightning Bug Banner.desc: The Etherian Lightning Bug is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 3 in waves 2 and 6.
Etherian Lightning Bug Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Etherian Lightning Bug

Etherian Mana.name: Etherian Mana
Etherian Mana.desc: Etherian Mana is used to summon Tavernkeep's sentries during the Old One's Army event, and is dropped by all of the event's enemies.
Etherian Mana.tip: Often used to manifest one's will as a physical form of defense

Etherian Wyvern Banner.name: Etherian Wyvern Banner
Etherian Wyvern Banner.desc: The Etherian Wyvern is a flying enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 4–5, Tier 2 during waves 3–7, and Tier 3 during waves 3–4.
Etherian Wyvern Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Etherian Wyvern

Eucalyptus Sap.name: Eucalyptus Sap
Eucalyptus Sap.desc: The Eucalyptus Sap is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Sugar Glider that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Sugar Glider flies while extending its gliding membranes to catch up to them.

Eventide.name: Eventide
Eventide.desc: The Eventide is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bow that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light.

Evolution Beast Banner.name: Evolution Beast Banner
Evolution Beast Banner.desc: The Evolution Beast is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. It attacks by shooting a slow, homing Nebula Sphere and attempting to ram the player.
Evolution Beast Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Evolution Beast

Exotic Chew Toy.name: Exotic Chew Toy
Exotic Chew Toy.desc: The Exotic Chew Toy is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Fennec Fox that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Fennec Fox pet will fly by flapping its ears like wings to catch up to them.
Exotic Chew Toy.tip: Summons a fennec fox · 'It squeaks at a glorious 96kHz!'

Exotic Scimitar.name: Exotic Scimitar
Exotic Scimitar.desc: The Exotic Scimitar is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped from the Dye Trader. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%. This damage bonus decays at a rate of 0.5% per tick or 30% per second.

Explosive Bunny.name: Explosive Bunny
Explosive Bunny.desc: The Explosive Bunny is a critter that explodes upon death. Crafting it requires a Bunny, which must be caught with any Bug Net.

Explosive Trap Cane.name: Explosive Trap Cane
Explosive Trap Cane.desc: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby.
Explosive Trap Cane.tip: Summons a sentry · A trap that explodes when enemies come near · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Explosive Trap Rod.name: Explosive Trap Rod
Explosive Trap Rod.desc: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby.
Explosive Trap Rod.tip: Summons a sentry · A trap that explodes when enemies come near · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Explosive Trap Staff.name: Explosive Trap Staff
Explosive Trap Staff.desc: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby.
Explosive Trap Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · A trap that explodes when enemies come near · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Explosives.name: Explosives
Explosives.desc: Explosives are a placeable, consumable mechanism that can be triggered using wiring. Pressing Up and Down keys when placing Explosives rotates the placed visual.
Explosives.tip: Explodes when signalled · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Extendo Grip.name: Extendo Grip
Extendo Grip.desc: The Extendo Grip is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. While equipped, it increases placement range and tool range by 2 tiles vertically and 3 tiles horizontally.
Extendo Grip.tip: Increases block placement & tool range by 3 (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) · Increases tile reach (Old-gen console version)

Extractinator.name: Extractinator
Extractinator.desc: The Extractinator (or Silt Extractinator) is a special crafting station that converts Silt, Slush, and Desert Fossils into various resources such as ores, coins, and gems.
Extractinator.tip: Placing some items into the extractinator turns them into something more useful · Processes items from adjacent chests when signalled

Eye Bone.name: Eye Bone
Eye Bone.desc: The Eye Bone is a pet-summoning item that spawns Chester, a mobile Piggy Bank, to follow the player. Chester, being a pet, is essentially an upgrade to the Money Trough as it follows the player and does not require repeated summons.
Eye Bone.tip: Summons a living chest · Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops · 'It's looking into my soul.'

Eye Patch.name: Eye Patch
Eye Patch.desc: The Eye Patch is a Hardmode vanity item. It has a 1/500 chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands, Pirate Corsairs, Pirate Deadeyes, and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event.

Eye Spring.name: Eye Spring
Eye Spring.desc: The Eye Spring is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns an Eyeball Spring that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Eyeball Spring spins its tentacles to catch up to the player.

Eyebrella.name: Eyebrella
Eyebrella.desc: The Eyebrella is a vanity item that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by Deerclops. When equipped, it summons a raincloud that constantly produces raindrops above the player's head. This effect is purely visual; it does not deal any damage.

Eyezor Banner.name: Eyezor Banner
Eyezor Banner.desc: The Eyezor is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event, and primarily attacks by advancing toward the player while firing high-velocity purple laser beams at them. It also travels faster than normal Zombies and is highly resistant to knockback.
Eyezor Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Eyezor

Face Monster Banner.name: Face Monster Banner
Face Monster Banner.desc: The Face Monster is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be found in The Crimson. It follows the Fighter AI, being able to open doors at any time. Like other Crimson enemies, it drops Vertebra fairly often.
Face Monster Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Face Monster

Faecorn.name: Faecorn
Faecorn.desc: The Faecorn is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Cenaxe pet, which passively harvests items from trees. The Faecorn has a small chance of dropping when the player shakes a Forest tree.
Faecorn.tip: Summons Cenaxe · 'Bears a striking resemblance to a certain someone...'

Faeling.name: Faeling
Faeling.desc: The Faeling is a flying critter that emits light, which naturally spawns in the Aether. Most critters that come into contact with Shimmer will also transform into Faelings. Faelings can pass through blocks and try to fly away from the player if they get too close.

Blue Fairy.name: Blue Fairy
Blue Fairy.desc: The Pink Fairy, Green Fairy, and Blue Fairy are critters that emit light, which will attempt to lead the player to valuable treasures, such as Life Crystals, Chests, or ore deposits.

Green Fairy.name: Green Fairy
Green Fairy.desc: The Pink Fairy, Green Fairy, and Blue Fairy are critters that emit light, which will attempt to lead the player to valuable treasures, such as Life Crystals, Chests, or ore deposits.

Pink Fairy.name: Pink Fairy
Pink Fairy.desc: The Pink Fairy, Green Fairy, and Blue Fairy are critters that emit light, which will attempt to lead the player to valuable treasures, such as Life Crystals, Chests, or ore deposits.

Fairy Glowstick.name: Fairy Glowstick
Fairy Glowstick.desc: The Fairy Glowstick is a consumable light source sold by the Zoologist for when all three fairies have been recorded in the Bestiary. The Fairy Glowstick functions like a regular Glowstick when thrown.
Fairy Glowstick.tip: Hovers when thrown · Works when wet

Blue Fairy Jar.name: Blue Fairy Jar
Blue Fairy Jar.desc: Fairy jars are animated decorative furniture items, crafted using a Bottle and their respective fairy. By throwing a fairy jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the fairy as an item.

Green Fairy Jar.name: Green Fairy Jar
Green Fairy Jar.desc: Fairy jars are animated decorative furniture items, crafted using a Bottle and their respective fairy. By throwing a fairy jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the fairy as an item.

Pink Fairy Jar.name: Pink Fairy Jar
Pink Fairy Jar.desc: Fairy jars are animated decorative furniture items, crafted using a Bottle and their respective fairy. By throwing a fairy jar into Shimmer, it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the fairy as an item.

Fake Unicorn Horn.name: Fake Unicorn Horn
Fake Unicorn Horn.desc: The Fake Unicorn Horn is a vanity accessory purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Fake Unicorn Horn.tip: 'It's a new day, yes it is!'

Falcon Blade.name: Falcon Blade
Falcon Blade.desc: The Falcon Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 38/625 chance of being obtained from Iron Crates and a 299/5000 chance from Mythril Crates. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%.

Fallen Star Block.name: Fallen Star Block
Fallen Star Block.desc: Fallen Star Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Fallen Stars and Stone Blocks. Their main use is crafting Fallen Star furniture and Fallen Star Walls.

Fallen Star Wall.name: Fallen Star Wall
Fallen Star Wall.desc: Fallen Star Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Fallen Star Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Fallen Tuxedo Pants.name: Fallen Tuxedo Pants
Fallen Tuxedo Pants.desc: The Fallen Tuxedo set is a set of vanity items consisting of the Fallen Tuxedo Shirt and the Fallen Tuxedo Pants.

Fallen Tuxedo Shirt.name: Fallen Tuxedo Shirt
Fallen Tuxedo Shirt.desc: The Fallen Tuxedo set is a set of vanity items consisting of the Fallen Tuxedo Shirt and the Fallen Tuxedo Pants.

Familiar Pants.name: Familiar Pants
Familiar Pants.desc: The Familiar set is a vanity set that displays the player's default clothes. It consists of the Familiar Wig, the Familiar Shirt, and the Familiar Pants, and can be purchased from the Clothier for.

Familiar Shirt.name: Familiar Shirt
Familiar Shirt.desc: The Familiar set is a vanity set that displays the player's default clothes. It consists of the Familiar Wig, the Familiar Shirt, and the Familiar Pants, and can be purchased from the Clothier for.

Familiar Wig.name: Familiar Wig
Familiar Wig.desc: The Familiar set is a vanity set that displays the player's default clothes. It consists of the Familiar Wig, the Familiar Shirt, and the Familiar Pants, and can be purchased from the Clothier for.

Fancy Dishes.name: Fancy Dishes
Fancy Dishes.desc: The Fancy Dishes are a furniture item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Fart in a Balloon.name: Fart in a Balloon
Fart in a Balloon.desc: The Fart in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Fart in a Jar and the Shiny Red Balloon.
Fart in a Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Fart in a Jar.name: Fart in a Jar
Fart in a Jar.desc: The Fart in a Jar is an accessory that allows the player to perform a double jump, accompanied by a farting sound effect. The Fart jump goes 10.5 tiles into the air, totalling 16.5 tiles when put together with the first jump.
Fart in a Jar.tip: Allows the holder to double jump

Fedora.name: Fedora
Fedora.desc: The Fedora is a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Feywood.name: Feywood
Feywood.desc: Feywood is a type of wood used to craft the Feywood furniture set.

Feywood Wall.name: Feywood Wall
Feywood Wall.desc: Feywood Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Feywood Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Fez.name: Fez
Fez.desc: The Fez is a head piece vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Fire Imp Banner.name: Fire Imp Banner
Fire Imp Banner.desc: The Fire Imp is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underworld. It fires Burning Spheres, which travel through blocks and have a 1/3 chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / seconds.
Fire Imp Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Fire Imp

Fireblossom Seeds.name: Fireblossom Seeds
Fireblossom Seeds.desc: Fireblossom Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Fireblossoms while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Fireblossoms while they are fully grown.

Firecracker.name: Firecracker
Firecracker.desc: The Firecracker is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It has a 34% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Firecracker.tip: Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with blazing energy · Blazing energy explodes from enemies hit by summons

Firecracker (mobile).name: Firecracker (mobile)
Firecracker (mobile).desc: The Firecracker was an unobtainable thrown consumable weapon. It was intended to be dropped from the Red Envelope, another removed unimplemented item related to the removed unimplemented Chinese New Year seasonal event.

Fireplace.name: Fireplace
Fireplace.desc: The Fireplace is a decorative furniture item with a style similar to that of the Chimney. A Fireplace operates similarly to a Campfire, having the same dimensions, emitting light, and granting nearby players the Cozy Fire regeneration buff.

Firestarter's Skirt.name: Firestarter's Skirt
Firestarter's Skirt.desc: The Firestarter's set is a vanity set consisting of the Firestarter's Sweater and the Firestarter's Skirt.

Firestarter's Sweater.name: Firestarter's Sweater
Firestarter's Sweater.desc: The Firestarter's set is a vanity set consisting of the Firestarter's Sweater and the Firestarter's Skirt.

Firework Fountain.name: Firework Fountain
Firework Fountain.desc: The Firework Fountain is a placed novelty mechanism that is purchased from the Party Girl for. Once placed, it can be activated via Wire, or by interacting with the Fountain directly via Right Click.

Blue Rocket.name: Blue Rocket
Blue Rocket.desc: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the Right Click button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect.

Green Rocket.name: Green Rocket
Green Rocket.desc: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the Right Click button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect.

Red Rocket.name: Red Rocket
Red Rocket.desc: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the Right Click button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect.

Yellow Rocket.name: Yellow Rocket
Yellow Rocket.desc: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the Right Click button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect.

Fireworks Box.name: Fireworks Box
Fireworks Box.desc: The Fireworks Box is a placed novelty mechanism that is purchased from the Party Girl for. Once placed, it can be activated via Wire (with a 0.5 second cooldown) or by interacting with the Box directly via Right Click (no cooldown).

First Fractal.name: First Fractal
First Fractal.desc: The First Fractal is an unobtainable melee weapon that was originally supposed to be the new endgame sword for 1.4.0.1, but the concept was discarded during development. Its place is now taken by Zenith, though this item is still in Terraria's code.

Fish.name: Fish
Fish.desc: The Fish is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Penguin that follows the player. When the player is flying or is far enough away, the Baby Penguin will use a jetpack to catch up.

Fish Bowl.name: Fish Bowl
Fish Bowl.desc: The Fish Bowl, Gold Fish Bowl, Pupfish Bowl, and Lava Serpent Bowl are decorative furniture items. The Fish Bowl and Gold Fish Bowl also double as wearable items that can be equipped in the player's helmet slot.

Gold Fish Bowl.name: Gold Fish Bowl
Gold Fish Bowl.desc: The Fish Bowl, Gold Fish Bowl, Pupfish Bowl, and Lava Serpent Bowl are decorative furniture items. The Fish Bowl and Gold Fish Bowl also double as wearable items that can be equipped in the player's helmet slot.
Gold Fish Bowl.tip: 'Is it a gold bowl? Or a gold fish?'

Lava Serpent Bowl.name: Lava Serpent Bowl
Lava Serpent Bowl.desc: The Fish Bowl, Gold Fish Bowl, Pupfish Bowl, and Lava Serpent Bowl are decorative furniture items. The Fish Bowl and Gold Fish Bowl also double as wearable items that can be equipped in the player's helmet slot.
Lava Serpent Bowl.tip: 'No, you can't wear it on your head'

Pupfish Bowl.name: Pupfish Bowl
Pupfish Bowl.desc: The Fish Bowl, Gold Fish Bowl, Pupfish Bowl, and Lava Serpent Bowl are decorative furniture items. The Fish Bowl and Gold Fish Bowl also double as wearable items that can be equipped in the player's helmet slot.

Fish Costume Finskirt.name: Fish Costume Finskirt
Fish Costume Finskirt.desc: The Fish Costume set is a vanity set composed of the Fish Costume Mask, Fish Costume Shirt, and Fish Costume Finskirt. The complete set can be acquired randomly as a reward for completing a Fishing quest from the Angler NPC.

Fish Costume Mask.name: Fish Costume Mask
Fish Costume Mask.desc: The Fish Costume set is a vanity set composed of the Fish Costume Mask, Fish Costume Shirt, and Fish Costume Finskirt. The complete set can be acquired randomly as a reward for completing a Fishing quest from the Angler NPC.

Fish Costume Shirt.name: Fish Costume Shirt
Fish Costume Shirt.desc: The Fish Costume set is a vanity set composed of the Fish Costume Mask, Fish Costume Shirt, and Fish Costume Finskirt. The complete set can be acquired randomly as a reward for completing a Fishing quest from the Angler NPC.

Fish Finder.name: Fish Finder
Fish Finder.desc: The Fish Finder is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the weather, wind speed, moon phase, and the player's Fishing Power.
Fish Finder.tip: Displays weather, moon phase, and fishing information

Fisherman's Pocket Guide.name: Fisherman's Pocket Guide
Fisherman's Pocket Guide.desc: The Fisherman's Pocket Guide is an informational accessory that displays the player's current Fishing Power.

Flairoon.tip: Spews homing bubbles · Right click to toggle modes

Flamarang.name: Flamarang
Flamarang.desc: The Flamarang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang and an upgrade to the Enchanted Boomerang. It has a 1/2 chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff to enemies for 3 seconds on hit.

Flame Trap.name: Flame Trap
Flame Trap.desc: The Flame Trap is a trap found naturally in the Jungle Temple. When activated, it fires a jet of fire, which has a maximum range of 20 ( 47) tiles, and can pierce an infinite number of targets. It has a cooldown of 200 ticks / 3 seconds between firings.

Flameburst Cane.tip: Summons a sentry · An average speed tower that shoots exploding fireballs · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Flameburst Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · An average speed tower that shoots exploding fireballs · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Flamelash.name: Flamelash
Flamelash.desc: The Flamelash is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand. When used, it fires a fireball that follows the cursor when Left Click key is held. If the Left Click key is released mid-drag, the fireball will be fired in that direction.
Flamelash.tip: Summons a controllable ball of fire

Flaming Arrow.name: Flaming Arrow
Flaming Arrow.desc: The Flaming Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has a 1/3 chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3 on enemies.

Flaming Mace.name: Flaming Mace
Flaming Mace.desc: The Flaming Mace is a pre-Hardmode flail. It has a 1/6 chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff on hit. While the player is in water or the flail's head is submerged, the fire is extinguished and the weapon effectively becomes a regular Mace.

Flarefin Koi.name: Flarefin Koi
Flarefin Koi.desc: Flarefin Koi are a type of pre-Hardmode / Hardmode fish which are found very rarely by fishing in any biome in any layer, but only in lava. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Inferno Potions.

Blue Flare.name: Blue Flare
Blue Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Cursed Flare.name: Cursed Flare
Cursed Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Flare.name: Flare
Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Rainbow Flare.name: Rainbow Flare
Rainbow Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Shimmer Flare.name: Shimmer Flare
Shimmer Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Spelunker Flare.name: Spelunker Flare
Spelunker Flare.desc: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun. When fired, they travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks, similar to Sticky Glowsticks, but have greater velocity and range. They emit low-level tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes.

Flask of Gold.name: Flask of Gold
Flask of Gold.desc: The Flask of Gold is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Midas debuff for 2 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Flask of Gold.tip: Melee and Whip attacks make enemies drop more gold

Flask of Nanites.name: Flask of Nanites
Flask of Nanites.desc: The Flask of Nanites is a Hardmode, post-Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips to inflict the Confused debuff for 1–3 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Flask of Nanites.tip: Melee and Whip attacks confuse enemies and deal 5% extra damage

Flask of Party.name: Flask of Party
Flask of Party.desc: The Flask of Party is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips to create bursts of confetti when hitting enemies. The confetti is purely cosmetic and does not provide damage bonuses.
Flask of Party.tip: Melee and Whip attacks cause confetti to appear

Flesh Block.name: Flesh Block
Flesh Block.desc: The Flesh Block is a Hardmode block. They are used to craft Flesh furniture and Flesh Block Walls. When placed, eyeballs and intestines can be seen bulging out of the block. Flesh Blocks will not spread The Crimson.

Flesh Block Wall.name: Flesh Block Wall
Flesh Block Wall.desc: The Flesh Block Wall is a type of background wall. As with most placed walls, it is compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Flesh Cloning Vat.name: Flesh Cloning Vat
Flesh Cloning Vat.desc: The Flesh Cloning Vat is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Flesh furniture (Crimson-themed furniture) out of Flesh Blocks. The Flesh Cloning Vat can be purchased from the Steampunker for, but only appears for sale in worlds that are generated with The Crimson.

Flesh Grinder.name: Flesh Grinder
Flesh Grinder.desc: The Flesh Grinder is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Flint.name: Flint
Flint.desc: The Flint is a Hardmode melee weapon. The weapon builds up charge while the Left Click button is held down, and releasing the button swings it in an arc around the player, accompanied by a yellow aura that reaches further than the weapon itself and also covers behind the player.
Flint.tip: 'A helping hand from a former prison warden, fallen to the Malaise'

Flinx Fur Block.name: Flinx Fur Block
Flinx Fur Block.desc: Flinx Fur Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Flinx Fur. Their main use is crafting Flinx Fur furniture and Flinx Fur Walls.

Flinx Fur Wall.name: Flinx Fur Wall
Flinx Fur Wall.desc: Flinx Fur Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Flinx Fur Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Flinx Staff.name: Flinx Staff
Flinx Staff.desc: The Flinx Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Flinx minion. It runs towards enemies, bouncing upwards upon contact before attempting to hit its target again. Its rapid attack rate also allows its bouncing to keep it airborne atop slow flying enemies.
Flinx Staff.tip: Summons a snow flinx to fight for you

Flipper.name: Flipper
Flipper.desc: The Flipper is an accessory that allows a player to swim in liquids. When equipped, the player can swim upwards in any liquid by holding or pressing Jump repeatedly – essentially allowing unlimited multi-jumps while within liquid.

Floaty Gross Banner.name: Floaty Gross Banner
Floaty Gross Banner.desc: The Floaty Gross is a floating Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Crimson. It can float through blocks in a manner similar to Wraiths and has a 1/25 to inflict the Weak debuff for 2 / 4 / minutes upon contact with the player.
Floaty Gross Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Floaty Gross

Flocko Banner.name: Flocko Banner
Flocko Banner.desc: The Flocko is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 11 of the Frost Moon event. Flockos tend to spawn along with the Ice Queen and attack by flying toward the player while spinning at high speed.
Flocko Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Flocko

Flounder.name: Flounder
Flounder.desc: Flounders are a type of fish which are found plentifully by fishing in the Desert biome.

Flow Invader Banner.name: Flow Invader Banner
Flow Invader Banner.desc: The Flow Invader is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. When it spawns, three smaller minions will appear one at a time and begin orbiting it.
Flow Invader Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Flow Invader

Flower of Fire.name: Flower of Fire
Flower of Fire.desc: The Flower of Fire is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand that fires a slow, non-piercing fireball that can bounce off blocks up to five times. The fireball dissipates upon contact with an enemy, with a 1/2 chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for a duration of 5 seconds.

Flower of Frost.name: Flower of Frost
Flower of Frost.desc: The Flower of Frost is a Hardmode wand that has a 19/60 chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics. When used, it fires a non-piercing ball of frost that can bounce off blocks up to seven times, dissipating on its eighth impact.

Blue Flower Seeds.name: Blue Flower Seeds
Blue Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Magenta Flower Seeds.name: Magenta Flower Seeds
Magenta Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Pink Flower Seeds.name: Pink Flower Seeds
Pink Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Red Flower Seeds.name: Red Flower Seeds
Red Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Tall Grass Seeds.name: Tall Grass Seeds
Tall Grass Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Violet Flower Seeds.name: Violet Flower Seeds
Violet Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

White Flower Seeds.name: White Flower Seeds
White Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Wild Flower Seeds.name: Wild Flower Seeds
Wild Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Yellow Flower Seeds.name: Yellow Flower Seeds
Yellow Flower Seeds.desc: Flower Seeds are seeds used to plant a random flower. They can all be purchased from the Dryad for each. Flower Seeds can only be planted on pure grass and mowed grass blocks (not on any other type of grass), in Clay Pots, in Planter Boxes, and in Rock Golem Heads.

Flower Wall.name: Flower Wall
Flower Wall.desc: The Flower Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Forest and in Enchanted Sword Shrines, considered unsafe. It does drop as an item when destroyed. It can also be obtained by purchasing it from the Dryad for each.

Flurry Boots.name: Flurry Boots
Flurry Boots.desc: The Flurry Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as in Frozen Crate and Boreal Crate.
Flurry Boots.tip: The wearer can run super fast

Flying Fish Banner.name: Flying Fish Banner
Flying Fish Banner.desc: The Flying Fish is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns when the weather is rainy in any surface biome. It follows a path much like the Eater of Souls, but has relatively low movement speed. Unlike most other flying enemies, it is able to freely enter water.
Flying Fish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Flying Fish

Flying Knife.name: Flying Knife
Flying Knife.desc: The Flying Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it fires a controllable knife.

Flying Snake Banner.name: Flying Snake Banner
Flying Snake Banner.desc: The Flying Snake is a flying enemy that spawns in the Jungle Temple. Its only spawning requirement is that the player stands in front of unsafe Lihzahrd Brick Walls. The Flying Snake flies directly towards nearby players and deals contact damage, identically to a Bat.
Flying Snake Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Flying Snake

Flymeal.name: Flymeal
Flymeal.desc: The Flymeal is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. Like the Classy Cane, it has the special ability to attack town NPCs. Flymeal completely ignores the defense of NPCs, and does 2× damage to them ( base damage; 4× damage or base damage to the Nurse instead).
Flymeal.tip: Best used for pranking townsfolk · 'Makes others smell like cilantro'

Fog Machine.name: Fog Machine
Fog Machine.desc: The Fog Machine is a placed novelty mechanism that is purchased from the Party Girl for at night. When placed, it produces fog cloud effects around itself. It can be toggled on and off via Wire.

Fogbound Dye.name: Fogbound Dye
Fogbound Dye.desc: Fogbound Dye is a dye purchased from the Dye Trader while in a Graveyard for. When equipped, it reduces the color saturation of the item and gives it a grayer tone, with a fog-like effect overlaying on top of the item.

FoodBarbarian's Horned Helm.name: FoodBarbarian's Horned Helm
FoodBarbarian's Horned Helm.desc: It is the vanity set made for FoodBarbarian, one of the production assistants at Re-Logic.

FoodBarbarian's Savage Greaves.name: FoodBarbarian's Savage Greaves
FoodBarbarian's Savage Greaves.desc: It is the vanity set made for FoodBarbarian, one of the production assistants at Re-Logic.
FoodBarbarian's Savage Greaves.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'They don't let me wear a loincloth anymore.'

FoodBarbarian's Wild Wolf Spaulders.name: FoodBarbarian's Wild Wolf Spaulders
FoodBarbarian's Wild Wolf Spaulders.desc: It is the vanity set made for FoodBarbarian, one of the production assistants at Re-Logic.
FoodBarbarian's Wild Wolf Spaulders.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'Max was a good boy.'

Football.name: Football
Football.desc: The Football is a novelty item that players can throw to each other, or to themselves. It is sold by the Party Girl for, after the player has accumulated a golf score of at least 501.

Forbidden Mask.name: Forbidden Mask
Forbidden Mask.desc: Forbidden armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Forbidden Mask, Forbidden Robes, and Forbidden Treads. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Forbidden Fragments and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).

Forbidden Robes.name: Forbidden Robes
Forbidden Robes.desc: Forbidden armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Forbidden Mask, Forbidden Robes, and Forbidden Treads. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Forbidden Fragments and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).
Forbidden Robes.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 10% increased summon damage · Increases your max number of minions by 1

Forbidden Treads.name: Forbidden Treads
Forbidden Treads.desc: Forbidden armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Forbidden Mask, Forbidden Robes, and Forbidden Treads. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Forbidden Fragments and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).
Forbidden Treads.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 10% increased magic damage · Increases your max number of minions by 1

Forbidden Block.name: Forbidden Block
Forbidden Block.desc: Forbidden Blocks are Hardmode blocks crafted from Stone Blocks and Forbidden Fragments. Their main use is crafting Forbidden furniture and Forbidden Walls.

Forbidden Wall.name: Forbidden Wall
Forbidden Wall.desc: Forbidden Wall is a Hardmode wall. As with most crafted walls, Forbidden Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Format:C.name: Format:C
Format:C.desc: The Format:C is a Hardmode, post-Skeletron Prime yoyo. It has a 24% base critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%, and deals 250% damage on critical hits as opposed to the usual 200%.

Fossil Greaves.name: Fossil Greaves
Fossil Greaves.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 60 Sturdy Fossils.

Fossil Helmet.name: Fossil Helmet
Fossil Helmet.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 60 Sturdy Fossils.

Fossil Plate.name: Fossil Plate
Fossil Plate.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 60 Sturdy Fossils.

Fossil Pickaxe.name: Fossil Pickaxe
Fossil Pickaxe.desc: The Fossil Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian. It is slightly faster than both the Gold Pickaxe and Platinum Pickaxe in terms of mining speed.

Fox Mask.name: Fox Mask
Fox Mask.desc: The Fox set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. The set consists of the Fox Mask, Fox Shirt, and Fox Pants.

Fox Pants.name: Fox Pants
Fox Pants.desc: The Fox set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. The set consists of the Fox Mask, Fox Shirt, and Fox Pants.

Fox Shirt.name: Fox Shirt
Fox Shirt.desc: The Fox set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. The set consists of the Fox Mask, Fox Shirt, and Fox Pants.

Fox Ears.name: Fox Ears
Fox Ears.desc: The Fox set is a vanity set composed of the Fox Tail and Fox Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a Third Quarter or a Waning Crescent for.

Fox Tail.name: Fox Tail
Fox Tail.desc: The Fox set is a vanity set composed of the Fox Tail and Fox Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a Third Quarter or a Waning Crescent for.

Foxparks.name: Foxparks
Foxparks.desc: Foxparks is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Foxparks minion. It does not deal contact damage, but runs and shoots fireballs towards enemies that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 5–10 seconds.
Foxparks.tip: Summons Foxparks to fight for you · Left click to use Foxparks' Huggy Fire skill, shooting flames! · Right click to pet it!

Trusty Foxparks.name: Trusty Foxparks
Trusty Foxparks.desc: Foxparks is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Foxparks minion. It does not deal contact damage, but runs and shoots fireballs towards enemies that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 5–10 seconds.
Trusty Foxparks.tip: Summons Trusty Foxparks to fight for you · Left click to use Foxparks' Huggy Fire skill, shooting flames! · Right click to pet it! · Its trust empowers it, and it learned 'Spirit Fire'!

FPV Goggles.name: FPV Goggles
FPV Goggles.desc: The FPV Goggles are a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory purchased from the Cyborg for.
FPV Goggles.tip: Allows wearer to see through their remote vehicle camera · 'Chonky Fishron RC Systems'

Frankenstein Banner.name: Frankenstein Banner
Frankenstein Banner.desc: Frankenstein is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Frankensteins behave similarly to Zombies, but have increased stats.
Frankenstein Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Frankenstein

Freeze Bomb.name: Freeze Bomb
Freeze Bomb.desc: The Freeze Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but its explosion will convert water to Ice Blocks, instead of destroying blocks.
Freeze Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will freeze water

Fried Egg.name: Fried Egg
Fried Egg.desc: The Fried Egg is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Fried Egg has a 1/30 chance of being dropped by Wall Creepers, Black Recluses, and Sand Poachers. Statue-spawned Wall Creepers do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Fried Egg.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Sunny side up!'

Friendly Boulder.name: Friendly Boulder
Friendly Boulder.desc: The Friendly Boulder is a pet-summoning item that spawns a harmless Friendly Boulder that rolls around to follow the player. When the player is flying or far enough away, the Friendly Boulder will roll through the air toward the player.
Friendly Boulder.tip: Summons a friendly boulder to roll after you · 'Let's rock n' roll!'

Friendly Rainbow Boulder.name: Friendly Rainbow Boulder
Friendly Rainbow Boulder.desc: The Friendly Rainbow Boulder is a pet-summoning item obtained by throwing a Friendly Boulder into Shimmer, which summons a Rainbow Boulder pet to follow the player.
Friendly Rainbow Boulder.tip: Summons a friendly rainbow boulder to roll after you · 'This rock is poppin'!'

Fries.name: Fries
Fries.desc: Fries are a food item that grant the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Fries have a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Flying Fish.
Fries.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Where's the Ketchup!?'

Fritz Banner.name: Fritz Banner
Fritz Banner.desc: Fritz is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It moves very quickly on the ground and leaps into players to attack.
Fritz Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Fritz

Frog Webbing.name: Frog Webbing
Frog Webbing.desc: The Frog Webbing is an accessory crafted from a Frog Leg and a Tiger Climbing Gear. It combines the abilities of these two items, increasing the player's jump speed and safe falling distance, allowing auto-jump, and granting enhanced mobility on walls.
Frog Webbing.tip: Allows the ability to climb walls · Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

Froggle Bunwich.name: Froggle Bunwich
Froggle Bunwich.desc: The Froggle Bunwich is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Froggle Bunwich.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Has a bit of a kick to it.'

Frost Breastplate.name: Frost Breastplate
Frost Breastplate.desc: Frost armor is a Hardmode melee/ranged armor set consisting of the Frost Helmet, Frost Breastplate, and Frost Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Frost Cores and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).
Frost Breastplate.tip: 11% increased melee and ranged critical strike chance

Frost Helmet.name: Frost Helmet
Frost Helmet.desc: Frost armor is a Hardmode melee/ranged armor set consisting of the Frost Helmet, Frost Breastplate, and Frost Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Frost Cores and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).

Frost Leggings.name: Frost Leggings
Frost Leggings.desc: Frost armor is a Hardmode melee/ranged armor set consisting of the Frost Helmet, Frost Breastplate, and Frost Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 3 Frost Cores and 46 Adamantite or Titanium Bars (184 ore).
Frost Leggings.tip: 8% increased movement speed · 10% increased melee speed

Frost Daggerfish.name: Frost Daggerfish
Frost Daggerfish.desc: The Frost Daggerfish is a consumable ranged weapon. Depending to player's final Fishing Power, from 7 to 137 Frost Daggerfish can be fished from lakes in Snow biomes at a time.

Frost Minnow.name: Frost Minnow
Frost Minnow.desc: Frost Minnows are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in a Snow biome in any layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Warmth Potions.

Frost Staff.name: Frost Staff
Frost Staff.desc: The Frost Staff is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Icy Mermen and Ice Elementals. When used, it fires a frost bolt that pierces one enemy and does not pass through blocks. The Frost Staff also inflicts the Frostbite debuff for 7 seconds on hit.

Frostbrand.name: Frostbrand
Frostbrand.desc: The Frostbrand is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 19/60 chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics.

Frostspark Boots.name: Frostspark Boots
Frostspark Boots.desc: The Frostspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Lightning Boots and Ice Skates, and combines their functionality. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Frostspark Boots.tip: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed

Frozen Chest.name: Frozen Chest
Frozen Chest.desc: The Frozen Chest is a Chest storage item found only in the Ice biome, spawning as frequently as Chests do in other biomes.

Frozen Crate.name: Frozen Crate
Frozen Crate.desc: The Frozen Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Snow and Ice biome. Frozen Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in Frozen Chests. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Boreal Crate.
Frozen Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Frozen Crown.name: Frozen Crown
Frozen Crown.desc: The Frozen Crown is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a miniature Ice Queen that follows the player. The Frozen Crown is dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event in Master Mode with a 12.5–25% chance depending on the current wave.
Frozen Crown.tip: Summons a tiny Ice Queen · 'Fit for a queen!'

Frozen Slime Block.name: Frozen Slime Block
Frozen Slime Block.desc: Frozen Slime Blocks are blocks without any friction, making them more slippery than their constituent block, the Ice Block.

Frozen Turtle Shell.name: Frozen Turtle Shell
Frozen Turtle Shell.desc: The Frozen Turtle Shell is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Ice Tortoises. While equipped, it grants the Ice Barrier buff, which provides +25% damage reduction while the player's health is at or below 50%.
Frozen Turtle Shell.tip: Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25%

Frozen Zombie Banner.name: Frozen Zombie Banner
Frozen Zombie Banner.desc: The Frozen Zombie is a Zombie variant that only appears on the Surface Snow biome at night.
Frozen Zombie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Frozen Zombie

Fruit Juice.name: Fruit Juice
Fruit Juice.desc: Fruit Juice is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Fruit Juice.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'With 5% real fruit juice!'

Fruit Salad.name: Fruit Salad
Fruit Salad.desc: The Fruit Salad is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Fruit Salad.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Yummy yummy'

Fruitcake Chakram.name: Fruitcake Chakram
Fruitcake Chakram.desc: The Fruitcake Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.626% in pre-Hardmode and 0.584% in Hardmode.

Full Moon Squeaky Toy.name: Full Moon Squeaky Toy
Full Moon Squeaky Toy.desc: The Full Moon Squeaky Toy is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Werewolf that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Werewolf flies after them by flapping its arms, mimicking a bird-like creature.

Funeral Coat.name: Funeral Coat
Funeral Coat.desc: The Funeral set is a vanity set consisting of the Funeral Hat, Funeral Coat, and Funeral Pants.

Funeral Hat.name: Funeral Hat
Funeral Hat.desc: The Funeral set is a vanity set consisting of the Funeral Hat, Funeral Coat, and Funeral Pants.

Funeral Pants.name: Funeral Pants
Funeral Pants.desc: The Funeral set is a vanity set consisting of the Funeral Hat, Funeral Coat, and Funeral Pants.

Fungi Bulb Banner.name: Fungi Bulb Banner
Fungi Bulb Banner.desc: The Fungi Bulb is an uncommon enemy found in Glowing Mushroom biomes above the surface. During Hardmode, they can also appear in Underground Glowing Mushroom biomes. The Fungi Bulb follows the plant behavior akin to the Man Eater, but is less aggressive.
Fungi Bulb Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Fungi Bulb

Furnace.name: Furnace
Furnace.desc: The Furnace is a crafting station used mainly to smelt ores into bars and create various pieces of furniture. It is also a light source, but it is not valid for housing. The Furnace smelts all pre-Hardmode ores besides Hellstone, which must be smelted in a Hellforge.

Fuzzy Carrot.name: Fuzzy Carrot
Fuzzy Carrot.desc: The Fuzzy Carrot is a mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Bunny Mount. It has a top speed of. The Fuzzy Carrot is obtained from the Angler as a reward for completing his 5th fishing quest.

Galaxy Pearl.name: Galaxy Pearl
Galaxy Pearl.desc: The Galaxy Pearl is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's luck by 0.03. It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing a Pink Pearl into Shimmer.

Gangsta Hat.name: Gangsta Hat
Gangsta Hat.desc: The Gangsta Hat is a vanity item purchased from the Clothier after the Frost Legion has been defeated.

Garden Gnome.name: Garden Gnome
Garden Gnome.desc: The Garden Gnome is a small furniture item formed when a Gnome touches sunlight. A placed Garden Gnome positively influences the player's Luck stat by 0.2. The buff is applied to any players standing within a centered on the Garden Gnome, similar to the Heart Lantern.
Garden Gnome.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Said to bring good fortune and keep evil spirits at bay'

Garland.name: Garland
Garland.desc: The Garland is a vanity item for the Social Helmet slot.

Gas Trap.name: Gas Trap
Gas Trap.desc: The Gas Trap is a trap item obtained by throwing a Whoopie Cushion into Shimmer. It also has a 1/15 chance to appear in any chest when the No Traps special seed is active.
Gas Trap.tip: Releases poisonous gas when a container it is in is opened

Used Gas Trap.name: Used Gas Trap
Used Gas Trap.desc: The Gas Trap is a trap item obtained by throwing a Whoopie Cushion into Shimmer. It also has a 1/15 chance to appear in any chest when the No Traps special seed is active.

Gastropod Banner.name: Gastropod Banner
Gastropod Banner.desc: The Gastropod is a flying Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns frequently on the surface of The Hallow at night. If the player is within its line of sight, it will open its shell and fire high-velocity Pink Lasers which emit faint pink light.
Gastropod Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Gastropod

Gatligator.name: Gatligator
Gatligator.desc: The Gatligator is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. When used, it rapidly fires bullets in a roughly 30° spread, at a varying velocity. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.
Gatligator.tip: 50% chance to save ammo · Highly inaccurate

Gato Egg.name: Gato Egg
Gato Egg.desc: The Gato Egg is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Propeller Gato that follows the player. The Gato Egg is dropped by Dark Mages during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/6 / 1/4 chance during Tier 1, and a 1/12 chance during Tier 3.

Gel Dye.name: Gel Dye
Gel Dye.desc: Gel Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It is received as a random reward. When equipped, the Gel Dye produces an effect similar to that of the Slime debuff caused by the Slime Gun.

Gelatin Crystal.name: Gelatin Crystal
Gelatin Crystal.desc: The Gelatin Crystal is a Hardmode boss-summoning item that summons Queen Slime when used. It can only be used in The Hallow or Underground Hallow, at any time.

Gelatinous Pillion.name: Gelatinous Pillion
Gelatinous Pillion.desc: The Gelatinous Pillion is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a friendly Winged Slime Mount.
Gelatinous Pillion.tip: Summons a rideable Winged Slime mount
