Gentleman's Beard.name: Gentleman's Beard
Gentleman's Beard.desc: The Gentleman's set is a vanity set consisting of the Gentleman's Beard, the Gentleman's Long Beard, the Gentleman's Magnificent Beard, the Gentleman's Vest, and the Gentleman's Trousers.

Gentleman's Long Beard.name: Gentleman's Long Beard
Gentleman's Long Beard.desc: The Gentleman's set is a vanity set consisting of the Gentleman's Beard, the Gentleman's Long Beard, the Gentleman's Magnificent Beard, the Gentleman's Vest, and the Gentleman's Trousers.

Gentleman's Magnificent Beard.name: Gentleman's Magnificent Beard
Gentleman's Magnificent Beard.desc: The Gentleman's set is a vanity set consisting of the Gentleman's Beard, the Gentleman's Long Beard, the Gentleman's Magnificent Beard, the Gentleman's Vest, and the Gentleman's Trousers.

Gentleman's Trousers.name: Gentleman's Trousers
Gentleman's Trousers.desc: The Gentleman's set is a vanity set consisting of the Gentleman's Beard, the Gentleman's Long Beard, the Gentleman's Magnificent Beard, the Gentleman's Vest, and the Gentleman's Trousers.

Gentleman's Vest.name: Gentleman's Vest
Gentleman's Vest.desc: The Gentleman's set is a vanity set consisting of the Gentleman's Beard, the Gentleman's Long Beard, the Gentleman's Magnificent Beard, the Gentleman's Vest, and the Gentleman's Trousers.

Geode.name: Geode
Geode.desc: The Geode is a consumable that has a 1/20 chance of being dropped by Granite Elementals and Granite Golems. When used, it is thrown and drops gems upon impact with blocks. Each Geode drops 2 types of gems with 3–6 gems of each type.
Geode.tip: May drop valuable shinies when smashed!

Geyser.name: Geyser
Geyser.desc: The Geyser is a trap that spews a vertical stream of fire which deals a base damage of 40 / 80 / and a knockback of emitting large amount of light. It will activate when a player touches it or when it is triggered via wire.

Ghastly Glaive.name: Ghastly Glaive
Ghastly Glaive.desc: The Ghastly Glaive is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear that is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/10 chance / 1/5 chance during Tier 2, and a 1/20 chance during Tier 3. Unlike any other spear, it is thrust in a curved motion.
Ghastly Glaive.tip: Summons ghosts as it hits enemies

Ghost Banner.name: Ghost Banner
Ghost Banner.desc: The Ghost is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer during the Halloween seasonal event.
Ghost Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ghost

Ghost Mask.name: Ghost Mask
Ghost Mask.desc: The Ghost set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. It consists of a Ghost Mask and Ghost Shirt. When a player wearing it is killed, the set parts float down into the ground and the player's severed remains do not appear.

Ghost Shirt.name: Ghost Shirt
Ghost Shirt.desc: The Ghost set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. It consists of a Ghost Mask and Ghost Shirt. When a player wearing it is killed, the set parts float down into the ground and the player's severed remains do not appear.

Ghostar's Garb.name: Ghostar's Garb
Ghostar's Garb.desc: It is the vanity set made for Ghostar, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Ghostar's Garb.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'A fine dress handmade by a dragon'

Ghostar's Soul Jar.name: Ghostar's Soul Jar
Ghostar's Soul Jar.desc: It is the vanity set made for Ghostar, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Ghostar's Soul Jar.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'Could this be the real Ghostar?'

Ghostar's Tights.name: Ghostar's Tights
Ghostar's Tights.desc: It is the vanity set made for Ghostar, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Ghostar's Tights.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step'

Ghoulder.name: Ghoulder
Ghoulder.desc: The Ghoulder is a special type of Boulder that generates instead of normal Boulders near the Dungeon (see Boulder generation).

Ghoul Banner.name: Ghoul Banner
Ghoul Banner.desc: Ghouls are Hardmode Underground Desert enemies who follow the Fighter AI (behaving similarly to Zombies).
Ghoul Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ghoul

Giant Bat Banner.name: Giant Bat Banner
Giant Bat Banner.desc: The Giant Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It can inflict the Confused debuff for 5 / 10 / seconds, and also has a 1/10 chance to inflict the Feral Bite debuff in Expert Mode for 30–90 seconds. It appears much larger than a normal Cave Bat.
Giant Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Bat

Giant Bow.name: Giant Bow
Giant Bow.desc: The Giant Bow is a festive vanity item that has a 1/20 chance to drop during Christmas by Present Slimes, which visually have a large bow on. The Bow itself is red, but it can drop from any of the four colors of Present Slime.

Giant Cursed Skull Banner.name: Giant Cursed Skull Banner
Giant Cursed Skull Banner.desc: The Giant Cursed Skull is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated.
Giant Cursed Skull Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Cursed Skull

Giant Flying Fox Banner.name: Giant Flying Fox Banner
Giant Flying Fox Banner.desc: The Giant Flying Fox is a Hardmode bat enemy that spawns only on the surface of the Jungle at night. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff.
Giant Flying Fox Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Flying Fox

Giant Shelly Banner.name: Giant Shelly Banner
Giant Shelly Banner.desc: The Giant Shelly is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has two color variants that share identical stats and behavior. The Giant Shelly walks around slowly and occasionally curls into its shell.
Giant Shelly Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Shelly

Giant Tiki.name: Giant Tiki
Giant Tiki.desc: The Giant Tiki is a furniture item that is sold by the Witch Doctor when in the Jungle for. It has three different sprites which can be cycled through with the Up and Down keys before placing.
Giant Tiki.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Giant Tortoise Banner.name: Giant Tortoise Banner
Giant Tortoise Banner.desc: The Giant Tortoise is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle and Underground Jungle. It walks around slowly, and occasionally retracts into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage.
Giant Tortoise Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Tortoise

Worm Banner.name: Worm Banner
Worm Banner.desc: The Giant Worm is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and tunnels through blocks to attack the player.
Worm Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Giant Worm

Martian Gigazapper Banner.name: Martian Gigazapper Banner
Martian Gigazapper Banner.desc: The Gigazapper is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. It uses a short-ranged electrical spear weapon unavailable to players, with a maximum fire rate of once every half of a second.
Martian Gigazapper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Gigazapper

Ginger Beard.name: Ginger Beard
Ginger Beard.desc: The Ginger Beard is a vanity accessory found in Iron and Mythril Crate, which can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any height.

Gingerbread Cookie.name: Gingerbread Cookie
Gingerbread Cookie.desc: The Gingerbread Cookie is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Gingerbread Cookie can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 3.601% in pre-Hardmode and 3.361% in Hardmode.
Gingerbread Cookie.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Not the gumdrop buttons!'

Gingerbread Man Banner.name: Gingerbread Man Banner
Gingerbread Man Banner.desc: The Gingerbread Man is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. He is much like the Splinterling but drops no items.
Gingerbread Man Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Gingerbread Man

Glacier Fang.name: Glacier Fang
Glacier Fang.desc: The Glacier Fang is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires chargeable icicles toward the cursor, affected by gravity. It can be found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, Frozen Crates, and Boreal Crates.

Gladiator Breastplate.name: Gladiator Breastplate
Gladiator Breastplate.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

Gladiator Helmet.name: Gladiator Helmet
Gladiator Helmet.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

Gladiator Leggings.name: Gladiator Leggings
Gladiator Leggings.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

Glass Kiln.name: Glass Kiln
Glass Kiln.desc: The Glass Kiln is a crafting station used to craft Glass furniture out of Glass. it also has the ability to produce all normal Furnace recipes. Like the Furnace, it emits light when placed.

Glass Slipper.name: Glass Slipper
Glass Slipper.desc: The Glass Slipper is a vanity accessory sold by the Princess for. It will leave sparkling particles when the player walks around.

Glass Wall.name: Glass Wall
Glass Wall.desc: Glass Walls are transparent walls that can be used to make windows that let in natural light, while preventing monster spawns. They are crafted from Glass and also spawn naturally in houses on Floating Islands. They can be crafted into Stained Glass.

Glommer's Flower.name: Glommer's Flower
Glommer's Flower.desc: Glommer's Flower is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns Glommer to follow the player. Glommer's Flower is dropped from Derplings with a 1/100 chance and increased to 1/40 in The Constant secret seed.
Glommer's Flower.tip: Summons a Glommer · 'The petals shimmer in the light'

Glow Tulip.name: Glow Tulip
Glow Tulip.desc: The Glow Tulip is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Caveling Gardener that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, it flies through solid tiles while holding onto a Snare Plant in order to catch up to them.
Glow Tulip.tip: Summons a Caveling Gardener · 'Ancient energy in full bloom.'

Glowing Mushroom Dye.name: Glowing Mushroom Dye
Glowing Mushroom Dye.desc: Glowing Mushroom Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it gives items a blue and black color palette which glows in the dark.

Glowing Snail.name: Glowing Snail
Glowing Snail.desc: The Glowing Snail is an uncommon critter that only spawns in either surface or underground Glowing Mushroom biomes. It emits light and is quite large compared to its normal counterpart.

Glowstick.name: Glowstick
Glowstick.desc: The Glowstick is a consumable light source that can be held or tossed a fair distance. It works underwater but cannot be placed on a wall or floor like Torches can. After being thrown, a Glowstick will emit light for 5 minutes and expire afterward.

Gnome Banner.name: Gnome Banner
Gnome Banner.desc: The Gnome is an uncommon pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns around the surface, and spawns more commonly in Living Trees. When it is not behind a background wall on the surface during the daytime, it will turn into a Garden Gnome which increases the luck of nearby players.
Gnome Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Gnome

Goat Skull.name: Goat Skull
Goat Skull.desc: The Goat Skull is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Goat Mount which allows the mounted player to perform a double jump, similar to the Cloud in a Bottle. The Goat Skull has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh in Master Mode.
Goat Skull.tip: Summons a rideable death goat mount · 'Brutal!'

Goblin Archer Banner.name: Goblin Archer Banner
Goblin Archer Banner.desc: The Goblin Archer is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It fires Wooden Arrows at players within its line of sight while stationary. Its attacks can be interrupted by knocking it back.
Goblin Archer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Archer

Goblin Bomber Cap.name: Goblin Bomber Cap
Goblin Bomber Cap.desc: The Goblin Bomber Cap is an unobtainable item resembling the cap worn by Etherian Goblin Bombers. It only exists as an ID and image file in the game's code. Attempting to use third-party tools to obtain it will result in it instantly disappearing.

Goblin Mask.name: Goblin Mask
Goblin Mask.desc: The Goblin Mask is an unimplemented item resembling an Etherian Goblin mask. It only exists as an ID and image file in the game's code. It presumably would be available as part of the Dungeon Defenders 2 crossover.

Goblin Peon Banner.name: Goblin Peon Banner
Goblin Peon Banner.desc: The Goblin Peon is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It is the event's most basic enemy and follows the Fighter AI. Approximately one out of every five goblins will be a Peon (17.8% chance to spawn).
Goblin Peon Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Peon

Goblin Scout Banner.name: Goblin Scout Banner
Goblin Scout Banner.desc: The Goblin Scout is an uncommon pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface in the farthest edges of the player's world. It appears to be an enemy from the Goblin Army event, but it spawns during ordinary gameplay.
Goblin Scout Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Scout

Goblin Sorcerer Banner.name: Goblin Sorcerer Banner
Goblin Sorcerer Banner.desc: The Goblin Sorcerer is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. Approximately one out of every nine goblins will be a Sorcerer (11.11% chance to spawn). The Goblin Sorcerer fires three Chaos Balls in succession that travel through blocks before it teleports.
Goblin Sorcerer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Sorcerer

Goblin Tech.name: Goblin Tech
Goblin Tech.desc: The Goblin Tech is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the most valuable block nearby, the player's current, and their current movement speed.
Goblin Tech.tip: Displays movement speed, damage per second, and valuable ore

Goblin Thief Banner.name: Goblin Thief Banner
Goblin Thief Banner.desc: The Goblin Thief is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It follows the typical Fighter AI but moves at a higher speed than similar enemies. Goblin Thieves can jump high and open Tall Gate faster than other fighters.
Goblin Thief Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Thief

Goblin Warlock Banner.name: Goblin Warlock Banner
Goblin Warlock Banner.desc: The Goblin Warlock is a Hardmode enemy that rarely spawns during the Goblin Army event. Because of her high stats and relatively high difficulty compared to other goblins, she will present a challenge for new Hardmode players.
Goblin Warlock Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Warlock

Goblin Warrior Banner.name: Goblin Warrior Banner
Goblin Warrior Banner.desc: The Goblin Warrior is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It follows the Fighter AI and is the most commonly encountered enemy in the event. Approximately one out of every three goblins will be a Warrior (31.6% chance to spawn).
Goblin Warrior Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goblin Warrior

Goblorc Ears.name: Goblorc Ears
Goblorc Ears.desc: The Goblorc Ears are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Goggles.name: Goggles
Goggles.desc: Goggles are a piece of armor placed in the helmet slot. Unlike most helmets, Goggles do not cover the player's hair. Due to their low defense, they are often used as vanity items.

Ancient Gold Helmet.name: Ancient Gold Helmet
Ancient Gold Helmet.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Gold Chainmail.name: Gold Chainmail
Gold Chainmail.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Gold Greaves.name: Gold Greaves
Gold Greaves.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Gold Helmet.name: Gold Helmet
Gold Helmet.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Gold Axe.name: Gold Axe
Gold Axe.desc: The Gold Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Gold Bird.name: Gold Bird
Gold Bird.desc: The Gold Bird is a harmless critter. It may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Gold Bow.name: Gold Bow
Gold Bow.desc: The Gold Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Gold Brick.name: Gold Brick
Gold Brick.desc: Gold Bricks are a type of brick crafted from Gold Ore. In some worlds, they are found as part of Jungle Shrines in the Underground Jungle. Like the ore they are made of, placed Gold Bricks will sparkle.

Gold Brick Wall.name: Gold Brick Wall
Gold Brick Wall.desc: The Gold Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Gold Bunny.name: Gold Bunny
Gold Bunny.desc: The Gold Bunny is a harmless critter.

Gold Chest.name: Gold Chest
Gold Chest.desc: The Gold Chest is a naturally-generated chest, with various loot as its contents. Each chest includes one special item, as well as some coins and other more common items.

Gold Crown.name: Gold Crown
Gold Crown.desc: The Gold Crown is a craftable vanity item that can be worn in the Social Helmet inventory slot. It is also one of the crafting materials for the Slime Crown, which is used to spawn King Slime.

Gold Dragonfly.name: Gold Dragonfly
Gold Dragonfly.desc: The Gold Dragonfly is a harmless critter.

Gold Frog.name: Gold Frog
Gold Frog.desc: The Gold Frog is a harmless critter.

Gold Goldfish.name: Gold Goldfish
Gold Goldfish.desc: The Gold Goldfish is a harmless critter.
Gold Goldfish.tip: 'Not to be confused with the elusive Gold Gold Goldfish'

Gold Grasshopper.name: Gold Grasshopper
Gold Grasshopper.desc: The Gold Grasshopper is a harmless critter.

Gold Hammer.name: Gold Hammer
Gold Hammer.desc: The Gold Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Gold Ladybug.name: Gold Ladybug
Gold Ladybug.desc: The Gold Ladybug is a harmless critter.

Gold Mouse.name: Gold Mouse
Gold Mouse.desc: The Gold Mouse is a harmless critter.

Gold Ore.name: Gold Ore
Gold Ore.desc: Gold Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Gold Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Gold Pickaxe.name: Gold Pickaxe
Gold Pickaxe.desc: The Gold Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian. It can also mine Meteorite.

Gold Ring.name: Gold Ring
Gold Ring.desc: The Gold Ring is a Hardmode accessory that greatly increases the pickup range for coins. It has a 1/500 chance to be dropped by pirates (except Parrots) during Pirate Invasions, with a 1/125 chance from the Pirate Captain.

Gold Seahorse.name: Gold Seahorse
Gold Seahorse.desc: The Gold Seahorse is a harmless critter.

Gold Shortsword.name: Gold Shortsword
Gold Shortsword.desc: The Gold Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Gold Squirrel.name: Gold Squirrel
Gold Squirrel.desc: The Gold Squirrel is a harmless critter. Gold Squirrel may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Gold Starry Block.name: Gold Starry Block
Gold Starry Block.desc: The Gold Starry Block is an animated decorative block. When placed it shows twinkling, gold stars on a black background. It is the gold-themed variant of the Blue Starry Block.

Gold Starry Wall.name: Gold Starry Wall
Gold Starry Wall.desc: Gold Starry Wall is a background wall made from Gold Starry Blocks. It is one of only a few animated background walls.

Gold Water Strider.name: Gold Water Strider
Gold Water Strider.desc: The Gold Water Strider is a harmless critter.

Gold Worm.name: Gold Worm
Gold Worm.desc: The Gold Worm is a critter. Gold Worms have a 1/20 chance of being obtained from opening a Can Of Worms.

Golden Bug Net.name: Golden Bug Net
Golden Bug Net.desc: The Golden Bug Net is an upgraded version of the Bug Net and Lavaproof Bug Net.
Golden Bug Net.tip: Used to catch critters and bait · Can catch lava critters too!

Golden Carp.name: Golden Carp
Golden Carp.desc: Golden Carp are a type of fish which are found extremely rarely by fishing in any biome in the Underground, Cavern and Underworld layers, with the exception of the Desert. They have an extraordinarily high sell value of.
Golden Carp.tip: 'Quite shiny. This will probably sell well.'

Golden Crate.name: Golden Crate
Golden Crate.desc: The Golden Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any layer. It is the highest tier of standard crate, having the greatest value if sold directly. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Titanium Crate.
Golden Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Golden Key.name: Golden Key
Golden Key.desc: Golden Keys are required to unlock the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon and Golden Lock Box obtained by fishing in the Dungeon, as well as to free the Elder Slime from an Old Shaking Chest. A Golden Key is consumed upon use, so each unlock will require an additional key.
Golden Key.tip: Opens one locked Gold Chest or Lock Box (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) · Opens one Gold Chest (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Golden Lock Box.name: Golden Lock Box
Golden Lock Box.desc: The Golden Lock Box is a grab bag item that is always obtained from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates. It always contains one rare item normally found in locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon.
Golden Lock Box.tip: Right click to open · Requires a Golden Key

Golden Seaweed.name: Golden Seaweed
Golden Seaweed.desc: The Golden Seaweed was used to summon a pet Golden Turtle. It lasted until the player manually canceled the buff by using the Golden Seaweed again. It was obtained from Chests, but only on the Amazon Fire TV. It was obtainable on other mobile devices via trading.

Goldfish.name: Goldfish
Goldfish.desc: The Goldfish is a critter that swims in water and walks on land during rain. It flops in place when out of water and rain; it does not take damage while doing so.
Goldfish.tip: 'It's smiling, might be a good snack'

Goldfish Banner.name: Goldfish Banner
Goldfish Banner.desc: The Goldfish is a critter that swims in water and walks on land during rain. It flops in place when out of water and rain; it does not take damage while doing so.
Goldfish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Goldfish

Black Golf Ball.desc: Golf Balls are accessories that are used in golf and come in a variety of colors. The plain, white Golf Ball can be purchased from the Golfer for and can be used for crafting the colored variants.
Black Golf Ball.tip: Can be hit with a golf club

Golf Cart Keys.name: Golf Cart Keys
Golf Cart Keys.desc: The Golf Cart Keys are a post-Skeletron mount-summoning item that places the player in a rideable Golf Cart. The Golf Cart emits light from its front that reaches about 40 tiles, with the brightest point being at about 15 tiles.
Golf Cart Keys.tip: Summons a rideable Golf Cart mount

Fancy Golf Club (Driver).name: Fancy Golf Club (Driver)
Fancy Golf Club (Driver).desc: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.
Fancy Golf Club (Driver).tip: A powerful club for long distances · Golf balls will carry very far, with little vertical loft

Fancy Golf Club (Iron).name: Fancy Golf Club (Iron)
Fancy Golf Club (Iron).desc: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.
Fancy Golf Club (Iron).tip: A well-rounded club best for mid-range distances · Golf balls will carry a good distance with decent vertical loft

Fancy Golf Club (Putter).name: Fancy Golf Club (Putter)
Fancy Golf Club (Putter).desc: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.
Fancy Golf Club (Putter).tip: A specialized club for finishing holes · Golf balls will stay close to the ground over short distances for precision shots

Fancy Golf Club (Wedge).tip: A specialized club for sand pits or tall obstacles · Golf balls will gain tons of vertical loft but will not carry very far

Golf Cup.name: Golf Cup
Golf Cup.desc: The Golf Cup is a block and activation mechanism used in Golf. It can be purchased from the Golfer for.
Golf Cup.tip: Aim to sink your golf ball in the cup · Lets everyone know how well you did

Golf Tee.name: Golf Tee
Golf Tee.desc: The Golf Tee is a furniture item used in golfing purchased from the Golfer for. It assists in placement of Golf Balls, and balls struck from a Golf Tee will travel further.
Golf Tee.tip: Right click to place a golf ball on it

Bronze Golf Trophy.name: Bronze Golf Trophy
Bronze Golf Trophy.desc: Golf trophies are decorative furniture items that can be purchased from the Golfer for each once the player has reached a certain golf score.

Gold Golf Trophy.name: Gold Golf Trophy
Gold Golf Trophy.desc: Golf trophies are decorative furniture items that can be purchased from the Golfer for each once the player has reached a certain golf score.

Silver Golf Trophy.name: Silver Golf Trophy
Silver Golf Trophy.desc: Golf trophies are decorative furniture items that can be purchased from the Golfer for each once the player has reached a certain golf score.

Golf Whistle.name: Golf Whistle
Golf Whistle.desc: The Golf Whistle is a tool used in golf that allows a player to recover Golf Balls, returning it to the previous position before it was hit when used. Using the Golf Whistle adds one stroke to the player's golf score for the shot as a penalty.
Golf Whistle.tip: Returns your last hit Golf Ball to its previous position · Has a one stroke penalty

Goodie Bag.name: Goodie Bag
Goodie Bag.desc: The Goodie Bag is a grab bag item available during the Halloween seasonal event. Each contains one random reward from the list below. Goodie Bags are opened by pressing Right Click from within the player's inventory, similar to all other grab bags.

Gothic Brick.name: Gothic Brick
Gothic Brick.desc: Gothic Bricks are pre-Hardmode bricks crafted from Stone Blocks, Cobwebs, and Bones at a Bone Welder. Their main use is crafting Gothic furniture and Gothic Brick Walls.

Gothic Brick Wall.name: Gothic Brick Wall
Gothic Brick Wall.desc: Gothic Brick Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Gothic Brick Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

GPS.name: GPS
GPS.desc: The GPS is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, the player's horizontal position, and their depth.

Gradient.name: Gradient
Gradient.desc: The Gradient is a Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for. It leaves behind a visual gradient trail when used.

Aetherium Clock.name: Aetherium Clock
Aetherium Clock.desc: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time. If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap.

Granite Chest.name: Granite Chest
Granite Chest.desc: The Granite Chest is a chest storage item found only in Underground Cabins within Granite Caves. Like Marble Chests and Rich Mahogany Chests, Granite Chests have exactly the same loot as Gold Chests.

Granite Elemental Banner.name: Granite Elemental Banner
Granite Elemental Banner.desc: The Granite Elemental is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Granite Caves and floats towards the player.
Granite Elemental Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Granite Elemental

Granite Golem Banner.name: Granite Golem Banner
Granite Golem Banner.desc: The Granite Golem is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Granite Caves. Every 300 ticks, it will stand still and shield itself from all attacks for 120 ticks, making it completely invulnerable.
Granite Golem Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Granite Golem

Granite Wall.name: Granite Wall
Granite Wall.desc: The Granite Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Granite Caves, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed. It can also be generated as part of an Underground Cabin in a Granite Cave, considered safe.

Grape Juice.name: Grape Juice
Grape Juice.desc: Grape Juice is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff.
Grape Juice.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Sugar. Water. Purple.'

Grass Seeds.name: Grass Seeds
Grass Seeds.desc: Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant regular grass on Dirt Blocks. They are purchased from the Dryad for each, while a Blood Moon is not occurring. They can also be obtained from putting Poo into an Extractinator.

Grass Wall.name: Grass Wall
Grass Wall.desc: The Grass Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in above-ground tunnels and grottoes on the surface, considered unsafe.

Grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
Grasshopper.desc: The Grasshopper is a type of critter that can be found when destroying grass plants and moves by hopping along the ground identically to slimes.

Grate.name: Grate
Grate.desc: The Grate is a foreground block which allows liquids to fall through while remaining solid for everything else, acting like a drainage system.
Grate.tip: Allows only liquids through · Closes or opens when signalled · 'They're grrrreat!'

Gravedigger Coat.name: Gravedigger Coat
Gravedigger Coat.desc: The Gravedigger set is a vanity set consisting of the Gravedigger Hat and Gravedigger Coat.

Gravedigger Hat.name: Gravedigger Hat
Gravedigger Hat.desc: The Gravedigger set is a vanity set consisting of the Gravedigger Hat and Gravedigger Coat.

Gravedigger's Shovel.name: Gravedigger's Shovel
Gravedigger's Shovel.desc: The Gravedigger's Shovel is a tool that can be used to dig up "soft" blocks (see below) more efficiently than a pickaxe or drill, in a 3×3-tile rectangle centered on the cursor.
Gravedigger's Shovel.tip: Digs in a bigger area than a pickaxe · Only digs up soft tiles · 'Can you dig it?'

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Gravity Globe.name: Gravity Globe
Gravity Globe.desc: The Gravity Globe is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord accessory that allows the holder to flip gravity, so that the player falls up instead of down, and toggle gravity back to normal afterward. Once equipped, pressing the Up key toggles the gravity direction.
Gravity Globe.tip: Allows the holder to reverse gravity · Press Up to change gravity

Gray Brick.name: Gray Brick
Gray Brick.desc: The Gray Brick is a pre-Hardmode brick.

Gray Brick Wall.name: Gray Brick Wall
Gray Brick Wall.desc: Gray Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Gray Bricks. They can only be painted white, black or brown.

Martian Gray Grunt Banner.name: Martian Gray Grunt Banner
Martian Gray Grunt Banner.desc: The Gray Grunt is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. While outwardly similar to most Martian enemies, it is unique in that it is completely invulnerable to knockback.
Martian Gray Grunt Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Gray Grunt

Gray Swimshorts.name: Gray Swimshorts
Gray Swimshorts.desc: The Gray Swimshorts are a craftable vanity item.

Greater Mana Potion.name: Greater Mana Potion
Greater Mana Potion.desc: The Greater Mana Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use.

Grebe.name: Grebe
Grebe.desc: The Grebe is a critter that spawns in bodies of water in the Desert biome that are directly above Sand Blocks. It may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Greedy Ring.name: Greedy Ring
Greedy Ring.desc: The Greedy Ring is a Hardmode accessory that combines the Discount Card's 20% discount off at any NPC shop, the Lucky Coin's 20% chance of spawning 1–10 extra coins whenever an enemy is hit and +0.05 luck, and the Gold Ring's increased coin pickup range.
Greedy Ring.tip: Increases coin pickup range · Hitting enemies will sometimes drop extra coins · Lowers shop prices by 20%

Green Cap.name: Green Cap
Green Cap.desc: The Green Cap is a piece of armor. It will always drop from the Guide, but only when his name is Andrew.

Green Horseshoe Balloon.name: Green Horseshoe Balloon
Green Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The Green Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33%, jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck.
Green Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Green Mushroom.name: Green Mushroom
Green Mushroom.desc: The Green Mushroom is a type of mushroom. It grows on Dirt, Stone, Mud, or regular Jungle grass in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Green Dye.

Green Slime Banner.name: Green Slime Banner
Green Slime Banner.desc: The Green Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime. It is the weakest slime and also one of the most common ones to encounter, likely making it the first enemy a player will come across in a new world.
Green Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Green Slime

Green Swimshorts.name: Green Swimshorts
Green Swimshorts.desc: The Green Swimshorts are a craftable vanity item.

Grenade Launcher.name: Grenade Launcher
Grenade Launcher.desc: The Grenade Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher. When used, it consumes rockets and launches grenades that explode after three seconds have passed or upon contact with enemies.

Grilled Squirrel.name: Grilled Squirrel
Grilled Squirrel.desc: The Grilled Squirrel is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Grilled Squirrel.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'That'll keep you out of my birdfeeders...'

Grim Dye.name: Grim Dye
Grim Dye.desc: Grim Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it turns the color of the armor or vanity currently selected into a blood red type color, while emitting a dark effect around the player, similar to Loki's Dye.

Grox The Great's Chestplate.name: Grox The Great's Chestplate
Grox The Great's Chestplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Grox The Great, one of the programmers who develops Terraria.

Grox The Great's Greaves.name: Grox The Great's Greaves
Grox The Great's Greaves.desc: It is the vanity set made for Grox The Great, one of the programmers who develops Terraria.

Grox The Great's Horned Cowl.name: Grox The Great's Horned Cowl
Grox The Great's Horned Cowl.desc: It is the vanity set made for Grox The Great, one of the programmers who develops Terraria.

Grub Soup.name: Grub Soup
Grub Soup.desc: Grub Soup is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Grub Soup.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Grub's up!'

Grubby.name: Grubby
Grubby.desc: Grubby is one of three critters that occasionally spawn in the Jungle or Underground Jungle biome when a player breaks a plant, the others being Sluggy (rarer) and Buggy (rarest). Grubby is the most common of the three.

Guardian Golem.name: Guardian Golem
Guardian Golem.desc: The Guardian Golem is a Hardmode, post-Golem light pet-summoning item that spawns a Toy Golem light pet upon being used or equipped. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Toy Golem emits a rocket exhaust to catch up to them.
Guardian Golem.tip: Summons a toy golem to light your way · 'Power cells not included.'

Guide to Critter Companionship.name: Guide to Critter Companionship
Guide to Critter Companionship.desc: The Guide to Critter Companionship is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from harming critters while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag. It can be purchased from the Zoologist for.
Guide to Critter Companionship.tip: Prevents you from hurting critters while in the inventory · Right click to deactivate effects

Guide to Critter Companionship (Inactive.name: Guide to Critter Companionship (Inactive)
Guide to Critter Companionship (Inactive.desc: The Guide to Critter Companionship is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from harming critters while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag. It can be purchased from the Zoologist for.
Guide to Critter Companionship (Inactive.tip: Prevents you from hurting critters while in the inventory · Effects are currently inactive, Right click to reactivate

Guide to Environmental Preservation.name: Guide to Environmental Preservation
Guide to Environmental Preservation.desc: The Guide to Environmental Preservation is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from breaking plants while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag. It can be purchased from the Dryad for.
Guide to Environmental Preservation.tip: Prevents you from accidentally destroying the environment while in the inventory · Right click to deactivate effects

Guide to Environmental Preservation (Ina.name: Guide to Environmental Preservation (Inactive)
Guide to Environmental Preservation (Ina.desc: The Guide to Environmental Preservation is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from breaking plants while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag. It can be purchased from the Dryad for.
Guide to Environmental Preservation (Ina.tip: Prevents you from accidentally destroying the environment while in the inventory · Effects are currently inactive, Right click to reactivate

Guide to Old World Parkour.name: Guide to Old World Parkour
Guide to Old World Parkour.desc: The Guide to Old World Parkour is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord tool that slightly modifies the player's movement capabilities while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag.
Guide to Old World Parkour.tip: Allows moving in nostalgic ways. · Right click to deactivate effects · 'Because it's there!'

Guide to Old World Parkour (Inactive).name: Guide to Old World Parkour (Inactive)
Guide to Old World Parkour (Inactive).desc: The Guide to Old World Parkour is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord tool that slightly modifies the player's movement capabilities while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag.
Guide to Old World Parkour (Inactive).tip: Allows moving in nostalgic ways. · Effects are currently inactive, Right click to reactivate · 'Because it's there!'

Guide to Peaceful Coexistence.name: Guide to Peaceful Coexistence
Guide to Peaceful Coexistence.desc: The Guide to Peaceful Coexistence is a pre-Hardmode tool that combines the effects of the Guide to Critter Companionship and the Guide to Environmental Preservation, preventing player attacks from harming critters and breaking plants when placed within the player's inventory or opened Void Bag.
Guide to Peaceful Coexistence.tip: Prevents you from hurting critters while in the inventory · Prevents you from accidentally destroying the environment while in the inventory · Right click to deactivate effects

Guide to Peaceful Coexistence (Inactive).name: Guide to Peaceful Coexistence (Inactive)
Guide to Peaceful Coexistence (Inactive).desc: The Guide to Peaceful Coexistence is a pre-Hardmode tool that combines the effects of the Guide to Critter Companionship and the Guide to Environmental Preservation, preventing player attacks from harming critters and breaking plants when placed within the player's inventory or opened Void Bag.
Guide to Peaceful Coexistence (Inactive).tip: Prevents you from hurting critters while in the inventory · Prevents you from accidentally destroying the environment while in the inventory · Effects are currently inactive, Right click to reactivate

Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage.name: Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage
Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage.desc: The Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage is an accessory that, when equipped, causes destroyed vines to drop Vine Ropes. It has a 1/11 chance of being found in surface Chests, or a 1/120 chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.
Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage.tip: Allows the collection of Vine Rope from vines

Guide Voodoo Doll.name: Guide Voodoo Doll
Guide Voodoo Doll.desc: The Guide Voodoo Doll is a boss-summoning item used to summon the Wall of Flesh. It is a guaranteed drop from Voodoo Demons, a fairly rare enemy in the Underworld.

Gummy Worm.name: Gummy Worm
Gummy Worm.desc: The Gummy Worm is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's Fishing Power by 3. It can only be used once per player and is obtained when a Gold Worm comes into contact with Shimmer, either as a critter or in dropped item form.

Guy Fawkes Mask.name: Guy Fawkes Mask
Guy Fawkes Mask.desc: The Guy Fawkes Mask is a head piece vanity item. It is purchased from the Clothier during Halloween for.

Hades Dye.name: Hades Dye
Hades Dye.desc: Hades Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it turns the dyed armor, accessory, or equipment blue, also adding a blue flames effect.

Haemorrhaxe.name: Haemorrhaxe
Haemorrhaxe.desc: The Haemorrhaxe is a Hardmode hamaxe that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks and Blood Eels.

Biome Hair Dye.name: Biome Hair Dye
Biome Hair Dye.desc: Hair Dyes are consumable items sold by the Stylist NPC. When used, they replace a player's hair color with a dynamic effect.

Depth Hair Dye.name: Depth Hair Dye
Depth Hair Dye.desc: Hair Dyes are consumable items sold by the Stylist NPC. When used, they replace a player's hair color with a dynamic effect.

Hair Dye Remover.desc: Hair Dyes are consumable items sold by the Stylist NPC. When used, they replace a player's hair color with a dynamic effect.

Hallowed Greaves.name: Hallowed Greaves
Hallowed Greaves.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.

Hallowed Headgear.name: Hallowed Headgear
Hallowed Headgear.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
Hallowed Headgear.tip: Increases maximum mana by 100 · 12% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Hallowed Helmet.name: Hallowed Helmet
Hallowed Helmet.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
Hallowed Helmet.tip: 15% increased ranged damage · 8% increased ranged critical strike chance

Hallowed Hood.name: Hallowed Hood
Hallowed Hood.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
Hallowed Hood.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Hallowed Mask.name: Hallowed Mask
Hallowed Mask.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
Hallowed Mask.tip: 10% increased melee damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased melee speed

Hallowed Plate Mail.name: Hallowed Plate Mail
Hallowed Plate Mail.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.

Hallowed Brick.name: Hallowed Brick
Hallowed Brick.desc: The Hallowed Brick is a Hardmode brick that is crafted from Pearlstone Blocks and Hallowed Bars.

Hallowed Brick Wall.name: Hallowed Brick Wall
Hallowed Brick Wall.desc: Hallowed Brick Wall is a Hardmode wall. As with most crafted walls, Hallowed Brick Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Hallowed Crate.name: Hallowed Crate
Hallowed Crate.desc: The Hallowed Crate is a crate that can only be fished in The Hallow. It contains items found in standard crates.
Hallowed Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Hallowed Crown.name: Hallowed Crown
Hallowed Crown.desc: The Hallowed Crown is a craftable vanity item that can be worn in the Social Helmet inventory slot. Unlike other Hallowed head pieces, it is not armor, provides no bonuses to the player, and does not count towards the Hallowed armor set bonus.

Hallowed Grass Wall.name: Hallowed Grass Wall
Hallowed Grass Wall.desc: The Hallowed Grass Wall is a type of background wall which can be found in The Hallow, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, by purchasing it from the Dryad in Hardmode for each.

Hallowed Jousting Lance.name: Hallowed Jousting Lance
Hallowed Jousting Lance.desc: The Hallowed Jousting Lance is a Hardmode melee weapon. When attacking using Left Click, the lance will extend, and holding Left Click will keep it extended at a fixed angle.
Hallowed Jousting Lance.tip: Build momentum to increase attack power

Hallowed Seeds.name: Hallowed Seeds
Hallowed Seeds.desc: Hallowed Seeds are Hardmode seeds used to plant Hallowed grass on Dirt Blocks, which will then spread The Hallow. Hallowed Seeds are purchased from the Dryad in Hardmode for each.

Hallowed Cavern Wall.name: Hallowed Cavern Wall
Hallowed Cavern Wall.desc: The Hallowed Prism Wall, Hallowed Cavern Wall, Hallowed Shard Wall, and Hallowed Crystalline Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Hallow, considered unsafe.

Hallowed Crystalline Wall.name: Hallowed Crystalline Wall
Hallowed Crystalline Wall.desc: The Hallowed Prism Wall, Hallowed Cavern Wall, Hallowed Shard Wall, and Hallowed Crystalline Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Hallow, considered unsafe.

Hallowed Prism Wall.name: Hallowed Prism Wall
Hallowed Prism Wall.desc: The Hallowed Prism Wall, Hallowed Cavern Wall, Hallowed Shard Wall, and Hallowed Crystalline Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Hallow, considered unsafe.

Hallowed Shard Wall.name: Hallowed Shard Wall
Hallowed Shard Wall.desc: The Hallowed Prism Wall, Hallowed Cavern Wall, Hallowed Shard Wall, and Hallowed Crystalline Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Hallow, considered unsafe.

Ham Bat.name: Ham Bat
Ham Bat.desc: The Ham Bat is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/25 chance of being dropped by Pigrons. It gains slightly increased damage if a food buff is active. Killing an enemy with the Ham Bat grants the Hearty Meal buff, which increases the player's health regeneration by 3 per second.
Ham Bat.tip: Grows more powerful the better fed you are · Defeating enemies temporarily improves healing · 'TIS A WEAPON O' PIG BUTT!'

Hammush.name: Hammush
Hammush.desc: The Hammush is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss hammer that is purchased from the Truffle for. When swung, the Hammush releases mushroom projectiles at its tip. Like the Pwnhammer, it can destroy altars.
Hammush.tip: Strong enough to destroy Demon Altars

Hand Of Creation.name: Hand Of Creation
Hand Of Creation.desc: The Hand Of Creation is a post-Skeletron construction accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Hand Of Creation.tip: Increases mining speed by 25% · Increases block & wall placement speed · Increases block placement & tool range by 3 · Increases pickup range for items · Automatically paints or coats placed objects · Hold Up to reach higher

Handgun.name: Handgun
Handgun.desc: The Handgun is a pre-Hardmode gun that has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.

Hanging Brazier.name: Hanging Brazier
Hanging Brazier.desc: The Hanging Brazier is a placeable decorative furniture item. It can only be placed on the ceiling, and breaking one of the blocks above it will drop the item. The Hanging Brazier is a valid light source for NPC housing.

Hanging Blinkroot.name: Hanging Blinkroot
Hanging Blinkroot.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Corrupt Deathweed.name: Hanging Corrupt Deathweed
Hanging Corrupt Deathweed.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Crimson Deathweed.name: Hanging Crimson Deathweed
Hanging Crimson Deathweed.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Daybloom.name: Hanging Daybloom
Hanging Daybloom.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Fireblossom.name: Hanging Fireblossom
Hanging Fireblossom.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Moonglow.name: Hanging Moonglow
Hanging Moonglow.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Shiverthorn.name: Hanging Shiverthorn
Hanging Shiverthorn.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Waterleaf.name: Hanging Waterleaf
Hanging Waterleaf.desc: Hanging herbs are placeable decorative furniture items craftable with one Hanging Pot and one herb. They can only be placed on the ceiling and breaking one of the blocks above a hanging herb will drop the item.

Hanging Pot.name: Hanging Pot
Hanging Pot.desc: The Hanging Pot is a placeable decorative furniture item obtained by opening Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Hanging Skeleton.name: Hanging Skeleton
Hanging Skeleton.desc: The Hanging Skeleton is a decorative furniture item that can be placed on background walls. It can be found in the Dungeon, where they only appear in areas backed by Slab or Tile Walls.

Happy Grenade.name: Happy Grenade
Happy Grenade.desc: The Happy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon that inflicts half the damage of an ordinary Grenade and displays a confetti effect.
Happy Grenade.tip: A small explosion that will not destroy tiles

Hardened Crimsand Block.name: Hardened Crimsand Block
Hardened Crimsand Block.desc: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Ebonsand Block.name: Hardened Ebonsand Block
Hardened Ebonsand Block.desc: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Pearlsand Block.name: Hardened Pearlsand Block
Hardened Pearlsand Block.desc: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Crimsand Wall.name: Hardened Crimsand Wall
Hardened Crimsand Wall.desc: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Hardened Ebonsand Wall.name: Hardened Ebonsand Wall
Hardened Ebonsand Wall.desc: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Hardened Pearlsand Wall.name: Hardened Pearlsand Wall
Hardened Pearlsand Wall.desc: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Hardened Sand Wall.name: Hardened Sand Wall
Hardened Sand Wall.desc: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Treacherous Hardened Sand Wall.name: Treacherous Hardened Sand Wall
Treacherous Hardened Sand Wall.desc: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.
Treacherous Hardened Sand Wall.tip: A dangerous slab of sand wall that will spawn monsters

Mythril Anvil.name: Mythril Anvil
Mythril Anvil.desc: The Mythril Anvil and Orichalcum Anvil are Hardmode crafting stations that serve and extend the function of a pre-Hardmode Anvil. These are very crucial to game advancement, as they account for making nearly every Hardmode recipe before the Ancient Manipulator.
Mythril Anvil.tip: Used to craft items from mythril, orichalcum, adamantite, and titanium bars

Adamantite Forge.name: Adamantite Forge
Adamantite Forge.desc: The Adamantite Forge and Titanium Forge are Hardmode crafting stations that incorporate the same functions as a regular Furnace and Hellforge, with the additional bonus of being able to smelt Adamantite, Titanium and Chlorophyte ores into their respective bars.
Adamantite Forge.tip: Used to smelt adamantite and titanium ore

Titanium Forge.name: Titanium Forge
Titanium Forge.desc: The Adamantite Forge and Titanium Forge are Hardmode crafting stations that incorporate the same functions as a regular Furnace and Hellforge, with the additional bonus of being able to smelt Adamantite, Titanium and Chlorophyte ores into their respective bars.
Titanium Forge.tip: Used to smelt adamantite and titanium ore

Hardy Saddle.name: Hardy Saddle
Hardy Saddle.desc: The Hardy Saddle is a mount-summoning item that summons a Turtle Mount that can swim and has increased movement speed in liquids ( maximum), but reduced movement speed ( maximum) and jump reach ( tiles maximum) on land. It also allows the player to breathe underwater.

Harp.name: Harp
Harp.desc: The Harp is a Hardmode crafting material, used only to craft the Magical Harp. While the Harp can be used itself, it has no functional use, and only makes sounds. It is sold by the Wizard for each.

Harpoon.name: Harpoon
Harpoon.desc: The Harpoon is a unique pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that auto-fires an arcing spear projectile connected to the player via a chain that pierces through enemies and inflicts the Bleeding debuff for 8–12 seconds on hit.

Harpy Banner.name: Harpy Banner
Harpy Banner.desc: The Harpy is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns in Space and at high altitudes, typically around Floating Islands. They move following the Bat AI, and fire slow-moving blue feather projectiles in inaccurate bursts of three.
Harpy Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Harpy

Harpy Block.name: Harpy Block
Harpy Block.desc: Harpy Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Feathers. Their main use is crafting Harpy furniture and Harpy Walls.

Harpy Charm.name: Harpy Charm
Harpy Charm.desc: The Harpy Charm is a pre-Hardmode combat accessory that grants +5% ranged critical strike chance and redirects arrows fired by the player towards the closest enemy. Arrows must be at least tiles away from the player in order to be redirected.

Harpy Wall.name: Harpy Wall
Harpy Wall.desc: Harpy Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Harpy Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Hat Rack.name: Hat Rack
Hat Rack.desc: The Hat Rack is a decorative furniture item that can be used to display up to two helmet-slot armor and vanity items, as well as dyes.
Hat Rack.tip: Right click when placed to display hats and helmets

Hay Wall.name: Hay Wall
Hay Wall.desc: The Hay Wall is a type of wall made from Hay.

Headless Horseman Banner.name: Headless Horseman Banner
Headless Horseman Banner.desc: The Headless Horseman is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 5 / wave 9 of the Pumpkin Moon event. He is an exceptionally dangerous enemy due to his speed, high contact damage, and immunity to knockback.
Headless Horseman Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Headless Horseman

Candy Apple.name: Candy Apple
Candy Apple.desc: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies, broken pots, or as a bonus drop from slimes. Enemies and pots will only drop Hearts when the closest player does not have full health.

Candy Cane.name: Candy Cane
Candy Cane.desc: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies, broken pots, or as a bonus drop from slimes. Enemies and pots will only drop Hearts when the closest player does not have full health.

Heart.name: Heart
Heart.desc: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies, broken pots, or as a bonus drop from slimes. Enemies and pots will only drop Hearts when the closest player does not have full health.

drops.chance: 50% (Desktop, Console, Old-gen console and Mobile versions) / 100% (3DS version)

Heart Hairpin.name: Heart Hairpin
Heart Hairpin.desc: The Heart Hairpin is a vanity item that is sold by the Traveling Merchant for. It is worn in the helmet slot.

Heat Ray.name: Heat Ray
Heat Ray.desc: The Heat Ray is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires yellow lasers that instantly travel their maximum distance. The lasers do not pierce enemies.
Heat Ray.tip: Shoots a scorching ray of heat · 'Oolaa!!'

Heavenforge Brick.name: Heavenforge Brick
Heavenforge Brick.desc: Heavenforge Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Full Moon.

Heavenforge Brick Wall.name: Heavenforge Brick Wall
Heavenforge Brick Wall.desc: Heavenforge Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Heavenforge Bricks.

Heavy Assembler.name: Heavy Assembler
Heavy Assembler.desc: The Heavy Assembler is a crafting station used to make various building materials, decorative items, and mechanisms.

Heavy Sling.name: Heavy Sling
Heavy Sling.desc: The Heavy Sling is a Hardmode accessory that has a 19/80 chance of dropping from Ice Mimics.
Heavy Sling.tip: Walk past a sentry to carry it

Helium Moss Brick Wall.name: Helium Moss Brick Wall
Helium Moss Brick Wall.desc: Helium Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed. Just like Helium Moss Bricks and Helium Moss, its glow cycles through the colors of rainbow.

Hell Armored Bones Banner.name: Hell Armored Bones Banner
Hell Armored Bones Banner.desc: The Hell Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawn in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties and follow the Fighter AI.
Hell Armored Bones Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hell Armored Bones

Hellbat Banner.name: Hellbat Banner
Hellbat Banner.desc: The Hellbat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in The Underworld. Although they cannot fly underwater or through lava, they take no damage from making contact with either.
Hellbat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hellbat

Hellforge.name: Hellforge
Hellforge.desc: The Hellforge is a crafting station that functions as a regular Furnace, with the additional ability of smelting Hellstone into Hellstone Bars. It is also used to craft the essential Adamantite/Titanium Forge in Hardmode.

Hellhound Banner.name: Hellhound Banner
Hellhound Banner.desc: The Hellhound is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 3 of the Pumpkin Moon event.
Hellhound Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hellhound

Hellstone Brick.name: Hellstone Brick
Hellstone Brick.desc: Hellstone Bricks are placeable blocks that occur naturally in unique Ruined Houses, though they can also be crafted.
Hellstone Brick.tip: Burns you when touched without special protection

Hellstone Brick Wall.name: Hellstone Brick Wall
Hellstone Brick Wall.desc: The Hellstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Ruined Houses in the Underworld, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Hellstone Crate.name: Hellstone Crate
Hellstone Crate.desc: The Hellstone Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in lava.
Hellstone Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Hematic Crate.name: Hematic Crate
Hematic Crate.desc: The Hematic Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be obtained by fishing in The Crimson. Hematic Crates contain items found in standard crates, and additionally always drop an item normally obtained by breaking a Crimson Heart. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Crimson Crate.
Hematic Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Hemogoblin Shark Banner.name: Hemogoblin Shark Banner
Hemogoblin Shark Banner.desc: The Hemogoblin Shark is a Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Hemogoblin Shark or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish.
Hemogoblin Shark Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hemogoblin Shark

Hemopiranha.name: Hemopiranha
Hemopiranha.desc: Hemopiranha are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in The Crimson in any layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Rage Potions.

Herb Bag.name: Herb Bag
Herb Bag.desc: The Herb Bag is a consumable grab bag item, which when opened with Right Click from within the player's inventory, contains 2–40 herbs and/or herb seeds. Herb Bags can be found in Chests on the surface.

Hercules Beetle.name: Hercules Beetle
Hercules Beetle.desc: The Hercules Beetle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that increases the damage of summon weapons by 15% and increases their knockback by 2. The Hercules Beetle can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for if he is spoken to in the Jungle after Plantera has been defeated.
Hercules Beetle.tip: Increases summon damage by 15% · Increases the knockback of your minions

Hero Shield.name: Hero Shield
Hero Shield.desc: The Hero Shield is a Hardmode post-Plantera shield accessory that redirects 25% of damage from players on the same team while above 25% health, similar to the effect of the Paladin's Shield.
Hero Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life · Enemies are more likely to target you

Hero's Hat.name: Hero's Hat
Hero's Hat.desc: The Hero's set is a vanity set composed of the Hero's Hat, the Hero's Shirt, and the Hero's Pants. Crafting the entire set requires 420 Cobwebs and 27 Jungle Grass Seeds as base ingredients.

Hero's Pants.name: Hero's Pants
Hero's Pants.desc: The Hero's set is a vanity set composed of the Hero's Hat, the Hero's Shirt, and the Hero's Pants. Crafting the entire set requires 420 Cobwebs and 27 Jungle Grass Seeds as base ingredients.

Hero's Shirt.name: Hero's Shirt
Hero's Shirt.desc: The Hero's set is a vanity set composed of the Hero's Hat, the Hero's Shirt, and the Hero's Pants. Crafting the entire set requires 420 Cobwebs and 27 Jungle Grass Seeds as base ingredients.

Heroicis' Coat.name: Heroicis' Coat
Heroicis' Coat.desc: Heroicis' set is a set of vanity items consisting of Heroicis' Hat, Heroicis' Coat, and Heroicis' Pants. It is obtained by throwing a Platinum Coin into a pool of water, lava, or honey in a Desert.
Heroicis' Coat.tip: 'Draw wisdom from many places, lest it become stale.'

Heroicis' Hat.name: Heroicis' Hat
Heroicis' Hat.desc: Heroicis' set is a set of vanity items consisting of Heroicis' Hat, Heroicis' Coat, and Heroicis' Pants. It is obtained by throwing a Platinum Coin into a pool of water, lava, or honey in a Desert.
Heroicis' Hat.tip: 'Believe in yourself, and value others. Both are blessings.'

Heroicis' Pants.name: Heroicis' Pants
Heroicis' Pants.desc: Heroicis' set is a set of vanity items consisting of Heroicis' Hat, Heroicis' Coat, and Heroicis' Pants. It is obtained by throwing a Platinum Coin into a pool of water, lava, or honey in a Desert.
Heroicis' Pants.tip: 'True humility is the only antidote to shame.'

Heroicis' Wings (Inactive).name: Heroicis' Wings (Inactive)
Heroicis' Wings (Inactive).desc: Heroicis' Wings (Inactive) are a crafting material used solely to craft Heroicis' Wings. They can be obtained along with the rest of Heroicis' set by throwing a Platinum Coin into water in an Oasis.
Heroicis' Wings (Inactive).tip: Can be activated with the right materials · 'At every setback, begin again... wiser.'

Herpling Banner.name: Herpling Banner
Herpling Banner.desc: The Herpling is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Crimson. It attacks the player by quickly jumping across the ground. While it cannot jump very high, it can cover horizontal distance very quickly, making it a potent threat.
Herpling Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Herpling

Hexxed Branch.name: Hexxed Branch
Hexxed Branch.desc: The Hexxed Branch is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Tree Mount, a ground-based mount that is unable to fly.
Hexxed Branch.tip: Summons a rideable tree mount · 'A wand crafted from the branch of a cursed tree.'

High Test Fishing Line.name: High Test Fishing Line
High Test Fishing Line.desc: The High Test Fishing Line is an accessory that prevents fishing line from breaking while fishing when equipped. Without the High Test Fishing Line equipped, there is a 1/7 chance that the line will break on any reel-in that was supposed to yield a catch.

HiTek Sunglasses.name: HiTek Sunglasses
HiTek Sunglasses.desc: The HiTek Sunglasses are a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity item for the social helmet slot. They are similar to the Sunglasses and Goggles, in that they provide eye graphics without concealing the player's hair.

Hive.name: Hive
Hive.desc: Hive is a block type that Bee Hives are made from. Upon mining it may either turn into liquid honey, spawn in a Bee, or simply drop like a regular item. Hive blocks can also be acquired by dropping Honey Blocks or Crispy Honey Blocks into Shimmer.

Hive Wall.name: Hive Wall
Hive Wall.desc: The Hive Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Bee Hives, considered unsafe. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Holly.name: Holly
Holly.desc: The Holly is a decorative item resembling an, a typical Christmas ornament. It can be placed on a background wall, similar to paintings. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 9.001% in pre-Hardmode and 8.401% in Hardmode.

Honey Balloon.name: Honey Balloon
Honey Balloon.desc: The Honey Balloon is an accessory that combines the functions of a Shiny Red Balloon and a Honey Comb.
Honey Balloon.tip: Increases jump height · Releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged

Honey Block.name: Honey Block
Honey Block.desc: Honey Blocks are blocks formed when water comes into contact with honey. When placed, they slow the movement of any player walking on them. Vertically, a player can slowly slide down them (even without having the Climbing Claws or Shoe Spikes equipped).

Honey Dispenser.name: Honey Dispenser
Honey Dispenser.desc: The Honey Dispenser is a crafting station used to craft Honey furniture out of Honey Blocks. The Honey Dispenser has a 1/4 chance of being obtained from Ivy Chests in the Underground Jungle. it can also be purchased from the Steampunker for in the Jungle.

Honeyed Goggles.name: Honeyed Goggles
Honeyed Goggles.desc: The Honeyed Goggles is a pre-Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Bee Mount which grants limited flight. The Honeyed Goggles have a 1/20 / 11/100 chance of being dropped from the Queen Bee.

Honeyfall Block.name: Honeyfall Block
Honeyfall Block.desc: The Honeyfall Block is a block which shows an animated texture of flowing honey.

Honeyfall Wall.name: Honeyfall Wall
Honeyfall Wall.desc: The Honeyfall Wall is one of only a few animated background wall types. It depicts flowing honey.

Hook.name: Hook
Hook.desc: The Hook is a crafting material used solely to craft the Grappling Hook. It has a 1/25 chance to drop from Skeletons, Undead Miners, Hoplites, and Undead Vikings in the Marble Caves, Ice biome, and Cavern layer.
Hook.tip: Sometimes dropped by Skeletons and Piranha

Hook of Dissonance.name: Hook of Dissonance
Hook of Dissonance.desc: The Hook of Dissonance is a Hardmode grappling hook that fires a single hook that reaches 30 tiles; when the hook attaches to a block, it will instantly teleport the user to the hook's position if the path to the hook is wide enough to fit a player.
Hook of Dissonance.tip: Teleports you to the location of the hook · Press Grapple to launch hook
