Hoplite Banner.name: Hoplite Banner
Hoplite Banner.desc: The Hoplite is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Marble Caves. It throws piercing Javelins at the player, which deals immense damage, especially in Expert Mode or Master Mode.
Hoplite Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hoplite

Hoppin' Jack Banner.name: Hoppin' Jack Banner
Hoppin' Jack Banner.desc: The Hoppin' Jack is a Hardmode enemy that will only appear at night during the Halloween seasonal event, or in Graveyard at any time of year. He attacks by hopping towards the player in a manner identical to most slimes.
Hoppin' Jack Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hoppin' Jack

Hornet Banner.name: Hornet Banner
Hornet Banner.desc: The Hornet is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy found in the Underground Jungle. They follow the Flying AI, floating just out of reach and then charging the player, while also firing stinger projectiles (at an increased rate in Expert Mode).
Hornet Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Hornet

Hotdog.name: Hotdog
Hotdog.desc: The Hotdog is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Hotdog has a 1/30 chance of being dropped by Bone Serpents and Red Devils.
Hotdog.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Hot diggity!'

Hoverboard.name: Hoverboard
Hoverboard.desc: The Hoverboard is a Hardmode wing-type accessory. It functions like a regular pair of wings, but with the added ability to hover by holding Jump and Down.
Hoverboard.tip: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover

Huge Dragon Egg.name: Huge Dragon Egg
Huge Dragon Egg.desc: The Huge Dragon Egg is a consumable grab bag item, which can be opened with Right Click from within the player's inventory and contains either a Chillet or Chillet Ignis. It is rarely found placed in the Cavern layer.
Huge Dragon Egg.tip: May hatch into something wonderful! · Right click to open

Hunter Cloak.name: Hunter Cloak
Hunter Cloak.desc: The Hunter Cloak is a vanity item sold by the Clothier for when the player has an accumulated golf score of 2000 or more. It is also occasionally sold by the Traveling Merchant, regardless of golf scores.

Huntress's Jerkin.name: Huntress's Jerkin
Huntress's Jerkin.desc: Huntress armor is a Hardmode ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Huntress's Wig, Huntress's Jerkin, and Huntress's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Huntress's Jerkin.tip: 20% increased summon and ranged damage and 10% chance to save ammo

Huntress's Pants.name: Huntress's Pants
Huntress's Pants.desc: Huntress armor is a Hardmode ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Huntress's Wig, Huntress's Jerkin, and Huntress's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Huntress's Pants.tip: 10% increased summon damage and 20% increased movement speed

Huntress's Wig.name: Huntress's Wig
Huntress's Wig.desc: Huntress armor is a Hardmode ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Huntress's Wig, Huntress's Jerkin, and Huntress's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Huntress's Wig.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 and increases ranged critical strike chance by 10%

Huntress's Buckler.name: Huntress's Buckler
Huntress's Buckler.desc: The Huntress's Buckler is a Hardmode shield accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%.
Huntress's Buckler.tip: Increase your max number of sentries by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Ice Bat Banner.name: Ice Bat Banner
Ice Bat Banner.desc: The Ice Bat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Ice biome. It inflicts the Chilled debuff and, more rarely, the Frozen debuff. Additionally, it emits a very faint glow.
Ice Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ice Bat

Ice Blade.name: Ice Blade
Ice Blade.desc: The Ice Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that is found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, Frozen Crates, and Boreal Crates. When swung, it occasionally fires an Ice Bolt projectile that deals the weapon's damage and does not pass through blocks or pierce enemies.

Pink Ice Block.name: Pink Ice Block
Pink Ice Block.desc: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions.

Purple Ice Block.name: Purple Ice Block
Purple Ice Block.desc: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions.

Red Ice Block.name: Red Ice Block
Red Ice Block.desc: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions.

Ice Bow.name: Ice Bow
Ice Bow.desc: The Ice Bow is a Hardmode bow that has a 19/60 chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics. When used, it converts any type of arrow into high-velocity Frost Arrows. Unlike the Frostburn Arrow item, they do not inflict the Frostburn debuff.

Ice Brick.name: Ice Brick
Ice Brick.desc: The Ice Brick is a brick type made from Ice Blocks. It does not have the sliding properties of ice, nor does it cause snow to fall like Snow Bricks.

Ice Brick Wall.name: Ice Brick Wall
Ice Brick Wall.desc: Ice Brick Wall is a type of Wall that is made using Ice Bricks.

Ice Cream.name: Ice Cream
Ice Cream.desc: Ice Cream is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Ice Cream has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Ice Bats, Ice Slimes, and Spiked Ice Slimes.
Ice Cream.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Eat it before it melts!'

Ice Elemental Banner.name: Ice Elemental Banner
Ice Elemental Banner.desc: The Ice Elemental is a Hardmode enemy that appears in the Snow biome at night and in the Ice biome at any time. The Ice Elemental slowly hovers towards the player and shoots Frost Blasts which, on, have a 1/3 chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 6 / 12 / seconds.
Ice Elemental Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ice Elemental

Ice Golem Banner.name: Ice Golem Banner
Ice Golem Banner.desc: The Ice Golem is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome during Blizzards. The Ice Golem walks slowly, and, when it has a clear line of sight with the player, fires high-velocity Frost Beam projectiles that chill and occasionally freeze them in place.
Ice Golem Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ice Golem

Ice Machine.name: Ice Machine
Ice Machine.desc: The Ice Machine is a crafting station used to craft Frozen furniture out of Ice Blocks and Snow furniture out of Snow Blocks. The Ice Machine has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Frozen Chests in the Ice biome.

Ice Slime Banner.name: Ice Slime Banner
Ice Slime Banner.desc: The Ice Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Snow biome during the daytime. Upon contact with the player, it has a chance to inflict the Chilled debuff, if the player is not already inflicted with the Frozen debuff.
Ice Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ice Slime

Ice Tortoise Banner.name: Ice Tortoise Banner
Ice Tortoise Banner.desc: The Ice Tortoise is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome. It walks around slowly, and occasionally retracts into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage.
Ice Tortoise Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ice Tortoise

Ice Wall.name: Ice Wall
Ice Wall.desc: The Ice Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Ice biome, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Ichor Dart.name: Ichor Dart
Ichor Dart.desc: The Ichor Dart is a Hardmode dart. It can pierce infinitely when initially fired. After traveling for a random duration between 6 ticks to 30 ticks, the Ichor Dart splits into 3–5 non-piercing darts (average of 3.75 darts). Ichor Darts inflict the Ichor debuff for 7–14 seconds.

Ichor Sticker Banner.name: Ichor Sticker Banner
Ichor Sticker Banner.desc: The Ichor Sticker is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Crimson and floats around in the air. When tracking the player, it spits a stream of Ichor at them, similar to that of the Golden Shower.
Ichor Sticker Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ichor Sticker

Icy Merman Banner.name: Icy Merman Banner
Icy Merman Banner.desc: The Icy Merman is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. Upon gaining line of sight of the player, it will stop in place and begin firing Icewater Spit projectiles similar to those fired by the Frost Staff, but with less frequency.
Icy Merman Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Icy Merman

Illuminant Bat Banner.name: Illuminant Bat Banner
Illuminant Bat Banner.desc: The Illuminant Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that only spawns in the Underground Hallow. It is the Hallowed version of the Giant Bat, but is much stronger and emits a blurred, after-image effect.
Illuminant Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Illuminant Bat

Illuminant Slime Banner.name: Illuminant Slime Banner
Illuminant Slime Banner.desc: The Illuminant Slime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Hallow, replacing normal cave slimes (Black and Mother Slimes) in most cases. Compared to its pre-Hardmode counterparts, it deals much more damage and has more health.
Illuminant Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Illuminant Slime

Imbuing Station.name: Imbuing Station
Imbuing Station.desc: The Imbuing Station is a crafting station used to craft flasks. It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for.
Imbuing Station.tip: Used to craft weapon imbuement flasks

Infernal Wisp Dye.name: Infernal Wisp Dye
Infernal Wisp Dye.desc: Infernal Wisp Dye is a Hardmode, post-Plantera dye obtained by turning in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Any equipment it is applied to is colored bright orange, while also emitting an orange glow.

Infused Fertilizer.name: Infused Fertilizer
Infused Fertilizer.desc: The Infused Fertilizer is a consumable item which immediately grows a sapling or gemcorn into extra-tall versions of their respective trees, similar to the Fertilizer. It is obtained by throwing Fertilizer into Shimmer.
Infused Fertilizer.tip: Causes saplings to instantly grow into taller trees · 'It’s got what plants crave!'

Inner Tube.name: Inner Tube
Inner Tube.desc: The Inner Tube is an accessory that has a 9/40 chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates. When equipped, it causes the player to float on the surface of liquids instead of sinking to the bottom and gives +5 Fishing Power.
Inner Tube.tip: Grants the ability to float in water

Iridescent Brick.name: Iridescent Brick
Iridescent Brick.desc: Iridescent Brick is a cheap brick. It can be mined with any pickaxe or drill. It and its walls can either be crafted, or collected from Jungle Shrines in the Underground Jungle.

Iridescent Brick Wall.name: Iridescent Brick Wall
Iridescent Brick Wall.desc: The Iridescent Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Ancient Iron Helmet.name: Ancient Iron Helmet
Ancient Iron Helmet.desc: Iron armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Iron Helmet, Iron Chainmail, and Iron Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Iron Bars (180 Iron Ore). The full set grants 9 defense while equipped.

Iron Chainmail.name: Iron Chainmail
Iron Chainmail.desc: Iron armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Iron Helmet, Iron Chainmail, and Iron Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Iron Bars (180 Iron Ore). The full set grants 9 defense while equipped.

Iron Greaves.name: Iron Greaves
Iron Greaves.desc: Iron armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Iron Helmet, Iron Chainmail, and Iron Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Iron Bars (180 Iron Ore). The full set grants 9 defense while equipped.

Iron Helmet.name: Iron Helmet
Iron Helmet.desc: Iron armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Iron Helmet, Iron Chainmail, and Iron Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Iron Bars (180 Iron Ore). The full set grants 9 defense while equipped.

Iron Axe.name: Iron Axe
Iron Axe.desc: The Iron Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe. In Journey Mode, the Iron Axe replaces the Copper Axe for newly created characters.

Iron Bow.name: Iron Bow
Iron Bow.desc: The Iron Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Iron Brick.name: Iron Brick
Iron Brick.desc: Iron Brick is a type of Brick crafted from Iron Ore.

Iron Brick Wall.name: Iron Brick Wall
Iron Brick Wall.desc: Iron Brick Wall is a type of background wall.

Iron Broadsword.name: Iron Broadsword
Iron Broadsword.desc: The Iron Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Iron Crate.name: Iron Crate
Iron Crate.desc: The Iron Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any height. It is the middle tier of standard crate. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Mythril Crate.

Iron Hammer.name: Iron Hammer
Iron Hammer.desc: The Iron Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer. Newly created characters spawn with an Iron Hammer in Journey Mode.

Iron Ore.name: Iron Ore
Iron Ore.desc: Iron Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Iron Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes. It can be obtained from all types of crates.

Iron Pickaxe.name: Iron Pickaxe
Iron Pickaxe.desc: The Iron Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite. In Journey Mode, the Iron Pickaxe replaces the Copper Pickaxe for newly created characters.

Iron Shortsword.name: Iron Shortsword
Iron Shortsword.desc: The Iron Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. In Journey Mode, the Iron Shortsword replaces the Copper Shortsword for newly created characters.

Item Flask.name: Item Flask
Item Flask.desc: The Item Flask is a furniture item that can be hung from the underside of blocks or placed on platforms. It has three different sprites which can be cycled through with the Up and Down keys before placing it.
Item Flask.tip: Right click to place item in item flask · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Preserve your most treasured possessions within viscous fluids'

Item Frame.name: Item Frame
Item Frame.desc: The Item Frame is a furniture item that can be placed on a 2×2 area of background wall, placed on or hung from blocks, or placed on top of platforms.
Item Frame.tip: Right click to place item on item frame

Ivy.name: Ivy
Ivy.desc: The Ivy is a novelty instrument. It will always drop from the Steampunker, but only when her name is Whitney. When used, the player strums a chord depending on how far the cursor is from the player.
Ivy.tip: Playable Instrument · 'Property of Dead Man's Sweater'

Ivy Chest.name: Ivy Chest
Ivy Chest.desc: The Ivy Chest is a chest storage item found only in Jungle Shrines and Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle.

Jack 'O Lantern.name: Jack 'O Lantern
Jack 'O Lantern.desc: The Jack 'O Lantern is a placeable furniture item that gives off light. It can have different faces when placed.
Jack 'O Lantern.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Explosive Jack 'O Lantern.name: Explosive Jack 'O Lantern
Explosive Jack 'O Lantern.desc: The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns as ammunition. Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns bounce off blocks before exploding upon contact with an enemy or after 300 ticks.

Jack 'O Lantern Launcher.name: Jack 'O Lantern Launcher
Jack 'O Lantern Launcher.desc: The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns as ammunition. Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns bounce off blocks before exploding upon contact with an enemy or after 300 ticks.

Jack 'O Lantern Mask.name: Jack 'O Lantern Mask
Jack 'O Lantern Mask.desc: The Jack 'O Lantern Mask is a vanity item for the helmet slot. It is dropped by Headless Horsemen during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 0.71%–5% (1.25%–5%) chance depending on the current wave.

drops.chance: 1/7 (14.29%) (In what a horrible night to have a curse worlds)

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.desc: The Javelin is a consumable ranged weapon that are dropped by Hoplites, which have a 1/2 chance to drop 40–80 Javelins. When used, it flies straight for approximately 36 tiles before dropping abruptly. Javelins do not drop themselves as items after hitting a block or enemy.

Blood Jelly Banner.name: Blood Jelly Banner
Blood Jelly Banner.desc: Jellyfish are enemies found in water. When underwater, they attack by propelling themselves towards the player in short bursts. When outside of water, they will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way.
Blood Jelly Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Jelly

Blue Jellyfish Banner.name: Blue Jellyfish Banner
Blue Jellyfish Banner.desc: Jellyfish are enemies found in water. When underwater, they attack by propelling themselves towards the player in short bursts. When outside of water, they will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way.
Blue Jellyfish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blue Jellyfish

Fungo Fish Banner.name: Fungo Fish Banner
Fungo Fish Banner.desc: Jellyfish are enemies found in water. When underwater, they attack by propelling themselves towards the player in short bursts. When outside of water, they will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way.
Fungo Fish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Fungo Fish

Green Jellyfish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Green Jellyfish

Pink Jellyfish Banner.name: Pink Jellyfish Banner
Pink Jellyfish Banner.desc: Jellyfish are enemies found in water. When underwater, they attack by propelling themselves towards the player in short bursts. When outside of water, they will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way.
Pink Jellyfish Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pink Jellyfish

Blue Jellyfish.name: Blue Jellyfish
Blue Jellyfish.desc: Jellyfish are a type of bait which are found rarely by fishing. Each has a bait power of 20%.

Green Jellyfish.name: Green Jellyfish
Green Jellyfish.desc: Jellyfish are a type of bait which are found rarely by fishing. Each has a bait power of 20%.

Pink Jellyfish.name: Pink Jellyfish
Pink Jellyfish.desc: Jellyfish are a type of bait which are found rarely by fishing. Each has a bait power of 20%.

Jellyfish Block.name: Jellyfish Block
Jellyfish Block.desc: Jellyfish Blocks are Hardmode blocks purchased from the Pirate in a Graveyard for each. Their main use is crafting Jellyfish furniture and Jellyfish Walls. They glow in the dark when placed.

Jellyfish Diving Gear.name: Jellyfish Diving Gear
Jellyfish Diving Gear.desc: Jellyfish Diving Gear is an accessory crafted by combining Jellyfish Necklace and Diving Gear at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the functionalities of its ingredients:
Jellyfish Diving Gear.tip: Grants the ability to swim and greatly extends underwater breathing · Generates a very subtle glow which becomes more vibrant underwater

Blue Jellyfish Jar.name: Blue Jellyfish Jar
Blue Jellyfish Jar.desc: Jellyfish jars are animated decorative furniture items. The Jellyfish needed to craft these decorations are bait items obtained by fishing, not by killing the actual Jellyfish enemies.

Green Jellyfish Jar.name: Green Jellyfish Jar
Green Jellyfish Jar.desc: Jellyfish jars are animated decorative furniture items. The Jellyfish needed to craft these decorations are bait items obtained by fishing, not by killing the actual Jellyfish enemies.

Pink Jellyfish Jar.name: Pink Jellyfish Jar
Pink Jellyfish Jar.desc: Jellyfish jars are animated decorative furniture items. The Jellyfish needed to craft these decorations are bait items obtained by fishing, not by killing the actual Jellyfish enemies.

Jellyfish Necklace.name: Jellyfish Necklace
Jellyfish Necklace.desc: The Jellyfish Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/100 chance to drop from Pink, Blue, or Green Jellyfish in the Ocean and Underground or Cavern layer. the Jellyfish Necklace provides a faint pink glow when the player is submerged in water or honey.
Jellyfish Necklace.tip: Generates a very subtle glow which becomes more vibrant underwater (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) · Provides light under water (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Jellyfish Wall.name: Jellyfish Wall
Jellyfish Wall.desc: Jellyfish Wall is a Hardmode wall. As with most crafted walls, Jellyfish Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning. They glow in the dark when placed like the Jellyfish Blocks that it is made from.

Jewel of Light.name: Jewel of Light
Jewel of Light.desc: The Jewel of Light is a Hardmode, post-Plantera light pet-summoning item that spawns a Fairy Princess that provides pink-colored light. It is fast and will always position itself slightly elevated behind the player.
Jewel of Light.tip: Summons a fairy princess to provide light · 'A glowing gemstone that houses a powerful fairy.'

Jim's Cap.name: Jim's Cap
Jim's Cap.desc: Jim's Cap is an vanity item. It will always drop from the Painter, but only when his name is Jim.

Jim's Breastplate.name: Jim's Breastplate
Jim's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Jimmarn, an artist who develops graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Jim's Helmet.name: Jim's Helmet
Jim's Helmet.desc: It is the vanity set made for Jimmarn, an artist who develops graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Jim's Leggings.name: Jim's Leggings
Jim's Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for Jimmarn, an artist who develops graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Joja Cola.name: Joja Cola
Joja Cola.desc: The Joja Cola is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. It has a 1/8 chance of being fished up instead of a junk item when fishing.
Joja Cola.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Please Recycle'

Jousting Lance.name: Jousting Lance
Jousting Lance.desc: The Jousting Lance is a Hardmode melee weapon purchased from the Zoologist for after filling out 30% of the Bestiary. When attacking using Left Click, the lance will extend, and holding Left Click will keep it extended at a fixed angle.
Jousting Lance.tip: Build momentum to increase attack power · 'Have at thee!'

Junction Box.name: Junction Box
Junction Box.desc: The Junction Box is a mechanism that allows wires of the same color to cross without connecting. It is purchased from the Mechanic for. The Junction Box can be placed in midair, without the need for support.
Junction Box.tip: Separates wire paths · Hammer to change direction

Jungle Hat.name: Jungle Hat
Jungle Hat.desc: Jungle armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Jungle Shirt, Jungle Hat, and Jungle Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 32 Jungle Spores, 2 Vines, and 10 Stingers.
Jungle Hat.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 6% increased magic critical strike chance

Jungle Pants.name: Jungle Pants
Jungle Pants.desc: Jungle armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Jungle Shirt, Jungle Hat, and Jungle Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 32 Jungle Spores, 2 Vines, and 10 Stingers.
Jungle Pants.tip: Increases maximum mana by 20 · 6% increased magic critical strike chance

Jungle Shirt.name: Jungle Shirt
Jungle Shirt.desc: Jungle armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Jungle Shirt, Jungle Hat, and Jungle Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 32 Jungle Spores, 2 Vines, and 10 Stingers.
Jungle Shirt.tip: Increases maximum mana by 20 · 6% increased magic damage

Jungle Bat Banner.name: Jungle Bat Banner
Jungle Bat Banner.desc: The Jungle Bat is a common pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Jungle and less commonly in the Underground Jungle. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree at night. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff.
Jungle Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Jungle Bat

Jungle Crate.name: Jungle Crate
Jungle Crate.desc: The Jungle Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Jungle. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally found in Ivy Chests within Jungle Shrines or Living Mahogany Trees. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Bramble Crate.
Jungle Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Jungle Creeper Banner.name: Jungle Creeper Banner
Jungle Creeper Banner.desc: The Jungle Creeper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. Like other spiders, it can climb on background walls.
Jungle Creeper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Jungle Creeper

Jungle Juice.name: Jungle Juice
Jungle Juice.desc: Jungle Juice is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 180 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.
Jungle Juice.tip: 'A tropical concoction with hints of Life Fruit and nutmeg'

Jungle Slime Banner.name: Jungle Slime Banner
Jungle Slime Banner.desc: The Jungle Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that only spawns in the Jungle during the daytime. They have relatively high damage and health compared to most other slimes in the early game.
Jungle Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Jungle Slime

Jungle Turtle.name: Jungle Turtle
Jungle Turtle.desc: The Jungle Turtle is a harmless critter that spawns in or near a body of water on the surface Jungle at any time. Like its Forest counterpart, it moves slowly on land and swims at the surface of water.

Jungle Wall.name: Jungle Wall
Jungle Wall.desc: The Jungle Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained by purchasing it from the Dryad for each, in Hardmode.

Ivy Stone Wall.name: Ivy Stone Wall
Ivy Stone Wall.desc: The Lichen Stone Wall, Leafy Jungle Wall, Ivy Stone Wall, and Jungle Vine Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Jungle Vine Wall.name: Jungle Vine Wall
Jungle Vine Wall.desc: The Lichen Stone Wall, Leafy Jungle Wall, Ivy Stone Wall, and Jungle Vine Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Leafy Jungle Wall.name: Leafy Jungle Wall
Leafy Jungle Wall.desc: The Lichen Stone Wall, Leafy Jungle Wall, Ivy Stone Wall, and Jungle Vine Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Lichen Stone Wall.name: Lichen Stone Wall
Lichen Stone Wall.desc: The Lichen Stone Wall, Leafy Jungle Wall, Ivy Stone Wall, and Jungle Vine Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Old Shoe.name: Old Shoe
Old Shoe.desc: Junk items are fished instead of regular fishing catches when the player's fishing conditions are particularly unfavorable. Their only use is being converted by the Extractinator or Chlorophyte Extractinator to obtain low-level bait.

Seaweed.name: Seaweed
Seaweed.desc: Junk items are fished instead of regular fishing catches when the player's fishing conditions are particularly unfavorable. Their only use is being converted by the Extractinator or Chlorophyte Extractinator to obtain low-level bait.

Tin Can.name: Tin Can
Tin Can.desc: Junk items are fished instead of regular fishing catches when the player's fishing conditions are particularly unfavorable. Their only use is being converted by the Extractinator or Chlorophyte Extractinator to obtain low-level bait.

Karate Tortoise Mask.name: Karate Tortoise Mask
Karate Tortoise Mask.desc: The Karate Tortoise set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween, with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Karate Tortoise Mask, Karate Tortoise Shirt and Karate Tortoise Pants. Its male and female variants look identical.

Karate Tortoise Pants.name: Karate Tortoise Pants
Karate Tortoise Pants.desc: The Karate Tortoise set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween, with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Karate Tortoise Mask, Karate Tortoise Shirt and Karate Tortoise Pants. Its male and female variants look identical.

Karate Tortoise Shirt.name: Karate Tortoise Shirt
Karate Tortoise Shirt.desc: The Karate Tortoise set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween, with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Karate Tortoise Mask, Karate Tortoise Shirt and Karate Tortoise Pants. Its male and female variants look identical.

Kazzymodus' Chestpiece.name: Kazzymodus' Chestpiece
Kazzymodus' Chestpiece.desc: It is the vanity set made for Kazzymodus, who is in charge of quality assurance at Re-Logic.

Kazzymodus' Hood.name: Kazzymodus' Hood
Kazzymodus' Hood.desc: It is the vanity set made for Kazzymodus, who is in charge of quality assurance at Re-Logic.
Kazzymodus' Hood.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'I have a cunning plan...'

Kazzymodus' Leggings.name: Kazzymodus' Leggings
Kazzymodus' Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for Kazzymodus, who is in charge of quality assurance at Re-Logic.

Keg.name: Keg
Keg.desc: The Keg is a crafting station used solely to brew Ale. In addition to being crafted, it can sometimes be found in Underground Cabins.

Key of Light.name: Key of Light
Key of Light.desc: The Key of Light is a craftable item which spawns a Hallowed Mimic when placed in any slot of any empty Chest. The world must be in Hardmode and the only item inside the Chest must be a single Key of Light.
Key of Light.tip: 'Charged with the essence of many souls'

Key of Night.name: Key of Night
Key of Night.desc: The Key of Night is a craftable item that spawns a Corrupt Mimic or a Crimson Mimic when placed in any slot of any empty Chest, depending on whether the world generated with The Corruption or The Crimson, respectively.
Key of Night.tip: 'Charged with the essence of many souls'

Keybrand.name: Keybrand
Keybrand.desc: The Keybrand is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/200 / 399/40000 chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Hell Armored Bones, and Rusty Armored Bones in the Hardmode Dungeon.
Keybrand.tip: Deals more damage to injured foes

Killing Deck.name: Killing Deck
Killing Deck.desc: The Killing Deck is a Hardmode magic weapon that can be purchased from the Wizard for during a Blood Moon. It launches Killing Card projectiles that fly for 0.5 seconds in a serpentine pattern before abruptly falling.
Killing Deck.tip: 'A Dead Man's Hand for your opponents, mon chéri'

Kimono.name: Kimono
Kimono.desc: The Kimono is a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Kinship Peach.name: Kinship Peach
Kinship Peach.desc: The Kinship Peach is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss crafting material, which is notably crafted using Life Fruit. It is used to upgrade Cattiva and Foxparks to their "trusty" variants.
Kinship Peach.tip: A rarely seen magical fruit · It is said that a Pal who eats it will open its heart to humans · Choose carefully which Pal you give it to

Angry Trapper Kite.desc: Kites are miscellaneous items that can be held by the player. A kite can be flown during Windy Days or if the player runs fast enough while holding it. It can be raised higher with Left Click and lowered with Right Click.
Angry Trapper Kite.tip: Kites can be flown on windy days · Reel it in with Right click

KO Cannon.name: KO Cannon
KO Cannon.desc: The KO Cannon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Clowns. When used, it fires a boxing glove attached to the player via a chain. The glove retracts on contact with blocks or enemies, or after traveling 12 tiles.

Kobold Banner.name: Kobold Banner
Kobold Banner.desc: The Kobold is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 2–7, and Tier 3 during waves 2–5.
Kobold Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Kobold

Kobold Dynamite Backpack.name: Kobold Dynamite Backpack
Kobold Dynamite Backpack.desc: The Kobold Dynamite Backpack is an unimplemented item that resembles the dynamite backpack worn by Kobolds and Kobold Gliders. It only exists as an ID and image file in the game's code. Attempting to use third-party tools to obtain it will result in it instantly disappearing.

Kobold Glider Banner.name: Kobold Glider Banner
Kobold Glider Banner.desc: The Kobold Glider is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 5–7, and Tier 3 during waves 4–5.
Kobold Glider Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Kobold Glider

Kraken.name: Kraken
Kraken.desc: The Kraken is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/7 chance to drop from Duke Fishron. It has a base critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.
Kraken.tip: Enchanted with sunken energy · Hits charge a powerful wave

Krampus Banner.name: Krampus Banner
Krampus Banner.desc: The Krampus is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 8 of the Frost Moon event.
Krampus Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Krampus

Krypton Moss Brick Wall.name: Krypton Moss Brick Wall
Krypton Moss Brick Wall.desc: Krypton Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Krypton Moss and the Krypton Moss Brick it is made from.

Kwad Racer Drone.name: Kwad Racer Drone
Kwad Racer Drone.desc: The Kwad Racer Drone is a Hardmode, post-Plantera novelty item purchased from the Cyborg for. Pressing the Left Click button while selected in the hotbar summons a harmless drone that can be controlled by the Up, Left Click, and Right Click buttons.
Kwad Racer Drone.tip: Rotate Left/Right to steer & Press Up to accelerate · 'First rule of Flight Club, we don't talk about Flight Club'

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Lac Beetle Banner.name: Lac Beetle Banner
Lac Beetle Banner.desc: The Lac Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. When killed, it will drop the Violet Husk, which can be used to make Violet Dye.
Lac Beetle Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lac Beetle

Ladybug.name: Ladybug
Ladybug.desc: The Ladybug is a small uncommon critter that can be found in Forests with a town during the Windy Day event at daytime.

Lamia Banner.name: Lamia Banner
Lamia Banner.desc: The Lamia is a Hardmode enemy that can only be found in the Underground Desert biome. When found in regular or Hallowed Underground Deserts, it has pale blonde hair and has a chance to drop the Sun Mask.
Lamia Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lamia

Lamia Mask.name: Lamia Mask
Lamia Mask.desc: The Lamia set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Lamia Mask, Lamia Wraps and the Lamia Tail. It is rarely dropped by Lamias, with a 1/120 chance per piece for both types of Lamia.

Lamia Tail.name: Lamia Tail
Lamia Tail.desc: The Lamia set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Lamia Mask, Lamia Wraps and the Lamia Tail. It is rarely dropped by Lamias, with a 1/120 chance per piece for both types of Lamia.

Lamia Wraps.name: Lamia Wraps
Lamia Wraps.desc: The Lamia set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Lamia Mask, Lamia Wraps and the Lamia Tail. It is rarely dropped by Lamias, with a 1/120 chance per piece for both types of Lamia.

Lamp Post.name: Lamp Post
Lamp Post.desc: The Lamp Post is a piece of furniture that emits light. It can be placed underwater and can be toggled with wires. It counts as a light source for housing.

Aetherium Lamp.name: Aetherium Lamp
Aetherium Lamp.desc: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source. They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms.

Large Emerald.desc: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem, and are dropped when the player dies, even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode. With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head.
Large Emerald.tip: For Capture the Gem. It drops when you die

Large Sapphire.name: Large Sapphire
Large Sapphire.desc: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem, and are dropped when the player dies, even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode. With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head.
Large Sapphire.tip: For Capture the Gem. It drops when you die

Large Topaz.name: Large Topaz
Large Topaz.desc: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem, and are dropped when the player dies, even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode. With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head.
Large Topaz.tip: For Capture the Gem. It drops when you die

Large Volcano.name: Large Volcano
Large Volcano.desc: The Large Volcano is a decorative animated furniture item that emits light when placed. Its animation can be toggled on and off with wires.

Laser Drill.name: Laser Drill
Laser Drill.desc: The Laser Drill is a Hardmode, post-Golem drill that has a 1/800 chance of being dropped from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event. It produces a green glowing drill-like beam that extends up to a base distance of 16 tiles. It can mine all blocks.

Lava Bat Banner.name: Lava Bat Banner
Lava Bat Banner.desc: The Lava Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that appears in the Underworld after one of the mechanical bosses has been defeated. It is a stronger version of the Hellbat.
Lava Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lava Bat

Lava Boulder.name: Lava Boulder
Lava Boulder.desc: The Lava Boulder is a special type of Boulder. It deals 140 / 280 / damage to players (70 damage to NPCs, enemies, and critters) and inflicts On Fire! for 5 / 10 / seconds to players (5 seconds to NPCs, enemies, and critters). It can be encountered within 60 tiles of Lava.

Lava Cloud.name: Lava Cloud
Lava Cloud.desc: The Lava Cloud is a block that glows in the dark when placed. It replaces Rain Clouds in Skyblock islands that spawn in the Underworld, which most prominently occurs when combined with the Remix special seed.

Lava Lamp.name: Lava Lamp
Lava Lamp.desc: The Lava Lamp is a furniture item purchased from the Party Girl for, that emits a small amount of light and has an animated texture. It is not a mechanism but can be placed on tables. It is not considered a suitable light source for an NPC house.

Lava Moss Brick Wall.name: Lava Moss Brick Wall
Lava Moss Brick Wall.desc: Lava Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Lava Moss and the Lava Moss Brick it is made from.

Lava Slime Banner.name: Lava Slime Banner
Lava Slime Banner.desc: The Lava Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Underworld. It gives off an orange glow with fire particles.
Lava Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lava Slime

Lava Waders.name: Lava Waders
Lava Waders.desc: The Lava Waders are a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:
Lava Waders.tip: Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

Cinder Wall.name: Cinder Wall
Cinder Wall.desc: The Obsidian Wall, Ember Wall, Cinder Wall, Magma Wall, and Smouldering Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the lower Cavern layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Ember Wall.name: Ember Wall
Ember Wall.desc: The Obsidian Wall, Ember Wall, Cinder Wall, Magma Wall, and Smouldering Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the lower Cavern layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Magma Wall.name: Magma Wall
Magma Wall.desc: The Obsidian Wall, Ember Wall, Cinder Wall, Magma Wall, and Smouldering Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the lower Cavern layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Obsidian Wall.name: Obsidian Wall
Obsidian Wall.desc: The Obsidian Wall, Ember Wall, Cinder Wall, Magma Wall, and Smouldering Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the lower Cavern layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Smouldering Stone Wall.name: Smouldering Stone Wall
Smouldering Stone Wall.desc: The Obsidian Wall, Ember Wall, Cinder Wall, Magma Wall, and Smouldering Stone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the lower Cavern layer, considered unsafe. They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting.

Lavafall Block.name: Lavafall Block
Lavafall Block.desc: The Lavafall Block is an animated block type that shows flowing lava, which glows when placed. It does not satisfy the need for a light source in an NPC house.

Lavafall Wall.name: Lavafall Wall
Lavafall Wall.desc: Lavafall Wall is one of few animated background wall types. It depicts flowing lava, and in a similar manner to lava also emits light when placed. Despite it being made from lava, it will still burn in lava.

Lavafly.name: Lavafly
Lavafly.desc: The Lavafly is a critter that spawns occasionally in the Underworld at night. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking an Ash tree in the Underworld at any time.

Lavaproof Bug Net.name: Lavaproof Bug Net
Lavaproof Bug Net.desc: The Lavaproof Bug Net is an upgraded version of the Bug Net. It allows the player to successfully catch the Lavafly, Magma Snail, and Hell Butterfly that can be used to fish in lava. It swings faster than the Bug Net and can destroy tall grass and vines.
Lavaproof Bug Net.tip: Used to catch critters and bait · Can catch lava critters too! · 'For when things get too hot to handle'

Lavaproof Fishing Hook.name: Lavaproof Fishing Hook
Lavaproof Fishing Hook.desc: The Lavaproof Fishing Hook is an accessory that allows the player to fish in lava with any bait and any fishing pole. It has a 19/100 chance of being obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates, both of which can be obtained from fishing in lava.

Lawn Flamingo.name: Lawn Flamingo
Lawn Flamingo.desc: The Lawn Flamingo is a decorative furniture item that can be placed and serves no purpose other than as decoration. It can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Lawn Flamingo.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Lawn Mower.name: Lawn Mower
Lawn Mower.desc: The Lawn Mower is a tool that can be purchased from the Golfer for and mows normal and Hallowed grass.
Lawn Mower.tip: Mows Pure and Hallowed grass · Mowed grass reduces enemy spawn chance

Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet.name: Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet
Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet.desc: It is the vanity set made for Lazure, a former artist at Re-Logic.
Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Become the wind, ride the lightning.

Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak.name: Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak
Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak.desc: It is the vanity set made for Lazure, a former artist at Re-Logic.
Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Bejeweled and elegant for soaring through the thundering skies

Lead Chainmail.name: Lead Chainmail
Lead Chainmail.desc: Lead armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Lead Helmet, Lead Chainmail, and Lead Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Lead Bars (180 Lead Ore). The full set grants 11 defense while equipped.

Lead Greaves.name: Lead Greaves
Lead Greaves.desc: Lead armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Lead Helmet, Lead Chainmail, and Lead Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Lead Bars (180 Lead Ore). The full set grants 11 defense while equipped.

Lead Helmet.name: Lead Helmet
Lead Helmet.desc: Lead armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Lead Helmet, Lead Chainmail, and Lead Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Lead Bars (180 Lead Ore). The full set grants 11 defense while equipped.

Lead Axe.name: Lead Axe
Lead Axe.desc: The Lead Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Lead Bow.name: Lead Bow
Lead Bow.desc: The Lead Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Lead Brick.name: Lead Brick
Lead Brick.desc: Lead Brick is a type of Brick crafted from Lead Ore.

Lead Brick Wall.name: Lead Brick Wall
Lead Brick Wall.desc: Lead Brick Wall is a type of background wall.

Lead Broadsword.name: Lead Broadsword
Lead Broadsword.desc: The Lead Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Lead Hammer.name: Lead Hammer
Lead Hammer.desc: The Lead Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Lead Ore.name: Lead Ore
Lead Ore.desc: Lead Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Lead Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Lead Pickaxe.name: Lead Pickaxe
Lead Pickaxe.desc: The Lead Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite.

Lead Shortsword.name: Lead Shortsword
Lead Shortsword.desc: The Lead Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Leinfors' Excessive Style.name: Leinfors' Excessive Style
Leinfors' Excessive Style.desc: It is the vanity set made for Leinfors, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.

Leinfors' Fancypants.name: Leinfors' Fancypants
Leinfors' Fancypants.desc: It is the vanity set made for Leinfors, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Leinfors' Fancypants.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'There might be pasta in the pockets'

Leinfors' Hair Protector.name: Leinfors' Hair Protector
Leinfors' Hair Protector.desc: It is the vanity set made for Leinfors, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Leinfors' Hair Protector.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'To keep those luscious locks as gorgeous as ever'

Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo.name: Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo
Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo.desc: It is the vanity set made for Leinfors, a former production assistant at Re-Logic.
Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · 'Brought to you by LeinCorp'

Lemonade.name: Lemonade
Lemonade.desc: Lemonade is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Lemonade.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · '...make lemonade!'

Leprechaun Hat.name: Leprechaun Hat
Leprechaun Hat.desc: The Leprechaun set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event. It consists of a Leprechaun Hat, Leprechaun Shirt and Leprechaun Pants.
Leprechaun Hat.tip: To me it look like a leprechaun to me

Leprechaun Pants.name: Leprechaun Pants
Leprechaun Pants.desc: The Leprechaun set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event. It consists of a Leprechaun Hat, Leprechaun Shirt and Leprechaun Pants.
Leprechaun Pants.tip: I want the gold. I want the gold. I want the gold. Gimme the gold!

Leprechaun Shirt.name: Leprechaun Shirt
Leprechaun Shirt.desc: The Leprechaun set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event. It consists of a Leprechaun Hat, Leprechaun Shirt and Leprechaun Pants.
Leprechaun Shirt.tip: I just wanna know where the gold at!

Lesion Block.name: Lesion Block
Lesion Block.desc: The Lesion Block is a Hardmode block. It is used to craft Lesion furniture and Lesion Block Walls. Lesion Blocks will not spread the Corruption.

Lesion Block Wall.name: Lesion Block Wall
Lesion Block Wall.desc: The Lesion Block Wall is a type of background walls. Like most walls, they will stop enemy spawning, and can be used for NPC houses.

Lesser Mana Potion.name: Lesser Mana Potion
Lesser Mana Potion.desc: The Lesser Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores mana when used and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It can be purchased from the Merchant for each, and can also be found in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.

Lever.name: Lever
Lever.desc: The Lever is a 2×2 activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for. It can activate Statues, lights, etc. via Right Click.
Lever.tip: Right click when placed to signal

Librarian Block.name: Librarian Block
Librarian Block.desc: Librarian Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks that are used to craft Librarian Platforms, Librarian Walls, and Librarian furniture.

Librarian Skeleton Banner.name: Librarian Skeleton Banner
Librarian Skeleton Banner.desc: The Librarian Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in front of placed Books in the Dungeon. It teleports around the player, preferably near books, and attacks by throwing nearby books at the player, which go through blocks.
Librarian Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Librarian Skeleton

Librarian Wall.name: Librarian Wall
Librarian Wall.desc: Librarian Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Librarian Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Life Booster.name: Life Booster
Life Booster.desc: The Life Booster is one of the three power-ups occasionally dropped when striking enemies while wearing a full set of Nebula armor.

Life Crystal Boulder.name: Life Crystal Boulder
Life Crystal Boulder.desc: The Life Crystal Boulder is a furniture item. It spawns naturally in the Celebration Mk 10, No Traps, and the Zenith special world seeds.

Life Preserver.name: Life Preserver
Life Preserver.desc: The Life Preserver is a wall decoration acquired by finishing Angler quests. It is rewarded with a 1/70 chance.

Light Disc.name: Light Disc
Light Disc.desc: The Light Disc is a Hardmode, post-The Destroyer boomerang. It does not necessarily return immediately upon contact with objects, but instead can bounce off blocks before returning.

Lightning Aura Cane.name: Lightning Aura Cane
Lightning Aura Cane.desc: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within.
Lightning Aura Cane.tip: Summons a sentry · An aura that repeatedly zaps enemies that go inside · Aura damage penetrates enemy defense · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Lightning Aura Rod.name: Lightning Aura Rod
Lightning Aura Rod.desc: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within.
Lightning Aura Rod.tip: Summons a sentry · An aura that repeatedly zaps enemies that go inside · Aura damage penetrates enemy defense · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Lightning Aura Staff.name: Lightning Aura Staff
Lightning Aura Staff.desc: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within.
Lightning Aura Staff.tip: Summons a sentry · An aura that repeatedly zaps enemies that go inside · Aura damage penetrates enemy defense · Costs 10 Etherian Mana per use while defending an Eternia Crystal

Lightning Bug.name: Lightning Bug
Lightning Bug.desc: The Lightning Bug is a harmless Hardmode critter that gives off a tiny amount of light, similarly to the Firefly. It spawns on Hallowed grass blocks during the night.

Lightning Carrot.name: Lightning Carrot
Lightning Carrot.desc: The Lightning Carrot is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Volt Bunny that follows the player.

Lightning Strike.name: Lightning Strike
Lightning Strike.desc: The Lightning Strike is a Hardmode wand that calls down lightning bolts from the sky, and is an upgrade to the Thunder Zapper. When used, it creates a blue spark at the cursor's location which is initially harmless.
Lightning Strike.tip: Summons lightning strikes from the sky

Lihzahrd Banner.name: Lihzahrd Banner
Lihzahrd Banner.desc: The Lihzahrd is an enemy that spawns in the Jungle Temple and initially behaves like an ordinary walking fighter. However, as soon as its health is reduced to below 55% ( / / ), it enters its second, crawling form, causing it appear like a more lizard-like quadrupedal creature.
Lihzahrd Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Lihzahrd

Lihzahrd Altar.name: Lihzahrd Altar
Lihzahrd Altar.desc: The Lihzahrd Altar is a furniture item used for summoning Golem with Lihzahrd Power Cells. Upon pressing Right Click on it, one Lihzahrd Power Cell is consumed from the player's inventory and Golem is instantly summoned.

Forbidden Lihzahrd Brick Wall.name: Forbidden Lihzahrd Brick Wall
Forbidden Lihzahrd Brick Wall.desc: The Lihzahrd Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Jungle Temple, considered unsafe. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.
Forbidden Lihzahrd Brick Wall.tip: An ancient segment of Temple wall that will spawn Lihzahrds

Lihzahrd Brick Wall.name: Lihzahrd Brick Wall
Lihzahrd Brick Wall.desc: The Lihzahrd Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Jungle Temple, considered unsafe. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Lihzahrd Chest.name: Lihzahrd Chest
Lihzahrd Chest.desc: Lihzahrd Chests are chests found in the Jungle Temple. Each contains one Lihzahrd Power Cell, and may contain a Lihzahrd Furnace, some Solar Tablet Fragments, and sometimes, a Solar Tablet. They also contain other typical Gold Chest loot.

Lihzahrd Furnace.name: Lihzahrd Furnace
Lihzahrd Furnace.desc: The Lihzahrd Furnace is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting station used to craft Lihzahrd furniture out of Lihzahrd Bricks. It is always found in every Lihzahrd Chest in the Jungle Temple.

Lihzahrd Power Cell.name: Lihzahrd Power Cell
Lihzahrd Power Cell.desc: The Lihzahrd Power Cell is a boss-summoning item used to summon Golem. It can only be used at the Lihzahrd Altar (located in the final chamber of the Jungle Temple), at any time, as long as the world is in Hardmode and Plantera has been defeated.

Lilac Dusk Dress.name: Lilac Dusk Dress
Lilac Dusk Dress.desc: The Lilac Dusk set is a vanity set consisting of the Lilac Dusk Hairclip, the Lilac Dusk Dress, and the Lilac Dusk Skirt. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Lilac Dusk Hairclip.name: Lilac Dusk Hairclip
Lilac Dusk Hairclip.desc: The Lilac Dusk set is a vanity set consisting of the Lilac Dusk Hairclip, the Lilac Dusk Dress, and the Lilac Dusk Skirt. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Lilac Dusk Skirt.name: Lilac Dusk Skirt
Lilac Dusk Skirt.desc: The Lilac Dusk set is a vanity set consisting of the Lilac Dusk Hairclip, the Lilac Dusk Dress, and the Lilac Dusk Skirt. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Lilith's Necklace.name: Lilith's Necklace
Lilith's Necklace.desc: Lilith's Necklace is a Hardmode transformation mount item that turns the player into a Wolf. Some vanity items are visible when transformed, but certain accessories cannot be used, such as wings.
Lilith's Necklace.tip: Grants the wearer the power of the wolf

Lime Kelp.name: Lime Kelp
Lime Kelp.desc: The Lime Kelp is a dye material and type of plant. It grows on any tiles submerged in at least 2 tiles of any liquid in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe.

Dry Bomb.name: Dry Bomb
Dry Bomb.desc: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks. There are four different types of liquid bombs: Dry Bomb, Wet Bomb, Lava Bomb, and Honey Bomb.
Dry Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will absorb liquid

Honey Bomb.name: Honey Bomb
Honey Bomb.desc: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks. There are four different types of liquid bombs: Dry Bomb, Wet Bomb, Lava Bomb, and Honey Bomb.
Honey Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will spread honey

Lava Bomb.name: Lava Bomb
Lava Bomb.desc: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks. There are four different types of liquid bombs: Dry Bomb, Wet Bomb, Lava Bomb, and Honey Bomb.
Lava Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will spread lava

Wet Bomb.name: Wet Bomb
Wet Bomb.desc: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks. There are four different types of liquid bombs: Dry Bomb, Wet Bomb, Lava Bomb, and Honey Bomb.
Wet Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will spread water

Dry Rocket.name: Dry Rocket
Dry Rocket.desc: Liquid rockets are rocket ammunition items which place or remove liquids in addition to dealing damage. There are four different types of liquid rockets: Dry Rocket, Wet Rocket, Lava Rocket, and Honey Rocket.

Honey Rocket.name: Honey Rocket
Honey Rocket.desc: Liquid rockets are rocket ammunition items which place or remove liquids in addition to dealing damage. There are four different types of liquid rockets: Dry Rocket, Wet Rocket, Lava Rocket, and Honey Rocket.

Lava Rocket.name: Lava Rocket
Lava Rocket.desc: Liquid rockets are rocket ammunition items which place or remove liquids in addition to dealing damage. There are four different types of liquid rockets: Dry Rocket, Wet Rocket, Lava Rocket, and Honey Rocket.

Wet Rocket.name: Wet Rocket
Wet Rocket.desc: Liquid rockets are rocket ammunition items which place or remove liquids in addition to dealing damage. There are four different types of liquid rockets: Dry Rocket, Wet Rocket, Lava Rocket, and Honey Rocket.

Little Kinship Peach.name: Little Kinship Peach
Little Kinship Peach.desc: The Little Kinship Peach is a Hardmode crafting material. It is used to upgrade Chillet to Trusty Chillet, Chillet Ignis to Trusty Chillet Ignis and Digtoise to Trusty Digtoise.
Little Kinship Peach.tip: A small fruit filled with kindness · It is said that a Pal who eats it will open its heart to humans · Choose carefully which Pal you give it to

Living Cursed Fire Block.name: Living Cursed Fire Block
Living Cursed Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Living Demon Fire Block.name: Living Demon Fire Block
Living Demon Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Living Frost Fire Block.name: Living Frost Fire Block
Living Frost Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Living Ichor Block.name: Living Ichor Block
Living Ichor Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Living Ultrabright Fire Block.name: Living Ultrabright Fire Block
Living Ultrabright Fire Block.desc: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill.

Living Flame Dye.name: Living Flame Dye
Living Flame Dye.desc: Living Flame Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It can only be obtained after defeating a mechanical boss.

Living Leaf Wall.name: Living Leaf Wall
Living Leaf Wall.desc: Living Leaf Wall is a type of wall. Like other player-crafted walls, it can be used for valid housing.

Living Loom.name: Living Loom
Living Loom.desc: The Living Loom is a crafting station used to craft Living Wood furniture out of any kind of Wood as well as Feywood furniture out of Feywood. It can also be used as a Loom.

Living Ocean Dye.name: Living Ocean Dye
Living Ocean Dye.desc: Living Ocean Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It is only obtainable after defeating any mechanical boss.

Living Rainbow Dye.name: Living Rainbow Dye
Living Rainbow Dye.desc: Living Rainbow Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It is only obtainable after defeating a mechanical boss.

Living Wood Chest.name: Living Wood Chest
Living Wood Chest.desc: A Living Wood Chest is a Chest storage item that can be found inside rooms within hollow Living Trees. It can also be crafted at a Living Loom, which may sometimes be found placed near a Living Wood Chest.

Living Wood Wall.name: Living Wood Wall
Living Wood Wall.desc: The Living Wood Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Living Trees, considered unsafe, where it does not drop as an item when destroyed.

Overgrown Living Wood Wall.name: Overgrown Living Wood Wall
Overgrown Living Wood Wall.desc: The Living Wood Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Living Trees, considered unsafe, where it does not drop as an item when destroyed.
Overgrown Living Wood Wall.tip: A dangerous slab of living wood wall that will spawn monsters

Lizard Egg.name: Lizard Egg
Lizard Egg.desc: The Lizard Egg is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Lizard that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Pet Lizard will sprout wings like those of a Flying Snake to catch up with the player.

Lizard Ears.name: Lizard Ears
Lizard Ears.desc: The Lizard set is a vanity set composed of the Lizard Tail and the Lizard Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a New Moon or a Waxing Crescent for.

Lizard Tail.name: Lizard Tail
Lizard Tail.desc: The Lizard set is a vanity set composed of the Lizard Tail and the Lizard Ears. It can be purchased from the Zoologist during a New Moon or a Waxing Crescent for.

Lobster Tail.name: Lobster Tail
Lobster Tail.desc: The Lobster Tail is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Lobster Tail.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Delicious with a bit of butter'

Logic Gate Lamp (Faulty).name: Logic Gate Lamp (Faulty)
Logic Gate Lamp (Faulty).desc: A Logic Gate Lamp is a mechanism that is placed atop a Logic Gate or another Logic Gate Lamp. The Logic Gate is activated based on its type and the states of the Logic Gate Lamps atop it. The state of a Logic Gate Lamp is toggled via wire.
Logic Gate Lamp (Faulty).tip: Place this on logic gate lamps · When signalled, randomly chooses a lamp below it. If that lamp is on, the logic gate signals

Logic Gate Lamp (Off).name: Logic Gate Lamp (Off)
Logic Gate Lamp (Off).desc: A Logic Gate Lamp is a mechanism that is placed atop a Logic Gate or another Logic Gate Lamp. The Logic Gate is activated based on its type and the states of the Logic Gate Lamps atop it. The state of a Logic Gate Lamp is toggled via wire.
Logic Gate Lamp (Off).tip: Place this on logic gates to add checks · Turns on when signalled

Logic Gate Lamp (On).name: Logic Gate Lamp (On)
Logic Gate Lamp (On).desc: A Logic Gate Lamp is a mechanism that is placed atop a Logic Gate or another Logic Gate Lamp. The Logic Gate is activated based on its type and the states of the Logic Gate Lamps atop it. The state of a Logic Gate Lamp is toggled via wire.
Logic Gate Lamp (On).tip: Place this on logic gates to add checks · Turns off when signalled

Logic Gate (AND).name: Logic Gate (AND)
Logic Gate (AND).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (AND).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "All logic gate lamps above are on"

Logic Gate (NAND).name: Logic Gate (NAND)
Logic Gate (NAND).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (NAND).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "Not all logic gate lamps above are on"

Logic Gate (NOR).name: Logic Gate (NOR)
Logic Gate (NOR).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (NOR).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "No logic gate lamps above are on"

Logic Gate (OR).name: Logic Gate (OR)
Logic Gate (OR).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (OR).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "Any logic gate lamp above is on"

Logic Gate (XNOR).name: Logic Gate (XNOR)
Logic Gate (XNOR).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (XNOR).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "Zero or more than one logic gate lamps above are on" · Also known as NXOR

Logic Gate (XOR).name: Logic Gate (XOR)
Logic Gate (XOR).desc: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.
Logic Gate (XOR).tip: Signals when this condition starts or stops being met: · "Exactly one logic gate lamp above is on"

Loki's Dye.name: Loki's Dye
Loki's Dye.desc: Loki's Dye is a Hardmode dye that can be obtained from Hardmode bosses' Treasure Bags (except Queen Slime's), as part of Loki's set.

Loki's Breastplate.name: Loki's Breastplate
Loki's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Loki, the Chief Strategy Officer at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, a glow similar to Spooky armor, and causes the armor to appear darker.
Loki's Breastplate.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Know thy self, know thy enemy. A thousand battles, a thousand victories…

Loki's Greaves.name: Loki's Greaves
Loki's Greaves.desc: It is the vanity set made for Loki, the Chief Strategy Officer at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, a glow similar to Spooky armor, and causes the armor to appear darker.
Loki's Greaves.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Wheels of justice grind slow but grind fine.

Loki's Helmet.name: Loki's Helmet
Loki's Helmet.desc: It is the vanity set made for Loki, the Chief Strategy Officer at Re-Logic. Equipping the full set produces a pulsating effect similar to Adamantite armor, a glow similar to Spooky armor, and causes the armor to appear darker.
Loki's Helmet.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Disorder came from order, fear came from courage, weakness came from strength

Loom.name: Loom
Loom.desc: The Loom is a crafting station used to craft Silk, as well as some items that require Silk as an ingredient. It can sometimes be found in Underground Cabins.

Lucky Clover.name: Lucky Clover
Lucky Clover.desc: The Lucky Clover is an item rarely obtained from cutting tall grass. It increases the player's luck by 0.03 while it is in their inventory or opened Void Bag. Having more than one Lucky Clover does not increase luck any further.

Lucky Coin.name: Lucky Coin
Lucky Coin.desc: The Lucky Coin is a Hardmode accessory that causes enemies to drop extra coins when damaged and grants the player +0.05 luck.
Lucky Coin.tip: Hitting enemies will sometimes drop extra coins · 'I found a coin! It's my lucky day!'

Lucy the Axe.name: Lucy the Axe
Lucy the Axe.desc: Lucy the Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Deerclops. She occasionally displays a line of dialogue depending on certain player actions. Lucy the Axe also has a base critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Nebula Axe.name: Nebula Axe
Nebula Axe.desc: Luminite Axes are unobtainable tools. The four types are the Solar Flare Axe, Vortex Axe, Nebula Axe, and the Stardust Axe, each themed after a different Celestial Tower. They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes.

Solar Flare Axe.name: Solar Flare Axe
Solar Flare Axe.desc: Luminite Axes are unobtainable tools. The four types are the Solar Flare Axe, Vortex Axe, Nebula Axe, and the Stardust Axe, each themed after a different Celestial Tower. They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes.

Luminite Brick.name: Luminite Brick
Luminite Brick.desc: Luminite Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material. Despite being made of Luminite, the highest tier of ore, it has no sell value. It can be used to craft Luminite Brick Walls.

Luminite Brick Wall.name: Luminite Brick Wall
Luminite Brick Wall.desc: Luminite Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Luminite Bricks. It stops enemies from spawning on the tile where it's placed. It can be used to make houses for NPCs.

Nebula Chainsaw.name: Nebula Chainsaw
Nebula Chainsaw.desc: Luminite Chainsaws are unobtainable tools. All of the chainsaws share the same stats. The four types are the Solar Flare Chainsaw, Vortex Chainsaw, Nebula Chainsaw, and the Stardust Chainsaw, each themed after different Celestial Pillars.

Solar Flare Chainsaw.name: Solar Flare Chainsaw
Solar Flare Chainsaw.desc: Luminite Chainsaws are unobtainable tools. All of the chainsaws share the same stats. The four types are the Solar Flare Chainsaw, Vortex Chainsaw, Nebula Chainsaw, and the Stardust Chainsaw, each themed after different Celestial Pillars.

Nebula Drill.desc: The Luminite Drills are Hardmode, post-Moon Lord drills. The four types are the Vortex Drill, Nebula Drill, Solar Flare Drill, and Stardust Drill.

Solar Flare Drill.name: Solar Flare Drill
Solar Flare Drill.desc: The Luminite Drills are Hardmode, post-Moon Lord drills. The four types are the Vortex Drill, Nebula Drill, Solar Flare Drill, and Stardust Drill.

Stardust Drill.desc: The Luminite Drills are Hardmode, post-Moon Lord drills. The four types are the Vortex Drill, Nebula Drill, Solar Flare Drill, and Stardust Drill.

Nebula Hamaxe.desc: The Luminite Hamaxes are post-Moon Lord hamaxes. The four types are the Solar Flare Hamaxe, the Vortex Hamaxe, the Nebula Hamaxe, and the Stardust Hamaxe. All share the same stats.

Solar Flare Hamaxe.desc: The Luminite Hamaxes are post-Moon Lord hamaxes. The four types are the Solar Flare Hamaxe, the Vortex Hamaxe, the Nebula Hamaxe, and the Stardust Hamaxe. All share the same stats.

The four types are the Solar Flare Hammer, Vortex Hammer, Nebula Hammer, and the Stardust Hammer, each themed after a different Celestial Tower. They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes.

Luna's Runic Pixie Cloak.name: Luna's Runic Pixie Cloak
Luna's Runic Pixie Cloak.desc: It is the vanity set made for Luna ("RunicPixels"), who is an artist at Re-Logic.

Luna's Runic Pixie Hood.name: Luna's Runic Pixie Hood
Luna's Runic Pixie Hood.desc: It is the vanity set made for Luna ("RunicPixels"), who is an artist at Re-Logic.
