Luna's Runic Pixie Shirt.desc: It is the vanity set made for Luna ("RunicPixels"), who is an artist at Re-Logic.

Lunar Hook.name: Lunar Hook
Lunar Hook.desc: The Lunar Hook is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist grappling hook crafted from Lunar Fragments. It has four glowing hooks which can be launched simultaneously and reach up to 34.375 tiles. Each hook is themed after one of the four Celestial Pillars.
Lunar Hook.tip: 'You want the moon? Just grapple it and pull it down!' · Press Grapple to launch hook

Lunar Rust Brick.name: Lunar Rust Brick
Lunar Rust Brick.desc: Lunar Rust Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Waning Gibbous.

Lunar Rust Brick Wall.name: Lunar Rust Brick Wall
Lunar Rust Brick Wall.desc: Lunar Rust Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Lunar Rust Bricks.

Blue Macaw.name: Blue Macaw
Blue Macaw.desc: The Scarlet Macaw and Blue Macaw are critters that spawn in the Jungle during the daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree during the day. They may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Scarlet Macaw.name: Scarlet Macaw
Scarlet Macaw.desc: The Scarlet Macaw and Blue Macaw are critters that spawn in the Jungle during the daytime. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree during the day. They may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.desc: The Mace is a pre-Hardmode flail found in Gold Chests located in the underground or cavern layer.

Maggot.name: Maggot
Maggot.desc: The Maggot is a critter that replaces Worms in the Graveyard biome, and can also be spawned from Maggot Zombies when they are killed.

Magic Cuffs.name: Magic Cuffs
Magic Cuffs.desc: The Magic Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which increases maximum mana by 40 and restores mana when the wearer is damaged. It also provides 2 defense.
Magic Cuffs.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Restores mana when damaged

Magic Dagger.name: Magic Dagger
Magic Dagger.desc: The Magic Dagger is a Hardmode magic weapon that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by Mimics. When used, it rapidly fires Magic Dagger projectiles that travel in a straight line in the direction of the cursor for 24 tiles, then suddenly become affected by gravity.

Magic Honey Dropper.name: Magic Honey Dropper
Magic Honey Dropper.desc: Magic Droppers are Hardmode items used to place "droplets" — dripping liquid effects on ceilings. Once placed, they permanently display an intermittent dripping effect. The effect is purely visual, and has no functional use.

Magic Lava Dropper.name: Magic Lava Dropper
Magic Lava Dropper.desc: Magic Droppers are Hardmode items used to place "droplets" — dripping liquid effects on ceilings. Once placed, they permanently display an intermittent dripping effect. The effect is purely visual, and has no functional use.

Magic Sand Dropper.name: Magic Sand Dropper
Magic Sand Dropper.desc: Magic Droppers are Hardmode items used to place "droplets" — dripping liquid effects on ceilings. Once placed, they permanently display an intermittent dripping effect. The effect is purely visual, and has no functional use.

Magic Water Dropper.name: Magic Water Dropper
Magic Water Dropper.desc: Magic Droppers are Hardmode items used to place "droplets" — dripping liquid effects on ceilings. Once placed, they permanently display an intermittent dripping effect. The effect is purely visual, and has no functional use.

Magic Lantern.name: Magic Lantern
Magic Lantern.desc: The Magic Lantern is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a small glowing Magic Lantern which hovers above the player, emitting dim yellow light.
Magic Lantern.tip: Summons a magic lantern that exposes nearby treasure

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Ice Mirror.name: Ice Mirror
Ice Mirror.desc: The Magic Mirror is a pre-Hardmode tool. When used, it plays an animation before teleporting the player to their spawn point.
Ice Mirror.tip: Gaze in the mirror to return home

Magic String.name: Magic String
Magic String.desc: The Magic String is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss accessory that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for. While equipped, all yoyos and counterweights are thrown when Left Click is released, instead of being retracted.

Magic Yoyo Bag.name: Magic Yoyo Bag
Magic Yoyo Bag.desc: The Magic Yoyo Bag is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of Magic String and the Yoyo Bag. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Magic Yoyo Bag.tip: Gives the user magic yoyo skills

Magical Harp.name: Magical Harp
Magical Harp.desc: The Magical Harp is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires ricocheting, piercing projectiles that graphically resemble purple musical notes. Each projectile lasts for 180 ticks before dissipating and will both ricochet infinitely and pierce enemies up to 5 times.

Magical Pumpkin Seed.name: Magical Pumpkin Seed
Magical Pumpkin Seed.desc: The Magical Pumpkin Seed is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Squashling that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Squashling will twirl and fly after the player to catch up to them.

Magma Skull.name: Magma Skull
Magma Skull.desc: The Magma Skull is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Burning debuff. It also grants immunity to lava for 7 seconds.
Magma Skull.tip: Provides 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks

Magma Snail.name: Magma Snail
Magma Snail.desc: The Magma Snail is a critter that spawns in The Underworld. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking an Ash tree in the Underworld. The Magma Snail emits light.

Magnet Flower.name: Magnet Flower
Magnet Flower.desc: The Magnet Flower is an accessory that reduces mana usage by 8%, automatically uses Mana Potions when needed, and increases pickup range for Stars by 18.75tiles.
Magnet Flower.tip: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Increases pickup range for mana stars

Maid Bonnet.name: Maid Bonnet
Maid Bonnet.desc: The Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Maid Bonnet, Maid Dress and Maid Shoes.

Maid Dress.name: Maid Dress
Maid Dress.desc: The Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Maid Bonnet, Maid Dress and Maid Shoes.

Maid Shoes.name: Maid Shoes
Maid Shoes.desc: The Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Maid Bonnet, Maid Dress and Maid Shoes.

Malaise.name: Malaise
Malaise.desc: The Malaise is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Man Eater Banner.name: Man Eater Banner
Man Eater Banner.desc: The Man Eater is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Jungle, and is nearly identical in appearance and behavior to the above-ground Snatcher. Man Eaters spawn anchored to blocks, with an extendable stem topped by a pincher.
Man Eater Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Man Eater

Mana Booster.name: Mana Booster
Mana Booster.desc: The Mana Booster is one of the three power-ups occasionally dropped when striking enemies while wearing a full set of Nebula armor. When picked up, it grants the Mana Nebula buff which immediately increases the player's mana regeneration rate by 10 mana per second for 8 seconds.

Mana Cloak.name: Mana Cloak
Mana Cloak.desc: The Mana Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Mana Flower and Star Cloak. It also adds a new effect of spawning stars upon dealing magic damage.
Mana Cloak.tip: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Causes stars to fall after taking damage · Stars restore mana when collected

Mana Cloak Star.name: Mana Cloak Star
Mana Cloak Star.desc: The Mana Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Mana Flower and Star Cloak. It also adds a new effect of spawning stars upon dealing magic damage.

Mana Regeneration Band.name: Mana Regeneration Band
Mana Regeneration Band.desc: The Mana Regeneration Band is an accessory item made by combining a Band of Starpower and a Band of Regeneration at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of both bands, increasing a player's maximum mana by 40 and their health regeneration by 1hp per second.
Mana Regeneration Band.tip: Slowly regenerates life · Increases maximum mana by 40 · Increases mana regeneration rate

Mango.name: Mango
Mango.desc: The Mango is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Mannequin.name: Mannequin
Mannequin.desc: The Mannequin is a furniture item that can be used to display armor, weapons, and vanity items, as well as accessories and dyes.

Marble Chest.name: Marble Chest
Marble Chest.desc: The Marble Chest is a chest storage item found only in Underground Cabins within Marble Caves. Like Granite Chests and Rich Mahogany Chests, Marble Chests have exactly the same loot as Gold Chests.

Marble Wall.name: Marble Wall
Marble Wall.desc: The Marble Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Marble Caves, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed. It can also be generated as part of an Underground Cabin in a Marble Cave, considered safe.

Maroon Graduation Cap.name: Maroon Graduation Cap
Maroon Graduation Cap.desc: The Maroon Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Maroon Graduation Cap and the Maroon Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waxing Crescent.

Maroon Graduation Gown.name: Maroon Graduation Gown
Maroon Graduation Gown.desc: The Maroon Graduation set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Maroon Graduation Cap and the Maroon Graduation Gown. They are purchased from the Clothier for during a Waxing Crescent.

Marshmallow.name: Marshmallow
Marshmallow.desc: The Marshmallow is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. Marshmallows can be purchased from the Merchant for each when he is spoken to in a Snow biome.
Marshmallow.tip: Put it on a stick and roast over a campfire · Minor improvements to all stats · 'How many can you fit in your mouth?'

Marshmallow on a Stick.name: Marshmallow on a Stick
Marshmallow on a Stick.desc: The Marshmallow on a Stick is an item that is used to create a Cooked Marshmallow by holding it over any lit Campfire, i.e. the Marshmallow must overlap with the 2×3-tile rectangle of the Campfire. It must be held for up to 15 seconds.

Martian Conduit Plating.name: Martian Conduit Plating
Martian Conduit Plating.desc: Martian Conduit Plating is a post-Golem block dropped by most enemies during the Martian Madness event, and is used to create a variety of space- or Martian-themed furniture.

Martian Conduit Wall.name: Martian Conduit Wall
Martian Conduit Wall.desc: Martian Conduit Wall is a background wall type crafted from Martian Conduit Plating. It emits a faint glow when placed.

Martian Costume Mask.name: Martian Costume Mask
Martian Costume Mask.desc: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask, Martian Costume Shirt, and Martian Costume Pants.

Martian Costume Pants.name: Martian Costume Pants
Martian Costume Pants.desc: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask, Martian Costume Shirt, and Martian Costume Pants.

Martian Costume Shirt.name: Martian Costume Shirt
Martian Costume Shirt.desc: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask, Martian Costume Shirt, and Martian Costume Pants.

Martian Drone Banner.name: Martian Drone Banner
Martian Drone Banner.desc: The Martian Drone is a Hardmode, post-Golem flying enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It can move through solid blocks, and when it is positioned lower than the player, flies directly towards a point just above the player.
Martian Drone Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Martian Drone

Martian Dye.name: Martian Dye
Martian Dye.desc: Martian Dye is a Hardmode, post-Golem dye that is sometimes acquired from the Dye Trader after completing a Strange Plant quest. It is only obtainable after completing a Martian Madness event. When equipped, it gives items a cyan and white color palette which glows in the dark.

Martian Engineer Banner.name: Martian Engineer Banner
Martian Engineer Banner.desc: The Martian Engineer is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. Martian Engineers have the ability to build Tesla Turrets around them.
Martian Engineer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Martian Engineer

Martian Officer Banner.name: Martian Officer Banner
Martian Officer Banner.desc: The Martian Officer is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event.
Martian Officer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Martian Officer

Martian Uniform Helmet.name: Martian Uniform Helmet
Martian Uniform Helmet.desc: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet, Martian Uniform Torso, and Martian Uniform Pants.

Martian Uniform Pants.name: Martian Uniform Pants
Martian Uniform Pants.desc: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet, Martian Uniform Torso, and Martian Uniform Pants.

Martian Uniform Torso.name: Martian Uniform Torso
Martian Uniform Torso.desc: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet, Martian Uniform Torso, and Martian Uniform Pants.

Martian Walker Banner.name: Martian Walker Banner
Martian Walker Banner.desc: The Martian Walker is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It appears as a large tripod enemy that moves at a very fast pace and fires rapid barrages of blue Laser Rays at the player.
Martian Walker Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Martian Walker

Betsy Mask.desc: Masks are vanity items dropped by all non-event bosses, as well as those from the Old One's Army. They are worn in the social head slot.

Master Gamer's Jacket.name: Master Gamer's Jacket
Master Gamer's Jacket.desc: The Master Gamer's set is a vanity set consisting of the Master Gamer's Jacket and the Master Gamer's Pants. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Master Gamer's Jacket.tip: 'I thought I told you to clean up your room!'

Master Gamer's Pants.name: Master Gamer's Pants
Master Gamer's Pants.desc: The Master Gamer's set is a vanity set consisting of the Master Gamer's Jacket and the Master Gamer's Pants. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Master Gamer's Pants.tip: 'I thought I told you to clean up your room!'

Meat Grinder.name: Meat Grinder
Meat Grinder.desc: The Meat Grinder is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Flesh Blocks and Lesion Blocks. It has a 1/200 chance of being dropped by several Crimson and Corruption enemies.

Mechanical Battery Piece.name: Mechanical Battery Piece
Mechanical Battery Piece.desc: The Mechanical Battery Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit. It is always dropped from Skeletron Prime's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Mechanical Lens.name: Mechanical Lens
Mechanical Lens.desc: The Mechanical Lens is an informational accessory which reveals placed Wire and Actuators. Each color of Wire can be shown at maximum brightness, regular, or faded, which is configurable via toggles. The Mechanical Lens is purchased from the Mechanic for.

Mechanical Ruler.name: Mechanical Ruler
Mechanical Ruler.desc: The Mechanical Ruler is an informational accessory that, when equipped, draws a cyan, semi-transparent grid overlay on the screen, making individual block distances much clearer. This grid fades out when the player begins moving and returns once movement stops.
Mechanical Ruler.tip: Creates measurement lines on screen for block placement

Mechanical Wagon Piece.name: Mechanical Wagon Piece
Mechanical Wagon Piece.desc: The Mechanical Wagon Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit. It is always dropped from The Destroyer's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Mechanical Wheel Piece.name: Mechanical Wheel Piece
Mechanical Wheel Piece.desc: The Mechanical Wheel Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit. It is always dropped from The Twins' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Medicated Bandage.name: Medicated Bandage
Medicated Bandage.desc: The Medicated Bandage is an immunity accessory that combines the functions of the Adhesive Bandage and the Bezoar. This item grants immunity to any Bleeding and Poison debuffs.
Medicated Bandage.tip: Grants immunity to Poisoned and Bleeding

Medusa Banner.name: Medusa Banner
Medusa Banner.desc: Medusa is a Hardmode enemy found near Marble Caves, and is a relatively fast-moving melee attacker who has the unique ability to inflict the Stoned debuff through her gaze. This debuff deals 20 / 40 / damage to the player and petrifies them, turning them into stone.
Medusa Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Medusa

Medusa Head.name: Medusa Head
Medusa Head.desc: The Medusa Head is a Hardmode magic weapon that continuously fires close-range yellow beams up to four times per second, hitting up to three enemies per attack within a 20-tile radius of the player. mana is consumed per each attack, regardless of the number of enemies struck.

Megaphone.name: Megaphone
Megaphone.desc: The Megaphone is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Silenced debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Pixies, Green Jellyfish, Dark Mummies, and Blood Mummies.

Mercury Brick.name: Mercury Brick
Mercury Brick.desc: Mercury Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a New Moon.

Mercury Brick Wall.name: Mercury Brick Wall
Mercury Brick Wall.desc: Mercury Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Mercury Bricks.

Mermaid Adornment.name: Mermaid Adornment
Mermaid Adornment.desc: The Mermaid set is a vanity set composed of the Seashell Hairpin, Mermaid Adornment, and Mermaid Tail. The complete set is awarded randomly for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC.

Mermaid Tail.name: Mermaid Tail
Mermaid Tail.desc: The Mermaid set is a vanity set composed of the Seashell Hairpin, Mermaid Adornment, and Mermaid Tail. The complete set is awarded randomly for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC.

Seashell Hairpin.name: Seashell Hairpin
Seashell Hairpin.desc: The Mermaid set is a vanity set composed of the Seashell Hairpin, Mermaid Adornment, and Mermaid Tail. The complete set is awarded randomly for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC.

Metal Detector.name: Metal Detector
Metal Detector.desc: The Metal Detector is an informational accessory that detects valuable objects, including ores, chests, Life Crystals, and Life Fruit, within a centered on the player.
Metal Detector.tip: Displays the most valuable ore around you

Meteor Helmet.name: Meteor Helmet
Meteor Helmet.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite).

Meteor Leggings.name: Meteor Leggings
Meteor Leggings.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite).

Meteor Suit.name: Meteor Suit
Meteor Suit.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite).

Meteor Hamaxe.name: Meteor Hamaxe
Meteor Hamaxe.desc: The Meteor Hamaxe is a pre-Hardmode hamaxe. It combines the functionality of a hammer and an axe.

Meteor Head Banner.name: Meteor Head Banner
Meteor Head Banner.desc: The Meteor Head is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that only spawns in a Meteorite biome. They override all other enemy spawns in the biome, except the Ocean biome. Once only 74 blocks of Meteorite remain, the area is no longer considered a Meteorite biome.
Meteor Head Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Meteor Head

Meteorite Brick.name: Meteorite Brick
Meteorite Brick.desc: Meteorite Brick is a type of decorative brick crafted with Meteorite. It emits a small amount of light when placed.

Meteorite Brick Wall.name: Meteorite Brick Wall
Meteorite Brick Wall.desc: Meteorite Brick Wall is a wall made from crafting Meteorite Bricks at a Work Bench. It emits light when placed.

Midnight Confetti Block.name: Midnight Confetti Block
Midnight Confetti Block.desc: The Midnight Confetti Block is an animated block type showing falling confetti. It is one of the few items that uses the Crystal Ball as a crafting station. It is a dark, non-transparent version of the Confetti Block.

Midnight Confetti Wall.name: Midnight Confetti Wall
Midnight Confetti Wall.desc: Midnight Confetti Walls are a type of background wall made from Midnight Confetti Blocks. They depict falling confetti.They are one of only a few animated background walls. Confetti Walls are a transparent version of them.

Midnight Rainbow Dye.name: Midnight Rainbow Dye
Midnight Rainbow Dye.desc: Midnight Rainbow Dye is a dye that creates a "reverse" rainbow effect that waves throughout the colors of the spectrum. This dye can be earned by trading a Strange Plant with the Dye Trader after defeating the Martian Madness event.

Milkshake.name: Milkshake
Milkshake.desc: The Milkshake is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff. The Milkshake has a 1/75 chance of being dropped by Ice Tortoises and Icy Mermen.
Milkshake.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'It brings the boys to the yard!'

Milkyway Weaver Banner.name: Milkyway Weaver Banner
Milkyway Weaver Banner.desc: The Milkyway Weaver is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, worm enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It is similar to the Solar Pillar's Crawltipede, in that it is completely unaffected by gravity and floats freely through the air.
Milkyway Weaver Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Milkyway Weaver

Mime Mask.name: Mime Mask
Mime Mask.desc: The Mime Mask is a vanity item equipped in the Social Helmet slot. It is purchased from the Clothier during a Blood Moon for.

Corrupt Mimic Banner.name: Corrupt Mimic Banner
Corrupt Mimic Banner.desc: Mimics are rare Hardmode enemies disguised as Chests, appearing as the appropriate chest type for the environment.
Corrupt Mimic Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Corrupt Mimic

Crimson Mimic Banner.name: Crimson Mimic Banner
Crimson Mimic Banner.desc: Mimics are rare Hardmode enemies disguised as Chests, appearing as the appropriate chest type for the environment.

Minecart Track.name: Minecart Track
Minecart Track.desc: Minecart Tracks are placeable furniture-type blocks that allow for rapid transportation over long distances. They form a continuous track when placed next to each other, and form slopes when placed diagonally. Although they cannot be walked on, they can be grappled using a hook.
Minecart Track.tip: Hammer end piece to change bumper style · Hammer or signal intersections to change direction

Minecart Upgrade Kit.name: Minecart Upgrade Kit
Minecart Upgrade Kit.desc: The Minecart Upgrade Kit is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses permanent booster item that permanently unlocks a boost for all Minecarts, including a speed increase, extra defense when moving, and a laser attack. It also drops a Mechanical Cart when used.
Minecart Upgrade Kit.tip: Permanently grants boosted speed and a defensive probe for minecarts · 'Free Mechanical Cart included!'

Amber Minecart.name: Amber Minecart
Amber Minecart.desc: Minecarts are mounts that allow players to ride on Minecart Tracks. When the player is near a Minecart Track, pressing the Mount hotkey or pressing the Right Click key on a point on the track causes a Minecart to spawn, which the player is automatically placed in.

Mini Volcano.name: Mini Volcano
Mini Volcano.desc: The Mini Volcano is a decorative animated furniture item that emits light when placed. Its animation can be toggled on and off with wires. It has a 19/100 chance of being dropped when opening Obsidian and Hellstone Crates.

Mining Helmet.name: Mining Helmet
Mining Helmet.desc: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Helmet, Mining Shirt, and Mining Pants. The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 chance.

Mining Pants.name: Mining Pants
Mining Pants.desc: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Helmet, Mining Shirt, and Mining Pants. The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 chance.

Mining Shirt.name: Mining Shirt
Mining Shirt.desc: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Helmet, Mining Shirt, and Mining Pants. The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 chance.

Minishark.name: Minishark
Minishark.desc: The Minishark is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for. When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a slight spread, with each shot having a 1/3 chance of not consuming any ammunition.
Minishark.tip: 33% chance to save ammo · 'Half shark, half gun, completely awesome.'

Mirage Crate.name: Mirage Crate
Mirage Crate.desc: The Mirage Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Desert biome. Mirage Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in a Sandstone Chest in the Underground Desert. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Oasis Crate.
Mirage Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Mirage Dye.name: Mirage Dye
Mirage Dye.desc: Mirage Dye is a Hardmode dye obtained by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. Unlike other dyes, it does not change the color of objects, but instead applies a multicolored Shimmering effect.

Mister Stabby Banner.name: Mister Stabby Banner
Mister Stabby Banner.desc: Mister Stabby is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It chases the player and occasionally stops in place to do a considerably long stabbing animation with its knife.
Mister Stabby Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mister Stabby

Mitey-Titey.name: Mitey-Titey
Mitey-Titey.desc: The Mitey-Titey is a tool used to place stalagmites and stalactites using items from the player's inventory. It is sold by the Demolitionist for.
Mitey-Titey.tip: Used with materials to place matching stalactites and stalagmites · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'I forget which are the ceiling ones and which are the floor ones'

Mobius Strip.name: Mobius Strip
Mobius Strip.desc: The Mobius Strip is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/6 chance to drop from Golem. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Mobius Strip.tip: Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 1 · Increases whip range by 10%

Mollusk Whistle.name: Mollusk Whistle
Mollusk Whistle.desc: The Mollusk Whistle is a mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Flamingo. The Flamingo mount allows players to float in all liquids, similar to using an Inner Tube, and dive by holding Down.

Molten Breastplate.name: Molten Breastplate
Molten Breastplate.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Hellstone Bars (135 Hellstone and 45 Obsidian).

Molten Greaves.name: Molten Greaves
Molten Greaves.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Hellstone Bars (135 Hellstone and 45 Obsidian).

Molten Helmet.name: Molten Helmet
Molten Helmet.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Hellstone Bars (135 Hellstone and 45 Obsidian).

Molten Charm.name: Molten Charm
Molten Charm.desc: The Molten Charm is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that combines the effects of the Lava Charm and Obsidian Skull.
Molten Charm.tip: Provides 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks

Molten Hamaxe.name: Molten Hamaxe
Molten Hamaxe.desc: The Molten Hamaxe is a pre-Hardmode hamaxe. It has a chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff on enemy hits.

Molten Pickaxe.name: Molten Pickaxe
Molten Pickaxe.desc: The Molten Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Dungeon Bricks, Cobalt Ore, and Palladium Ore. The Molten Pickaxe occasionally inflicts the On Fire! debuff on hit enemies.

Molten Quiver.name: Molten Quiver
Molten Quiver.desc: The Molten Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that has the same effects as the Magic Quiver with the addition of turning Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows when fired from a bow.
Molten Quiver.tip: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Lights wooden arrows ablaze · 'Quiver in fear!'

Molten Skull Rose.name: Molten Skull Rose
Molten Skull Rose.desc: The Molten Skull Rose is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory. It grants 7 seconds of immunity to lava, immunity to the Burning debuff, and reduces damage taken from lava.
Molten Skull Rose.tip: Provides 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks · Reduces damage from touching lava

Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap.name: Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap
Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap.desc: Monk armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap, Monk's Shirt, and Monk's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 and increases melee speed by 20%

Monk's Pants.name: Monk's Pants
Monk's Pants.desc: Monk armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap, Monk's Shirt, and Monk's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Monk's Pants.tip: 10% increased summon damage, · 15% increased melee critical strike chance and 20% increased movement speed

Monk's Shirt.name: Monk's Shirt
Monk's Shirt.desc: Monk armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Monk's Bushy Brow Bald Cap, Monk's Shirt, and Monk's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.

Monk's Belt.name: Monk's Belt
Monk's Belt.desc: The Monk's Belt is a Hardmode accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. The Monk's Belt is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event with a 1/6 / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 2, and a 1/12 chance during Tier 3.
Monk's Belt.tip: Increase your max number of sentries by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Aether Monolith.tip: 'Witness a glimpse of the Aether's power.' · Can be used to manifest or suppress the Aether

Void Monolith.tip: 'Harness a small amount of power from the Void'

Vortex Monolith.name: Vortex Monolith
Vortex Monolith.desc: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during events or under other special circumstances.
Vortex Monolith.tip: 'Wield a small amount of power from the Vortex Tower'

Monster Lasagna.name: Monster Lasagna
Monster Lasagna.desc: The Monster Lasagna is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Monster Lasagna.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Tastes like hairs and meats with noodle.'

Monster Meat.name: Monster Meat
Monster Meat.desc: The Monster Meat is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Pig Man that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Pig Man flies while carrying an Umbrella from ' in order to catch up.
Monster Meat.tip: Summons a small Pig Man · 'Gross. It's full of hairs.'

Moon Charm.name: Moon Charm
Moon Charm.desc: The Moon Charm is a Hardmode accessory that, when equipped during nighttime, transforms the player into a werewolf and applies the Werewolf buff, which provides several stat bonuses.
Moon Charm.tip: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night
stats: From 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM while equipped

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Moon Globe.name: Moon Globe
Moon Globe.desc: The Moon Globe is a thrown consumable item purchased from the Zoologist for after the Bestiary is 50% complete. When a Moon Globe is thrown and shatters on a surface, the world's moon style will be randomized to one of 9 options.
Moon Globe.tip: Toss it to change how the moon looks! · 'Time for a change of scenery'

Moon Lord Legs.name: Moon Lord Legs
Moon Lord Legs.desc: The Moon Lord Legs are an armor item for the legs slot. They have a 1/15 chance to be found in Chests in worlds with the Drunk seed active.
Moon Lord Legs.tip: Slightly increases mobility · 'These might be Steve's'

Moon Lord Torso.name: Moon Lord Torso
Moon Lord Torso.desc: The Moon Lord Torso is a vanity item equipped in the body slot.
Moon Lord Torso.tip: 'The legs, the torso, the whole darn thing...'

Moon Mask.name: Moon Mask
Moon Mask.desc: The Moon Mask is a vanity headpiece dropped by Lamias in Underground Deserts tainted with The Corruption or The Crimson.

Moon Shell.name: Moon Shell
Moon Shell.desc: The Moon Shell is a Hardmode accessory that can be crafted at the Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of the Moon Charm and the Neptune's Shell: Equipping it will turn the player into a Merfolk when entering water or honey (at any time), or into a Werewolf at night.
Moon Shell.tip: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night and a merfolk when entering water

Moonglow Seeds.name: Moonglow Seeds
Moonglow Seeds.desc: Moonglow Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Moonglows while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Moonglows while they are fully grown. Moonglow will only bloom at night, and will glow and give off blue orbs of light.

Moonplate Block.name: Moonplate Block
Moonplate Block.desc: Moonplate Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks obtained from throwing Sunplate Blocks into Shimmer. Their main use is crafting Duskware furniture and Crescent Walls.

Blue Moss.name: Blue Moss
Blue Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Brown Moss.name: Brown Moss
Brown Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Green Moss.name: Green Moss
Green Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Purple Moss.name: Purple Moss
Purple Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Red Moss.name: Red Moss
Red Moss.desc: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Moss Hornet Banner.name: Moss Hornet Banner
Moss Hornet Banner.desc: The Moss Hornet is a Hardmode flying enemy similar to the pre-Hardmode Hornet, being encountered in the Underground Jungle biome and requiring blocks of Jungle grass in order to spawn.
Moss Hornet Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Moss Hornet

Blue Mossy Wall.name: Blue Mossy Wall
Blue Mossy Wall.desc: The Green Mossy Wall, Brown Mossy Wall, Red Mossy Wall, Blue Mossy Wall, and Purple Mossy Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers in moss chambers, considered unsafe.

Brown Mossy Wall.name: Brown Mossy Wall
Brown Mossy Wall.desc: The Green Mossy Wall, Brown Mossy Wall, Red Mossy Wall, Blue Mossy Wall, and Purple Mossy Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers in moss chambers, considered unsafe.

Green Mossy Wall.name: Green Mossy Wall
Green Mossy Wall.desc: The Green Mossy Wall, Brown Mossy Wall, Red Mossy Wall, Blue Mossy Wall, and Purple Mossy Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers in moss chambers, considered unsafe.

Purple Mossy Wall.name: Purple Mossy Wall
Purple Mossy Wall.desc: The Green Mossy Wall, Brown Mossy Wall, Red Mossy Wall, Blue Mossy Wall, and Purple Mossy Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers in moss chambers, considered unsafe.

Red Mossy Wall.name: Red Mossy Wall
Red Mossy Wall.desc: The Green Mossy Wall, Brown Mossy Wall, Red Mossy Wall, Blue Mossy Wall, and Purple Mossy Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground and Cavern layers in moss chambers, considered unsafe.

Moth Banner.name: Moth Banner
Moth Banner.desc: The Moth is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. It flies around very slowly, and upon seeing the player, will direct its attention towards them and attempt to deal contact damage.
Moth Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Moth

Mother Slime Banner.name: Mother Slime Banner
Mother Slime Banner.desc: The Mother Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Cavern layer. Upon death, it spawns 1-3 Baby Slimes, and like all slimes, drops Gel.
Mother Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mother Slime

Mothron Banner.name: Mothron Banner
Mothron Banner.desc: Mothron is a rare, powerful, Hardmode, post-Plantera, flying enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event.
Mothron Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mothron

Mouse.name: Mouse
Mouse.desc: The Mouse is a critter that spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, but not in Ice, Crimson, Corruption, Jungle or Hallow biomes. It can also spawn in front of unsafe Living Wood Walls below the surface at a much higher rate.

Mrs. Claus Hat.name: Mrs. Claus Hat
Mrs. Claus Hat.desc: The Mrs. Claus set is a vanity set. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. It consists of a Mrs. Claus Hat, Mrs. Claus Shirt and Mrs. Claus Heels.

Mrs. Claus Heels.name: Mrs. Claus Heels
Mrs. Claus Heels.desc: The Mrs. Claus set is a vanity set. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. It consists of a Mrs. Claus Hat, Mrs. Claus Shirt and Mrs. Claus Heels.

Mrs. Claus Shirt.name: Mrs. Claus Shirt
Mrs. Claus Shirt.desc: The Mrs. Claus set is a vanity set. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. It consists of a Mrs. Claus Hat, Mrs. Claus Shirt and Mrs. Claus Heels.

Mud Ball.name: Mud Ball
Mud Ball.desc: The Mud Ball is a consumable weapon. When used, it throws a Mud Ball projectile that is affected by gravity, pierces enemies infinitely, and places a Mud Block upon hitting the ground.

Mud Bud.name: Mud Bud
Mud Bud.desc: The Mud Bud is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns Plantero, a miniature version of Plantera, that follows the player.

Mud Wall.name: Mud Wall
Mud Wall.desc: The Mud Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Jungle and occasionally the Underground Jungle, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting.

Mudstone Brick.name: Mudstone Brick
Mudstone Brick.desc: The Mudstone Brick is a type of brick made from Stone Blocks and Mud Blocks. It can also be obtained from Jungle Shrines. It is brown in color with a Stone-like texture.

Mudstone Brick Wall.name: Mudstone Brick Wall
Mudstone Brick Wall.desc: The Mudstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Mug.name: Mug
Mug.desc: The Mug is a cup made of Glass. It can be used to craft Ale. It can be placed on a flat furniture item, where it functions as a Placed Bottle crafting station.

Multicolor Wrench.name: Multicolor Wrench
Multicolor Wrench.desc: The Multicolor Wrench is a tool that can place down any combination of Wire color, and also remove it. It can be used at any part of the screen, regardless of block placement range.
Multicolor Wrench.tip: Right click while holding to edit wire settings

Blood Mummy Banner.name: Blood Mummy Banner
Blood Mummy Banner.desc: Mummies are Hardmode enemies that spawn in the Desert biome and areas where Sand Blocks are present. They follow the Fighter AI, behaving similarly to Zombies.
Blood Mummy Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Blood Mummy

Dark Mummy Banner.name: Dark Mummy Banner
Dark Mummy Banner.desc: Mummies are Hardmode enemies that spawn in the Desert biome and areas where Sand Blocks are present. They follow the Fighter AI, behaving similarly to Zombies.
Dark Mummy Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Dark Mummy

Light Mummy Banner.name: Light Mummy Banner
Light Mummy Banner.desc: Mummies are Hardmode enemies that spawn in the Desert biome and areas where Sand Blocks are present. They follow the Fighter AI, behaving similarly to Zombies.
Light Mummy Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Light Mummy

Mummy Banner.name: Mummy Banner
Mummy Banner.desc: Mummies are Hardmode enemies that spawn in the Desert biome and areas where Sand Blocks are present. They follow the Fighter AI, behaving similarly to Zombies.
Mummy Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mummy

Mummy Mask.name: Mummy Mask
Mummy Mask.desc: The Mummy set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Mummy Mask, the Mummy Shirt, and the Mummy Pants. Each piece is dropped by Mummies with a 1/75 chance.

Mummy Pants.name: Mummy Pants
Mummy Pants.desc: The Mummy set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Mummy Mask, the Mummy Shirt, and the Mummy Pants. Each piece is dropped by Mummies with a 1/75 chance.

Mummy Shirt.name: Mummy Shirt
Mummy Shirt.desc: The Mummy set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Mummy Mask, the Mummy Shirt, and the Mummy Pants. Each piece is dropped by Mummies with a 1/75 chance.

Mushi Ladybug Banner.name: Mushi Ladybug Banner
Mushi Ladybug Banner.desc: The Mushi Ladybug is an enemy that spawns in Glowing Mushroom biomes, both on the surface and below-ground in Hardmode, but only on the surface in pre-Hardmode.
Mushi Ladybug Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mushi Ladybug

Mushroom Cap.name: Mushroom Cap
Mushroom Cap.desc: The Mushroom Cap is a vanity hat purchased from the Truffle for. It greatly resembles a Glowing Mushroom without the stalk.

Mushroom Chest.name: Mushroom Chest
Mushroom Chest.desc: Mushroom Chests are chests that can be found inside Underground Cabins in Glowing Mushroom biomes.

Mushroom Grass Seeds.name: Mushroom Grass Seeds
Mushroom Grass Seeds.desc: Mushroom Grass Seeds are seeds that have a 1/40 chance to drop from harvesting Glowing Mushrooms. The seeds can also be purchased from the Dryad for each if she is spoken to in a Glowing Mushroom biome.

Mushroom Hat.name: Mushroom Hat
Mushroom Hat.desc: The Mushroom set is a vanity set consisting of the Mushroom Hat, Mushroom Vest, and Mushroom Pants. All three pieces have a 1/2 chance of being found in Mushroom Chests in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.

Mushroom Pants.name: Mushroom Pants
Mushroom Pants.desc: The Mushroom set is a vanity set consisting of the Mushroom Hat, Mushroom Vest, and Mushroom Pants. All three pieces have a 1/2 chance of being found in Mushroom Chests in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.

Mushroom Vest.name: Mushroom Vest
Mushroom Vest.desc: The Mushroom set is a vanity set consisting of the Mushroom Hat, Mushroom Vest, and Mushroom Pants. All three pieces have a 1/2 chance of being found in Mushroom Chests in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.

Mushroom Spear.name: Mushroom Spear
Mushroom Spear.desc: The Mushroom Spear is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear that can be purchased from the Truffle for. When thrust, it summons seven spinning mushrooms that linger in midair and deal 33.33% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) but do not inflict knockback.

Mushroom Staff.name: Mushroom Staff
Mushroom Staff.desc: The Mushroom Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Mushroom Boi minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage.
Mushroom Staff.tip: Summons a mushroom boi to fight for you · 'Get Mushed Boi!'

Mushroom Wall.name: Mushroom Wall
Mushroom Wall.desc: The Mushroom Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Glowing Mushroom biome, considered safe. It is also considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Music Box (Aether).desc: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for. When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay.

Mysterious Package.name: Mysterious Package
Mysterious Package.desc: The Mysterious Package was an unobtainable pet-summoning item, which was supposed to summon a Pet Drone that would drop a box every few minutes. It was likely intended to be available to those who bought Terraria on Amazon.

Mystic Arts Sash.name: Mystic Arts Sash
Mystic Arts Sash.desc: The Mystic Arts Sash is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Mana Regeneration Band and a Black Belt at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of the two accessories.
Mystic Arts Sash.tip: Slowly regenerates life · Increases maximum mana by 40 · Increases mana regeneration rate · Gives a chance to dodge attacks

Mystic Bloom.name: Mystic Bloom
Mystic Bloom.desc: The Mystic Bloom is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that fires three petals which slowly home in on nearby enemies within a 25-tile radius and can bounce off blocks, each dealing 100% of the weapon's damage and knockback.

Mystic Robe.name: Mystic Robe
Mystic Robe.desc: The Mystic Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It provides minimal defense (2) but a 6% damage and critical strike boost to magic weapons, along with a 10% reduction in mana use. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Mystic Robe.tip: 6% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · 10% reduced mana cost

Mythical Lion Mask.name: Mythical Lion Mask
Mythical Lion Mask.desc: The Mythical set is a removed unimplemented vanity set that was intended to be dropped by the Mythical Wyvern during the Chinese New Year seasonal event.

Mythical Robe.name: Mythical Robe
Mythical Robe.desc: The Mythical set is a removed unimplemented vanity set that was intended to be dropped by the Mythical Wyvern during the Chinese New Year seasonal event.

Mythril Chainmail.name: Mythril Chainmail
Mythril Chainmail.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Mythril Greaves.name: Mythril Greaves
Mythril Greaves.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Mythril Hat.name: Mythril Hat
Mythril Hat.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Mythril Hat.tip: 12% increased ranged damage · 7% increased ranged critical strike chance

Mythril Helmet.name: Mythril Helmet
Mythril Helmet.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Mythril Helmet.tip: 8% increased melee critical strike chance · 10% increased melee damage

Mythril Hood.name: Mythril Hood
Mythril Hood.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Mythril Hood.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage

Mythril Brick.name: Mythril Brick
Mythril Brick.desc: Mythril Brick is a mythril tier brick.

Mythril Brick Wall.name: Mythril Brick Wall
Mythril Brick Wall.desc: Mythril Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Mythril Bricks.

Mythril Chainsaw.name: Mythril Chainsaw
Mythril Chainsaw.desc: The Mythril Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Mythril Waraxe.
stats: 15 (Very fast) (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 8 (Insanely fast) (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)

Mythril Crate.name: Mythril Crate
Mythril Crate.desc: The Mythril Crate is a Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any height. It is the middle tier of standard crate. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Iron Crate.
Mythril Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Mythril Drill.name: Mythril Drill
Mythril Drill.desc: The Mythril Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Mythril Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Mythril Halberd.name: Mythril Halberd
Mythril Halberd.desc: The Mythril Halberd is a Hardmode spear.

Mythril Ore.name: Mythril Ore
Mythril Ore.desc: Mythril Ore belongs to the second tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the second altar broken, either it or Orichalcum Ore can spawn in the cavern layer. Mining Mythril Ore requires a Cobalt/Palladium Pickaxe or better.

Mythril Pickaxe.name: Mythril Pickaxe
Mythril Pickaxe.desc: The Mythril Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Mythril Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Mythril Repeater.name: Mythril Repeater
Mythril Repeater.desc: The Mythril Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Mythril Sword.name: Mythril Sword
Mythril Sword.desc: The Mythril Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Mythril Waraxe.name: Mythril Waraxe
Mythril Waraxe.desc: The Mythril Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Mythril Chainsaw.

Nachos.name: Nachos
Nachos.desc: Nachos are a food item that grant the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Nachos have a 1/30 chance of being dropped by Angry Tumblers and all Sand Shark variants.
Nachos.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'It's nach-yos, it's mine!'

Nail.name: Nail
Nail.desc: The Nail Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Nails as ammunition. When used, it fires a Nail that deals 15% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and sticks to enemies or blocks before exploding after 90 ticks, dealing 135% damage ( base damage).

Nail Gun.name: Nail Gun
Nail Gun.desc: The Nail Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Nails as ammunition. When used, it fires a Nail that deals 15% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and sticks to enemies or blocks before exploding after 90 ticks, dealing 135% damage ( base damage).

Nailhead Banner.name: Nailhead Banner
Nailhead Banner.desc: The Nailhead is an uncommon Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. In addition to dealing high contact damage, the Nailhead has a 1/3 chance to fire three to five Nail projectiles in a wide spread when attacked.
Nailhead Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Nailhead

Nano Bullet.name: Nano Bullet
Nano Bullet.desc: The Nano Bullet is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bullet. It inflicts the Confused debuff on hit for 1–3 seconds, reversing enemy movement to make them run away from the player rather than towards them.
Nano Bullet.tip: Causes confusion and bounces back after hitting a wall · Deals 25% extra damage

Nazar.name: Nazar
Nazar.desc: The Nazar is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Cursed debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Cursed Skulls, Giant Cursed Skulls, Cursed Hammers, Crimson Axes, and Enchanted Swords.

Nebula Breastplate.name: Nebula Breastplate
Nebula Breastplate.desc: Nebula armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet, Nebula Breastplate, and Nebula Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Nebula Fragments.
Nebula Breastplate.tip: 9% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Nebula Helmet.name: Nebula Helmet
Nebula Helmet.desc: Nebula armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet, Nebula Breastplate, and Nebula Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Nebula Fragments.
Nebula Helmet.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 15% reduced mana cost · 7% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Nebula Leggings.name: Nebula Leggings
Nebula Leggings.desc: Nebula armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet, Nebula Breastplate, and Nebula Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Nebula Fragments.
Nebula Leggings.tip: 10% increased magic damage · 10% increased movement speed

Nebula Brick.name: Nebula Brick
Nebula Brick.desc: The Nebula Brick is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist brick that is crafted from Nebula Fragments. It is one of the four Fragment Bricks, bricks which are crafted with Lunar Fragments. It glows when placed and can be used to craft Nebula furniture.

Nebula Brick Wall.name: Nebula Brick Wall
Nebula Brick Wall.desc: Nebula Brick Wall is a background wall made from Nebula Bricks.

Nebula Floater Banner.name: Nebula Floater Banner
Nebula Floater Banner.desc: The Nebula Floater is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. The Nebula Floater periodically spawns up to three Nebula Eyes that float around it.
Nebula Floater Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Nebula Floater

Nebula Fragment Block.name: Nebula Fragment Block
Nebula Fragment Block.desc: Nebula Fragment Blocks are blocks made from Nebula Fragments which are dropped by the Nebula Pillar. The blocks have a crystal-like appearance with intense shades of pink and purple. They can be crafted with the Ancient Manipulator. Walls cannot be crafted with them.

Ancient Necro Helmet.name: Ancient Necro Helmet
Ancient Necro Helmet.desc: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet, Necro Breastplate, and Necro Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones.

Necromancer Banner.name: Necromancer Banner
Necromancer Banner.desc: The Necromancer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks by rapidly firing Shadow Beams at the player, thin rays of purple light that reflect off walls multiple times.
Necromancer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Necromancer

Necromantic Scroll.name: Necromantic Scroll
Necromantic Scroll.desc: The Necromantic Scroll is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that increases the player's minion slots by one and increases the damage of all summon weapons by 10%.
Necromantic Scroll.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Nectar.name: Nectar
Nectar.desc: The Nectar is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Hornet that follows the player. This pet will not teleport to the player when it is far away. The Nectar has a 1/15 / 1/9 chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee.

Negative Dye.name: Negative Dye
Negative Dye.desc: Negative Dye is a type of dye bought from the Dye Trader during a full moon, or given as a possible reward for turning in a Strange Plant in Hardmode. When applied, it will completely invert the color of dyed armor or accessories. It is not combinable with other dyes.

Neon Moss Brick Wall.name: Neon Moss Brick Wall
Neon Moss Brick Wall.desc: Neon Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Neon Moss and the Neon Moss Brick it is made from.

Neon Tetra.name: Neon Tetra
Neon Tetra.desc: Neon Tetras are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in the Jungle in any layer. They sell for twice what other fish in their catch quality do, and on the they have no use except for this sell price.

Neptune's Shell.name: Neptune's Shell
Neptune's Shell.desc: Neptune's Shell is a Hardmode accessory that aids maneuverability in water, honey, and Shimmer by granting indefinite breathing time while submerged, swimming via the Jump key, and eliminating the slow movement speed usually caused by submerging underwater.
Neptune's Shell.tip: Transforms the holder into merfolk when entering water

Nettle Burst.name: Nettle Burst
Nettle Burst.desc: The Nettle Burst is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it extends a 24-tile-long snaking vine that lingers for several seconds, passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and hits rapidly for up to nine times per enemy.

Nightglow.name: Nightglow
Nightglow.desc: The Nightglow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that fires four rainbow-colored projectiles which emerge from the player and home in on nearby enemies.

Nightmare Pickaxe.name: Nightmare Pickaxe
Nightmare Pickaxe.desc: The Nightmare Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode, post-Eater of Worlds pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Hellstone, Crimstone Blocks, and Ebonstone Blocks.

Ninja Hood.name: Ninja Hood
Ninja Hood.desc: Ninja armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ninja Hood, Ninja Shirt and Ninja Pants. King Slime drops each piece separately (1 per kill with a 1/3 chance each), or two pieces from the Treasure Bag it drops in Expert Mode.

Ninja Pants.name: Ninja Pants
Ninja Pants.desc: Ninja armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ninja Hood, Ninja Shirt and Ninja Pants. King Slime drops each piece separately (1 per kill with a 1/3 chance each), or two pieces from the Treasure Bag it drops in Expert Mode.

Ninja Shirt.name: Ninja Shirt
Ninja Shirt.desc: Ninja armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ninja Hood, Ninja Shirt and Ninja Pants. King Slime drops each piece separately (1 per kill with a 1/3 chance each), or two pieces from the Treasure Bag it drops in Expert Mode.

North Pole.name: North Pole
North Pole.desc: The North Pole is a Hardmode, post-Plantera spear that is dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.
North Pole.tip: Shoots an icy spear that rains snowflakes

Nurse Hat.name: Nurse Hat
Nurse Hat.desc: The Nurse set is a vanity set that resembles the Nurse's clothes. It is sold by the Arms Dealer during Halloween for. It consists of the Nurse Hat, Nurse Shirt, and Nurse Pants.

Nurse Pants.name: Nurse Pants
Nurse Pants.desc: The Nurse set is a vanity set that resembles the Nurse's clothes. It is sold by the Arms Dealer during Halloween for. It consists of the Nurse Hat, Nurse Shirt, and Nurse Pants.

Nurse Shirt.name: Nurse Shirt
Nurse Shirt.desc: The Nurse set is a vanity set that resembles the Nurse's clothes. It is sold by the Arms Dealer during Halloween for. It consists of the Nurse Hat, Nurse Shirt, and Nurse Pants.

Nutcracker Banner.name: Nutcracker Banner
Nutcracker Banner.desc: The Nutcracker is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 3 of the Frost Moon event. There are two Nutcracker variants, each with slightly differing damage and defense.
Nutcracker Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Nutcracker

Nymph Banner.name: Nymph Banner
Nymph Banner.desc: The Nymph is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer of any biome. When encountered, she appears as the Lost Girl, who seems to be a helpless, stationary NPC in need of rescue.
Nymph Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Nymph

Oasis Crate.name: Oasis Crate
Oasis Crate.desc: The Oasis Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Desert biome. Oasis Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in a Sandstone Chest in the Underground Desert. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Mirage Crate.
Oasis Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Obsidian Longcoat.name: Obsidian Longcoat
Obsidian Longcoat.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian, 30 Silk, and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples.
Obsidian Longcoat.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1

Obsidian Outlaw Hat.name: Obsidian Outlaw Hat
Obsidian Outlaw Hat.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian, 30 Silk, and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples.

Obsidian Pants.name: Obsidian Pants
Obsidian Pants.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian, 30 Silk, and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples.

Obsidian Brick.name: Obsidian Brick
Obsidian Brick.desc: The Obsidian Brick is a brick-block mainly used for building. It can be crafted at a Furnace or mined by any tier of pickaxe. It is commonly found in the Underworld's Ruined Houses.

Obsidian Brick Wall.name: Obsidian Brick Wall
Obsidian Brick Wall.desc: The Obsidian Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Ruined Houses in the Underworld, considered unsafe. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Obsidian Crate.name: Obsidian Crate
Obsidian Crate.desc: The Obsidian Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in lava.
Obsidian Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Obsidian Horseshoe.name: Obsidian Horseshoe
Obsidian Horseshoe.desc: The Obsidian Horseshoe is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Obsidian Horseshoe.tip: Negates fall damage · Grants immunity to fire blocks

Obsidian Lock Box.name: Obsidian Lock Box
Obsidian Lock Box.desc: The Obsidian Lock Box is a grab bag item which is always obtained from Obsidian and Hellstone Crates. It always contains one rare item normally found in locked Shadow Chests in the Underworld.
Obsidian Lock Box.tip: Right click to open · Requires a Shadow Key

Obsidian Skull.name: Obsidian Skull
Obsidian Skull.desc: The Obsidian Skull is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants + defense and immunity to the Burning debuff inflicted upon contact with Meteorite, Hellstone, Hellstone Bricks, or Ancient Hellstone Bricks. It does not grant immunity to lava or fire-based attacks.

Obsidian Skull Rose.name: Obsidian Skull Rose
Obsidian Skull Rose.desc: The Obsidian Skull Rose is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants immunity to the Burning debuff and reduced damage from lava.
Obsidian Skull Rose.tip: Grants immunity to fire blocks · Reduces damage from touching lava

Obsidian Swordfish.name: Obsidian Swordfish
Obsidian Swordfish.desc: The Obsidian Swordfish is a Hardmode spear that is obtained via fishing in lava, by using any lava fishing method (including lava bait or Lavaproof Fishing Hook).

Obsidian Water Walking Boots.name: Obsidian Water Walking Boots
Obsidian Water Walking Boots.desc: Obsidian Water Walking Boots are a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grant the ability to walk on water, honey, and Shimmer, while also giving immunity to the Burning debuff. They do not allow walking on lava.
Obsidian Water Walking Boots.tip: Provides the ability to walk on water & honey · Grants immunity to fire blocks

Obsidifish.name: Obsidifish
Obsidifish.desc: Obsidifish are a type of pre-Hardmode / Hardmode fish which are found rarely by fishing in any biome in any layer, but only in lava. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners, Inferno Potions, and Potions of Return.

Ocean Crate.name: Ocean Crate
Ocean Crate.desc: The Ocean Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Ocean. Ocean Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in Water Chests. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Seaside Crate.

Office Block.name: Office Block
Office Block.desc: Office Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks. Their main use is crafting Office furniture and Office Walls.

Office Wall.name: Office Wall
Office Wall.desc: Office Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Office Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Offline Amber Gemspark Wall.name: Offline Amber Gemspark Wall
Offline Amber Gemspark Wall.desc: Offline Gemspark Walls are a group of walls made from Gemspark Blocks. Unlike Gemspark Blocks, they produce no light, and have no mechanical function. Gemspark Walls are the illuminant variant.

Offline Amethyst Gemspark Wall.name: Offline Amethyst Gemspark Wall
Offline Amethyst Gemspark Wall.desc: Offline Gemspark Walls are a group of walls made from Gemspark Blocks. Unlike Gemspark Blocks, they produce no light, and have no mechanical function. Gemspark Walls are the illuminant variant.

Offline Topaz Gemspark Wall.desc: Offline Gemspark Walls are a group of walls made from Gemspark Blocks. Unlike Gemspark Blocks, they produce no light, and have no mechanical function. Gemspark Walls are the illuminant variant.

Ogre's Club.name: Ogre's Club
Ogre's Club.desc: The Ogre's Club is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Ogre that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Ogre will hold onto an Etherian Wyvern by its tail in order to catch up to them.
Ogre's Club.tip: Summons a baby ogre · 'No other uses besides smashing.'

Old One's Skeleton Banner.name: Old One's Skeleton Banner
Old One's Skeleton Banner.desc: The Old One's Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Dark Mage during the Old One's Army event.
Old One's Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Old One's Skeleton

Orange Bloodroot.name: Orange Bloodroot
Orange Bloodroot.desc: The Orange Bloodroot is a type of plant. It can grow below Dirt Blocks in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Orange Dye.

Orca Banner.name: Orca Banner
Orca Banner.desc: The Orca is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. It is a stronger version of the Shark, acting similarly but with higher stats.
Orca Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Orca

Orichalcum Breastplate.name: Orichalcum Breastplate
Orichalcum Breastplate.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

Orichalcum Headgear.name: Orichalcum Headgear
Orichalcum Headgear.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Orichalcum Headgear.tip: 18% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases maximum mana by 80

Orichalcum Helmet.name: Orichalcum Helmet
Orichalcum Helmet.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Orichalcum Helmet.tip: 15% increased ranged critical strike chance · 8% increased movement speed

Orichalcum Leggings.name: Orichalcum Leggings
Orichalcum Leggings.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Orichalcum Leggings.tip: 8% increased damage and 11% increased movement speed

Orichalcum Mask.name: Orichalcum Mask
Orichalcum Mask.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Orichalcum Mask.tip: 11% increased melee damage and melee speed · 7% increased movement speed

Orichalcum Chainsaw.name: Orichalcum Chainsaw
Orichalcum Chainsaw.desc: The Orichalcum Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Orichalcum Waraxe.

Orichalcum Drill.name: Orichalcum Drill
Orichalcum Drill.desc: The Orichalcum Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Orichalcum Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Orichalcum Halberd.name: Orichalcum Halberd
Orichalcum Halberd.desc: The Orichalcum Halberd is a Hardmode spear.

Orichalcum Ore.name: Orichalcum Ore
Orichalcum Ore.desc: Orichalcum Ore belongs to the second tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the second altar broken, either it or Mythril Ore can spawn in the cavern layer. Mining Orichalcum Ore requires a Cobalt/Palladium Pickaxe or better.

Orichalcum Pickaxe.name: Orichalcum Pickaxe
Orichalcum Pickaxe.desc: The Orichalcum Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Orichalcum Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Orichalcum Repeater.name: Orichalcum Repeater
Orichalcum Repeater.desc: The Orichalcum Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Orichalcum Sword.name: Orichalcum Sword
Orichalcum Sword.desc: The Orichalcum Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Orichalcum Waraxe.name: Orichalcum Waraxe
Orichalcum Waraxe.desc: The Orichalcum Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Orichalcum Chainsaw.

Ornate Shadow Key.name: Ornate Shadow Key
Ornate Shadow Key.desc: The Ornate Shadow Key is a pet-summoning item that spawns a pet Shadow Mimic to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Shadow Mimic propels itself by spinning towards them while emitting a trail of purple flames.

Ouroboros Ring.name: Ouroboros Ring
Ouroboros Ring.desc: The Ouroborus Ring is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Ouroboros Ring.tip: Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 1 · Increases whip range by 10% · Every 3 swings, joins and attacks with your second whip

Owl.name: Owl
Owl.desc: The Owl is a critter that spawns near Towns on the surface Forest and Hallow during the night, when it is not raining. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest tree at night.

Oyster.name: Oyster
Oyster.desc: The Oyster is a consumable grab bag item, which when opened with Right Click from within the player's inventory, contains a Shucked Oyster, and has a 1/4 chance to drop (in order of increasing rarity) a White, Black, or Pink Pearl.

Pad Thai.name: Pad Thai
Pad Thai.desc: Pad Thai is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. Pad Thai can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Pad Thai.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Spicy level 5!'

Paint Roller.name: Paint Roller
Paint Roller.desc: The Paint Roller is a tool which is used to paint walls. It is purchased from the Painter for. Its upgrade, the Spectre Paint Roller, grants a bonus to range. Using a roller requires paint to be in the player's inventory.
Paint Roller.tip: Used with paint to color walls · Can also apply coatings

Paint Scraper.name: Paint Scraper
Paint Scraper.desc: The Paint Scraper is a tool which is used to remove paint off tiles and walls, eliminating the need of breaking and re-placing a tile to remove its paint. The Paint Scraper is purchased for from the Painter. Its upgrade, the Spectre Paint Scraper, grants a bonus to range.
Paint Scraper.tip: Used to remove paint or coatings · Can sometimes collect moss

Paint Sprayer.name: Paint Sprayer
Paint Sprayer.desc: The Paint Sprayer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. While equipped, or when held in the inventory, it automatically applies paint or coating to any object when placing it.
Paint Sprayer.tip: Automatically paints or coats placed objects

Paintbrush.name: Paintbrush
Paintbrush.desc: The Paintbrush is a tool which is used to apply paint to tiles. It is purchased from the Painter for. Its upgrade, the Spectre Paintbrush, grants a bonus to range.
Paintbrush.tip: Used with paint to color blocks · Can also apply coatings

A Horrible Night for Alchemy.desc: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls. Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria-related.
