Pair of Eyeballs.name: Pair of Eyeballs
Pair of Eyeballs.desc: The Pair of Eyeballs is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns Rez and Spaz, miniature versions of The Twins in their first form. The Pair of Eyeballs has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by The Twins in Master Mode.
Pair of Eyeballs.tip: Summons miniature mechanical eyes · 'Two are better than one.'

Pal Metal Chestplate.name: Pal Metal Chestplate
Pal Metal Chestplate.desc: The Pal Metal set is a vanity set consisting of the Pal Metal Chestplate and Pal Metal Leggings.
Pal Metal Chestplate.tip: Armor fully utilizing the latest otherworldy technology. · 'Maybe its overwhelming defense is the pals you made along the way?'

Pal Metal Leggings.name: Pal Metal Leggings
Pal Metal Leggings.desc: The Pal Metal set is a vanity set consisting of the Pal Metal Chestplate and Pal Metal Leggings.
Pal Metal Leggings.tip: Armor fully utilizing the latest otherworldy technology. · 'Maybe its overwhelming defense is the pals you made along the way?'

Paladin Banner.name: Paladin Banner
Paladin Banner.desc: The Paladin is a rare, resilient Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It is immune to knockback and attacks by rapidly throwing hammer projectiles which can pass through blocks and inflict extreme damage.
Paladin Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Paladin

Palladium Breastplate.name: Palladium Breastplate
Palladium Breastplate.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Palladium Breastplate.tip: 3% increased damage · 2% increased critical strike chance

Palladium Headgear.name: Palladium Headgear
Palladium Headgear.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Palladium Headgear.tip: 9% increased magic damage and critical strike chance · Increases maximum mana by 60

Palladium Helmet.name: Palladium Helmet
Palladium Helmet.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Palladium Helmet.tip: 9% increased ranged damage · 9% increased ranged critical strike chance

Palladium Leggings.name: Palladium Leggings
Palladium Leggings.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Palladium Leggings.tip: 2% increased damage · 1% increased critical strike chance

Palladium Mask.name: Palladium Mask
Palladium Mask.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Palladium Mask.tip: 12% increased melee damage · 12% increased melee speed

Palladium Chainsaw.name: Palladium Chainsaw
Palladium Chainsaw.desc: The Palladium Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Palladium Waraxe.

Palladium Column.name: Palladium Column
Palladium Column.desc: The Palladium Column is a building material crafted from Stone Blocks and Palladium Ore. It is essentially the Palladium Ore's equivalent of a brick.

Palladium Column Wall.name: Palladium Column Wall
Palladium Column Wall.desc: Palladium Column Wall is a wall crafted from Palladium Columns.

Palladium Drill.name: Palladium Drill
Palladium Drill.desc: The Palladium Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Palladium Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Mythril and Orichalcum Ore.

Palladium Ore.name: Palladium Ore
Palladium Ore.desc: Palladium Ore belongs to the first tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the first altar broken, either it or Cobalt Ore will spawn in the underground and cavern layers. Mining Palladium Ore requires a Molten Pickaxe or better.

Palladium Pickaxe.name: Palladium Pickaxe
Palladium Pickaxe.desc: The Palladium Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Palladium Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Mythril and Orichalcum Ore.

Palladium Pike.name: Palladium Pike
Palladium Pike.desc: The Palladium Pike is a Hardmode spear.

Palladium Repeater.name: Palladium Repeater
Palladium Repeater.desc: The Palladium Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Palladium Sword.name: Palladium Sword
Palladium Sword.desc: The Palladium Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Palladium Waraxe.name: Palladium Waraxe
Palladium Waraxe.desc: The Palladium Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Palladium Chainsaw.

Palm Wood Breastplate.name: Palm Wood Breastplate
Palm Wood Breastplate.desc: Palm Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palm Wood Helmet, Palm Wood Breastplate, and Palm Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Palm Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Palm Wood Greaves.name: Palm Wood Greaves
Palm Wood Greaves.desc: Palm Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palm Wood Helmet, Palm Wood Breastplate, and Palm Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Palm Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Palm Wood Helmet.name: Palm Wood Helmet
Palm Wood Helmet.desc: Palm Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palm Wood Helmet, Palm Wood Breastplate, and Palm Wood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Palm Wood. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Palm Wood Bow.name: Palm Wood Bow
Palm Wood Bow.desc: The Palm Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Palm Wood Hammer.name: Palm Wood Hammer
Palm Wood Hammer.desc: The Palm Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Palm Wood Sword.name: Palm Wood Sword
Palm Wood Sword.desc: The Palm Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Palm Wood Wall.name: Palm Wood Wall
Palm Wood Wall.desc: Palm Wood Wall is a background wall made from Palm Wood.

Panda Ears.name: Panda Ears
Panda Ears.desc: Panda Ears are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Paper Airplane.name: Paper Airplane
Paper Airplane.desc: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons. When thrown, they will travel in a different path each time, as they are affected by wind speed and direction, which is especially apparent on a Windy Day. The two variants are functionally identical.

White Paper Airplane.name: White Paper Airplane
White Paper Airplane.desc: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons. When thrown, they will travel in a different path each time, as they are affected by wind speed and direction, which is especially apparent on a Windy Day. The two variants are functionally identical.

Parka Coat.name: Parka Coat
Parka Coat.desc: The Parka set is a vanity set which consists of Parka Hood, Parka Coat, and Parka Pants. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in Pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode.

Parka Hood.name: Parka Hood
Parka Hood.desc: The Parka set is a vanity set which consists of Parka Hood, Parka Coat, and Parka Pants. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in Pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode.

Parka Pants.name: Parka Pants
Parka Pants.desc: The Parka set is a vanity set which consists of Parka Hood, Parka Coat, and Parka Pants. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in Pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode.

Parrot Banner.name: Parrot Banner
Parrot Banner.desc: The Parrot is a Hardmode flying enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion. It flies towards the player in an attempt to deal contact damage. It will occasionally roost on any block if not pursuing the player, similarly to Ravens and Vultures.
Parrot Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Parrot

Parrot Cracker.name: Parrot Cracker
Parrot Cracker.desc: The Parrot Cracker is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Parrot that follows the player. If the player stays still for long enough, it will perch on a nearby solid block, staying still until the player moves away from it.

Party Bullet.name: Party Bullet
Party Bullet.desc: The Party Bullet is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It releases a visual cloud of confetti upon contact with enemies or blocks.

Party Center.name: Party Center
Party Center.desc: The Party Center is an animated novelty mechanism furniture item bought from the Party Girl NPC for. Pressing the Right Click button on a Party Center toggles the Party event.

Party Hat.name: Party Hat
Party Hat.desc: The Party Hat is a Vanity item sold by the Party Girl NPC for.

Party Present.name: Party Present
Party Present.desc: The Party Present is a decorative furniture item that can be purchased from the Party Girl during a Party for 20 silver. It has one of several different appearances when placed, similar to Books.
Party Present.tip: Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Wonder what's inside?'

PDA.name: PDA
PDA.desc: The PDA is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, the weather, wind speed, moon phase, the player's Fishing Power, the most valuable block nearby, nearby rare creatures, the number of nearby enemies, the player's enemy kill count, the player's current, the player's current movement speed, the player's horizontal position, and the player's depth.

Peach.name: Peach
Peach.desc: The Peach is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Peach Sangria.name: Peach Sangria
Peach Sangria.desc: The Peach Sangria is a food item that grants Well Fed buff when consumed.
Peach Sangria.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Life's a peach'

Pearlstone Block.name: Pearlstone Block
Pearlstone Block.desc: The Pearlstone Block is a Hardmode block type found in The Hallow. It requires at least a Nightmare Pickaxe, Deathbringer Pickaxe, or explosives to mine.

Pearlstone Brick.name: Pearlstone Brick
Pearlstone Brick.desc: Pearlstone Brick is a brick made from Pearlstone. It does not spread The Hallow when placed, therefore making it a safer construction material than its raw ingredients.

Pearlstone Brick Wall.name: Pearlstone Brick Wall
Pearlstone Brick Wall.desc: Pearlstone Brick Walls are a type of wall crafted from Pearlstone Bricks. Like most walls, they will stop enemy spawning, and can be used for NPC houses.

Pearlstone Wall.name: Pearlstone Wall
Pearlstone Wall.desc: The Pearlstone Wall is a type of background wall which can be found in Corruption/Crimson chasms that have been taken over by the Hallow, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting.

Pearlwood.name: Pearlwood
Pearlwood.desc: Pearlwood is a Hardmode-exclusive type of wood harvested from Pearlwood trees and Pearlwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Hallow biomes.

Pearlwood Breastplate.name: Pearlwood Breastplate
Pearlwood Breastplate.desc: Pearlwood armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pearlwood Helmet, Pearlwood Breastplate, and Pearlwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pearlwood. The full set grants 8 defense while equipped.

Pearlwood Greaves.name: Pearlwood Greaves
Pearlwood Greaves.desc: Pearlwood armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pearlwood Helmet, Pearlwood Breastplate, and Pearlwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pearlwood. The full set grants 8 defense while equipped.

Pearlwood Helmet.name: Pearlwood Helmet
Pearlwood Helmet.desc: Pearlwood armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pearlwood Helmet, Pearlwood Breastplate, and Pearlwood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pearlwood. The full set grants 8 defense while equipped.

Pearlwood Bow.name: Pearlwood Bow
Pearlwood Bow.desc: The Pearlwood Bow is a Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Pearlwood Crate.name: Pearlwood Crate
Pearlwood Crate.desc: The Pearlwood Crate is a Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any height. It is the lowest tier of standard crate, having the least value if sold directly. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Wooden Crate.

Pearlwood Wall.desc: Pearlwood Wall is a type of wall made from Pearlwood.

Peddler's Hat.name: Peddler's Hat
Peddler's Hat.desc: The Peddler's Hat is a vanity item that always drops from the Traveling Merchant if he is killed. It appears identical to the hat that the Traveling Merchant wears.

Peddler's Satchel.name: Peddler's Satchel
Peddler's Satchel.desc: The Peddler's Satchel is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the number of items sold by the Traveling Merchant by 1. It can only be used once in the world and is obtained by throwing a Peddler's Hat into Shimmer.
Peddler's Satchel.tip: Permanently increases items sold by the Traveling Merchant

Pedguin's Hood.name: Pedguin's Hood
Pedguin's Hood.desc: Pedguin's set is a vanity set. Each piece has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Corrupt and Vicious Penguins.
Pedguin's Hood.tip: Become the Pedguin · 'Great for impersonating streamers!'

Pedguin's Jacket.name: Pedguin's Jacket
Pedguin's Jacket.desc: Pedguin's set is a vanity set. Each piece has a 1/150 chance of being dropped by Corrupt and Vicious Penguins.
Pedguin's Jacket.tip: Become the Pedguin · 'Great for impersonating streamers!'

Penguin.name: Penguin
Penguin.desc: The Penguin is a harmless critter that only spawns in the Snow biome and may spawn with different colors.

Penguin Banner.name: Penguin Banner
Penguin Banner.desc: The Penguin is a harmless critter that only spawns in the Snow biome and may spawn with different colors.
Penguin Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Penguin

Pew-matic Horn.name: Pew-matic Horn
Pew-matic Horn.desc: The Pew-matic Horn is a pre-Hardmode gun that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Deerclops. When used, it converts any bullet into a randomized item fired as a projectile. The projectiles travel in an arc and dissipate upon contact with an enemy or block.
Pew-matic Horn.tip: Converts bullets into random stuff · 'ALLOWS WIRELESS TRANSFER OF INJURY!'

Phantom Phoenix.name: Phantom Phoenix
Phantom Phoenix.desc: The Phantom Phoenix is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss bow. When used, it fires a slight spread of two arrows, alongside a large Phoenix projectile on every third use.
Phantom Phoenix.tip: Harnesses the power of undying flames

Pharaoh's Mask.name: Pharaoh's Mask
Pharaoh's Mask.desc: The Pharaoh's set is a vanity set consisting of the Pharaoh's Mask and the Pharaoh's Robe. A full set can be found in a Gold Chest within a Pyramid, at a 1/9 chance. On Celebration Mk 10 worlds, this chance is guaranteed.

Pharaoh's Robe.name: Pharaoh's Robe
Pharaoh's Robe.desc: The Pharaoh's set is a vanity set consisting of the Pharaoh's Mask and the Pharaoh's Robe. A full set can be found in a Gold Chest within a Pyramid, at a 1/9 chance. On Celebration Mk 10 worlds, this chance is guaranteed.

Phasic Warp Ejector.desc: The Phasic Warp Ejector is an unimplemented and incomplete item. Its only remains in the game files are an item ID and an image, containing no stats or behavior.

Philosopher's Stone.name: Philosopher's Stone
Philosopher's Stone.desc: The Philosopher's Stone is a Hardmode accessory which decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a; the Philosopher's Stone reduces it to 45 seconds. It has a 1/6 chance to be dropped by Mimics.
Philosopher's Stone.tip: Reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%

Pho.name: Pho
Pho.desc: Pho is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff. Pho can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Pho.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Pho sho...'

Phoenix Quiver.name: Phoenix Quiver
Phoenix Quiver.desc: The Phoenix Quiver is a Hardmode accessory made by combining a Harpy Charm and a Molten Quiver at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Phoenix Quiver.tip: Periodically redirects arrows towards enemies · Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Lights wooden arrows ablaze · 'The flame of the phoenix'

Pickaxe Axe.name: Pickaxe Axe
Pickaxe Axe.desc: The Pickaxe Axe is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses pickaxe and axe. It is the alternative to the Drax, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore.
Pickaxe Axe.tip: 'Not to be confused with a hamdrill'

Picksaw.name: Picksaw
Picksaw.desc: The Picksaw is a Hardmode pickaxe and axe that has a 1/4 / 1/3 chance of being dropped by Golem. It can mine all blocks.

Piece of Moon Squid.name: Piece of Moon Squid
Piece of Moon Squid.desc: The Piece of Moon Squid is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord pet-summoning item that spawns a Moonling, which resembles the Moon Lord's head, that follows the player. The Piece of Moon Squid has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord in Master Mode.

Pigron Banner.name: Pigron Banner
Pigron Banner.desc: The Pigron is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome when it is overlapped with the Underground Corruption, Underground Crimson, or Underground Hallow. It has multiple color variants, depending on which overlapping biome it spawns in, but all share identical stats and behavior.
Pigron Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pigron

Pigronata.name: Pigronata
Pigronata.desc: The Pigronata is a placeable furniture item hung by the player from the underside of blocks, similar to banners. When hit with weapons or projectiles, it is destroyed in a shower of confetti, and drops coins and/or other loot.
Pigronata.tip: Beat the shindig out of it! · May contain a suprise!

Blue Pin Flag.name: Blue Pin Flag
Blue Pin Flag.desc: Pin Flags are furniture items used in golfing. They are purely decorative and come in multiple colors. They can be purchased from the Golfer for each.

Green Pin Flag.name: Green Pin Flag
Green Pin Flag.desc: Pin Flags are furniture items used in golfing. They are purely decorative and come in multiple colors. They can be purchased from the Golfer for each.

Purple Pin Flag.desc: Pin Flags are furniture items used in golfing. They are purely decorative and come in multiple colors. They can be purchased from the Golfer for each.

Yellow Pin Flag.name: Yellow Pin Flag
Yellow Pin Flag.desc: Pin Flags are furniture items used in golfing. They are purely decorative and come in multiple colors. They can be purchased from the Golfer for each.

Pin Wheel.name: Pin Wheel
Pin Wheel.desc: The Pin Wheel is a novelty furniture. When placed, the wheel spins if it is windy, with its spin speed depending on the current wind speed in the area. It is purchased from the Merchant for during the Windy Day event.

Piña Colada.name: Piña Colada
Piña Colada.desc: The Piña Colada is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Piña Colada.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'If you like piña coladas and getting caught in the rain'

Pine Tree Block.name: Pine Tree Block
Pine Tree Block.desc: Pine Tree Blocks are blocks that are dropped in stacks of 20–49 from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event (December 15–December 31), with a chance of 16.803% in pre-Hardmode and 15.683% in Hardmode.

Pine Tree Wall.name: Pine Tree Wall
Pine Tree Wall.desc: Pine Tree Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Pine Tree Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Pine Wood.name: Pine Wood
Pine Wood.desc: Pine Wood is a type of wood crafted from Pine Tree Blocks.

Pine Wood Wall.name: Pine Wood Wall
Pine Wood Wall.desc: Pine Wood Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Pine Wood Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Pineapple.name: Pineapple
Pineapple.desc: The Pineapple is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Pineapple.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Goes great with pizza'

Pink Gel Dye.name: Pink Gel Dye
Pink Gel Dye.desc: Pink Gel Dye is a dye that is crafted from Gel Dye. The Gel Dye can be acquired from the Dye Trader, and can be combined with Pink Gel, a crafting material dropped by Pinky, at a Dye Vat.

Pink Horseshoe Balloon.name: Pink Horseshoe Balloon
Pink Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The Pink Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck.
Pink Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Pink Maid Bonnet.name: Pink Maid Bonnet
Pink Maid Bonnet.desc: The Pink Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Pink Maid Bonnet, Pink Maid Dress and Pink Maid Shoes.

Pink Maid Dress.name: Pink Maid Dress
Pink Maid Dress.desc: The Pink Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Pink Maid Bonnet, Pink Maid Dress and Pink Maid Shoes.

Pink Maid Shoes.name: Pink Maid Shoes
Pink Maid Shoes.desc: The Pink Maid set is a vanity set consisting of the Pink Maid Bonnet, Pink Maid Dress and Pink Maid Shoes.

Pink Prickly Pear.name: Pink Prickly Pear
Pink Prickly Pear.desc: The Pink Prickly Pear is a dye material. It grows on top of regular or Hallowed Cacti above surface, but can also be seen on top of Corrupt or Crimson Cacti (see Notes for details). Unlike many plants, instead of being broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe.

Pink Slime Block.name: Pink Slime Block
Pink Slime Block.desc: The Pink Slime Block can be created with Pink Gel if the player is near a Solidifier. In a similar way to Silly Balloons, landing on Pink Slime Blocks negates fall damage and causes the player to bounce.

Pink Snow Coat.name: Pink Snow Coat
Pink Snow Coat.desc: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood, Pink Snow Coat, and Pink Snow Pants.

Pink Snow Hood.name: Pink Snow Hood
Pink Snow Hood.desc: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood, Pink Snow Coat, and Pink Snow Pants.

Pink Snow Pants.name: Pink Snow Pants
Pink Snow Pants.desc: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood, Pink Snow Coat, and Pink Snow Pants.

Pinky Banner.name: Pinky Banner
Pinky Banner.desc: Pinky is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in place of certain types of other slimes (see Notes section for details).
Pinky Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pinky

Piranha Banner.name: Piranha Banner
Piranha Banner.desc: The Piranha is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be found in water pools in the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes, as well as in the Cavern layer. It is twice as common in the Jungle biomes.
Piranha Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Piranha

Pirate Captain Banner.name: Pirate Captain Banner
Pirate Captain Banner.desc: The Pirate Captain is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event.
Pirate Captain Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pirate Captain

Pirate Corsair Banner.name: Pirate Corsair Banner
Pirate Corsair Banner.desc: The Pirate Corsair is a Hardmode enemy that spawns commonly during the Pirate Invasion. It moves towards the player by running and jumping, similar to the Pirate Deckhand, but has slightly higher stats.
Pirate Corsair Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pirate Corsair

Pirate Crossbower Banner.name: Pirate Crossbower Banner
Pirate Crossbower Banner.desc: The Pirate Crossbower is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event. She fires Flaming Arrows every few seconds, which deal high damage and have a 1/3 chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / seconds.
Pirate Crossbower Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pirate Crossbower

Pirate Deadeye Banner.name: Pirate Deadeye Banner
Pirate Deadeye Banner.desc: The Pirate Deadeye is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event. It appears similar to the Pirate Deckhand but comes armed with a blunderbuss that can fire bullets at the player, an eye patch, and slightly modified stats.
Pirate Deadeye Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pirate Deadeye

Pirate Deckhand Banner.name: Pirate Deckhand Banner
Pirate Deckhand Banner.desc: The Pirate Deckhand is a Hardmode enemy which appears during a Pirate Invasion. It moves towards the player by running and jumping, similar to the Pirate Corsair.
Pirate Deckhand Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pirate Deckhand

Pirate Map.name: Pirate Map
Pirate Map.desc: The Pirate Map is a Hardmode event-summoning item used to summon a Pirate Invasion. The Pirate Map has a 1/100 chance of dropping from most enemies killed in the surface Ocean biome during Hardmode (see Notes for more details).

Pirate Hat.name: Pirate Hat
Pirate Hat.desc: The Pirate set is a vanity set which consists of the Pirate Hat, Pirate Shirt and Pirate Pants. They are purchased from the Pirate for.

Pirate Pants.name: Pirate Pants
Pirate Pants.desc: The Pirate set is a vanity set which consists of the Pirate Hat, Pirate Shirt and Pirate Pants. They are purchased from the Pirate for.

Pirate Shirt.name: Pirate Shirt
Pirate Shirt.desc: The Pirate set is a vanity set which consists of the Pirate Hat, Pirate Shirt and Pirate Pants. They are purchased from the Pirate for.

Pirate Staff.name: Pirate Staff
Pirate Staff.desc: The Pirate Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Pirate minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, attacking with a sword up close.
Pirate Staff.tip: Summons pirates to fight for you

Pixel Box.name: Pixel Box
Pixel Box.desc: The Pixel Box is a mechanism that can be bought from the Mechanic for. When activated, it looks fully illuminated but does not emit light.
Pixel Box.tip: Separates wire paths · Toggle lights with simultaneous crossed signals

Pixie Banner.name: Pixie Banner
Pixie Banner.desc: The Pixie is a Hardmode enemy that spawns frequently in The Hallow at the surface layer. Pixies hover a limited height aboveground, emitting a fair amount of flickering light, and can inflict the Slow or Silenced debuffs upon contact.
Pixie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Pixie

Pixie Dye.name: Pixie Dye
Pixie Dye.desc: Pixie Dye is a Hardmode dye sometimes acquired from the Dye Trader as a reward for completing a Strange Plant quest. It can only be obtained after defeating Plantera. When equipped, it turns the player yellow-orange, mimicking the slight glow that Pixies give off.

Pixie Pants.name: Pixie Pants
Pixie Pants.desc: The Pixie set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Pixie Shirt and Pixie Pants.

Pixie Shirt.name: Pixie Shirt
Pixie Shirt.desc: The Pixie set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Pixie Shirt and Pixie Pants.

Pizza.name: Pizza
Pizza.desc: Pizza is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. Pizza has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Hoplites and Medusas. Statue-spawned Hoplites and Medusas do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Pizza.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'With pepperoni and extra cheese.'

Plaguebringer's Cloak.name: Plaguebringer's Cloak
Plaguebringer's Cloak.desc: The Plaguebringer set is a vanity set consisting of the Plaguebringer's Skull, the Plaguebringer's Cloak, and the Plaguebringer's Treads.
Plaguebringer's Cloak.tip: 'Who knew a blight-weaving world-ender would have such good taste in fashion?' · Concept by SodaHunter

Plaguebringer's Skull.name: Plaguebringer's Skull
Plaguebringer's Skull.desc: The Plaguebringer set is a vanity set consisting of the Plaguebringer's Skull, the Plaguebringer's Cloak, and the Plaguebringer's Treads.
Plaguebringer's Skull.tip: 'That right there is 100% genuine Ahamkara, trust!' · Concept by SodaHunter

Plaguebringer's Treads.name: Plaguebringer's Treads
Plaguebringer's Treads.desc: The Plaguebringer set is a vanity set consisting of the Plaguebringer's Skull, the Plaguebringer's Cloak, and the Plaguebringer's Treads.
Plaguebringer's Treads.tip: 'The horrors these boots have seen, or should I say, stepped on.' · Concept by SodaHunter

Planked Wall.name: Planked Wall
Planked Wall.desc: Planked Wall is a background wall that naturally spawns in Underground Cabins. It can also be crafted.

Blinkroot Planter Box.name: Blinkroot Planter Box
Blinkroot Planter Box.desc: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space.

Daybloom Planter Box.name: Daybloom Planter Box
Daybloom Planter Box.desc: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space.

Deathweed Planter Box.desc: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space.

Plantera Seedling.name: Plantera Seedling
Plantera Seedling.desc: The Plantera Seedling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Plantera Seedling that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Plantera Seedling flies by twirling its petals like a propeller to catch up to them.
Plantera Seedling.tip: Summons a newly sprouted Plantera · 'Get to the root of the problem.'

Plasma Lamp.name: Plasma Lamp
Plasma Lamp.desc: The Plasma Lamp is a mechanism item that emits a faint blue light and has an animated texture. It is not considered a suitable light source for an NPC house. It is used purely as a decorative light source. The Plasma Lamp can be purchased from the Party Girl for.

Aetherium Platform.name: Aetherium Platform
Aetherium Platform.desc: Platforms are special types of blocks that allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the Down key while standing on one.
Aetherium Platform.tip: Press Down to fall through · Does not block items
stats: 9999 (Desktop, Console, Old-gen console and Mobile versions) / 99 (3DS version)

Platinum Chainmail.name: Platinum Chainmail
Platinum Chainmail.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Platinum Bars (300 Platinum Ore). The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

Platinum Greaves.name: Platinum Greaves
Platinum Greaves.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Platinum Bars (300 Platinum Ore). The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

Platinum Helmet.name: Platinum Helmet
Platinum Helmet.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Platinum Bars (300 Platinum Ore). The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

Platinum Axe.name: Platinum Axe
Platinum Axe.desc: The Platinum Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Platinum Bow.name: Platinum Bow
Platinum Bow.desc: The Platinum Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Platinum Brick.name: Platinum Brick
Platinum Brick.desc: Platinum Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material. Like the ore it's made of, placed Platinum Bricks will sparkle. Despite being made of Platinum, it has no sell value. It can be crafted into Platinum Brick Walls.

Platinum Brick Wall.name: Platinum Brick Wall
Platinum Brick Wall.desc: Platinum Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Platinum Bricks. Like most walls, they will stop enemy spawning, and can be used for NPC houses.

Platinum Broadsword.name: Platinum Broadsword
Platinum Broadsword.desc: The Platinum Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Platinum Crown.name: Platinum Crown
Platinum Crown.desc: The Platinum Crown is a craftable vanity item that can be worn in the Social Helmet inventory slot. It is also one of the crafting materials for the Slime Crown, which is used to spawn the King Slime.

Platinum Hammer.name: Platinum Hammer
Platinum Hammer.desc: The Platinum Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Platinum Pickaxe.name: Platinum Pickaxe
Platinum Pickaxe.desc: The Platinum Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian. It can also mine Meteorite.

Platinum Shortsword.name: Platinum Shortsword
Platinum Shortsword.desc: The Platinum Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Plumber's Hat.name: Plumber's Hat
Plumber's Hat.desc: The Plumber's set is a vanity set made up of the Plumber's Hat, the Plumber's Shirt, and the Plumber's Pants. The hat has a 1/250 chance to be dropped by Fire Imps, while the shirt and pants are purchased from the Clothier for each, during a full moon.

Plumber's Pants.name: Plumber's Pants
Plumber's Pants.desc: The Plumber's set is a vanity set made up of the Plumber's Hat, the Plumber's Shirt, and the Plumber's Pants. The hat has a 1/250 chance to be dropped by Fire Imps, while the shirt and pants are purchased from the Clothier for each, during a full moon.

Plumber's Shirt.name: Plumber's Shirt
Plumber's Shirt.desc: The Plumber's set is a vanity set made up of the Plumber's Hat, the Plumber's Shirt, and the Plumber's Pants. The hat has a 1/250 chance to be dropped by Fire Imps, while the shirt and pants are purchased from the Clothier for each, during a full moon.

Pocket Mirror.name: Pocket Mirror
Pocket Mirror.desc: The Pocket Mirror is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Stoned debuff. It has a 1/40 / 1/20 chance of being dropped by naturally spawned Medusas.

Pogo Stick.name: Pogo Stick
Pogo Stick.desc: The Pogo Stick is a mount-summoning item that summons a Pogo Stick Mount. Jumping again while in the air causes the player to do a front flip. The Pogo Stick Mount doubles the speed at which the player falls, allowing a top falling speed of 20 pixels.
Pogo Stick.tip: Summons a rideable pogo stick mount · Press Jump again in mid-air to do tricks!

Poison Barb.name: Poison Barb
Poison Barb.desc: The Poison Barb is a pre-Hardmode combat accessory that causes arrows fired by the player to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 90 ticks.

Poison Dart.name: Poison Dart
Poison Dart.desc: The Poison Dart is a pre-Hardmode dart. It inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit, which has a 1/3 chance to last for 60 seconds, and a 2/3 chance to last for 30 seconds.

Poison Staff.name: Poison Staff
Poison Staff.desc: The Poison Staff is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/40 chance of being dropped by Black Recluses. When used, it fires a burst of 3–4 Poison Fangs in a roughly 30° spread. Each projectile pierces two enemies and inflicts the Poisoned debuff for 30 seconds.
Poison Staff.tip: Shoots a poison fang that pierces multiple enemies

Poisoned Knife.name: Poisoned Knife
Poisoned Knife.desc: The Poisoned Knife is a consumable ranged weapon that has a 1/2 chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff. It otherwise behaves exactly like the Throwing Knife, except for having slightly better stats overall and auto-use.

Poltergeist Banner.name: Poltergeist Banner
Poltergeist Banner.desc: The Poltergeist is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 4 / wave 5 of the Pumpkin Moon event. It behaves similarly to a Wraith, except it can fly freely through the air without needing solid ground to hover on.
Poltergeist Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Poltergeist

Pomegranate.name: Pomegranate
Pomegranate.desc: The Pomegranate is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Poo Boulder.name: Poo Boulder
Poo Boulder.desc: The Poo Boulder is a special type of Boulder. It acts identically to the Boulder, with the exception of lasting longer and placing Poo when it breaks.

Poo Wall.name: Poo Wall
Poo Wall.desc: Poo Wall is a type of background wall crafted using Poo.

Pork of the Sea.name: Pork of the Sea
Pork of the Sea.desc: The Pork of the Sea is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Tiny Fishron that follows the player. The Pork of the Sea has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron in Master Mode.
Pork of the Sea.tip: Summons a tiny Fishron · 'Brined to perfection.'

Portable Cement Mixer.name: Portable Cement Mixer
Portable Cement Mixer.desc: The Portable Cement Mixer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing walls.

Portable Kiln.name: Portable Kiln
Portable Kiln.desc: The Portable Kiln is a tool used to place decorative pots using items from the player's inventory. It is sold by the Demolitionist for.
Portable Kiln.tip: Used with materials to place matching decorative pots · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Is a portable pot machine a porta-potty?'

Portal Gun.name: Portal Gun
Portal Gun.desc: The Portal Gun is a Hardmode tool that is always dropped from the Moon Lord. It launches projectiles that create up to two different portals upon contact with blocks: one fired using Left Click, the other using Right Click.
Portal Gun.tip: Creates a pair of portals that can be traveled through. · Use Left click & Right click to place portals. · Increases momentum and falling speed. · 'Speedy thing goes in, speedy thing comes out.'

drops.chance: 14.29% (In we don't even test for that worlds)

Portal Gun Station.name: Portal Gun Station
Portal Gun Station.desc: The Portal Gun Station is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord furniture item and mechanism that can fire portals, similar to the Portal Gun. The Portal Gun Station can be purchased from the Cyborg for if the player has a Portal Gun or another Portal Gun Station in their inventory.
Portal Gun Station.tip: Right click to adjust trajectory, change portal colour and fire

Possessed Armor Banner.name: Possessed Armor Banner
Possessed Armor Banner.desc: The Possessed Armor is a Hardmode enemy which spawns on the surface at night, and underground at any time. It walks quickly and casts a motion blur similar to that of the Shadow armor. It can always open doors, regardless of whether or not there is a blood moon.
Possessed Armor Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Possessed Armor

Possessed Skull.name: Possessed Skull
Possessed Skull.desc: The Possessed Skull is a pet-summoning item that spawns Skeletron Jr. to follow the player. When the player is too far away or in midair, Skeletron Jr. will start spinning its head in order to catch up to them.
Possessed Skull.tip: Summons a small Skeletron · 'A skull with unimaginable power dulled.'

Possession.name: Possession
Possession.desc: Possession is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord whip that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. It has a 5% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Possession.tip: 25 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with prophetic energy · Visions strike enemies hit by summons

Potato Chips.name: Potato Chips
Potato Chips.desc: The Potato Chips are a food item that grant the Well Fed buff when consumed. The Potato Chips have a 1/75 chance of being dropped by Crawdads, Giant Shellies, and Salamanders.
Potato Chips.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Betcha can't eat just one!'

Power Bomb.name: Power Bomb
Power Bomb.desc: The Power Bomb is a Hardmode explosive that is a direct upgrade to the Bomb. It explodes 5 seconds after being thrown, and breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a radius of 9 tiles.
Power Bomb.tip: A large explosion that will destroy most tiles · Can destroy hardmode ores

Iron Anvil.name: Iron Anvil
Iron Anvil.desc: The Iron Anvil and Lead Anvil are pre-Hardmode crafting stations used mainly to craft weapons and armor. Both anvils can craft the same items. Most of their recipes require metal bars, although they are also used to make other items, such as the Jungle tier of equipment.
Iron Anvil.tip: Used to craft items from metal bars

Lead Anvil.name: Lead Anvil
Lead Anvil.desc: The Iron Anvil and Lead Anvil are pre-Hardmode crafting stations used mainly to craft weapons and armor. Both anvils can craft the same items. Most of their recipes require metal bars, although they are also used to make other items, such as the Jungle tier of equipment.
Lead Anvil.tip: Used to craft items from metal bars

Predictor Banner.name: Predictor Banner
Predictor Banner.desc: The Predictor is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Predictor Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Predictor

Blue Present.name: Blue Present
Blue Present.desc: The Present is a grab bag item available during the Christmas seasonal event which contains a random Christmas-themed reward. It can be opened by pressing the Right Click button on it in the player's inventory, similar to all other grab bags.

Present Mimic Banner.name: Present Mimic Banner
Present Mimic Banner.desc: The Present Mimic is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. It acts like normal Mimics do, but passes itself off as a present instead of a Chest.
Present Mimic Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Present Mimic

Presserator.name: Presserator

Presserator.tip: Automatically places actuators on placed objects

Pressure Plate Track.name: Pressure Plate Track
Pressure Plate Track.desc: Pressure Plate Tracks are activation mechanisms that work similarly to Pressure Plates and are activated while riding over with a Minecart. They can be crafted using any type of Pressure Plate.
Pressure Plate Track.tip: Signals when a minecart travels over it · Not for use on slopes

Pretty Mirror.name: Pretty Mirror
Pretty Mirror.desc: The Pretty Mirror is a consumable weapon that can be thrown at targets. The damage it deals is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment. The Pretty Mirror can be purchased from the Stylist while in a Graveyard for.
Pretty Mirror.tip: 'You break it, you buy it - you and all of your friends'

Pretty Pink Dress.name: Pretty Pink Dress
Pretty Pink Dress.desc: The Pretty Pink set is a vanity set consisting of the Pretty Pink Ribbon, Pretty Pink Dress, and Pretty Pink Stockings. The set is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Pretty Pink Ribbon.name: Pretty Pink Ribbon
Pretty Pink Ribbon.desc: The Pretty Pink set is a vanity set consisting of the Pretty Pink Ribbon, Pretty Pink Dress, and Pretty Pink Stockings. The set is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Pretty Pink Stockings.name: Pretty Pink Stockings
Pretty Pink Stockings.desc: The Pretty Pink set is a vanity set consisting of the Pretty Pink Ribbon, Pretty Pink Dress, and Pretty Pink Stockings. The set is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Prince Cape.desc: The Prince set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Prince Uniform, Prince Cape, and the Prince Pants. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Prince Pants.name: Prince Pants
Prince Pants.desc: The Prince set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Prince Uniform, Prince Cape, and the Prince Pants. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Prince Uniform.name: Prince Uniform
Prince Uniform.desc: The Prince set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Prince Uniform, Prince Cape, and the Prince Pants. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Princess Fish.name: Princess Fish
Princess Fish.desc: Princess Fish are a type of Hardmode fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in The Hallow in any layer. They are used to craft Love Potions and Seafood Dinner.

Princess Dress.name: Princess Dress
Princess Dress.desc: The Princess set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Princess Hat and Princess Dress.

Princess Hat.name: Princess Hat
Princess Hat.desc: The Princess set is a vanity set that can be obtained from Goodie Bags with a 2/57 chance. It consists of a Princess Hat and Princess Dress.

Tiara.name: Tiara
Tiara.desc: The Princess set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tiara and the Princess Dress. It is purchased from the Clothier for, during a New Moon.

Prismatic Dye.name: Prismatic Dye
Prismatic Dye.desc: Prismatic Dye is a Hardmode, post-Plantera dye dropped by the Empress of Light with a 1/4 chance. The dye creates a prism-esque effect, making the equipped item seem transparent and glow in a cycling rainbow.

Prismatic Lacewing.name: Prismatic Lacewing
Prismatic Lacewing.desc: The Prismatic Lacewing is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera flying critter and boss-summoning item that spawns on the surface Hallow after Plantera has been defeated.
Prismatic Lacewing.tip: 'Its wings are so delicate, you must be careful not to damage it...'

Prismatic Lacewing Jar.name: Prismatic Lacewing Jar
Prismatic Lacewing Jar.desc: The Prismatic Lacewing Jar is a placeable furniture item which displays the Prismatic Lacewing, normally a critter which summons the Empress of Light boss if killed. This item is a safe method of displaying captured Prismatic Lacewings.

Prismatic Punch.name: Prismatic Punch
Prismatic Punch.desc: The Prismatic Punch is a Hardmode food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.
Prismatic Punch.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Feel the rainbow, taste the crystal!'

Prismite.name: Prismite
Prismite.desc: Prismites are a type of Hardmode fish which are found rarely by fishing in The Hallow in any layer. They are used to craft Seafood Dinner and Lifeforce Potions.

Prospector Helmet.name: Prospector Helmet
Prospector Helmet.desc: Prospector armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Prospector Helmet, Prospector Shirt, and Prospector Pants.

Prospector Pants.name: Prospector Pants
Prospector Pants.desc: Prospector armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Prospector Helmet, Prospector Shirt, and Prospector Pants.

Prospector Shirt.name: Prospector Shirt
Prospector Shirt.desc: Prospector armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Prospector Helmet, Prospector Shirt, and Prospector Pants.

Proximity Mine Launcher.name: Proximity Mine Launcher
Proximity Mine Launcher.desc: The Proximity Mine Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that can be purchased from the Cyborg for.
Proximity Mine Launcher.tip: Mines deal triple damage when armed

Psycho Banner.name: Psycho Banner
Psycho Banner.desc: The Psycho is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event.
Psycho Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Psycho

Psycho Knife.name: Psycho Knife
Psycho Knife.desc: The Psycho Knife is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/40 / 79/1600 chance of being dropped by Psychos during the Solar Eclipse event.
Psycho Knife.tip: Allows you to go into stealth mode

Puffer Shrimp.name: Puffer Shrimp
Puffer Shrimp.desc: The Puffer Shrimp is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Pufferfish that follows the player in a bubble.
Puffer Shrimp.tip: Summons a friendly pufferfish · 'The PB&J of the sea'

Pufferfish.name: Pufferfish
Pufferfish.desc: The Pufferfish is a rare Critter that spawns in the Ocean. Upon getting hit or leaving water, it will puff up. The Pufferfish will float to the surface of water when puffed up.

Pumpkin Breastplate.name: Pumpkin Breastplate
Pumpkin Breastplate.desc: Pumpkin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pumpkin Helmet, Pumpkin Breastplate, and Pumpkin Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pumpkins. The full set grants 7 defense and increases all damage dealt by the player by 10% while equipped.

Pumpkin Helmet.name: Pumpkin Helmet
Pumpkin Helmet.desc: Pumpkin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pumpkin Helmet, Pumpkin Breastplate, and Pumpkin Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pumpkins. The full set grants 7 defense and increases all damage dealt by the player by 10% while equipped.

Pumpkin Leggings.name: Pumpkin Leggings
Pumpkin Leggings.desc: Pumpkin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pumpkin Helmet, Pumpkin Breastplate, and Pumpkin Leggings. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pumpkins. The full set grants 7 defense and increases all damage dealt by the player by 10% while equipped.

Pumpkin Pie.name: Pumpkin Pie
Pumpkin Pie.desc: Pumpkin Pie is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Pumpkin Pie.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Stuff it all up in one bite!'

Pumpkin Scented Candle.name: Pumpkin Scented Candle
Pumpkin Scented Candle.desc: The Pumpkin Scented Candle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera light pet-summoning item that spawns a miniature Pumpking named Jack 'O Lantern to follow the player around.
Pumpkin Scented Candle.tip: Summons a possessed Jack 'O Lantern · 'The flame cannot be put out!'

Pumpkin Mask.name: Pumpkin Mask
Pumpkin Mask.desc: The Pumpkin set is a vanity set which consists of the Pumpkin Mask, Pumpkin Shirt, and Pumpkin Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. Unlike Pumpkin armor, the Pumpkin set cannot be crafted.

Pumpkin Pants.name: Pumpkin Pants
Pumpkin Pants.desc: The Pumpkin set is a vanity set which consists of the Pumpkin Mask, Pumpkin Shirt, and Pumpkin Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. Unlike Pumpkin armor, the Pumpkin set cannot be crafted.

Pumpkin Shirt.name: Pumpkin Shirt
Pumpkin Shirt.desc: The Pumpkin set is a vanity set which consists of the Pumpkin Mask, Pumpkin Shirt, and Pumpkin Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween. Unlike Pumpkin armor, the Pumpkin set cannot be crafted.

Pumpkin Wall.name: Pumpkin Wall
Pumpkin Wall.desc: Pumpkin Wall is a background wall made from Pumpkins.

Inlet Pump.name: Inlet Pump
Inlet Pump.desc: Inlet and Outlet Pumps are mechanisms used to transport liquids (water, lava, honey, and Shimmer), without having to construct pathways through blocks or rely on gravity.
Inlet Pump.tip: Moves liquid to connected outlet pump when signalled

Outlet Pump.name: Outlet Pump
Outlet Pump.desc: Inlet and Outlet Pumps are mechanisms used to transport liquids (water, lava, honey, and Shimmer), without having to construct pathways through blocks or rely on gravity.
Outlet Pump.tip: Receives liquid from connected input pump when signalled

Pupfish.name: Pupfish
Pupfish.desc: The Pupfish is a critter that spawns infrequently in bodies of water in the Desert biome that are directly above Sand Blocks. Unlike many critters, Pupfish are capable of spawning on-screen.

Purple Clubberfish.name: Purple Clubberfish
Purple Clubberfish.desc: The Purple Clubberfish is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be obtained by fishing in The Corruption with a 1/10 chance with 100 Fishing Power, up to a maximum 1/4 chance with 300 Fishing Power. It has a 1/2 chance to inflict the Confused debuff for 1–3 seconds on hit.

Purple Mucus.name: Purple Mucus
Purple Mucus.desc: The Purple Mucus is a dye material that is dropped by Sea Snails, which only spawn in the Ocean biome. Its sole purpose is to make Purple Dye.

Purple Ooze Dye.name: Purple Ooze Dye
Purple Ooze Dye.desc: Purple Ooze Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it gives the player a purple tone, with parts of the dye distorting and varying in different shades of purple.

Purple Slime Banner.name: Purple Slime Banner
Purple Slime Banner.desc: The Purple Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime. It is a larger and stronger variant of the Blue Slime.
Purple Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Purple Slime

Pygmy Staff.name: Pygmy Staff
Pygmy Staff.desc: The Pygmy Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Pygmy minion. It fires a spear towards nearby enemies, which inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 5–10 seconds and does not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.
Pygmy Staff.tip: Summons a Pygmy to fight for you

Aether Pylon.name: Aether Pylon
Aether Pylon.desc: Pylons are placeable furniture items that appear as a large crystal hovering and rotating above a biome-themed stand. With two or more pylons placed in the world, the player can teleport from one pylon to another one. The system they form is referred to as the Pylon Network.
Aether Pylon.tip: Teleport to another pylon when 2 villagers are nearby · You can only place one per type and in the matching biome

Pyroclastic Stone.name: Pyroclastic Stone
Pyroclastic Stone.desc: The Pyroclastic Stone is a pre-Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects when equipped:
Pyroclastic Stone.tip: Melee attacks inflict fire damage · Periodically recharges with faint light · Melee and ranged hits discharge an explosive slash

R.E.K. 3000.name: R.E.K. 3000
R.E.K. 3000.desc: The R.E.K. 3000 is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of nearby rare creatures, the number of nearby enemies, and the player's enemy kill count.
R.E.K. 3000.tip: Displays number of monsters, kill count, and rare creatures

Rabbit Perch.name: Rabbit Perch
Rabbit Perch.desc: The Rabbit Perch is vanity item purchased from the Zoologist for after filling out 40% of the Bestiary.
Rabbit Perch.tip: 'It looks like a bunny, but it's actually a bunny'

Blacksmith Rack.name: Blacksmith Rack
Blacksmith Rack.desc: Racks are decorative items that are placed on walls. They have no functional effect. Unlike the Weapon Rack, these racks cannot be used to display other items.

Carpentry Rack.name: Carpentry Rack
Carpentry Rack.desc: Racks are decorative items that are placed on walls. They have no functional effect. Unlike the Weapon Rack, these racks cannot be used to display other items.

Ragged Caster Banner.name: Ragged Caster Banner
Ragged Caster Banner.desc: The Ragged Caster is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated.
Ragged Caster Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ragged Caster

Rain Coat.name: Rain Coat
Rain Coat.desc: Rain armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rain Hat and Rain Coat. Each piece has a 1/40 chance to be dropped by Raincoat Zombies. The full set grants 3 defense while equipped.

Rain Hat.name: Rain Hat
Rain Hat.desc: Rain armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rain Hat and Rain Coat. Each piece has a 1/40 chance to be dropped by Raincoat Zombies. The full set grants 3 defense while equipped.

Rain Cloud.name: Rain Cloud
Rain Cloud.desc: Rain Cloud is a type of block found beneath Floating Islands, along with Cloud blocks. Rain Cloud blocks cause purely decorative raindrops to appear beneath them that fall for about 18 tiles before fading away for 5 more. landing on Rain Clouds will not inflict fall damage.
Rain Cloud.tip: Prevents fall damage (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions)

Rain Song.name: Rain Song
Rain Song.desc: The Rain Song is a novelty instrument that has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by Flying Fish, which spawn during rain. When used, the player strums a chord depending on how far the cursor is from the player.

Rainbow Boulder.name: Rainbow Boulder
Rainbow Boulder.desc: The Rainbow Boulder is a rare object that can be encountered in Boulder traps, where it occasionally replaces the regular Boulder. It can be found more commonly in Celebration Mk 10 worlds.

Rainbow Brick.name: Rainbow Brick
Rainbow Brick.desc: Rainbow Brick is a Hardmode brick that can be obtained as a drop from the Rainbow Slime. It glows in the dark when placed, and cycles through the colors of the rainbow.

Rainbow Brick Wall.name: Rainbow Brick Wall
Rainbow Brick Wall.desc: Rainbow Brick Walls are Hardmode background walls crafted from Rainbow Bricks. Like Rainbow Bricks, they glow when placed and continuously change color.

Rainbow Cloud.name: Rainbow Cloud
Rainbow Cloud.desc: The Rainbow Cloud is a rainbow variant of the Cloud, crafted from Rainbow Bricks and Cloud blocks. They glow in the dark and give off a small amount of light while cycling through multiple colors when placed.

Rainbow Cursor.name: Rainbow Cursor
Rainbow Cursor.desc: The Rainbow Cursor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera vanity accessory that causes the player's cursor to cycle through the colors of the rainbow continuously. It has a 1/20 chance of being dropped from the Empress of Light.
Rainbow Cursor.tip: Causes your mouse cursor to have shifting rainbow colors

Rainbow Glowstick.name: Rainbow Glowstick
Rainbow Glowstick.desc: The Rainbow Glowstick is a consumable light source. It behaves similarly to the regular Bouncy Glowstick when thrown, but cycles its light through the rainbow, as well as leaving behind a trail.

drops.chance: 1/4 (25%) (Cavern, in Celebration Mk 10 or Rainbow road worlds)

Rainbow Piece.name: Rainbow Piece
Rainbow Piece.desc: The Rainbow Piece was a crafting material used solely to craft the Pot o' Gold. Rainbow Pieces used to fall from the sky, much like Fallen Stars, except that they fell during the day, disappeared at night, and only fell during the St. Patrick's Day season.
Rainbow Piece.tip: Combine 5 pieces to craft a pot o' gold

Rainbow Slime Banner.name: Rainbow Slime Banner
Rainbow Slime Banner.desc: The Rainbow Slime is a rare Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns on Hallowed blocks ( in The Hallow on non-Hallowed blocks) while it is raining. It constantly changes color, as do the Rainbow Bricks it drops.
Rainbow Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Rainbow Slime

Raincoat Zombie Banner.name: Raincoat Zombie Banner
Raincoat Zombie Banner.desc: The Raincoat Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that spawns during rain on the surface at night.
Raincoat Zombie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Raincoat Zombie

Rally.name: Rally
Rally.desc: The Rally is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that has a 6241/96000 chance of being dropped by Crawdads, Giant Shellies, and Salamanders in the Cavern layer.

Ram Rune.name: Ram Rune
Ram Rune.desc: The Ram Rune is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory that can be obtained as secondary loot from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.
Ram Rune.tip: Jump while holding DOWN to slam downward · Slamming into the ground will deal damage to nearby enemies · 'Pound the ground like the heroes of old'

Rambutan.name: Rambutan
Rambutan.desc: The Rambutan is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Rat.name: Rat
Rat.desc: The Rat is a harmless critter that spawns in the Graveyard biome.

Raven Banner.name: Raven Banner
Raven Banner.desc: The Raven is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that appears in Graveyard and can be found in the Forest at night during the Halloween seasonal event. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest tree during this time at night.
Raven Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Raven

Raven Feather.name: Raven Feather
Raven Feather.desc: The Raven Feather is an item that has a 1/10 chance of being dropped by Ravens. It decreases the player's luck by 0.1 while it is in their inventory or opened Void Bag.
Raven Feather.tip: 'A passing raven chose you to carry this emblem. · What manner of ill doth this portent?'

Martian Ray Gunner Banner.name: Martian Ray Gunner Banner
Martian Ray Gunner Banner.desc: The Ray Gunner is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It fires red laser projectiles, at a maximum fire rate of once every 0.67 seconds (40 ticks).
Martian Ray Gunner Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Ray Gunner

Raynbro's Hood.name: Raynbro's Hood
Raynbro's Hood.desc: Raynbro's set is a vanity set consisting of Raynbro's Hood, Raynbro's Hoodie, and Raynbro's Pants. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Raynbro's Hoodie.name: Raynbro's Hoodie
Raynbro's Hoodie.desc: Raynbro's set is a vanity set consisting of Raynbro's Hood, Raynbro's Hoodie, and Raynbro's Pants. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Raynbro's Pants.name: Raynbro's Pants
Raynbro's Pants.desc: Raynbro's set is a vanity set consisting of Raynbro's Hood, Raynbro's Hoodie, and Raynbro's Pants. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.

Razortip.name: Razortip
Razortip.desc: The Razortip is an unobtainable accessory. When equipped, it grants +8% ranged critical strike chance and +1 damage to all arrows.

Reaper Banner.name: Reaper Banner
Reaper Banner.desc: The Reaper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. it will only spawn after all mechanical bosses have been defeated.
Reaper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Reaper

Reaper Hood.name: Reaper Hood
Reaper Hood.desc: The Reaper set is a vanity set which consists of the Reaper Hood and Reaper Robe. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Reaper Robe.name: Reaper Robe
Reaper Robe.desc: The Reaper set is a vanity set which consists of the Reaper Hood and Reaper Robe. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Reaver Shark.name: Reaver Shark
Reaver Shark.desc: The Reaver Shark is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe obtained by fishing in the Ocean. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Red Acid Dye.name: Red Acid Dye
Red Acid Dye.desc: Red Acid Dye is a dye acquired as a random reward from the Dye Trader for giving him a Strange Plant. When equipped in a dye slot, it applies a dark red rippling effect that pulses outward, similar to Acid Dye and Blue Acid Dye.

Red Brick Wall.name: Red Brick Wall
Red Brick Wall.desc: Red Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Red Bricks. It stops enemies from spawning where it is placed and, if covering an entire room, can be used to make NPC houses.

Red Devil Banner.name: Red Devil Banner
Red Devil Banner.desc: The Red Devil is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in The Underworld after any mechanical boss has been defeated. While flying toward the player in a similar manner to that of the Demon, it fires five purple trident projectiles that deal extremely large amounts of damage upon contact.
Red Devil Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Red Devil

Red Envelope.name: Red Envelope
Red Envelope.desc: The Red Envelope is a removed unimplemented item that was intended to drop from all enemies during the Chinese New Year event.

Red Husk.name: Red Husk
Red Husk.desc: The Red Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cochineal Beetles. Its sole purpose is to make Red Dye.

Red Potion.name: Red Potion
Red Potion.desc: The Red Potion is a potion which can be found in chests within worlds generated with the Drunk seed enabled (1/30 chance), or the For the Worthy seed enabled (1/10 chance), or both Drunk and For the Worthy enabled (13/100 chance).

Red Riding Dress.name: Red Riding Dress
Red Riding Dress.desc: Red Riding armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Red Riding Hood, Red Riding Dress, and Red Riding Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Red Riding Dress.tip: 25% increased summon & ranged damage and 20% chance to save ammo

Red Riding Hood.name: Red Riding Hood
Red Riding Hood.desc: Red Riding armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Red Riding Hood, Red Riding Dress, and Red Riding Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Red Riding Hood.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 2 · 10% increased summon damage and ranged critical strike chance

Red Riding Leggings.name: Red Riding Leggings
Red Riding Leggings.desc: Red Riding armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem ranged/summoner armor set consisting of the Red Riding Hood, Red Riding Dress, and Red Riding Leggings. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Red Riding Leggings.tip: 25% increased summon damage and 10% increased ranged critical strike chance · 20% increased movement speed

Red Ryder.name: Red Ryder
Red Ryder.desc: The Red Ryder is a pre-Hardmode gun dropped from Presents obtained during Christmas, with a 0.643% chance in pre-Hardmode and 0.6% chance in Hardmode.

Red Slime Banner.name: Red Slime Banner
Red Slime Banner.desc: The Red Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer, alongside Yellow Slimes. They are slightly stronger than Blue and Green Slimes.
Red Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Red Slime

Red Snapper.name: Red Snapper
Red Snapper.desc: Red Snappers are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in the Ocean in the Sky or Surface layers.

Red Swimsuit.name: Red Swimsuit
Red Swimsuit.desc: The Red Swimsuit is a craftable vanity item.

Red's Breastplate.name: Red's Breastplate
Red's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Redigit, lead developer of Terraria.

Red's Helmet.name: Red's Helmet
Red's Helmet.desc: It is the vanity set made for Redigit, lead developer of Terraria.

Red's Leggings.name: Red's Leggings
Red's Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for Redigit, lead developer of Terraria.

Red's Throw.name: Red's Throw
Red's Throw.desc: Red's Throw is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Red's set.

Reef Block.name: Reef Block
Reef Block.desc: Reef Blocks are a type of decorative block. They can be used to craft Reef furniture.

Reef Wall.name: Reef Wall
Reef Wall.desc: Reef Walls are a type of background wall. They are crafted with Reef Blocks at a Work Bench.

Reflective Copper Dye.name: Reflective Copper Dye
Reflective Copper Dye.desc: Reflective Copper Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the selected accessory/armor a copper-plated, "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Reflective Dye.name: Reflective Dye
Reflective Dye.desc: Reflective Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the selected accessory/armor a "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Reflective Gold Dye.name: Reflective Gold Dye
Reflective Gold Dye.desc: Reflective Gold Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the selected accessory/armor a gold-plated, "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Reflective Metal Dye.name: Reflective Metal Dye
Reflective Metal Dye.desc: Reflective Metal Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the selected accessory/armor a black, "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Reflective Obsidian Dye.name: Reflective Obsidian Dye
Reflective Obsidian Dye.desc: Reflective Obsidian Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the respective equipment an obsidian-plated, "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Reflective Shades.name: Reflective Shades
Reflective Shades.desc: The Reflective Shades are a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Darkness and Stoned debuffs.
Reflective Shades.tip: Grants immunity to Darkness and Stoned

Reflective Silver Dye.name: Reflective Silver Dye
Reflective Silver Dye.desc: Reflective Silver Dye is a dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When equipped, it will give the selected accessory/armor a silver-plated, "shiny" effect, reflecting the surrounding light around the player.

Regal Delicacy.name: Regal Delicacy
Regal Delicacy.desc: The Regal Delicacy is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Slime Princess that follows the player. The pet resembles a miniature Queen Slime with blush, small dotted eyes, and a tiny mouth. The Regal Delicacy has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Queen Slime in Master Mode.
Regal Delicacy.tip: Summons a Slime Princess · 'A dessert fit for a queen!'

Reindeer Antlers.name: Reindeer Antlers
Reindeer Antlers.desc: The Reindeer Antlers are a vanity item that is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 2.308% in pre-Hardmode and 2.154% in Hardmode. When worn in the helmet slot, they place antlers on the player's head.

Reindeer Bells.name: Reindeer Bells
Reindeer Bells.desc: The Reindeer Bells are a Hardmode, post-Plantera mount-summoning item that summons the rideable Rudolph mount, which greatly speeds a player's movement and adds the ability to fly.

Release Doves.name: Release Doves
Release Doves.desc: The Release Doves are a consumable item sold by the Party Girl for when in a Graveyard. Using the item releases three Doves, which fly around and disappear after ticks.

Release Lantern.name: Release Lantern
Release Lantern.desc: The Release Lantern is a consumable light source sold by the Party Girl for each during a Lantern Night. When used, it releases a lantern that will float up into the air before disappearing after 16 seconds.

Betsy Relic.name: Betsy Relic
Betsy Relic.desc: Relics are furniture items dropped by bosses and mini-bosses in Master Mode. They are golden depictions of their respective boss that hover above a pedestal, have a golden particle effect, and emit light when placed close to a light source.

Brain of Cthulhu Relic.name: Brain of Cthulhu Relic
Brain of Cthulhu Relic.desc: Relics are furniture items dropped by bosses and mini-bosses in Master Mode. They are golden depictions of their respective boss that hover above a pedestal, have a golden particle effect, and emit light when placed close to a light source.
