Repaired Life Crystal.name: Repaired Life Crystal
Repaired Life Crystal.desc: The Repaired Life Crystal is a furniture item that places down a decorative Life Crystal. It drops a Life Crystal when destroyed.

Repaired Mana Crystal.name: Repaired Mana Crystal
Repaired Mana Crystal.desc: The Repaired Mana Crystal is a furniture item that places down a decorative Mana Crystal. It drops a Mana Crystal when destroyed.

Replica Crimson Altar.name: Replica Crimson Altar
Replica Crimson Altar.desc: Replica Altars are decorative altar variants. They cannot function as crafting stations, nor do they have any effect (except dropping as items) when destroyed. They can only be broken with a hammer or explosives.

Replica Demon Altar.name: Replica Demon Altar
Replica Demon Altar.desc: Replica Altars are decorative altar variants. They cannot function as crafting stations, nor do they have any effect (except dropping as items) when destroyed. They can only be broken with a hammer or explosives.

Replica Crimson Heart.name: Replica Crimson Heart
Replica Crimson Heart.desc: The Replica Crimson Heart is a decorative piece of furniture that looks like a Crimson Heart when placed. It can be placed without any blocks or walls supporting it, and it can only be broken with a hammer or explosives.

Replica Shadow Orb.name: Replica Shadow Orb
Replica Shadow Orb.desc: The Replica Shadow Orb is a decorative piece of furniture that looks like a Shadow Orb when placed. It can be placed without any blocks or walls supporting it, and it can only be broken with a hammer or explosives.

Resonance Scepter.name: Resonance Scepter
Resonance Scepter.desc: The Resonance Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by the Princess. When used, it creates pink circular auras at the cursor's location, which expand and then collapse into sparkles over the course of 1 second.

Resplendent Dessert.name: Resplendent Dessert
Resplendent Dessert.desc: The Resplendent Dessert is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that is a combination of the Royal Delight from King Slime and the Regal Delicacy from Queen Slime, allowing the player to summon both the Slime Prince and Slime Princess at the same time.
Resplendent Dessert.tip: Summons both Slime Royals · 'A dessert to celebrate love'

Restoration Potion.name: Restoration Potion
Restoration Potion.desc: The Restoration Potion is a recovery potion that can be found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld. When used, it restores health and inflicts Potion Sickness for only 45 seconds (rather than the usual 60 of health-restoring potions).

Restoration Shield.name: Restoration Shield
Restoration Shield.desc: The Restoration Shield is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron shield accessory item made by combining a Cobalt Shield and a Mana Regeneration Band at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of the two accessories.
Restoration Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback · Slowly regenerates life · Increases maximum mana by 40 · Increases mana regeneration rate

Rich Mahogany Breastplate.name: Rich Mahogany Breastplate
Rich Mahogany Breastplate.desc: Rich Mahogany armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rich Mahogany Helmet, Rich Mahogany Breastplate, and Rich Mahogany Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Rich Mahogany. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Rich Mahogany Greaves.name: Rich Mahogany Greaves
Rich Mahogany Greaves.desc: Rich Mahogany armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rich Mahogany Helmet, Rich Mahogany Breastplate, and Rich Mahogany Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Rich Mahogany. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Rich Mahogany Helmet.name: Rich Mahogany Helmet
Rich Mahogany Helmet.desc: Rich Mahogany armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rich Mahogany Helmet, Rich Mahogany Breastplate, and Rich Mahogany Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Rich Mahogany. The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Rich Mahogany Bow.name: Rich Mahogany Bow
Rich Mahogany Bow.desc: The Rich Mahogany Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Rich Mahogany Chest.name: Rich Mahogany Chest
Rich Mahogany Chest.desc: The Rich Mahogany Chest is a chest found only in Underground Cabins within the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes. Like Granite Chests and Marble Chests, Rich Mahogany Chests have exactly the same loot as Gold Chests.

Rich Mahogany Hammer.name: Rich Mahogany Hammer
Rich Mahogany Hammer.desc: The Rich Mahogany Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Rich Mahogany Sword.name: Rich Mahogany Sword
Rich Mahogany Sword.desc: The Rich Mahogany Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Rich Mahogany Wall.name: Rich Mahogany Wall
Rich Mahogany Wall.desc: The Rich Mahogany Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle, as well as in Jungle Shrines in some worlds. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting.

Roasted Duck.name: Roasted Duck
Roasted Duck.desc: The Roasted Duck is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff.
Roasted Duck.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Better than chicken from a wall.'

Robot Hat.name: Robot Hat
Robot Hat.desc: The Robot Hat is a vanity item equipped in the Social Helmet Slot. It has a 1/250 chance to drop from Piranhas and Angler Fish.

Robot Mask.name: Robot Mask
Robot Mask.desc: The Robot set is a vanity set consisting of the Robot Mask, Robot Shirt, and Robot Pants. Its male and female variants are identical. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event.

Robot Pants.name: Robot Pants
Robot Pants.desc: The Robot set is a vanity set consisting of the Robot Mask, Robot Shirt, and Robot Pants. Its male and female variants are identical. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event.

Robot Shirt.name: Robot Shirt
Robot Shirt.desc: The Robot set is a vanity set consisting of the Robot Mask, Robot Shirt, and Robot Pants. Its male and female variants are identical. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained by opening a Goodie Bag from the Halloween event.

Robotic Skull.name: Robotic Skull
Robotic Skull.desc: The Robotic Skull is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns Mini Prime, a miniature version of Skeletron Prime that follows the player. The Robotic Skull has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Skeletron Prime in Master Mode.
Robotic Skull.tip: Summons a miniature Skeletron Prime · 'We can rebuild it.'

Rock Candy.name: Rock Candy
Rock Candy.desc: Rock Candy is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Rock Golem Banner.name: Rock Golem Banner
Rock Golem Banner.desc: The Rock Golem is a powerful Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It throws rocks at players that are within its line of sight but out of its contact range. When being attacked, it continues to attack, making stun-lock options unusable.
Rock Golem Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Rock Golem

Rock Golem Head.name: Rock Golem Head
Rock Golem Head.desc: The Rock Golem Head is a dual-purpose vanity and furniture item dropped by Rock Golems at a 1/3 chance. It can be worn or placed.

Rock Lobster.name: Rock Lobster
Rock Lobster.desc: Rock Lobsters are a type of fishing catch which are found plentifully by fishing in the Desert biome.

Rocket Boots.name: Rocket Boots
Rocket Boots.desc: Rocket Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for. While equipped, they allow the player to hold Jump in midair to fly for a total of 70ticks. While flying, the boots emit visual flame particles that give off a large amount of light.

Rockfish.name: Rockfish
Rockfish.desc: The Rockfish is a pre-Hardmode hammer. It can be fished from the Underground layer within any biome. Its hammer power and tool speed are equal to that of the Molten Hamaxe.

Blue Roller Skates.name: Blue Roller Skates
Blue Roller Skates.desc: Roller Skates are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant or Skeleton Merchant. There are four different color variants with identical functionalities. They greatly alter the player's movement physics while mounted:

Classic Roller Skates.name: Classic Roller Skates
Classic Roller Skates.desc: Roller Skates are pre-Hardmode mount-summoning items that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant or Skeleton Merchant. There are four different color variants with identical functionalities. They greatly alter the player's movement physics while mounted:

Rolling Cactus.name: Rolling Cactus
Rolling Cactus.desc: The Rolling Cactus is a placeable object that behaves similarly to the Boulder. Rolling Cacti are naturally generated all throughout the Underground Desert but do not respawn once they have been activated.

Rope Coil.name: Rope Coil
Rope Coil.desc: Rope Coils are consumable mobility items that, when thrown by the player, travel in an arc affected by gravity until striking a block.
Rope Coil.tip: Throw to create a climbable line of rope

Silk Rope Coil.name: Silk Rope Coil
Silk Rope Coil.desc: Rope Coils are consumable mobility items that, when thrown by the player, travel in an arc affected by gravity until striking a block.
Silk Rope Coil.tip: Throw to create a climbable line of silk rope

Vine Rope Coil.name: Vine Rope Coil
Vine Rope Coil.desc: Rope Coils are consumable mobility items that, when thrown by the player, travel in an arc affected by gravity until striking a block.
Vine Rope Coil.tip: Throw to create a climbable line of vine rope

Web Rope Coil.tip: Throw to create a climbable line of web rope

Rope.name: Rope
Rope.desc: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility. They can be placed adjacent to blocks in any direction, or in midair where background walls are present.

Silk Rope.name: Silk Rope
Silk Rope.desc: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility. They can be placed adjacent to blocks in any direction, or in midair where background walls are present.

Vine Rope.name: Vine Rope
Vine Rope.desc: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility. They can be placed adjacent to blocks in any direction, or in midair where background walls are present.

Web Rope.name: Web Rope
Web Rope.desc: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility. They can be placed adjacent to blocks in any direction, or in midair where background walls are present.

Rotten Egg.name: Rotten Egg
Rotten Egg.desc: The Rotten Egg is a consumable ranged weapon obtained commonly from Goodie Bags, which are dropped during the Halloween season, and from shaking trees during that time. They explode on impact, with no chance of being retrieved.

Royal Delight.name: Royal Delight
Royal Delight.desc: The Royal Delight is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Slime Prince that follows the player. The pet resembles a miniature King Slime with blush, small dotted eyes, and a tiny mouth. The Royal Delight has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by King Slime in Master Mode.
Royal Delight.tip: Summons a Slime Prince · 'A dessert fit for a king!'

Royal Gel.name: Royal Gel
Royal Gel.desc: The Royal Gel is a pre-Hardmode accessory that pacifies most slimes when equipped, causing them to no longer pursue the player, and will deal no contact damage or fire projectiles, even if the player deals damage to them.

Royal Guard's Harness.name: Royal Guard's Harness
Royal Guard's Harness.desc: The Royal Guard's Harness is a Hardmode shield accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Royal Guard's Harness.tip: Walk past a sentry to carry it · Grants immunity to knockback

Royal Scepter.name: Royal Scepter
Royal Scepter.desc: The Royal Scepter is a vanity accessory sold by the Princess for.

Royal Blouse.name: Royal Blouse
Royal Blouse.desc: The Royal set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Royal Tiara, Royal Blouse, and the Royal Dress. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Royal Dress.name: Royal Dress
Royal Dress.desc: The Royal set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Royal Tiara, Royal Blouse, and the Royal Dress. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Royal Tiara.name: Royal Tiara
Royal Tiara.desc: The Royal set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Royal Tiara, Royal Blouse, and the Royal Dress. It is purchased from the Princess for.

Rubblemaker (Large).name: Rubblemaker (Large)
Rubblemaker (Large).desc: The Rubblemaker is a tool used to place ambient objects ("rubble") using items from the player's inventory. It is sold by the Goblin Tinkerer for.
Rubblemaker (Large).tip: Used with materials to place matching rubble · Right click to toggle placement size · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Not a piledriver nor a placeinator: It's a Rubblemaker'

Rubblemaker (Medium).name: Rubblemaker (Medium)
Rubblemaker (Medium).desc: The Rubblemaker is a tool used to place ambient objects ("rubble") using items from the player's inventory. It is sold by the Goblin Tinkerer for.
Rubblemaker (Medium).tip: Used with materials to place matching rubble · Right click to toggle placement size · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Not a piledriver nor a placeinator: It's a Rubblemaker'

Rubblemaker (Small).name: Rubblemaker (Small)
Rubblemaker (Small).desc: The Rubblemaker is a tool used to place ambient objects ("rubble") using items from the player's inventory. It is sold by the Goblin Tinkerer for.
Rubblemaker (Small).tip: Used with materials to place matching rubble · Right click to toggle placement size · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles · 'Not a piledriver nor a placeinator: It's a Rubblemaker'

Ruby Robe.name: Ruby Robe
Ruby Robe.desc: The Ruby Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set.
Ruby Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 13% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Rubies flash double

Ruby Staff.name: Ruby Staff
Ruby Staff.desc: The Ruby Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that quickly fires a red bolt, which deals 50% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and 100% of its knockback, and has 4 armor penetration, but does not pierce.
Ruby Staff.tip: Rubies flash double · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Ruinous Staff.name: Ruinous Staff
Ruinous Staff.desc: The Ruinous Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon crafted using desert and light/dark materials. It summons a Forbidden Ruin minion that hovers above the player.
Ruinous Staff.tip: Summons forbidden ruins to fight for you

Ruler.name: Ruler
Ruler.desc: The Ruler is a pre-Hardmode shortsword purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for. It swings four times in quick succession per use, with slightly varying angles with each stab.

Rune Hat.name: Rune Hat
Rune Hat.desc: The Rune set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Rune Hat and Rune Robe. Both pieces are always dropped by the Rune Wizard, a rare Underground enemy.

Rune Robe.name: Rune Robe
Rune Robe.desc: The Rune set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Rune Hat and Rune Robe. Both pieces are always dropped by the Rune Wizard, a rare Underground enemy.

Rune Wizard Banner.name: Rune Wizard Banner
Rune Wizard Banner.desc: The Rune Wizard is a rare Hardmode caster enemy that is found in the lower Cavern layer.
Rune Wizard Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Rune Wizard

Rusty Armored Bones Banner.name: Rusty Armored Bones Banner
Rusty Armored Bones Banner.desc: The Rusty Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties and follow the Fighter AI.
Rusty Armored Bones Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Rusty Armored Bones

Black Studded Saddle.name: Black Studded Saddle
Black Studded Saddle.desc: The Dusty Rawhide Saddle, Royal Gilded Saddle, and Black Studded Saddle are mount-summoning items that summon the rideable Painted Horse Mount, Majestic Horse Mount, and Dark Horse Mount, respectively. All three horse mounts are functionally identical.
Black Studded Saddle.tip: Summons a rideable dark horse mount

Dusty Rawhide Saddle.name: Dusty Rawhide Saddle
Dusty Rawhide Saddle.desc: The Dusty Rawhide Saddle, Royal Gilded Saddle, and Black Studded Saddle are mount-summoning items that summon the rideable Painted Horse Mount, Majestic Horse Mount, and Dark Horse Mount, respectively. All three horse mounts are functionally identical.
Dusty Rawhide Saddle.tip: Summons a rideable painted horse mount

Royal Gilded Saddle.name: Royal Gilded Saddle
Royal Gilded Saddle.desc: The Dusty Rawhide Saddle, Royal Gilded Saddle, and Black Studded Saddle are mount-summoning items that summon the rideable Painted Horse Mount, Majestic Horse Mount, and Dark Horse Mount, respectively. All three horse mounts are functionally identical.
Royal Gilded Saddle.tip: Summons a rideable white horse mount

Safe.name: Safe
Safe.desc: The Safe is a portable storage item with 40 slots to store other items. The Safe, Piggy Bank, Defender's Forge, and Void Vault have the unique ability to be carried while they contain items. The Safe can be purchased from the Merchant for after Skeletron has been defeated.
Safe.tip: Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops

Safeman's Pink Leggings.name: Safeman's Pink Leggings
Safeman's Pink Leggings.desc: It is the vanity set made for Safeman, the Community Manager at Re-Logic.

Safeman's Sun Dress.name: Safeman's Sun Dress
Safeman's Sun Dress.desc: It is the vanity set made for Safeman, the Community Manager at Re-Logic.

Safeman's Sunny Day.name: Safeman's Sunny Day
Safeman's Sunny Day.desc: It is the vanity set made for Safeman, the Community Manager at Re-Logic.

Sail.name: Sail
Sail.desc: The Sail is a type of background wall purchased from the Pirate for each. It is considered a valid wall for housing.

Sailfish Boots.name: Sailfish Boots
Sailfish Boots.desc: The Sailfish Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Wooden Crates and Iron Crates. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31.
Sailfish Boots.tip: The wearer can run super fast

Sailor Hat.name: Sailor Hat
Sailor Hat.desc: The Sailor set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Sailor Hat, Sailor Shirt, and Sailor Pants. Each piece has a 1/500 chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands, Pirate Corsairs, Pirate Deadeyes, and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event.

Sailor Pants.name: Sailor Pants
Sailor Pants.desc: The Sailor set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Sailor Hat, Sailor Shirt, and Sailor Pants. Each piece has a 1/500 chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands, Pirate Corsairs, Pirate Deadeyes, and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event.

Sailor Shirt.name: Sailor Shirt
Sailor Shirt.desc: The Sailor set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Sailor Hat, Sailor Shirt, and Sailor Pants. Each piece has a 1/500 chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands, Pirate Corsairs, Pirate Deadeyes, and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event.

Sake.name: Sake
Sake.desc: Sake is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff when consumed, which increases many of the player's stats but lowers the player's defense for 240, twice the duration of Ale. Sake can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for.
Sake.tip: Minor improvements to melee stats & lowered defense · 'Drink too much of this, and you become karate master.'

Sakura Sapling.name: Sakura Sapling
Sakura Sapling.desc: The Sakura Sapling is a type of seed that grows into a Sakura tree, which is a tree that can also spawn naturally in Forest biomes, when planted. Its appearance is purely decorative and it functions identically to regular forest trees.

Salamander Banner.name: Salamander Banner
Salamander Banner.desc: The Salamander is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has nine color variants that all share identical stats and behavior.
Salamander Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Salamander

Salmon.name: Salmon
Salmon.desc: Salmon are a type of fish which are found plentifully by fishing in a Forest in the Sky or Surface layers. They can only be caught in lakes with more than 1,000 tiles of water.

Crimsand Block.name: Crimsand Block
Crimsand Block.desc: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions.
Crimsand Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you

Ebonsand Block.name: Ebonsand Block
Ebonsand Block.desc: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions.
Ebonsand Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you

Pearlsand Block.name: Pearlsand Block
Pearlsand Block.desc: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions.
Pearlsand Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you

Sand Elemental Banner.name: Sand Elemental Banner
Sand Elemental Banner.desc: The Sand Elemental is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during Sandstorms. She attacks by summoning three Ancient Storms randomly around the general location of the player, which each lasts 5 seconds.
Sand Elemental Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sand Elemental

Sand Poacher Banner.name: Sand Poacher Banner
Sand Poacher Banner.desc: The Sand Poacher is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Desert biome. Following the Spider AI, it will follow and attempt to deal contact damage to the player while also being capable of climbing onto background walls.
Sand Poacher Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sand Poacher

Bone Biter Banner.name: Bone Biter Banner
Bone Biter Banner.desc: Sand Sharks are Hardmode enemies only found in Desert biomes during a Sandstorm. They are able to "swim" through all varieties of Sand, Hardened Sand, and Sandstone Blocks, but will collide normally against any other block.
Bone Biter Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Bone Biter

Crystal Thresher Banner.name: Crystal Thresher Banner
Crystal Thresher Banner.desc: Sand Sharks are Hardmode enemies only found in Desert biomes during a Sandstorm. They are able to "swim" through all varieties of Sand, Hardened Sand, and Sandstone Blocks, but will collide normally against any other block.
Crystal Thresher Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Crystal Thresher

Flesh Reaver Banner.name: Flesh Reaver Banner
Flesh Reaver Banner.desc: Sand Sharks are Hardmode enemies only found in Desert biomes during a Sandstorm. They are able to "swim" through all varieties of Sand, Hardened Sand, and Sandstone Blocks, but will collide normally against any other block.
Flesh Reaver Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Flesh Reaver

Sand Shark Banner.name: Sand Shark Banner
Sand Shark Banner.desc: Sand Sharks are Hardmode enemies only found in Desert biomes during a Sandstorm. They are able to "swim" through all varieties of Sand, Hardened Sand, and Sandstone Blocks, but will collide normally against any other block.
Sand Shark Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sand Shark

Sand Slime Banner.name: Sand Slime Banner
Sand Slime Banner.desc: The Sand Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Desert. It can be recognized by its sandy color and texture.
Sand Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sand Slime

Sandcastle Bucket.name: Sandcastle Bucket
Sandcastle Bucket.desc: The Sandcastle Bucket is a tool that places a decorative sandcastle and consumes one Sand Block upon use. It can be used on all variants of Sand Blocks and platforms, in any biome.
Sandcastle Bucket.tip: Places sandcastles using Sand Blocks · Press Up/Down to cycle through placement styles

Sandfall Block.name: Sandfall Block
Sandfall Block.desc: The Sandfall Block is an animated block type showing falling sand. It is one of the few items that uses the Crystal Ball as a crafting station.
Sandfall Block.tip: Falling sand you can safely watch

Sandfall Wall.name: Sandfall Wall
Sandfall Wall.desc: Sandfall Wall is one of only a few animated background walls. It depicts falling sand.
Sandfall Wall.tip: Falling sand you can safely watch

Crimsandstone Block.name: Crimsandstone Block
Crimsandstone Block.desc: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome. Like Sand and Hardened Sand, they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption, Crimson, and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone, Crimsandstone, and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Ebonsandstone Block.name: Ebonsandstone Block
Ebonsandstone Block.desc: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome. Like Sand and Hardened Sand, they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption, Crimson, and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone, Crimsandstone, and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Pearlsandstone Block.name: Pearlsandstone Block
Pearlsandstone Block.desc: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome. Like Sand and Hardened Sand, they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption, Crimson, and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone, Crimsandstone, and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Sandstone Brick.name: Sandstone Brick
Sandstone Brick.desc: Sandstone Bricks are brick-type blocks that spawn naturally in Pyramids and can also be crafted manually.

Sandstone Brick Wall.name: Sandstone Brick Wall
Sandstone Brick Wall.desc: The Sandstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Pyramids. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Sandstone Chest.name: Sandstone Chest
Sandstone Chest.desc: The Sandstone Chest is a storage item found in the Underground Desert. They are usually found in Underground Cabins but may also uncommonly generate by themselves. Sandstone Chests can also be crafted.

Sandstone Slab.name: Sandstone Slab
Sandstone Slab.desc: Sandstone Slab is a building material which is similar in appearance to Sandstone Bricks, but darker and larger. Unlike most other building blocks (Stone Slabs in particular), the Sandstone Slab does not have a wall counterpart.

Crimsandstone Wall.name: Crimsandstone Wall
Crimsandstone Wall.desc: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Ebonsandstone Wall.name: Ebonsandstone Wall
Ebonsandstone Wall.desc: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Pearlsandstone Wall.name: Pearlsandstone Wall
Pearlsandstone Wall.desc: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Sandstone Wall.name: Sandstone Wall
Sandstone Wall.desc: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Treacherous Sandstone Wall.name: Treacherous Sandstone Wall
Treacherous Sandstone Wall.desc: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.
Treacherous Sandstone Wall.tip: A dangerous slab of sand wall that will spawn monsters

Sandstorm in a Balloon.name: Sandstorm in a Balloon
Sandstorm in a Balloon.desc: The Sandstorm in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functions of the Sandstorm in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.
Sandstorm in a Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump · Increases jump height

Sanguine Staff.name: Sanguine Staff
Sanguine Staff.desc: The Sanguine Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Sanguine Bat minion. It flies in an elliptical loop between the player and the target enemy.
Sanguine Staff.tip: Summons a sanguine bat to fight for you

Santa Hat.name: Santa Hat
Santa Hat.desc: The Santa set is a vanity set which consists of the Santa Hat, the Santa Shirt, and the Santa Pants. It is purchased from Santa Claus for after the Frost Legion has been defeated.

Santa Pants.name: Santa Pants
Santa Pants.desc: The Santa set is a vanity set which consists of the Santa Hat, the Santa Shirt, and the Santa Pants. It is purchased from Santa Claus for after the Frost Legion has been defeated.

Santa Shirt.name: Santa Shirt
Santa Shirt.desc: The Santa set is a vanity set which consists of the Santa Hat, the Santa Shirt, and the Santa Pants. It is purchased from Santa Claus for after the Frost Legion has been defeated.

Sapphire Robe.name: Sapphire Robe
Sapphire Robe.desc: The Sapphire Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Sapphire Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to create two projectiles which move in a double-helix pattern, each dealing 60% damage.
Sapphire Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 9% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Sapphires swirl in pairs

Sauteed Frog Legs.name: Sauteed Frog Legs
Sauteed Frog Legs.desc: Sauteed Frog Legs are a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Sauteed Frog Legs.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'The other, other white meat.'

Sawmill.name: Sawmill
Sawmill.desc: The Sawmill is a crafting station for advanced Wood and Furniture crafting. It is 3 blocks wide, 3 blocks high, and must be placed on top of solid blocks or platforms.
Sawmill.tip: Used for crafting advanced items such as beds, looms and dressers

Sawtooth Shark.name: Sawtooth Shark
Sawtooth Shark.desc: The Sawtooth Shark is a pre-Hardmode chainsaw that can be fished from an Ocean biome. It can be caught at a rate of 1/100 with 50% Fishing Power and 1/50 with 100% Fishing Power. In terms of axe power, it is equal to the Cobalt Chainsaw.

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Scaly Truffle.name: Scaly Truffle
Scaly Truffle.desc: The Scaly Truffle is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a Pigron Mount that allows the player to fly for a limited time and run faster on land.

Scarab Bomb.name: Scarab Bomb
Scarab Bomb.desc: The Scarab Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Sticky Bomb, but instead creates a 21-tile long and 3-tile wide shaft. The explosion will always aim away from the player's position, even after being thrown.
Scarab Bomb.tip: A narrow explosion that will destroy most tiles · Explosion aims away from your position

Scarecrow Banner.name: Scarecrow Banner
Scarecrow Banner.desc: The Scarecrow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Pumpkin Moon event. There are ten varieties of Scarecrow, five of which lack legs and can only move by jumping, while the other five follow the normal Fighter AI.
Scarecrow Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Scarecrow

Scarecrow Hat.name: Scarecrow Hat
Scarecrow Hat.desc: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat, the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants. All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event, each with a 0.37%–3.33% (0.56%–3.33%) chance depending on the current wave.

Scarecrow Pants.name: Scarecrow Pants
Scarecrow Pants.desc: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat, the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants. All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event, each with a 0.37%–3.33% (0.56%–3.33%) chance depending on the current wave.

Scarecrow Shirt.name: Scarecrow Shirt
Scarecrow Shirt.desc: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat, the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants. All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event, each with a 0.37%–3.33% (0.56%–3.33%) chance depending on the current wave.

Black Scorpion.name: Black Scorpion
Black Scorpion.desc: The Scorpion and Black Scorpion are harmless critters that are most commonly found in a Desert. For detailed spawning conditions, see Notes.

Scorpion.name: Scorpion
Scorpion.desc: The Scorpion and Black Scorpion are harmless critters that are most commonly found in a Desert. For detailed spawning conditions, see Notes.

Scout's Sling.name: Scout's Sling
Scout's Sling.desc: The Scout's Sling is a Hardmode accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Scout's Sling.tip: Walk past a sentry to carry it · Enemies are less likely to target you · 5% increased damage

Scrying Orb.name: Scrying Orb
Scrying Orb.desc: The Scrying Orb is a tool that allows spectating another player in multiplayer. When used, it shifts the camera to the perspective of the next player.
Scrying Orb.tip: See through the eyes of other players

Martian Scutlix Gunner Banner.name: Martian Scutlix Gunner Banner
Martian Scutlix Gunner Banner.desc: The Scutlix is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It consists of the Scutlix creature, ridden by a Scutlix Gunner enemy, both of which have individual health meters and can be killed independently.
Martian Scutlix Gunner Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Scutlix Gunner

Scutlix Banner.name: Scutlix Banner
Scutlix Banner.desc: The Scutlix is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It consists of the Scutlix creature, ridden by a Scutlix Gunner enemy, both of which have individual health meters and can be killed independently.
Scutlix Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Scutlix

Sea Snail Banner.name: Sea Snail Banner
Sea Snail Banner.desc: The Sea Snail is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. The Sea Snail's spawn rate is the lowest of all enemies in the Ocean, one-third that of Squids. It slowly crawls along the seafloor while attempting to deal contact damage.
Sea Snail Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sea Snail

Seagull.name: Seagull
Seagull.desc: The Seagull is a critter that spawns in the Ocean. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Palm tree or its Corrupt, Crimson, or Hallowed variant in the Ocean biome. Unlike Birds, it will not fly away when a player approaches.

Seahorse.name: Seahorse
Seahorse.desc: The Seahorse is a critter that spawns in the Ocean. They occasionally move in water by swimming in bursts at random directions.

Junonia Shell.name: Junonia Shell
Junonia Shell.desc: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Lightning Whelk Shell.name: Lightning Whelk Shell
Lightning Whelk Shell.desc: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Tulip Shell.name: Tulip Shell
Tulip Shell.desc: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Seaside Crate.name: Seaside Crate
Seaside Crate.desc: The Seaside Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Ocean. Seaside Crates contain items found in standard crates, and always contain one item normally found in Water Chests. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Ocean Crate.

Seaweed Planter.name: Seaweed Planter
Seaweed Planter.desc: The Seaweed Planter is a decorative furniture item acquired as a random reward for completing quests from the Angler NPC with a 1/30 chance.

Seed.name: Seed
Seed.desc: The Seed is a pre-Hardmode dart. While a Blowpipe or Blowgun is in a player's inventory, there is a chance that any vegetation growing on normal grass, in Clay Pots, and in Planter Boxes will drop Seeds.

Seedling.name: Seedling
Seedling.desc: The Seedling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Sapling to follow the player around. When the player is far enough away or in midair, it will sprout leaflets from its arms and use them as makeshift wings to fly towards them.

Selenian Banner.name: Selenian Banner
Selenian Banner.desc: The Selenian is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Selenian Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Selenian

Liquid Sensor (Any).name: Liquid Sensor (Any)
Liquid Sensor (Any).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.
Liquid Sensor (Any).tip: Signals when any liquid starts or stops touching it

Liquid Sensor (Honey).name: Liquid Sensor (Honey)
Liquid Sensor (Honey).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.
Liquid Sensor (Honey).tip: Signals when honey starts or stops touching it

Liquid Sensor (Lava).name: Liquid Sensor (Lava)
Liquid Sensor (Lava).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.
Liquid Sensor (Lava).tip: Signals when lava starts or stops touching it

Liquid Sensor (Water).name: Liquid Sensor (Water)
Liquid Sensor (Water).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.
Liquid Sensor (Water).tip: Signals when water starts or stops touching it

Logic Sensor (Day).name: Logic Sensor (Day)
Logic Sensor (Day).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.

Logic Sensor (Night).name: Logic Sensor (Night)
Logic Sensor (Night).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.

Logic Sensor (Player Above).name: Logic Sensor (Player Above)
Logic Sensor (Player Above).desc: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.
Logic Sensor (Player Above).tip: Signals when the first player enters or the last player leaves the area above it

Seraph Necklace.name: Seraph Necklace
Seraph Necklace.desc: The Seraph Necklace is a Hardmode accessory made by combining a Harpy Charm and a Cross Necklace at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of the two accessories, periodically redirecting arrows towards enemies and doubling the length of invincibility after taking damage.
Seraph Necklace.tip: Periodically redirects arrows towards enemies · Increases length of invincibility after taking damage

Sextant.name: Sextant
Sextant.desc: The Sextant is an informational accessory that displays the current moon phase.
Sextant.tip: Displays the phase of the moon

Shackle.name: Shackle
Shackle.desc: The Shackle is an accessory that grants 1 point of defense. It is dropped by most kinds of Zombies with a 1/50 chance. Shackles may be useful early in the game when only few accessories are available.

Shadewood Breastplate.name: Shadewood Breastplate
Shadewood Breastplate.desc: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet, Shadewood Breastplate, and Shadewood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Greaves.name: Shadewood Greaves
Shadewood Greaves.desc: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet, Shadewood Breastplate, and Shadewood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Helmet.name: Shadewood Helmet
Shadewood Helmet.desc: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet, Shadewood Breastplate, and Shadewood Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood. The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Bow.name: Shadewood Bow
Shadewood Bow.desc: The Shadewood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Shadewood Hammer.name: Shadewood Hammer
Shadewood Hammer.desc: The Shadewood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Shadewood Sword.name: Shadewood Sword
Shadewood Sword.desc: The Shadewood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Shadewood Wall.name: Shadewood Wall
Shadewood Wall.desc: Shadewood Walls are a type of Wall made from Shadewood.

Shadow Greaves.name: Shadow Greaves
Shadow Greaves.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore) and 45 Shadow Scales.

Shadow Helmet.name: Shadow Helmet
Shadow Helmet.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore) and 45 Shadow Scales.

Shadow Scalemail.name: Shadow Scalemail
Shadow Scalemail.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore) and 45 Shadow Scales.

Shadow Candle.name: Shadow Candle
Shadow Candle.desc: The Shadow Candle is a furniture item that emits a low amount of light, and can be placed only on flat-surface items. When placed, it grants nearby players the Shadow Candle debuff.
Shadow Candle.tip: Nullifies the peaceful benefits of towns
stats: Furniture / Light source / Mechanism / Crafting material

Shadow Chest.name: Shadow Chest
Shadow Chest.desc: The Shadow Chest is a storage item which is found only in The Underworld, generally on top of or within Ruined Houses, and contains rare items.

Shadow Jousting Lance.name: Shadow Jousting Lance
Shadow Jousting Lance.desc: The Shadow Jousting Lance is a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When attacking using Left Click, the lance will extend, and holding Left Click will keep it extended at a fixed angle.
Shadow Jousting Lance.tip: Build momentum to increase attack power

Shadow Key.name: Shadow Key
Shadow Key.desc: The Shadow Key is an item used solely to open Shadow Chests found scattered in the Underworld and Obsidian Lock Boxes found from Obsidian and Hellstone Crates. It is not consumed upon use; one Shadow Key can be used to open unlimited Shadow Chests.
Shadow Key.tip: Opens all Shadow Chests and Obsidian Lock Boxes

Shadow Orb.name: Shadow Orb
Shadow Orb.desc: The Shadow Orb is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a slow-moving Shadow Orb which follows the player around and emits dim, purple light.

Shadowflame Hades Dye.name: Shadowflame Hades Dye
Shadowflame Hades Dye.desc: Shadowflame Hades Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When applied, it turns the item violet and adds fire effects that trail behind the player.

Shark Banner.name: Shark Banner
Shark Banner.desc: The Shark is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. Sharks are rarer than other Ocean enemies like Crabs or Pink Jellyfish, though they are still relatively common.
Shark Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Shark

Shark Bait.name: Shark Bait
Shark Bait.desc: The Shark Bait is a pet-summoning item that summons a pet Shark Pup. When underwater, the Shark Pup swims around freely. When out of water, it is encased in a bubble. When the player is too far away, the Shark Pup will move swiftly toward them.
Shark Bait.tip: Summons a Shark Pup · 'Doo, doo, doo, doo, doo, doo'

Sharkron Balloon.name: Sharkron Balloon
Sharkron Balloon.desc: The Sharkron Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Tsunami in a Bottle and the Balloon Pufferfish.
Sharkron Balloon.tip: Increases jump height · Allows the holder to double jump

Sharp Spike Block.name: Sharp Spike Block
Sharp Spike Block.desc: The Sharp Spike Block is a pre-Hardmode block crafted from Spike Blocks. Upon contact, it deals 70 damage to the player and inflicts the Bleeding debuff for 10–20 / 20–40 / seconds.

Shellphone.name: Shellphone
Shellphone.desc: The Shellphone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the Cell Phone, Magic Conch, and Demon Conch.
Shellphone.tip: Displays everything · Right click to toggle destination · 'If you listen closely, you can hear something about your car's warranty'

Shellphone (Home).name: Shellphone (Home)
Shellphone (Home).desc: The Shellphone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the Cell Phone, Magic Conch, and Demon Conch.
Shellphone (Home).tip: Displays everything · Allows you to return home at will · Right click to toggle destination · 'If you listen closely, you can hear something about your car's warranty'

Shellphone (Ocean).name: Shellphone (Ocean)
Shellphone (Ocean).desc: The Shellphone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the Cell Phone, Magic Conch, and Demon Conch.
Shellphone (Ocean).tip: Displays everything · Allows you to travel to the ocean at will · Right click to toggle destination · 'If you listen closely, you can hear something about your car's warranty'

Shellphone (Spawn).name: Shellphone (Spawn)
Shellphone (Spawn).desc: The Shellphone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the Cell Phone, Magic Conch, and Demon Conch.
Shellphone (Spawn).tip: Displays everything · Allows you to return to spawn at will · Right click to toggle destination · 'If you listen closely, you can hear something about your car's warranty'

Shellphone (Underworld).name: Shellphone (Underworld)
Shellphone (Underworld).desc: The Shellphone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the Cell Phone, Magic Conch, and Demon Conch.
Shellphone (Underworld).tip: Displays everything · Allows you to travel to the underworld at will · Right click to toggle destination · 'If you listen closely, you can hear something about your car's warranty'

Shifting Pearlsands Dye.name: Shifting Pearlsands Dye
Shifting Pearlsands Dye.desc: Shifting Pearlsands Dye is a Hardmode dye which is very similar to the Shifting Sands Dye, but more pink. It can only be crafted, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Shifting Sands Dye.name: Shifting Sands Dye
Shifting Sands Dye.desc: Shifting Sands Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. When applied, it gives the item an appearance similar to falling sand. It can be used to craft Shifting Pearlsands Dye when one acquires Crystal Shards.

Shimmer Gun.name: Shimmer Gun
Shimmer Gun.desc: The Shimmer Gun is a tool that is obtained by throwing a Slime Gun into Shimmer. When used, it sprays a stream of Shimmer that inflicts the Shimmering debuff on enemies and NPCs.
Shimmer Gun.tip: Squirts an enchanted stream of Shimmer · 'Transform your friends! Does not contain psycho-reactive slime'

Shimmer Slime Banner.name: Shimmer Slime Banner
Shimmer Slime Banner.desc: The Shimmer Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that cannot be found naturally, and is instead created when most varieties of slimes come into contact with Shimmer or upon being sprayed by the Shimmer Gun (with exceptions below).
Shimmer Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Shimmer Slime

Shimmerfall Block.name: Shimmerfall Block
Shimmerfall Block.desc: The Shimmerfall Block is an animated block type which shows flowing Shimmer. It glows when placed.

Shimmerfall Wall.name: Shimmerfall Wall
Shimmerfall Wall.desc: Shimmerfall Wall is a type of wall. It depicts flowing Shimmer. It glows when placed like Shimmerfall Blocks that it is made from. As with most crafted walls, Shimmerfall Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet.name: Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet
Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet.desc: Shinobi Infiltrator armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet, Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso, and Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 2 and increases summon & melee damage by 20%

Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants.name: Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants
Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants.desc: Shinobi Infiltrator armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet, Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso, and Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants.tip: 20% increased summon damage and melee critical strike chance · 30% increased movement speed

Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso.name: Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso
Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso.desc: Shinobi Infiltrator armor is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Shinobi Infiltrator's Helmet, Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso, and Shinobi Infiltrator's Pants. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of.
Shinobi Infiltrator's Torso.tip: 20% increased summon damage and melee speed · 5% increased melee critical strike chance

Shiny Black Slab.name: Shiny Black Slab
Shiny Black Slab.desc: The Shiny Black Slab was a pet-summoning item that spawned an Android. It was obtainable from Chests in the surface layer, but only on the Google Play version. It was obtainable on other mobile devices via trading.

Ship in a Bottle.name: Ship in a Bottle
Ship in a Bottle.desc: The Ship in a Bottle is a decorative furniture item acquired by completing Angler NPC quests.

Ship's Wheel.name: Ship's Wheel
Ship's Wheel.desc: The Ship's Wheel is a wall decoration acquired by completing Angler quests.

Shiverthorn Seeds.name: Shiverthorn Seeds
Shiverthorn Seeds.desc: Shiverthorn Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Shiverthorns while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on a naturally grown Shiverthorns while they are fully grown.

Shoe Spikes.name: Shoe Spikes
Shoe Spikes.desc: The Shoe Spikes are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair. Jumps can also be performed off the sides of blocks. By repeatedly sticking and jumping, vertical blocks can be scaled.
Shoe Spikes.tip: Allows the ability to slide down walls · Improved ability if combined with Climbing Claws

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.desc: The Shotgun is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for. When used, it fires a spread of 4–5 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Shrimp.name: Shrimp
Shrimp.desc: Shrimp are a type of fishing catch which are found uncommonly by fishing in the Ocean in the Sky or Surface layers.

Shrimp Po' Boy.name: Shrimp Po' Boy
Shrimp Po' Boy.desc: The Shrimp Po' Boy is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. The Shrimp Po' Boy has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Sharks, Orcas, and Crabs. Statue-spawned Sharks, Orcas and Crabs do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Shrimp Po' Boy.tip: Medium improvements to all stats · 'Po' Boy are you in for a treat!'

Shrimpy Truffle.name: Shrimpy Truffle
Shrimpy Truffle.desc: The Shrimpy Truffle is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that spawns Cute Fishron, a miniature rideable Duke Fishron-style mount that can fly and hover indefinitely. The Shrimpy Truffle is always dropped from Duke Fishron's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.
Shrimpy Truffle.tip: Attracts a legendary creature which flourishes in water & combat

Shroomite Breastplate.name: Shroomite Breastplate
Shroomite Breastplate.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
Shroomite Breastplate.tip: 13% increased ranged damage & critical strike chance · 20% chance to save ammo

Shroomite Headgear.name: Shroomite Headgear
Shroomite Headgear.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
Shroomite Headgear.tip: Increases bow damage by 12% · 5% increased ranged critical strike chance

Shroomite Helmet.name: Shroomite Helmet
Shroomite Helmet.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
Shroomite Helmet.tip: Increases specialist ranged damage by 12% · These are launchers, dartguns, or anything else that doesn't shoot arrows/bullets · 5% increased ranged critical strike chance

Shroomite Leggings.name: Shroomite Leggings
Shroomite Leggings.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
Shroomite Leggings.tip: 7% increased ranged critical strike chance · 12% increased movement speed

Shroomite Mask.name: Shroomite Mask
Shroomite Mask.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
Shroomite Mask.tip: Increases gun damage by 12% · 5% increased ranged critical strike chance

Shroomite Digging Claw.name: Shroomite Digging Claw
Shroomite Digging Claw.desc: The Shroomite Digging Claw is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pickaxe and axe. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore. It is the pickaxe with the fastest mining speed.

Shroomite Plating.name: Shroomite Plating
Shroomite Plating.desc: Shroomite Plating is a building material crafted from Stone Blocks and Shroomite Bars. It produces a small amount of light when placed but it does not count as a light source for housing. It is essentially the Shroomite equivalent of a brick.

Shroomite Plating Wall.name: Shroomite Plating Wall
Shroomite Plating Wall.desc: The Shroomite Plating Wall is a type of wall made from Shroomite Plating. It glows when placed like the block it is made from.

Shrub Star.name: Shrub Star
Shrub Star.desc: The Shrub Star is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns an Everscream Sapling to follow the player around.

Shucked Oyster.name: Shucked Oyster
Shucked Oyster.desc: The Shucked Oyster is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Shucked Oyster.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Aw, shucks!'

Shuriken.name: Shuriken
Shuriken.desc: The Shuriken is a consumable ranged weapon. Shurikens can be found in Pots and Chests around the world, and can be purchased from the Merchant for each.

Sign.name: Sign
Sign.desc: The Sign is a decorative furniture item that can store a player-written message. A Sign must be placed and then the Right Click button must be pressed on it to edit or display its message.

Silly Balloon Machine.name: Silly Balloon Machine
Silly Balloon Machine.desc: The Silly Balloon Machine is a novelty furniture item that can be purchased from the Party Girl for. Once placed, it continuously produces decorative pink, purple, and green balloons at short random intervals and at no cost. It can be deactivated and reactivated via Wire.

Silly Green Balloon Wall.name: Silly Green Balloon Wall
Silly Green Balloon Wall.desc: Silly Balloon Walls are background Walls crafted from Silly Balloons, which are purchased from the Party Girl during a party.

Silly Pink Balloon Wall.name: Silly Pink Balloon Wall
Silly Pink Balloon Wall.desc: Silly Balloon Walls are background Walls crafted from Silly Balloons, which are purchased from the Party Girl during a party.

Silly Purple Balloon Wall.name: Silly Purple Balloon Wall
Silly Purple Balloon Wall.desc: Silly Balloon Walls are background Walls crafted from Silly Balloons, which are purchased from the Party Girl during a party.

Silly Green Balloon.name: Silly Green Balloon
Silly Green Balloon.desc: Silly Balloons are blocks that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each or obtained from killing Balloon Slimes. When a single one is placed, it has a round appearance, just like Bubbles and Smoke Blocks.

Silly Pink Balloon.name: Silly Pink Balloon
Silly Pink Balloon.desc: Silly Balloons are blocks that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each or obtained from killing Balloon Slimes. When a single one is placed, it has a round appearance, just like Bubbles and Smoke Blocks.

Silly Purple Balloon.name: Silly Purple Balloon
Silly Purple Balloon.desc: Silly Balloons are blocks that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each or obtained from killing Balloon Slimes. When a single one is placed, it has a round appearance, just like Bubbles and Smoke Blocks.

Silly Sunflower Bottoms.name: Silly Sunflower Bottoms
Silly Sunflower Bottoms.desc: The Silly Sunflower set is a vanity set which consists of the Silly Sunflower Petals, Silly Sunflower Tops and Silly Sunflower Bottoms. They are purchased from the Clothier for while a Party is active.

Silly Sunflower Petals.name: Silly Sunflower Petals
Silly Sunflower Petals.desc: The Silly Sunflower set is a vanity set which consists of the Silly Sunflower Petals, Silly Sunflower Tops and Silly Sunflower Bottoms. They are purchased from the Clothier for while a Party is active.

Silly Sunflower Tops.name: Silly Sunflower Tops
Silly Sunflower Tops.desc: The Silly Sunflower set is a vanity set which consists of the Silly Sunflower Petals, Silly Sunflower Tops and Silly Sunflower Bottoms. They are purchased from the Clothier for while a Party is active.

Silly Tied Balloon (Green).name: Silly Tied Balloon (Green)
Silly Tied Balloon (Green).desc: Silly Tied Balloons are animated novelty furniture items that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each.

Silly Tied Balloon (Pink).name: Silly Tied Balloon (Pink)
Silly Tied Balloon (Pink).desc: Silly Tied Balloons are animated novelty furniture items that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each.

Silly Tied Balloon (Purple).name: Silly Tied Balloon (Purple)
Silly Tied Balloon (Purple).desc: Silly Tied Balloons are animated novelty furniture items that can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl for each.

Silly Tied Bundle of Balloons.name: Silly Tied Bundle of Balloons
Silly Tied Bundle of Balloons.desc: The Silly Tied Bundle of Balloons is an animated novelty furniture item crafted from green, purple, and pink Silly Tied Balloons, which can be purchased during a Party from the Party Girl.

Silt Block.name: Silt Block
Silt Block.desc: Silt Blocks are a type of soil blocks that generates in the Underground and Cavern layers, appearing more frequently at lower depths. Silt is affected by gravity and will deal damage to any player or enemy it falls on.
Silt Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you · Can be extractinated
stats: Until the player gets out from under the Silt Blocks

Silver Chainmail.name: Silver Chainmail
Silver Chainmail.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Silver Bars (240 Silver Ore). The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

Silver Greaves.name: Silver Greaves
Silver Greaves.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Silver Bars (240 Silver Ore). The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

Silver Helmet.name: Silver Helmet
Silver Helmet.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Silver Bars (240 Silver Ore). The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

Silver Axe.name: Silver Axe
Silver Axe.desc: The Silver Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Silver Bar.name: Silver Bar
Silver Bar.desc: The Silver Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Silver Bow.name: Silver Bow
Silver Bow.desc: The Silver Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Silver Bracer.name: Silver Bracer
Silver Bracer.desc: The Silver Bracer is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory that can be obtained as secondary loot from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Silver Bracer.tip: Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 1 · Significantly increases the duration of your summon tag effects · 'Tis a silver lining!'

Silver Brick.name: Silver Brick
Silver Brick.desc: Silver Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material. Like the ore it is made of, placed Silver Bricks will sparkle. It is not recommended that it be used for building unless the player has silver ore to spare. It can be crafted into Silver Brick Walls.

Silver Brick Wall.name: Silver Brick Wall
Silver Brick Wall.desc: Silver Brick Walls are a type of background wall crafted from Silver Bricks. Enemies will not spawn where they are placed, and they can be used for NPC houses.

Silver Broadsword.name: Silver Broadsword
Silver Broadsword.desc: The Silver Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Silver Hammer.name: Silver Hammer
Silver Hammer.desc: The Silver Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Silver Ore.name: Silver Ore
Silver Ore.desc: Silver Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Silver Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Silver Pickaxe.name: Silver Pickaxe
Silver Pickaxe.desc: The Silver Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite.

Silver Shield.name: Silver Shield
Silver Shield.desc: The Silver Shield is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron shield accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Silver Shield.tip: Grants immunity to knockback and fire blocks · Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 1 · Significantly increases the duration of your summon tag effects

Silver Shortsword.name: Silver Shortsword
Silver Shortsword.desc: The Silver Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Aetherium Sink.name: Aetherium Sink
Aetherium Sink.desc: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station. Like Fountains, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

Skeleton Banner.name: Skeleton Banner
Skeleton Banner.desc: The Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that frequently spawns in the Cavern layer as one of many variants. Regular Skeletons can be spawned by the Skeleton Statue.
Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Skeleton

Skeleton Archer Banner.name: Skeleton Archer Banner
Skeleton Archer Banner.desc: The Skeleton Archer is a Hardmode enemy that sometimes spawns in the Cavern layer. They move fairly slow compared to other cave enemies.
Skeleton Archer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Skeleton Archer

Skeleton Commando Banner.name: Skeleton Commando Banner
Skeleton Commando Banner.desc: The Skeleton Commando is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It slowly approaches the player, and upon getting within their line of sight, stops in place before firing Rockets that explode upon contact with solid blocks.
Skeleton Commando Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Skeleton Commando

Skeleton Sniper Banner.name: Skeleton Sniper Banner
Skeleton Sniper Banner.desc: The Skeleton Sniper is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks from long range, slowly approaching the player. As soon as it has a clear line of sight, it pauses briefly before firing a single shot.
Skeleton Sniper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Skeleton Sniper

Skiphs' Blood.name: Skiphs' Blood
Skiphs' Blood.desc: Skiphs' Blood is a Hardmode dye obtained from Hardmode bosses' Treasure Bags (except Queen Slime's) along with Skiphs' set. It can also be a random reward from the Dye Trader for completing a Strange Plant quest after the Moon Lord has been defeated.

Skiphs' Bear Butt.name: Skiphs' Bear Butt
Skiphs' Bear Butt.desc: It is the vanity set made for Skiphs, one of the programmers who develops Terraria and its official website.

Skiphs' Mask.name: Skiphs' Mask
Skiphs' Mask.desc: It is the vanity set made for Skiphs, one of the programmers who develops Terraria and its official website.

Skiphs' Skin.name: Skiphs' Skin
Skiphs' Skin.desc: It is the vanity set made for Skiphs, one of the programmers who develops Terraria and its official website.

Skull.name: Skull
Skull.desc: The Skull is a rare vanity item that has a 1/500 chance of being dropped by Skeletons and Spore Skeleton, which are found in the Cavern layer, or a 1/2500 chance by those spawned from a Skeleton Statue or a Bone Skeleton Statue.

Skull Bow.name: Skull Bow
Skull Bow.desc: The Skull Bow is an unobtainable bow. Apart from standard bow behavior, it can convert Bone Arrows (ID 474) into Bone Arrows from the Marrow (ID 117).

Skull Lantern.name: Skull Lantern
Skull Lantern.desc: The Skull Lantern is a decorative piece of furniture that provides light. They always face left, and cannot be turned off via Wire.

Sky Blue Flower.name: Sky Blue Flower
Sky Blue Flower.desc: The Sky Blue Flower is a type of plant. It grows on Jungle grass in any layer except the Underworld, or on regular Sand Blocks submerged in at least 2 tiles of any liquid above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe.
Sky Blue Flower.tip: Used to make Sky Blue Dye

Sky Crate.name: Sky Crate
Sky Crate.desc: The Sky Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in Space, e.g. in Floating Lakes. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally found in Skyware Chests (with the exception of the Sky Mill).
Sky Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Sky Dragon's Fury.name: Sky Dragon's Fury
Sky Dragon's Fury.desc: The Sky Dragon's Fury is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee weapon that possesses two different modes of attack.
Sky Dragon's Fury.tip: Right click while holding for an alternate attack!

Sky Mill.name: Sky Mill
Sky Mill.desc: The Sky Mill is a crafting station used to craft the Cloud, Duskware, Harpy, and Skyware furniture sets; Rain, Rainbow, Snow, Star, and Lava Cloud blocks; and Sunplate Blocks, and Harpy Blocks.

Skyware Chest.name: Skyware Chest
Skyware Chest.desc: The Skyware Chest is a storage item found only on Floating Islands.

Slap Hand.name: Slap Hand
Slap Hand.desc: The Slap Hand is a Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for during a Blood Moon. It is notable for having extremely high base knockback – a rating of, one of the highest values among all player-caused sources of knockback.

Slasher's Mysterious Skull.name: Slasher's Mysterious Skull
Slasher's Mysterious Skull.desc: Slasher's Mysterious Skull is a transformation mount item that transforms the user into a Velociraptor. While in this form, wings can be used, which differs from other mounts. It will show a Pterosaur carrying the Velociraptor (the player) when flying.
Slasher's Mysterious Skull.tip: 'Embrace your inner raptor - complete with nasty, big, pointy teeth!'

Sleepy Octopod.name: Sleepy Octopod
Sleepy Octopod.desc: The Sleepy Octopod is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss melee weapon that is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/10 / 1/5 chance during Tier 2, and a 1/20 chance during Tier 3. When used, it is swung continuously in a 360° radius around the player.
Sleepy Octopod.tip: Charges power as it is swung to smash enemies

Slice of Hell Cake.name: Slice of Hell Cake
Slice of Hell Cake.desc: The Slice of Hell Cake is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Imp to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Imp will spread its arms and fly to catch up to them.
Slice of Hell Cake.tip: Summons a baby imp · 'He hasn't learned how to teleport yet!'

Slime Block.name: Slime Block
Slime Block.desc: The Slime Block is a type of block crafted using the Solidifier. Walking or landing on Slime Blocks produces droplet particles.

Slime Block Wall.name: Slime Block Wall
Slime Block Wall.desc: The Slime Block Wall is a type of Wall made from a Slime Block.

Slime Crown.name: Slime Crown
Slime Crown.desc: The Slime Crown is a boss-summoning item that summons King Slime when used. It can be used in any biome at any time.

Slime Gun.name: Slime Gun
Slime Gun.desc: The Slime Gun is a tool that has a 2/3 chance of being dropped by King Slime. When used, it sprays an arc of slime which inflicts the Slime debuff on players, enemies, and NPCs for 3.
Slime Gun.tip: Squirts a stream of slime that can turn most lights on · Slimed players and creatures take more damage from fire

Slime Spear.name: Slime Spear
Slime Spear.desc: The Slime Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that inflicts the Slime debuff for 3 on hit.

Slime Whip.name: Slime Whip
Slime Whip.desc: The Slime Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 60% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Slime Whip.tip: 3 summon tag damage · Whip crack can ignite enemies

Slimer Banner.name: Slimer Banner
Slimer Banner.desc: The Slimer is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Corruption and Underground Corruption. It spawns as a winged slime, attacking the player using the Bat AI pattern.
Slimer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Slimer

Slimy Saddle.name: Slimy Saddle
Slimy Saddle.desc: The Slimy Saddle is a pre-Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a friendly Slime Mount.

Sluggy.name: Sluggy
Sluggy.desc: Sluggy is one of three critters that occasionally spawn in the Jungle or Underground Jungle biome when a player breaks a plant, the others being Grubby (more common) and Buggy (rarest).

Slush Block.name: Slush Block
Slush Block.desc: Slush Blocks are blocks that appear naturally in Ice biomes. They are subject to gravity and will fall if the blocks supporting them are removed, dealing damage to any player or enemy they fall on (similar to Sand and Silt).
Slush Block.tip: Will suffocate you if it falls on you · Can be extractinated
stats: Until the player gets out from under the Slush Blocks

Smoke Block.name: Smoke Block
Smoke Block.desc: Smoke Blocks are animated background furniture blocks that can be purchased from the Party Girl for in Hardmode. When placed together, they will connect in a way that each block on the outer left and right sides visually take up half of a block.

Smoke Bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke Bomb.desc: The Smoke Bomb is a throwable, consumable novelty item that, when thrown, emits thick gray smoke for one minute. Upon throwing a Smoke Bomb, it will bounce or roll until it comes to a complete stop and continues to release smoke.

Smooth Granite Block.name: Smooth Granite Block
Smooth Granite Block.desc: Smooth Granite Blocks are blocks with a dark blue appearance. The block can be crafted or found as walls in underground houses in Granite Caves. They can be used to craft the Granite furniture set.

Smooth Granite Wall.name: Smooth Granite Wall
Smooth Granite Wall.desc: Smooth Granite Wall is a type of Wall that can be crafted with Smooth Granite Blocks.

Smooth Marble Wall.name: Smooth Marble Wall
Smooth Marble Wall.desc: Smooth Marble Walls are background walls made from Smooth Marble Blocks.

Smooth Sandstone.name: Smooth Sandstone
Smooth Sandstone.desc: Smooth Sandstone is a type of block crafted from Sandstone Blocks. It can be used to craft the Sandstone furniture set.

Smooth Sandstone Wall.name: Smooth Sandstone Wall
Smooth Sandstone Wall.desc: The Smooth Sandstone Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Smooth Sandstone Blocks. It is the only Sandstone Wall type not to generate naturally.

Smoothie of Darkness.name: Smoothie of Darkness
Smoothie of Darkness.desc: The Smoothie of Darkness is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Smoothie of Darkness.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Come to the dark side, we have smoothies'

Snail.name: Snail
Snail.desc: The Snail is a rather rare critter that spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, but not in Ice, Crimson, Corruption, or Hallow biomes. It can also spawn in front of unsafe Living Wood Walls below the surface at a much higher rate.

Snake Band.name: Snake Band
Snake Band.desc: The Snake Band is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/40 chance of dropping from Lamias in the Underground Desert. When equipped, every third attack with a whip causes the player to automatically perform an extra whip swing at the same time.
Snake Band.tip: Every 3 swings, joins and attacks with your second whip · 'When a problem comes along, you must whip it...'

Snake Charmer's Flute.name: Snake Charmer's Flute
Snake Charmer's Flute.desc: The Snake Charmer's Flute is a pre-Hardmode tool that places a pot from which a snake rises. Once the snake reaches its full height of 100 tiles or touches a block, it stops rising and becomes climbable like a rope.

Snapping Stone.name: Snapping Stone
Snapping Stone.desc: The Snapping Stone is a pre-Hardmode accessory that has a 1/80 chance of dropping from Granite Golems and Granite Elementals.
Snapping Stone.tip: Periodically recharges with faint light · Ranged hits discharge a damaging pulse

Snatcher Banner.name: Snatcher Banner
Snatcher Banner.desc: The Snatcher is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the surface Jungle, and is nearly identical in appearance and behavior to the Underground Jungle's Man Eater. Snatchers spawn anchored to blocks, with an extendable stem topped by a pincher.
Snatcher Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Snatcher

Snow Balla Banner.name: Snow Balla Banner
Snow Balla Banner.desc: The Snow Balla is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It moves by hopping towards the player and throws snowballs at them which form Snow Blocks on impact with other blocks, similar to the attack of an Antlion.
Snow Balla Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Snow Balla

Snow Brick.name: Snow Brick
Snow Brick.desc: Snow Bricks are bricks crafted from Snow Blocks. Placing snow bricks will cause snow to fall in the background and they count toward the qualifications for a Snow biome.

Snow Brick Wall.name: Snow Brick Wall
Snow Brick Wall.desc: The Snow Brick Wall is a pre-Hardmode background wall.

Snow Cloud.name: Snow Cloud
Snow Cloud.desc: Snow Cloud is a type of block that can be crafted at a Sky Mill from Cloud blocks in the Snow biome. Snow Cloud blocks cause purely decorative snowflakes to appear beneath them, continuing for about 8 tiles and then fading away for 5 more.

Snow Flinx Banner.name: Snow Flinx Banner
Snow Flinx Banner.desc: The Snow Flinx is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome (another name for the Cavern layer Snow biome). It is susceptible to knockback, and when hit, will tumble over and fly backwards.
Snow Flinx Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Snow Flinx

Snow Hat.name: Snow Hat
Snow Hat.desc: The Snow Hat is a vanity item dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode.

Snow Wall.name: Snow Wall
Snow Wall.desc: The Snow Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in the Snow biome, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Snowball Launcher.name: Snowball Launcher
Snowball Launcher.desc: The Snowball Launcher is a pre-Hardmode furniture item and placeable weapon that has a 1/25 chance of being dropped by Snow Flinx.

Snowfall Block.name: Snowfall Block
Snowfall Block.desc: The Snowfall Block is an animated block type which shows falling snow. Like related blocks such as the Waterfall Block or Lavafall Block, it is one of the few items that uses the Crystal Ball as a crafting station.
Snowfall Block.tip: 'A lot cooler than a snow globe'

Snowfall Wall.name: Snowfall Wall
Snowfall Wall.desc: Snowfall Wall is one of only a few animated background walls. It depicts falling snow.
Snowfall Wall.tip: 'A lot cooler than a snow globe'

Snowman Gangsta Banner.name: Snowman Gangsta Banner
Snowman Gangsta Banner.desc: The Snowman Gangsta is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It moves by hopping toward the player while occasionally firing bullets at them at a slow rate, and can only shoot left or right.
Snowman Gangsta Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Snowman Gangsta

Aetherium Sofa.name: Aetherium Sofa
Aetherium Sofa.desc: Sofas are furniture items which fulfill a house's chair requirement. Players can sit in sofas by pressing the Right Click button on them. Players can choose to sit on the left, middle, or right positions, and thus up to 3 players can sit on a sofa at a time.
