Solar Brick.name: Solar Brick
Solar Brick.desc: The Solar Brick is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist brick that is crafted from Solar Fragments. It is one of the four Fragment Bricks, bricks which are crafted with Lunar Fragments. It glows when placed and can be used to craft Solar furniture.

Solar Brick Wall.name: Solar Brick Wall
Solar Brick Wall.desc: Solar Brick Wall is a background wall made from Solar Bricks.

Solar Flare Breastplate.name: Solar Flare Breastplate
Solar Flare Breastplate.desc: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet, Solar Flare Breastplate, and Solar Flare Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Solar Fragments.
Solar Flare Breastplate.tip: 29% increased melee damage · Grants minor life regeneration · Enemies are more likely to target you

Solar Flare Helmet.name: Solar Flare Helmet
Solar Flare Helmet.desc: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet, Solar Flare Breastplate, and Solar Flare Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Solar Fragments.
Solar Flare Helmet.tip: 26% increased melee critical strike chance · Grants minor life regeneration · Enemies are more likely to target you

Solar Flare Leggings.name: Solar Flare Leggings
Solar Flare Leggings.desc: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet, Solar Flare Breastplate, and Solar Flare Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Solar Fragments.
Solar Flare Leggings.tip: 15% increased movement and melee speed · Grants minor life regeneration · Enemies are more likely to target you

Solar Fragment Block.name: Solar Fragment Block
Solar Fragment Block.desc: Solar Fragment Blocks are blocks made from Solar Fragments which are dropped by the Solar Pillar. The blocks have a crystal-like appearance with intense shades of yellow, red, and orange. They can be crafted with the Ancient Manipulator. Walls cannot be crafted with them.

Solar Tablet.name: Solar Tablet
Solar Tablet.desc: The Solar Tablet is a Hardmode event-summoning item used to summon a Solar Eclipse. It may only be used during the day (from 4:30 AM to 7:29 PM), causing the eclipse to begin immediately, regardless of the time. The eclipse lasts until 7:30 PM of the current day.

Solidifier.name: Solidifier
Solidifier.desc: The Solidifier is a crafting station used to craft Slime furniture, some miscellaneous blocks, and two weapons: the Slime Spear and Slime Whip. The Solidifier is always dropped by King Slime, and is also always placed on the starting island of a newly generated Skyblock world.

Blue Solution.name: Blue Solution
Blue Solution.desc: Solutions are a type of ammunition used solely by the Clentaminator and Terraformer. Each solution will convert certain blocks and walls to other blocks and walls, creating and/or destroying different biomes in the process. There are 8 different solutions.
Blue Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Hallow

Brown Solution.name: Brown Solution
Brown Solution.desc: Solutions are a type of ammunition used solely by the Clentaminator and Terraformer. Each solution will convert certain blocks and walls to other blocks and walls, creating and/or destroying different biomes in the process. There are 8 different solutions.
Brown Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Forest

Dark Blue Solution.desc: Solutions are a type of ammunition used solely by the Clentaminator and Terraformer. Each solution will convert certain blocks and walls to other blocks and walls, creating and/or destroying different biomes in the process. There are 8 different solutions.
Dark Blue Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads Glowing Mushrooms

Green Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Purity

White Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Snow

Yellow Solution.tip: Used by the Clentaminator · Spreads the Desert

Soulscourge.name: Soulscourge
Soulscourge.desc: The Soulscourge is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 40% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Soulscourge.tip: 5 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · 'Lash your enemies with the remnants of evil incarnate'

Space Creature Mask.name: Space Creature Mask
Space Creature Mask.desc: The Space Creature set is a vanity set consisting of the Space Creature Mask, Space Creature Shirt, and Space Creature Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Space Creature Pants.name: Space Creature Pants
Space Creature Pants.desc: The Space Creature set is a vanity set consisting of the Space Creature Mask, Space Creature Shirt, and Space Creature Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Space Creature Shirt.name: Space Creature Shirt
Space Creature Shirt.desc: The Space Creature set is a vanity set consisting of the Space Creature Mask, Space Creature Shirt, and Space Creature Pants. Its male and female variants look identical. It has a 2/57 chance to drop from Goodie Bags during Halloween.

Spaghetti.name: Spaghetti
Spaghetti.desc: The Spaghetti is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. Spaghetti has a 1/50 chance of being dropped by Granite Elementals and Granite Golems. Statue-spawned Granite Golems do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Spaghetti.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Al dente!'

Sparkle Slime Balloon.name: Sparkle Slime Balloon
Sparkle Slime Balloon.desc: The Sparkle Slime Balloon is a Hardmode novelty consumable item.

Sparkling Honey.name: Sparkling Honey
Sparkling Honey.desc: The Sparkling Honey is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Honey Bee pet, a large bee which follows the player around. The Sparkling Honey has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee in Master Mode.
Sparkling Honey.tip: Summons a honey bee · 'The secret ingredient for royal bees.'

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.desc: The Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 1/11 chance of being found in Wooden Chests that are located on the surface as well as in the underground layer.

Spear Trap.name: Spear Trap
Spear Trap.desc: The Spear Trap is a trap found naturally in the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door.

Spectre Hood.name: Spectre Hood
Spectre Hood.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.

Spectre Mask.name: Spectre Mask
Spectre Mask.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.
Spectre Mask.tip: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 13% reduced mana cost · 10% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Spectre Pants.name: Spectre Pants
Spectre Pants.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.
Spectre Pants.tip: 8% increased magic damage · 8% increased movement speed

Spectre Robe.name: Spectre Robe
Spectre Robe.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.
Spectre Robe.tip: 7% increased magic damage and critical strike chance

Spectre Goggles.name: Spectre Goggles
Spectre Goggles.desc: The Spectre Goggles are a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory which allows the player to see Echo Blocks, Echo Platforms, Echo Walls, Ghostly Stinkbug Blockers, and tiles painted with Echo Coating while equipped.
Spectre Goggles.tip: Enables Echo Sight, showing hidden blocks

Spectre Hamaxe.name: Spectre Hamaxe
Spectre Hamaxe.desc: The Spectre Hamaxe is a Hardmode, post-Plantera hamaxe.

Spectre Paint Roller.name: Spectre Paint Roller
Spectre Paint Roller.desc: The Spectre Paint Roller is a Hardmode tool which is used to paint walls, much like the regular Paint Roller sold by the Painter. The advantage over its predecessor is the Spectre Paint Roller's increased range of +3 tiles.
Spectre Paint Roller.tip: Used with paint to color walls · Can also apply coatings

Spectre Paint Scraper.name: Spectre Paint Scraper
Spectre Paint Scraper.desc: The Spectre Paint Scraper is a Hardmode tool which is used to remove paint off tiles and walls, much like the regular Paint Scraper sold by the Painter. The advantage over its predecessor is the Spectre Paint Scraper's increased range of +3 tiles.
Spectre Paint Scraper.tip: Used to remove paint or coatings · Can sometimes collect moss

Spectre Paintbrush.name: Spectre Paintbrush
Spectre Paintbrush.desc: The Spectre Paintbrush is a Hardmode tool which is used to apply paint to tiles, much like the regular Paintbrush sold by the Painter. The advantage over its predecessor is the Spectre Paintbrush's increased range of +3 tiles.
Spectre Paintbrush.tip: Used with paint to color blocks · Can also apply coatings

Spectre Pickaxe.name: Spectre Pickaxe
Spectre Pickaxe.desc: The Spectre Pickaxe is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Chlorophyte Ore. It also has a notably high range bonus of 3 blocks.

Specular Fish.name: Specular Fish
Specular Fish.desc: Specular Fish are a type of fish that are commonly found by fishing in a Forest or Snow biome in the Underground, Cavern, and Underworld layers. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners, Recall Potions, and Wormhole Potions.

Spelunker Glowstick.name: Spelunker Glowstick
Spelunker Glowstick.desc: The Spelunker Glowstick is a consumable light source that can be held or tossed a fair distance, similar to the regular Glowstick. In addition, it highlights the location of nearby treasures in a 30-tile radius around the glowstick with a slight yellowish glimmer.

Spider Breastplate.name: Spider Breastplate
Spider Breastplate.desc: Spider armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Spider Mask, Spider Breastplate, and Spider Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 36 Spider Fangs.
Spider Breastplate.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 5%

Spider Greaves.name: Spider Greaves
Spider Greaves.desc: Spider armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Spider Mask, Spider Breastplate, and Spider Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 36 Spider Fangs.
Spider Greaves.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 6%

Spider Mask.name: Spider Mask
Spider Mask.desc: Spider armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Spider Mask, Spider Breastplate, and Spider Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 36 Spider Fangs.
Spider Mask.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 5%

Spider Boulder.name: Spider Boulder
Spider Boulder.desc: The Spider Boulder is a special type of Boulder. It acts identically to the Boulder, with the exception of placing Cobwebs while moving and spawning Wall Creepers upon breaking. It generates near Spider Nests.

Spider Egg.name: Spider Egg
Spider Egg.desc: The Spider Egg is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Spider to follow the player around. The Pet Spider climbs on background walls and has similar behavior to the Spider AI.

Spider Nest Block.name: Spider Nest Block
Spider Nest Block.desc: Spider Nest Blocks are Hardmode blocks crafted from one Spider Fang and 10 Cobwebs at a Work Bench. They are used to craft Spider furniture and Spider Nest Walls.

Spider Nest Wall.name: Spider Nest Wall
Spider Nest Wall.desc: Spider Nest Walls are a type of wall. As with most placed walls, they are compatible with NPC housing and will prevent enemies from spawning.

Infested Spider Wall.name: Infested Spider Wall
Infested Spider Wall.desc: The Spider Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Spider Nests, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.
Infested Spider Wall.tip: An egg-infested chunk of Spider wall that will spawn spiders

Spider Wall.name: Spider Wall
Spider Wall.desc: The Spider Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Spider Nests, considered unsafe. It does not drop as an item when destroyed and can only be obtained on, via crafting. It is considered a safe wall when placed by the player.

Spiffo Plush.name: Spiffo Plush
Spiffo Plush.desc: The Spiffo Plush is a pet-summoning item that spawns Spiffo to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, Spiffo twirls its tail like a propeller to fly towards them.

Spike Block.name: Spike Block
Spike Block.desc: Spike Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks crafted from Stone Blocks and Spikes at a Work Bench. Their main use is crafting Spike furniture, Sharp Spike Blocks and Spike Walls. With the exception of Sharp Spike Blocks, these do not damage the player.

Spike Wall.name: Spike Wall
Spike Wall.desc: Spike Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Spike Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Spiked Ice Slime Banner.name: Spiked Ice Slime Banner
Spiked Ice Slime Banner.desc: The Spiked Ice Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Ice biome.
Spiked Ice Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Spiked Ice Slime

Spiked Jungle Slime Banner.name: Spiked Jungle Slime Banner
Spiked Jungle Slime Banner.desc: The Spiked Jungle Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Jungle. It fires Jungle Spikes at the player which have a chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff.
Spiked Jungle Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Spiked Jungle Slime

Spiky Ball Trap.name: Spiky Ball Trap
Spiky Ball Trap.desc: The Spiky Ball Trap is a type of trap that can be found naturally in the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door. When activated, it dispenses orange spiky balls that bounce several times. It has a cooldown of 5 / 4 seconds between activations.

Splinterling Banner.name: Splinterling Banner
Splinterling Banner.desc: The Splinterling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 2 of the Pumpkin Moon event. It is one of the only sources of Spooky Wood, the other being the Mourning Wood.
Splinterling Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Splinterling

Honey Absorbant Sponge.name: Honey Absorbant Sponge
Honey Absorbant Sponge.desc: Sponges are tools used to erase liquids by pressing the Left Click button on them. This causes the liquid to disappear from the environment without storing it. There are four different types of sponges:
Honey Absorbant Sponge.tip: Capable of soaking up an endless amount of honey

Lava Absorbant Sponge.name: Lava Absorbant Sponge
Lava Absorbant Sponge.desc: Sponges are tools used to erase liquids by pressing the Left Click button on them. This causes the liquid to disappear from the environment without storing it. There are four different types of sponges:
Lava Absorbant Sponge.tip: Capable of soaking up an endless amount of lava

Super Absorbant Sponge.name: Super Absorbant Sponge
Super Absorbant Sponge.desc: Sponges are tools used to erase liquids by pressing the Left Click button on them. This causes the liquid to disappear from the environment without storing it. There are four different types of sponges:
Super Absorbant Sponge.tip: Capable of soaking up an endless amount of water

Ultra Absorbant Sponge.name: Ultra Absorbant Sponge
Ultra Absorbant Sponge.desc: Sponges are tools used to erase liquids by pressing the Left Click button on them. This causes the liquid to disappear from the environment without storing it. There are four different types of sponges:
Ultra Absorbant Sponge.tip: Capable of soaking up an endless amount of liquid

Spooky Twig.name: Spooky Twig
Spooky Twig.desc: The Spooky Twig is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material used solely for crafting Spooky Wings. It is dropped by the Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.86–20% (5–20%) chance depending on the current wave.

Spooky Wood.name: Spooky Wood
Spooky Wood.desc: Spooky Wood is a type of wood dropped by Splinterlings and Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon event. It is used to craft Halloween-themed furniture and Spooky armor.

drops.amount: 1–3 (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 1–4 (Old-gen console and 3DS versions)1–42–4

Spooky Wood Wall.name: Spooky Wood Wall
Spooky Wood Wall.desc: Spooky Wood Wall is a type of background Wall that resembles Wood Wall in texture, but tinted purple. It can be crafted from Spooky Wood.

Spore Bat Banner.name: Spore Bat Banner
Spore Bat Banner.desc: The Spore Bat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes. It has the same stats as a Cave Bat. However, Spore Bats have a chance to drop a Shroomerang. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff for 30–90 seconds.
Spore Bat Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Spore Bat

Spore Sac.name: Spore Sac
Spore Sac.desc: The Spore Sac is a Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from Plantera's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it continuously spawns multiple floating Spore Traps around the player, which will slowly home in on enemies.
Spore Sac.tip: Summons spores over time that will damage enemies

Spore Skeleton Banner.name: Spore Skeleton Banner
Spore Skeleton Banner.desc: The Spore Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Underground Glowing Mushroom biomes, specficially within the Cavern layer. Its behavior, drops, and statistics are all equivalent to normal Skeletons.
Spore Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Spore Skeleton

Spore Zombie Banner.name: Spore Zombie Banner
Spore Zombie Banner.desc: The Spore Zombie is a zombie variant that only appears on Mushroom Grass above the Surface at any point in the game. It acts the same as normal zombies, slowly walking towards the player to deal contact damage, while attempting to navigate around obstacles.
Spore Zombie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Spore Zombie

Squid Banner.name: Squid Banner
Squid Banner.desc: The Squid is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. When underwater, it attacks by propelling itself towards the player in short bursts. If led out of the water, it will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way.
Squid Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Squid

Squire's Great Helm.name: Squire's Great Helm
Squire's Great Helm.desc: Squire armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Squire's Great Helm, Squire's Plating, and Squire's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Squire's Great Helm.tip: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 and increases your life regeneration

Squire's Greaves.name: Squire's Greaves
Squire's Greaves.desc: Squire armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Squire's Great Helm, Squire's Plating, and Squire's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.
Squire's Greaves.tip: 15% increased summon damage, 15% increased melee critical strike chance and movement speed

Squire's Plating.name: Squire's Plating
Squire's Plating.desc: Squire armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Squire's Great Helm, Squire's Plating, and Squire's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any mechanical boss.

Squire's Shield.name: Squire's Shield
Squire's Shield.desc: The Squire's Shield is a shield accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. It is dropped by the Dark Mage with a 1/4 / 1/2 chance.
Squire's Shield.tip: Increase your max number of sentries by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Squirrel Hook.name: Squirrel Hook
Squirrel Hook.desc: The Squirrel Hook is a pre-Hardmode grappling hook that fires a single hook that reaches 19 tiles, and functions similarly to other hooks with the unique ability to grapple and attach to the trunks of trees and Giant Glowing Mushrooms.
Squirrel Hook.tip: Grapple onto trees like a real squirrel! · 'In the tree, part of the tree' · Press Grapple to launch hook

Red Squirrel.name: Red Squirrel
Red Squirrel.desc: The Squirrel and Red Squirrel are critters that spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Squirrel.name: Squirrel
Squirrel.desc: The Squirrel and Red Squirrel are critters that spawn in the Forest biome. They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree. Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Sroller Banner.name: Sroller Banner
Sroller Banner.desc: The Sroller is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Sroller Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Sroller

Staff of Earth.name: Staff of Earth
Staff of Earth.desc: The Staff of Earth is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires a Boulder that is affected by gravity, bounces off blocks and rolls on the ground, and can pierce enemies five times, before dissipating on the sixth hit.

Staff of Regrowth.name: Staff of Regrowth
Staff of Regrowth.desc: The Staff of Regrowth is a tool that can be found in Ivy Chests as well as Jungle and Bramble Crates. When harvesting blooming stage herbs, it increases the yield of herbs and their seeds.
Staff of Regrowth.tip: Creates grass on dirt · Increases alchemy plant collection when used to gather

Blue Stained Glass.name: Blue Stained Glass
Blue Stained Glass.desc: Stained Glass are a group of walls made from combining gems with Glass Walls. They work like the normal Glass Wall besides changing the color of the sunlight to match that of the stained glass.

Green Stained Glass.name: Green Stained Glass
Green Stained Glass.desc: Stained Glass are a group of walls made from combining gems with Glass Walls. They work like the normal Glass Wall besides changing the color of the sunlight to match that of the stained glass.

Multicolored Stained Glass.name: Multicolored Stained Glass
Multicolored Stained Glass.desc: Stained Glass are a group of walls made from combining gems with Glass Walls. They work like the normal Glass Wall besides changing the color of the sunlight to match that of the stained glass.

Yellow Stained Glass.desc: Stained Glass are a group of walls made from combining gems with Glass Walls. They work like the normal Glass Wall besides changing the color of the sunlight to match that of the stained glass.

Stake.name: Stake
Stake.desc: The Stake Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera repeater that consumes Stakes as ammunition. When used, it fires Stakes that pierce nine enemies, are unaffected by gravity, and have a higher velocity than most arrows.

Stake Launcher.name: Stake Launcher
Stake Launcher.desc: The Stake Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera repeater that consumes Stakes as ammunition. When used, it fires Stakes that pierce nine enemies, are unaffected by gravity, and have a higher velocity than most arrows.

Stalker's Quiver.name: Stalker's Quiver
Stalker's Quiver.desc: The Stalker's Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Magic Quiver and the aggro-reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.
Stalker's Quiver.tip: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Enemies are less likely to target you

Soul Cake.name: Soul Cake
Soul Cake.desc: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24, as long as the closest player does not have full mana.

Star.name: Star
Star.desc: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24, as long as the closest player does not have full mana.

Sugar Plum.name: Sugar Plum
Sugar Plum.desc: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24, as long as the closest player does not have full mana.

Star Anise.name: Star Anise
Star Anise.desc: The Star Anise is a consumable ranged weapon, similar to Shurikens although slightly stronger. 20–40 can drop from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a 6.301% chance in pre-Hardmode and a 5.881% chance in Hardmode.

Star Cannon.name: Star Cannon
Star Cannon.desc: The Star Cannon is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that consumes and fires Fallen Stars. The projectiles are not affected by gravity, pierce an infinite amount of enemies, and dissipate after 60 or upon impact with a block.

Mini Star Cell Banner.name: Mini Star Cell Banner
Mini Star Cell Banner.desc: The Star Cell is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It floats slowly towards the player but can move at a faster rate if the player begins moving away from it.
Mini Star Cell Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Mini Star Cell

Star Cell Banner.name: Star Cell Banner
Star Cell Banner.desc: The Star Cell is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It floats slowly towards the player but can move at a faster rate if the player begins moving away from it.
Star Cell Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Star Cell

Star Cloud.name: Star Cloud
Star Cloud.desc: Star Cloud is a block that functions like the Cloud. It can be crafted or found as the base of Floating Islands on specific secret world seeds. At night, Star Cloud blocks cause purely decorative star particles to shoot off above them. It glows in the dark when placed.

Star Hairpin.name: Star Hairpin
Star Hairpin.desc: The Star Hairpin is a vanity item that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for. It is worn in the helmet slot.

Star in a Bottle.name: Star in a Bottle
Star in a Bottle.desc: The Star in a Bottle is a functional lantern that grants the Star in a Bottle buff, providing mana regeneration of 5 mana per second to all players within a.
Star in a Bottle.tip: Increases mana regeneration when placed nearby

Star Princess Crown.name: Star Princess Crown
Star Princess Crown.desc: The Star Princess set is a vanity set consisting of the Star Princess Crown and Star Princess Dress.

Star Princess Dress.name: Star Princess Dress
Star Princess Dress.desc: The Star Princess set is a vanity set consisting of the Star Princess Crown and Star Princess Dress.

Star Royale Brick.name: Star Royale Brick
Star Royale Brick.desc: Star Royale Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Waxing Crescent.

Star Royale Brick Wall.name: Star Royale Brick Wall
Star Royale Brick Wall.desc: Star Royale Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Star Royale Bricks.

Starcrash.name: Starcrash
Starcrash.desc: The Starcrash is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 30% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Starcrash.tip: 2 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with primed energy · Meteorites fall on primed enemies hit by summons

Stardrop.name: Stardrop
Stardrop.desc: The Stardrop is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Junimo that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Junimo twirls the leaf on its head like a propeller to fly after them.
Stardrop.tip: Summons a Junimo · 'A mysterious fruit from another world. The flavor is like a dream...'

Stardust Helmet.name: Stardust Helmet
Stardust Helmet.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Stardust Fragments.
Stardust Helmet.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases your max number of sentries by 1 · Increases summon damage by 22%

Stardust Leggings.name: Stardust Leggings
Stardust Leggings.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Stardust Fragments.
Stardust Leggings.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Increases summon damage by 22% · Increases whip range by 15%

Stardust Plate.name: Stardust Plate
Stardust Plate.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Stardust Fragments.
Stardust Plate.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Increases summon damage by 22% · Increases whip range by 15%

Stardust Brick.name: Stardust Brick
Stardust Brick.desc: The Stardust Brick is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist brick that is crafted from Stardust Fragments. It is one of the four Fragment Bricks, bricks which are crafted with Lunar Fragments. It glows when placed and can be used to craft Stardust furniture.

Stardust Brick Wall.name: Stardust Brick Wall
Stardust Brick Wall.desc: Stardust Brick Wall is a background wall made from Stardust Bricks.

Stardust Fragment Block.name: Stardust Fragment Block
Stardust Fragment Block.desc: Stardust Fragment Blocks are blocks made from Stardust Fragments which are dropped by the Stardust Pillar. The blocks have a crystal-like appearance with intense shades of blue and yellow. They can be crafted at the Ancient Manipulator. Walls cannot be crafted with them.

Stargazer Banner.name: Stargazer Banner
Stargazer Banner.desc: The Stargazer is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Stargazer Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Stargazer

Static Hook.name: Static Hook
Static Hook.desc: The Static Hook is a Hardmode grappling hook that fires up to two hooks which can be launched simultaneously, reaching up to 37.5 tiles (the longest reach of any hook). The Static Hook can be purchased from the Steampunker for.

Steak.name: Steak
Steak.desc: The Steak is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Steak has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by The Possessed, and a 1/10 chance of being dropped by Undead Miners.
Steak.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'Well done with ketchup!'

Steampunk Boiler.name: Steampunk Boiler
Steampunk Boiler.desc: The Steampunk Boiler is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Steampunk furniture out of Cogs. The Steampunk Boiler can be purchased from the Steampunker for, once the Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds/Brain of Cthulhu and Skeletron have been defeated.

Steampunk Goggles.name: Steampunk Goggles
Steampunk Goggles.desc: The Steampunk Goggles are a vanity item sold from the Steampunker for during the Halloween seasonal event.

Steampunk Hat.name: Steampunk Hat
Steampunk Hat.desc: The Steampunk set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Steampunk Hat, Steampunk Shirt, and Steampunk Pants. It is purchased from the Steampunker for, during the full and waning moon phases.

Steampunk Pants.name: Steampunk Pants
Steampunk Pants.desc: The Steampunk set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Steampunk Hat, Steampunk Shirt, and Steampunk Pants. It is purchased from the Steampunker for, during the full and waning moon phases.

Steampunk Shirt.name: Steampunk Shirt
Steampunk Shirt.desc: The Steampunk set is a Hardmode vanity set which consists of the Steampunk Hat, Steampunk Shirt, and Steampunk Pants. It is purchased from the Steampunker for, during the full and waning moon phases.

Sticky Bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
Sticky Bomb.desc: The Sticky Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.
Sticky Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will destroy most tiles · 'Tossing may be difficult.'

Sticky Dirt Bomb.name: Sticky Dirt Bomb
Sticky Dirt Bomb.desc: The Sticky Dirt Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Dirt Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.
Sticky Dirt Bomb.tip: A small explosion that will spread dirt · 'Tossing may be difficult.'

Sticky Dynamite.name: Sticky Dynamite
Sticky Dynamite.desc: Sticky Dynamite is an explosive that functions like Dynamite, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.
Sticky Dynamite.tip: A large explosion that will destroy most tiles · 'Tossing may be difficult.'

Sticky Glowstick.name: Sticky Glowstick
Sticky Glowstick.desc: The Sticky Glowstick is a consumable light source that behaves identically to the standard Glowstick, but sticks to any surface on contact, rather than ricocheting or rolling. After being thrown, a Sticky Glowstick will emit light for 5 minutes and expire afterward.

Sticky Grenade.name: Sticky Grenade
Sticky Grenade.desc: The Sticky Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon. It can be made by combining Grenades with Gel. Like the Sticky Bomb, it will not roll, and will instead stick to the first block it touches until it explodes.
Sticky Grenade.tip: A small explosion that will not destroy tiles · 'Tossing may be difficult.'

Sticky Power Bomb.name: Sticky Power Bomb
Sticky Power Bomb.desc: The Sticky Power Bomb is a Hardmode explosive that functions like the Power Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.
Sticky Power Bomb.tip: A large explosion that will destroy most tiles · Can destroy hardmode ores · 'Tossing may be difficult.'

Stinger Necklace.name: Stinger Necklace
Stinger Necklace.desc: The Stinger Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtainable after defeating the Queen Bee.
Stinger Necklace.tip: Increases armor penetration by 5 · Releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged

Stinkbug.name: Stinkbug
Stinkbug.desc: The Stinkbug is a harmless critter which spawns on the surface.

Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker.name: Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker
Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker.desc: The Stinkbug Blocker and Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker are furniture items. When placed in a valid house, they will prevent NPCs from moving in.
Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker.tip: When placed in a home, prevents villagers from moving in · Only visible with Echo Sight · 'Smells like expired cilantro'

Stinkbug Blocker.name: Stinkbug Blocker
Stinkbug Blocker.desc: The Stinkbug Blocker and Ghostly Stinkbug Blocker are furniture items. When placed in a valid house, they will prevent NPCs from moving in.
Stinkbug Blocker.tip: When placed in a home, prevents villagers from moving in · 'Smells like cilantro'

Stinkfish.name: Stinkfish
Stinkfish.desc: Stinkfish are a type of fish which are found rarely by fishing in any biome in the Underground layer or below, with the exception of The Corruption, The Hallow and the Desert. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Stink Potions.

Stockade Crate.name: Stockade Crate
Stockade Crate.desc: The Stockade Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in the Dungeon after Skeletron has been defeated.
Stockade Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Stone Accent Slab.name: Stone Accent Slab
Stone Accent Slab.desc: The Stone Accent Slab is a block which is visually identical to the Stone Slab, except that it does not blend with any blocks other than itself and Smooth Marble Blocks.
Stone Accent Slab.tip: A Stone Slab variant that merges differently with nearby blocks · Favored by advanced builders

Stone Slab.name: Stone Slab
Stone Slab.desc: The Stone Slab is a block similar in appearance to regular stone, but smoother, and the texture is made up of much larger bricks. It is extremely easy to produce, although it requires a Heavy Assembler which cannot easily be obtained very early on.

Stone Slab Wall.name: Stone Slab Wall
Stone Slab Wall.desc: Stone Slab Wall is a background wall that can be used for housings.

Stone Wall.name: Stone Wall
Stone Wall.desc: Stone Wall is a background wall made from Stone Blocks. Like other walls, it stops enemies from spawning when it is placed and can be used for houses.

Storm Diver Banner.name: Storm Diver Banner
Storm Diver Banner.desc: The Storm Diver is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. Storm Divers wield a type of ranged weapon that is able to fire tight spreads of projectiles, similar to the Tactical Shotgun.
Storm Diver Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Storm Diver

Storm Spear.name: Storm Spear
Storm Spear.desc: The Storm Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.

Strange Brew.name: Strange Brew
Strange Brew.desc: The Strange Brew is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for. When used, it restores 70–120 health, inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness, and has a 60/100 chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility.
Strange Brew.tip: Side Effects May Include: · -Unpredictable Healing · -Inconsistent Potion Sickness · -Brief Periods of Inexplicable Invulnerability · 'It looks and smells terrible'

Strange Glowing Mushroom.name: Strange Glowing Mushroom
Strange Glowing Mushroom.desc: The Strange Glowing Mushroom is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Truffle that follows the player. The Baby Truffle emits a small amount of blue light similar to Glowing Mushrooms. The Strange Glowing Mushroom can be purchased from the Truffle for.

Strange Plant.name: Strange Plant
Strange Plant.desc: Strange Plants are Hardmode quest plant items that can be turned in to the Dye Trader by selecting the LegacyInterface.107 option in his dialogue window. In return, he rewards the player with six vials of one random special exclusive dye per plant.
Strange Plant.tip: Can be traded for rare dyes

Blue Streamer.name: Blue Streamer
Blue Streamer.desc: Streamers are placeable items that can be climbed on for mobility. They are available in three different colors: Blue Streamer, Green Streamer, and Pink Streamer. These are all functionally identical and can be purchased for each from the Party Girl during a Party.

Green Streamer.desc: Streamers are placeable items that can be climbed on for mobility. They are available in three different colors: Blue Streamer, Green Streamer, and Pink Streamer. These are all functionally identical and can be purchased for each from the Party Girl during a Party.

Stress Ball.name: Stress Ball
Stress Ball.desc: The Stress Ball is an accessory that has a 1/100 chance to be dropped by Hoplites. When equipped, while not moving and with the inventory closed, the player will automatically and continuously use the weapon or tool that they are holding.
Stress Ball.tip: Continuously use some items when not moving · Not functional when inventory is open

Stylish Scissors.name: Stylish Scissors
Stylish Scissors.desc: The Stylish Scissors are a pre-Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/8 chance of being dropped by the Stylist. Letting go of Left Click while swinging the weapon will throw the scissors in the direction of the cursor.

Stynger Bolt.name: Stynger Bolt
Stynger Bolt.desc: The Stynger is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that consumes Stynger Bolts as ammunition. When used, it fires high-velocity Stynger Bolts that explode upon contact with enemies or blocks.

Sugar Cookie.name: Sugar Cookie
Sugar Cookie.desc: The Sugar Cookie is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. The Sugar Cookie can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 3.601% in pre-Hardmode and 3.361% in Hardmode.
Sugar Cookie.tip: Major improvements to all stats · 'You'll bounce off the walls!'

Summer Hat.name: Summer Hat
Summer Hat.desc: The Summer Hat is a vanity item equipped in the Social Helmet Slot. It is purchased from the Clothier for, when he is spoken to during the day outside of a Graveyard.

Sun Mask.name: Sun Mask
Sun Mask.desc: The Sun Mask is a vanity helmet dropped by Lamias in normal Underground Deserts with a 1/25 chance.

Sun Stone.name: Sun Stone
Sun Stone.desc: The Sun Stone is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory which has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Moon Stone; however, these bonuses only activate during the day.
Sun Stone.tip: During daytime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

Sunflower.name: Sunflower
Sunflower.desc: The Sunflower is a large, tall plant which can be found growing naturally on grass, and can be broken with a pickaxe or drill, or by coming into contact with water.

Sunglasses.name: Sunglasses
Sunglasses.desc: The Sunglasses are a vanity item equipped in the social helmet slot. While equipped, the sun in the background will change to its pre-1.2 variant wearing sunglasses as well. Cattiva will also appear wearing sunglasses when equipped.

Super Dart Trap.name: Super Dart Trap
Super Dart Trap.desc: The Super Dart Trap is a trap found inside the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door. It fires a dart when activated via Wire, which costs no ammunition, but has a cooldown period of 3.33 seconds / 3 seconds between firings.

Superheated Blood.name: Superheated Blood
Superheated Blood.desc: The Superheated Blood is a mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Lava Shark Mount. The Superheated Blood has a 19/100 chance of being obtained from Obsidian Crates or Hellstone Crates found by fishing in lava.
Superheated Blood.tip: Summons a rideable lava shark mount · 'Bloody hell!'

Superhero Costume.name: Superhero Costume
Superhero Costume.desc: The Superhero set is a vanity set which consists of the Superhero Mask, the Superhero Costume, and the Superhero Tights.

Superhero Mask.name: Superhero Mask
Superhero Mask.desc: The Superhero set is a vanity set which consists of the Superhero Mask, the Superhero Costume, and the Superhero Tights.

Superhero Tights.name: Superhero Tights
Superhero Tights.desc: The Superhero set is a vanity set which consists of the Superhero Mask, the Superhero Costume, and the Superhero Tights.

Suspicious Grinning Eye.name: Suspicious Grinning Eye
Suspicious Grinning Eye.desc: The Suspicious Grinning Eye is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Suspicious Eye, a miniature version of the Eye of Cthulhu, that follows the player.
Suspicious Grinning Eye.tip: Summons a suspicious eye · 'Seems to have lost its look.'

Suspicious Looking Eye.name: Suspicious Looking Eye
Suspicious Looking Eye.desc: The Suspicious Looking Eye is a boss-summoning item that summons the Eye of Cthulhu when used. It can be used in any biome, but only at night.

Suspicious Looking Tentacle.name: Suspicious Looking Tentacle
Suspicious Looking Tentacle.desc: The Suspicious Looking Tentacle is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord light pet-summoning item that spawns the Suspicious Looking Eye, a small tentacled floating eye that provides cyan light and follows the player.
Suspicious Looking Tentacle.tip: Calls upon a suspicious looking eye to provide light · 'I know what you're thinking....'

Swamp Thing Banner.name: Swamp Thing Banner
Swamp Thing Banner.desc: The Swamp Thing is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. He moves very fast and occasionally stops in place.
Swamp Thing Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Swamp Thing

Swarm Grenade.name: Swarm Grenade
Swarm Grenade.desc: The Swarm Grenade is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Swarm Biter that follows the player. When the player moves too far away, the Swarm Biter will disappear and emits a small puff of pink smoke.
Swarm Grenade.tip: Summons a pet swarm biter · 'Careful, I hear they bite!'

SWAT Helmet.name: SWAT Helmet
SWAT Helmet.desc: The SWAT Helmet is a vanity item that has a 1/12 / 23/144 chance to drop from Tactical Skeletons in the post-Plantera Dungeon.

Sweet Barb.name: Sweet Barb
Sweet Barb.desc: The Sweet Barb is a pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it releases 1–3 homing Bee projectiles that attack nearby enemies each time the player takes damage, and grants the Honey buff for 5 seconds after being damaged.
Sweet Barb.tip: Releases bees and douses the user in honey when damaged · Arrows inflict poison, and hits may release bees!

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.desc: The Switch is an activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for 20 silver. It can also be found in the Dungeon connected to Chain Lanterns, where it can be harvested with a Pickaxe or Drill.
Switch.tip: Right click when placed to signal

Swordfish.name: Swordfish
Swordfish.desc: The Swordfish is a pre-Hardmode spear obtainable through fishing in the Ocean biome.

Aetherium Table.name: Aetherium Table
Aetherium Table.desc: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs. All variants fulfill a house's table requirement.

Tablet Fragment.name: Tablet Fragment
Tablet Fragment.desc: The Tablet Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist pet-summoning item that spawns a Phantasmal Dragon that follows the player.
Tablet Fragment.tip: Summons a baby phantasmal dragon · 'Contains a fragment of Phantasm energy.'

Tackle Box.name: Tackle Box
Tackle Box.desc: The Tackle Box is an accessory that decreases the chance of bait consumption while fishing.

Tactical Skeleton Banner.name: Tactical Skeleton Banner
Tactical Skeleton Banner.desc: The Tactical Skeleton is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Once the player is within its line of sight, the Tactical Skeleton remains stationary before firing spreads of four bullets at them that deal immense damage.
Tactical Skeleton Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Tactical Skeleton

Tall Gate.name: Tall Gate
Tall Gate.desc: The Tall Gate is a furniture item which is essentially a tall, sliding door that can be opened and closed by pressing Right Click on it. Tall Gate fulfills a house's door requirement.

Tally Counter.name: Tally Counter
Tally Counter.desc: The Tally Counter is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that displays the number of enemies of a specific type that have been killed. The Tally Counter will first display "GameUI.NoKillCount" underneath the minimap.
Tally Counter.tip: Displays how many monsters have been killed

Tam O' Shanter.name: Tam O' Shanter
Tam O' Shanter.desc: The Tam O' Shanter is a Hardmode vanity item purchased from the Clothier for, during the third quarter moon phase.

Tattered Bee Wing.name: Tattered Bee Wing
Tattered Bee Wing.desc: The Tattered Bee Wing is a rare Hardmode crafting material dropped by Moss Hornets with a 1/100 / 1/150 chance. It is used solely to craft Bee Wings.

drops.chance: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1% / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 0.67%

Tattered Wood Sign.name: Tattered Wood Sign
Tattered Wood Sign.desc: The Tattered Wood Sign is a placeable item that functions like the regular Sign. It can be crafted from wood when the player is near a Work Bench in the Graveyard mini-biome.

Tax Collector's Hat.name: Tax Collector's Hat
Tax Collector's Hat.desc: The Tax Collector's set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tax Collector's Hat, the Tax Collector's Suit and the Tax Collector's Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for when the Tax Collector is present in the world.

Tax Collector's Pants.name: Tax Collector's Pants
Tax Collector's Pants.desc: The Tax Collector's set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tax Collector's Hat, the Tax Collector's Suit and the Tax Collector's Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for when the Tax Collector is present in the world.

Tax Collector's Suit.name: Tax Collector's Suit
Tax Collector's Suit.desc: The Tax Collector's set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tax Collector's Hat, the Tax Collector's Suit and the Tax Collector's Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for when the Tax Collector is present in the world.

Teacup.name: Teacup
Teacup.desc: The Teacup is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Teacup.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'A must-have for tea parties'

Teal Mushroom.name: Teal Mushroom
Teal Mushroom.desc: The Teal Mushroom is a type of mushroom. It grows on Dirt, Stone, Mud, or regular Jungle grass in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Teal Dye.

Blue Team Block.name: Blue Team Block
Blue Team Block.desc: Team Blocks are decorative blocks purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. Team Blocks are available in six different colors, each representing one of the six team colors selectable in the player's inventory, including white for the neutral team.

Team Dye.name: Team Dye
Team Dye.desc: Team Dye is a dye that can be purchased from the Dye Trader while playing multiplayer. The color of this dye will correspond to the team the player is on; if the player is not on a team, it acts as though no dye was equipped.

Blue Team Platform.name: Blue Team Platform
Blue Team Platform.desc: Team Platforms are decorative platforms purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. They are available in six different colors, each representing one of the six team colors selectable in the player's inventory, including white for the neutral team.

Green Team Platform.name: Green Team Platform
Green Team Platform.desc: Team Platforms are decorative platforms purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. They are available in six different colors, each representing one of the six team colors selectable in the player's inventory, including white for the neutral team.

Pink Team Platform.desc: Team Platforms are decorative platforms purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. They are available in six different colors, each representing one of the six team colors selectable in the player's inventory, including white for the neutral team.

Yellow Team Platform.desc: Team Platforms are decorative platforms purchased from the Traveling Merchant for each. They are available in six different colors, each representing one of the six team colors selectable in the player's inventory, including white for the neutral team.

Teleporter.name: Teleporter
Teleporter.desc: The Teleporter is a travel mechanism purchased from the Mechanic / Steampunker for. When two Teleporters are wired together with a triggering mechanism, they can exchange players, NPCs, and most enemies between them.
Teleporter.tip: Transports creatures to a connected teleporter when signalled

Tempest Staff.name: Tempest Staff
Tempest Staff.desc: The Tempest Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Sharknado minion. It hovers near enemies, dealing contact damage and firing Mini Sharkron projectiles that visually splatter upon contact with enemies or blocks.
Tempest Staff.tip: Summons sharknados to fight for you

Templar's Sling.name: Templar's Sling
Templar's Sling.desc: The Templar's Sling is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Templar's Sling.tip: Walk past a sentry to carry it · 10% increased sentry critical strike chance

Temple Key.name: Temple Key
Temple Key.desc: The Temple Key is dropped by Plantera and is used to unlock the Lihzahrd Door, the door to the Jungle Temple. It is consumed upon use, like Golden Keys.

Tendon Bow.name: Tendon Bow
Tendon Bow.desc: The Tendon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tentacle Spike.name: Tentacle Spike
Tentacle Spike.desc: The Tentacle Spike is a pre-Hardmode broadsword dropped by Eaters of Souls, Devourers, Crimeras, Face Monsters, and Blood Crawlers with a 1/525 chance. When swung, it sticks tentacle spikes into enemies on hit, which linger on the enemy and deal 3 damage per second for 9 seconds.
Tentacle Spike.tip: Embeds damaging spikes in enemies · 'Never grab the pointy end.'

Terraformer.name: Terraformer
Terraformer.desc: The Terraformer is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord tool. It has the same effects as a Clentaminator but reaches 95 tiles and has a width of 7 tiles and has a 1/3 chance not to consume ammunition, compared to the Clentaminator which reaches 60 tiles and has a width of 5 tiles.
Terraformer.tip: Creates and destroys biomes when sprayed · Uses colored solution · 33% chance to save ammo

Terraprisma.name: Terraprisma
Terraprisma.desc: The Terraprisma is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Terraprisma minion. It flies towards enemies, performing a quick stab before repeatedly attacking with a swinging or stabbing motion.
Terraprisma.tip: Summons an Enchanted Sword to fight for you

Martian Tesla Turret Banner.name: Martian Tesla Turret Banner
Martian Tesla Turret Banner.desc: The Tesla Turret is a Hardmode enemy found only during the Martian Madness event. It is built by Martian Engineers and is completely immobile. Every three seconds, it will fire an Electric Bolt at the player, which has a 2/3 chance to inflict the Electrified debuff for 5 seconds.
Martian Tesla Turret Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Tesla Turret

The Beheaded's Cuirass.name: The Beheaded's Cuirass
The Beheaded's Cuirass.desc: The Beheaded's set is a vanity set consisting of The Beheaded's Head, The Beheaded's Cuirass, and The Beheaded's Trousers.

The Beheaded's Head.name: The Beheaded's Head
The Beheaded's Head.desc: The Beheaded's set is a vanity set consisting of The Beheaded's Head, The Beheaded's Cuirass, and The Beheaded's Trousers.
The Beheaded's Head.tip: 'A mysterious dark cloud, with what appears to be a glowing crystal within...'

The Beheaded's Trousers.name: The Beheaded's Trousers
The Beheaded's Trousers.desc: The Beheaded's set is a vanity set consisting of The Beheaded's Head, The Beheaded's Cuirass, and The Beheaded's Trousers.

The Black Spot.name: The Black Spot
The Black Spot.desc: The Black Spot is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that spawns a rideable Pirate Ship Mount which can fly infinitely. The Black Spot has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Flying Dutchman in Master Mode.
The Black Spot.tip: Summons the Black Spot mount · 'Arrr! This be mutiny!'

The Breaker.name: The Breaker
The Breaker.desc: The Breaker is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

The Bride Banner.name: The Bride Banner
The Bride Banner.desc: The Bride is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns rarely during a Blood Moon or very rarely at any time in a Graveyard biome. She acts the same as regular Zombies.
The Bride Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: The Bride

The Dirtiest Block.name: The Dirtiest Block
The Dirtiest Block.desc: The Dirtiest Block is a pet-summoning item that spawns The Dirtiest Block that follows the player. It can be found extremely rarely as a block that looks identical to Dirt Blocks.

The Doctor's Pants.name: The Doctor's Pants
The Doctor's Pants.desc: The Doctor's set is a vanity set which consists of The Doctor's Shirt and The Doctor's Pants. They are purchased from the Clothier for in total, during Waning Gibbous.

The Doctor's Shirt.name: The Doctor's Shirt
The Doctor's Shirt.desc: The Doctor's set is a vanity set which consists of The Doctor's Shirt and The Doctor's Pants. They are purchased from the Clothier for in total, during Waning Gibbous.

The Eye of Cthulhu.name: The Eye of Cthulhu
The Eye of Cthulhu.desc: The Eye of Cthulhu is a Hardmode, post-Plantera yoyo that has a 1/3 / 5/9 chance of being dropped by Mothrons during a Solar Eclipse.
The Eye of Cthulhu.tip: Hits with the power of the Eye of Cthulhu

The Grand Design.name: The Grand Design
The Grand Design.desc: The Grand Design is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron tool for working with wiring and mechanisms.
The Grand Design.tip: Allows ultimate control over wires! · Right click while holding to edit wire settings

The Groom Banner.name: The Groom Banner
The Groom Banner.desc: The Groom is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns rarely during a Blood Moon or very rarely at any time in a Graveyard biome. He acts the same as regular Zombies.
The Groom Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: The Groom

The Imploder.name: The Imploder
The Imploder.desc: The Imploder is an unimplemented item. Apart from a unique tooltip, no stats or behaviors exist for this item.

The Plan.name: The Plan
The Plan.desc: The Plan is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Slow and Confused debuffs.
The Plan.tip: Grants immunity to Slow and Confusion

The Possessed Banner.name: The Possessed Banner
The Possessed Banner.desc: The Possessed is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Despite not resembling one, she acts similarly to spider-type enemies, climbing on background walls when able to and walking on the ground at all other times.
The Possessed Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: The Possessed

Thin Ice.name: Thin Ice
Thin Ice.desc: Thin Ice is a type of block found in the Snow and Ice biomes. It is found naturally in two configurations: either as a single layer over a pool of water, or in large packed regions underground.
Thin Ice.tip: Breaks when fallen on · 'Watch your step'

Thorn Chakram.name: Thorn Chakram
Thorn Chakram.desc: The Thorn Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not necessarily return immediately upon contact with objects, but instead can bounce off blocks before returning. The Thorn Chakram has a 1/2 chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff.

Black Thread.name: Black Thread
Black Thread.desc: Threads are crafting materials used primarily in vanity items. Black Thread and Pink Thread can be purchased from the Clothier, while Green Thread can be crafted.

Green Thread.name: Green Thread
Green Thread.desc: Threads are crafting materials used primarily in vanity items. Black Thread and Pink Thread can be purchased from the Clothier, while Green Thread can be crafted.

Pink Thread.name: Pink Thread
Pink Thread.desc: Threads are crafting materials used primarily in vanity items. Black Thread and Pink Thread can be purchased from the Clothier, while Green Thread can be crafted.

Throne.name: Throne
Throne.desc: The Throne is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house's chair requirement.

Blood Water.name: Blood Water
Blood Water.desc: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown.
Blood Water.tip: Spreads the Crimson to some blocks

Unholy Water.name: Unholy Water
Unholy Water.desc: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown.
Unholy Water.tip: Spreads the Corruption to some blocks

Tiger Climbing Gear.name: Tiger Climbing Gear
Tiger Climbing Gear.desc: Tiger Climbing Gear is an accessory that allows for sliding down or completely stopping while touching walls. Holding the Down key while clinging to a wall allows the player to slide down walls a little faster than if they only had one of the ingredient accessories.
Tiger Climbing Gear.tip: Allows the ability to climb walls

Tiki Mask.name: Tiki Mask
Tiki Mask.desc: Tiki armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Tiki Mask, Tiki Shirt, and Tiki Pants. The set can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for a total of.
Tiki Mask.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10% · Increases whip range by 10%

Tiki Pants.name: Tiki Pants
Tiki Pants.desc: Tiki armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Tiki Mask, Tiki Shirt, and Tiki Pants. The set can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for a total of.
Tiki Pants.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Tiki Shirt.name: Tiki Shirt
Tiki Shirt.desc: Tiki armor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Tiki Mask, Tiki Shirt, and Tiki Pants. The set can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for a total of.
Tiki Shirt.tip: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases summon damage by 10%

Tiki Torch.name: Tiki Torch
Tiki Torch.desc: The Tiki Torch is a stationary light source that must be placed in order to provide light. Like Torches, it can be placed on platforms, and will be put out, broken and subsequently dropped when coming into contact with water.

Tiki Totem.name: Tiki Totem
Tiki Totem.desc: The Tiki Totem is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Tiki Spirit that floats and spins above the player's head. Unlike most pets, it will not teleport to the player when the player moves too quickly for it to keep up; it will simply float straight towards the player.

Tim Banner.name: Tim Banner
Tim Banner.desc: Tim is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy found in the lower Cavern layer. With an appearance similar to Dark Casters, he can be distinguished by his Wizard Hat, which is guaranteed to drop when he is defeated.
Tim Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Tim

Timeless Traveler's Cloak.name: Timeless Traveler's Cloak
Timeless Traveler's Cloak.desc: The Timeless Traveler's set is a vanity set consisting of the Timeless Traveler's Hood, the Timeless Traveler's Cloak, and the Timeless Traveler's Footwear.
Timeless Traveler's Cloak.tip: '...Despite the journey's bygone end...' · Concept by DisRicardo

Timeless Traveler's Footwear.name: Timeless Traveler's Footwear
Timeless Traveler's Footwear.desc: The Timeless Traveler's set is a vanity set consisting of the Timeless Traveler's Hood, the Timeless Traveler's Cloak, and the Timeless Traveler's Footwear.
Timeless Traveler's Footwear.tip: '...And passing of aeons!' · Concept by DisRicardo

Timeless Traveler's Hood.name: Timeless Traveler's Hood
Timeless Traveler's Hood.desc: The Timeless Traveler's set is a vanity set consisting of the Timeless Traveler's Hood, the Timeless Traveler's Cloak, and the Timeless Traveler's Footwear.
Timeless Traveler's Hood.tip: 'May time itself with gentle hands' · 'Guide you, who travel on...' · Concept by DisRicardo

1 Second Timer.name: 1 Second Timer
1 Second Timer.desc: Timers are triggering mechanisms that periodically send an activation signal to other mechanisms.

1/2 Second Timer.name: 1/2 Second Timer
1/2 Second Timer.desc: Timers are triggering mechanisms that periodically send an activation signal to other mechanisms.
1/2 Second Timer.tip: Signals every half of a second

1/4 Second Timer.name: 1/4 Second Timer
1/4 Second Timer.desc: Timers are triggering mechanisms that periodically send an activation signal to other mechanisms.
1/4 Second Timer.tip: Signals every fourth of a second

3 Second Timer.name: 3 Second Timer
3 Second Timer.desc: Timers are triggering mechanisms that periodically send an activation signal to other mechanisms.

5 Second Timer.name: 5 Second Timer
5 Second Timer.desc: Timers are triggering mechanisms that periodically send an activation signal to other mechanisms.

Tin Chainmail.name: Tin Chainmail
Tin Chainmail.desc: Tin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tin Helmet, Tin Chainmail, and Tin Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Tin Bars (144 Tin Ore). The full set grants 7 defense while equipped.

Tin Greaves.name: Tin Greaves
Tin Greaves.desc: Tin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tin Helmet, Tin Chainmail, and Tin Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Tin Bars (144 Tin Ore). The full set grants 7 defense while equipped.

Tin Helmet.name: Tin Helmet
Tin Helmet.desc: Tin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tin Helmet, Tin Chainmail, and Tin Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Tin Bars (144 Tin Ore). The full set grants 7 defense while equipped.

Tin Axe.name: Tin Axe
Tin Axe.desc: The Tin Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Tin Bar.name: Tin Bar
Tin Bar.desc: The Tin Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Tin Bow.name: Tin Bow
Tin Bow.desc: The Tin Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tin Brick.name: Tin Brick
Tin Brick.desc: Tin Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material made from Tin Ore. In some worlds it can also be harvested from Jungle Shrines. Like the ore it is made of, placed Tin Bricks will sparkle.

Tin Brick Wall.name: Tin Brick Wall
Tin Brick Wall.desc: The Tin Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds. It drops as an item when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting. It is always considered a safe wall.

Tin Broadsword.name: Tin Broadsword
Tin Broadsword.desc: The Tin Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Tin Hammer.name: Tin Hammer
Tin Hammer.desc: The Tin Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Tin Ore.name: Tin Ore
Tin Ore.desc: Tin Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Tin Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Tin Pickaxe.name: Tin Pickaxe
Tin Pickaxe.desc: The Tin Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite.

Tin Plating.name: Tin Plating
Tin Plating.desc: Tin Plating is a pre-Hardmode brick.

Tin Plating Wall.name: Tin Plating Wall
Tin Plating Wall.desc: Tin Plating Wall is a background wall made of Tin Plating.

Tin Shortsword.name: Tin Shortsword
Tin Shortsword.desc: The Tin Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Titan Glove.name: Titan Glove
Titan Glove.desc: The Titan Glove is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by Mimics. While equipped, it grants the following effects:
Titan Glove.tip: Increases melee knockback · Increases the size of melee weapons

Titanium Breastplate.name: Titanium Breastplate
Titanium Breastplate.desc: Titanium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Titanium Breastplate and Titanium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Titanium Mask, Titanium Helmet, and Titanium Headgear, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Titanium Breastplate.tip: 4% increased damage · 3% increased critical strike chance

Titanium Headgear.name: Titanium Headgear
Titanium Headgear.desc: Titanium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Titanium Breastplate and Titanium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Titanium Mask, Titanium Helmet, and Titanium Headgear, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Titanium Headgear.tip: 16% increased magic damage and 7% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases maximum mana by 100

Titanium Helmet.name: Titanium Helmet
Titanium Helmet.desc: Titanium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Titanium Breastplate and Titanium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Titanium Mask, Titanium Helmet, and Titanium Headgear, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Titanium Helmet.tip: 16% increased ranged damage · 7% increased ranged critical strike chance

Titanium Leggings.name: Titanium Leggings
Titanium Leggings.desc: Titanium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Titanium Breastplate and Titanium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Titanium Mask, Titanium Helmet, and Titanium Headgear, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Titanium Leggings.tip: 3% increased damage and critical strike chance · 6% increased movement speed

Titanium Mask.name: Titanium Mask
Titanium Mask.desc: Titanium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Titanium Breastplate and Titanium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Titanium Mask, Titanium Helmet, and Titanium Headgear, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
Titanium Mask.tip: 9% increased melee damage and critical strike chance · 9% increased melee speed

Titanium Chainsaw.name: Titanium Chainsaw
Titanium Chainsaw.desc: The Titanium Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Titanium Waraxe.

Titanium Crate.name: Titanium Crate
Titanium Crate.desc: The Titanium Crate is a Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any layer. It is the highest tier of standard crate, having the greatest value if sold directly. Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Golden Crate.
Titanium Crate.tip: 12x9px|link=Desktop version history|Desktop version Right click to open / · 13x10px|link=Console version|Console version L2 to open (class=blackwhite-icon|15x11px|link=Console version|PlayStation) / · LT to open (12x12px|link=Console version|Xbox One) / · ZL to open (14x14px|link=Switch version|Nintendo Switch) / · 9x12px|link=Mobile version|Mobile version Double tap to open

Titanium Drill.name: Titanium Drill
Titanium Drill.desc: The Titanium Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Titanium Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Titanium Pickaxe.name: Titanium Pickaxe
Titanium Pickaxe.desc: The Titanium Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Titanium Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.

Titanium Repeater.name: Titanium Repeater
Titanium Repeater.desc: The Titanium Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Titanium Sword.name: Titanium Sword
Titanium Sword.desc: The Titanium Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Titanium Trident.name: Titanium Trident
Titanium Trident.desc: The Titanium Trident is a Hardmode spear.

Titanium Waraxe.name: Titanium Waraxe
Titanium Waraxe.desc: The Titanium Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Titanium Chainsaw.

Titanstone Block.name: Titanstone Block
Titanstone Block.desc: The Titanstone Block is a Hardmode brick.

Titanstone Block Wall.name: Titanstone Block Wall
Titanstone Block Wall.desc: Titanstone Block Wall is a wall made from Titanstone Blocks.

TNT Barrel.name: TNT Barrel
TNT Barrel.desc: The TNT Barrel is a trap which explodes immediately when destroyed, or hit by virtually any weapon or tool.

Aetherium Toilet.name: Aetherium Toilet
Aetherium Toilet.desc: Toilets are furniture items which can be placed on the ground. They are functionally similar to chairs, and fulfill a house's chair requirement. Similarly to chairs, Toilets can be sat on by pressing the Right Click button on them.

Tomb Crawler Banner.name: Tomb Crawler Banner
Tomb Crawler Banner.desc: The Tomb Crawler is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy found in the Underground Desert. Following the same AI pattern as Giant Worms, it moves through solid blocks to attack the player by charging. The sound of its burrowing grows louder and faster as it draws near.
Tomb Crawler Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Tomb Crawler

Tome of Infinite Wisdom.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
Tome of Infinite Wisdom.desc: The Tome of Infinite Wisdom is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss wand that possesses two different modes of attack. When used with Left Click, it fires bursts of four high-velocity pages that dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks.
Tome of Infinite Wisdom.tip: Gotta wonder who stuck a tome of infinite wisdom on a stick... · Right click to cast a powerful tornado

Toolbelt.name: Toolbelt
Toolbelt.desc: The Toolbelt is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for. While equipped, it grants +1 placement range, but not tool range.

Toolbox.name: Toolbox
Toolbox.desc: The Toolbox is a construction accessory that is obtained when opening Presents dropped during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.309% in pre-Hardmode and 0.288% in Hardmode. While equipped, it grants +1 placement range and tool range.
Toolbox.tip: Increases block placement & tool range by 1

Topaz.name: Topaz
Topaz.desc: Topaz is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It is the second-least valuable gem available, being able to craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and it also has two exclusive recipes: the Sandgun and the Magiluminescence.

Topaz Robe.name: Topaz Robe
Topaz Robe.desc: The Topaz Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Topaz Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to burst in a large area of effect when the projectile expires, doing 35% of the original knockback and damage.
Topaz Robe.tip: Increases maximum mana by 40 · 7% reduced mana cost · Enchants gem-powered magic · Topazes burst brightly

Topaz Staff.name: Topaz Staff
Topaz Staff.desc: The Topaz Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a yellow bolt which does not pierce and explodes upon dissipating, dealing 35% of the weapon's damage ( base damage) and knockback (base knockback of ) to other nearby enemies within an area, but not to the target hit directly by the bolt.
Topaz Staff.tip: Topazes burst brightly · Its power may be enchanted by other gems

Torch God's Favor.name: Torch God's Favor
Torch God's Favor.desc: Torch God's Favor is a permanent booster item that permanently grants the player the ability to automatically convert regular Torches and Campfires in the player's hand to the current biome's torch or campfire variant, which increases the player's torch luck in most areas.
Torch God's Favor.tip: Unlocks an ability toggle to the left of the inventory · When enabled normal torches change according to your biome

Torch God's Flavor.name: Torch God's Flavor
Torch God's Flavor.desc: The Torch God's Flavor is a buff potion which grants the Torch Blessing buff when consumed. The buff automatically converts placed Torches near the player to their biome variant, corresponding to the biome the player is in.
Torch God's Flavor.tip: Nearby torches will be converted to match the biome

Blue Torch.name: Blue Torch
Blue Torch.desc: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for each.

Toucan.name: Toucan
Toucan.desc: The Toucan is a critter that spawns in the Jungle during the daytime. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree during the day. It may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Toxic Sludge Banner.name: Toxic Sludge Banner
Toxic Sludge Banner.desc: The Toxic Sludge is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer in place of ordinary slimes. It deals significantly increased damage and has a 1/2 chance of inflicting the Poisoned debuff for 10 / 20 / seconds, which it is also immune to.
Toxic Sludge Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Toxic Sludge

Toxikarp.name: Toxikarp
Toxikarp.desc: The Toxikarp is a Hardmode ranged weapon that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in the Corruption biome in any layer.

Toy Sled.name: Toy Sled
Toy Sled.desc: The Toy Sled is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Snowman that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Snowman rides in a toy sled to catch up to them. The Toy Sled has a 1/20 chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics.

Toy Tank.name: Toy Tank
Toy Tank.desc: The Toy Tank is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Santank Mount. The mount is notable for having a double jump as well as two auto-targeting weapons attached; a front-facing machine gun and a homing rocket launcher.
Toy Tank.tip: Summons a rideable Santank mount · 'For the REALLY naughty ones.'

Toybreaker Brick.name: Toybreaker Brick
Toybreaker Brick.desc: The Toybreaker Brick is a Hardmode, post-Plantera brick sold by the Cyborg for. It despawns "toy" projectiles upon contact, returning them to the player's inventory. It affects projectiles from the following items:
Toybreaker Brick.tip: Breaks most toys when touched · 'NO FUN ALLOWED!'

Tragic Umbrella.name: Tragic Umbrella
Tragic Umbrella.desc: The Tragic Umbrella is a pre-Hardmode shortsword and held item that can be purchased from the Clothier for while in a Graveyard. It functions identical to the standard Umbrella, aside from dealing higher damage.
Tragic Umbrella.tip: You will fall slower while holding this

Trap Door.name: Trap Door
Trap Door.desc: Trap Doors are furniture items. They are essentially full-block horizontal Doors. Trap Doors can be opened using Right Click, causing them to expand into a 2x2 block. They fulfill a house's door requirement.

Fake_newchest1.name: Fake_newchest1
Fake_newchest1.desc: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest. It cannot be used for storage, as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire.
