Treasure Hunter Pants.name: Treasure Hunter Pants
Treasure Hunter Pants.desc: The Treasure Hunter set is a vanity set. It consists of a Treasure Hunter Shirt and Treasure Hunter Pants. It has a 2/57 chance of being obtained from opening Goodie Bags.

Treasure Hunter Shirt.name: Treasure Hunter Shirt
Treasure Hunter Shirt.desc: The Treasure Hunter set is a vanity set. It consists of a Treasure Hunter Shirt and Treasure Hunter Pants. It has a 2/57 chance of being obtained from opening Goodie Bags.

Treasure Magnet.name: Treasure Magnet
Treasure Magnet.desc: The Treasure Magnet is a post-Skeletron accessory which increases the pickup range of items from 2.625 tiles to 12 tiles while equipped. When an item is within its range, before directly flying to the player, it will hover a few blocks off the ground.

Treasure Map.name: Treasure Map
Treasure Map.desc: The Treasure Map is a decorative wall hanging randomly obtained as a reward for Angler fishing quests (1% chance).

Tree Globe.name: Tree Globe
Tree Globe.desc: The Tree Globe is a thrown consumable item sold by the Zoologist for after 50% of the Bestiary has been filled out. When a Tree Globe is thrown and shatters on a surface, all of the trees in the current biome will switch to another random style.
Tree Globe.tip: Toss it to change how trees look! · 'Time for a change of scenery'

Tree Mask.name: Tree Mask
Tree Mask.desc: The Tree set is a vanity set consisting of the Tree Mask, Tree Shirt, and Tree Trunks. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. Its male and female variants look identical.

Tree Shirt.name: Tree Shirt
Tree Shirt.desc: The Tree set is a vanity set consisting of the Tree Mask, Tree Shirt, and Tree Trunks. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. Its male and female variants look identical.

Tree Trunks.name: Tree Trunks
Tree Trunks.desc: The Tree set is a vanity set consisting of the Tree Mask, Tree Shirt, and Tree Trunks. It is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode. Its male and female variants look identical.

Trident.name: Trident
Trident.desc: The Trident is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 9/40 chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates. When held while submerged in water or lava, the player is granted increased movement speed and jump height.
Trident.tip: Increases mobility in water when held · Hold Up to descend slower

Trifold Map.name: Trifold Map
Trifold Map.desc: The Trifold Map is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Confused debuff. It has a 1/100 / 199/10000 chance to drop from Clowns, Giant Bats, and Light Mummies.

Tropical Smoothie.desc: The Tropical Smoothie is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.
Tropical Smoothie.tip: Minor improvements to all stats · 'Real smooth'

Trout.name: Trout
Trout.desc: Trout are a type of fish which are found plentifully by fishing in the Ocean in the Sky or Surface layers.

True Copper Shortsword.name: True Copper Shortsword
True Copper Shortsword.desc: The True Copper Shortsword is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee weapon obtained by throwing the Zenith into Shimmer. It functions completely identically to the Zenith, but every sword used in its attack animation is replaced with the Copper Shortsword.

Truffle Worm.name: Truffle Worm
Truffle Worm.desc: The Truffle Worm is a rare Hardmode critter and boss-summoning item that spawns in the underground Glowing Mushroom biome. It summons Duke Fishron when used as bait. It can only be used in the Ocean, at any time. It emits a small amount of light.

Tsunami in a Bottle.name: Tsunami in a Bottle
Tsunami in a Bottle.desc: The Tsunami in a Bottle is an accessory which can be found in Wooden, Iron, Pearlwood Crate, and Mythril Crate.
Tsunami in a Bottle.tip: Allows the holder to double jump

Tuna.name: Tuna
Tuna.desc: Tuna are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in the Ocean in the Sky or Surface layers.

Tungsten Chainmail.name: Tungsten Chainmail
Tungsten Chainmail.desc: Tungsten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tungsten Helmet, Tungsten Chainmail, and Tungsten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Tungsten Bars (240 Tungsten Ore). The full set grants 15 defense while equipped.

Tungsten Greaves.name: Tungsten Greaves
Tungsten Greaves.desc: Tungsten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tungsten Helmet, Tungsten Chainmail, and Tungsten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Tungsten Bars (240 Tungsten Ore). The full set grants 15 defense while equipped.

Tungsten Helmet.name: Tungsten Helmet
Tungsten Helmet.desc: Tungsten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Tungsten Helmet, Tungsten Chainmail, and Tungsten Greaves. Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Tungsten Bars (240 Tungsten Ore). The full set grants 15 defense while equipped.

Tungsten Axe.name: Tungsten Axe
Tungsten Axe.desc: The Tungsten Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Tungsten Bar.name: Tungsten Bar
Tungsten Bar.desc: The Tungsten Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Tungsten Bow.name: Tungsten Bow
Tungsten Bow.desc: The Tungsten Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tungsten Brick.name: Tungsten Brick
Tungsten Brick.desc: Tungsten Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material. Like the ore it is made of, placed Tungsten Bricks will sparkle. It is not recommended that it be used for building unless the player has tungsten to spare. Despite being made of Tungsten, it has no sell value.

Tungsten Brick Wall.name: Tungsten Brick Wall
Tungsten Brick Wall.desc: Tungsten Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Tungsten Bricks. Like most walls, they will stop enemy spawning, and can be used for NPC houses.

Tungsten Broadsword.name: Tungsten Broadsword
Tungsten Broadsword.desc: The Tungsten Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Tungsten Bullet.name: Tungsten Bullet
Tungsten Bullet.desc: The Tungsten Bullet is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It deals more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g.

Tungsten Hammer.name: Tungsten Hammer
Tungsten Hammer.desc: The Tungsten Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Tungsten Ore.name: Tungsten Ore
Tungsten Ore.desc: Tungsten Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Tungsten Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Tungsten Pickaxe.name: Tungsten Pickaxe
Tungsten Pickaxe.desc: The Tungsten Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Meteorite.

Tungsten Shortsword.name: Tungsten Shortsword
Tungsten Shortsword.desc: The Tungsten Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword.

Turtle.name: Turtle
Turtle.desc: The Turtle is a critter which can spawn in bodies of water in the Forest during the day. They move slowly on land and swim at the surface of water.

Turtle Helmet.name: Turtle Helmet
Turtle Helmet.desc: Turtle armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses melee armor set consisting of the Turtle Helmet, Turtle Scale Mail, and Turtle Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 54 Chlorophyte Bars (270 Chlorophyte Ore) and 3 Turtle Shells.
Turtle Helmet.tip: 6% increased melee damage · Enemies are more likely to target you

Turtle Leggings.name: Turtle Leggings
Turtle Leggings.desc: Turtle armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses melee armor set consisting of the Turtle Helmet, Turtle Scale Mail, and Turtle Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 54 Chlorophyte Bars (270 Chlorophyte Ore) and 3 Turtle Shells.
Turtle Leggings.tip: 4% increased melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you

Turtle Scale Mail.name: Turtle Scale Mail
Turtle Scale Mail.desc: Turtle armor is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses melee armor set consisting of the Turtle Helmet, Turtle Scale Mail, and Turtle Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 54 Chlorophyte Bars (270 Chlorophyte Ore) and 3 Turtle Shells.
Turtle Scale Mail.tip: 8% increased melee damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you

Tuxedo Pants.name: Tuxedo Pants
Tuxedo Pants.desc: The Tuxedo set is a vanity set consisting of the Top Hat, Tuxedo Shirt and Tuxedo Pants.

Tuxedo Shirt.name: Tuxedo Shirt
Tuxedo Shirt.desc: The Tuxedo set is a vanity set consisting of the Top Hat, Tuxedo Shirt and Tuxedo Pants.

Lazer Blazer.name: Lazer Blazer
Lazer Blazer.desc: The TV Head set is a vanity set consisting of the Video Visage, the Lazer Blazer, and the Pinstripe Pants.
Lazer Blazer.tip: 'How bad could business possibly be?' · Concept by Dr.Zootsuit

Pinstripe Pants.name: Pinstripe Pants
Pinstripe Pants.desc: The TV Head set is a vanity set consisting of the Video Visage, the Lazer Blazer, and the Pinstripe Pants.
Pinstripe Pants.tip: 'I can't decide... leather or suede?' · Concept by Dr.Zootsuit

Video Visage.name: Video Visage
Video Visage.desc: The TV Head set is a vanity set consisting of the Video Visage, the Lazer Blazer, and the Pinstripe Pants.
Video Visage.tip: 'You can't see me behind the screen, I'm half human and half machine...' · Concept by Dr.Zootsuit

Twilight Dye.name: Twilight Dye
Twilight Dye.desc: Twilight Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader. It can, like other dyes, be equipped in the dyes slot in the player's equipment or accessory tabs in their inventory.

Twilight Grasp.name: Twilight Grasp
Twilight Grasp.desc: The Twilight Grasp is a Hardmode accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Twilight Grasp.tip: Increases your max number of summon tag effects by 2 · Significantly increases the duration of your summon tag effects · Increases whip knockback

Twinkle Popper Banner.name: Twinkle Popper Banner
Twinkle Popper Banner.desc: The Twinkle Popper is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events.
Twinkle Popper Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Twinkle Popper

Ugly Sweater.name: Ugly Sweater
Ugly Sweater.desc: The Ugly Sweater is a vanity item dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a chance of 1.08% in pre-Hardmode and 1.008% in Hardmode.

Ultrabright Helmet.name: Ultrabright Helmet
Ultrabright Helmet.desc: The Ultrabright Helmet is an armor piece for the helmet slot that combines the functionalities of the Mining Helmet and the Night Vision Helmet.
Ultrabright Helmet.tip: Improves vision and provides light when worn · 'The darkness holds no secrets for you'

Umbrella Hat.name: Umbrella Hat
Umbrella Hat.desc: The Umbrella Hat is a vanity item that has a 1/45 chance to drop from Umbrella Slimes during the Rain event.

Umbrella Slime Banner.name: Umbrella Slime Banner
Umbrella Slime Banner.desc: The Umbrella Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns during rainy days on the surface, holding an umbrella. It is larger than and statistically superior to Blue and Green Slimes.
Umbrella Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Umbrella Slime

Undead Miner Banner.name: Undead Miner Banner
Undead Miner Banner.desc: The Undead Miner is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer and follows the Fighter AI. Undead Miners wear a Mining Helmet, which provides a small amount of light around them.
Undead Miner Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Undead Miner

Undead Viking Banner.name: Undead Viking Banner
Undead Viking Banner.desc: The Undead Viking is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. It behaves similarly to the Skeleton, but spawns more frequently and jumps higher.
Undead Viking Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Undead Viking

Unholy Trident.name: Unholy Trident
Unholy Trident.desc: The Unholy Trident is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss wand that fires high-velocity purple tridents which lose speed as they travel and have armor penetration, and inflict the Shadowflame debuff for 5–10 seconds on hit.

Unicorn Banner.name: Unicorn Banner
Unicorn Banner.desc: The Unicorn is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Hallow. It is a very fast enemy that has a rather large amount of health and can jump approximately 7 tiles high and 20 tiles wide. The Unicorn leaps around and charges, attempting to trample the player.
Unicorn Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Unicorn

Unicorn on a Stick.name: Unicorn on a Stick
Unicorn on a Stick.desc: The Unicorn on a Stick is a Hardmode novelty item which, when selected, is held stationary in front of the player to provide the illusion that they are riding a unicorn. It has no real function, unlike the Unicorn Mount.

Unicorn Mask.name: Unicorn Mask
Unicorn Mask.desc: The Unicorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Unicorn Mask, Unicorn Shirt, and Unicorn Pants. It can be obtained from Goodie Bags, which are dropped by enemies with a 2/57 chance during the Halloween seasonal event.

Unicorn Pants.name: Unicorn Pants
Unicorn Pants.desc: The Unicorn set is a vanity set consisting of the Unicorn Mask, Unicorn Shirt, and Unicorn Pants. It can be obtained from Goodie Bags, which are dropped by enemies with a 2/57 chance during the Halloween seasonal event.

Universal Pylon.name: Universal Pylon
Universal Pylon.desc: The Universal Pylon is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord pylon obtained by completing 100% of the Bestiary, at which point it will be sold by the Zoologist for.
Universal Pylon.tip: Teleport to another pylon · Can function anywhere · 'You must construct additional pylons'

Unlucky Yarn.desc: The Unlucky Yarn is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Black Cat that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Black Cat flies on a broom to catch up with them.

Valkyrie Yoyo.desc: The Valkyrie Yoyo is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Lazure's set.

Vampire Banner.desc: The Vampire is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It will transform into a bat if the player is far enough away from it, and attempts to fly near the player at high speed before turning back into a humanoid.
Vampire Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Vampire

Vampire Frog Staff.name: Vampire Frog Staff
Vampire Frog Staff.desc: The Vampire Frog Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Vampire Frog minion. It hops towards enemies to deal contact damage. The Vampire Frog Staff has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Mermen.
Vampire Frog Staff.tip: Summons a vampire frog to fight for you

Vicious Bunny Banner.name: Vicious Bunny Banner
Vicious Bunny Banner.desc: The Vicious Bunny is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Bunny that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vicious Powder on it or when a Bunny spawns during a Blood Moon in a Crimson world.
Vicious Bunny Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Vicious Bunny

Vicious Mushroom.desc: The Vicious Mushroom is a type of mushroom found on grass in The Crimson, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing of any weapon or tool. Vicious Mushroom can only grow when there are proper walls behind the soil block, or no walls at all.

Vicious Penguin Banner.name: Vicious Penguin Banner

Viking Helmet.name: Viking Helmet

Violet Husk.name: Violet Husk
Violet Husk.desc: The Violet Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Lac Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Jungle. Its sole purpose is to make Violet Dye.

Vital Crystal.name: Vital Crystal
Vital Crystal.desc: The Vital Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's health regeneration. It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing a Life Crystal into Shimmer.

Closed Void Bag.desc: The Void Bag is a portable storage item that grants the player access to the Void Vault anywhere. When used, it will summon a temporary portal which lasts for 3 minutes, and pressing Right Click on the portal opens the player's Void Vault inventory.
Closed Void Bag.tip: Summons the Void Vault · Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops · Functions as an extended inventory when open · May pick up overflowing items when open · Right click to open · 'This pocket dimension is out of this world!'

Void Bag.name: Void Bag
Void Bag.desc: The Void Bag is a portable storage item that grants the player access to the Void Vault anywhere. When used, it will summon a temporary portal which lasts for 3 minutes, and pressing Right Click on the portal opens the player's Void Vault inventory.

Void Vault.name: Void Vault
Void Vault.desc: The Void Vault is a placeable portable storage item that extends the player's inventory in a manner similar to the Piggy Bank, Safe, and Defender's Forge. Like all other storage items, the Void Vault provides 40 slots of storage.
Void Vault.tip: Can be used to store your items · Stored items can only be accessed by you · Stored coins can be used in shops · Will contain items picked up by a Void Bag

Volatile Gelatin.name: Volatile Gelatin
Volatile Gelatin.desc: The Volatile Gelatin is a Hardmode accessory that periodically fires small, purple slimeballs similar to those of the Queen Slime's Regal Gel projectiles at nearby enemies.

Vortex Breastplate.name: Vortex Breastplate
Vortex Breastplate.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Vortex Fragments.
Vortex Breastplate.tip: 12% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · 25% chance to save ammo

Vortex Helmet.name: Vortex Helmet
Vortex Helmet.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Vortex Fragments.
Vortex Helmet.tip: 16% increased ranged damage · 7% increased ranged critical strike chance

Vortex Leggings.name: Vortex Leggings
Vortex Leggings.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings. Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite) and 45 Vortex Fragments.
Vortex Leggings.tip: 8% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · 10% increased movement speed

Vortex Brick.name: Vortex Brick
Vortex Brick.desc: The Vortex Brick is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist brick that is crafted from Vortex Fragments. It is one of the four Fragment Bricks, bricks which are crafted with Lunar Fragments. It glows when placed and can be used to craft Vortex furniture.

Vortex Brick Wall.name: Vortex Brick Wall
Vortex Brick Wall.desc: Vortex Brick Wall is a background wall made from Vortex Bricks.

Vortex Fragment Block.name: Vortex Fragment Block
Vortex Fragment Block.desc: Vortex Fragment Blocks are blocks made from Vortex Fragments which are dropped by the Vortex Pillar. The blocks have a crystal-like appearance with intense shades of green and blue. They can be crafted with the Ancient Manipulator. Walls cannot be crafted with them.

Vortexian Banner.name: Vortexian Banner
Vortexian Banner.desc: The Vortexian is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks towards the player, trying to deal contact damage.
Vortexian Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Vortexian

Vulgar Display of Flower.name: Vulgar Display of Flower
Vulgar Display of Flower.desc: The Vulgar Display of Flower is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera. It has a 15% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
Vulgar Display of Flower.tip: 9 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with volatile energy · Violent petals bloom from enemies hit by summons · 'A thorn-barbed whip ripped from the Queen of the Jungle herself? Metal!'

Vulture Banner.name: Vulture Banner
Vulture Banner.desc: The Vulture is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that commonly spawns in Deserts during the day; however, they can also spawn roosting on Sand Blocks in any biome. When the player comes close or attacks a Vulture, it will begin to fly at the player.
Vulture Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Vulture

Waffle's Iron.name: Waffle's Iron
Waffle's Iron.desc: The Waffle's Iron is a Hardmode sword that shoots a waffle projectile once per swing, which is significantly affected by gravity. The frying pan itself also has a 1/3 chance to inflict the Hellfire debuff upon contact for 5 seconds.

Wall Anchor.name: Wall Anchor
Wall Anchor.desc: The Wall Anchor is a wall decoration acquired by completing Angler NPC quests.

Wall Creeper Banner.desc: The Wall Creeper is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be found in and around Spider Nests in the Cavern layer, mostly during pre-Hardmode.

Wall Racer Car.name: Wall Racer Car
Wall Racer Car.desc: The Wall Racer Car is a Hardmode, post-Plantera novelty item purchased from the Cyborg for. Pressing the Left Click button while selected in the hotbar summons a harmless car that can be controlled by the Left Click, and Right Click buttons and the Jump to jump.
Wall Racer Car.tip: Press Jump to drive on the walls if they are behind the car · 'Last rule of Car Club, we always talk about Car Club'

Wall Skeleton.name: Wall Skeleton
Wall Skeleton.desc: The Wall Skeleton is a Decorative Furniture item that can be placed on walls, similar to Paintings. Wall Skeletons can only be obtained by looting them from the Dungeon, where they only appear in areas backed by Slab Walls.

Wandering Eye Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Wandering Eye

Hallowed Water Fountain.tip: Changes the color of nearby water

Water Gun.name: Water Gun
Water Gun.desc: The Water Gun is a tool that sprays a stream of water which inflicts the Wet debuff on players, enemies, and NPCs for 25 seconds. Additionally, the stream turns off most light sources, as opposed to the slime of the Slime Gun, which turns them on.
Water Gun.tip: Squirts a stream of water that can turn most lights off · Wet players and creatures become immune to fire

Water Strider.name: Water Strider
Water Strider.desc: The Water Strider is a harmless critter that spawns on bodies of water on the Surface during the day. It only spawns near Sand or Jungle grass blocks, but not in the Ocean biome. It will not spawn if the wind speed exceeds 20 or if it is raining.

Waterfall Block.name: Waterfall Block
Waterfall Block.desc: The Waterfall Block is an animated block type which shows flowing water.

Waterfall Wall.name: Waterfall Wall
Waterfall Wall.desc: Waterfall Wall is one of only a few animated background walls. It depicts flowing water.

Waterleaf Seeds.name: Waterleaf Seeds
Waterleaf Seeds.desc: Waterleaf Seeds are a type of seed that can be obtained from harvesting Waterleaves while they are blooming or using the Staff of Regrowth on naturally grown Waterleaves while they are fully grown. A Waterleaf plant only blooms during Rain.

Weapon Rack.name: Weapon Rack
Weapon Rack.desc: The Weapon Rack is a furniture item that can be placed on background walls. By pressing the Right Click button on it, a player can mount any weapon-type item for display, including damage-dealing tools.
Weapon Rack.tip: Right click to place item on weapon rack

Weather Pain.name: Weather Pain
Weather Pain.desc: The Weather Pain is a pre-Hardmode wand that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Deerclops. When used, it fires a Hurtnado that dissipates after 570 ticks or after hitting 15 enemies.
Weather Pain.tip: Ignores 10 points of enemy Defense · 'What a pane... heh'

Weather Radio.name: Weather Radio
Weather Radio.desc: The Weather Radio is an informational accessory that displays the current weather and wind speed on the Surface, even if the player is in the Underground, Cavern, or Underworld layers.

Weather Vane.name: Weather Vane
Weather Vane.desc: The Weather Vane is a decoration piece that will periodically sway in the wind if placed in the surface or space layer, and without a background wall behind it. During the Windy Day event, it will point to the direction of the wind.

Web Covered Chest.name: Web Covered Chest
Web Covered Chest.desc: Web Covered Chests can be found in Spider Nests, though they are rare. They always contain a Web Slinger, in addition to common or uncommon items (also found in Gold Chests) depending on the height they were found: Underground or Caverns.

Wedding Dress.name: Wedding Dress
Wedding Dress.desc: The Wedding set is a vanity set which consists of the Wedding Veil and the Wedding Dress. They are guaranteed to be dropped by The Bride, a rare enemy that spawns during a Blood Moon and in the Graveyard mini biome.

Wedding Veil.name: Wedding Veil
Wedding Veil.desc: The Wedding set is a vanity set which consists of the Wedding Veil and the Wedding Dress. They are guaranteed to be dropped by The Bride, a rare enemy that spawns during a Blood Moon and in the Graveyard mini biome.

Welding Mask.name: Welding Mask
Welding Mask.desc: The Welding Mask is a Hardmode vanity accessory.

Werewolf Banner.name: Werewolf Banner
Werewolf Banner.desc: The Werewolf is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns at night only while a full moon is active. Werewolves can open doors and have a 1/8 chance to inflict the Bleeding debuff for 45 / 90 / seconds.
Werewolf Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Werewolf

White Horseshoe Balloon.name: White Horseshoe Balloon
White Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The White Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck.
White Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to double jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

White Tuxedo Pants.name: White Tuxedo Pants
White Tuxedo Pants.desc: The White Tuxedo set is a vanity set consisting of the White Tuxedo Shirt and the White Tuxedo Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, on the night of a Full Moon.

White Tuxedo Shirt.name: White Tuxedo Shirt
White Tuxedo Shirt.desc: The White Tuxedo set is a vanity set consisting of the White Tuxedo Shirt and the White Tuxedo Pants. It is purchased from the Clothier for, on the night of a Full Moon.

Whoopie Cushion.name: Whoopie Cushion
Whoopie Cushion.desc: The Whoopie Cushion is a voice accessory that makes a farting sound when the player takes damage while it is equipped. It can also be used with the Left Click key to play the sound at any time.

Will's Breastplate.name: Will's Breastplate
Will's Breastplate.desc: It is the vanity set made for Phlebas, an artist who formerly developed graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.

Wilted Clover.desc: The Wilted Clover is an item obtained by throwing a Lucky Clover into Shimmer. It decreases the player's luck by 0.1 while it is in their inventory or opened Void Bag. Having more than one Wilted Clover does not decrease luck any further.
Wilted Clover.tip: 'Watering this lucky charm with Shimmer maybe wasn't the best idea...'

Wire Bulb.name: Wire Bulb
Wire Bulb.desc: The Wire Bulb is a light source that has multiple colors. It is purchased from the Mechanic for. Each corner can be lit up by wires. Each color of wire lights up a different corner. As there are four wire colors, there are four corners with four separate colors.
Wire Bulb.tip: Lights up bulbs for each wire color

Wire Cutter.name: Wire Cutter
Wire Cutter.desc: The Wire Cutter is a tool that allows players to free and harvest Wires and Actuators. It is sold by the Mechanic NPC who is initially found in the Dungeon.

Wisp Dye.name: Wisp Dye
Wisp Dye.desc: Wisp Dye is a Hardmode, post-Plantera dye obtained from the Dye Trader when turning in a Strange Plant. It causes equipment it is applied to gain a solid bright cyan texture with no animation. It is based off the light pet summoned by the Wisp in a Bottle.

Wisp in a Bottle.name: Wisp in a Bottle
Wisp in a Bottle.desc: The Wisp in a Bottle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera light pet-summoning item that spawns a light-providing Wisp that follows the player around. While active, it is similar to the Flickerwick.
Wisp in a Bottle.tip: Summons a Wisp to provide light

Witch Boots.name: Witch Boots
Witch Boots.desc: The Witch set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained from a Goodie Bags during the Halloween seasonal event. It consists of a Witch Hat, Witch Dress and Witch Boots. It may also be found in chests in Vampirism worlds.

Witch Dress.name: Witch Dress
Witch Dress.desc: The Witch set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained from a Goodie Bags during the Halloween seasonal event. It consists of a Witch Hat, Witch Dress and Witch Boots. It may also be found in chests in Vampirism worlds.

Witch Hat.name: Witch Hat
Witch Hat.desc: The Witch set is a vanity set. It has a 2/57 chance to be obtained from a Goodie Bags during the Halloween seasonal event. It consists of a Witch Hat, Witch Dress and Witch Boots. It may also be found in chests in Vampirism worlds.

Witch's Broom.name: Witch's Broom
Witch's Broom.desc: The Witch's Broom is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Witch's Broom, allowing the player to fly and hover indefinitely in any direction.

Wither Beast Banner.name: Wither Beast Banner
Wither Beast Banner.desc: The Wither Beast is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 6–7, and Tier 3 during waves 5–7.
Wither Beast Banner.tip: Nearby players get a small bonus against: Wither Beast

Wizard Hat.name: Wizard Hat
Wizard Hat.desc: The Wizard Hat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece that can be equipped in the helmet slot. While equipped, it grants + defense and increases the player's magic damage by 5%. It is always dropped by Tim.

Wolf Banner.desc: The Wolf is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome at night. It has the same AI as the Unicorn, and attacks by leaping and charging into the player. Like Unicorns, Wolves move at very fast speeds and can jump fairly high, making them one of the hardest enemies to evade.
Wolf Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Wolf

Wood Wall.name: Wood Wall
Wood Wall.desc: Wood Walls are a background wall made from Wood. Like other walls, it stops enemies from spawning when it is placed and can be used for houses.

Wooden Bow.name: Wooden Bow
Wooden Bow.desc: The Wooden Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Wooden Crate.name: Wooden Crate
Wooden Crate.desc: The Wooden Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can be obtained by fishing in any biome, at any height. It is the lowest tier of standard crate, having the least value if sold directly. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Pearlwood Crate.

World Feeder Banner.name: World Feeder Banner
World Feeder Banner.desc: The World Feeder is a Hardmode worm-like enemy which spawns in The Corruption, and can be considered the Hardmode counterpart of the Devourer. Loot is dropped from its head segment, so it can get stuck and buried deep in blocks if one of the main body parts is killed first.
World Feeder Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: World Feeder

World Globe.name: World Globe
World Globe.desc: The World Globe is a thrown consumable item sold by the Zoologist after the Bestiary is 50% complete.
World Globe.tip: Toss it to change how the world looks! · 'Time for a change of scenery'

Worm.name: Worm
Worm.desc: The Worm is a critter that spawns in the Underground layer at any time, or on the surface while it is raining. It also has a chance to spawn when grass plants or certain ambient dirt or stone piles are destroyed, jumping out of the destroyed object.

Worm Tooth.name: Worm Tooth
Worm Tooth.desc: Worm Tooth is a crafting material dropped by Devourers in The Corruption. Unlike most Corruption items, it does not have a Crimson equivalent.

Wraith Banner.name: Wraith Banner
Wraith Banner.desc: The Wraith is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface at night, can travel through blocks, and has a 1/8 chance to inflict the Slow debuff upon contact with the player for 15 / 30 / seconds.
Wraith Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Wraith

Blue Wrench.name: Blue Wrench
Blue Wrench.desc: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires, which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate. There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench, Green Wrench, Blue Wrench, and Yellow Wrench, each placing its respective color of Wire.

Green Wrench.name: Green Wrench
Green Wrench.desc: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires, which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate. There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench, Green Wrench, Blue Wrench, and Yellow Wrench, each placing its respective color of Wire.

Red Wrench.name: Red Wrench
Red Wrench.desc: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires, which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate. There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench, Green Wrench, Blue Wrench, and Yellow Wrench, each placing its respective color of Wire.

Yellow Wrench.name: Yellow Wrench
Yellow Wrench.desc: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires, which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate. There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench, Green Wrench, Blue Wrench, and Yellow Wrench, each placing its respective color of Wire.

Writhing Remains.name: Writhing Remains
Writhing Remains.desc: The Writhing Remains is a pet-summoning item that spawns an Eater of Worms that follows the player. The Writhing Remains has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Eater of Worlds in Master Mode.
Writhing Remains.tip: Summons the Eater of Worms · 'It'll give you worms!'

Wyvern Banner.name: Wyvern Banner
Wyvern Banner.desc: The Wyvern is a large Hardmode enemy that spawns in Space. It resembles a long, white and follows the Worm AI.
Wyvern Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Wyvern

Xenon Moss Brick Wall.name: Xenon Moss Brick Wall
Xenon Moss Brick Wall.desc: Xenon Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Xenon Moss and the Xenon Moss Brick it is made from.

Yelets.name: Yelets
Yelets.desc: The Yelets is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that has a 1/200 chance to drop from any enemy killed in the Jungle and Underground Jungle, including in the Jungle Temple. It inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 2 seconds on hit.

Yellow Horseshoe Balloon.name: Yellow Horseshoe Balloon
Yellow Horseshoe Balloon.desc: The Yellow Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 75%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck.
Yellow Horseshoe Balloon.tip: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

Yellow Marigold.name: Yellow Marigold
Yellow Marigold.desc: The Yellow Marigold is a type of plant. It grows on regular grass and Hallowed grass above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Yellow Dye.

Yellow Slime Banner.name: Yellow Slime Banner
Yellow Slime Banner.desc: The Yellow Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer, alongside Red Slimes. They are slightly larger and stronger than Purple Slimes.
Yellow Slime Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Yellow Slime

Yellow Willow Sapling.name: Yellow Willow Sapling
Yellow Willow Sapling.desc: The Yellow Willow Sapling is a type of seed that grows into a Yellow Willow tree, which is a tree that can also spawn naturally in Forest biomes, when planted. Its appearance is purely decorative and it functions identically to regular forest trees.

Yeti Banner.name: Yeti Banner
Yeti Banner.desc: The Yeti is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 12 of the Frost Moon event. It behaves similarly to Krampus and the Nutcracker, although it is much stronger and is immune to knockback.
Yeti Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Yeti

Yoraiz0r's Recolored Goggles.name: Yoraiz0r's Recolored Goggles
Yoraiz0r's Recolored Goggles.desc: It is the vanity set made for Yoraiz0r, one of the programmers who develops Terraria. The Scowl will add a shadow effect over the character's eyes.

Yoraiz0r's Scowl.name: Yoraiz0r's Scowl
Yoraiz0r's Scowl.desc: It is the vanity set made for Yoraiz0r, one of the programmers who develops Terraria. The Scowl will add a shadow effect over the character's eyes.
Yoraiz0r's Scowl.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · If you see this you should probably run away...

Yoraiz0r's Skirt.name: Yoraiz0r's Skirt
Yoraiz0r's Skirt.desc: It is the vanity set made for Yoraiz0r, one of the programmers who develops Terraria. The Scowl will add a shadow effect over the character's eyes.

Yoraiz0r's Uniform.name: Yoraiz0r's Uniform
Yoraiz0r's Uniform.desc: It is the vanity set made for Yoraiz0r, one of the programmers who develops Terraria. The Scowl will add a shadow effect over the character's eyes.

Yoraiz0r's Spell.name: Yoraiz0r's Spell
Yoraiz0r's Spell.desc: Yoraiz0r's Spell is a developer wing. Like other developer items, it is dropped along with its respective developer's vanity set, which is Yoraiz0r's set.
Yoraiz0r's Spell.tip: 'Great for impersonating devs!' · Allows flight and slow fall · Whatever this accessory does to you is not a bug!

Yoyo Glove.name: Yoyo Glove
Yoyo Glove.desc: The Yoyo Glove is a Hardmode accessory that is purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for. While equipped, hitting an enemy with a yoyo will create a duplicate of that yoyo that rapidly orbits around the main one.
Yoyo Glove.tip: Allows the use of two yoyos at once

drops.chance: More info (In I am error worlds)

Zephyr Fish.name: Zephyr Fish
Zephyr Fish.desc: The Zephyr Fish is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Zephyr Fish pet that follows the player. The pet will not teleport to the player when it is far away, unlike most other pets. The Zephyr Fish is rarely caught from fishing in any body of water.

Zombie Banner.name: Zombie Banner
Zombie Banner.desc: The Zombie is a common pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface at night, and is a primary reason newer players will want to build a shelter before night arrives.
Zombie Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Zombie

Zombie Arm.name: Zombie Arm
Zombie Arm.desc: The Zombie Arm is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/250 chance of being dropped by Zombies, Frozen Zombies, and Raincoat Zombies. When held, it visually appears on the player. It will also randomly release visual Zombie gore when swung.

Zombie Elf Banner.name: Zombie Elf Banner
Zombie Elf Banner.desc: The Zombie Elf is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. They are the most basic fighter-type enemy that spawns during the event, and despite being relatively easy to hold off, they still deal heavy contact damage.
Zombie Elf Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Zombie Elf

Zombie Merman Banner.name: Zombie Merman Banner
Zombie Merman Banner.desc: The Zombie Merman is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Zombie Merman or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish.
Zombie Merman Banner.tip: Nearby players get a bonus against: Zombie Merman
